ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par01_: Patch 1.4 introduces various improvements and fixes to the game. Here, we highlight the most important ones, starting with A-Life. With this update, stalkers are now living their long, happy lives, unless they meet their end in the Zone as a result of their actions outside the player's view.
Stalkers, welcome to the updated Zone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par02_: Mutants! There is no need for research from SIRCAA scientists to figure out how mutants have survived in the Zone for so long. With countless fights happening all the time, there are plenty of corpses for them to taste! With this update, we made sure that you can now spectate this process by yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par03_: If you think that you can just approach mutants to spectate them doing their things like it’s the Zoo — we suggest you think again. From now on, all creatures are alerted if something is happening near or approaching them. They will sniff around, put their ears to the ground (figuratively), and howl to double-check if something or someone is trespassing their territory.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par04_: Don’t be afraid to use it to your advantage. Be more cautious, as you’ll hear or see mutants getting suspicious, alert, and ready to defend their ground. You see them doing things above — it's your sign to get the hell out of there, unless you’re looking for a fight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par05_: It’s not just the mutants that got smarter. We improved human combat, making it harder and more tactical. Stalkers now flank more often, use cover more effectively, hide behind the trees, and no longer spam grenades. The squad moves more tactically in combat, and they don’t rush forward unless needed.
Behind a tree, behind a wall, they flank!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par06_: Players on Veteran and Stalker difficulties, be warned: close combat just got tougher.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par07_: Other updates to combat AI include improvements in communication and actions synchronization between characters in a squad. Now they communicate tactical actions and react more clearly in combat. Stalkers learned some tricks too! Now they can hit mutants hard with their weapon stocks, just like they can hit you in close combat!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par08_: Oh, and when the fight ends, you’ll surely be let know. Stalkers will look around for a brief moment, searching for enemies after combat ends, and then proceed to post-combat activities, such as looting and healing the wounded.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par09_: Some improvements are also worth mentioning. For example, no more snipe shots from shotguns. We fixed problems with pellet dispersion and non-natural ballistic distances. Also, stalkers who turn on flashlights are now slightly more illuminated and visible in the dark.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par10_: When looking at a weapon's stats in your inventory, you may notice some improvements. We’re introducing a new stat: Handling. It showcases how quickly you can interact with the weapon: the speed of aiming, equipping/unequipping, and even how fast Skif moves while aiming.
You know how to handle it, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par11_: Besides that, all stats displayed were redesigned for better comparison between weapons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par12_: More and more people are entering the Zone, searching for money, fame, glory, answers to their questions, or Monolith knows what else. So many new stalkers are now wandering through anomalies and abandoned villages. With this update, we bring more faces to the Zone; those are just a few examples.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par13_: Oh, and just for your information, if you are still reading — just a heads-up: Burer can now throw your grenade right back at you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par14_: This is not a complete list of changes, fixes, and improvements introduced in Patch 1.4. There are plenty of things we worked on, including Balance, Audio, Cutscenes, Quests & Encounters, Optimization, and more. The extended version of the patch notes can be found on our Steam page, while the full version is presented on our website. Please take a look!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch14HaM_par15_: Thank you so much for your continuous feedback and support. With your help, the Zone is becoming a better place with each update. We welcome your thoughts and comments on social media regarding this update, which helps us move forward and deliver a better experience for all stalkers!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par01_: Stalkers, welcome back to S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl. Time flies, and the Zone evolves once again. Before you dive into the new adventures, let’s take a look at new things introduced in Patch 1.5.
There, and back again… and again!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par02_: The Three-line rifle is a fast and relatively lightweight bolt-action sniper rifle with a respectable effective range. This new gun is a recent hit in the Zone, so you can meet Three-line connoisseurs in the very first days of your story. Three-line rifle will be a great choice for experienced players who practiced and mastered their aim.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par03_: Sometimes you want to feel the real power in your hands, there is a charm in clunky, slow weapons that carry a punch. Kora might not be as ergonomic and fast as its modern colleagues, but it delivers some serious damage, and you will feel the impact of each bullet shot from its limited magazine. Weapon collectors are already discussing how and where to get their hands on its unique variant: "Night Stalker".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par04_: Patch 1.5 introduces the new feature: looting of mutant parts. If the benefit of still being alive wasn’t compelling enough, now those angry bloodsuckers and fleshes are going to pay for all the lives of poor stalkers and, most importantly, ammo in eyes, tusks, and… tentacles. Grab them for traders, and enjoy your well-earned coupons, but do not forget to learn the tricks at Malachite before you try to get them in a decent tradable condition!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par05_: A-life NPCs are going to the bars tonight because now they are living their long, happy lives, unless they meet their end in the Zone as a result of their actions outside the player's view. We are expanding the Living Zone by making characters continue to live their lives and pursue their goals far from the player. Instead of deleting characters after the player moves far away, we continuously simulate each character's life until they die. The player will be able to encounter characters they haven't seen in a long time. New characters repopulate the Zone far away from the player, so recently cleared lairs won't have their inhabitants immediately respawn. The A-Life Director no longer generates fights at the edge of the player's visualization range, but instead spawns them much further away, making characters stream in more naturally.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par06_: Now when using cars as cover, you can meet some new “faces”. We updated our Zone car park with new models. Not as shiny as Ward-mobiles, of course, but in their prime time these cars were respectable vehicles. Now their rusted remains are mostly occupied by rodents.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par07_: New guns, new loot and trading opportunities, the Zone is getting nicer to stalkers? Don’t celebrate too soon, stalkers, She always has pocket aces. If you thought water was a safe haven in the Zone, think again. Now you can encounter anomalous water vortexes. Keep your eyes open when fishing!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par08_: Patch 1.5 introduces new QOL features such as an increased player stash window size, a clear icon representing its type for each ammo type, and reload renewal. Quickly access stashed ammo and enjoy Skif’s new skill: continuing reloads from where he left off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par09_: Those of you who are playing with Ukrainian voiceover will notice that in Patch 1.5 we added Ukrainian lipsync for all the cutscenes except for prerenders. Time to revisit some favorite story moments?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par10_: Shape the Zone your way with the Zone Kit! Unleash your tinkering nature and modify existing content or create something new — animations, weapons, mechanics, and even wonders of the Zone. Official Mod Support is here, so now is the time to create your own content and use modifications made by your fellow stalkers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par11_: game assets to craft unique adventures. You are free to tailor game assets to your own vision of the Zone. Time to express your creativity and do the wildest ideas!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par12_: Expand gameplay with new mechanics, weapons, enemies, and more. Now you can adjust the gameplay to your own specific preferences, whether you're seeking more challenge, less difficulty, or something entirely new.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par13_: Get the Zone Kit toolset on the Epic Games Store, and share your creations via MOD.IO or Steam Workshop, depending on your platform. More functionality and features will be added to the Kit in future S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl updates.
Install modifications in a few clicks
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par14_: We are incredibly lucky to have such a passionate community of stalkers. Together we are making the Zone a better place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par15_: The extended version of the patch notes is available on our Steam page, while the complete version can be found on our website. Feel free to check them out to see all the changes!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch15HaM_par16_: Thank you so much for your continuous feedback and support. With your help, the Zone is becoming a better place with each update. We welcome your thoughts and comments on social media regarding this update, which helps us move forward and deliver a better experience for all stalkers!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch16HaM_par05_: You think we're finished with NVGs?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch16HaM_par12_: Playing with a controller? This is for you
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch16HaM_par16_: And that's not all the updates
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par01_: Stalkers, welcome back to the Zone and to the newest changes in Update 1.7. Before we dive in – thank you so much for staying with us! A year ago, we began a new chapter in the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series, which we continue to update and improve based on your comments, suggestions, and feedback. And there’s more to come, starting with Update 1.7!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par02_: We’ve implemented numerous fixes and improvements to the A-Life system, so now factions can expand control over new territories. This means they may also lose control over their lands if they fail to defend them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par03_: Various points of interest, checkpoints, locations (but not hubs) are in contest between different NPCs and… mutants! They also want to defend their lairs and territories from their very unfriendly stalker-neighbors. You can either jump into the fights or stay away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par04_: We’ve introduced new difficulty level Master Difficulty to the game – a true challenge for the most experienced stalkers. Mutants and NPCs are much more deadly. A wrong step into an anomaly may kill. Radiation, hunger, sleepiness, and other effects can be extremely painful. Resources are low. Items are not as durable, and traders are not as economically friendly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par05_: There are plenty of other adjustments for the hardcore enjoyers, but there is one more to mention – saves! Your progress will only be saved when exiting a Hub and within some Main Quest story moments. That's it. This is the peak stalker experience, of course, if you are strong enough!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par06_: As for Expedition Mode – this one is for those who don’t want to endure the struggles of Master Difficulty, but want to feel each trip is an Expedition. It has the same progress save system as in Master, but with the option to choose other difficulty levels.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par07_: Note: Both Master Difficulty and Expedition Mode require starting a new campaign. You can’t activate/deactivate those from the settings menu in the campaign.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par08_: With Update 1.7, enemies have real problems detecting you in tall grass or reeds, and are much less accurate when shooting through the bushes. Swamp shootouts will feel fair at last! You can now use the greenery to your full advantage, but be cautious – the closer you are to an enemy, the more likely you are to be spotted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par09_: Mutants and NPCs have also learned to retreat from the fight if they realize that chances for survival are low. They will also try to flank more actively, and choose a distance to fight from that best suits their weapon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par10_: It’s also worth noting that NPC combat animation timings were slightly tweaked to make their movement more realistic. Oh, and mutants have also received new death animations!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par11_: We’ve completely redesigned the Equipment section in the Inventory. Firstly, we added protection stats. You’ll now be able to see exact info on how much protection you have from different Zone dangers. It calculates all the values from your armor, helmet, and artifacts, and also takes into consideration the equipment's wear and tear.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par12_: Secondly – stats for artifacts and consumables. From now on, those have 5 levels of stats, with a more user-friendly interface for better understanding the pros and cons of using them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par13_: And last but not least – the artifact radiation bar. This thing will help you understand whether you’ve balanced your artifacts well in terms of the radiation they produce. Keeping this bar level low will definitely help you to stay healthier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par14_: With Update 1.7, we’ve reworked the stamina mechanic and added a new, ‘second sprint’ state to the movement system! We also reworked how energy drinks affect you. From now on, frequent consumption is not recommended, as it may result in tremors and shortness of breath, which leads to aim difficulties. Drink responsibly!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par15_: The first one is pretty harmless, but looks very weird. It’s literally drops of water rising up to the sky from puddles on the ground.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par16_: The second anomaly can actually warm you in cold days and nights, but we don’t recommend using it in such a way because it’s too hot. Boiling hot, in fact! Test the new “Steam” anomaly with the bolt first.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par17_: From now on, you can lock to different enemies without re-targeting. Furthermore, you can now slightly correct your aim point on the locked enemy. As a nice bonus, you can set the time in seconds for how long you lock on to an enemy for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par18_: Introducing Immersive Mode, which allows you to quickly disable the entire HUD and change the FOV to a preset value so you can take beautiful screenshots or simply explore the Zone without distractions. It’s especially effective with the new Light Rainy weather scenario!
Even more updates in short format!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par19_: Another new thing – SD Cards with coupons on them in stashes. Think about those like digital wallets. Don’t want the headshot sound? Okay, then disable it. The navigation on the map in the PDA is also improved. Now, there’s an assist to select markers easily.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par20_: As a final touch, we’re also introducing DualSense™ controller support on PC (via wire) for those who want to feel the Zone even more!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par21_: The extended version of the patch notes is available on our Steam page, while the complete version can be found on our website. Feel free to check them out to see all the changes!
And those are not all updates
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch17HaM_par22_: Thank you very much for your ongoing support and feedback. With your help, the Zone is becoming a better place with each update. Please continue sharing your ideas and thoughts on our forums and socials, including those you have about Update 1.7. It helps us improve the game and deliver a better experience for all stalkers!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch19_par01_des: Places of horrific experiments on humanity and nature are spread across the Zone, sealed behind massive doors, or buried by the ashes of their own 'research' results. This time, there's a rumor across the Zone that Diode, a technician from Slag Heap, got access to the lower levels of the X18 lab!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch19_par02_des: Diode doesn’t care about loot, only about the one thing he really needs. It just so happens that Skif is now the man who can provide him with a pass to the lab, and a way to get richer. And what else do stalkers need besides a high risk, high reward gig with an air of mystery and the scent of secrets?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch19_par03_des: Besides, no one knows what's happening on the lower levels of X18. That’s on you to find out. Diode is paying well, and who knows, maybe by the end of it, you'll have your own reward – uncovered mysteries, things to use or sell, or even something for the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch19_par04_des: This won’t be a walk in the park. We're talking about an X-lab, so make sure to prepare your gear and be ready to face the unknown. We obviously won't spoil what's awaiting you in there, but we can tell you this – your decisions will affect the outcome.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch19_par05_des: As always, enjoy this free new content update, and thanks for staying with the Zone! Your comments and suggestions help us make the game better. Please continue sharing your feedback, and see you in the Zone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch19_par06_des: The update is available to players after completing the story quest "Hot on the Trail" and before starting the quest "A Minor Incident".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par01_des: Back to the Zone — Update 2.0 is our biggest overhaul to how the Zone looks, feels, and lives since launch. The technical work now runs deeper than before — including a significant engine upgrade — and alongside it, we've packed in features stalkers have been asking for, and a few things we've been wanting to show you for a while.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par02_des:
The lighting in the Zone has been changed significantly. The sun still shines brightly outside, but it now plays differently across the environment on the ground — shadows and reflections included. We've also improved indoor lighting to feel more realistic, both inside buildings and in underground locations.

On top of that, we've reworked the landscape and foliage to look more natural, and fixed hundreds of issues with levitating items — along with other miscellaneous bugs that felt like anomalies were turning up in the wrong places.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par03_des:
A-Life now simulates more believable behaviour — the Zone isn't one constant gunfight. It's a lonely place where life carries on by its own rules, and every encounter or firefight is the result of stalkers and mutants simply doing stalker and mutant things.

In practice: living creatures now have more places to be. More campfires, bus stops, and other points of interest are contested between stalkers and mutants. Stalkers across the Zone loot the fallen all the time — not just when you're around to see it.

We've also done plenty of under-the-hood work on behaviour that wasn't strictly A-Life but certainly felt like it: enemies occasionally shooting or throwing things through walls, sudden overpopulation of certain areas, and dozens of other fixes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par04_des:
Want more hardcore fights but a less punishing economy? Or do you find dodging anomalies far harder than managing coupons? With this update, we're introducing a "Custom Rules" difficulty — you can tune the settings yourself to craft your ideal experience.

As a side note: a while back we introduced the "Master" difficulty, along with a toggleable "Expedition" mode for the other difficulty levels. Give both a try if you're after a more hardcore stalker experience.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par05_des: Not one, but three types of binoculars are now at a stalker's disposal. Scout your surroundings, identify friends or targets, and plan your engagements well in advance. Each is equipped with different tech, with its own functionality and purpose. Find the one you prefer out in the Zone — or from certain traders for a less-than-fair price.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par06_des:
New toys keep getting smuggled through the Perimeter wall somehow — like the Arev (AR), GP3A (DMR), SIC (DMR), and Fora-230 (SMG). Better to try them yourself than have us explain how they handle in combat. And somewhere in the Zone, you'll even find a unique variant of one of them.

Your scope options have widened too: a new x3 scope for Western-bloc weapons and a new red dot sight for Eastern ones. Customise your loadout to fit your playstyle! Oh, and offset aiming is now no longer limited to NVGs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par06_nam: New weapons and scopes to use
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par07_des:
Not just weather, but a full-scale gameplay mechanic for every stalker to utilize. In the fog you and your enemies will see less — and even hear less. Use it to your advantage to play things sneaky, or simply soak in the atmosphere it brings to the Zone. It's up to you.

Along with the updated visuals, we've also reworked the Light Rainy weather scenario to look even more breathtaking.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par08_des: How many bullets have you wasted? What's your weapon of choice? Which mutant is your favourite to run into and put down? From now on, all of this and much more is tracked on your PDA's new "Statistics" page. Track it, share it — it's up to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par08_nam: New PDA page to track your progress
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par09_des: Around the Zone, you may now be attacked by bloodsuckers that look different depending on their habitat. The same goes for fleshes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par10_des: We've also delivered our first major DLC, which drags you right into the iconic conflict between Duty and Freedom. S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope is already available to all Ultimate Edition owners, and can also be bought separately. The Iron Forest and Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant regions are open to explore, with dozens of hours of story to see through to the end. We also added an ability to get straight into the DLC action for those who own it, if you want purely the Cost of Hope action. In addition to that, if you wish to continue with the current campaign and you've passed through the Point of No Return with no saves to jump back — we've got you covered as well with an option to go back to just before the point of no return.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par10_nam: The first DLC is now available to purchase!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par11_des:
The Zone Kit — official modding tool for S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 — has also received a major update. Newly available tools — narrative scripting, audio, and localization — are all working together, so you can write, voice and localize a complete story mod from start to finish with the ability to save the mod's data.

Download the Zone Kit for free and modify the Zone the way you like!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par11_nam: Create your own stories in the Zone Kit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par12_des: It's been a long journey since the original release of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2. With your feedback and continued support, we've done our best to improve your experience and make the Zone a better place. Please keep sharing your feedback across all our forums and socials — and massive thanks for being with the Zone all these years!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_misc_whatsNewPopUp_patch20_par12_nam: If you are still reading this — thank you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ALTQuest01note_body:
$J0L0I can't believe this is finally happening…
For several years we tried so fucking much.
My family, I can finally see them again, and with the resources we have from our raids I'll be able to pay for their treatment.
Same goes for other guys' families as well.
After all this was the only reason why we came here…
I personally consider this a miracle - to survive in this godforsaken place for so long. And not to lose your mind in the process.
It's all thanks to the boys. Don't know what would we all do without each other…$J0L0Some of us got a little injured during the last job, but that's just small bruises compared to the excitement we feel right now.
Still, I need to rest more.$J0L0Loki and several others left to get supplies and kits to get us back on our feet, and then it's just pretty much a straightforward road home. Well, as much straight as it can be in the Zone…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ANCQ01_HvorostPDANote_body:
$J0L0Vadya Kindling: Ever notice how there’s always a fuck-ton of blind dogs at the station?
Mykha Tur: They’re all over the place, man. That’s why I stick close to Zalissya.
Vadya Kindling: It’s like they’re drawn here. Maybe the equipment emits some kind of signal? Something that pulls them in?
Mykha Tur: Nah, all that equipment’s been fried a hundred times over! Folks hang out at the station, get loaded, pig out, and leave scraps everywhere – no wonder mutants come sniffing around.
Mykha Tur: You better scram before they overrun the place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ANCQ01_HvorostPDANote_hint: A chat from the Radiation Monitoring Station.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ANCQ01_HvorostPDANote_name: Vadya Kindling’s Chat with Mykha Tur
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ANCQ04_Lokot_PDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Elbow: Howdy, Vitko. A little birdie told me Leshy is somewhere on your turf. If you guys see him, drop me a message.
Vitko Handbrake: Should we grab him?
Elbow: I need the asshole alive. He went after me, if you can believe it. I’m not that easy to get, of course, and now I want him to rat out his employer.
Vitko Handbrake: I see. You got it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ANCQ04_Lokot_PDA_Note_hint: Taken from his body near the POL Depot

But look at you, finding a cozy spot like this! Is it for vodka or fishing? Hopefully vodka, because all the fish kicked the bucket here back in ’06. I left you some sausage. Help yourself. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ANCQ10_NoteMedicText_body:
$J0L0Day 52
Patients reported difficulty breathing, fatigue, and headaches. High blood pressure noted in nearly all cases. Weather changes may be a factor, as standard tests came back with normal results…
Day 53
At first, I thought it was the cyclone, but it turned out to be an Emission that caused the Perimeter to expand! This expansion promises more chances to save lives. Perhaps, new artifacts will emerge. This event will undoubtedly lead to a better future for all of us!
Day 54
IPSF officials are expected shortly. They’ll terminate our research and enforce nondisclosure agreements. As if the signing of those papers could cover up the immense power of the Zone! I’m hoping this expansion of the Perimeter won’t be the last – further expansions could allow me to explore new ways to aid our patients.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_ANCQ10_NoteMedicText_hint: A page from a doctor’s journal discovered at the elevator
