ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_Presentation_bo:
$J0L0I keep coming here just to spend time with you. You on that fresco are the reminder of who we should have become in X19. Our best selves, our faith in ourselves, what we wanted people to see in us – and wanted to be.
We weren't just an advanced X laboratory site, we were the very future of Project X. And you were leading us. You always seemed so invincible.
Look at us now. You are gone, and I am sitting in front of your portrait, thinking of how we started out, to find the strength to keep going. After the mess we've made here in the name of science, the one thing I regret is what happened to you. And our greed that led to it.
How am I supposed to continue your work, without your talents? I have always been just Dr. Dolhykh, your right hand, a shadow, a student, and an admirer. But never anything more.
But I will try anyway. Just to prove this might have not been for nothing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_ProjectorRoom_b:
$J0L0Subject A-37 does not demonstrate external somatic reactions to pain stimuli (electric discharge). However, psi scanning and encephalography show extreme activity at the moment of stimulation in the zones similar to the human limbic system. The signal recorded is more than a signal of pain, but a complex response that we can identify with high probability as fear.

Doctor Dolhykh has put forward a hypothesis that the Subject is able not only to feel, but, probably, in some way, to project feelings into the Noosphere. The experiment may result in unexpected increases or decreases of anomalous energy, similar to those we encountered at the CNPP.

We consider the risks justified, as the discovery we are about to make is paramount.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_ProjectorRoom_h: Project X document found in the embryo room
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_RentgenRoom_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>I understand Myklukha. No way we can win. Not like this, not from here.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>But I won't give up. If there is a chance to turn their own creations against them, we have to find a way. We owe it not just to ourselves, but to all of humanity.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Myklukha is wrong about one thing – we can't hide from it, even in the Zone. We only have two options: die fighting for our freedom, or live in fear.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>I choose to fight.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_RentgenRoom_hin: Found on a PDA in the X19 lab
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_Rooms_body:
$J0L0Doctor Bozhko: Listen, I know this is none of my business, but I simply can't watch another friend risking death. Please, don't go out there! I've heard stories about the Zone. What we have created is too dangerous.
Doctor Ovcharuk: I need fresh air, Bozhko. Even if it's through a filter! I'll go stir-crazy if I spend another hour in this basement, within these walls that are suffocating me.
Doctor Bozhko: Then why did you stay when they dismissed the Project staff?
Doctor Ovcharuk: Because I can't abandon my work halfway! I'm not a coward. I can do this. And then, I'll finish what we started here. The Zone is just… another fear to overcome.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_Rooms_hint: Found in the inhabited part of X19.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_StudyRoom_body:
$J1L0To: MDST technical security chief
From: Doctor Bozhko
Another attempt to get into the laboratory wing failed – the system didn't allow us access via our keys. It seems the facility had been abandoned before we arrived, or protected with a parallel security system that we don't have clearance for. Urgent assistance is required on this matter. We continue to work blindly.

Note: I am changing the code to the Projector Room while you are dealing with it. New code: 3150. Enough loitering.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_MQ12_X19_StudyRoom_name: Request for access to the laboratory wing
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ01_KajfNote_body:
$J0L0[11:20]: Some dudes were hanging around the wall. They pissed off. The camo Cash came up with is working. Give the guy a bonus, boss!
[12:44]: Checked it out. All peachy, IPSF didn't get to our routes.
[13:31]: Had some lunch, and these rations are shit. Need to order something else. And some candy.
[15.42]: Had to rescue some IPSF deadweights. One wounded. Sent him to Kurin.

Note: Harpoon, if you force me to deal with paperwork again, I'll transfer to a different squad. I mean it! We're Freedom, and if I wanted to file reports, I'd have joined Duty. Being off comms is not an excuse! This is the last time I'm doing this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ01_KajfNote_hint: Taken from a dead Freedomer in the Iron Forest
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ01_SoldierNote_body:
$J0L0Pvt. Tsvyhun: I don't like this. What if Vusatyi catches wind of it?
Lt. Sorel: Get a grip, chickenshit. The deal with Freedom is way more fun than what the bandits offered.
Pvt. Tsvyhun: I don't know. That's court-martial—
Lt. Sorel: Stop whining! We're going for the goods from that stash, so get ready. That's an order.
Pvt. Tsvyhun: Yes, Lieutenant.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ01_SoldierNote_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Found on the PDA taken from Sorel's body</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ02_DeadFriendNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Goodbye: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Why the hell are you running your mouth about the Iron Forest? Our employer won't be happy.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Chatterbox: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Chill! I haven't said a word about it. I was just making up stories about us heroes over a bottle of booze.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Goodbye: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>You better watch your words, hero. I'm not a fan of these bandits and their bosses.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>…</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Goodbye: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>What the fuck, Chatterbox? I got bandits following me.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Chatterbox: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>I… can't remember. I got wasted. You okay?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Chatterbox: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Goodbye? You alive?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ02_GuiderNote_body:
$J0L0Fenrir: Goodbye and Chatterbox, the diggers. They need to be offed.$J0L0Maxon Gasbag: Goodbye's decent. It's his buddy running his mouth.$J0L0Fenrir: I don't care. We had a deal: the two of them stay quiet.$J0L0Maxon Gasbag: Got it, boss.$J0L0…$J0L0Maxon Gasbag: Took care of Goodbye. On to Chatterbox.$J0L0Fenrir: You sure take your time. Now you'll have to guard the passage we showed them. It's getting too crowded in the Iron Forest.

Maxon Gasbag: You mean the Freedom camp, boss? We'll take precautions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ02_GuiderNote_hint: Found on a dead bandit in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ04_BilonizhkoPDANote_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[22:30] Pvt. Bilonozhko: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>New info. Found a gap in the patrolling schedule, two hours minimum. Plus, a possible 'source' in logistics.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[22:31] Khoryv: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Roger, mon ami. Just what we needed.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[22:35] Pvt. Bilonozhko: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Khoryv, I kept my part of the deal. How are things with getting to the Mainland? I can't take it any longer.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[22:37] Pvt. Bilonozhko: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Today's report had two more guys written off. I don't want to end up as just another number on that list.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[22:38] Khoryv: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>I hear you, mon ami, I'll keep my word. Hang on for just a bit longer. You're almost free.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[22:42] Pvt. Bilonozhko: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Fine.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ04_BilonizhkoPDANote_h: Found on a PDA that belonged to a bandit's hostage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ04_KhoryvPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12:01] Khoryv:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Gembel, mon ami, we need to talk. That "middleman" of ours wanted to screw us over.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12:03] Gembel:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Oh really. I told you back then he was shady. My chakras were all blocked up ‘cause of him.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12:04] Khoryv:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Should have listened to you, sorry.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12:04] Khoryv:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> But I have an idea how we could make this situation less unpleasant. And, possibly, get back the coupons we sent as ransom. Care to participate?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12:05] Gembel:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Depends on what you got in mind.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12:07] Khoryv:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I have some info on exactly where he'll be passing through. We could prepare, get there early, and catch him off guard. Then explain that Freedom shouldn't be treated like that.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12:10] Gembel:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> First time you said something reasonable all week. I'll get a couple more guys to join us.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ04_KhoryvPDANote_hint: PDA that belonged to Khoryv, who was planning an ambush
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ04_MayoPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[02:03] Scraper: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Mayo, we stumbled upon some mutant lunch. Duty patrol. The loot from the bodies is shit, but we got a survivor.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[02:03] Mayo: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>A Duty member who's still alive is a pain in the ass. If his gear's no good, shoot him.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[02:04] Scraper: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>I took a look at his PDA. He's a rat, snitching for Khoryv.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[02:06] Mayo: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>What a fucking catch! Get him to the old spot. Alive and in a sellable condition.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[02:06] Scraper: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Gotcha.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ04_MayoPDANote_hint: PDA of Mayo, the dead local bandit kingpin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ06_SergNote_body:
$J0L0Cpt. Bulat: Stalkers are disappearing around the Dam. Supposedly, problems with the mutes. Need to patrol the vicinity.

Cpt. Bulat: Take two or three men and go hunting. Clear out fucking everything both up top, and in the tech facilities, too!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ06_SergNote_hint: Message found on a Duty member's PDA at the Dam
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ14_ChadikovPDANote_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>This forest gives me the chills. We've been trying to set up the equipment for three days straight, with no luck. It's as if something doesn't want us to.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>I'm getting a lot of complaints about headaches. A couple of our guys went to set up sensors further away from the sawmill. They should have been back by now, but they aren't…</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ14_ChadikovPDANote_hin: PDA from the body of a scientist in the Abandoned Sawmill
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ14_GamerPDA_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Zen, shit, I can't fucking work like this! It's not showing up on any of the radars. I'm always happy to piss Duty off, but whatever this technology is, it's clearly beyond our understanding.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ14_HatchetPDA_Note_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>The technology works. Hermann was right – you can move freely between the concealed entry points. The margin of error stays withing ten meters. Testing is over. So is our cooperation. Left the prototype at your spot near A.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ14_RabojPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Varchuk's order was clear: Freedom can't get their hands on this technology, whatever it is. That means the source needs to be destroyed as soon as it's discovered.

But how the hell are we supposed to know what it is?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ14_TauminPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>There is something in the forest. Something watching us. One by one, people are losing their minds. I keep hearing voices, too, and they are becoming louder. More persistent.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>We shouldn't have come here, but it is too late now. None of us will make it out of this forest alive.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_DutyOrder_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Hvizdko, you take the cave in square C. Don't take too long, and avoid contact with the chimera. Report in when you get there.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_DutyOrder_hint: Zulu's order, found next to a dead Duty member
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_FreedomTalk_body:
$J0L0Senya Moon: Man, I'm near the chimera's lair. You won't believe it!
Borys Las Vegas: You have a death wish, or what?
Senya Moon: I'll be quiet! Just wanted to see if the rumors that someone lives here were true.
Borys Las Vegas: Me calling you a shitty scout doesn't mean you gotta risk your damned life for campfire gossip!
Senya Moon: It's not just gossip! I saw him! I think he went into the cave.
Borys Las Vegas: Get the hell outta there! Now!

Borys Las Vegas: Senya! You there?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_FreedomTalk_hint: Found on a Freedom member killed by a chimera.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_PhantomWalls_body:
$J0L0Naggin: Can you believe it? When I'm drinking, there's no wall. I'm not drinking, there it is!
Creeper: You, not drinking? Nah, I can't believe it. More like you're drinking so much you're imagining stuff.
Naggin: That was mean. It was just one bottle.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_PhantomWalls_hint: Found on a stalker's body in the CNPP
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_QuestFail_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Day 46.</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I went to that light shaft above the reactor again. It's so beautiful! But my head hurts really bad, like it's getting fried from the inside. Next time, I'll wear my suit, but… that's the only place where my memories are coming back. Bits and pieces, faces, and places. But it's all foggy, and I can't reach it.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Day 48. </NoteBold><NoteDefault>I remembered something important! When I woke up back then, the main anomaly… blew up? It burst into little fragments, which fell and created artifacts. I found one of them… Where did I put it? Need to find it. Maybe it can do something.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Day 53.</NoteBold><NoteDefault> It worked! That artifact fragment protects from psi! Looks like there are only five of those artifacts, if I counted it right. Got one of them here. If I manage to get them all, I can reach the center of the anomaly. That's where the main artifact is – I saw it through my scope. There are several, but only one of them must be real, meaning the rest are probably illusions. Once I have it, I'll remember everything! Marking the approximate zones on the map now, so I don't forget…</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_QuestFail_Note_hint: Found on an escaped stalker's body
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_QuestFail_Note_name: Diary of a loner from the CNPP
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_SuspiciousStalkerDu: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Duty patrols report seeing an unknown stalker right by the chimera's lair. Either he's extremely stupid and already dead, or he's very smart and knows how to survive alongside mutants. I need to investigate the area near </NoteDefault><NoteBold>the garage and car wash</NoteBold><NoteDefault> (marked the spot on the map).</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
Written by Skif after the conversation with Sgt. Kamenetskyi.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_SuspiciousStalkerFr: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Freedom guys are saying that some stalker has been hanging around the chimera lair. Either he's extremely stupid and already dead, or he's very smart and knows how to survive alongside mutants. I need to investigate the area near </NoteDefault><NoteBold>the garage and car wash</NoteBold><NoteDefault> (marked the spot on the map).</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
Written by Skif after the conversation with Sashko Chaga.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_VydraLastDiaryPage_:
$J0L0The fog in my head cleared up. Not just the one that didn't let me remember, but also the one that made me so naive.
Everything is clear now. Here I am, a thief and a murderer. A piece of shit. Somehow, I even feel better. I remembered thinking that I came here to make money, not die a hero. Remembered how I first came across a group with some loot from the CNPP. It turned out to be so easy, pretending to be wounded to make them trust me. Easy to catch them off guard. Easy to kill them.
I can't remember their names. But I do remember how pleasantly heavy the artifact container was. That feeling that something in my life was finally going somewhere. Then, it only became easier and easier.
I was unlucky once. He made me before I could put a bullet in him. That's where the fog came from… Anyway, the strongest man survived.
Skif could have guessed. But that's not even the point. His loot is what really matters.
Found on a dead stalker's body
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_WallImage_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>The picture shows a building with a pipe, drawn in chalk. The building has some mark on it.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_SQ15_WallImage_hint: Found in an unknown stalker's shelter
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01_X16Lab_body:
$J1L0The administration has been recording more security procedure violations. This kind of negligence leads to test subjects (text redacted), incl. damaging laboratory equipment. These emergencies require requests for additional funding and jeopardize the progression to further experiment phases, such as (text redacted).$J1L0Reminder on the necessary basic kit for experiments:
– High-precision craniotome to prepare the operation area,
– Hermetic bio-containers, for transportation (text redacted),
– "Cocoon-3М" kit, for securing limbs.

In the case of any further negligence, employees will be fired, and their medical license confiscated.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DLC01__MQ04_ArtFarmNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Vasya, next up we have the sections on the second floor. Lomako made a mess there, so we need to clean it up. Take two rookies and get on it, please. I owe you a beer.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DeathNote_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Do not read this- you loose</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J1L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>test for NoteBody</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DeathNote_hint: Hm, what do we get here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_DevatyjPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Sickle:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Damn... Ninth. Monolith bless you. We had to leave quickly. You've come such a long way... </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Nine:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> And I'll do it again. To return. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Sickle:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> For what? Don't be stupid. Wherever you hide, they'll find you sooner or later. Everything's changed. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Sickle:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Now you either go the way of lies and self-pity, live as a stalker, among strangers. Or you come to us, brother. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Nine: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Then tell me: What do I do? </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Sickle:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Put on our old armor. The gifts of the Monolith will help you pass where no one else can. Trust me. I will send a route. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Sickle:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> May the Monolith light your way. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E01_GermanNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Step-by-step to get the artifact: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Take the Scanner off your shoulder.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Place the Scanner on the ground.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Activate the Scanner.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Step back.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteStrike>Yes, these instructions are for morons.</NoteStrike></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E01_MQ01_NedogaNote_body:
$J0L0Solder: Got it?
Dr. Nehoda: Yes. It’s all on my laptop. How long will these coordinates be up to date?
Solder: Until the next Emission. So that guy of yours should move his ass.
Dr. Nehoda: There’s someone at the bunker. That must be the man Hermann sent…

$J0L0Solder: Got it?
Dr. Nehoda: Yes. It’s all on my laptop. How long will these coordinates be up to date?

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E01_MQ02_Memo_to_Voloshin_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Voloshyn! As project leader, I’m ordering you to remain in the bunker until we receive the suits from the Institute. Safety comes first, regardless of any psi radiation coefficients you might have detected. If you venture into that cave one more time, I will kick you out personally – first out of the cave, then out of this project. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E01_MQ02_Memo_to_Voloshin_hint: A note from the mobile lab
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_MQ01_ScanerNote_body:
$J0L0Activation date and time: DD/TT
Event log:
[00:00:001]: Initiating procedure protocol.
[00:01:247]: Background anomalous radiation detected. Saturation: 0.47 ef.
[00:03:589]: Forming transition channel.
[00:04:761]: Initiating scan procedure.
[00:05:115]: Phase transition.
[00:06:247]: Saturation: 0.99 ca.
[00:07:081]: Object reactivated.
[00:07:821]: Approbating using the Knyazhinsky formula.
[00:07:921]: Detecting auto-emission in the upper tau range.
[00:08:001]: Checking for sync phase.
[00:09:111]: Kaymanov’s sync phase detected.
[00:10:001]: Procedure complete.$J0L0WARNING! Kaymanov’s sync phase detected! Operator, follow special protocol PS-07! Make sure the procedure is complete! Do not try to extract the container on site! The device must be safely transported to the ARL in the Special Field Research Unit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_MQ02_BS_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Hey, Elbow – quick update. We had some sketchy stalker snooping around. Sent him packing back to the farmstead. Don’t sweat it: the loot’s gonna be top-notch. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_MQ02_BS_Note_hint: From a PDA found at the radiation hazard signs warehouse
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_MQ03_MSOP_Note_body:
$J0L0Sgt. Petrushenko: All set. The tunnel codes have been updated: it’s 2765 now.
Base: Is everything sorted at the Ribs?
Sgt. Petrushenko: Affirmative, sir. All squared away.
Base: Copy that. Now make your way back, and keep this hush-hush.
Sgt. Petrushenko: My lips are sealed, sir.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_MQ03_MSOP_Note_hint: Chat from the dead IPSF soldier’s PDA found at the Ribs
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_MQ03_Note_for_Sidor_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> This is the second and last shipment without advance payment. I didn’t screw Hamster over just to have you bullshit me. Either cough up what you owe, or I’ll close up shop and tip the Gaffer off. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_MQ03_PripoyNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> We’ve got an emergency here, Nestor. The Ward knows about the scanners. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_NoteAbotKosoy_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Hey Elbow, here's a quick update: we had some sketchy stalker snooping around. We sent him packing toward the farmstead. Don’t sweat it, the loot’s gonna be top-notch. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_NoteAbotKosoy_hint: Found at the radiation hazard signs warehouse
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_SQ01_ZorikNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Gloomy, in case I don’t make it, I stowed the goods in the chopper. Here are the coordinates. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_SQ01_ZorikNote_hint: Found on the PDA of a stalker from the Post Office
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_SQ01_banditPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Silencer: Varan, we tracked down those assholes. One made a run for the Post Office, Valve’s got the other. Should we off ’em both?
Varan: First, find out where the money is, then you can do them in. Not like last time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E02_SQ01_banditPDA_Note_hint: Found on a dead bandit’s body
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ01_ChernozemNote_body:
$J0L0Diode: Need some help here, Chornozem. I had a close call today. Think it was some thugs. Any leads on who might be gunning for me?
Chornozem: I could use a hand myself. The Ward’s making moves – the place is swarming with those clowns. Doubt it’s all for show.
Chornozem: Why isn’t Nestor handling your shit? You’re his pet tech, after all.
Diode: The damn scanners, that’s why. You’re lucky you’re not in this mess with us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ01_GoshaMogilaNote_body:
$J0L0Hosha Mohyla: I saw you packing up today. Getting ready to bail, huh?
Vetos Balaban: You’re sharper than you look. But not sharp enough.
Hosha Mohyla: Heard Chornozem sent Cucumber to chat with the Ward. Maybe they’ll sort things out.
Vetos Balaban: I don’t give a shit about Chornozem’s games. Pigs are pigs. They’ll screw you over, put a bullet in your skull, and dump you in the nearest burner.
Vetos Balaban: You think they just let Cucumber go, and now he’s sipping cocktails on the Mainland? He’s six feet under already! And I ain’t planning to join him for those shitheads.
Hosha Mohyla: Bolting on your guys is fucked up. The boys ain’t gonna like it. But take me with you, and I’ll keep my mouth shut.
Vetos Balaban: Fuck. Guess I got no choice!
Vetos Balaban: But if we end up in a jam because of you, you’re as good as dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ01_GoshaMogilaNote_hint: From the PDA of a bandit who tried to escape from the Depot
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ01_GoshaMogilaNote_name: Vetos Balaban’s Chat with Hosha Mohyla
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ02_DeviceNote_hint: A document salvaged from lab Х18
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ02_IskraPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Keep an eye out for the device specs, guys – they’re in a regular file folder. And watch your step in there. Who knows what might have creeped in from the lab to the warehouse. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ02_IskraPDANote_name: Last Message from a Sparker’s PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ02_ZmeevikPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You need to get to the lab, Serpentine. Nestor stashed loads of gear there, but the device blueprints are top priority. Look for an entrance on the lower levels. I’ll send you the passwords so you won’t have to crack anything. And be quick about it. The Ward’s been scouring Garbage ever since Nestor went missing, so watch your back. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ02_ZmeevikPDANote_name: Last Message to Serpentine from Unknown
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ03_Note1_body:
$J0L0[10:00] Roosevelt: Mind checking out an old stash for me?
[10:00] Roosevelt: I sent you the coordinates.
[10:01] Roosevelt: Got a bad feeling someone might’ve cleaned it out.
[10:05] Zulu: Sure thing, I can do it for you.
[18:00] Zulu: All good, even that vodka Borodulin left for you.
[18:01] Zulu: How’s he holding up, by the way? Think he might come back to your side?
[18:15] Roosevelt: Even if he’s having second thoughts, it’s too late. You know how many chances I gave him? There’s only so much patience a man can have.
[18:16] Roosevelt: If he wants to get drunk as a skunk every day, that’s his choice. I ain’t his mamma.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ03_Note1_hint: From a PDA belonging to Roosevelt, the Commissary kingpin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ03_Note2_body:
$J0L0Anonymous: You’ve been holed up in your bar for too long. Crack a window open and get some fresh air. Can you smell it?
That’s the wind of change, Shah.
The Bazaar’s on the brink of a new era. More cash rolling in, more players at the table, and less chatter about that “free trade zone” crap.
But if we want to make it happen, Myklukha has to go.
Do you agree?
Check the stash. There’s bound to be something that’ll put an end to our problem.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ03_Note2_hint: From a PDA belonging to the Shah, the Brood kingpin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ04_VaranPDANote_body:
$J0L0Varan: What the fuck, Nestor?!
Nestor: What’s wrong?
Varan: We gave your fucking scanner a ride yesterday, and some assholes jumped my boys!
Nestor: Who?
Varan: Loner gear, but it looked off. Iron thinks they’re not from around here. We invited one of them over for a chat.
Nestor: I have no idea, Varan.
Varan: Nestor, you son of a bitch! My boys had a look at your scanner. Are you trying to screw me over?! It’s rigged! What, did you want those hitmen to raid my Plant?!
Varan: You must be real busy. Whatever. We’ll sort this out face-to-face soon enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ04_VaranPDANote_hint: From the brazen kingpin Varan’s PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ05_NestorNotes_body:
$J0L0 You might be an egghead, Hermann, but your plan sucks. Let’s do this the smart way, okay?

1. You throw the scanners away with the SIRCAA trash. Make sure nobody sees you.
2. Diggers get them and bring them to the Labyrinth for radiation cleanup. I’ll get artifacts to absorb the radiation. Swiping a few from loners ain’t a problem.
3. Once they’re clean, I’ll send Diode to tinker with them just like we talked about.
4. Then we scatter them around the Dig Site, and I’ll send the coordinates to our buyers. Just keep your freaking head down, you got it?

You better. You’re a smart one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ05_NestorNotes_hint: A draft message to Hermann found among Nestor’s papers
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ05_PahanOrder_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> The info is solid. Go to the mark. Tomorrow, I’ll be waiting at the Factory for the results. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E03_MQ05_PahanOrder_hint: PDA from a bandit who needed a Scanner, apparently
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_DubnyjToBrodyaga_body:
$J0L0 Look, I know what’s on your mind, and I swore not to speak of it again. But this is a note, so I’m not breaking my fuckin’ word, okay?
Faust is really pushing it. He went off today about how our resistance to Emissions and toxic fumes has diminished because the Monolith is gone. And folks are eating it up.
Some of them are starting to fall for it, Strider. I’ve seen it in their eyes. Even if it’s not total bullshit, we gotta do something about this!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_KillingMachine_body:
$J0L0Zamir Thunder: So, what do you think?
Shell: We’re all in agreement that stalking is a dangerous business.
Zamir Thunder: I thought you weren’t afraid to remember your past.
Shell: What’s that got to do with anything? You just need some extra firepower.
Zamir Thunder: Exactly! You’re going to do what you’re good at. And that means awakening your muscle memory! The rest will come back over time.
Shell: Are you serious?
Zamir Thunder: Absolutely! That’s what the scientists are saying.
Shell: All right. I’ll give it some thought.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_KillingMachine_hint: Chat from a missing PDA found at the Noontide Base
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_Legends_body:
$J0L0Tall: Can you believe it? They’ve got canned Flesh over on the Mainland!
Comet: How do you know?
Tall: Found one in a warehouse. The label says “Pork,” but there’s a Flesh on it! Just a tad pinker and with ears.
Comet: I always thought the Mainland was nothing like the Zone. Turns out, all they’ve got on us is Fleshes with ears.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_RememberUs_body:
$J0L0Vector: Think any of those stalkers remember us from way back? Someone who knows who we are and where we came from?
Six-Fingers: If there’s any loner who might have known us, he’s conveniently forgotten it.
Six-Fingers: Don’t worry about it. Strider’s already told us everything we need to know. Unlike those stalkers, he’s actually looking out for us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_RememberUs_hint: Found on Vector’s PDA on Wild Island
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_Unity_body:
$J0L0 That was a special moment. I want to hold on to it. The guys and I were chatting by the fire when silence suddenly fell upon us, and we all just watched the flames dance. And yet it felt like our conversation carried on, and we understood each other without saying a word. There was a strange familiarity to it. A sense of unity…
The brothers say they experience the same feeling during their gatherings with Faust. Maybe I should join them…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_Note_Unity_hint: A page from a diary found on Wild Island
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_SQ01_PDABanditNote_body:
$J0L0Karim Cyclops: Roosevelt wants Mute and Sava taken care of. But all I see is Sava and a couple of shady guys in Noontide gear.
Sprain: So what? Let’s take them out anyways.
Karim Cyclops: Some stalkers recognized Mute and Sava from Prypiat. They left a trail of dead loners there. Why bother with the rest?
Sprain: All the damn Monolithians slaughtered folks left and right. We’ll just tell the client to fork over the dough for the other two. Then we’ll hit the Commissary and celebrate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E04_SQ01_PDABanditNote_hint: A chat between two bandits behind a hit on Noontiders
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ01_EchoReportNote_body:
$J0L2Psi-radiation hotspots with significant fluctuations in range have been detected across the Zaton region.
Source: unknown.
Research priority: high.Psi-radiation hotspots with consistent exposure levels identified in the Swamps.
Source: presumably the equipment that used to protect the Clear Sky base. Access to faction archives required for further investigation.
Research priority: low.Intense surge in psi activity detected near the long-abandoned Clear Sky base.
Source: likely a malfunction of antiquated scientific equipment.
Research priority: very low – remote areas are of minimal interest to the expedition.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ01_EchoReportNote_hint: Found at the scene of the scientist killings at Echo Station
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ01_Shterev_Diary_body:
$J0L0 Ha! I’ve never come across a Zone “miracle” quite like this one. How on earth did he manage to survive if he’s blind? He keeps going on about how there’s always someone ready to lend a hand. Where’d he come across anyone that stupid around here? That voice of his, though…

That’s it. I’m taking the next patrol bound for the Claw. It’s time to put an end to these endless debates in my mind and confront him face to face. Sure, he knows the Zone like no other. Sometimes, I can’t help but feel he’s not the one who’s been blind. $J0L0 It’s time for the Ward to wake up to the truth: we’ve been protecting the deceivers who dread his true power. But I know how to make them see the light. I’ll do what he’s taught me, and then they’ll listen. They’ll come to believe in him, just like I have. $J0L0 Just as he anticipated: SIRCAA doesn’t need truth – only obedient soldiers. One of their agents showed up at Icarus the moment I began my mission. Faust believes this presents an opportunity nonetheless. We can always leverage others to further our own agenda, but first, we need to determine exactly what they intend to do at Icarus and Echo Station.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ01_Shterev_Diary_hint: Found on Shterev’s body, in his breast pocket
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ02_KalanchaMap_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> A map of the Swamps. Received from Nimble. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ02_KalanchaMap_hint: A map of beacons in the Swamps, provided by Nimble
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ02_ZveroboyTask_body:
$J0L0 Here’s the deal, Trapper. The mutants in Zaton are chomping through my boys like candy. You handle them, and I’ll make it worth your while.
You won’t be flying solo on this one – you’ll be teamed up with Nimble, a seasoned loner who knows his way around. Check every spot and take out every critter. There’s a cave swarming with snorks – Nimble’s got that covered, and he’ll blast it to kingdom come. Meanwhile, you handle that hairy bastard I told you about.
If Nimble pisses off or bites it in that cave, you’re on your own.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ03_KalanchaCommsSessionN:
$J0L0Message from 9/03/2011
V. D.: In response to your earlier inquiry: As of September 2011, the anomalous energy emanating from the Noosphere remains unstable. The so-called Emissions are a consequence of these ongoing fluctuations. Continue monitoring and collecting data.
Kalancha: Understood. We’ll continue our observations. $J0L0 Message from 9/10/2011
V. D.: To ensure the successful execution of the Cutter Initiative, you are required to accept Agent A:MS-017 into the group and continuously monitor his activity. Should any instability arise in his neuroprogramming, the agent must be compelled to seek out and terminate stalker A:LS-013.
Lebedev: Acknowledged. Initiating monitoring.
PDA found at the Clear Sky base
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ03_LebedevOrder_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>MDST is done. The Ancile scientist protection project has been compromised. I have one last job for you: find any information on two stalkers who go by Fang and Ghost while Scar is looking for Strelok. If you find them, eliminate them. Good luck. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ03_NimbleDiaryNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I got a little present for you. Ran into this stalker named Scar right after the Emission. Don’t ask me how, but the guy made it through. Lebedev’s all hyped about him, says we gotta rescue him at all costs. Keep an eye on him, would you? It’d be a shame if he bites the dust now. I’ll see if I can rustle up some meds for you. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ03_NimbleDiaryNote_hint: Found in the ruins of the Clear Sky base
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_MQ03_NimbleNote_body:
$J0L0Nimble: Nope, I’m out. Had my fill of this. Killing fellow stalkers wasn’t in the job description.
Sickle: But you did not kill him. And now he has lots of questions. Some of them involve you.
Nimble: All the more reason to get the hell outta the Swamps. I’ll leave you the map of Kalancha’s beacons. Tune them to yourself, starting with the first, and they’ll guide you to Clear Sky’s doorstep. Or should I say, your thugs. You managed without maps just fine.
Sickle: The Monolith guides me. Also, there is no need to insult my brothers.
Nimble: Are you reading your own lines for once, Sickle? Or is he pulling the strings like always? Eh, whatevs. You’ve got to recalibrate at least four beacons for this to pan out. Then you can waltz through the ruins all the way to Clear Sky.
Sickle: You said you would guide my men there.
Nimble: And you said I wouldn’t have any problems, Faust.
Sickle: All of your problems are of your own making.
Nimble: I’ve heard enough. You’ve got the coordinates. Let’s hope we never cross paths again.
Sickle: Of that I am certain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_SQ01_VartaPatrolNote_body:
$J0L0 1. Icarus – Izumrudne – Skadovsk – Canning Factory – Icarus.
2. Icarus – Canning Factory – Maintenance Facility – Icarus.
3. Icarus – Burnt Farmstead – Gas Station – Canning Factory – Icarus.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_SQ01_VartaPatrolNote_hint: Found among the belongings of runaway Wardens
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_SQ03_NoteAboutX11Equipment:
$J0L0 Pursuant to the directive to modernize the monorail station, I hereby issue the following orders:
– organize a detail to accompany the scientists transporting the first shipment to the station
– set up a hangar to accommodate the mobile field laboratory
– implement measures to ensure the safety and security of the expedition
$J2L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Sgt. Shavruk has been briefed on the mission objectives </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
From a Warden’s body found in the depot near Icarus
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_SQ04_ArturLapaPDANote_body:
$J0L0Sultan: I got that Warden in line, Paw. He’s moving the goods today.
Sultan: Pick up my stuff from that quartermaster guy. Keep it quiet.
Sultan: And keep your head down.
Artur Paw: Will do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_SQ04_ArturLapaPDANote_hint: PDA from a dead customer’s body beneath Icarus
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E05_SQ04_ArturLapaPDANote_name: Order from the Kingpin for Artur Paw
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_AgathaNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You’re on the verge of surpassing your father’s accomplishments. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_DalinWindow_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> With the latest breakthroughs in Emission protection tech, this window now offers a clear view of your aspirations and humanity’s future. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Happy birthday, Dr. Dalin! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_DalinWindow_Note_hint: Written on the window of Dalin’s suite
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_ExperimentRoom_Note_b:
$J0L0Dr. Leshkiv: If the intensity of radiation is kept at the same level, there will be irreversible changes.
Dr. Kryvenko: All the changes so far remain within acceptable parameters.
Dr. Leshkiv: Does Dalin know about all this?
Dr. Kryvenko: Believe me, all interested parties are in the loop. I never expected you of all people to be concerned about the ethical side of the matter.
Dr. Leshkiv: I’m concerned about the “my career” side of the matter. I had to abandon my own research for this. And now I’m facing the risk of being left with nothing.
Dr. Kryvenko: All our sacrifices will bear fruit when fifth-level protection is created. Keep up the good work.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_SciMagazine_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> “I know this might not sit well with everyone, but I do not see 2006 as a tragedy. It was a blessing for humanity! The Zone presents endless opportunities that cannot be confined behind walls. As Director of SIRCAA, I am committed to ensuring that in the coming years…” </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_SciMagazine_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Dmytro Dalin, the young scientist now at the helm of SIRCAA, shares his thoughts on his appointment: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_SciMagazine_hint: A clipping from an article in a prominent scientific journal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_VartaOrder_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>I hereby order: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>The following detachments (list provided in Annex А) to report to SIRCAA immediately.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Increase institute security comprehensively, enforce enhanced safety procedures (the Warden program).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Ensure evacuation of scientists (list of names provided in Annex B) from the institute.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Secure SIRCAA and ensure safety of the personnel left on the premises (list of names provided in Annex B) until further instructions.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_Zombie_Note_body:
$J0L0Observation time: 74 days
Ratio: 000.98
Conclusion: No potential. Should be disposed of.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E06_MQ01_Zombie_Note_hint: Taken from a zombie at the Cryptobiology Lab
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ01_HorsNotes_body:
$J0L0Khors: The valves are all set. What about those fuses? I just need to replace them, and we’ll be good to go.
Quiet: Still waiting on those. Should be here tomorrow. How’s my gun, by the way?
Khors: Almost done. I gotta finish one for Skif first.
Quiet: Hey, we had a deal! I’ll stash everything in the usual place. Swing by when you’re done with my stuff. Just leave the gun and take the fuses. Fair and square.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ01_HorsNotes_hint: A note about vent repair parts
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ01_HorsPlan_body:
$J0L0The brothers have been complaining about the ventilation. It’s struggling under the strain. Stink from the waste is seeping into the living quarters.

Shelter ventilation system repair plan:
1. Identify cause of malfunction and rectify it (Valves are worn out. Tried swapping them out. Didn’t work.)
2. Insufficient power output from generator. Fuses? (Checked. Found a few blown.)
3. Swap out the fuse.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ01_SkiperNote_body:
$J0L0 Client: Wild Island, Skipper. It’s time. Get moving. Then hand the goods over to Degtyarev. I’ll send the coordinates.
Skipper: Wasn’t planning on risking my neck. How about a bonus?
Client: It’ll be a walk in the park. The Monolith have no stake in the island. They’ll move on.
Skipper: I’ve heard different.
Client: And I’ve got history. I dealt with the Monolith long before Noontide. I know their ways.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ01_SkiperNote_hint: A chat about the Wild Island job
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ01_TihiyNote_body:
$J0L0Sidorovich
1. Courier for ongoing deliveries from Rostok (found, discussed price, reached an agreement).
2. Batch of acid artifacts (all packed and ready for transportation. Once the shipment gets there, Sidorovich will hand over some interesting guns).
3. Got an order for something science-y. Still exploring my options (The price tag is pretty sweet!). $J0L0Kalyna
She sent me some sardines. A whole can. How’d she know? Did Sidorovich spill the beans? I should definitely catch up with her. Feels like she’s got more than just canned fish to offer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ02_SyhinBody_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> The hour has come for all your questions to be answered, brother. Have faith. You will become what you have always been: a man among his own kind. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ02_SyhinOffice_Note_body: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Voluntary transfer request of First Lieutenant O. K. Sukhin to the Zone is hereby granted.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>First Lieutenant O. K. Sukhin is to be promoted to the rank of Captain.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Captain O. K. Sukhin is to assume command of the Sphere garrison, paygrade to be established in accordance with respective procedures.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>$J2L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>7/6/2018</NoteBold></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ02_SyhinOffice_Note_foot:
$J2L0 Lieutenant Colonel G. S. Kozhedub,
Commander of the IPSF
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ02_SyhinOffice_Note_hint: Papers found in Cpt. Sukhin’s office
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ02_Syhin_Note_body:
$J1L0 MEDICAL HISTORY $J0L0 Name: Oleksiy Kyrylovych Sukhin
Age: 26
Rank: Lieutenant
Date of admission: 2/17/2014.
Diagnosis: gunshot wounds to the left forearm and thigh, shrapnel wounds to facial soft tissue, partial retrograde amnesia attributed to concussion. $J1L0 ANAMNESIS $J0L0 According to the patient, he was leading a patrol near the Perimeter walls when his squad was ambushed by Monolith forces. During combat, he sustained injuries and lost consciousness following a grenade explosion. Upon regaining consciousness, he found himself the sole survivor of the engagement. He managed to call for assistance and was subsequently evacuated.
The patient’s memory is clear only for the hours immediately preceding the incident. Memories preceding the traumatic event are fragmented.
There are no apparent cognitive impairments apart from memory loss. $J1L0 TREATMENT PLAN $J0L0 1. Surgical intervention
2. ECG, MRI of the brain
3. Consultation with neurosurgeon
4. Reconstructive surgery
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_MQ02_Syhin_Note_footer: $J2L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Col. O. Mendel, Head of Medical Services </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_SQ01_Note_MonolithOrders_h: Found on the M-PDA from Uncle Lyonya’s corpse
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E07_SQ01_Note_ThanksForDadyaLe: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I really owe you for yanking me out of that Fruit Punch and helping me get my head on straight. I brought you some supplies from my first haul. Stay safe, and see you soon. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
Found at Uncle Lyonya’s house near Zalissya
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_EQ02_DenyaAndVenyaPDANote_:
$J0L0Denya Veteran: You hear what the fellas were saying about that mutant wearing a collar?
Venya Kalych: Yeah. Folks said it looked weird, like… twitchy or some shit.
Denya Veteran: They’re dumbasses, and so are you. Damn critter’s trained, for sure! Let’s bring it to Boozer, like a gift for the bar. Maybe he’ll let our tabs slide. Or even toss us some coupons!
Venya Kalych: Better to hand it over to the eggheads. Heard some prick’s collecting them collars. We could make a pretty penny off this one.
Denya Veteran: Dope! Tomorrow, we’ll put it down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_EQ03_KrikPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: There’s a bloodsucker in a collar running around near the Scorcher. My scientists can’t work like that! Kill it.
Yevhen Mamay: Hello, Viktoria. For jobs like these, we usually talk about payment upfront.
Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: Bring me the collar, and then we’ll talk money. End of story.
Yevhen Mamay: I can’t say no to you. Anything else you need? Shooting some blind dogs, maybe?
Yevhen Mamay: Viktoria?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_EQ03_KrikPDA_Note_name: Order to Eliminate a Mutant in the Area
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_ActivationInstruction: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Always verify that the emergency safety system is disengaged before activating the equipment! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_ControllerList_body:
$J0L0Project title: Controller
Sections: Induced illusions, psi exposure, phantoms.
Description: classified. A-8 clearance required for viewing.
List of project participants:$J0L2I. VishnevskyA. GalitskyV. DvupalovA. YeliseevaI. KornienkoY. KravchenkoN. KurkubetL. MalyshevaA. MelnikovaD. RussS. SmetaninP. StrizhA. FomichyovM. CherikovV. ChubkoT. ShugaevaN. YusupovE. Yastrebenko
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_Desiatov_body:
$J0L0 I, Mykola Desyatov, hereby request a transfer from Prof. Razumovsky’s research team due to personal conflict and an unhealthy work environment.
Furthermore, I bring to your attention Prof. Razumovsky’s increasingly erratic reports, which often stray from the experiments’ primary objectives. His prolonged research into induced illusions may have adversely impacted his mental well-being.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_Desiatov_hint: Request found in the Mirror VPC
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_PhantomProtocol_body: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Take a few deep breaths to calm down.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Close your eyes and open them, repeat several times. This is often enough to get rid of any remaining residue from the induced illusion.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>If the illusion persists, do not attempt to interact with it. Ignore it.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Ask a coworker to accompany you to the medical ward, where a qualified staff member will assist you.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Do not panic. Remember, induced illusions are a harmless side effect of excess psi-exposure. There will be no consequences to your health, as long as you get immediate medical assistance. </NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_PhantomProtocol_heade: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Protocol for Treating Induced Illusions Residue </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_PhantomProtocol_name: Protocol for Dealing with Induced Illusions
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_TruePhantomProtocol_b: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Do not breathe too loudly.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Do not turn your back to them or take your eyes off them.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>If you do what they say, they might leave.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Do not ask coworkers for help – it could be a trap.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>FEAR THE ILLUSIONS. They can and will harm you. If they persist, do your best to sneak into the medical ward and get your hands on some sleeping pills…</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_TruePhantomProtocol_h: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Real Protocol for Dealing with Induced Illusions </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_TruePhantomProtocol_n: Protocol for Cases in Which Meds Do Not Work
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ01_TuningInstructionNote: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Connect the station to the power source and ensure access to the X-Network.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Clear the rails of any obstructions to facilitate movement.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Use the main console to initiate and stabilize connection.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Closely monitor movement along the rails to mitigate potential emergencies.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Once a connection has been established, save the data in the appropriate archive section based on its category.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Instructions for connecting to X-Network facilities </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
Instructions found at the Mirror VPC
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_CollarsTests_body:
$J0L0 The data is derived from an experiment involving blind dogs.
10 m range: specimen mortality recorded at 0.01 sec.
50 m range: specimen mortality recorded at 0.08 sec.
200 m range: specimen mortality recorded at 1.1 sec.
500 m range: specimen mortality recorded at 2.0 sec.
700 m range: specimen mortality recorded at 2.8 sec.
1 km range: specimen mortality recorded at 4.06 sec.
Findings derived from experiment with a single mutant species are considered unrepresentative.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_CollarsTests_footer: $J2L0<NoteBody><NoteItalic>Permission is required to proceed with an extended experiment involving different specimens</NoteItalic></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_CollarsTests_hint: What little has survived in the labs beneath Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_DocsProjectController: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Prototype 8. </NoteBold><NoteDefault>High post-implantation mortality; survivors show no telekinetic abilities. Outbreaks of self-harm. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Prototype 11. </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Deemed unsuccessful at the development phase. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Prototype 17. </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Displays extreme aggression, prohibited from reproduction. Final specimens sent to reclamation lab for preservation. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
From the depths of Lab X5 beneath Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_DvupalovLastWord_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Day one post-implementation.</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Medical parameters remain within expected ranges. I’m certain I made the correct choice this time. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Day ten.</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Subject is awake, and conditioned reflexes have returned. No apparent disorientation. Tests indicate that his brain is capable of processing human speech – a promising sign despite our inability to establish direct contact. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Three months.</NoteBold><NoteDefault>  Every attempt to indirectly stimulate the subject’s cognitive processes or Controller abilities has been futile. It’s like he isn’t even here. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Five (six?) months.</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Physical stimulation has also proven ineffective. The subject has not used his abilities once. I’m beginning to suspect that his brain may be damaged after all. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Hell if I know how long. </NoteBold><NoteDefault> Now they’re cutting our funding! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_DvupalovLastWord_hint: Miraculously preserved on the lower level of Lab X5
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_NoteWarning_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Any documents in the control room should be off limits to lab assistants. Last week, someone took the Suppressor manual yet again, jeopardizing a scheduled experiment! This is not the first case of negligent handling of crucial Project X documentation. This matter needs to be addressed at once. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_NoteWarning_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> To Prof. Chubko from Prof. Dvupalov </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_NoteWarning_hint: A note from Dvupalov’s desk at X5
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_ReceptionNote_body:
$J0L0 The new batch of samples is coming in earlier than expected, Valentyna. They’re sedated, but keep an eye out for any issues.
And send someone downstairs to inspect the central control panel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_ReceptionNote_hint: Left at the entrance to X5 beneath Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_SherbaNote_body:
$J0L0 Dear Prof. Dvupalov,

I have successfully defended four theses in biotechnology. I delivered the printouts along with the comments, but unfortunately, you seem to have used them as kindling…

No, that won’t do. I must refrain from negativity.

Dear Prof. Dvupalov, I concur with your assessment of Project X’s initial failures in mutant research. However, your genius can change everything. Please find attached, once again, the printouts of my theses in biotechnology, which I brilliantly…

No, I shouldn’t brag too much… $J0L0Dear Prof. Dvupalov, How could you…

I need to take a breath.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_SherbaNote_hint: Found among Shcherba’s personal belongings at Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_SherbaNote_name: Draft of a Message to Dvupalov
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_X5SciArticle_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> …say with certainty that Prof. Dvupalov was mostly correct. The main flaw in the Universal Soldier program lay in the Project X scientists’ failure to preserve the test subjects’ reason and humanity during brain manipulation, prioritizing basic… personality is also a factor. For example, prisoners with type C7 exhibit less promising results than stalkers with type… </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_X5SciArticle_hint: What little has survived in the labs beneath Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_X5_NewEra_body:
$J0L0 In light of the escalating risks posed by the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone, Project X has been terminated. All activities within your laboratory have officially been canceled.

Unofficially, Prof. Chubko, Laboratory X5 now falls under the jurisdiction of MDST – our jurisdiction. Those interested in advancing the mission entrusted to us by C-Consciousness and continuing to work on Project X may join MDST and maintain their positions.
More information regarding the lab’s new priorities will be provided later. Until then, please continue your work as usual.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_MQ03_X5_NewEra_hint: What little has survived in the labs beneath Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E08_SQ01_KartezhnykPDA_Note_bo:
$J0L0Caps: Hey, Mr. Scientist. That thing damn near took me out! Either you cough up double the cash, or I’ll fetch you some Fleshes or psi dogs instead.
Shcherba: Absolutely not. We had a deal.
Shcherba: I’ve had my fill of Fleshes and psi dogs. I need larger specimens.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ01_ArhipPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Myklukha: Great work last time, dude.
We gotta do it again. The route to Yaniv’s getting too risky – I’m burning through more ammo than I’m selling. It ain’t good for business, ya know?
Myklukha: Well, mutants are your problem, and coupons are mine. Business as usual.
Myklukha: Do it fast, and I’ll toss in a bonus. Freedom appreciates reliable folks like you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ01_LeaderPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0 The doctor is currently in the Red Forest, but his exact whereabouts are unknown.
Your job is to locate and deal with him swiftly. Ask the locals, explore anomaly clusters, and investigate abandoned settlements, as these may serve as his hideouts.
You’ll get paid double. Stick to the deadline.
Keep me updated, especially if you discover his lair.
Get started.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ01_LeaderPDA_Note_name: A Hit on the Doctor from an Unknown Client
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ01_SiviyPDA_Audiolog_bod:
$J0L0 Can you hear me, Arkhyp? Arkhyp! It’s Gray! Fucking anomaly!
Tundra got shot! We’d just set up shop at the same place the doctor was spotted. I figured that if we saw him, we’d hand him over to the mercs. But now Tundra’s guts are hanging out! I couldn’t even see where the shot came from! We’re wide open out here. Tundra’s a goner! You gotta alert… *gunshot, followed by the sound of a body falling* Please, don’t… *another gunshot*
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ01_YarlPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Wolfhound: Jarl’s team, get to the village. We’ll hit the cemetery. Stay frosty, he’s gotta be close by. The doctor’s been around the Zone longer than us, so this won’t be a walk in the park. Report back every three hours.
Wolfhound: Let’s go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ01_YarlPDA_Note_hint: From Jarl’s PDA in the abandoned village
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ02_Monolith_Note_body:
$J0L2Injured: 4.Seriously injured: 1.Gone to the Monolith: 2 (1 as a resource-saving measure).$J0L0 Regenerators running low, need fresh supply.
Other equipment sufficient.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ02_Monolith_Note_hint: A note found at the Monolith infirmary
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ02_OldPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Tailor: What made you think I could be a doctor?
Strider: You stepped up when your brother needed help. You didn’t flinch. You fixed him up without hesitation, like it was second nature.
Tailor: But I don’t remember a thing…
Strider: None of us do, but we can learn everything again. We’ve got a future to build, Tailor. Don’t let fear hold you back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ02_RegeneratorNotes_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> If the Regenerator is not configured properly, the brothers start to have nightmares and vivid hallucinations. It is important to tune the exposure level very carefully lest these temptations test their faith. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E10_MQ02_RegeneratorNotes_foot: $J2L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Guide your protector along the path, o Monolith! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ01_OasisNote_body:
$J0L0[11:57]: I found it! I found the Oasis! You didn’t believe I would, huh? And now I’ve already run outta containers for artifacts!
[11.59]: So, Sidor – you ready to pay for the coordinates? Fifty percent of every transaction. Sixty, if you try haggling. You mull it over, and I’ll take a little break.
[12:10]: It’s so beautiful here, you know. So peaceful. Just… just right.
[12:13]: I can see it as it really is. I feel so…
[12:14]: …grt
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ01_OasisNote_hint: From an unknown stalker’s PDA, found in X3
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ01_OasisNote_name: Last Messages from Someone Who Found the Oasis
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ02_3rdKaymanovDiaryNote_:
$J0L0 Currently pursuing the first option at Orbita Station (X-15). Setting up a Pod for myself. In theory, everything should work. Producing a signature imprint at the station in Lab X3 is quite the ordeal, of course… I’d have to bend the rules and request additional bio samples for the incubator down in the mine from lab assistant Burnov. The thought of spending two hours in a dry aquarium myself isn’t exactly thrilling.

One thing is certain: the prototype Pod offers more than just observation of the Noosphere. These sessions feel more like lucid dreams, where I sense the potential to influence those entities, albeit limited to one psynapse. Alas, “potential” is the keyword here: we’re clearly lacking sufficient energy to reach full interaction. It would take way more than one doctor’s mind and a single Pod to achieve that level of engagement.

Upon hearing my thoughts, Valentyn Dalin crunched the numbers and designed the specifications for an eight-pod system. That means we’re about to take a leap of faith and explore my second option to contact the Noosphere. What will come of it? Only time will tell.
Found among the papers at Orbita Station
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ02_CodeToBunkerDoor_body:
$J0L0 Following three recent incidents involving biological psi threats, floor B2 is now closed until further notice. Entry to this area is strictly prohibited except for emergencies. In the event of an emergency, use the code 4221 for access.
For further inquiries, contact First Assistant Dorosh.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ02_CodeToBunkerDoor_hint: Found among the papers at Orbita Station
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ02_InstAnt_body:
$J0L0 In the event of my absence, follow these instructions.
Reminder: the antenna is a powerful psi conductor. Being in its immediate vicinity while it is in operation is strictly prohibited. $J0L2Activate the antenna on the rooftop.Ensure that there is no biological activity nearby – any interference could damage the antenna. If the equipment detects such activity, the fuses will blow, cutting off the power supply.Stand by. The settings are configured to activate the antenna automatically if the aforementioned conditions are met. No manual input required!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ02_KaymanovDiaryNote_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Obtained the Alpha, a product of the Caribbean experiment. This remarkable artifact possesses the unique ability to convert biological alpha-psi radiation into electromagnetic beta-psi and vice versa. This discovery significantly expands our technological capabilities, allowing us to utilize existing equipment safely and paving the way for groundbreaking innovations. Are we on the threshold of accessing the Noosphere?</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Nope, no way. Creating a stable channel for data reception is turning out to be a real challenge, mainly because the ionosphere-noosphere barrier turned out to be way more energetically stable than I expected. I’m considering three options:</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>First, I could crank up the intensity until it fries the brain.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Second, I could explore the possibility of linking several consciousnesses together.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>The third option, which is a bit out there, involves using the signature imprint not just as a channel key, but as a way to create a Mediator within the Noosphere itself. Data would flow directly to the Mediator, eliminating the need to penetrate the barrier and drastically cutting down on energy consumption – sounds pretty slick, right? Problem is, how do we retrieve the data from the Mediator? If we can figure out how to set up the Source-Mediator system as a superposition, thus getting around the barrier, then we'll be rolling in it.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>As enticing as it sounds, it’s implausible for the time being. I’ll focus on the first two options for now.</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ02_KaymanovDiaryNote_hin: Found among the papers at Orbita Station
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ03_PTSthreadNote_body:
$J0L0 Since its inception in 1966 by the young and gifted Associate Prof. Sakharov, Project IRCD-1 (Individual Remote Communication Device), also known as unit “FIBER-1P,” has encountered persistent challenges in advancing beyond rudimentary experimental stages until present.
Despite the project’s official suspension due to technical constraints, such as limited range and susceptibility to interference, Professor Kalancha succeeded in making notable progress by refining and calibrating the equipment to establish a link with the STALKER Program Control Center. This breakthrough revitalized efforts in exploring the transmission and reception of cognitive information over extended distances by leveraging principles of biological radio wave propagation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ04_LetterFromKrivenko_No:
$J0L0 To Col. Korshunov
From Head of Joint Cryptobiology and Psi-Medicine Laboratory, S.A. Kryvenko $J0L0 The HVS coils have been installed on the exoskeleton as you ordered.
I understand the emergency but feel obliged to warn you:
1. The exoskeleton has been in development for quite some time. I am ready to guarantee its reliability, although your body will need some time to adapt and synchronize motor functions.
2. The stability of the intrusion protection coils cannot be guaranteed: the technology (based on the evolution of Ruhmkorff coils) has not yet passed all stages of testing, therefore, it is recommended for activation only in extreme cases (if there is a direct threat to life).
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ04_PDA_Chernozem_body: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Find potential couriers among stalkers.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Memorize requirements for potential candidates and destroy these instructions immediately.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Get in touch with Nestor.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Provide couriers with scanners on a rolling basis.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ04_PDA_Chernozem_hint: Chornozem’s PDA, found in a warehouse at the Chemical Plant
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ04_PDA_Nestor_body: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Find a contact among SIRCAA employees.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Gain their trust and establish mutually beneficial cooperation.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Obtain scanners.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Deliver all obtained equipment to Chornozem.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ04_PDA_Nestor_hint: Nestor’s PDA, found in a warehouse at the Chemical Plant
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E11_MQ04_Protocol78_Instructio: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Following an investigation conducted in the Depot and at the Slag Heap, two personal digital assistants belonging to the subjects were located and confiscated.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Biological samples were dispatched to the Mainland in accordance with transportation protocol Cargo 900X.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>All material evidence has been moved to the Chemical Plant warehouse for safekeeping.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Access code: 8506.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
Found in the Chemical Plant infirmary
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_AboutDalin_body:
$J0L0Ozersky: Dalin! Can you believe it? Dalin! He’s never set foot in the Zone! He’s only seen fieldwork from his cushy penthouse!
Hermann: Well, that might work in our favor, right? Sounds like he won’t be sticking his nose where it doesn’t belong. And with his connections, we might get some serious funding…
Ozersky: I came to the Zone to push the boundaries of science, not to push pencils! And now they want me to take orders from some kid? No way in hell! I’m out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_AboutDalin_hint: Prof. Ozersky’s PDA found inside Spirit’s bunker
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_DuhToRihter_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Stay put until the heat is down, Richter. The Corps doesn’t know about this spot. You’ll be safe here. If I don’t reach out in two days, head through the tunnel to Lymansk and wait for me at the base. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_DuhToRihter_hint: A message on a sheet of paper found in the cave
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_Groups_body:
$J0L0Group 1: Danya Bylaw & Sanya Marine.
(Crossed without problems.)
Group 2: Roma Winger & Bohdan Hook.
(I took them through, then they refused to pay. Only upfront from now on.)
Group 3: Avanes Mountain.
(Sanya Marine sent him my way. Everything’s fine.)
Group 4: Vitya Copper, Lyova Lout, Vitya Brash.
(Lout couldn’t keep up and ended up a crispy critter in the anomaly. Why’d he even tag along if he was in such shitty shape?)
Group 5: Fly & Richie.
(Richie got cold feet about crossing the Boundary. I still got paid for both.)
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_Groups_name: List of People Crossing the Boundary
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_Instruction_body:
$J0L0 I’ve tinkered with the scanner as requested and added a few tweaks. You can deactivate anomalous fields now. Not all of them, mind you, or I’d be richer than Myklukha by now. But maybe it’ll work in that tunnel under the Offloading Terminal.
Using the scanner is easy, but I’ll break it down so you don’t bug me about it.
Scanner-M Manual:
1. Set the scanner up by a stable anomaly.
2. Press the button once to activate it.
3. That’s it. Now you can go through the anomalous field. $J0L0 Note 1: Don’t drag your feet after switching it on – the effect doesn’t last long.
Note 2: Remember to throw a bolt to make sure the anomaly is really off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_Photo_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Spark is no more. Those who claim to be them now are just fakes. The original founders of Spark were killed by the Ward. And if it wasn’t for Marshal, I wouldn’t be here either. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MO01_Photo_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Spark Scientific Research and Investigation Group. Topol, Spirit, Snake, Mace. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E12_MQ01_KPKDuh_body:
$J0L0 The key card to the bunker is in my pocket. The scanner I used to get to Prypiat is inside. It’s not too hard, you’ll figure it out. I left the manual there, too.
Sorry for delivering the message like this. We can’t be sure who’s listening in. A delayed one is safer.
When you search my body, don’t be shy – take everything you need. Just make sure you bury me deep, okay? I think I deserve some rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E14_MQ01_Helicopter_Note_body:
$J0L0Squad Name: Stingray-7
Assignment: Locate all underground entrances to the Foundation facility and register their coordinates.
Sitrep: Lost contact with the helicopter crew. The last communication and coordinates are encrypted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E14_MQ01_Helicopter_Note_hint: Information from a Stingray-7 flash drive
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E14_MQ01_LaundromatDocs_Note_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Due to the Failure of Operation Fairway, Stingray survivors are to be evacuated from Site B28. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Group list: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Col. Kovalsky (Stingray-1).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Cpt. Tarasov (Stingray-3).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Lt. Rogovets (Stingray-5).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Lt. Kirillov (Stingray-3).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Lt. Podorozhny (Stingray-3).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Lt. Sokolov (Stingray-4).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>WO Valentyr (Stingray-5).</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> For assistance in rescuing our men, the stalker known as Strelok is to be evacuated with the squad. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E14_MQ01_LaundromatDocs_Note_f: $J2L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Maj. Degtyarev, officer in charge of the evacuation </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E14_MQ01_LaundromatDocs_Note_n: Evacuating Stingray Group out of the Zone
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E14_MQ01_Prometey_Spark_Note_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Rustle, we’re retreating to our fallback position. If anything goes wrong, take cover at these coordinates. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E14_MQ01_Prometey_Varta_Note_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Maj. Dvoryankov: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Delta Team, rendezvous at the exact coordinates for points B or C. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_2ndDoctorDiaryNote_bo: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> A group of these new explorers of the Zone wandered into my swamp the other day.
