These two, who go by the names Fang and Ghost, find the local miracles quite enough for them, but this Strelok guy wants more. He wants to go north, to the CNPP, and even further, to the very Center. I don’t have the slightest idea what’s going on there now. I’ve heard rumors that after becoming C-Consciousness with the help of the MDST engineers, my former colleagues are doing their best to cover up their tracks. Their futile attempts to bring order to chaos are making things even worse. But to hell with them. My duty here is to save lives. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_2ndDoctorDiaryNote_hi: Found in the basement of the doctor’s cabin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_3rdDoctorDiaryNote_bo:
$J0L0 Strelok left an artifact with me for safekeeping: the Heart of Chornobyl. He brought it back from the north.
I did some tests and came to a surprising conclusion: apparently the Zone has created an Altered Variometer, an anomalous version of Suslov’s electromagnetic psi-amplifier, and it’s at least eight times more powerful!
If I had something like this back in 2006, I would have been able to connect to the Noosphere by myself!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_3rdDoctorDiaryNote_hi: Found in the basement of the doctor’s cabin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_4thDoctorDiaryNote_bo:
$J0L0 Fang and Ghost brought in Strelok. He was half-dead. They say they came across some “Monolith” inside the CNPP Sarcophagus. Supposedly, it’s a kind of mystical wish-granting rock… what kind of nonsense is that? Either my former colleagues have gone completely nuts, or they still fancy themselves a force of destiny. Should I intervene, or remain on the sidelines?
How grateful I am to find a source of joy in all this gloom. Strelok has become like a son to me – not by blood, but by the ways of the Zone. He is strong. He will heal. And when he does, he’ll go north again.
Do I have the right to hold him back?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_4thDoctorDiaryNote_hi: Found in the basement of the doctor’s cabin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_DoctorDiaryNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Kaymanov the scientist is done: forever infamous. By trying to prevent a disaster, I may have brought forth another, more terrifying one. There is no return to the Mainland for me. I will stay in the Red Forest, contemplating the consequences of my actions. The Zone is a monster from the darkest realm of creation. I unleashed it upon us all, and this can hardly be undone. The Zone kills and maims, so my atonement must be to devote the rest of my days to helping its countless victims. Kaymanov the scientist is dead. I hope that the doctor will serve this world better. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_DoctorDiaryNote_hint: Found in the basement of the doctor’s cabin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_ProjectYNote_body:
$J0L0 You are capable of more than you think – enough to take on the hardships that will inevitably befall us in the New World. You will need something more, however, to face the unknown. Much more!
May the Zone aid us if we find ourselves lacking courage in our future trials!
You were all courageous enough to get here – every single one of you! You had the will and the faith to make it through, and you are now worthy to become liberators.
Now go to the Mainland. Wait for the right time.
Something beautiful is about to happen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_ProjectYNote_name: Draft of a Speech to an Unknown Audience
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_ProjectY_body: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Couriers (Chornozem, destroy the list).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Lab X3 (destroy all the documents, as well as any evidence of reframing agents and using couriers).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Provide scanners (Nestor).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Provide Alpha Artifacts (we’ve got a number of faded ones – more than enough).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Duga Comms Center (replace the microchips with external action modules).</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E15_MQ03_ProjectY_hint: A document from the secret unit in Kaymanov’s Laboratory
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentSFile_Chernozem_body:
$J0L0Name: Timur Tairov
Nickname: Chornozem
YOB: 1988
Profile: Career criminal, wanted murder suspect. Upon his arrival in the Zone, he promptly formed a gang and garnered favor from prominent underworld figures. Prone to violence. Psychological assessment indicates no risk of suicide and zero resistance to programming.
Programming results: Fully successful.
Programming objective: Elimination of individuals identified as potential threats.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentSFile_Chernozem_hint: C-Consciousness Agent Profile from the Neurolaboratory Archive
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentSFile_Strelok_body:
$J0L0Name: N/A.
Nickname: N/A.
YOB: N/A.
Profile: N/A.
Programming results: Program error.
Programming objective: Kill Strelok / A:LS-013.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentSFile_Strelok_hint: C-Consciousness Agent Profile from the Neurolaboratory Archive
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentSFile_Temnyj_body:
$J0L0Name: Ihor Bykov
Nickname: Dark
YOB: 1976
Profile: Former children’s hiking instructor and mountain rescuer. His professional background facilitated rapid adaptation to the Zone, where he garnered respect among stalkers assisting field researchers. Known for his strategic acumen. Cool-headed, strong communication skills. Psychological assessment indicates zero resistance to programming.
Programming results: Fully successful.
Programming objective: Kill Strelok.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentSFile_Temnyj_hint: C-Consciousness Agent Profile from the Neurolaboratory Archive
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentsFile_Nestor_body:
$J0L0Name: Oleksandr Kuchko
Nickname: Nestor
YOB: 1959
Profile: Behavioral psychologist, one of the founders of Ukrainian criminal psychology. Captured by bandits while conducting sociological research in the Zone. Low level of resistance to programming due to problems with alcohol.
Programming results: Fully successful.
Programming objective: Select candidates for future programming.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentsFile_Nestor_hint: C-Consciousness Agent Profile from the Neurolaboratory Archive
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentsFile_Scar_body:
$J0L0Nickname: Scar / A:MS-017
YOB: 1979
Profile: A mercenary. Has a natural resistance to anomalous energy and can survive Emissions without any means of psi-protection (5th class psi-resistance assumed).
Intrinsic traits: Stubborn, reckless, works well under pressure. Had Marshal’s key memories implanted during programming. [EVENT REFRAME: The Chemical Plant/death of the Spark group members].
Obtained traits: Strong interpersonal skills, exuberance, hatred for the Ward.
Warning: On the verge of nervous breakdown. Could become unstable.
Programming objective: Reflection Program.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_AgentsFile_Scar_hint: C-Consciousness Agent Profile from the Neurolaboratory Archive
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ01_PDA_Scar_body: $J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Locate an active Alpha Artifact or recruit a person to bring it to SIRCAA and keep them under control.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>An Alpha Artifact is needed in X11 to restore the functionality of the X-Network.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Use Orbita Station to recruit scientists.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Assemble a working Visiograph at STC Malachite (X17) using modules found in the Zone.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Activate the Visiograph.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Await further instructions.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ01_PDA_Scar_hint: Scar’s PDA taken from his body
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ02_MarshalNote_body:
$J0L0Marshal: That night at the Chemical Plant… It keeps coming back to me, Spirit. Spark and our boys. Why did it have to happen? We ran to them as soon as we heard the first gunshot. Topol was the first to die, and I can still see it. Mace tried to warn us, but all he could do was wheeze. That fucking second assault squad… That workshop, packed with barrels of chemicals…
Marshal: We wouldn’t be talking right now if it weren’t for Snake.
Marshal: Thieves rule, Wardens drool. That’s what he always said, remember?
Spirit: Of course I do.
Spirit: Just be careful. Don’t defy Korshunov openly.
Marshal: Don’t worry. We’ve got other ways to give him hell.
Spirit: I just don’t want them to find you too.
Marshal: Don’t worry, Spirit.
Marshal: I’ll go north. The Ward won’t get me there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ02_MarshalNote_hint: PDA taken from Marshal’s body in the Neurolaboratory
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_1stNoosphereDocumenta: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> According to a report from Lab X-18, alpha-psi radiation of a biological nature has been detected while studying the brain of sentient species. I have no idea where Pyotr Kalugin gets his test subjects from, and I have no intention of finding out. I want no part in these studies after what I’ve heard from my colleagues, even though their twisted “in vivo” methods do yield quite spectacular results. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> They performed a successful test of IRCD-1 (Individual Remote Communication Device) – the “FIBER-1P” unit – at the Troposphere Comm Station (TCS). As a side effect, they obtained data indicating that psi-radiation might somehow be linked to a powerful external information field. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Existing issues: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L1<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Very limited range (no more than 50 meters)</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Susceptibility to interference</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Interference from a far more powerful psi-source of unknown nature</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_2ndNoosphereDocumenta: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>  Biological psi-radiation has some intrinsic, fundamental constraints that can hardly be overcome in the foreseeable future. The only apparent option is to artificially grow a brain of enormous size. X16 does have a number of volunteers for this project, including Prof. Prykhodko, but this is not the path that will take us to the Noosphere. For now, while alternative approaches are yet to be found, we’ll focus our efforts on the electromagnetic generation of psi-radiation. Objectives:  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L1<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Increase the capacity of the transmitting channel</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Develop a “tunnel” to limit interference</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Increase range</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>  The group’s work on the electromagnetic simulation of psi-radiation has resulted in the discovery of beta-psi radiation. А physical prototype is to be presented shortly.  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_3rdNoosphereDocumenta:
$J0L0 Part of the group led by Prof. Chubko is working in Lab X10. So far they have tested “Raduga,” an omnidirectional antenna for a psi-emitter with electromagnetic excitation. $J0L0 Known issue:
The dispersion field provided by the modulator is quite small (approx. 1 km). The modulator is poorly isolated from the surrounding psi-environment, and the level of interference is high, resulting in significant damage to anything alive and sentient in the vicinity. $J0L0 Documented results have been sent to Lab X8, to Lebedev. Suslov says that they plan to add some necessary modifications and will try to use Raduga as an aggression-suppressing device. Kalancha has always been a dreamer. There’s no changing him. He should bring his ideas to Pyotr Strizh at the Ahroprom Research Institute – they’re definitely both on the same page. $J0L0 Unexpected discovery: (un?)fortunately, the reason for all of our technical hurdles might be due to the existence of a greater information field engulfing the entire planet. I can hardly believe it myself. The Noosphere? $J0L0 Raduga has been built and tested, but to test this incredible hypothesis, we need something smaller and equipped with a beam-focusing feature.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_4thKaymanovDiaryNote_:
$J0L0 Progress is underway as we scout for a site to set up the installation. We’ll need to be patient until the stations for probing the barrier’s density are operational:
– Azimuth router station
– Sphere station
– Krug antenna complex $J0L0 My colleagues are enthusiastic about the idea, and so am I. But the more I think about it, the less I like their fervor. I’ve been hearing a lot of talk lately about connecting to the Noosphere and changing it to get rid of the darkness humanity has brought upon itself – to create a more perfect world… $J0L0 At one point, I had to step in and remind everyone of the unwritten rules of scientific ethics and the individual mission of every scientist in particular.
Found in Kaymanov’s office in Lab X7
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_5thKaymanovDiaryNote_: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>  We’ve secured an optimal location north of the CNPP. Rapid preparations are underway for the Northern Plateau. The Generator units are arriving – we’re having significant progress. Dalin is currently assembling the O-KTA. He intends to integrate eight Pods, which should suffice. Thanks to our benefactors, Lab X7 has been deployed in no time. Additionally, Lab X11 is under construction southeast of the cooling pond and equipped with a podium for the Alpha. It will serve as a backup location for debugging, test runs, and maintaining a secure remote connection to the Center.  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>  That unhealthy gleam in their eyes troubles me. What does “getting rid of the darkness” even mean? A general amnesty? But what about human nature, the Ecce Homo? At the end of the day, we humans will remain the same, with all our inherent flaws. Even if some of us would die happy, what about the generations to come? No, their plan offers only a momentary respite. Ultimately, these measures lead nowhere.  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
Found in Kaymanov’s office in Lab X7
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_6thKaymanovDiaryNote_: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Looks like they’ve made up their minds. They’re keeping up professional appearances, sure, yet they’re avoiding eye contact. What does the Noosphere mean to you, Kaymanov? Will you give in to your desires, or will you protect the thought-forms within its confines? This is the crux of the matter. Should we take a risk? It might pay off, but if it doesn’t… We could be facing a disaster of unthinkable, even global magnitude. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> It seems Dalin intends to swap out my (empty) Pod with Suslov’s apparatus from the Caribbean Experiment. I’m surprised they haven’t thought about constructing a Variometer large enough to replace all eight of us. But then who would claim the accolades? </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
Found in Kaymanov’s office in Lab X7
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_CaribbeanDoc_body: $J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Suslov has built an interesting contraption he calls the Variometer. It is an electromagnetic psi-amplifier with a modulation unit. Its output power is actually similar to that of a human brain in active state. It allowed us to perform the Caribbean Experiment, which was aimed at testing the hypothesis of the Noosphere’s existence.</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>The report is attached.</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Location: Island in the CNPP cooling pond, Laboratory X-6.</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Emission source: RV OROL Long-Range Communication Vessel, equipped with Suslov’s Variometer. The OTH range was reached via electromagnetic psi-beam reflection at the lower ionosphere layers.</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Emission receiver: Orchila Island, Caribbean Sea, RV AGAR.</NoteDefault></NoteBody> $J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Results:</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Processing the obtained data and analyzing the registered distortions has provided experimental proof of the Noosphere’s existence.</NoteDefault> </ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Not only was the psi-beam reflected at the ionosphere, it also “grazed” the Noosphere itself. As a result, a cluster of unknown matter coagulated on board the receiving vessel in the Caribbean Sea. This cluster has received the code name “Object Alpha.”</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>The Artifact was discretely delivered to the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone for in-depth study by the Project X special task force.</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_InstructionOKTA_body:
$J0L0 NOOSPHERE EXPERIMENT PROTOCOL $J0L0 Instruction for technical personnel operating O-СTA equipment $J0L0Laboratory power supply:
Engage the power switch to power up the facility.
Needle antenna:
Place the psi-amplifier into the container on the central stand.
Main control panel:
1. Insert Cartridges containing personal signatures into the slots in the receiving panel.
2. O-СTA: Set the primary mode lever to the “INITIAL” position and wait for the Pods to become operational.
3. Press the “SERVICE: EXPOSE” button and wait for the Pods to assume vertical position.
4. All experiment participants should enter their designated Pods.
5. Set the primary mode lever to the “EXPERIMENT” position. $J0L0*Note:Pod #1 is equipped with a remote launch button. It can be unlocked from the console in Room #1.$J0L0 6. Technical staff should continuously monitor telemetry and nominal modes. Close your eyes and go to your happy place!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_InstructionOKTA_hint: Found in Kaymanov’s office in Lab X7
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_StrelokPDANoteOnArtif: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>  To think that I had the Heart of Chornobyl on me when I first reached the Pods in X7, at the Generators… Protecting the Zone wasn’t on my mind at the time, however. But if the doctor’s findings regarding this artifact are true, I can succeed now. This time, there’s no doubt.  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
From Strelok’s PDA taken from his body
Note on the Heart of Chornobyl
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_StrelokPDANote_body:
$J0L0 I had to copy the instructions by hand. The original is pretty much unreadable. $J0L0 “The Signature must be obtained in the Marking Neurolaboratory.
The process is entirely automated.
Staff must ensure the subject is seated and remains still throughout the procedure.
Once the Signature has been obtained, retrieve the Cartridge and archive the recording following established protocol.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_E16_MQ03_StrelokPDANote_hint: A note from Strelok’s PDA taken from his body
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ109_MarikTopotNote_body:
$J0L0 Marik Stomper: I packed my bags and headed out. Moved to the Burnt Forest.
Illyukha Sparrow: Alone? No way! You lookin’ to get killed out there?
Marik Stomper: I’m fed up with the Gaffer’s yapping, man. I’m sick of tagging along with a bunch of rookies on a jaunt right around the corner. Nah, I’m looking for a fresh start. Found myself an artifact in an anomaly field just yesterday, like a real stalker! You get me?
Illyukha Sparrow: I do… I’m actually a little jealous.
Marik Stomper: No need, bro. I’ve already set up my own stash. It ain’t fancy, but it’ll come in handy. But take care – word is, some bandits from the Swamps are coming our way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ109_MarikTopotNote_hint: PDA from a stalker’s body inside the crashed helicopter
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ109_VitekLunaNote_body:
$J0L0Vityok Moon: Me and the crew are done with the Sultan’s joint, Tokha. We’re striking out on our own here.
Tokha Meadow: “Here?” And where’s that?
Vityok Moon: You won’t rat us out, will ya? We’re out in the boonies. They say it’s called the Burnt Forest. Come on over, man. The stalkers here are real sloppy. Easy pickings.
Tokha Meadow: Maybe I’ll swing by. I need to think it over.
Vityok Moon: What’s there to think over? Ain’t you tired of wondering if your own buddies are gonna put a bullet in your skull? Join us, man. But pack some grub – we’ve got no traders here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ109_VitekLunaNote_hint: PDA from a bandit’s body at the Swinery
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ110_DokaPDANote_body:
$J0L0 I’m getting close. Hermit picked this spot for a reason. It takes guts to scavenge for loot in this neck of the woods. Word is, he was among the first stalkers to prowl the Zone. Which means the guy could be stashing some serious swag.
There are critters roaming around the school, but they say Hermit always traveled light. Maybe I can find a way to slip through… If I discover his secret stash, I’ll have a tale to share over a drink. Fingers crossed it’s not just a bunch of expired canned chow…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ110_DokaPDANote_hint: PDA from a stalker’s body near the school
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ110_HermitNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I had a bizarre dream yesterday. There was a family gathering around the kitchen table. The mother was serving food, and the TV was humming softly in the background. Toys all over the floor, but some of them were artifacts. A child was playing with them as though they were ordinary playthings. Everyone smiled as they sat down to eat, but in the backdrop, an Emission was looming. Black high-rise buildings against a fiery red sky… </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> The morning brought a biting wind – a sign from the Zone to go north. The route to the Zone’s heart goes through the Red Forest. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’m traveling light, taking only what’s absolutely necessary. I’m leaving the rest behind for whoever stumbles across it. Something tells me I won’t be coming back.  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> There’s something in the air. The Zone is stirring, like a growling, restless beast in a cage. If it breaks free, it will spare no one. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ110_HermitNote_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’ve been having trouble sleeping lately. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ110_HermitNote_hint: Note from Hermit’s stash near the School
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ118_NoteDeadIskra_body:
$J0L0Ozersky: We have been picking up an odd signal coming from Lymansk lately. Time to figure out what is going on there.
Ozersky: Head to the coordinates, find some high ground, and record whatever you hear. I have filed the request for equipment with the warehouse. It will be ready for pickup when you need it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ118_NoteDeadIskra_hint: A PDA found near the checkpoint at the bridge in the Red Forest
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ11_Norton_Note_body:
$J0L0Norton: West, we got a problem. Those damn loners from the Cordon offloaded the artifacts to Sidorovich—and they’re not giving back the advance.
Norton: Word is, we tried to pull a fast one, but Sidor straightened ’em out about the prices.
Norton: Fuck, when did we start pinching pennies harder than Sidor?
West: I dunno. Maybe when you lost your last bolt in a game of cards, smartass.
West: Anyway, we gotta silence those dudes before they start spreading the word that Freedom are easy marks. Text your merc, whoever he is.
Norton: Moth. Told you a hundred times.
West: I don’t give a damn what his name is. Just make sure he’ll do the job quickly and quietly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ11_Norton_Note_hint: Freedom members discussing a hit on their former partners
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ13_Filimon_Note_body:
$J0L0Adik Pedal: Hey, huckster. Heard you’re the stash guy. We’re after a big one. Good guns.
Filimon: Some assault rifles, a couple of hunting rifles, and a machine gun, I think. Plus ammo for all of ’em. Got Fleshes nearby. 7,000, if that’s good with you.
Adik Pedal: That’s a ripoff! We’ll burn through half the ammo just dealing with the critters, and that’s if my boys even make it. Gimme a discount!
Filimon: Take it or leave it. My stashes move fast.
Adik Pedal: Fuck, you Freedom scumbags are nothing but scammers. All right, the coupons are on the way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ13_Filimon_Note_hint: A contract to sell a weapons stash to bandits
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ13_MihaNote_body:
$J0L0Moth: Hey there. Heard you’re after the guy who supplied the bandits with guns. I got a lead for you. It’ll cost you, though. A thousand coupons.
Mykha Cowboy: Sent the coupons your way. Now spit it out.
Moth: Ever heard of Filimon from Freedom? He’s the man who sold them the stash.
Mykha Cowboy: How’d you find out?
Moth: Had a few with Adik. He runs the gang that took out your pals. Spilled everything in his cups.
Mykha Cowboy: Son of a bitch... I know Filimon. I can deal with him. Where’s Adik now?
Moth: Gonna need more for that info. Ten grand. Can you swing it?
Mykha Cowboy: I’ll make it happen. Keep in touch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ13_MihaNote_hint: The tip that sparked Mykha’s vendetta against Filimon
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ140_IluhaVorobejNote_NoDetec:
$J0L0 Can a man be cursed with perpetual misfortune? No, I refuse to accept it. When a technician botches your gear, then you get mauled by mutants, then bandits rough you up, your luck is bound to turn around eventually. And if it doesn’t… well, that’s just not fair, damn it.
The guys make fun of me. They say if the Zone rejects you, you’re better off spinning yarns by the campfire – the sausage and vodka are on us. But that’s not why I came all the way here. If I was willing to settle for less, I’d have stayed put on the Mainland after I got my lit degree. No, out there… success is waiting for me.
I’ll head to Perun’s Hill. The journey is long and daunting, and my detector is acting up. I wish that stalker had sold me one of his… Now, I’ll have to make do with this piece of junk to hunt for artifacts. Still, if I manage to find just one, it’ll make up for all my past failures. After all, fortune favors the bold… right?
PDA from a loner’s body in the Burnt Forest
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ140_IluhaVorobejNote_body:
$J0L0 Can a man be cursed with perpetual misfortune? No, I refuse to accept it. When a technician botches your gear, then you get mauled by mutants, then bandits rough you up, your luck is bound to turn around eventually. And if it doesn’t… well, that’s just not fair, damn it.
The guys make fun of me. They say that if the Zone rejects you, you’re better off spinning yarns by the campfire – the sausage and vodka are on us. But that’s not why I came all the way here. If I was willing to settle for less, I’d have stayed put on the Mainland after I got my lit degree. No, out there… success is waiting for me.
I’ll head to Perun’s Hill. The journey is long and daunting, and the place is as barren as it gets – no traders, nowhere safe to rest – but if I make it back with an artifact, it’ll make up for all my past failures. After all, fortune favors the bold… right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ140_IluhaVorobejNote_hint: PDA from a loner’s body in the Burnt Forest
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ143_NoteRybakinKolumb_body:
$J0L0[15:23]Rybyakin: The advance is coming through. Everything’s set. Drop the goods at the coordinates I sent.
[15:24]Rybyakin: And make sure to grab some anti-rad! Those buses are soaked in rads, like they circled around the reactor back in ’86 or somethin’. $J0L0[17:40]Columbus: Dude, that spot you picked is hot as hell. My counter was screaming blue murder while I stashed the goods!
[17:41]Rybyakin: No one’s gonna snoop around that place. Pretty smart, huh?
[18:01]Columbus: I don’t feel so hot. I think I messed up with the anti-rads
[18:02]Rybyakin: Get to the bar quick, we’ll sort you out! $J0L0[19:11]Rybyakin: You all right, man?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ143_NoteRybakinKolumb_hint: Rybyakin gives instructions for the stash
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ144_GlazgoNote_body:
$J0L0Glasgow: I’m sober now, Tyoma. Shit… you’re at Chystohalivka? We found a stash in the basement, but then someone locked us in. Can you come get us out?
Glasgow: There was an Emission outside, and Short wouldn’t let some guy in, so he locked us inside, then dropped dead. I need your help.
Glasgow: Short’s so hammered that he can’t even stand up. That vodka must’ve been bad. I’m scared to go check on him, what if he’s dead? Dammit… my head’s pounding.
Glasgow: Dammit, I can hear a PDA beeping from outside every time I text you. You were the dude Short didn’t let inside? I’m sorry. He never said he called you.
Glasgow: But if you’re dead over there… then, who’s making all that noise?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ144_KucyjNote_body:
$J0L0Short: Guess what, Tyoma – me and the gang stumbled across a stash! Looks like Freedom’s. Sweet spot, nobody around!
Short: We hit the booze jackpot, Tyoma! We’re so sloshed! Where the hell are you?
Short: Can you believe this? Some chump tried to crash our party! We didn’t let him in. There’s barely enough room for us!
Short: That son of a bitch locked us in! Now he’s gone and croaked outside, but somehow jammed the damn door shut! Get us outta here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ145KostaKonusNoteText_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Yesterday: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L1<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Southern checkpoint – to the southwest, every 2 hours</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Eastern checkpoint – to the northeast, every 3 hours.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Today: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L1<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Southern checkpoint – to the southwest, every 4 hours</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Eastern checkpoint – to the northeast, every hour</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Patrols keep changing their routine. Can’t see a pattern yet. Snipers are active in the area. No blind spots. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ145KostaKonusNoteText_hint: A note found on a Sparker’s body in Chornobyl-2
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ14_KuzaNote_body:
$J0L0Sanya Chief: How’s it going? Bright mentioned you’re rolling in it over in Rostok.
Kuzya: Yeah, we struck gold. Rostok’s full of rich suckers cozying up to Freedom. They’re all loaded – not a piece of cake for a shakedown, but they’re ripe for a scam.
Sanya Chief: So you’re making a living off smooth talk? Really?
Kuzya: You bet. I’ve got the gift of gab, and it’s paying off. If you wanna join the party, chip in on the stash. I’ll ping you the location.
Sanya Chief: Sounds dope. I’ll mull it over. Catch you later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ14_KuzaNote_hint: PDA of a bandit named Kuzya, who tried to sell a car
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ150_NoteOtshelnikText_body:
$J0L0 I got out of the Red Forest. The journey was grueling. I encountered a hornhead. Mutants usually steer clear of me, but this one halted in my path, glaring at me with a vacant, menacing gaze, as if barring my passage. For a heartbeat, I feared it would charge and tear me limb from limb. But it veered off, snapping dry branches underfoot as it went.
Even now, when I close my eyes, I see lush green canopies in place of the withered red. It’s as if the forest is saying, “Behold my former glory. Behold what’s been wrought upon me.” The First Disaster, the breach of the Noosphere… Humanity has shown no mercy to this place. Now, it reaps what it has sown.
One met his end with a bullet in his back, another got torn apart by mutants, a third fell off a ledge into an anomaly… More bodies littered the path, but I paid them no heed.
A brief rest, and then onward, to the Dead Valley. The Zone calls to me, its heart beckoning. What truths lie within? What revelations does it hold?

I’ll leave some provisions here. Should another escape the Red Forest, they will surely be needed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ150_NoteOtshelnikText_hint: A note found in the village in Yaniv
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ155_BromPDAText_body:
$J0L0[14:30] Hosha Boyara: What was that drunk gibberish you sent me last night, Bromine? Something about some fat sucker you ran into?
[14:31] Hosha Boyara: Did you see him in a mirror?
[14:35] Borya Bromine: Shut your trap. That sucker’s a lab tech for the eggheads. We got him wasted, and he spilled the beans about a kick-ass stash. But the door’s got a damn code lock!
[14:37] Hosha Boyara: Well, I dunno, try 1111 or 1234…
[14:40] Borya Bromine: Are you fucking stupid? I don’t have to guess. The password’s written on some lab critter’s collar from their experiments. It’s probably been dead for ages. Just gotta find the corpse.
[14:40] Hosha Boyara: You better watch out, or there’ll be two dead critters there. Ha ha. $J0L0[16:02] Hosha Boyara: Cat got your tongue? You mad at me, bro?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ155_BromPDAText_hint: Found on a body near the Hydrodynamics Lab
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ155_CollarControllerNotes_hi: Text on a collar tag taken from a controller
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ156_MorozPDANote_body:
$J0L08/12
Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: About those samples… keep it under wraps, all right?
Zhenya Blizzard: Sure thing. But seriously, why the sudden interest in these bones? You’re more of a techie, aren’t you?
Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: This is not my project. A colleague of mine is very interested in them, though. He’s itching to study the bone marrow of bloodsucker victims. $J0L08/15
Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: How’s it going? Found a partner yet? Zhenya Blizzard: I can handle it on my own. I found a sweet spot in the swamp. Enough to fill a dozen of your suitcases.
Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: I don’t need a dozen, all right? Just bring me one, settle the bill, and we’ll put this behind us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ156_MorozPDANote_hint: PDA of a Sparker killed in the swamp near Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ161_kudravyjNote_body:
$J0L0Curly: My boys spotted Skif heading down to X5. I’m thinking we can catch him at the military warehouses.
Scar: Not a smart move.
Curly: Why not? We’ve got the numbers, and we know the turf. We’ll take him down quick, snatch Korshunov’s badge, and waltz into the Chemical Plant like we own the place.
Scar: Skif’s a good man who made some bad choices. I want to give him a chance to make things right.
Curly: That’s bullshit, Scar. He’s a Warden bitch. It’s too late to get all high and mighty.
Scar: Suit yourself. But something tells me he’ll be the one walking away from this, not you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ161_kudravyjNote_hint: An ambush planned for Skif at the base near Ahroprom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ163_PripoyFuneralNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> IN MEMORY OF PANAS, FROM HIS ASSHOLE FRIENDS </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ163_PripoyFuneralNote_hint: A farewell to the man who died in the Slag Heap assault
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ165_TrachukPDANote_body:
$J0L0Trachuk: I need a favor, Trickster… I’ve got a flash drive with extremely valuable information on it. Can you keep it safe for me while I look for a way to process the data?
Trickster: What kind of data are we talking?
Trachuk: I’ve been analyzing the information obtained over the course of an Emission, when anomalous energy was bursting from the Noosphere. I don’t want it to fall into the wrong hands. Call me paranoid, but I suspect someone in Malachite is working for the Ward. If they find out about my research, they’ll take it from me and use it for leverage.
Trickster: I see. Here are the coordinates of a spot far from Ward patrols. Meet me there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ165_TrachukPDANote_hint: Found on a dead scientist near the vehicle station in Malachite
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ166_ValerianPDANote_body:
$J0L0 Father Valerian: Got a new job from Duty. What’s your ETA?
Van: I’m not coming back.
Father Valerian: Come on, Van! We’ve been in this together since the Cordon! We’ve gone through so much!
Van: Cut the crap. You keep living in your memories about the time when we were fending off Yoga’s bandits. It’s all in the past. After the Second Emission, no one needs the base at the Cordon anymore. No one needs us. We’ve become errand boys for Duty. And I’m done with it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ166_ValerianPDANote_hint: PDA found on a stalker’s body by the Cooling Towers
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ167_NoteOtshelnikText_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’m here. I’m home. I’m ready. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ167_NoteOtshelnikText_hint: A note found in the Dead Valley
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ16_FaraPDANote_body:
$J0L0 Stopped by the Ribs today to honor the fallen. Whoever named it had quite the wits. Wish I was that creative… It’s like, a titan was walking through, his chest rupturing as he collapsed and died, and now his rib cage is the only thing left…
Just think of how many lives that giant has taken! I hope the medkits I left will come in handy.
Freaking beautiful view of the Poppy Field, especially at sunset. Sky is red, the flowers too, mirroring each other, blending together…
What sort of folks are we? Always fussing around, messing around, not even noticing the beauty of it all!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ16_FaraPDANote_hint: PDA belonging to Headlight, a stalker who marveled at the Zone’s splendor
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ20_PropositionFromZhukovsky_:
$J0L0Pvt. Pavlyuk: Hey, Zulu. My buddy and I are done beating around the bush with Voronin. We wanna roll with the real Duty. You got room for us?
Zulu: I can hook you up with a couple of jobs. Nail those, then we’ll talk.
Zulu: Number one: nab the stash at these coordinates. Number two: mop up all the mutants in Kopachi. You got three days. Any questions?
Pvt. Pavlyuk: Negative. We’ll split and get it done in one day.
Zulu: Don’t go playing the hero. Stick together.
Zulu: Pasha, do you copy?
PDA from a Duty member’s body in Eastern Tunnel
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ26_ChatWithOzerskijAndLevsa_:
$J0L08/07
Dorozhnyuk: Get the equipment from the storage room tonight. I need psi-radiation measurements from Yantar. I’ll provide the coordinates.
Dorozhnyuk: Handle the equipment with care, and keep this mission under wraps. Especially from Ozersky.
Lefty: Understood. $J0L08/08
Lefty: We’re pinned down in the psi-radiation zone. Surrounded, can’t break out.
Dorozhnyuk: What about the equipment?
Lefty: We ditched it at the last mark. We need backup ASAP.
Dorozhnyuk: Hang in there! I’ll do what I can.
PDA from a stalker’s body near Lake Yantar
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ29_TradeNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> We’re gonna do it the old-fashioned way. You drop the artifact and pick up the goods. Mess up like the last guy, and you’ll vanish in the Zone like the others. Remember, you’re breaking the law by trespassing here. Unlike us. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ29_TradeNote_hint: A note from the Eastern Checkpoint stash
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ30_DobryakReturn_Note_body:
$J0L0Alex Koldoba: We never knew each other, and you’ll never get a chance to read this, but I still feel the need to write it… To explain myself, maybe. I was so happy when I snatched the artifact in that anomaly and somehow made it out alive, and then… then I saw you buried under a pile of rocks. $J0L0
Alex Koldoba: It could have been me. But the Zone chose me today, and I wanted to do the right thing, like a decent human being. I’m sorry I couldn’t get your body out. It was just too dangerous. But at least I have your PDA. I’ll leave it here, by this cross. $J0L0
Alex Koldoba: Rest in peace.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ30_DobryakReturn_Note_hint: A stalker’s PDA left by a rock near the Ribs
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ30_DobryakReturn_Note_name: A farewell message to a fallen stalker

Poltos: I’ll leave it here so it’ll always be with you.

$J0L0Snag: I’m hustling chumps at the Flea Market these days. Need some muscle.
Varan: My rates are still the same.
Snag: Cool. Just make sure your goons dress the part.
Varan: No problem. We just offed a couple of loners yesterday.
Snag: And make sure they call me “Lex the Legend.” Can’t let the act slip.
Snag: Yesterday, I had some nosy son of a bitch asking too many questions. I got out, but I’ve got this fucking feeling he’s not done bugging me. Send a couple more guys my way, just to be safe.
Varan: Fine. I’ll send one more, but that’s all you’re getting. You’re not exactly flush with cash. Chill out and head back. Don’t worry. You’re not big enough of a deal to have the whole Zone looking for you.

$J0L0 Hi, Teacher. I spotted you near the Swamp streetcar with some sketchy guys the other day. If you’re in a bind, just holler – we’ve got your back.

P.S. Why were those thugs calling you “Snag,” if you don’t mind me asking? Just curious.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ35_VolanNote_hint: One of the Legend’s disciples is worried about his idol
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ36_KucherNote_body:
$J0L0Ihor: You went to Tolik’s grave again, didn’t you?
Gena Hackman: Yeah.
Ihor: You gotta let him go. Let the whole thing go. It ain’t your fault he’s gone. You gotta find a way to move on, dude. I bet Tolik would want that.
Gena Hackman: You hitting the booze in there? Playing shrink now, are ya?
Ihor: Maybe a little. All right, let’s toast to Tolik’s memory with the boys. He was the real deal. Knew Strelok himself!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ36_KucherNote_hint: PDA from a stalker’s body at the Cemetery
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ37_NoteFromGrom_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> May at least some of the victims of the First Raid find remembrance here. Mikha Sheepskin, Luther, Hollywood… rest in peace. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ37_NoteFromGrom_hint: Found at the mass grave by the Cage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ38_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Energy drinks from decent folks. Take what you need, leave what you can. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ38_Note_hint: A paper note from the energy drink stash
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ38_ThanksNotes_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Big shoutout for the energy drinks, pals. Saved me from dozing off for good in the Poppy Field. When I swing back with the loot, I’ll make sure to restock the stash. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ38_ThanksNotes_hint: A message from the milk truck stash
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ38_ThanksNotes_name: Note from the Energy Drink Stash
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ48_GiverNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> So, you like rummaging through other people’s stashes? You’ve sure been persistent enough to get this far. I get it. I was in your shoes once, but I’ve had my fill now. Take my stuff, and in return, do me a favor – put a good word in with the Zone for a former stalker. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ48_GiverNote_hint: Note from a stash at the Cordon
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ51_TemaJetPDANote_body:
$J0L0Pvt. Pavlyuk: Hey there! Just sent over Zulu’s orders. Got your gear ready?
Pvt. Tymchenko: Locked and loaded! Let’s hit Kopachi first, then grab the stash.
Pvt. Pavlyuk: Nah, that won’t get us anywhere. I’ll snag the stash while you deal with Kopachi.
Pvt. Tymchenko: Wait, what? They’re both two-man jobs.
Pvt. Pavlyuk: You think we’re the only ones Zulu’s testing? The early bird gets the worm. All right, I’m off. See you back at base.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ51_TemaJetPDANote_hint: PDA from a Duty member’s body in Kopachi village
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ52_PuzirPDANote_body:
$J0L0Shah: Think you can hide? Think again, motherfucker.
Shah: If you don’t cough it up, I’ll carve snowflakes out of your eyelids and dangle them on your window. You’ll be peering through the gaps to see where I strung your balls up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ52_PuzirPDANote_hint: PDA of a bandit who died in the anomaly
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ58_NotesAboutZombieFriend_bo:
$J0L07/16
Foster walked into a psi anomaly today and suffered significant exposure… Rostok was out of the question – he’s in rough shape, and they’d put him down on sight. So I brought him to the tunnel and gave him some meds. Fingers crossed he pulls through and doesn’t turn into a zombie. $J0L07/17
It didn’t work. Foster’s pale as a ghost, blank stare, doesn’t seem to recognize me anymore. He’s just pacing around, lashing out at me. I had to lock him up in a cage. Thought I’d put him out of his misery, but couldn’t bring myself to do it. And he keeps calling my name.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ60_NoteVovchik_body:
$J0L0Twine: Got everything squared away? Everyone’s hanging tight. We’re just waiting on you.
Koldyba: I’m still at the pig farm, sorting out my stash. I’ll be heading out soon.
Twine: Man, you’re slower than molasses in January! The crew’s getting restless. Hurry up, or we’ll leave Garbage without you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ60_NoteVovchik_hint: PDA from a body found at the Pig Feedlot in Garbage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ62_MuhaNote_body:
$J0L0Tarragon: Tire’s freaking out. We really going through with this?
Fly: Calm your tits, I’ve got it under control. But I’m warning you, if anyone blabs, I’ll knock your teeth out!
Tarragon: Got it, mum’s the word. But you better sweet-talk them real good, or we’re toast.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ62_MuhaNote_hint: PDA of a gang boss killed near the railway tracks in Garbage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ64_MakisPDANote_body:
$J0L0Breadcrumb: I’ve run outta bullets.
Smiley: Don’t sweat it. I got extra.
Breadcrumb: I’m sick of this. We’re living like fucking hobos. No coupons, no crib. I came here to make bank, not rot away in the Lesser Zone.
Smiley: Chill. We’ll score big soon – get some loot, buy decent gear, head to Rostok. They say it’s the place to be. And we won’t have to deal with greenhorns no more.
Breadcrumb: Dude, we’re the greenhorns. Fine, whatever. I’m in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ64_MakisPDANote_hint: Stalker’s PDA found in the southern part of the Lesser Zone
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ65LosNote_body:
$J0L0Sidorovich: Leech’s looking for a sidekick to hit a stash. How convenient. Why don’t you volunteer?
Alex Moose: You for real, man? We’ve all had it with his crap. Might be nice to get away from his yapping for a bit.
Sidorovich: Remember what we talked about? Go with Leech, find out where he scored the cash for that fancy gun, and ask him about the IPSF. He’ll blather on about it, guaranteed.
Sidorovich: If my gut is right and he’s selling artifacts straight to the IPSF, you come back solo. If not, he lives. I’ll pay you either way.
Alex Moose: Well, I dunno about that… Not everyone’s cut out for the Zone, and that gun of his is calling my name.
Sidorovich: Your call. Just make sure to bring me his PDA. And keep your trap shut about our little deal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ65LosNote_hint: Found on Moose’s PDA at the Elevator
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ67_UraKotPDANote_body:
$J0L0Yura Cat: Titmouse! We’re screwed! Help! Monolith hit us hard and I’m hurt real bad.
Yura Cat: These freaks are nastier than ever… Nobody made it!
Yura Cat: Say something, damn it! I’m bleeding out over here!
Titmouse: I’m sorry.
Yura Cat: WTF? Get someone over here! The Monolith goons are gone. THEY’RE GONE!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ68_Order_for_Kubrak_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Pvt. Kubrak is hereby tasked with leading the cleanup of mutant-infested areas. Additionally, Pvt. Zhyvotko is assigned to this duty as disciplinary action for tardiness. Upon completion, a verbal report is to be delivered to Lt. Mateus at the base, with a written report to be submitted to Cpt. Shkarlat. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ68_Order_for_Kubrak_name: Pvt. Kubrak’s Orders to Eliminate Mutants
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ70_DeadBodyNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Slick Dimon: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Take four signs and put ’em up by that shack near the building. We’ll make a stash there. The rookies piss themselves anywhere near radiation, so they won’t touch it with a ten-foot pole. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ70_DeadBodyNote_hint: PDA from the body of a rookie killed by Fleshes in the Lesser Zone
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ70_DeadBodyNote_name: Message from a dead stalker’s PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ73_EdikBaskaPDANote_body:
$J0L0Docent: The Shah took our cut again. That’s three months in a row, dammit!
Edik the Dome: Same old, same old.
Edik the Dome: Still working for free, or are we already in the red?
Docent: Tomorrow, we’ll be back in the black.
Docent: Huron’s delivering the cargo to the Shah.
Docent: Time to set your plan in motion.
Edik the Dome: About time! Lend me a couple of guys to make an impression.
Edik the Dome: We’ll catch the courier early and take what’s ours.
Docent: Make sure to mask up, and take the goods straight to the boiler house.
Docent: No detours.
Edik the Dome: Relax. It’s gonna be smooth as silk!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ73_EdikBaskaPDANote_hint: Found at the scene of a gang fight in Garbage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ73_EdikBaskaPDANote_name: Chat from Edik the Dome’s PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ74_JitnichenkoNote_body:
$J0L0Smirnov: You’re overstepping, Zhytnychenko! Your ludicrous theories about anomalies transforming radionuclides into artifacts are not only groundless, but they also contradict my own research!
Zhytnychenko: I respect your findings, Professor, but I can’t discount my own observations. My hypothesis could offer insights into the true nature of anomalies!
Smirnov: Very well. I’ll greenlight your expedition to Garbage. Let’s put this “hypothesis” of yours to the test.
Zhytnychenko: Hold on, I didn’t request permission for an expedition!
Smirnov: Let’s just cut through the red tape and consider it granted in advance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ74_JitnichenkoNote_hint: PDA from the body of a scientist in Garbage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ92_PDA_body:
$J0L0[18:28] Unknown: Any updates, stalker?
[18:29] Kiryukha: I found some intel on those guerrillas. Not too much – they keep things tight – but it’s as reliable as it gets!
[18:31] Unknown: Good. Shoot it over, we’ll vet it.
[18:32] Kiryukha: That’s not what we talked about! I take this directly to the commander, and he hooks me up with the Ward – that was our deal.
[18:41] Unknown: All right, I’ll arrange a meeting for you. With the commander. Tomorrow, 6 PM, at the tunnel.
[18:42] Kiryukha: Deal! $J0L0[17:50] Kiryukha: I’ll be there in a couple of minutes.
[17:51] Unknown: Hold tight. Like I said, I’ll be there.
[18:02] Kiryukha: So where are you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_EQ92_PDA_hint: PDA from a stalker’s body in the tunnel near the checkpoint
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Engergetik_Telegraf_body:
$J0L0Telegraph: They called us all to the Palace, the only safe place left.
Telegraph: If "safe" is an option when it's Monolith we're talking about.
Telegraph: I thought Deggy was blowing it out of proportion, but it turns out he was sugar-coating it.
Telegraph: And that's just the beginning, I'm sure. This town is only quiet before a storm.
Harpy: Well, is your heart still beating? Got your gun?
Harpy: You only get to message me if you got a problem with either.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Engergetik_Telegraf_hint: Found at the Corps base in Prypiat
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_01_NotesForKort_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I told you there was someone out there, Squat! I saw a stalker, probably one o’ them loonies from Wild Island. Carrying something hefty – looked like a big score. I’ll stay put and keep tabs on him while you rally the crew. Just in case, you know. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_02_NotesWithWarning_body:
$J0L0 Don’t wait up. I sent you my location, but you’re better off outta here – this critter messed me up, so it’s sure gonna get you too. In case you got a death wish, take whatever you want. I won’t need it anyway.
Sure hope Scar wasn’t lying about the Shining Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_03_NotesForGuide_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> No comms here… Guess I’ll be talking to myself. When you told me about this pipe, why the hell didn’t you say it smells like Flesh ass? Who’s gonna let me into a bar stinking like this? Drinks are on you. Some guide you are, damn it. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_04_NotesAboutFishing_body:
$J0L0[09:21]: Should’ve set up a stash by the river to go on night runs.
[09:33]: That catfish sure as hell remembered me – every foggy morning, I can see it staring at me from the water.
[09:38]: That’s what drinking’ll do to ya. Freaking catfish, really? That water will make a Monolithian float belly up. If there were any left…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_05_NotesAboutStash_P1_name: Note found on a body in the village
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_06_NotesAboutStash_P2_name: Note found on a body near the Marshes
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_07_NotesAboutStash_P3_name: Note found on a body inside the Popper
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_08_NotesMercenaries_body:
$J0L0[12:24]: Got anything?
[12:36]: Not really. All quiet on the bridge, but I did scare the crap outta this stalker. He told me all about his sweet stash.
[12:36]: Near the cliff, left of the bridge. Can’t check it out myself. Gotta keep a low profile.
[12:52]: Gotcha. We’ll swing by on the next raid and get it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_08_NotesMercenaries_name: Mercs chatting about some sweet loot
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_100_NotesAboutGarbage_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You’re digging in the wrong place, stalker. Look at this pile of garbage. Isn’t it beautiful? There’s something amazing in there, right? That’s what everyone’s thinking, yeah. You gotta be smarter than that. Look for a dig site. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_101_NotesBanditsTalk_body:
$J0L0[15:18]: He kept babbling about how he knew all the shortcuts around here.
[15:18]: He shut up real quick when he took a tumble off the crossing. By the way, your cut’s stashed under the mattress, same as always.
[15:19]: But that little piece of… Anyway, catch you later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_102_NotesAboutOmen_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[11:20]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Here's some folk wisdom for you: don’t go turning left three times, or the evil eye might get you. If you stumble upon someone under a bridge, offer up some loot or toss it way up. And no whistling at night if you want any chance of finding artifacts. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_103_NotesAboutContract_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Laying it all on Freedom isn’t fair, Alex. They might not be the friendliest bunch, but who in the Zone is? If you’ve got the cash, they’ll do what you need. Guns, a ride to Rostok – they’ve got you covered. Just don’t cause trouble at the checkpoint. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_108_NotesAboutDetector_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[20:19]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Have you lost your damn mind, snagging my detector without a word, Deadly? I busted my ass for a month to scrape up enough for it. Next time we cross paths, you won’t be Deadly anymore – you’ll just be dead. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_109_NotesNewbieTalk_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[17:06]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Come find me in Zalissya when you’ve had your fill of being Sidorovich’s flunky, Zinger. Look for the path northwest of the village. Don’t forget your backpack – I stashed some supplies along the way. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_110_NotesGoToDepo_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[14:47]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> So, sonny, you decided to try your chances in the Zone on your own? Fair enough, and good for you. Don’t work your ass off for Sidorovich. I stashed some proper loot in Garbage, near the Depot. Take it. It should be enough to get you started. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_111_NotesForIgor_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You have to get out of this shitty business, Ihor. I’ve got a good job for you at Rostok. Do you remember how you shared your last loaf of bread with me when I lost my finger? Well, I never forgot that. You’ll find everything for the masquerade next to the vehicles. Be sure to pull it out with both hands. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_117_NotesAboutTunnel_body:
$J0L0[07:19]: Got a bit of a problem here.
[07:19]: I don’t get it. I looked everywhere, but there’s no power switch. I can’t get the ladder down without it.
[07:20]: Must be somewhere below, but I’m not going down there. That slurping sound is freaking me out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_117_NotesAboutTunnel_name: Chat between Guys Stuck in the Tunnel
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_122_NotesForDen_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Dan, I can see the loot from the opposite window, but the door to the apartment is locked. There’s something in there. I can hear scratching. If you manage to get anything of value, bring it straight to the Palace. We’re almost out of supplies. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_123_NotesAboutSenyaDeath_b:
$J0L0[04:59]: Fuck my life. Senyok got himself blown to pieces, and all his loot got thrown onto a balcony.
[05:00]: As soon as you get back from patrol, go to these coordinates. Gotta find a way to get that loot.
[05:11]: I’m getting some movement on the roof. I’ll see who it is and get back to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_128_NotesAboutCat_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[01:33]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> You’re never gonna believe this. I’ve been seeing a cat dragging random trash into the red garage. I was just laughing at the stupid thing, but yesterday, I saw it dragging a bag of loot! I guess we should go see what else it might have. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_128_NotesAboutCat_name: Message about a Cat in the Garage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_129_NotesAboutAutotunnel_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[00:45]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Mission complete, Commander. We lost two men, and one is heavily wounded. We’re on the move to Wild Territory. Restocking from our stash in the Automotive Tunnel on the way. I’ll report as soon as we get there. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_131_NotesAboutSandpit_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Sheepy, rally your men and head to Zaton. Report as soon as you get there. Get a gun and some ammo from the stash at the Sand Mine on your way. And don’t you dare touch anything else in that stash! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_132_NotesAboutGiantMunant_: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[23:09]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I’m alive! Picture this: I’m holed up in the Village, waiting out the rain, when suddenly, there’s a rumble. It felt like an earthquake! I bolt outside, and there’s this colossal monster! I barely got away. Too bad I left my backpack with loot back at the house. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_134_NotesAboutLeshchyna_bo:
$J0L0Destination: Lishchyna.
Cargo: Medical supplies.

Note. Keep the key to the safe in the truck with you at all times.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_135_NotesAboutPahan_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[08:06]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I gotta meet with the boss. He said he’s gonna make me dig my own grave if I don’t settle my debt. Hold on to the stash key for now. See you at the parking lot. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_135_NotesAboutPahan_name: Part of a Chat between Two Bandits from the Burnt Forest
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_136_NotesAboutCherevach_bo:
$J0L0[08:06]: I gotta meet with the boss. He said he’s gonna make me dig my own grave if I don’t settle my debt. Hold on to the stash key for now. See you at the parking lot.
[12:43]: I’ll keep the key, but if you don’t show up tomorrow, I’m helping myself to your loot. I know it’s tucked away in your place in Cherevach.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_136_NotesAboutCherevach_na: Chat between Two Bandits from the Burnt Forest
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_140_NotesAboutSafe_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Take the safe to our spot in the room behind the theater stage. Don’t forget to change the code. Tweak it like you usually do, and I’ll figure it out. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_140_NotesAboutSafe_name: Note from a Corpse in Lab X15
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_141_NotesForSanya_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Sanya, there are </NoteDefault><NoteBold>eighteen</NoteBold><NoteDefault> dead bodies here, </NoteDefault><NoteBold>six</NoteBold><NoteDefault> of them with claw wounds. I don’t know what tore them apart like that, but </NoteDefault><NoteBold>one</NoteBold><NoteDefault> thing is clear: you shouldn’t be going out alone at night. But I guess you’ve already figured that out. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_141_NotesForSanya_name: Note from a Corpse in the Fairytale Pioneer Camp
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_144_VistaNote1_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Start with this tower, like we agreed. I didn’t climb the balloon, so you better not. Catch up at the second mark. Wanna scout all these heights in a month. Hurry up – it’s freaking scary out here. I’m not gonna wait. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_144_VistaNote1_name: Note from a comms tower in Zalissya
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_145_VistaNote2_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Who’d have thought these bastards can run so fast. Barely got away. If you spot a boar, climb somewhere high up – running ain’t gonna save you. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_146_VistaNote3_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> This is a real birds-eye view. I told you this would be better than back home. You better catch up! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_146_VistaNote3_name: Note from the top of the elevator
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_147_VistaNote4_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> This place is full of shitheads: tried to shoot me, but no dice. Keep your head on a swivel, lock and load. Good thing we were trained for this. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_147_VistaNote4_name: Note found at a port crane
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_148_VistaNote5_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Found a pretty cool gun on this poor grunt, and he won’t be needing it anyway. I’ll keep it. Might come in handy. Long time no see – I’m worried about you. Find me at the local hub. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_148_VistaNote5_name: Note found next to a gun
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_149_VistaNote6_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> While I was chilling here, I saw a Flesh torn apart in a whirligig. Always watch your step, my friend. You still gotta catch up. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_14_NotesFromCorpse_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Hey, do you even read my messages? Folks say nobody’s going beyond the Firebreath except for zombies and cats. What a load of crap! I heard gunfire myself when I passed by the train. Someone’s poking around out there, I tell ya! And if there’s someone, there’s gotta be loot. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_14_NotesFromCorpse_name: Note from a Corpse near an Anomaly
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_150_VistaNote7_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Barely made it up here. Met some seasoned stalkers, and they shared a lot about Zone life. I’ll tell you all about it when we meet. Now you gotta catch up with me. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_150_VistaNote7_name: Note from the Slag Heap sky deck
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_151_VistaNote8_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You’ll have to get through the anomalies to reach the stash. Those bolts will come in handy. Never thought we’d make some money here. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_152_VistaNote9_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> There’s an anomaly up on the pipe. No way to climb it. I’ll wait for you near the stash. Stalker, whoever you are: if you made it all the way up here, we, K. and L., left this stash for you. This sunset view should be rewarding enough, but still. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_153_VistaNote10_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Lots of Monolithians on the way to the stash – tread carefully, my friend. Those fanatics shoot first and talk later. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_153_VistaNote10_name: Note on the way to a stash
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_154_VistaNote11_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> The view here is incredible. Take a breather, grab a bite. Always someone shooting down there, so run to the stash when it quiets down. You know what I mean… </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_155_VistaNote12_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> There’s a bunch of loners chilling by the stash, so you can catch your breath, but be careful: if the fire’s out, that means there’s mutants. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_156_VistaNote13_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You can see all of Prypiat from up here – it’s just fascinating. Oh, by the way, there are zombies near the stash. Before the grand finale, let the rookies have their moment. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_156_VistaNote13_name: Note from up top outside of Prypiat
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_157_VistaNote14_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Now the final step – the Sarcophagus pipe. I know you won’t like it, but I’ve climbed every building in the Zone. I can do it, totally. I’ll see you at the bar once I do this. You better get the party drinks ready! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_157_VistaNote14_name: Note from the Prypiat panoramic view spot
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_17_NotesForKlers_body:
$J0L0 Hey Molasses, scribbling this just in case we don’t come back. Caught bandits from the tunnel on the radio yapping about stashing loot in a safe. We’re heading there tonight.
If you’re reading this, either we’re toast, or we decided to cut you out, loser.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_18_NotesValediction_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Rest in peace, Whisker. You were one hell of a stalker. Been to the Ahroprom underground, to Prypiat, and died here, at the Cordon. Got right back where you started. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_23_NotesAboutEnergyDrink_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Medic, my ass! Doctors are all full of crap. Mainland doctors, Zone doctors, same shit. Lay off those energy drinks, you’ll have a heart attack, blah blah blah… Almost botched my trip past the Boundary. Spirit doesn’t have all day… All right. Just need one more for the road, and then I’m off. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_23_NotesAboutEnergyDrink_n: Note from the Corpse of an Energy Drink Addict
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_24_NotesAboutEmission_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Guess what? Everything went down just like you said: I bet a crate of vodka that I’d ride the Emission out here, and those morons fell for it. Have the snacks ready. I’m not stupid – I’ll sneak into a proper shelter when they’re not looking. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_25_NotesAboutMarks_body:
$J0L0 Markers by the garages.
You were right, Goose. And I was wrong. Pretty stupid, eh?
Markers by the garages.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_26_NotesAboutSafe_P1_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Package secured in the deserted barracks safe. Split the safe combination among myself, the private, and the sergeant to safeguard it. My part is 26. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_27_NotesAboutSafe_P2_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Gotta keep that code in my head. It’s 57. Hope the private’s holding up out there. Starting to lose it myself. Remember – 57. Don’t forget! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_28_NotesAboutSafe_P3_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> They sure as hell ditched me here. Said they were off on recon… as if I’d buy that. Damn bastards. Semchenko, if you’re reading this, head straight to the colonel. And just in case, the code is 19. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_29_NotesGlobalStash_P0_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You were right, you know. Fuck the Zone. I was the </NoteDefault><NoteBold>first</NoteBold><NoteDefault> here, and now I’m the only </NoteDefault><NoteBold>one</NoteBold><NoteDefault> left standing. I drank to your memory. Here comes the Emission, damn it all. My loot, my PDA, everything. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_30_NotesGlobalStash_P1_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Already into day </NoteDefault><NoteBold>two</NoteBold><NoteDefault>, and it’s still radio silence. Who’s gonna read this, anyway? Unless someone finds me here somehow. I had </NoteDefault><NoteBold>three</NoteBold><NoteDefault> buddies, but when push came to shove, they were gone. Friendship ain’t got no place here. Nor do decent folks. Just assholes. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_31_NotesGlobalStash_P2_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Ha! You hear me, you swampy piece of shit? I said my </NoteDefault><NoteBold>third</NoteBold><NoteDefault> run would be a hit! And you were like, “What the hell are you thinking?” Yeah, I’ve only got grub for </NoteDefault><NoteBold>two</NoteBold><NoteDefault> days, and some asshole cleaned out my stash, but I’ve scored enough loot to stock three stashes this size.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_31_NotesGlobalStash_P2_nam: Stalker’s Note about a Successful Run
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_32_NotesGlobalStash_P3_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Four</NoteBold><NoteDefault> freaking days I’ve been stuck here, and those bloodsuckers won’t piss off. And you still won’t show up, will you, you piece of shit? Think you can take my loot, Mole? Screw you! I’ve got </NoteDefault><NoteBold>six</NoteBold><NoteDefault> spare mags – enough to deal with all of you! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_33_NotesGlobalStash_P4_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Okay, Needle. You called it. It’s been </NoteDefault><NoteBold>five</NoteBold><NoteDefault> days now, and those damn dogs are still on my tail. I look around and nobody’s there, but I swear, out the corner of my eye, I see </NoteDefault><NoteBold>three</NoteBold><NoteDefault> dogs every damn time. Guess it’s time to lay off the vodka. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_34_NotesGlobalStash_P5_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Damn it, Rotgut, I’m stranded up on the tower. Boars got me cornered, ammo’s gone, and the signal’s crap. Get over here and lend a hand. Maybe they’ll clear out by morning – I’m stuck here for the night either way. </NoteDefault><NoteBold>One</NoteBold><NoteDefault> sheep, </NoteDefault><NoteBold>two</NoteBold><NoteDefault> sheep… </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_35_NotesGlobalStash_P6_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Harry, you’ve got </NoteDefault><NoteBold>seven</NoteBold><NoteDefault> fucking days to settle your debt. Think fast, or prepare for what’s coming. We’re not known for giving </NoteDefault><NoteBold>second</NoteBold><NoteDefault> chances. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_36_NotesGlobalStash_P7_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’ve had enough of your life lessons. I didn’t leave the Mainland for this. I brought back </NoteDefault><NoteBold>eight</NoteBold><NoteDefault> artifacts from my last run, just ask the guys! The Zone’s taught me one thing: even when you’re knee-deep in shit, there are always </NoteDefault><NoteBold>two</NoteBold><NoteDefault> ways out. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_37_NotesBadIdea_body:
$J0L0[18:32]: Why is there a damn tornado here? What’s next, a tsunami?! At least it’s not raining fire, thank goodness!
[18:34]: Quit whining. Wherever you got anomalies, you also got artifacts, right?
[18:35]: Yeah, I get it. I should check it out, but it’s giving me the creeps.
[18:40]: I’ll try sneaking into the center. It looks calmer there. I’ll message you when I’m done.
[19:30]: How’s it going?
[22:00]: Hey, you holding up okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_39_NotesForSkat_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> No dice, Stingray. I’m not buying that those soldiers aren’t snagging valuable stuff under the table. I saw a lieutenant sneaking across the training grounds with a hefty backpack last night. That loot’s better off with me anyway! Just gotta wait for the right moment to slip in unnoticed. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_40_NotesForGars_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Enough’s enough, Hars. I’m beat. It’s off to the swamps for me. The guy at the bar spilled the beans on how to dodge the checkpoint search: just shut your Geiger counter off and slip through the gap after dark. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_41_NotesMilitaryLife_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Wolf to Tiger. Eagle out, repeat, Eagle out. Taking position. Over. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Wolf, this is Tiger. Roger that. Finishing my patrol and heading back with the snacks. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_42_NotesObservation_body: $J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Observation log #56:</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>These aren’t your ordinary wild dogs. They exhibit a clear hierarchy and mark the northern territory deliberately. They should’ve thought twice before kicking me out of college!</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_43_NotesBanditsAccounting_:
$J0L0 Riffraff, putz: sawed-off shotgun.
Grizzle, putz: two mags.
Uncle: solid guy, I let him in for free.
Fatso, putz: didn’t pay, got the boot.
Emissions are our gravy train. They’re the best time to fleece suckers for coupons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_46_NotesGiftOnCrane_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[16:34]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Fuck, I can’t take this anymore! Vitalyk’s at it again. He knows damn well I’m scared shitless of heights, but he still stashes our loot way up on that damn hill. “It’s nothing,” he says, “just walk over the crane. I left a little surprise for you there.” Nah… once this gig is over, I’m telling him to shove it. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_46_NotesGiftOnCrane_name: Notes from a Stalker with a Fear of Heights
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_47_NotesPasswordPuzzle_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[11:28] </NoteBold><NoteDefault>The password is 03079_. I’ve got the cash, and now I’m off to explore the </NoteDefault><NoteBold>four</NoteBold><NoteDefault> corners of the earth. You’re not stupid, so you can figure out the final digit. And if you can’t, that’s on you. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_50_NotesStalkerDelirium_bo:
$J0L0[15:37]: Imagine if moles mutated, eh? We’d put ’em to work digging for us. With a whole pack of ’em, we’d find every underground stash!
[15:39]: Yeah, right. You can’t even get yourself to do any digging, let alone a mole. The only thing you can find is the bar. Now stop hogging the line.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_50_NotesStalkerDelirium_na: Musings of a Stalker with Delirium Tremens
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_54_NotesAboutArmor_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[07:16]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> They’ll stash the gear south, by the edge of the forest. Just gotta scrounge up an artifact to cover the cost. Can’t wait to slip into those duds and finally feel like a proper stalker! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_54_NotesAboutArmor_name: Notes about a Deal with Smugglers
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_55_NotesAboutStimulants_bo:
$J0L0[11:47]: Too bad Yurchik got himself killed in an anomaly. Still, his loot shouldn’t go to waste.
[11:54]: Yeah, he was into herbs and stuff, so a greenhouse is a good place to look for his stash. There’s one marked on this map, but how do we get past the patrol?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_56_NotesParanoiaAboutBees_:
$J0L0 Note 443, from 01/09/21$J0L0 It’s hard to believe, but the darn bees stole my candy again. Do the bloody bugs even realize how hard those things are to come by?
Never mind. They won’t get to my stash this time. I’ll hide it under something heavy. Something their tiny little legs can’t lift.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_57_NotesArtifactTheory_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I told the kids about my hypothesis, and they laughed in my face. They don’t know a damn thing. They just poke anomalies blindly with their gadgets, and that’s pretty much all they can do. Let’s see who’s laughing when I come back with artifacts after the next Emission. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_57_NotesArtifactTheory_nam: Note on an Innovative Approach to Artifact Acquisition
