ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_58_NotesThoughtsOnRiver_bo: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[11:40] </NoteBold><NoteDefault>The sarge is eager to go back to the Mainland and keeps bitching about them not letting him. He says it stinks here. But look at the river, the beauty of it all… It’s got some rads in it, sure, but you can get used to it. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_58_NotesThoughtsOnRiver_na: Soldier’s Thoughts on the Uzh River
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_60_NotesNewShelter_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[02:57]</NoteBold><NoteDefault>: I found us a new shelter, a good one. And you doubted me! It’s all empty, and the place looks solid. We’ll drag a couple of barrels inside, make ourselves a little fire, and get all nice and cozy! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_60_NotesNewShelter_name: Happy Note about a New Shelter
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_63_NotesRendezvous_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[15:30]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Oh, come on! Don’t be such a buzzkill! The boys will be so happy to see you. It’s not that far, and it’s a real sweet spot. Come on, bring some snacks and booze – a bottle or two will do it. Or maybe three. Three is always better. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_64_NotesArtifactInAir_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[07:14] </NoteBold><NoteDefault> I mean it’s like floating in midair, can you believe it? Gives off rads like a bitch, though. Too scary to go for it, drunk or not. You said you had some anti-rad, right? Get it ready. I’m coming soon. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_67_NotesWhereIsMyStash_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[04:37] </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Hey, Vitya! Come in! Where’s the damn bird with my loot? I’m in Wild Territory, right? I’m sure I am! I couldn’t have gotten THAT drunk! Right? </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_70_NotesAboutLimanskRoad_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[19:58]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Come on, it’s gonna be okay! By the look of it, it’s not that hard to get there. A couple of jumps, pull yourself up the edge, and that’s it. Just gotta avoid falling in the water, that’s all. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_70_NotesAboutLimanskRoad_n: Stalker’s Thoughts about the Road to Limansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_73_NotesSecretStash_body:
$J0L0[04:24]: So where the hell’s that secret stash of yours? I looked everywhere and couldn’t find it!
[04:44]: Search the quarry. I’m giving you the exact same info I got. And mind you, I’m giving it to you for free.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_75_NotesAboutMine_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[14:11]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> There’s nothing good left here. Heading for the mine tomorrow. That place has gotta be warmer and easier to defend. There might be even some bandit loot left. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_75_NotesAboutMine_name: Stalker’s Thoughts Before Heading for the Mine
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_77_StashInCamp_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> If you find this stash, be a good Stalker and don’t touch it. It’s for emergencies. You never know what could be lurking in these woods... so if you take something, be sure to leave a replacement later. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_78_NotesAboutGraveFinding_:
$J0L0[09:45]: There was no point coming here. That wooden cross must have rotted away or something. I can’t find the grave.
[09:47]: Or maybe it was the dogs.
[09:50]: Screw you!
Stalker’s Notes about Searching for a Grave
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_80_NotesAboutTruck_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[04:37]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> That’s it, okay? I’m so fucking done! There’s no way in hell I can get this fucking truck to start! Three years of my life I wasted on this damn wreck! Brought parts for it from all over the Zone! And they’re all either faulty, or radioactive, or both!  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_80_NotesAboutTruck_name: Bandit’s Note about Repairing a Truck
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_81_NotesAboutBloodsucker_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[04:37]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> So that’s the way it goes, brother. I’m royally fucked. They used to lock up bandits here to keep civilians safe… and now it’s my place to hide, hoping against hope that this bloodthirsty beast won’t get to me. If I escape in one piece, I’ll start a new life. I swear on my dear Mom’s memory!  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_82_NotesAboutTheft_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[14:17]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Some bastard went through my stash. Can you believe it? Nothing’s missing, though – they just screwed off some random bit of my car. Lunatics. Who would even want that trash?  </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_83_NotesNewHut_body: $J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>Hey, Vovan! You won’t believe the setup the boys have here! Yeah, we lost Gray in the process of, uh… evicting the previous tenants, but he was a drag anyway. So swing by for the send-off.</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_87_NotesStupidDeath_body:
$J0L0[02:10]: Where the hell are you, Coarse?
[02:10]: Trying to mark your territory across the whole damn campsite?
[02:11]: Shit, I told you it was a lousy spot, but no, you had to bed down right by the anomalies…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_87_NotesStupidDeath_name: Bandit’s Chat with a Missing Buddy
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_88_NotesBanditGambling_bod: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[11:22]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> It’s done. We carved that cheat up, just like we said we would. “I’m just lucky” this and “the Zone’s on my side,” that. Yeah, right! We’ve seen his kind before. Now the problem is I’ve got no clue where that punk stashed his winnings. No worries. I’ll have the boys turn the place upside down. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_88_NotesBanditGambling_nam: Bandit’s Notes about Games of Chance
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_89_NotesAngryRookie_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[03:19]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I saw your face, fucker. Don’t even think I won’t recognize you! And I’ll get out of this cave, mark my words. Come morning, I’ll crawl out, find you, and gut you. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_89_NotesAngryRookie_name: Note from a Stalker Abandoned in a Cave
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_90_NotesWoundedRookie_body:
$J0L0[01:12]: We drove the dogs out. We’re close to Zalissya, but the rookie got bitten. He can hardly walk. We have to make a decision.
[01:17]: Bring him here. Mykolayich will see what he can do.
[01:17]: Tell me you saw it.
[01:29]: I did. I saw a bloodsucker.
[01:30]: Damn. Are you two out of there?
[01:40]: I am, yeah.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_93_NotesCowboy_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’m setting off with some kid from Freedom to find boars. He says his folks were cowboys, so he’s betting he can ride the beast. If I don’t make it back, here’s some slugs to cool the kid off. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_93_NotesCowboy_name: Note about a Bet between Stalkers
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_95_NotesAnomalyChange_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[23:41]</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Bummer. I just mapped this place out, thinking to sell it at the bar for some cash, and poof! I leave for a moment, and the anomalies decide to play musical chairs. Just my luck… Anyway, I gotta get my bag one way or another. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_96_NotesAboutFleshWalking_:
$J0L0 So here’s the deal, rookie: Fleshes are easy to herd – no need for a leash or loud noises, just keep whistling softly, and they’ll find their way. They’re smart.
If you’re tired, bring them inside. I left their favorite food there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_GDN_99_NotesOnMeadow_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> You’re as good as your word. I appreciate that. Got a table waiting for you, just like back on the Mainland – the fanciest spot in the Zone. If you need more gigs, you know where to find me. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_1_body:
$J0L0Report on sanitary casualties in the Ward.
Following the full implementation of the Guardian training program, there has been a significant decrease in casualties among personnel, dropping from sixteen last month to just nine this month.
Natural factors within the Zone still account for the majority of injuries and fatalities. Anomalous activity ranks highest in the overall statistics.
I believe it’s imperative to continue with the program.
However, Colonel, I strongly advise we consider enlisting a stalker instructor. It’s evident our soldiers lack practical survival skills in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_1_hint: A classified medical report for Korshunov
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_2_body:
$J0L0 I’ve got a few Sevas in stock. We can use them until we sort out our supply chain issues.
Naturally, I’ve reinforced their armor. These suits were salvaged from the stalkers who occupied the Chemical Plant before us. They had quite the stockpile of research equipment.
They even had spare parts for the suits. I took any extras from the gear they had on, too, as I thought it might come in handy. Fortunately, those stalkers were taken out cleanly, so there weren’t many holes.
So, what do you think?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_2_hint: A proposal addressing the body armor shortage
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_2_name: Note from a Chemical Plant Tech to Maj. Dvoryankov
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_AgathaToKors: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Don't be surprised by the changes in the decor, Colonel. It is a gift. Remember how we talked about how important decisions need a fitting backdrop?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_LevaFan_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Lyova Fan:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Got anything good for me, pal?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Danya Squirrel</NoteBold><NoteDefault>: I changed my mind. I'm out.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Lyova Fan</NoteBold><NoteDefault>: Sure about that?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Danya Squirrel</NoteBold><NoteDefault>: Coupons ain't worth it. I don't wanna be a snitch.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Lyova Fan</NoteBold><NoteDefault>: You got it wrong. You have no choice. Get the list to me tonight, or wait for a slug to catch.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Himzavod_Hub_Note_ScientistsWh: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Professor Strumylo:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I would like to express the outrage shared by the research personnel, signed below, caused by the conditions of our tenure at the "Chemical Plant". We were promised that it was a temporary measure, however, we have been here for several days already, and you have not reacted to a single concern we have expressed.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Professor Strumylo:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> But most importantly, you have personally guaranteed us full safety from the Zone at the Institute premises! Take action immediately, or we will make sure the global scientific community will know how you treat people.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Professor Strumylo: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Make no mistake, no respectable scientist will ever want to work with you.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Doctor Dalin:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> No respectable scientist will ever put his own comfort above science itself. Quit complaining and do your job.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
Professor Strumylo's chat with Doctor Dalin
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_IKAR_Hub_Note_BigLandChat_body:
$J0L0[September]
This message may be delivered a long time from now. It will probably be useless to answer, the tech says it's a separate network here. But I don't want to leave having said nothing.$J0L0I'm in the Zone.$J0L0You will have to trust me when I say I'm ready for this. Wait for me, I'll be back in a year, with trophies.$J0L0
$J0L0[December]
I know it's been a while since you heard from me, but I'm alive. Exhausted, though. It is impossible to sleep through the night here. I'm starting to understand what they meant, when those who came back said this place is eating you from the inside. People start acting... different.$J0L0Looks like we got new pills. Maybe, these will help. I can feel something growing inside of me.$J0L0I hope I'll come home soon.

$J0L0[March]
I won't be back. I'm sorry, I can't bring this back with me. I can feel it in my bones, and no matter how hard I try to wash it off, the smell is still on me. I have to stay here.$J0L0Tell Mom I love her. You were right, all of you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Ikar_Note_Batalov_Desperate_bo: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Please excuse my breaking the chain of command and going over Senkevych's head, but I see no other option. I would like to report that our patient headcount is catastrophic. The infirmary is packed. So is the main building. I am forced to pretend these kinds of mental disorders are common in this place, but not even Kryvenko knows what is going on here, despite his efforts to persuade me otherwise.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>I am not even certain Icarus has any soldiers fit to fight.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>SIRCAA does nothing. I am doing whatever I can, but it's not enough. My only hope is you, Colonel. I am asking you to take immediate action.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Ikar_Note_Krivenko_ToLeskiv_bo: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>… and, despite your skepsis, Mrs. Leshkiv, psi-immunity turned out to be no less complicated than the regular human immune system. Just as complex. I was able to confirm my theory, stating that practically every component may be weakened or enhanced, similarly to a regular immune mechanism. Right now, I am finding proof that even short-term influence...</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_LeshiyNote_body:
$J0L0Varan: I’ve got a job only a pro like you can handle, Leshy.
Varan: You’re taking out Elbow.
Leshy: You want me to off a big shot? And paint a bullseye on my back?
Varan: Smart men always open the door when opportunity knocks.
Varan: Check the pay. And consider the prospects.
Leshy: I see the pay. But the prospects aren’t anything special.
Varan: I’ve always admired people who know how to haggle.
Leshy: All right. That sounds more like it. Give me a week.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_LeshiyNote_hint: Taken from a mercenary killed at the Supply Depot
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_MaksSubbotaPDANote_body:
$J0L0Max Saturday: I need help.
Max Saturday: We ran into a Monolithian. Everybody’s dead.
Dew: What the fuck? What happened?
Max Saturday: The bastard grabbed Mastiff… to make a zombie out of him. I need backup. Please! I’ll owe you big time.
Max Saturday: Why aren’t you saying anything?
Max Saturday: This is urgent! Remember the place the Gaffer mentioned? I think that’s where he went.
Dew: Hold tight. I’m on my way. The fucker’s gonna pay for everything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_MaksSubbotaPDANote_hint: Chat on Max Saturday’s (Mastiff’s squad) PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Malahit_Hub_Note_1_body:
$J0L0 Your job is to manage inventory, not determine which experiments are appropriate.
My requests are to be fulfilled promptly and with no questions asked. $J0L0 Let’s make sure this doesn’t happen again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Malahit_Hub_Note_1_hint: A message from Professor Ozersky to Viktoria Dorozhnyuk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Malahit_Hub_Note_2_body:
$J0L0 After carefully assessing your CV, I must inform you that we are unable to offer you a position.
Here at SIRCAA, we seek out only the most promising scientists, and, unfortunately, your previous work has not met the criteria set by myself, my colleagues, and the project manager.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Malahit_Hub_Note_2_hint: A document found at the Malachite facility
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Malahit_Hub_Note_2_name: Reply to a Request for Cooperation
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Malahit_PDA_body:
$J0L0 Dear Dr. Dorozhnyuk, your responsibility is to manage inventory, not determine which experiments are appropriate.
My requests are to be fulfilled promptly and with no questions asked.
Let’s make sure this doesn’t happen again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Malahit_PDA_hint: Viktoria Dorozhnyuk’s PDA found at the Malachite facility
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_PDA_Skif_Background_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Out of the frying pan and into the fire! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I returned after three years of service in real hell to cool off, quietly trading ‘dummies’ – the cheapest artifacts, burnt out after being taken out of the Zone by some lucky stalkers, drinking in my smoke-filled apartment, and staring at the TV as if it were a window. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> And everything seemed to be going according to plan until my flat got blown to smithereens one night. An anomaly. Right in my kitchen. It wrecked the little I had and left behind another ‘dummy.’ Only this time, it was different. A special anomaly, a special dummy, and, if a certain Hermann is to be believed, special money if I manage to recharge it with his scientific gadget. The catch is, I’ll have to venture into the Zone to do it. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’ve heard enough stories to avoid the Zone at all costs, but it decided to reach out to me. Well, it’s time to pay a visit. Could it get any worse? As my demoted commander said: “If you’re born to hang, you’ll never drown.” </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Prypat_NoteFromUnknown2_body:
$J0L0 The Monolithians couldn’t care less about Emissions, and the Emissions couldn’t care less about your so-called protection. The major was a good man, but I’m at a loss as to where he scavenged that spacesuit from or what he was thinking when he put it on and walked into that Emission for “recon.”
Don’t waste your time looking for him. As the saying goes, ashes to ashes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Prypat_NoteFromUnknown2_hint: Message to the Palace of Culture
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Prypat_NoteFromUnknown_body:
$J0L0 You saw the writing on the wall, and so did I. The Monolith ain’t going nowhere, and we’re not getting any younger. In a way, it’s ironic – we basically ended up replacing them. But now our watch is over, Colonel.
Let your men go while there’s still someone left to walk away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_QTC_HK01_DudesNotes01_body: $J0L0Nodes used:$J0L1list of nodes 1list of nodes 2list of nodes 3$J0L2Numeral list 1Numeral list 2Numeral list 3$J0L0Italic Strikethrough Underline Mixed1 $J0L0 asdasdasdasddasdasdasd
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes2_body:
$J0L0 Don’t worry about me, okay? It’s not as scary as you think. They even helped me out with some gear in Zalissya – for a small cut, but still. And I’ve already found my first artifact! It’s called a Meat Chunk. Tell Dad I’ll get the money soon. There’ll be enough for his treatment, and for the roof repairs, and for golden earrings. The ones you liked at that store, remember?
I love you so much! I’ll be home soon!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes2_name: Message to a Missing Stalker’s Mom
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes3_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[01.45]:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Where are you? </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[01.50]:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Come on, man, don’t be an idiot! Come back – it’s getting dark! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[02.24]:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I was just kidding! It was a joke, okay? Didn’t you get it?! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[04.15]:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Hey! Look at your PDA, you goddamn moron! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>[12.35]:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> You’re not coming back, are you? </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes3_hint: Chat on a missing stalker’s PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes3_name: Incoming Messages from a Former Friend
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes4_body:
$J0L0 You scumbag. I’ll find you. I’ll get out of this lousy hole, and then I’ll come after you. Whether it’s in the Zone or on the Mainland, I’m coming for you!
Don’t expect me to forget how you left Serhiy to die. I’ll tear anyone limb from limb when it comes to my friends, so you better watch your back as long as I’m alive, you son of a bitch!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes4_hint: Threat from a dead stalker’s PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ01_NewbieNotes_body:
$J0L0 I know I’m not coming back.
Will you forgive me? I shouldn’t have left you. I should’ve lived my life like everyone else. But… I just couldn’t. Work, sleep, repeat…
No. The Zone – this is the life for me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ04_C10_GlavarNotes_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> IF YOU EVEN THINK OF TOUCHING THIS STASH, I’LL SHOOT YOUR BALLS OFF.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes1_body:
$J0L0Unknown: Found him.
Owl: You’re sure?
Unknown: Ihor Ihnatyev, aka Attila. Changed his nickname after becoming a merc. Was presumed dead. Often seen near Rostok.
Owl: You know what to do.
Unknown: What, by myself?! Did you hear what he’s done to the Sultan’s men?
Owl: The Sultan’s men don’t get paid as much as you do.
Unknown: Fuck.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes1_hint: From the PDA of Owl’s informer
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes2_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I know what’s coming next. You know what’s coming next. Even the blind dogs at the Cordon know what’s coming next. If you don’t want Owl to find out about what happened, transfer the coupons. You know how much and where to. Or you can come find me. I don’t mind either way… pal.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes2_hint: From the secret PDA of Owl’s informer
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes2_name: Message to Owl’s Agent from Unknown
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes3_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>You shouldn’t have taken this job, Owl. I’ll see you soon.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes3_hint: From the dead body of Owl’s informer
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes4_body: $J0L0<NoteBody> <NoteDefault>…so we can say that the Reflection Program … significant changes … I strongly recommend not to make any rushed … to ensure that the experiment is successful. or at least without catastrophic…</NoteDefault> </NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RSQ05_C10_Notes4_hint: Taken from a fragment of an important document
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RookieVillage_Hub_Note_Agent_b: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Dragonfly:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> What if I double that?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Whale:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> You don't have that kind of money, do you?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Dragonfly:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I'll triple it.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Dragonfly:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> How does Sidorovich contact Strelok?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Whale:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> It's the fifth time you're asking me. The answer is the same: no one's seen Strelok. I heard he left the Zone for good.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Whale:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Let's make it the last time you're bothering me, okay?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Dragonfly:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> You're a tough one to crack.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Dragonfly:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I know where I can make some more money. I'll be back in a month.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Whale:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> Did I stutter?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RookieVillage_Hub_Note_Agent_h: Found at an abandoned house at Rookie Village
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_RookieVillage_Hub_Note_Oasis_b:
$J0L0Sanya Goose: Take this, all of you who didn't believe me - I found it!$J0L0Dimka Spook: Oasis, or what? Come on, give me a break.$J0L0Dimka Spook: Where?$J0L0Sanya Goose: Just like they said, at the Cordon. Won't tell you no more, I'm not stupid. $J0L0Dimka Spook: You going in alone?$J0L0Sanya Goose: I did all the legwork looking for it, so all the loot is mine. I'm not cutting you in.$J0L0
Dimka Spook: Long time, no text. How's Oasis?$J0L0
Dimka Spook: Sanya, you there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Hub_MessageNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>So.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Myklukha didn't approve. Fuck him. I didn't join Freedom to sit on my ass and sell boots. If you don't like it, just say it already, I'll find another partner.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>We'll split it like always - I get the docs, you get whatever else we find.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Don't go around blabbing about it. Better shut it.</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Same meet spot. I bring the keycard, you bring the gear. If the gear's shit, you're going in first.</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Hub_MessageNote_hint: Found on a PDA forgotten at Rostok
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Hub_MessageNote_name: A note to a Freedom member
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Note_Agreement_body:
$J0L0 The following terms and conditions have been mutually accepted:
1. The mercenaries agree not to accept contracts from any third party without prior notification to the employer regarding any changes in their rate
2. Bogey, in his capacity as coordinator, shall maintain a consistent presence in Rostok and guarantee that the mercenaries will not interfere in the employer’s affairs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Note_SalesToShevchenko_:
$J0L0 Shipment for Beard:
1. AR416 x4
2. Mark I EMR x1
3. Sawed-off shotgun x5
A list found among Myklukha’s personal belongings
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Note_SalesToSultansk_bo:
$J0L0 Shipment for Kalyna:
1. Sawed-off shotgun x14
2. AKM-74S x20
3. Sunrise Suit x1
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Note_SalesToSultansk_fo: $J2L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Offer at a grossly inflated price, then let her negotiate it down to half </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_Note_SalesToSultansk_hi: A list found among Myklukha’s personal belongings
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_PDA_Bet_body:
$J0L0Leva Starter: Pay up. Frog sat down.
Yaryk Chill: He was just picking up a smoke. You bet he’d sit there and have a heart-to-heart chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_PDA_Bet_hint: A PDA left unattended in Rostok
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_PDA_Polovin_body:
$J0L0Molotov: Enjoying yourself in Rostok, huh? The Freedom scumbags just hit one of our patrols!
Polovyn: Where’d you hear that?
Molotov: From the higher-ups. They’re itching to know who leaked the patrol schedules. We all are.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Rostok_PDA_Polovin_hint: PDA from a Duty member’s body in Rostok
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ01_Note_body:
$J0L0 So you weren’t shitting me, Varan. This thing is real. No more shaking down chumps – this gizmo’s gonna do all the work for us! Ain’t that sweet?
I’m gonna try and get it working now. One of those eggheads told me everything about it. Didn’t even need much persuasion, heh heh. Man, life is gonna be sweet!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ02_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I used this fucking thing five times already and got shit! I’m just hauling it around the Zone like an idiot, catching more and more psi along the way! You promised the coordinates were accurate! I’m trying one more time, and if it doesn’t work, I’m heading right back to you and stuffing this damn thing up your ass! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ02_Note_hint: From the body of a zombified stalker
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ04_Note_body:
$J0L0 I guess the mercenaries are starting to realize that all the money got spent on this “scanner.” That was a bit reckless of me, but if the experiment is successful, I’ll be able to afford a proper expedition, instead of this farce… Then I’ll finally be able to pay all my debts!
I hope it works…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ04_Note_hint: From the body of a dead scientist
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ05_Note_body:
$J0L0 It’s gonna be all right, I promise.
I know it wasn’t the right thing to do, but we had no choice! We needed the money, and it was their idea from the start… I bought this scanner, and it’s gonna work. It has to work!
It’s gonna be all right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ06_Note_body:
$J0L0[16.46]: Are you sure these coordinates are accurate? There’s nothing here! Where am I supposed to put this shit?
[16.57]: Hey! Are you ignoring me?
[17.03]: If you fucked me over, I’ll turn the whole Sphere upside down, you hear me? $J0L0[22.01]: :)
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ06_Note_hint: From the body of a dead stalker
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ08_Note_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> How could you sign me up for this? You know I’m afraid of heights. No way he could give us some other coordinates? If I was into crawling up construction cranes, I’d become a climber, not a stalker! Good thing there aren’t any mutants here. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ08_Note_hint: From a dead stalker’s body near a construction crane
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ08_Note_name: Message from a Stalker Who’s Afraid of Heights
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ09_Note_body:
$J0L0 Sorry, man. I admit, I screwed up. Those coordinates I sent you… well, they aren’t exactly right. I mean, they’re supposed to be right, but only under certain conditions. Maybe they’re right at a certain time, and for the rest of the day they’re wrong… I don’t know, man. It’s complicated!
Anyway, I’m sorry. I’ll give you a discount next time. My bad.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ09_Note_hint: From a PDA found in a backpack
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SEQ10_Note_body:
$J0L0[11.34]: Deggy’s gonna kill us for this.
[11.40]: Deggy’ll kill us anyway as soon as he finds out about our new pals, so it’s kinda too late to get cold feet now. You gotta do it quickly – get in, deploy it, and get out before the Monolithians spot you. Okay? Now go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ01_ValenokPDA_Note_body:
$J0L0Valik Lummox: Can you believe it? Those knuckleheads asked for a showdown by the water tower. Ha ha! They’re in for a surprise up there.
Hunchback: What’s gotten into you, Valya? Trying to dig yourself into an even deeper hole?
Valik Lummox: Take it easy. I’ve got a plan to sort this out!
Hunchback: You’re gonna end up dead, you idiot…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ01_ValenokPDA_Note_hint: The PDA taken from Valik Lummox’s body
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ02_PomorNote_body:
$J0L0Ragman: New order’s in. Same deal, but I need double the ammo. They’re selling like hotcakes. We’ve got rodents all over the place.
Pomor: I’ll have it sorted in a week.
Ragman: Don’t nod off over there! You’re my top supplier.
Pomor: Not gonna happen. I’ve got a map.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ02_PomorNote_hint: Found on Pomor’s PDA at the Poppy Field
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ04_SoloveiPDANote_body:
$J0L0Hamster: The professor sent the money for the collars.
Nightingale: Oh! Hey, Hamster. How come burers don’t have any ID?
Hamster: Spare me your jokes. You out hunting dogs again?
Nightingale: What else is there? The routes are sealed and there’s nothing else to do.
Hamster: You could school the newbies.
Nightingale: Nah. It’ll be slick as a pseudodog’s fur. I’ll return shortly with the haul. Have those coupons ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ04_SoloveiPDANote_hint: The last message before his death
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ06_TransitWaybill_Note_body:
$J0L0 To V. Konstantinov, Lab X11 Security Chief

Your request #117 dated 3/15 has been partially fulfilled.
We are currently experiencing a shortage of weapons. I am sending all available items, with the remainder to be included in the upcoming shipment once our supply issues are resolved. The equipment and necessary biological samples have been provided in full, as the research conducted in your laboratory is considered a priority.

Attaching the shipping list:
1. AKM-74S x7
2. AKM-74U x11
3. Portable Psi Installation (PPI) x1
4. Horizon-2 suppressor capsule x1
5. Biological samples.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ06_TransitWaybill_Note_hint: An old form found in the railroad tunnel at the Cordon
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_DeadDiggerNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Kostyk, found the code, thought I wrote it down – no dice. The place where I saw it is still there, but that's it. Maybe you can take a look? And pick me up on the way back. I'll wait here. I've got a Jello brain, and I'm walking in circles.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_DeaddropInstructions_Tex: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>There's a safe next to you. Enter the code, put the Emitter inside, and you'll get what's yours when the system recognizes the device. Next steps according to plan.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_MapNote_Text_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Memorize the safe code. Need the Emitter ASAP.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_MiheyevNestorNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>The Emitter from the last shipment works, but standard psi-blockers are no good against hallucinations. I'd like to ask to reduce my working hours to four, and to six hours for Assistant Kovalenko.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_MiheyevNestorNote_footer: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteItalic>Tough it out. Cut the union crap. Nestor.</NoteItalic></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_PersonalCorrespondance_T:
$J0L0[20:48] Mavka: Are you having a midlife crisis, or what? "There are things I need to do on my own" – and off he went. I had to put up with Myklukha's bullshit, and the Arena, you think I can't handle your secrets?!$J0L0Piece of shit. Mavka out.

[00:17] Lukash: I'll respond. I know you can handle it, but there are things I can't risk, and people I can't sacrifice. Don't go looking for me, I'll get in touch.$J0L0Lukash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_ZombieDocNote2_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>If you have the Emitter, go to the Plant, the old place. You'll get your instructions there.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>– Lukash.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_ZombieDocNote2_footer: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteItalic>(map has two places marked: one near the Plant, with a handwritten note saying "instructions here", the other near the Electric field and "bring Emitter here")</NoteItalic></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_ZombieDocNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Kovalenko, always double-check if the room with the electrical system emergency reboot control is closed! Nestor's courier saw a big red button and couldn't resist. The door unlocked, the equipment powered down, and the zombies all scattered – half my work day went out the window!</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ103_ZombieStalkerNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Checked my part of the lab, there's no damn code there. Check yours out. If there's nothing, let's get out of here.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteItalic>Below is a photograph of a basic sketch of the laboratory with some notes on it.</NoteItalic></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_DubnyjPDANote_body:
$J0L0Dubny: How are Bluish and Jumper holding up?
Quiet: What do you expect?
Quiet: They’re fine.
Quiet: This is the place for them. Seriously.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_DubnyjPDANote_hint: From Dubny’s PDA, found on Wild Island
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_HogDubniiTalk_body:
$J0L0Dubny: We’ve got a controller at the WPS. It’s urgent. Can you handle it?
Hog: Standard fee, 50% upfront.
Dubny: Payment’s on the way.
Hog: We’ll take care of it. Though it’s a solid half-day’s walk from Rostok to your neck of the woods.
Dubny: Hurry. Please.
Dubny: The order covers the controller, its zombies, and any potential witnesses.
Dubny: If any of our crew are unaffected, help them. Eliminate the others.
Hog: Understood. Your Noontide secrets are safe with us. We’re on our way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_JumperSinjaiTalk_body:
$J0L0Jumper: How about a smoke break?
Bluish: What about the safety rules?
Jumper: Screw ’em! North’s our boss. He’s got all the keys. And he still keeps running up to the roof to get some fresh air.
Bluish: But I don’t want to run. I’m fed up with this work, and you know it.
Jumper: Not this again! We’re not abandoning the guys. Not gonna happen. We’re better than that.
Jumper: All right. Enough griping. Meet you in five.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_MonolithStashNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’m taking my share and leaving. I know you won’t be happy about me dealing in relics of the past, Strider, but for me, this marks the beginning of a better future! I swear I’ll make it up to you big time once I strike it rich – ten times over, in coupons! Don’t hold it against me. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_MonolithStashNote_hint: A note found inside the Monolith stash at the WPS
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_SeverPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Rumor has it that Faust’s followers may have smuggled a Monolith object onto the station in violation of established protocols. No hard evidence of the object being installed or venerated on-site so far. Running discreet inquiries into the veracity of these claims to avoid alerting the perpetrators prematurely. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ10_SeverPDANote_hint: Report from the shift supervisor, found at the WPS
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ18_KamysDeadbodyPDANote_body:
$J0L0Sultan: It’s been a while, Ringmaster. Gotta sit down and talk shop.
Ringmaster: Word is, you’re dealing with some heat. I heard about Miss Kalyna.
Sultan: So what? My issues with Kalyna are my business, not yours. We got our own.
Sultan: I’ll send the coordinates. Don’t keep me waiting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ18_KamysDeadbodyPDANote_name: Invitation for a Meeting with the Sultan
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ18_KamysPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Hello, Ringmaster. I need a favor from you. Arrange a little show for someone special. Four stalkers will be passing through tomorrow, loaded with weapons and gear. The poor bastards are gonna be real tired. You take them in, prep them for the show, and send a ticket to Beard. And remember, keep this hush-hush, just between you and me. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ18_KamysPDANote_hint: Note from the Ringmaster’s bandit camp
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ18_KamysPDANote_name: Request to the Ringmaster from Unknown
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ20_Note_body:
$J0L02011 Oleh Fiend (KIA)
2012 Marked One (This one valued North more than Arena)
2013 Barin (Good fighter, Freedom got him.)
2014 –
2015 –
2016 Bes
2017 Bes (Lost)
2018 Sanya Kugelblitz
2019 Tyrant (He did the previous champ beautifully! Boom! Headshot.)
2020 Tyrant
2021 Tyrant?! (Honestly, get lost already!)
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ23_KyshonDeathNote_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> 돌진[18:40]: 돈을 이체했습니다. 꼽추 [19:03]: 이것은 내가 요청한 것보다 더 많은 것입니다. 돌진 [19:05]: 당신이 중요한 일을 합니다! 나는 첫 번째가되고 싶다! 꼽추[19:25]: 밀지 마세요. 준비되면 드리겠습니다. 돌진[19:25]: 좋습니다. 어서, 나는 산만하지 않습니다. Dashing [13:58]: 음, 어때요? Dashing [16:01]: 안녕하세요, 잘 지내세요? Dashing [17:16]: 이봐, 내가 실제로 돈을 냈어. 돌진 [17:58]:T 돌진 [17:58]:S 돌진 [17:58]:G 돌진 [17:58]:D 돌진 [17:59]:E 돌진 [17:59]: 개년아! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ47_Note_DavidAkopan_PDA_body:
$J0L0[12:30] Hertz: Same time at the stash tonight?
[12:33] David: Let’s do it tomorrow. There’s this gig at the Slag Heap from a guy named Zakhar Babay. I’ll take care of it and report back. $J0L0[17:15] Hertz: You still doing that Babay gig, David?
[17:17] Hertz: Folks say he’s up to some sketchy stuff. Watch out for an ambush. Check in when you can. $J0L0[19:01] Hertz: You didn’t walk into that shit-show, did you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ47_Note_DavidAkopan_PDA_hint: PDA found on a stalker’s body
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ47_Note_DavidAkopan_PDA_name: David Akopyan’s Chat with His Buddy
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ47_Note_LevaBorzoj_PDA_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I’m passing a dry law just for you, you prick. You blabbed about my stash at the bar again! I’m fed up with shifting it every damn month. You wag your tongue one more time, and I’ll cut it off! </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ47_Note_LevaBorzoj_PDA_hint: PDA found on the body of Zakhar Babay’s thug
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ87_AdikPedalPDANote_body:
$J0L0 Yo, listen the fuck up – keep tabs on them stalkers, and don’t hand them any grub. I stowed the key up on the roof, but it’s off-limits, capisce?
Now, about our gig: I had a chitchat with some folks, now we play the waiting game. While they’re dukin’ it out in Zaton, we’re gonna be runnin’ the whole damn show. Big things comin’, ya dig?
Oh, and stay the hell away from the pier at the Fish Farm. That nasty anomaly turned Hoary into mush. Ain’t fuckin pretty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ87_AdikPedalPDANote_hint: PDA from a bandit’s body at the Fish Farm
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ87_ZenaGlybaPDANote_Alternat:
$J0L0Zhenya Hulk: I need help, Illyukha.
Zhenya Hulk: Some thugs got us locked up. No food, no water. Can’t hold out much longer.
Zhenya Hulk: Sent you the coordinates.
Illyukha Redhead: I’ll be there in two days. Can you hang on for that long?
Zhenya Hulk: Not like I got a choice. Can’t reach anyone on the radio. Some loner iced the bandits, and then he just took off, the bastard. Now we’re stuck here, and there’s nobody to let us out.
Illyukha Redhead: Gotcha. On my way. $J0L0Zhenya Hulk: The guys are out cold. I’m alone. Where you at?
Illyukha Redhead: Fuck, I took a shortcut and bumped into some mutants. Gotta fix myself up and press on.
Zhenya Hulk: Hurry up. It’s pretty bad over here. $J0L0Zhenya Hulk: Illyukha?
PDA from a stalker’s body at the Fish Farm

$J0L0Zhenya Hulk: Got a problem. We’re running late.
Illyukha Redhead: What happened?
Zhenya Hulk: Some fly-by goons jumped us. Got us holed up, demanding cash.
Illyukha Redhead: Need backup?
Zhenya Hulk: Nah, we’re covered. Help’s on the way. They’ll show these punks who’s boss around here.
Illyukha Redhead: Covered? Ha! Those Zaton crooks played you. One thug ain’t gonna duke it out with another over some loner.
Zhenya Hulk: Guess we’ll find out.
PDA taken from a Stalker’s body at the Fish Farm
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ87_ZenaGlybaPDANote_body:
$J0L0Zhenya Hulk: We got jumped, Sultan. Make sure your boys know we’re under your protection.
Sultan: Shit happens. Fine, I’ll sort it out. Who did it?
Zhenya Hulk: Adik Pedal and his goons. They’re shaking us down for coupons.
Sultan: Doesn’t ring a bell. So… tourists, huh? That’s against the rules. Okay, I’ll send my guys. Give me your coordinates.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ87_ZenaGlybaPDANote_hint: PDA from a stalker’s body at the Fish Farm
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ88_GrebenNoteText_body:
$J0L0A couple more weeks to go. I treated Machek and Poluyanov to the good stuff today. They stared at my burned ugly face, unable to recognize the man they’d condemned to a radioactive tomb in Chornobyl for a measly couple thousand coupons. $J0L0 Those scumbags knew it all. They knew the place was empty – there was nothing there, only death. Yet they sold us the key, laughing at us. Today, I returned the favor, grinning right back. It was the last thing they ever saw. $J0L0Just a week left. I can’t sleep. Every time I close my eyes, I hear a gunshot echoing. Sledgehammer grabs the anti-rad and walks away. I can’t move, just like back then in Chornobyl. The same feeling, over and over again. $J0L0Only a couple of days left. I awoke to a violent cough, spitting blood all across the floor. All I want is to hold on until the soldiers put a bullet in Sledgehammer’s forehead. I’d love to watch him suffer from radiation sickness like I am, but time is running out. $J0L0Pvt. Machek
Pvt. Poluyanov
Pvt. Jason
Lt. Novak
Sledgehammer
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ88_GrebenNoteText_hint: PDA from a stalker’s body in Chornobyl-2
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ88_KuvaldaDiaryText_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>September 10. </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Jason and Novak – two artifacts (payment received). We’d agreed on a new shipment, but they’ve been reassigned from external patrol duty to guard the warehouse under the Duga. Machek and Poluyanov will fill in for them. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>October 3. </NoteBold><NoteDefault>The clients didn’t show up for the meeting. Novak says they never made it back to base either. On my way home, I heard someone strumming a guitar. I followed the sound, but there was no one there. Better check the tripwires. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ88_KuvaldaDiaryText_hint: Diary of a dead stalker in Chornobyl-2
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ88_MacekPDANote_body:
$J0L0Machek: I got a few days leave. We’re heading out. But let’s move our meeting place away from the kindergarten.
Guitarist: Any complications?
Machek: We’re supposed to meet Sledgehammer, too. If he spots us, we’ll have some explaining to do. Let’s keep it under wraps for now.
Guitarist: Fine by me. Novak’s still in the loop?
Machek: Yeah, no changes there. His patrol’s rolling through the kindergarten, so he’s gonna check in with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ88_MacekPDANote_hint: PDA from a soldier’s body in Chornobyl-2
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ88_NimbleToBeardNote_body:
$J0L0 Beard, I got my boys to spill the beans. Sledgehammer pissed off to Chornobyl-2 with that freaking buddy of his. Folks say he's done fetching you artifacts for next to nothing. So I reckon that's it, you lost your golden goose.
Eh, one more thing. That vodka you gave me to "break the ice" wasn't enough. Had to share my own. So you owe me two more of 'em bottles.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ89_ZhgutNote_body:
$J0L0Wisp: Listen, man… been thinkin’ about your offer. Count me in.
Swedish: Hell yeah, that’s what I’m talkin’ about! Together, we’ll show Sidor who’s boss!
Wisp: All right. Where’s your trading post? Where do I drop off the goods?
Swedish: Head over to the western railroad tunnel. You know the spot?
Wisp: Yeah, I think so. I’ll check my old stashes first and see if there’s anything else worth selling. How’s security? I hope you’re ready for anything?
Swedish: Yeah, we’ve got three volunteers already. Couple more on their way. Need any backup? We can send a guy.
Wisp: That’s not too much. You better have ’em on standby – the post has to be secure at all times. Need more manpower, too, that’s for sure. I’ll ask around the village.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ89_ZhgutNote_hint: Wisp and Swedish discuss shipments and security
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_PlanOfTheAttack_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Freedom member: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>We’re almost there. I’ve got the key. The door on the second floor opens up to the tunnels that’ll take us right to the bandits’ den. We’ll slip in quiet and take ’em out before they even know what hit ’em. Don’t worry. They’ll never see it coming. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_PlanOfTheAttack_hint: PDA from a Freedom member’s body at the Parking Lot
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_PlanOfTheAttack_name: Plan for a Freedom Assault on a Bandit Base
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_TalkAboutAnomalyUnderBase:
$J0L0 Wig: How come you keep pokin’ around that tunnel near the anomaly? I warned you to stay the hell away.
Bustler: There’s an artifact bouncin’ around in there, man. It’s practically callin’ my name. Shit, wish I could snag it somehow. A little insurance for the future, you get me?
Wig: Getting mixed up in this Zone crap ain’t a thief’s game. But I like where your head’s at. We gotta figure out how to work this.
Bustler: But how? I’m not setting foot in there. No way!
Wig: You won’t have to. We’ll grab some schmuck, apply a little pressure, and tell him to fetch us a couple artifacts if he wants to keep breathing. He’ll keep bringing ’em until he keels over. Then we’ll find another one. We’ll split the loot… and stash half for the Boss, of course.
Bustler: Damn, that’s slick, man. Now we just need the Boss to sign off on it.
Wig: Long as we butter him up nicely, he won’t have a problem with it.
PDA from a bandit’s body at the Containers
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_TalkAboutPseudogiant_body:
$J0L0Mushroom: We got a bit of a problem, Boss.
Boss: What’d ya do this time?
Mushroom: Last night, the guys at the gate got plastered and passed out. One of ’em must’ve left some munchies out, and now we’ve got a real huge critter rummaging around out there.
Boss: Then blow it the hell away.
Mushroom: We tried! The fucking freak’s built like a tank. Ran us ragged until we herded it into a container. That’s where we’ve got it trapped.
Boss: Fine, then leave it there to rot. What’s all this got to do with me?
Mushroom: It went after the new guy. Can’t remember his name. So, uh… the kid’s a goner.
Boss: Tough break. Let those idiots know that if they’re ever caught drunk on duty again, they’ll wake up in those containers themselves. And they won’t come out alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_TalkAboutPseudogiant_hint: PDA from a bandit’s body at the Containers
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_TalkAboutRewardForBanditH:
$J0L0Boss: Listen up. Got word that Myklukha’s gunning for us. The bounty’s pretty hefty, so expect some visitors. Double up the patrols, make sure everyone’s strapped, and stay on your toes.
Tyoma Wig: Guess we roughed his boys up real nice. Your “good friend” has been a real asset. Mind telling us who he is? Wouldn’t wanna off him along with those Freedom guys on a whoopsie.
Boss: Don’t sweat it. He’s from the Cement Factory, so he’s in the clear. Just keep your trap shut about it.
PDA from the body of a gang leader’s lieutenant
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_TalkWithSnitch_body:
$J0L0Hera: Got something for you. Myklukha sent a team after you. They’re planning to sneak into your base through the caves.
Boss: Gotcha. We’ll set up an ambush. How much do I owe you for this?
Hera: Nothing, like always. Just make sure you handle that Freedom scum.
Boss: Ah, come on. I’m not one for handouts. If you don’t want coupons, I can send a couple of my boys over to the Cement Factory posing as loners. They’ll get you a case of vodka or something.
Hera: If they set foot in here, I’ll put ’em down. That’s all I gotta say. I’ll give you a heads-up if I hear anything else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ90_TalkWithSnitch_hint: PDA from a gang leader’s body at the Containers
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ92_MangustPDAText_body:
$J0L0 Dr. Almatov: Hello, Mongoose. Let me remind you of your assignment. You are to set-up two anomalous activity sensors and start them simultaneously. It won’t be too tricky – just make sure you don’t place them anywhere near mutants, otherwise there might be unintended consequences.
Mongoose: The fuck you talkin’ ’bout?! What “unintended consequences?”
Dr. Almatov: There is a chance that activating the devices could attract mutants in the vicinity and make them more aggressive. Since the devices’ range is quite significant, well… there may be a lot of mutants. The person who activates the second device is taking most of the risk. But still, this is merely a possibility.
Mongoose: And where do you suggest I find a place in the Zone without any mutants? How about we activate the devices inside Malachite? Dr. Almatov: No, I need data obtained in the field. I don’t expect any problems. Just have your partner close by to cover you. That’s all you need.
Mongoose: Dimon’s dead. Killed by Wardens. Whatever. I’ll think of somethin’.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ92_MangustPDAText_hint: From a dead Sparker’s PDA found near the Chemical Plant
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ92_VolkovPDAText_body:
$J0L0Sgt. Volkov: Hey, Myron. Could you cover my next patrol shift? The one to the Elevator?
Sgt. Myronov: Why?
Sgt. Volkov: I don’t know, man, that place just gives me the creeps. We shot a stalker there the other day, but we didn’t get his partner. And I’ve got a weird feeling somebody’s been watching me there ever since.
Sgt. Myronov: Oh, come on. Who’d dare to attack you, with all your gear and combat experience? But whatever – I’ll cover for you for three grand if you want.
Sgt. Volkov: Seriously? I’m asking you as a friend!
Sgt. Myronov: That’s where you’re wrong. I’m not your friend, I’m just a fellow soldier. And money is exactly why I joined the Ward in the first place. So you can send me the coupons, or you can say hi to the Elevator for me. Your choice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ92_VolkovPDAText_hint: From a dead Warden’s PDA found near the Chemical Plant
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ94_DogmasterDairy_body:
$J0L0Day one. Had to climb up boxes, so the pack wouldn't get me. They can sniff canned grub if you open it. Pal was careful, but took a bite.
Day two. Apparently, I smell tastier than sausage. Barely made it out.
Day three. Took a whole ruck of canned meat, enough for a week – I'll try to lure Pal out. Got a couple of military-grade first aid kits, just in case.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ94_DogmasterPDA_body:
$J0L0Alabai: Honta, I can't do this job. I made a friend here.
Honta: Meaning? How does that make sense?
Alabai: Heard of Noah? I'm almost like him now – a dog saved me from a rodent. Can't bring myself to kill blind dogs any more. If I tame him, he'll make a good hunter!
Honta: You were lucky, stupid. There's a whole pack, and you won't tame them all. Don't be dumb. Come back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ94_GontaPDA_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Honta, this is no good. Time is of the essence. I'm counting on you.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Honta:</NoteBold><NoteDefault> I'll get it to you tomorrow morning, maybe even tonight. It won't be just me hunting from now on, so it'll be easier.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Viktoria Dorozhnyuk: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Are you sure? I don't have any field operatives I can send out to collect material without risk. If I don't have the organs tomorrow, I'll have to send whoever I can.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Honta: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Don't put your people at risk. I'll get it for you.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ94_ZuzaPDA_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Private Illienko: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>The package is in the usual spot, but I can't promise I'll be able to get your meds next time.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Yaryk Zhuzha: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Thank you. There won't be a next time.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Private Illienko: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>“Won't be”? Haven't you considered that maybe your doctors made a mistake? And this “you only got six months” is bullshit?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Yaryk Zhuzha: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>Sasha, don't bother. How much for the meds?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteBold>Private Illienko: </NoteBold><NoteDefault>You offer me money again and I'll punch you in the face. I'm deleting this chat.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_SQ94_ZuzaPDA_name: Yaryk Zhuzha's chat with an IPSF soldier
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Shevchenko_Hub_BeardSpartacus_:
$J0L0Spartak: Welcome home, I guess. I heard you made it all the way to Prypiat. No place like Zaton in the whole Zone, ha?
Beard: Zone gossip spreads like radiation. Gets everywhere.
Spartak: Ah, come on. How long has it been since Sultan stole Skadovsk? So, you here because of old memories or old grudges?
Beard: Home is supposed to be the place you come back to.
Spartak: Watch out, those bandits are still in charge. You cross them, you're good as dead.
Beard: Maybe, that's what I wanna be. Good.
Messages from an old PDA found at the Shevchenko
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Shevchenko_Hub_RepairNote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Bobber, stand down! Can you believe it, didn't need to ask nobody, folks scraped it up on their own.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Shaggy, thank the sweet fuck, managed to get rad-free APC plates. Logger, that sneaky little shit, nicked some IPSF sealant. And I am the proud bastard who put all that crap on. So, no more shipwrecks when it rains!</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Shevchenko_Hub_RepairNote_hint: A note to the bartender from Beard's ship
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Shevchenko_NoteBoroda_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>List of essentials:</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L2<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteStrike>PTM (29 out of 29).</NoteStrike></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Sawed-off shotgun (11 out of 15). </NoteDefault><NoteItalic>Hamster promised delivery by the end of the week.</NoteItalic></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>AKM-74U (8 out of 11).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>SVDM-2 (1 out of 4).</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>RGD-5 Grenades (33 out of 60). </NoteDefault><NoteItalic>Negotiate with Sidorovich.</NoteItalic></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Shevchenko_NoteBoroda_name: List of Equipment for the Shevchenko
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Shevchenko_NoteDiary_body:
$J0L0Day 47. Found a few promising trails today. Not many artifacts, but the paths seem clear of bandits for now.
Day 53. There was a major Emission a couple of days back. Checked an old route today, and the anomaly there seems to have vanished. Need to update my map. $J0L0Day 84. The Sultan asked me to guide his thugs. Well, more like demanded, given the debt I owe him. This is my chance to settle my tab. He said he’ll make it worth my while. Let’s hope for a smooth ride this time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Shevchenko_NoteDiary_hint: Notes on a sheet of paper found on the Shevchenko
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteAgreement_body:
$J0L0 1. Effective immediately, the Skadovsk will be rechristened the Sultansk. With the Sultan as the kingpin, the vessel will function as an assembly point and a place of recreation for his buddies.
2. Beard’s crew is permitted to visit the Sultansk and conduct business aboard her, albeit at a premium of 20% above bandit rates. Should any stalker fail to meet his obligations to the Sultan, Beard can assume his debts and pay the coupons he owes. Late payments accrue an additional 5% charge per day.
3. The Sultan commits to addressing unwarranted attacks by his buddies against loners. Any unauthorized showdowns will result in punishment for the participants.
4. The Sultan permits Beard to depart unharmed and establish a new base for his associates. Both parties commit to respecting each other’s turf and conducting business honestly. Should they team up against a common enemy, any resulting profits will be shared at a ratio of 70% for the Sultan and 30% for Beard.

Both parties pledge to comply with these rules and uphold the agreements outlined above.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteAgreement_header: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> Spheres of Influence in the Swamps </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteAgreement_hint: A paper from the Sultan’s personal belongings
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteAgreement_name: Contract between Beard and the Sultan
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteKalinaDebt_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> I, Oleksandr Budko, promise to settle my outstanding debt to Ms. Sofiya Avramenko within three months. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteKalinaDebt_footer: $J2L0<NoteBody><NoteItalic>He’s past due. Tell Chisel to have a word with him. And give him some ammo, just in case.</NoteItalic></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteKalinaList_body:
$J0L0 Monday:
1. Secure an alternate vodka supplier (three poisoning incidents, people refuse to drink it, down 13k coupons).
2. Talk prices with Quiet (he loves sardines – don’t forget to bring some).
3. Talk to the Ringmaster (it’s about time).
4. Send a present to Sidor.
5. Wash the handkerchiefs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteKalinaList_hint: Papers found at the bar on the Sultansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteKalinaSituation_b:
$J0L0 Food for thought:
1. Situation on Icarus – find out what’s going on, dispatch stalkers for reconnaissance.
2. New bilateral treaty with Myklukha – draft a plan.
3. Cold Island – ?
4. Add one more group of troublemakers to the Slag Heap – last push.
5. Loyalty checks – identify troublemakers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteKalinaSituation_h: A sheet of paper found on the Sultansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteKalinaSituation_n: Sonya Kalyna’s Plans for the Future
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteParty_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> For the celebration: </NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L1<NoteBody><ListItem><NoteDefault>Vodka: </NoteDefault><NoteStrike>1</NoteStrike><NoteDefault> 2 bottles per person</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Beer: 3 bottles per person</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Sausage: 1 per person</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Canned food: 2 cans per person</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Bread: 2 loaves per person</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Condensed milk: 1 can per person</NoteDefault></ListItem><ListItem><NoteDefault>Shared food stash: canned food and vegetables</NoteDefault></ListItem></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteParty_hint: A list found at the bar on the Sultansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteZlotar_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> So I figured… sticking around here is a waste of time. The Sultan’s out of the picture, and for real, he never did much for us anyway. I say we hit the road for Rostok tomorrow and take it from there. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_NoteZlotar_hint: A note found on the Sultansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDABanditStalker_body:
$J0L0Vitya Chilik: Guess what? I’ve teamed up with a loner.
Vitya Chilik: Mutants give me the heebie-jeebies, and he’s got zero nose for loot. He could stroll past a stash a hundred times and still not catch a whiff of it.
Vitya Chilik: So we cooked up a plan: I find the goodies, and he takes care of the mutants lurking around. Then we divvy up the loot fifty-fifty.
Vitya Chilik: Who knew these loners would ever come in handy!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDABanditStalker_hint: A bandit’s PDA found at the bar on the Sultansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDABandit_body:
$J0L0Valik Lax: Are you heading to the bar soon?
Ashot Fugitive: Why? You gonna pour me a cold one?
Valik Lax: I’m about to turn cold myself. The stalkers I mugged yesterday are here. The fuckers know it was me.
Valik Lax: Get the hell over here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDABandit_hint: From a dead bandit’s PDA near the Sultansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDABandit_name: Chat between Two Bandits from Zaton
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDAKalina_body:
$J0L0Rubenchik: Myklukha’s asking about the shipment. When’s the next one due?
Sonya Kalyna: I’ve already told him — by the end of the week.
Sonya Kalyna: Seems like he’s losing it. Or maybe he’s just antsy?
Rubenchik: The local fences keep bothering him. Like, we’re out to screw him over or something.
Sonya Kalyna: We haven’t double-crossed him in two years, and they think we’re going to now?
Sonya Kalyna: Fine. I need info on those fences. They need mending.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDAKalina_hint: From Sonya Kalyna’s PDA on the Sultansk
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDASultanBoroda_body:
$J0L0[17:45] Beard: We need to talk, Sultan.
[1:46]Beard: This can’t wait.
[18:05]Beard: Talk to me. This is urgent.
[22:08] Sultan: What’s going on? The Shevchenko’s on fire?
[22:11]Sultan: Well? Did you put it out, or what?
[23:10]Sultan: What’s the matter? Cat got your tongue?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDASultanBoroda_name: The Sultan’s Chat with an Old Rival
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Sultansk_PDASultanSych_body:
$J0L0Sultan: Well?
Owl: He’s still twiddling his thumbs aboard the Shevchenko.
Owl: You better mind your own ship.
Owl: Lyokha Corps-de-ballet is poaching your men for the Slag Heap.
Sultan: Where the Ward struts around like they own the place?
Sultan: Let him have ’em. I won’t shed a tear for those deadbeats.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_TEST_EQ01_VargaPDA_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>[22:19] Кровосос забрал Тему. Тварь налетела из слепой зоны. Моя вина - отвлекся на схрон. Когда сам подыхал - он не ушел. Тащил меня. "В Зоне многие ходят, но мало кто остается". Шакалы уже кружат вокруг тела. Пусть приходят. Раз не могу вернуть долг живому, верну мертвому.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Terricon_NestorPDANote_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> This freak thinks he can take me for a ride like this? No, five will do, or that punk will think I'm afraid to talk to him. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Terricon_PDAAboutFriend_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault> It seems your buddy’s in a bit of a pickle. If you’re up for sorting it out, swing by the Sultansk, and we’ll have a chat. </NoteDefault></NoteBody>

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_YanovDeggyToNor_body: $J0L0Nor,$J0L0You listen up: I don't buy the story about Monolith never coming back. It is more than just stupid, it is dangerous. In my absence, I forbid to reduce the number of patrol teams. We have to be ready. Always. $J0L0

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Yanov_PDA_AboutGarik_body:
$J0L0Vitya Rudko: You ever think Garry might be losing it, Kostya? The dude keeps saying “we” when he’s all by himself.
Kostya Bandura: You flunked the rookie test for Yaniv! He’s always taking someone around the Zone. That’s why he talks like he’s not alone. That’s my theory anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Yanov_PDA_Lost_body:
$J0L0[17:40] Senya Smoke: Set the table! I’ve got some artifacts that even Wreck would pay a fortune for!
[17:42] Mykola Marksman: Whoa, man! Can’t wait for ya to get back!
[19:01] Mykola Marksman: So how long do we have to wait?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Yanov_PDA_Lost_hint: PDA from a stalker’s body in Yaniv
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_BatyaPDANotes_body:
$J0L0Lens: Sure, Hamster’s a prick, I’ll give you that. But kicking him out means we’ll be screwed for at least a month. No spare parts, no food… or meds. Yet another week without meds.
Lens: Look, I ain’t backin’ him up. Heard every damn word myself. But before we boot his sorry ass, we need someone else lined up to fill his shoes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_BatyaPDANotes_hint: PDA found among Gaffer’s personal belongings
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_ConderPDANote_body:
$J0L0Chapa Grumpy: Too many Wardens sniffing around. All our diggers are shitting their pants. Asking if they really need to stay here.
Diode: Once we finish our job around Slag Heap, we can sit on our asses anywhere in the Zone and have anything we want.
Diode: If you wanna piss of, be my guest. Won't have to cut you in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_ConderPDANote_hint: Messages on a lost digger's PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_HomakNote1_body:
$J0L0 He didn’t come back.
All because of you.
One of these days, the Gaffer will stop covering for you, and then I’m gonna pay you a visit.
You’d better start praying.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_HomakPDANote2_body:
$J0L0[14:55] Unknown: The coupons have been sent, as promised. Don’t drag this out, or there won’t be an advance next time.
[15:16] Hamster: No advance, no deal. The pills oughtta be here this week.
[15:17] Unknown: You said Monday!
[15:45] Hamster: Not everything’s up to me, bud. Don’t push it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_KoldunNote1_body:
$J0L0 I’ve chosen not to speak openly about his, but hear me out.
I’ve had enough.
Bring this up in public one more time, and we’ll have a different kind of conversation. We stand by our own. Always have, always will.
I hope that got through to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_KoldunNote1_hint: A note found in Warlock’s bar
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_KoldunPDANote2_body:
$J0L0[22:11] Unknown: Having someone who grasps the real power dynamics in charge of Zalissya would make things easier.
[22:12] Warlock: I’m not going to talk about it.
[23:45] Unknown: You don’t have to talk about it.
[23:45] Unknown: But maybe you ought to mull it over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_LinzaPDANote_body:
$J0L0 Isn’t it ridiculous that we’re writing to each other when we live right next door? Like some fucking lovebirds or something…
Look, I know you feel guilty about my… condition. That’s why you never visit me here. But I chose to go into that lab on my own. It was my decision, you get it? You were just being a good guide, doing your job. Stop blaming yourself. You should be proud you got me out of there, you old coot.
Anyhow, drop by sometime. Let’s catch up like we used to. It’s lonely as hell here. At least tell me what’s happening on the other side of that fence.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_NikolaichNote_body:
$J0L0 This shit actually works! Put it on a fresh wound, and it closes up right then and there! I tested it on myself and the bleeding stopped in seconds – two hours later, there wasn’t even a scar left!
Now to see if it works on old injuries.
If it does, Lens’ll be all over me!
If he can catch me, that is!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_NikolaichNote_hint: Notes found among the personal belongings of Zalissya’s medic
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_NoteClosedDoor_body:
$J0L0DO NOT ENTER
5 Curiosity killed the 8 guys before you
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_NoteClosedDoor_hint: A sign written on a crumpled piece of paper
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_NoteClosedDoor_name: A piece of paper on a restricted door at Slag Heap
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_Zalesie_NoteGravestone_body:
$J0L0Another anniversary, brother.
Don't even think about it, we haven't forgotten how you jumped at those Monolithians and saved us all. And I haven't forgotten it should have been me.
I've seen enough of all this. And you were so young, you would've liked our new Zalissya.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_e01_mq01_ssp_memo_body:
$J0L0 All personnel employed by the International Perimeter Security Force (IPSF) must comply with the following standards outlined in the Code of Professional Ethics: $J0L2Diligently perform service and combat duties within the scope of their authority, including:
- ensuring the safety and security of the Perimeter from threats posed by hostile fauna (referred to as “mutants”) and armed groups
- preventing the unauthorized crossing of the Perimeter by individuals and vehicles
- providing assistance to approved scientific expeditions
- assisting adjacent IPSF units within the area of responsibility
- carrying out any additional duties as directed by IPSF Command.Adhere to the principles of impartiality, prioritizing the mission and principles of the IPSF over personal objectives (whether material, ethical, or otherwise) or the interests of third parties.Refrain from disclosing any classified information obtained in the line of duty.Understand that individual conduct reflects directly on the reputation and credibility of the IPSF.$J0L0 IPSF personnel are not permitted to: $J0L2Enter areas of anomalous activity (referred to as “anomalies”) except when required by official duty.Possess, acquire, or otherwise engage with anomalous formations (referred to as “artifacts”) except when required by official duty.Receive any form of compensation from any third party, including artifacts, unofficial electronic currency (referred to as “coupons”), currency, services, loans, etc.Transfer IPSF-owned property to any third party (see IPSF Statute pp. 108-115 for detailed regulations).

$J0L0Anonymous: Howdy! How are you, man? Getting those burns treated?Anonymous: A little birdie told me merchants are paying for mutant "spares" again. Thinking of taking up hunting.
Anonymous: Why not? Take a small mutant apart, sell what you can. You'll get enough for a can of grub and a bottle of vodka. Beats jumping headfirst into anomalies and spending your pay on meds.
Anonymous: What I mean is, once you're up and running again, join me. Don't be a stranger, bro.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_supack_SQ97_LostExpeditionMess:
$J0L0[22:47] Ihor: Assistant professor, I'm done. This wasn't in our contract, and sure as shit wasn't in our paycheck.
[07:12] Assistant Professor: Ihor, stay calm! What's happening?
[07:13] Ihor: Can't you fucking figure it out?! All this shit – the ambush, the mutants, Compass almost getting killed by a tree – you think we're just out of luck? More like cursed! And the radio… you told us to keep it on so you could watch that frequency fry our brains?!
[09:24] Assistant Professor: For the love of god, calm down! This isn't SIRCAA, I can't deal with this! If you're under the effects of psi-radiation, I'll send a field operative with some anti-psi as soon as I can.
[09:25] Ihor: Screw you and your anti-psi! I'm telling you, it's not the psi making people crazy, it's the fre-quen-cy! And there's no way anyone can be this unlucky in a normal place! Can't you read, or are you just dumb?!
[18:36] Assistant Professor: Watch your tone. I'm messaging the NK-3 head researcher about your situation. We'll get you all the necessary assistance.
NK-3 member's chat with the assitant professor
