$J0L0All NK groups: high-frequency resistors within the system are regularly failing. If you need new ones, go to Maksym "Rascal" Shelomyn in Rostok, and I will compensate you. Please submit replacement applications to STC Malachite only if absolutely necessary!

Assistant Professor K. Medulin.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_tesquest_AL_note1_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Night in this forest seems to be, how even to put it into words… luminous…</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>We heard the music play, a beautiful melody.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Going to check it out, although this place is full of anomalies.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_tesquest_AL_note2_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Something strange happened in this forest - just a few months ago it was kind of different. Now it has this… feeling about it.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>At day it seems like a usual Zone forest, nothing special.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>But at nights, a melody plays. It would seem like it somehow fused with the anomaly field, but is this even possible?</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>I'm definitely going to check this out again tomorrow.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_notes_tesquest_AL_note3_body: $J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>This damn Melody…</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>He always comes to this forest, for some reason at damned nights, and just plays his guitar here… Crazy bastard with his charming words…</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>This idiot forgot his PDA, and there is an Emission coming, so I am going for his ass, I still need him alive.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>He is my friend after all.</NoteDefault></NoteBody>$J0L0<NoteBody><NoteDefault>Damn all these romantics and poets, Zone is not a place for people like this!</NoteDefault></NoteBody>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_AfterNote_Ohno_716: Fucking hell... What have we done...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_AfterZombies_1_717: No one left standing, hehe. I feel so relieved right now.
I feel like passing out at any moment...
Woop, we've got you there Skif.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_AttackZombies_1_71: Word! Haha! Let your steam out, my fellow tribesman!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_DrunkPartyIdea_Agr: Why the hell not! I need to let some steam off!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_DrunkPartyIdea_Ask: What's that idea you have, Thought?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_DrunkPartyIdea_Dru: Ahahahaha! Yes! You are a great companion, Skif!
Haha, same goes for you! Didn't expect to get this drunk all of a sudden...
I am drunk as well, my friends!
And yet, all this negative energy still looms over my head for some reason! Why don't you fuck off and go away, will ye?!
Are you a shaman? Hahaha. I need to get something off my chest as well, so I'll try with you!
I think I have an idea, how we can discharge all that negativity! I've seen something interesting yesterday...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_DrunkPartyIdea_Ide: I saw a building, not far from here, with a few zombies stuck inside!
Memory, you said that you can't just go around shooting people for nothing. But what about zombies?
Haha, this sound exciting and dangerous!
I mean zombies are surely not a threat to me! But how much of them are there? And what if controller is nearby?
By looking at you, Skif, I would be scared in the controllers place, not otherwise!
I am not scared! I am drunk!
From the look I got - those zombies were pretty weak, and they were stuck inside the building, so they are just free targets for our bullets to take our edge off!
And it is some old small factory building, no basement, no rooms. Just a workshop! There is nowhere for a controller to hide.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_DrunkPartyIdea_May: I dunno. Aren't we too drunk for the task?
This is not a task, Skif! That's the point! Tonight we are free of all the burdens!
Let go of fear, of comfort, of the anxiety!
And just shoot some fucking zombies!
Ehh. Life is too short anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_EndingLokiAlive_1_: A choice is a choice, Skif. And you've made a tough one.
Now that you've seen the repercussions, maybe you'll understand the weight of your actions. So live with it.
Let's bury our boys and leave this fucking dump forever...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_EndingLokiWounded_: I guess Zone is just the place for scumbags like you...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_EndingThoughtAlive: I never thought it would lead to this...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_FetchAnItem_Help_7: Fuck, I think I dropped my gun at the workshop yesterday...
And I am in no condition to go there now...
I think I'm gonna puke and pass out at any time, at the same time...
Skif, can I ask you for one little favor?
Since you look like you're the only one in walkable condition. Pretty please?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_FetchAnItem_Mornin: Oh my god, am I alive?
Morning there, Skif! How do you feel?
I feel like my head is going to explode any moment... What did we drink yesterday anyway?
Ha-hah, that was my special mixture! Some alcohol, and some pills...
That's... That's why it felt like my mind was outside of my body...
Imagine how Thought feels, heh. He is on that pills almost all the time.
There is no other way I would've survived the Zone for all this time. But even for me tonight was a little too much.
Don't wanna know what those pills were...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_FetchAnItem_Nah_71: Screw you, Thought! I am as dead as both of you are! I need to chill for a bit as well...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_FetchAnItem_Okay_7: Sure, I'll bring it. Better to take a walk anyways...
Thank you! Now, better turn away...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_FightingZombies_1_: Here, my brothers, in that building.
Wow, your drink has finally taken effect, Memory!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_Aggro: I guess killing you would be the right move then.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_Choos: Who of them two will live, who of them two will die.
I feel like you're just a victim of the circumstance, right, Skif? Wrong place, wrong time?
But wasn't it your decision, in the end? Didn't you choose to pull the trigger? To drink with strangers? To enter the Zone?
Was it your true nature, that led you here? Or was it all just an unlucky coincidence?
Oh wait... Maybe you still don't understand the weight of your own decisions?
So I'll teach you, Skif. A free lesson from fellow stalker.
One dies, another one lives. Who will it be?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_Rant_: To think that we were so fucking close to get out of this shithole...
For several years we survived, gathering enough money and resources to go back and leave this accursed place behind...
And it always worked out... we didn't lose a single person... until today.
Some of those guys you butchered... they had sick families back home. That's why we came here. Yes, it was very risky and dangerous, but we fucking new that we could do it, together...
And one day, when we were almost out of here, YOU happened...
The Zone... The Zone is a perfect place to see a true nature of men.
And what kind of man are you, Skif?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_SkifD: I would say it's a pleasure, but not under the conditions we've met.
Who are you and what do you want?
Tell me, Skif, what do you remember from the last night?
Do you remember shooting up a bunch of zombies in the workshop hereby?
Well, you see, they were not, how can I put it...
They were our dear friends from our squad.
And you lit them up like a Christmas tree on a Christmas Eve!
What the fuck are you talking about?
That booze you drank yesterday - it contained several drugs, some of which can make you feel and see things, that are not actually there.
These two dumbfucks like to make mixtures of these amazing ingredients.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_Stay_: Stay right fucking where you are and keep those hands up.
One wrong move, and both these stupid fucks and you are getting bodied!
Shut your wretched mouth, goddamn junkie!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_Story: There were no zombies at the workshop...
They were...just...injured stalkers...waiting for their squad to comeback with resources to help them...
What? I don't understand... But we saw zombies! We clearly saw...
Clearly? Huh. I could smell this stench from a mile away...
Some handmade drugs mixed with alcohol... I bet you could see horses on a rooftops with this shit up your brain...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_Talk1: As I see you were coming back from your morning stroll to the workshop.
Enlighten us all, Skif, what did you find back there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_nocho: You know, Skif, taking no action is also a choice, which means it also has consequences.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MakeAChoice1_pleas: Please don't make me do it... I... I can't do it...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_MemoryRage_1_71724: I'LL FUCKING KILL ALL OF YOU, BASTARDS!!!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_Aboutyo: Argh, today was pretty annoying. Sometimes I just have this inner urge to rage a little, you know? To discharge all this accumulated negative energy somewhere.
And I think you know what I'm talking about.
In the Zone there are many things which can annoy you or make you angry. Bad days happen all the time. But you can't just shoot everyone in sights, just because you've had a terrible day!
I'm not sure you can call them "people" after that.
Well, take a look around. In this place it takes too much to stay the same.
I don't think that people who do this actually are changed that much. The Zone is not what twists them - it is just a place with enough freedom to show what kind of beast you truly are.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_Another: Just another day in the Zone.
Been there, looted that, survived this. And other usually unpleasant stuff.
Ha-ha, I would've put it in the same way!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_Drink_7: Let us forget about all of that for a moment! Let's just drink, and drink, and drink!
What can be better than trusting total strangers in the Zone.
Sometimes you just have to go with the vibe, am I right?
The effect is not immediate though, so be ready when it hits, hehehe.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_Hello_7: Hello there, fellow stalker! Would you care to join us for a drink on this lovely evening?
Hey! Yes, come, sit! Take a break from all the looting with us!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_Intro_7: Huh. Well, they call me Skif around these parts.
Tell us, Skif, how was your day today?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_No_7157: Hey! Appreciate the offer, but maybe some another time alright?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_Roughda: Today actually was pretty dull. Just traveled from one stash to another, seen nothing, heard nothing.
It's the dull days like these make us appreciate how simple sometimes our life can be, even in a place like this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_QuestStart_Yes_715: Hey! I guess it won't hurt to take one night off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ALTQuest01_SkifSeesTheAfterma: These are the bodies of usual stalkers...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ02_Comment_Fight_angry_FF: Stay outta here, you bastards! You ain’t takin’ me alive!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_Comment_AboutMoneyAlt_: Just hand over the coupons already. I’ve got better things to do than mess around with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_Comment_AboutMoney_Abo: No one ordered you to speak. I could bust you for trespassing near a secure military site!
So what’s it gonna be? Do I follow the regulations, or would you rather work something out?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_Comment_MoveAlong_Move: Back off, stalker! Stay out of this.
Did I stutter? Hit the road, or I’ll shoot to kill!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_Comment_PhraseAfterSol: You got coupons to spare too? No? Then get lost.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_Comment_PraseAfterStal: Those uniform-wearing Bloodsuckers… why the hell did I even take this route?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_Comment_Thanks_thanks_: Thanks. Nice work dealing with these thugs. We’re all sick of their “fines.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_cernysov_1_InfoTopic_1: All those loners hanging around here — what's the point? They only make trouble.
One joy left to me — to catch a greenhorn on not knowing the regs and make a coupon or two.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ03_sana_stopor_0_InfoTopi: Those assholes act all tough when they’re waving their guns in your face. But the moment the mutants show up, poof! They vanish into thin air.
You wander all over the Zone, diving into anomalies and mutant nests… only to have your hard-earned money end up in the pockets of those camo-wearing thugs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ06_Audiolog_ScaredMan_sca: I’ll be at Zalissya later. Need to catch my breath.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ13_Audiolog_PsyField_1_57: Either I’ve lost too much blood, or… the statue’s, like, moving.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ13_Audiolog_PsyField_1_FF: I’m getting a little winded over here, Misha. Keep going without me. I’ll patch myself up by the statue, then catch up with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ26_AL_StrangeRecording_Su: (a recording of a weird and unpleasant sound)
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ27_AL_KlucUpdated_NK4_802: Check, one-two… yeah, it's working. This is Wrench, NK-4 research group. Day three. We made it out. Recorded that famous transmission of yours — no big deal… Don't forget, you owe me one.
The guys are a little shaken, but we pulled through. Bit of puking, but we're fine now. And here I thought I'd miss out on all the action stuck in the "control group". Okay… Deep breath…
Hey, man! What's up?! Hey… Hey! What the hell?! Drop the gun! Drop—
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ27_AL_Kluc_NK4_78152: This is Wrench, NK-4 research group. Day three.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ27_AL_Kluc_NK4_78154: Recorded that famous transmission of yours — no big deal…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ27_AL_Kluc_NK4_78155: Don't forget, you owe me one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ27_AL_Kluc_NK4_78156: The guys are a little shaken, but we pulled through. Bit of puking, but we're fine now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ANCQ27_AL_Kluc_NK4_78157: And here I thought I'd miss out on all the action stuck in the "control group".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Batya_Generic_ByeFriend_Bye_3: Feel free to drop by any time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Batya_Generic_HelloDefault_St: Another one? Great timing. Sorry, kid, now's not the time. Come back later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Batya_Generic_HelloEnemy_Hell: You just had to show up, didn't you? What is it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Batya_Generic_HelloFriend_Hel: Ah, Skif! Finally a face I'm glad to see. How can I help you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Assault_Dialog_1_4: Skif, come in! Come in! Solder sold us out, you hear me? That greedy son of a bitсh sold us out! I…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Assault_Dialog_1_5: What's that? Some kind of anomaly?
Situation unclear. You: inside. You: to the roof. Move out!
Finish him and let's make tracks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Assault_Dialog_1_7: Quiet! I see the Scanner… Tracing for anomalous activity and radio signals…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Intro_Dialog_1_488: The Zone is really raging today.
See that? It was a hell of a blast! Can't remember one, so fierce.
The Central Checkpoint could be on alert after the Emission, but there's another way in: a crack in the wall, to the left of the Fault.
Take the tunnel straight to the Zone. Jump over the wall and the sewers will take you right in.
Easy now, Hermann. Steady, real steady…
What the hell is this? I’ve seen artifacts taken from the Zone before,  they always burn out and fall apart real fast. But this one…
This one’s not from the Zone.
Oh, I bet! Where'd you find it?
Who do you think you're talking to, huh? Do you have any idea what this Scanner cost me?
This stone owes me a new home. We gotta move.
Get to the scientists’ bunker. Nehoda will explain how to proceed with the Scanner. He’s waiting for you. Good luck!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Intro_Dialog_1_497: If it's not an artifact, it's gonna blow us all to hell! I won't let my hard work come to nothing because of you. I won't let you flush it down the shitter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Intro_Dialog_1_703: …Sector 9, visual detection of the Fault, I say again, sector 9, visual detection of the Fault…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Intro_Dialog_1_705: Hope you didn't lose your “secret artifact” along the way? If it was outside the Zone for too long, it would've lost its anomalous energy,
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Intro_Dialog_1_706: One lucky activation and we have a goldmine here!
but I’ve got this shiny metal thing to recharge it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E01_MQ01_Opening_Dialog_1_7: І останнє питання, Докторе Далін: ви впевнені, що Периметра навколо Зони достатньо? Якщо відбудеться потужний викид, то ми…
Послухайте, Зона була стабільною роками. Окрім того, ми б не заснували найбільш передову Інституцію в історії людства, якби не гарантували її безпеку.
Як голова Науково-дослідного інституту Чорнобильської аномальної Зони, або скорочено НДІЧАЗу, я вірю в те що чудеса, які ми принесемо у світ перекривають усі ризики.
Зона відкриває новий, зовсім інший світ! Ми, звісно, можемо остерігатися будь-яких змін, але скажіть мені: ви хочете, щоб наші нащадки запамʼятали нас як боягузів?
Чи як тих, хто розширив горизонт на благо всього людства?
…підрозділи аварійно-рятувальних служб прямують на місця. Кількість постраждалих уточнюється. Нагадаємо нашим слухачам, що це вже другий інцедент…
…закликають населення зберігати спокій і запевняють, що ситуація перебуває під повним контролем…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50422: Nope. Talk to Gaffer. That’s him over there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50424: Sit down and stay out of sight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50426: Three of my men never reported back from their overnight patrol around the Lesser Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50427: We found their bodies by the Old Bridge.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50428: Hey, soldier. Over here! What do you call three dead Wardens up the Zone’s ass? A good start.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50429: A trader who goes by Hamster was peddling this service weapon that belonged to one of those Wardens. He got it from Squint.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50430: Apologies, Captain, but Zalissya is a free trade zone. We have an agreement with Korshunov.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50432: Zone has its share of secrets. Who are we to meddle in its designs?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50433: Playing a wizened stalker sage, are you? Fine.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_Dialog_1_50434: Squint was there for sure. He finished off the wounded and looted their bodies. Is that the stalker way now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_A_50435: I suppose it’s not that simple.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_A_57542: All right. If you won’t tell me, others will. Seize them!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_A_57545: If you don’t want the innocent to suffer, find me the culprit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_A_57546: Well then. In times of war…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_B_57536: If you won’t tell me, others will. Seize them!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_B_57539: If you don’t want the innocent to suffer, find me the culprit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_B_57540: Well then. In times of war…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_C_57530: If you won’t tell me, others will. Seize them!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_C_57533: If you don’t want the innocent to suffer, find me the culprit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_Bar_WFR_1_C_57534: Well then. In times of war…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ01_ToughAwakening_Dia: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Some fireworks, huh?
I'm your guardian angel. Here's a bolt.
Why the hell would I need a bolt?
Yep. Toss it into the anomaly, then while it resets, run like hell. Got it? Now go!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ03_Pripoy_Dialog_1_45: Oi! Drop the gun. Who the fuck are you?
Ha! You've got some nerve, mate. Breaking into a military base, raising hell, and now you’re pestering me with questions? Shit. I should shoot you right here and be done with it.
When was the last time you cleaned that thing? PMs tend to misfire a lot if you don’t take care of them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ03_Pripoy_Dialog_1_48: Who’d you sell Hermann out to?
PMs tend to misfire a lot if you don’t take care of them.
He’s the one you should be talking to. The kingpin of Garbage. That's huge pile of trash, you can't miss it. It’s north of…
Listen. I didn’t betray Hermann. I’ve sold some people out in my day, but not you guys.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ03_Pripoy_Dialog_1_50: Look, I’m a nobody. I just put anomalies on a map. Sure, I’ve sold stuff on the side to guys like you. But that’s it. Nestor runs the Scanner business.
Ah. Hang on. Did you get busted?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E02_MQ03_Pripoy_WFR_1_A_459: That’s one less pile of trash to deal with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E03_MQ02_PsiBomb_Dialog_1_4: Gimme a hand! Bring that shit over here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E03_MQ02_PsiBomb_WFR_1_A_49: Easy. We’ve got an infinite amount of time ahead…
You planning to hang around and catch some rays?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E03_MQ05_TerriconePeak_Dial: Richter?!
Spell-bound, a grove, all enchantedly radiant, Sleeping or dreaming, as if…
Skif?
What are you doing here?
Just living a little. I mean, take a look at that view!
Whoa, stay away from the edge!
Isn’t it beautiful?
Just a load of trash. Food waste, human waste, you name it.
You could find anything you wanted here, Skif: a friend, an enemy, money, death, miracles.  Even yourself.
You ever been to the… Zone’s center?
Not to the plant, no – you can’t get in.
I mean, you won’t find anything there now. It’s like a plundered pyramid. Word is, even the Wish Granter was stolen.
But I have been to Prypiat.
What?
We got hammered once and went on the Ferris wheel. It was a pretty shitty ride, but we had a hell of a time!
If crows are nesting in the landfill now, that means… Skif. Have you ever lost something you’ve loved?
What happened?
Fine. So, what do you think of the Zone, then?
Why are the stalkers so obsessed with the CNPP?
Because the Plant is the heart of it all. It's the very essence of the Zone.
And this… will pay for one ride.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E03_MQ05_TerriconePeak_WFR_: It’s a chance… to turn my life around. Although, it looks like it’s going straight to hell right now.
It may seem so. But that’s the will of the Zone. It knows what’s best for us all.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E03_MQ06_TerriconeVarta_I_1: Where’s Diode? You know, the technician?
You like asking questions, don’t you?
Diode said you asked him about some Scanners.
The thing about the Scanner…
Hold on, Dalin…
Take a seat. Let’s talk.
Colonel, if I may… It’s Skif, right?
I need you…
I need all of us to understand the urgency of this situation given the extreme importance of our mission.
That goes for you too, Skif.
I hear you’ve managed to activate one of our devices, the Institute’s most valuable invention.
You got it to work at the Old Bridge, didn’t you?
And the artifact? There was a faded artifact in the Scanner. What happened to it?
I see the Scanner... Tracing for anomalous activity and radio signals…
Stalker PDA detected! Someone here!
I was there.
I was attacked, just like your men.
The Scanner was stolen. And I’m looking for the scumbags who took it.
Fuck it. We’re all in the same boat.
Help me find those bastards, Skif. Maybe you know something I don’t…
Search him!
Dima.
Dima, you okay?

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E03_MQ06_TerriconeVarta_WFR: Something similar happened to Varan, a bandit from Garbage. He had a Scanner, and—
What?
Another goddamn Scanner?! Why are the bandits running around Garbage with your precious invention?!
Another Scanner?!
Don’t play dumb with me! At this point, there are more Scanners in the Zone than there are fucking stalkers!
I don’t know about that…
Well, I don’t know if—
Holy shit! A Monolith PDA!
Now I can finally burn their fucking nest down!
Wild Island. Fortifications...
Fortifications… two. No, three… They’re pretty heavily armed.
Zotov, come in!
The Scanner and the artifact, out there, in the hands of lunatics. Among the mud and the toxic waste!
Colonel…
What?!
Please, what if the Scanner gets damaged in the fighting? These are not stalkers, but former Monolithians! No, this is out of the question. I can’t bear to think about it!
Maybe we should send some neutral person to the island, someone who’s already helped you… I mean us.
Come on, think about the risk! We could lose the very thing we’ve been striving to obtain!
Colonel, this is Zotov. I don’t copy. Please repeat. Over. Colonel?
Just checking in. Over and out.
Unfortunately, I haven’t had a chance to introduce myself.
My name is Dmytro Dalin, and I’m the head of SIRCAA.
A temple of Science, a haven for geniuses, a place where the Holy Grail is not sought, but invented…
The Scanner is the Institute’s greatest achievement, but right now, all that really matters is the revived artifact at the heart of it.
If you get it back, our dream can become a reality. Mankind will be transformed – we’ll open the way for future technology.
And it will all be thanks to you — thanks to your courage and dedication to progress. You’ll be leading the way!
The brink of a new scientific era!
That’s wonderful, man.
But I’m here because the Anomaly burned down my home on the Mainland, and someone’s got to pay for it.
This cannot be…
Another of your miscalculations, eh, Einstein?
Skif, head over to Wild Island and find their leader, Strider.
He’ll know where the gang hangs out. And if you can persuade him, he just may tell you what kind of shady business they’ve gone and gotten themselves into.
I’ll get you a new one.
Take this. It’ll come in handy if someone gives you the silent treatment.
Good luck, soldier. Keep in touch.
Whoa, whoa! Guys! Varan’s men were attacked. But one of the attackers had this.
Wild Island.
Colonel!
Thank you.
But it did.
Where are they getting their equipment? Give me the radio.
Nope. Nothing so far.
You stalkers are a strange breed. Do you have to be so stubborn?
You put your secrets before reason, and for what? To snuff it in the first anomaly you stumble into. Just for some make-believe miracles of the Zone.
Unfortunately, I wasn’t given a chance to introduce myself.
My name is Dmytro Dalin, and I’m the head of SIRCAA.
The Scanner is the Institute’s greatest achievement, but right now, what really matters is the revived artifact at the heart of it.
If you get it back, our dream can become a reality. Mankind will be transformed – we’ll open the way for future technology.
And it will all be thanks to you – thanks to your courage and perseverance.
And rest assured, all your hard work and efforts will be rewarded handsomely.
Wasting your time, Dalin…
Nice to know, Head of SIRCAA.
Aha.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E04_MQ01_StriderAndFaust_Di: “He’s dead,” they say. “Destroyed!”
You can go and hide from him and cower away in some musty hole in the ground, but that won’t stop the wind from blowing or the rain from pouring!
“Brave warriors,” I tell you! His worthy children!
“Lies,” I tell you. They’re all filthy, pathetic lies.
You can’t kill God, just like you can’t get rid of the sky up above.
“Crazy fanatics,” they say. “Murderers!”
Stop brainwashing my men, Faust. You’re only making it worse.
What could be worse than… this? What have we become? Are you happy, Strider?
My boots are fine for the road I walk. There are more important things than happiness.
And what’s that then? Backbreaking work? Hardship? That enduring sense of guilt…? It didn’t use to be like this. We were different – part of something much greater…
I was the Word, and you carried the banner of the Monolith!
We brought death. Against our will.
Well now we’re dying ourselves. The fumes are killing us, as are the bullets of our vengeful enemies!
How many brothers roam the Zone to this day, lost and forgotten, forced to hide their past? We have to find them. We have to bring them to the safety…
By force? We all know about Wild Island. Everyone must make the choice for themselves.
And what will they find here? The meaning of life? Or a similar bunch of miserable wretches – just like them, who don’t know what they want?
Strider saved us!
And now he’s killing us…
Once, we were His children. And what are we now?
Men of free will, who choose their own way. You’re living in the past, Faust. The Monolith is dead. It’s time to grow up!
You can’t kill God, just like you can’t get rid of the sky up above.
Think again!
I am blind, but it’s you who cannot see. Go cower in your hole in the ground! Hide from the past, hide from His light… Hide from yourself
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E05_MQ02_ThatNimble_Dialog_: I don’t know who you are, stalker, but you best run!
Shit! Fuck! That was a little too close. I thought it was game over, for sure.
Two close calls in a minute. Not cool.
You were asking about Clear Sky. What do you wanna know?
You... That night, back at the Old Bridge. You stole my Scanner and gave me a hell of a headache!
That’s horseshit, man. I ain’t been back at the Old Bridge in a long time!
It was all Faust, man! Shi-i-i-t. I’m just a guide! I was only showing the way, all right?
It was a run-of-the-mill job, where the customer’s kinda shady, all obsessed with the Monolith and shit. But I’m not in the business of killing stalkers.
He ain’t that bad. Maybe a couple of screws loose, but here in the Zone, that don’t exactly make him unique.
You good now, bro? That’s what I thought.
But you are in the business with Faust!
Although, that whole blind thing? I think it’s a crock of shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E05_MQ02_ThatNimble_WFR_1_A: That’s a pretty stupid take. Any others?
Oh yeah, lots. You patch me up and I’ll share everything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E05_MQ02_ThatNimble_WFR_1_B: Back at the Old Bridge. I got lucky. But others? They could've been killed. So…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E05_MQ03_ClearSky_Dialog_1_: Shot by Loners. Died in an anomaly.
Found with a stone around his neck. Thrown off a cliff.
Torn apart by dogs. Operation Monolith.
Wait just a second, Skif, and the Scanner is yours. I need to… say my goodbyes.
Farewell to our great past. Enemies? Yes. But united by faith in one idea. For your kind, it was the Wish Granter. For us, the Monolith.
It spoke in many tongues, but everyone heard only what they wanted to hear. Repentance? Forgiveness? Not a chance. After a decade of silence, only hatred remains.
The Monolith has abandoned us to make us understand…
…that being alive does not mean to be happy. Nothing else matters.
Shot by Loners. Found with a stone around his neck.
Thrown off a cliff. Operation Monolith.
Hanged. Torn apart by dogs. Killed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ01_TemplesDoorstep_Di: We need to run compatibility tests. Check everything is all right.
Oh, yes. Of course. You must be tired.
Oh, here. Here’s the key to my room. I’m sleeping in my study either way. Don’t worry about your reward. You’ll get it!
Have some rest and get yourself cleaned up.
My colleagues promised me a surprise for my birthday, I wish I knew what it was…
Guess you’ll have to tell me. Enjoy it!
In fact, someone would like to talk to you as soon as we’ve completed all the necessary tests.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ02_MeetingAgatha_Dial: Skif! Skif! Thank God you’re here! If only Dalin had listened to me, I wouldn’t have to cheat! You know that’s true! Tell her, I’m begging you!
Your friend is a strange kind of scientist, Skif. He loves secrets more than discoveries.
That makes sense. People need more than just a couple of days to really become friends. You need to trust one another, share your secrets…
Like the fact that someone stole the Scanners from SIRCAA. Just because he was so envious of Dr. Dalin.
And guided by his co-conspirator, Faust – he insisted on murdering every last witness. Including you, of course.
There is no need to repeat yourself, Professor.
This man almost got you killed. So it’s up to you to decide his fate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ02_MeetingAgatha_WFR_: Let him go.
Professor Hermann, you may go.
Skif… Thank you. Thank you!
Professor! You forgot something.
Goodbye…
Yevhen Martynenko, twenty-five years old. Born in a small town, loved a good book but preferred a good fight.
Served in the army. Upon returning home was engaged in risky part-time jobs.
No real friends, no family – just lonely evenings in front of the TV. A while ago he came home to find his place in ruins.
You’ve been through a lot, Yevhen.
Cigarette?
After the fire at those apartments, everyone rushed to seek help from officials.
But not you, Yevhen. In your search for the truth, you had the courage to enter the Zone.
Perseverance is an admirable quality, and you’ve got heaps of it. That’s why we can thank you and you alone that the Scanner is back at SIRCAA.
The Zone is extremely dangerous to the outside world, but, thanks to you, we will soon have its power under control.
And in the meantime, you can return to the Mainland and move into a beautiful new house.
Sounds… great.
You deserve it.
But I want to be there for the experiment. Bread was promised – now it’s time for circuses.
Dr. Dalin speaks highly of you, but the experiment requires top-level security. Although, perhaps you could help us in this matter?
Someone’s planning to stop us, right? Stop us getting what we deserve…
He has to die.
Fair enough.

Strider, the leader of Noontide, intends to break into SIRCAA. They might be armed.
I knew I could count on you. Meet with Strider, convince him not to do anything stupid. I don’t want our new world to begin with bloodshed. And neither do you.
And if he doesn’t change his mind?
You’re an experienced guy, Yevhen. I’m sure you can handle it… one way or another.
I can’t help you. Sorry.
Skif, come in! Are you there yet? See if you can get to the labs and find out about the Monolith. I’m counting on you, stalker.
Someone’s taking advantage of you again, Yevhen…
Yeah, and you aren’t?
Strider has nothing to offer you in return – unlike us. Find him. Ask him to lay down his arms.
No worthy cause should begin with bloodshed.
I can’t help you. Sorry.
Skif, come in! Are you there yet? Scar says the Monolith is at the Institute! Can you get to the labs and confirm it?
Someone’s taking advantage of you again, Yevhen…
Yeah, and you aren’t?
Strider has nothing to offer you in return – unlike us. Find him. Ask him to lay down his arms.
No worthy cause should begin with bloodshed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ02_TheCaribbeanExperi: What do you want from me? Get to the point!
It’ll become clear soon enough, Colonel. And no, you won’t have to send your men anywhere or put them in danger. For that, we’ve got—
Speaking of danger.
As I was saying, we need someone who’s already got certain… qualities.
Courage. Persistence. Endurance.
Any of my men will do.
Not quite. We need someone who’s already had a… particular kind of experience in the Zone. Basically, we need a stalker.
The readings all match up, but to see it with my own eyes – that’s something else... A scientific miracle!
Alpha. Quarter of a century ago. Maybe even longer. The artifact that started it all.
It’s still going strong. And not just in the Zone.
You stalkers with your tall tales… You need to lay off the booze.
The Second Caribbean Experiment, you asshole. Tall tales, huh? Look at me! I lost everything back on the Mainland! And you tell me to lay off the booze?!
Colonel?!
To the victor go the spoils.
This Experiment isn’t gonna conduct itself… Stand down!
We had a simple choice: sit back and just wait for another Super-Emission, or take a chance and get control of the Anomalous energy!
And look – our gamble paid off!
As for your home… You can blame the Zone, not me!
Cool it, soldier. The Second Caribbean Experiment… didn’t go as planned. During the experiment, the group was attacked by Scar’s saboteurs. They’re local stalkers – a thorn in my side.
And since they achieved what they set out to back then, you can be sure they’ll keep trying to get in our way.  You’re blaming the wrong people, Skif.
Let’s hope that, this time, security will be your top priority.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ02_VoiceOfMonolith_Di: Your objective is here. Come to me. Your path is coming to end. Come to me. Only one will be rewarded. Your wish will soon be granted. Come to me.
The time has come. I see your wish. Your path has come to an end, human. Come to me. Come to me. You will get what you deserve.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ02_VoiceOfMonolith_en: Humanity is corrupt. Mankind must be controlled.
I want the Zone to disappear.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ02_VoiceOfMonolith_ru: I want to rule the world.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ03_StriderSignal_stri: Where the hell have you been? Help me out with these, will ya?
One on each hinge should do the trick.
Performing visual analysis. No damage detected.
SKALA here. Request for Sync Phase received.
Center! X11! The signal… The Sphere… Slag Heap!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ03_VartaSignal_signal: Zero coulombs on the Knyazhinsky scale.
Performing visual analysis. No damage detected.
Keep away from the door! Hands up! Keep your hands up! Where I can see them!
SKALA here. Request for Sync Phase received.
Are you nuts? Put it away!
This is the last one. The threat has been eliminated!
I barely slept during all those years of preparation. Maybe perhaps just a couple hours here and there on that awful couch. Thank you again for your help, Skif.
As of today, the Zone will be gone along with all our fears. You’ll go back to your new home. Strider will return to his island. And I’ll finally be able to sleep in a bed. With a real pillow.
Peacefully, with no dreams. Because all the dreams have come true.
Yes! I was right! I knew it!
Center! X11! The signal… The Sphere… Slag Heap!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E06_MQ04_TheZoneIsAlive_Dia: Skif, glad to see you, buddy! Let’s get outta here!
Hey, would you look at that!
My, my motherland, so great a land of Cheremosh and Prut...
You’re my only love, my native land, my motherland…
It’s alive! The Zone is alive!
You fucking crazy! I almost died at that fucking Institute!
What happened over there, Skif? Where is Strider?
Why are they shooting at us?! Why are you shooting at us?! We’re with Strider!
…just like you can’t get rid of the sky up above…
They say the sun’s always shining in Prypiat…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E07_MQ02_PsiImmunity_Dialog: The Signal has restored the programming of Noontiders and other ex-Monolithians, but their psi-immunity has been compromised ever since Project X.
I can’t yet say how dangerous it is for regular people.
But it is safe to say you’re a fucking failure, Dalin! Well, I guess it runs in the family.
Remind me – why did you save this little sack of shit from X11?
And you really think all this technobabble is gonna save your ass now? I should’ve kicked Dalin’s bullshit out of you a long time ago!
So you want me to dumb it down for you? Fine.
Here. See this Mesh? The Emitter is like the Duga, but in miniature.
The Duga can be used to amplify psi-radiation. It’s powerful enough to transmit another Signal and destroy the psi-immunity of everything and everyone in the Zone.
What, some kinda Brain Scorcher?!
In theory, yes. Only ten times as powerful. But that’s just a rough estimate, of course…
Son of a bitch… you just wanna do another experiment, don’t you?
Here we go again with your daddy issues. He can’t stand to live in his father's shadow.
Poor boy! Well, your old man also went to great lengths and ended up betraying the Board and destroying everything! Oh, he was really pleased with himself. Until he got shot.
You were hired to fix the problems on this Project, but now the Institute lies in ruins and my men are dead! What are you gonna fuck up next, Dalin?
But I succeeded!
Doctor is right, Colonel.
He did succeed. The Alpha Artifact has been found. Project X's network is restored and functioning. The Institute’s mission has been accomplished.
We may have underestimated Strider, but that’s not Dalin’s fault. Something else is going on here, something we don’t know about… yet.
But I’m sure the Ward is perfectly capable of dealing with these… issues.
Everyone needs to be on top of their game right now.
Our goal is within reach.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E07_MQ03_ExtremeMeasures_Di: There you are my good man!
I’ve got what you asked for.
It’s amazing this lamp is still intact…
Okay. Business first. I get it.
I’ve seen what this piece of shit is capable of.
The Ward is about to attack Duga. Their best men are going to be there. This “piece of shit” would be very helpful in thinning out their ranks.
So we're back to the same old bloodthirsty plan, huh?
That’s how the Zone works. Some people have to suffer so other people can stop suffering.
You knew all along, you son of a bitch!
Tell me. Do you actually have someplace to go back to? Or have you found what you were looking for?
Too many words, too few answers.
Man! A long time ago, I woke up in the scientists’ mobile lab at Yaniv Station. They were good men. They fed me and took care of me, all while huddled together in a cramped little iron box.
I wanted to help them, to find them a better place to live. During one of my trips, I stumbled upon the Chemical Plant. Yes, sure, another brick monstrosity, but…
So those good men moved there — it was the first Spark group.
We kept to ourselves, minded our own… business, even during the new faction war. Until one day…
BAM! BAM! Bam!… Topol… he was the first to die.
Mace tried to warn us…
“Thieves rule and Wardens drool!”
And now tell me, who holds the Chemical Plant now?
The Ward…
Yes, the Ward!
I've kept away from any ruins ever since… except for the ruins of the Institute. Sure, you can take my “bloodthirsty plan” as paying off a debt. But this war isn't just mine war.
Yes, you… Him.
You came to the Zone looking for justice too, didn’t you?
What’s the point of all this sacrifice, Scar? All these victims?
What’s the point?
We’re all to stand upon the sea. Through death, through darkness, thus.
I choose the nets that swallow me. This mortal coil failed us.
Do what must be done, and the mystery will reveal itself. That I know for sure. As for you — just have faith.
Back then, it was like an Oasis to me.
Over here!
But all he could do was wheeze. Spirit and I tried to escape through the workshop, and then the second assault squad burst in! Boom! But Snake had a grenade ready for them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E08_MQ01_Infirmary_Dialog_1: “Rest and recuperate?” My men died getting your asses out of SIRCAA, I damn near died at the Duga, and now you’re telling me to rest?!
I’m afraid there’s nothing else I can do for you right now.
You’ve been promising me class 5 psi-protection for years!
Colonel, sir, no one expected the Small Duga to—
No one, huh? My men are still lying out there and I can’t even bury them!
At least you didn’t share their fate.
We… selected soldiers and studied them in order to understand how psi-immunity works. But, this procedure had a side effect we weren’t expecting: loss of protection against targeted psi-exposure.
What the hell does that mean?
We have created class 5 protection as promised, but… it only works for you, Colonel.
Those Monolithians. They fight like it’s their last stand and die happy. Faust could be envied, huh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E08_MQ06_DeathofFaust_Dialo: Take a seat, Skif. We have a lot to talk about.
What time of day would you choose for an intimate conversation?
A mortal dies, yet the soul endures.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E08_MQ06_DeathofFaust_WFR_1: I've always liked dawn.
What a… fascinating show.
Much of the Zone is not what it seems.
What the hell… did you unleash upon us?
You know more than I do, Envoy of the Monolith.
What?
You stood by His side, carrying out His will, and now you’ve come for me. I have angered Him, and that is why you are here – seeking revenge and the reward.
I don’t get it. I just want to reclaim what I’ve lost.
That makes two of us.
Is that so?
Some come to the Zone to make money. Others come looking for miracles. Many just want to find happiness, you know? A way to feel real and alive again.
But have you ever met anyone who was truly happy?
And what do they look for, if the miracles don’t satisfy them? The Monolith brought joy to a chosen few. But I've decided that all stalkers in the Zone deserve better…
How generous of you…
I’ve been here before. Once, a long time ago, when I was a stalker looking for an adventure. I took just one awkward step, and my whole world plunged into darkness.
But, in the end, it was I who gained true sight, while the others kept stumbling around in the dark, searching for invisible wonders.
The Monolith showed me the Zone for what it truly is.
I prefer dusk.

Does it matter?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E08_MQ06_DeathofFaust_WFR_2: The Monolith has nothing to do with this…
You know more than I do, Envoy.
There is no Monolith, Faust. You acquired Controller abilities in one of the X-Labs so you could guide the Monolithians and serve C-Consciousness. So long as they were alive…
Well, you would say that. I’m not surprised. You need to stay here a little longer.  There is nothing you can keep secret that’ll not come into the open. It’s just a matter of time.
Such is the will of the Monolith.
Define reality. The Zone is what you consider it to be. I've shown you how I see it. Walk your own path and you will come to perceive the Zone in your own way.
Such is the will of the Monolith.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E09_MQ01_TheEnemyUnseen_Dia: All right, Ozersky! Do I look like an idiot to you?
That’s Professor Ozersky, if you don’t mind. And I think you know my answer to that question. As for the Visiograph, we haven’t actually tested it yet.
What? You discovered a device from Project X and you haven’t even tried to activate it?!

We followed your instructions to the letter, Dr. Dalin! We used the technical drawings to assemble the components, then waited for the green light from the Institute. I sent you several requests, and I—
If I didn't know you as well as I do, I might think you did this on purpose!
I don’t remember any requests about X17! When did you file it?!
I guess it's buried under that giant pile of reports no one ever bothered to read.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ01_Kaymanov_Dialog_1_: How long did you know each other?
Not long. I met him on Wild Island. Back when he was still… human.
He was someone who had everything taken away from him — his past, his ability to fight back, even his name.
We go to great lengths to cover up our mistakes.
After years of work, a group of scientists managed to tap into… the Noosphere, the Earth’s informational field, an achievement comparable at best to the conquest of space! It was a turning point…
However, as with all people, each of my colleagues was truly interested in only one person — himself! They began to dream of worldwide fame, of laurels crowning their bald shiny heads!
Naturally, the truth couldn’t come out about the secret laboratories, brutal experiments, and other such dubious undertakings, it was out of the question.
And so, they got all carried away with their dream of a “perfect world.” You know how the saying goes: great minds think alike — though fools seldom differ.
And, lo and behold, what do we have decades later? The Zone. In our image, after our likeness.
Not just for science, but for the fate of the human race…
You were there, right? For the C-Consciousness project?
I was once as deluded as they were, but my doubts soon outweighed their confidence. And so when the experiment took place, one of the pods was left empty.
The eighth one. Or, rather… The first. Dr. Kaymanov's pod.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ02_OrbitaStrider_I_1_: Skif? What’s going on? Where are we?
But the Experiment… Tell me we made it in time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ02_OrbitaStrider_I_2_: We were too late.
What happened to my men?
They’re under  control of The Monolith.
I’m sorry, Strider.
May 2012. The military is storming the CNPP. Lun and Sova Teams are in my sector. The primary objective is Quartet.
Southeast, 180. Landmark: Inspection Tower.
Target: Sova, 345. Low lateral.
Southwest, 195. Landmark: Pumping Station.
Target: Quartet, 400. Moderate lateral.
Windage. Breathing. Three… two… one.
That was the day the psi fields were turned off.  Suddenly, the voice of the Monolith was gone. I felt as if I was awakening from a years long coma.
He was not my enemy, Skif! I just hope that he has survived and has forgiven us.
You asked me about my good luck charm, remember? It’s an empty cartridge casing, a reminder from that day. I genuinely believed that I would never be a puppet again.
I am sorry, brothers. We have failed. Forgive me. And forgive me for everything you must do now.
It was a worthy try, Skif. Thank you. Stay strong.
And through the scope I saw the body of an unknown soldier fall.
Yes, we did.
Really? Good… Were any of my men hurt?
No. Just… Just you.
Well, we protected our new life. That’s all that matters.
You asked me about my good luck charm, remember? It’s an empty cartridge casing, nothing special. A reminder from the day the psi fields were turned off.
May 2012. The military is storming the CNPP. Lun and Sova Teams are in my sector. The primary objective is Quartet.
Southeast, 180. Landmark: Inspection Tower.
Target: Sova, 345. Low lateral.
Southwest, 195. Landmark: Pumping Station.
Target: Quartet, 400. Moderate lateral.
Windage. Breathing. Three… two… one.
Suddenly, the voice of the Monolith was gone. I opened my eyes, as if after years of coma. And through the scope I saw the body of an unknown soldier fall.
It’s the empty casing from that cartridge. It reminded me of what it meant to not be in charge of your own life… but now we are free, masters of our own destiny.
Thank you, Skif. Noontide will remember what you’ve done.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ02_OrbitaStrider_V_1_: You see anything, Skif? Enabling the visualizer…
Skif? What’s going on? Where are we?
But the Experiment… We were too late. So you sold me out, huh? What did they promise you?
…the Zone will be gone along with all our fears.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ02_OrbitaStrider_V_2_: I was dealing with my own problems, and I couldn't let you get in the way.
You lost. The Monolith is once again controlling you all.
You asked me about my good luck charm, remember? It’s an empty shell, nothing special. A reminder from the day the psi fields were turned off.
May 2012. The military is storming the CNPP. Lun and Sova Teams are in my sector. The primary objective is Quartet.
And then the voice of the Monolith was gone. And through the scope I saw the body of an unknown soldier fall.
That empty shell… it reminded me that we used to be puppets. Only I didn’t choose that path.
I wanted to sort out my own problems, and I didn’t expect it to go down that way.
You asked about my good luck charm, remember? It’s an empty shell, nothing special. A reminder from the day the psi fields were turned off.
May 2012. The military is storming the CNPP. Lun and Sova Teams are in my sector. The primary objective is Quartet.
Suddenly, the voice of the Monolith was gone. I opened my eyes, as if awakening after a long coma. And through the scope I saw the body of an unknown soldier fall.
He was not my enemy. I hope he has survived and forgiven us.
Farewell, Skif. Forgive me for what we did… and must do again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ03_OrbitaScar_I_1_Dia: Well, well… What a meeting! A good man in a tight spot. You don’t give up easy, huh? Keep sniffing around…
Hey, is it just me, or were you talking to somebody?
Strider? How'd he get here? Strider! Strider? Have you boys seen Strider around here? Strider! Stri-der!!!
Turns out there's life in the Noosphere. Can you believe it?
This rocket ain’t gonna take you into the Noosphere!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ03_OrbitaScar_I_2_Dia: I guess so. It's hard to digest at first.
But this time it's all different, right? Let me guess — it wasn’t the most pleasant conversation in your life?
The Shining! We’ll get rid of the darkness that imprisons us, preventing us from hearing each other. Imagine an Eternal spring, Skif! No pain, no regret, no suffering!
If you ask me, it looks more like a mind-prison.
You should have listened better to the Representative. Quit concentrating on the here and now, think instead about what we might achieve!
The Shining! To get rid of the darkness that imprisons us, preventing us from hearing each other. Imagine an Eternal spring, Skif! No pain, no regret, no suffering!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ03_OrbitaScar_I_3_Dia: I know, Scar. I just wanted to make sure.
Wonderful, I hope you didn’t waste your time and that you figured out something interesting. So, now it’s time to share!
I won’t be a part of this. Life is for the living, Scar. If the dead start talking to us, we’ll end up slaughtering each other. And then there won’t be peace for us – not even in death.
You know, all this time you’ve been a talisman to us, someone truly inspiring! I believed in you, but you turned out to be a forgery.
That’s why you didn’t get it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ03_OrbitaScar_V_1_Dia: I thought you were one of the good guys. Turns out you’re with the Ward.  Keep sniffing around, doing their bidding. I told you, it’s safer to sniff around for us — and way more fun.
Hey… is it just me, or were you talking to somebody?
Strider? Is he here? Strider? Strider! Have you seen Strider around here, boys? Strider!  Stride-e-e-er!
I get it. You were sent here to check if there’s life in the Noosphere, right?
This rocket ain’t gonna take you into the Noosphere!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ03_OrbitaScar_V_2_Dia: If you ask me, it looks more like a mind-prison.
You should have listened better to the Representative. Quit concentrating on the here and now. Think instead about what we might achieve!
The Shining! To get rid of the darkness that imprisons us, preventing us from hearing each other. Imagine an eternal spring, Skif! No pain, no regret, no suffering!
It was hard to digest at first.
Ah, I see. I take it you’ve met the Representative? Let me guess – the Wardens couldn’t make heads or tails of it, could they?
It has to be done, Skif. The Shining! We can get rid of the darkness that's imprisoning us, preventing us from hearing each other. Imagine an eternal spring! No pain, no regret, no suffering!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E10_MQ03_OrbitaScar_V_3_Dia: Life is for the living, Scar. If the dead start talking to us, we’ll end up slaughtering each other. And then there won’t be peace for us – not even in death.
You know, I made some inquiries on my way here. I wanted to help you learn more about the people you’re mixed up with. But now I realize there’s no point in explaining myself. You’re just not worthy.
Death doesn’t mean “goodbye”, it means “until we meet again”! See you later, Skif!
Don’t push it, Scar. I need some time to digest all this.
Fine, all time is ours now, at least while it still means something. Let’s talk – I’m here to help with your… digestion.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E11_MQ02_StrelokX3_Dialog_1: I'm not looking to make friends.
Hm, Skif. You’ve got some curious friends here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E11_MQ03_KorshunovPTS_I_1_D: What’s wrong with you, soldier? You’re a constant thorn in my side. You helped Strider, got mixed up with Spark—
Look, I’d love to gather all you stalkers around the campfire and explain exactly what we’re guarding and why, but I have no desire whatsoever to trip over your soiled mattresses while on patrol.
I’ve been ordered to keep the aftermath of Project X a secret from the likes of you. It’s too bad you trusted those dreamers. You’ve got a knack for it you know – taking people at their word…
You trusted Strelok? An agent of C-Consciousness?
The Dark One, Scar, Strelok. C-Consciousness bred them like cockroaches.  This installation will help us find every last agent, but only within the Perimeter.
Unfortunately, many of them have already left the Zone. And if we do nothing, houses on the Mainland will continue to burn and collapse!
This is reality! Miracles and fantasies are for those who can’t face up to the real world.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E11_MQ03_KorshunovPTS_V_1_D: What are you doing here, Skif? You could’ve just asked.
Well, I’m asking now. What is this installation, Colonel?
There’s too much stuff left over from Project X that we need to keep quiet about. Otherwise, we’ll end up with stalker bonfires and soiled mattresses piled up in every corner.
But… you’ve been a great help to the Ward, and I value your tenacity. So we can talk openly.
Not all knowledge is equally beneficial. Some of it can be outright dangerous in the wrong hands.
You trusted Strelok? An agent of C-Consciousness?
The Dark One, Scar, Strelok. C-Consciousness bred them like cockroaches. This installation will help us find every last agent, but only within the Perimeter.
Unfortunately, many of them have already left the Zone. And if we do nothing, houses on the Mainland will continue to burn and collapse!
If you fight us, soldier, you’re only fighting yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E11_MQ03_StrelokPTS_Dialog_: Screens. A whole wall of them, all static. And a creepy chair.
That’s his eyes you’re looking through. Wave to the man, Dark One.
Hello, Skif! It’s Dark One! Remember how I tried to kill Strelok? I’ve changed my mind!
Holy shit! How is this possible?

Well, C-Consciousness used to have very… advanced technology. Now we need to figure out what the Ward wants to do with it. Anyway, it’s time to wrap this up. It won't be long before they sniff you out.
I’ve got an idea. Talk to you later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E14_MQ02_FoundationSpark_Pa: Dalin! Don't act up! This ragtag bunch can’t get to the Generators on foot. So what was the point of opening up X11?
Just do this, and soon the name “Dmytro” will echo 'round the world.
We need someone we can all trust to get those fucking hoops spinning. And we both know that the Representative isn't an option.
But my father…
Your father’s dead! He’s gone! I saw them boiling in those Pods with my own eyes!
The goddamn Visiograph is just a fucking talking TV set!
It’s hard to believe, but Subtle Matter is real, Colonel! I know it!
You’re not a scientist, you’re just a lousy piece of shit.
Why the hell are you stalling? You just need to disconnect one stupid device and connect another in its place. It's no more difficult than changing batteries!
Don't push me, Colonel! This equipment hasn't been maintained in a long time. We need to be extremely careful, otherwise...
Shh!
You got it? Here.
Who are you?
We are the result of an experiment ended creating a super consciousness called "C-Consciousness".
Father?
According to our calculations, Earth is surrounded by a special informational field, the so-called Noosphere.
What’s the true scientist's rule?
It links all the sentient inhabitants of the planet and stores their mental images.
Our main goal was to make small adjustments to the Noosphere, allowing us to remove things like anger, cruelty, greed, and other negative factors from the planet.
Dad? Like you said… What’s the true rule of a scientist?
Individuals are unable to affect the Noosphere…
Be quiet.
…but C-Consciousness could.
Shut up!  Shut the fuck up!
It must be erased! Destroyed! Eradicated! I want it wiped out forever! Without a trace, without pity!!!
SKIF!!!
Dig deeper, Dalin! Dig deeper, son…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E14_MQ02_FoundationStrelok_: Dalin! Don’t act up!  This ragtag bunch can't get to the Generators on foot. So what was the point of opening up X11?
Just do this, and soon the name “Dmytro” will echo 'round the world. We need someone we can all trust to get those fucking hoops spinning. And we both know that the Representative isn't an option.
But my father…
Your father’s dead! He’s gone! I saw them boiling in those Pods with my own eyes! The goddamn Visiograph is just a fucking talking TV set!
There's no way to know for sure. But if there's even the slightest chance…
You’re not a scientist, you’re just a lousy piece of shit.
Oh yeah? Fuck you!!!
Let’s go on three. One, two, don’t fuck this up…Three!
Why the hell are you stalling? You just need to disconnect one stupid device and connect another in its place.
Don't push me, Colonel! This equipment hasn't been maintained in a long time. We need to be extremely careful...
Who are you?

Father?
