Dad?
Like you said… What’s the true rule of a scientist?
Individuals are unable to affect the Noosphere…
Be quiet!
…but C-Consciousness could.
Shut up! Shut the fuck up!
It must be erased! Destroyed! Eradicated! I want it wiped out forever! Without a trace, without pity!!!
Skif! Help me with this!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E14_MQ02_FoundationVarta_Pa: Dalin! Don't act up! This ragtag bunch can't get to the Generators on foot. So, what was the point of opening up X-11?
We need someone we can trust to get those fucking hoops spinning. And we both know that the Representative isn't an option.
But my father…
Your father’s dead! He’s gone! I saw them boiling in those Pods with my own eyes!
The goddamn Visiograph is just a fucking talking TV set!
What happened on the Orbita station, Skif? What did you see there?
I talked to Strider.
Just do this, and soon the name “Dmytro” will echo 'round the world.
It was just something that looked and sounded like him.
The Shining is real. Colonel, Subtle Matter is real!
You’re not a scientist, you’re just a lousy piece of shit…
Fuck you!
Whether it was Subtle Matter or Induced illusion, it felt like a mind-prison…
In every experiment, there is a probability of error.
You’re not a scientist, you’re just a piece of shit…
Fuck you!
Hermann?  What the hell?
I'm sorry about that show Skif, at the Institute. You had so much anger in you, I just wanted to help you to get rid of it.
A cold mind is what you need for our mutual success. Now, everyone is alive and well. Isn’t that wonderful?
He sold me out.
And he's atoned for it. You can trust him now. Don't be angry. A great cause needs a noble spirit. You don’t want to ruin our little party, do you?
Relax.
Get the Control unit! I’ll make this carousel move.
Hermann?
I'm sorry about that show at the Institute, Skif. You had so much anger in you, but you still did the right thing.
I don't know if you forgave Professor Hermann with your cold mind or warm heart, but… I followed your lead. I followed your example. Now, everybody is alive and well. Isn’t that wonderful?
Besides, Hermann is a great scientist. He’s every bit as good as… late Professor Dalin.
He’s the one who gave us something to celebrate!
Hello Skif.
Get the Control unit! I’ll make this carousel move.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E15_MQ03_MemoryCube_Dialog_: If you only knew where I’ve just been and what I saw!
One day you’ll finish badly, Strelok…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E15_MQ03_TheHardestChoise_D: The Monolith is no more, yet its cause lives on…
The greatest temptation - is trying to control something we do not fully understand. But what do we do when faced with the truly inexplicable?
Some tear it up to make souvenirs. Others keep it chained up inside the Perimeter cage.
Perhaps all the Zone really needs is our compassion. Perhaps the time has come…
…to let her choose her own destiny.
A tragedy most horrible, or a joy most profound. No one knows what the Zone truly desires.
And yet has a big heart. One that craves freedom… and the death of her tormentors.
He believes that he has been reborn here. So he will protect the Zone. That’s for sure. But how does one know the value of freedom if one has never been free?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E15_MQ03_TheHardestChoise_K: We can't just unleash an unfathomable monster on the world!
Do what you must. Whatever will be, will be.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E15_MQ03_TheHardestChoise_L: That means the Zone will never be free?
Do what you must. Whatever will be, will be.
Take the logs down to the basement. Behind the screen with the fireplace…
Just do what I said, please.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E15_MQ04_CouldNotBeFree_Dia: And the bullet was well deserved? It’s a shame you treated him like that.
Tell me about it. You think I didn’t try to spare his life? But the Zone couldn’t be free unless he died. And it was worth it – just look at it now! No, Skif, I won’t let anyone have the Zone.
She gave me a new life, one that I’m ready to give back if I have to. I'll always protect Her!
You think I didn’t try to spare his life? But the Zone couldn’t be free unless he died. And it was worth it – just look at it now! No, Skif, I will not let anyone have the Zone.
She gave me a new life, a life that I’m willing to give back if I have to. And I’ll always protect Her!
The Zone doesn’t need your protection. She can take care of herself. Just let her go.
Your lips are moving, but all I can hear is the “good doctor” talking… He knew what he’d done. He would've done anything to free himself from his past.
I trusted him. We were this close to unveil the real secret of the Zone. Turns out he was just using me to atone for his own sins…
He saved your life, you son of a bitch! And you never even thanked him. Every time you went to the North, you were just thinking about yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E16_MQ03_DogOnALeash_Dialog: Stalkers call them “Death Trucks.” They were used to deploy Agents all over the Zone.
Agents infiltrated the stalkers and carried out whatever tasks they were programmed for.
They were totally unaware of what they were doing.
The hands and eyes of C-Consciousness. I’ve been looking for them all over the Zone… Now it seems they’re on the Mainland.
You know, I used to have this hunting dog. And… he'd run round and round in circles, chasing his own tail.
Back then, I thought it was hilarious. Now I wonder: what was going through that dog’s mind? One day he’d get lucky and catch the damn thing.
But what then? Bite it? Sniff it? Lick it? Forever drag it around between his teeth? And why… Why was he chasing it in the first place?
Maybe it’s not about the tail… Just the chase.
’Cause once a dog’s got his tail, what then? What’s the fucking point?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E16_MQ03_Final_Skif_Dialog_: The greatest temptation – is trying to control something we do not fully understand. But what do we do when faced with the truly inexplicable?
Some tear it up to make souvenirs. Others keep it chained up inside the Perimeter cage. Perhaps all the Zone really needs is our compassion.
Perhaps the time has come… to let her choose her own destiny.
There is nothing you can keep secret that’ll not come into the open. It’s just a matter of time.
I used to serve the Monolith blindly, until she opened my eyes.  To keep life's adventure going, one must embrace freedom. Such is the gift of the Zone.
We are receiving numerous reports of unidentified anomalous entities appearing on the streets of our city.
Authorities are urgently forming a special commission to manage the situation.
Military officials are urging citizens not to leave their homes until further instructions from the special commission.
If you are outdoors or in an open area, please proceed to the nearest shelter or enclosed space.
If you are outdoors or in an open area, please proceed to the nearest shelter or enclosed space.
An address from the government to the nation is expected shortly. Please remain in a secure location and monitor government updates closely.
An address from the government to the nation is expected shortly. Please remain in a secure location and monitor government updates closely.
Do not approach or make contact with the anomalous objects.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E16_MQ03_Final_Strelok_Dial: Fallen cog returns to the machine…
“It seems that this is the only way to unveil the Zone’s real secret – the one you’ve been trying to figure out…” Come.
Hope the old man wasn’t lying this time.
You. Slide that damn thing back up, on my signal.
…Anyone… attempting to enter or leave… eliminated on the spot…
Attention!… checkpoints are closed. Crossing… is strictly prohibited… Attention!
Attention! All Exclusion Zone checkpoints are closed. Crossing the Zone’s Perimeter is strictly prohibited. Anyone attempting to enter or leave the Zone will be eliminated on the spot. Attention…
Lower your weapons. Let this stalker pass.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E16_MQ03_Final_TheSpark_Dia:
Wow! 
That's it. Stairway to Heaven.

Very nice.
My entry ticket… 
Come on.

Looking for O-CTA…
O-CTA… O-CTA… Oh there!

I’m going to go there. You're going to stay here. On my command, push that thing up. 
Don’t let me down!
Reality… is whatever you think is real.
Oh god, he plays so well!
Many stalkers owe you their lives, thank you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E16_MQ03_Final_TheWard_Dial: All this technology… Pods, wires, antennas and all that jazz…
Just so you can question less and serve more.
A tuft of hair… from a mangy old mare.
Thanks for the crutches, you old bastard.

Look for “O-KTA”.
Set it to “INITIAL” mode.
One last step for a spent man,

Thanks to you, we’re going to live in a new world with a bright future… 
I keep my promises.
You can stay with us, or…
You look tired. I’ll show you out.

Someone has to keep an eye on all of this. And “Colonel Martynenko” does have a nice ring to it. 
That’s your bird.
Condor-One. Whatever this stalker wants - this stalker gets.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_C_E16_MQ03_TotalRecall_Dialog: Poor Scar!
I knew him, Skif. A fellow of infinite jest, of most excellent fancy… and now, how abhorred in my imagination it is! My gorge rises at it.
Where be your gibes now? Your gambols? Your verses?
Prithee, Skif, tell me one thing.
What’s that?
Do you think the Representative looked o' this fashion in the earth?
I guess…
And smelt so? Pah!
What a miserable end, Skif! The Representative dies, the Representative is buried. The Representative turns to dust, the dust turns to soil, the soil to clay.
And who's to say that clay won't end up a stopper for a rusty rain barrel? And just to think, once he determined the destinies of all these stalkers.
So this is why in our own dreams sometimes we see their memories?
But the Representative is alive, only our enemies claim there's no life after death. If that’s the case, then there's no Shining Zone.
Tagan-tagan-tagan-ding-ding! If there's no Shining Zone, then all these lives are wasted in vain, Skif…
It’s not true.
Come on kids, the Shining Zone ain’t gonna find itself!
Poor stalker lost his arm, lost his head for this cause. Along with everything in it…
Jesus...
Scar?
Poor Scar!
I knew him, Skif. A fellow of infinite jest, of most excellent fancy… and now, how abhorred in my imagination it is! My gorge rises at it.
Where be your gibes now? Your gambols? Your verses?
Prithee, Skif, tell me one thing.
What’s that?
Do you think the Representative looked o’ this fashion in the earth?
I guess…
And smelt so? Pah!
What a miserable end, Skif! The Representative dies, the Representative is buried. The Representative turns to dust, the dust turns to soil, the soil to clay.
And who’s to say that clay won’t end up a stopper for a rusty rain barrel? And just to think, once, he determined the destinies of all these stalkers.
So this is why, in our own dreams, sometimes we see their memories?
But the Representative is alive. Yeah! Only the enemy claims there is no life after death. Argh! If that is the case then… there is no Shining Zone?
And if there is no Shining Zone, then all of these lives are wasted in vain, Skif!
No, we know it’s NOT TRUE!
I’ve lost my head for this cause! Along with all in it!
Jesus...
Scar?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_GCA_1_1_611: Why were you screaming in the middle of the night?
Well, I... I had a nightmare. A Rodent went up my pants, headed straight at my junk, and it was so damn fast... and so real!
I can still feel its little claws tearing at my skin...
Don’t worry, private, once you’ve killed a couple dozen of those little shits, they'll stop torturing you at night, I promise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_GCA_2_1_611: Your warrant officer refuses to sell me more than twenty rounds unless I fill out a bunch of paperwork. What the fuck is that about? What am I, his fucking secretary?
That’s the rule. If you don't like it, take it to the general.
You just gotta make simple shit complicated? Hello! We’re not on the Mainland!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_GCA_3_1_611: Zulu is gathering a team to retrieve some documents. He says they might have information on how to take down all the mutants in the Zone at once.
We’re waiting for the right moment, but when it comes, we need to be ready. So you’ve got some time to think.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_1: Our duty is to protect the world from the ravenous Zone. Join us and become a hero!
The Ward isn’t going to help us anymore, soldiers! We’re on our own now, but we’re up to the task! This is our duty!
Now is the time for action! Duty will put an end to the Zone and eliminate anyone who stands in our way!
Join your brothers in arms and show the mutants what you’re willing to do to protect humanity!
They fed us lies for too long, but enough is enough! We will not falter, we will not retreat, we will do our duty even if it’s the last thing we do.
Join Duty! The innocent civilians behind the Perimeter need you now like never before. Protect them from the Zone!
We have a huge responsibility on our shoulders: protecting the world from the sprawling Zone. Do your duty and join our ranks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_2: Stalker! Protect the world from the Zone! Join Duty!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_3: Everyone who joins Duty gets weapons and the latest equipment!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_4: We know that victory is at hand! We know that we will destroy the Zone! If we don’t, who will?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_5: Free stalkers, veterans, brave hunters — join Duty today! Save the world from the Zone plague! Save our planet and humanity!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_6: Join Duty, and help innocent civilians! Don’t let the Zone devour the planet!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_7: We are Duty! We are all that stands between the Zone and our loved ones!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_8: The Zone must be destroyed. Don’t let mutants and anomalies tear your hometowns apart!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_PropTopic_9: We’re closer to our goal now thanks to the Ward support! We’re unstoppable!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_closing_1_6: Attention, stalker. You’re entering Duty territory. Put your gun down, or we'll have to take action according to protocol.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_doktor_alen: Can’t you see I’m busy?
Yeah, go already.
You take care, all right?
See ya.
Quit whining. You’ll live.
I’ll still help you, don’t worry. Doctor's Oath.
Let’s get you patched up. You’ll be as good as new.
You did the right thing coming to me! It’s dangerous to neglect a condition like yours.
Well, speak up. What do you want?
Do you need medical assistance, or just dropping by for a chat?
Well, hello.
Here’s a little friendly heads-up: don’t go anywhere with Jager. He always takes the most mutant-ridden routes. 'Cause he's freaking bored, like that's an excuse!
It’s all a big pissing contest for those idiots, and I have to patch up what’s left of you. Damn savages!
The worst wounds I’ve seen here were inflicted by another human. Makes you wonder who you should really be afraid of in the Zone.
See what the Zone does to people? It’ll have us all at each other’s throats soon enough. It’s already started.
I can’t imagine how many boys will get killed in worthless skirmishes now.
Okay, are you gonna look around, or do you just need meds?
Need to get patched up? I’m having a hell of a busy shift today. Let me guess — stab wound? Sit down, please. I’ve had four of these today already...
Why would you ever leave the Mainland in the first place? Can't you see what the Zone’s doing to people? It makes you go feral. Always hunting for loot and fighting over it like wild animals.
Or maybe you’ve just got a death wish. Like Jager, a guide now, of all things... so? Cat got your tongue? What's bothering you?
I won’t sell you much, of course — I’ve got my own men to take care of.
Okay, let’s see what you might find useful.
Good decision. Make sure to restock your meds before heading out there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_fila_ohotsk: Go get yourself some good loot.
Hera, the bartender here, is an awesome dude. You can't tell, with that sour puss of his.
I guess it’s time to get out of here. I have a feeling it's gonna get ugly...
Fucking pencil pushers and their fucking papers...
I could sure go for some potatoes right about now... fried to crisp, with salt and garlic...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_g_hyphen_l_: I should have you locked-up, not chat with you.
Glad to see you’re still in one piece.
Tell me about the Cement Factory.
It’s our main base now, after we signed the Treaty and had to leave Rostok to Freedom.
It’s a good spot. Not exactly comfy, that’s for sure, but it has ample storage, and it’s easy to defend.
Loners are allowed to trade here, if they’re interested, and we have a bar. We have a doctor with us too. Go find him if you need him.
If you want my advice, don’t rush it. Every decision I’ve ever made in a hurry led to a disaster.
Those Freedom guys can taunt me all they want, I’m not taking the bait. It'll sort itself out. You’ll see.
That was unexpected, huh? We’ll have to see how it goes...
We need to keep observing and stay put. We can still pursue our goal, even without the Treaty. Proceeding slowly but steadily...
General Voronin, in charge of Duty. You should know right away, loner, that we follow military regulations here, and there are no exceptions.
If you want to join us, you’re always welcome. We need more men.
The enemy is falling back. Good job!
Attention! Emission in progress. Stay in shelter.
Attention, Duty! Emission underway. Take cover.
Remove the body from the premises.
We seem to have gotten off on the wrong foot. How about we start over? Clean slate?
Oh, you want a clean slate now, huh? You do realize how much trouble you’ve caused us, don’t you?
How about fair compensation first? If you want to make amends, bring my men something useful.
I need to think it over.
You’re on thin ice here, Skif.
Okay, we can start over. But I’ll be watching you, Skif.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_gera_0_ByeT: If you need anything, stop by.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_gera_0_Hell: I’ll tell you straight away, I won’t let you cause any trouble here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_gera_0_Info: I used to go out there, too, you know... shooting mutants, doing my duty, all that jazz. Until those mutants tore me up. Pretty bad, too. I almost spilled my guts crawling back.
But our doc here brought me back from the dead. Patched me up real good. Now I don’t even have a half-decent scar to show for it. He's a gem!
Still... after that, I decided I was done. No more running around.
Komisarov has really been helping me deal with this mess we’ve gotten ourselves into. He’s a nice guy. Always stays positive. It’s pretty inspiring.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_gera_0_Meet: So, the Treaty’s over. That’s a bitter pill... I need some vodka to wash it down with. You in?
Hey, a new face! That’s always good. Welcome to The Roadside. First drink’s on the house. But all the rest, you gotta pay for.
Name’s Hera. I'm here if you need a drinking buddy. And if you don’t mind listening, I can spin you a few yarns.
How do you like my joint? I remodeled it myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_gera_0_Trad: I save all the good stuff for my boys, so don’t get your hopes up.
If you really like something, I might give you a discount.
Are you looking to buy or sell?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_marsal_0_Bu: Got nothing else to do, eh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_marsal_0_By: Beat it while you still can.
If you need anything, stop by.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_marsal_0_He: I heard you’ve been busy, Skif. Good for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_marsal_0_In: Duty ain’t what it used to be. No more raids, no solo hunting allowed. I didn’t join up to waste my time on patrols! I’m a hunter!
My only hope is the Ward. Maybe one day they’ll finally clear out the whole Zone. It’s long overdue.
To tell you the truth, I might be leaving soon. I came here to fight the Zone, not shoot stalkers. Maybe I’ll take up hunting, I dunno.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_marsal_0_Me: I don't think I’ll live long enough to see the Zone cleared out. It’s too bad, but it doesn’t really change anything for me.
And, as always, I’m ready to take you wherever you want.
Well, hello, stalker. I’m Jager. You might have heard of me. I can guide you through the most dangerous routes. If you’re up for it, of course.
I can handle myself all right. You wouldn’t believe how many mutants I’ve killed. More than anyone in Duty! No, really. If you don’t believe me, ask the boys, they’ll tell ya!
Okay, how about we show the Zone who’s boss?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_marsal_0_Tr: Tell me where you need to go.
You’re badass. I’m sure you can handle a shortcut.
I can’t guarantee your safety, but I can promise you some fun. So, where to?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_praporsik_k: Well, you screwed things up all right… What do you need now?
What are you looking for, soldier? Maybe I can give you some advice.
I might just be a cog in a huge machine, but I’ve got Duty and the Ward watching my back. We will destroy the Zone. It’s just a matter of time.
Our general is smart. Always thinking ten steps ahead. No enemy will be able to stand against us now.
Everyone should just follow orders, and the commanding officers will take care of the rest. We all need to do our duty, and then everything is gonna be just fine.
My orders haven't changed, so you know the drill.
Name’s Komisarov. Quartermaster. Authorized to trade on behalf of Duty.
There have been some disruptions in our supply chain, so not much to choose from. But if you really need something, I might be able to get it. I know how the system works.
Do you know what you're looking for?
I haven’t been ordered to ban you from the warehouse, so you can have a look.
Okay, you don’t need to bother with the papers.
I run a tight ship here. If you want to get something, you have to fill out all the paperwork.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_rad_molotov: So you want to join Duty, loner?
Zulu knows what he’s talking about. Duty has to take action. If we don’t, who will? But then, he was also the one who lost his whole squad in the field last time. Hmm...
I heard Freedom attacked our patrol, point blank, just like that! They definitely started it.
I wish Voronin never gave up Rostok. Now those Freedom bastards are all nice and warm in there, and we’re freezing our balls off in this concrete box.
Can’t wait to go on patrol... I feel like I’m gonna turn all gray and cold, like this damn concrete. I want to go outside, see the faded grass and the blue sky...
Fucking allergies. I can barely breathe.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_serz_bykovn: I’m not in the mood to chat.
Our doctor's been frequenting the bar lately... I mean, no wonder. If I was getting free drinks, I’d never leave the place either!
Freedom were the ones who broke the Treaty. Those sons of bitches ambushed us, stabbed us in the back! We'll make them pay.
This shit wouldn't be happening if Krylov was still in charge.
Why are we sitting on our asses? When was our last decent mutant raid?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_ConcretePlant_Hub_serzant_hma: I’d kill you here and now, and that’d be the right thing to do. But I follow regulations.
Don’t think you can gain my trust by helping Duty out a couple of times.
Voronin might be an asshole, but our boys here are even worse. Half of them go shopping with Freedom now.
They’ve got no values. Duty means nothing to them.
Why are you asking? Maybe it’s none of your damn business.
To hell with the Treaty! Good riddance. Now we can finally remember who our real enemy is.
I know your kind. You loners think you’re free to plunder any place in the Zone like you own it all.
And Voronin is a spineless little bitch for allowing it.
All right. What do you want?
I’ll make sure it doesn’t fall apart. That’s all I can promise you.
Took this from a stiff, I guess?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC00_ItemHunt_Audiolog_III_m: The can of worms I opened, stalker… Now they will never get off my back.
Remember when I said I came here for the truth? Scratch that. I was chasing a hot scoop. It is true what they say: be careful what you wish for - the Zone can hear everything.
I'm going back to the Mainland, hoping to publish everything I've uncovered. It's the only way this information won't become a weapon in the wrong hands.
As for you, remember: do not trust anyone. Even those who say they are on your side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC00_ItemHunt_Audiolog_II_ma: Hello, stalker. I'm afraid we can't communicate directly. They're tracing my calls, which means they're watching me again.
My investigation has become a real pain in the neck for both my old enemies and former allies. But, since I rose from the dead, these trifles seldom bother me. Or you, I hope.
Our meeting will have to wait for now. I can only hope my stashes have made your journey a bit easier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC00_ItemHunt_Audiolog_IV_ma: My escape failed. They won't let me out of the Zone. And there is no place on Earth where I can be safe anyway.
Your story is a perfect example: it disappeared from every archive outside the Perimeter.
Maybe, it is a good thing I'm at the center of all these events. I have another way of communicating with the Mainland.
If you, like me, are not willing to give up, just like me, head over to Prypiat. The door code is 2021, you don't have to knock.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC00_ItemHunt_Audiolog_I_mai: Hello, stalker! I'll keep it brief: I know who you are, and I can guess why you came here. My occupational hazard — always reading the news from the Mainland and making acquaintances that might prove useful.
Once upon a time, I came to the Zone to find the truth, too. So, I want to help you.

I will transfer to you the coordinates for my stashes. There, you will find the things and information I managed to gather over the years. The dead have no use for it, and I've been dead for a while, according to my paperwork.
I hope we will meet soon. And as for my stuff, it’s nothing compared to all I’ve received from the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_03_QD_AboutReco: I've found a recorder with some tracks. Must be yours.
I like recording things. This is a way to learn.
You know the problem with most people here? They don't listen. They don't understand what the Zone wants to tell them. They jam the frequencies with their noise.
What you brought me is priceless. But to you, like to all stalkers, everything has a price. Hence, take this. And please leave, let me listen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ArenaAnnouncer_LI_PanMa: Heavy clouds are gathering over the stalker, but can his reputation get any more soggy?
Stalker, where in the blazes are you headed? Get yourself together now!
Hey, young eagle! It's time to show them the pecking order!
How unfortunate…
Come on, stalker, kick their asses already – before I start thinking you've got one for a head!
Come to your senses, chap! You do realize you can fight back, right?
Please accept our sincere congratulations on this important step towards victory.
Just you look at this stalker climbing the leaderboard!
What an inglorious end to a once glorious nemesis…
My, my! Our stalker's only been here for a red-hot minute, and yet he's already made some new friends. Do come back, my good lads, we'll be waiting!
Look at that! The newbie sure knows how to put the screws on them! While they're frolicking in the mud, here he is, basking in his glory! What a champ!
Greetings, my dearest of friends, on this jolly occasion of our gathering! And welcome to the newcomer! What a veritable thrill it is to see you here, stalker!
Looks like that dog tried to bite off more stalker steak than it could chew! They gnawed, they tore, they crushed, but it was tougher than they thought and they broke their teeth!
We've all seen what a blind dog in a meat market looks like, but what about a psi-dog? Today, we have both to compare, and you, my chum, are the meat.
As the saying goes, beware of the green-eyed monster! But here in the Zone, we're wary of all kinds of monsters! And furious stalkers, like this one! Make some noise for our hero!

Ha! You know how sweet can turn sour on a dime? Well, the opposite is also true! The lads have made peace, and that's good – one less drama in the Zone, and one more reason to knock back a glass at the bar.
There never was a story of more woe, than this of a stalker and his foe. And when he risks his life for you, a round of applause is surely due!
Tough luck, stalker, for on today's menu we've only got one item – a knuckle sandwich! Some boys think your success in the Arena has gone to your head, and they're here to help tenderize it!

Ladies and gentlemen! A true drama is unfolding upon the grounds of our Coliseum today. A once-bright brotherhood has been eclipsed by a darker lust for victory, and these former comrades are ready to clash to the death!
What an unwelcome surprise! Especially, for Lady Chimera!
So the devil proved to be not as black as it's painted, eh, stalker? No need to answer right away, go get some rest first and catch your breath. You can't say he hasn't earned it!
Hey, Mr. Stalker! We’ve an extraordinary 'commission' for one peculiar creature. I hear you’re are a true professional in such matters, so do us a favor, if you please!

Does this turn of events surprise anyone here at all? Unquestionably, this is unworthy of the sporting spirit! But will anyone dare to disqualify this gentleman? Certainly not I! So, we shall keep watching!

This is a triumph! Stalker, son, you did it! I remember when you stepped onto this Arena as a shabby little chap, and now you leave it a glowing legend who's larger than life! My most sincere congratulations, fellow Master!

We are all beyond excited for this very moment – the battle for the title of the new Arena champion! This is a story you will tell your children, your grandchildren, and each other at every celebration! Let the Grand Final begin!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81382: What are you talking about? I don’t know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81386: Need everything spelled out. Where’s everyone? What's going on?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81389: As long as he's not Duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81392: They didn't stand a chance. Taken down first.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81394: It makes sense to kill the camp's best shots first, huh? From over here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81395: And for a full-scale assault op, bypassing the guards by sneaking in through the window from over there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81396: A few moments of coordinated effort, and everybody is dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81397: Not a single Freedomer survived, yet Mavka is safe and sound.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81398: How did that happen? How did it happen that while my men died you were walking about with a Duty member? And not just any Duty member, the Duty member.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81399: What were the two of you chatting about over tea, after the Arena?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81400: Did you really think I wouldn't know?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Main_81401: Whatever you believe isn't important now. The only thing that matters is finding whoever did this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81405: I can't tell who did this just by what's written here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81408: It's disappointing to see someone doesn't know that Freedom took Rostok from Duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81409:
It’s disappointing to see… such ungratefulness.
Freedom has given so much to the people of the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81410: Why aren't they willing to return the favor?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81420: Let's go, stalker. Time to get answers to all of our questions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81429: Do you call this peace, Voronin? Is this what peace looks like to you? My guys! They let your men in, shared their food, and what did they get in return?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81432: My sincere condolences. I'm sorry I had to pull my squad and we weren't able to protect your people. The Zone is dangerous, and we are dealing with that danger. But we can't save everyone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81433: How heroic! How convenient! Go on, tell me that a mutant wrote that on the wall!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81436: I'm ready to take full responsibility.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81441: Cute. Just like I said – Duty’s mutts can still bark without a command.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81446: Look, you wanted to see me. Here I am. I expected to see proof, but there isn't any.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81447: Fine, fine. Let's try this another way. According to Section 6, Paragraph B of the D4 Agreement.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81453: In case of suspicion regarding one of the parties attacking the other, the affected party has the right…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81459: …to secure and surveil a member of the suspected aggressor…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81467: That is my decision to make.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81468: Get in the chopper. That is an order.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81481: Do you understand what you're doing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_81482: Do you? Duty doesn't play around with people's lives.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_87348: Admit it, General. Duty is holding an old grudge. And no useless Ward papers could force Duty to obey your orders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_01_87352: Choice… is a privilege reserved for those who are free.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_02_81406: Duty could've been harboring resentment because of Rostok.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_02_81411: Resenting the Zone. Resenting everyone around them. Resentment is the only thing Duty runs on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_02_81412: If only they could find the strength to replace resentment with gratitude. Freedom has given something to everyone in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_02_81413: But instead of a "thank you", what do we get in return?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_02_81421: Let's go, stalker. Time to get answers to all of our questions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_02_81430: Do you call this peace, Voronin? Is this what peace looks like to you? My guys! They let your men in, shared their food, and what did they get in return?!

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_03_81407: I see where you're going, but it's too early to draw any conclusions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_03_81414: I'm not surprised you disagree, stalker. It takes one to know one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_03_81415: Honestly, it's upsetting to see the lack of gratitude. Freedom has gifted something to everyone in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_748_Out_03_81423: Let's go, stalker. Time to get answers to all of our questions.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_82995: Hope I don't get fried. Had to fuck about all 'round the Iron Forest, and now this wreck.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_82996: What's taking so freaking long, dimwit?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_82997: Less talking, Tokha. All these switches take fucking forever. The lights on now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_82999: Be quiet. Keep it down there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83002: You're the one yapping all the fucking time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83005: You don't have to threaten me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83006: We ain't got no allies. Just temporary clients. Eyes on the prize, scientist.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83019: I asked you not to call me that. I gave up science a long time ago.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83020: And yet, muttering just like one of them eggheads. Maybe I should put a slug in your knee, hmm? Help you work faster, you know?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83021: Do you think that will help?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83025: It did not. You should thank me for everything I’ve been digging up for you – Bubble entry points, electronic archive decoder.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83026: I warned you from the start that I need at least a week, no less, to get all the data…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83030: Can't you see I'm doing everything I can? You're a rational man…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83031: Find a way to work faster yourself. We don't have a week.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_83040: I'm coming! Please, just don't be so loud.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_84866: You're not deaf, are you? Quite the opposite, actually. Are you sure that thing didn’t damage your brain too?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_84870: One more time, there is no suffering in the grave.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_87374: And Freedom is the last ally you mercenaries have left in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_87375: After you killed those Freedom guys in the Iron Forest, it's clear what you're capable of.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_749_Main_87376: Or Karma will make you find it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Extra_79961: ... whichever way we, go we always end up in the same exact spot. I still can't get used to this fog... It's weird... That Chepurny disappeared, without a trace. Strange. Maybe he found a way out?...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Extra_79963: Day six, we have run out of water... The Colonel flipped his lid, shot two people at point blank range, and then himself... Now I'm on my own in this damn anomaly...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Extra_79964: If I hadn't fixed for our communications with HQ to go down. They could have rescued us. Retirement, country house, fishing — and Duty wouldn't have existed. I wonder how things would have turned out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Extra_79965: Ah, screw it. That Captain Tachenko died a long time ago…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Extra_79967: And this General Tachenko of Duty will follow him...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79916: And this General Tachenko of Duty will follow him...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79919: One more step and I'll shoot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79921: Zakharchuk? No… Chepurny? Which one of you is it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79923: Identify yourself, soldier! Who are you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79924: You all changed so much after all these years.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79925: I'm not one of your men.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79927: Do you know how many times I've imagined this moment?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79928: When someone comes for it, and I can explain…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79929: And you don't even know what you came for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79930: You think it's just… a device?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79931: You think it's just a container?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79932: You think it's just… an artifact?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79937: How long do we have to stay here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79939: Destroy this damn thing, General! Or I'll do it myself!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79942: If you destroy it, you'll summon another Large Emission. Or something worse…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79943: Is that what you want? Are you ready for that?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79944: I don't want to die here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79947: All these years… Not in vain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79948: I knew Chekhov wouldn't let it go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79950: I came to stop the mercenaries.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79951: But who's going to stop you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79952: Someone must keep this damn thing locked up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79954: I won't let you drag THIS out there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_750_Main_79956: As long as it's here, the world is safe…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_BothRight_85612: You're both right. The Bubble was a nightmare, the Oasis was a miracle. Let's talk about it once we stop Nord.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_BothRight_85613: No. Let’s finish this conversation, here and now. And I'm warning you, Skif – if you're defending this creature, we are no longer on the same side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_BothRight_85614: Okay, let's finish this. Skif, you gotta choose. Either you're with me, or against me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Bubble_85609: Mavka, you weren't in the Bubble. It was a living nightmare.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Bubble_85610: I don't know what happened in the Bubble. But I do know that Lukash found a way to make this thing work properly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Bubble_85611: If you want to destroy it, you and I are no longer on the same side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_85597: You two distract them. I'll flank.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_85599: Mavka. Don't touch it. Back off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_85600: This is what we were looking for, Zulu! The thing that created an Oasis.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_85602: Whatever it is, it could've attacked us a dozen times already. But we're okay.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_85603: This is a mutant, Mavka. That damn thing killed General Tachenko. We need to destroy it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_85604: That damn thing, as you called it, healed you! Or did you forget about it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_87377: Hey, chill out! It won't hurt us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_87378: You Duty members are always assuming the worst.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_87379: Zulu, Chekhov was right. We can use this technology to make the world a better place. This is the key to freeing the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Main_PP_85593: Two by the door. Four by the rear wall, maybe more.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_MavkasBranch_856: Mavka's words make sense. Maybe, this is the way to change the world for the better.
I thought we'd stick together until the end. That we would stop the war.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_MavkasBranch_857: And now it seems we never could.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Oasis_85607: But the Oasis was a miracle, Zulu.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Oasis_85608: Skif, we've been through so much.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_Oasis_87382: But if you're going to side with this… this creature, we're gonna have to go our separate ways.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_751_ZulusBranch_8562: Out of our way, Mavka. Everyone who came close to this shit is dead.
When did you sign up for Duty?
Mavka, don't be stupid. Move away.
What for? You wanna show me how far you're willing to go for the idea of destroying everything?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82454: All good. Bulletproof glass: they barely scratched it. Listen up! The mercenaries, they found the way to...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82458: The mercenaries found the last spot with active samples. But they were too scared to enter. It’s no wonder: it’s...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82461: Suslov, Suslov. So how many samples are there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82462: It.. it’s hard to tell. It might be dozens. Or even hundreds.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82463: Hundreds? Wow! If each one creates an Oasis..
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82464: Fuck no! I will get rid of that fucking abomination!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82465: And how are you planning to get there alone?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82466: I will figure it out. I can take care of myself. Now back off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82467: Or what? You gonna kick the shit out of me, like you did with Shulha?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82470: Turn it on. Turn it on!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82471: But... but I disabled it! If I turn it on now, everyone in here dies.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_82480: You're a tough one, Skif. Doesn't matter. The Brain will do what it has to. And you will die.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Mavka_87387: Myklukha will back me up, but Voronin... You think he'll step in for you for the second time?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82427: All good. Bulletproof glass: they just scratched it. Listen up! The mercenaries found this…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82432: The mercenaries found the last spot with active samples. But they were too scared to enter, no wonder: it’s...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82435: Suslov, so how many are there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82436: It’s hard to tell. Might be dozens. Or even hundreds.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82437: Hundreds? If each one creates an Oasis…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82439: You stick your nose into that lab - you'll fucking regret it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82440: What, are you gonna kick the shit out of me, like you did with Shulha?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82444: How do we turn it on?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82445: But... but everyone in here will die. We won't make it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_752_Zulu_82450: You're a tough one, Skif. Doesn't matter. The Brain will do what it has to. And you will die.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82248: I’m not joking, Myklukha. Can’t you see you’re leading us nowhere?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82249: This nowhere isn’t so bad. See, I created a system of coupons, and now, everybody has them. And Freedom has them in abundance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82250: Myklukha, do you remember? We wanted to bring the world freedom. Freedom, not coupons!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82251: I was part of the roots, and I know the price of freedom. I'm paying for it. I'm paying for it with money.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82306: Tell me, what is it you’re trying to sell me, hm?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82309: Oh, well if you know better, then please, act on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82310: Open the passage to the Monorail…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82311: Ahhh, there we have it, that's the true goal, isn’t it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82312: Is that the one place you and your Duty friend haven't stuck your noses into yet?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82313: And let me remind you – that we are still in the middle of a war with Duty!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82315: My work with Zulu is in the past. He thought he could stop us from freeing the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82317: This is your personal war. Nobody’s going to fight it by your side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82318: And who's gonna stay by your side…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82319: Who’s gonna stay when they find out that Myklukha’s responsible for the death of our people? Including Lukash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82320: And let me remind you – we're in the middle of war with Duty!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82322: You’ve missed performing in the Arena, huh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82324: What you’ve got going on there isn't my business. Not for many years now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82325: So what is your business, huh? Counting coupons? If you don't do something, the mercenaries might attack our people! Our Freedom!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82326: Chekhov? Chekhov couldn’t care less about the death of Lukash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_82328: Take him out! Or it's all for nothing…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_84267: My people. My Freedom. The one that doesn't buy your fairy tales anymore. And it will stay this way even of someone has to die. We're done.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_84882: (laughs) You were always so good at entertaining, I’ll grant you that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_87389: Isn’t it high time for our faction to go back to our roots?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_87390: I've seen them heal. I know how to create those miracles. Even outside the Zone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_87391: Recently you’ve been helping him more than you have your own faction.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_87393: Who’s going to stay by your side when they find out about your 'personal' stash at the Monorail?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_753_Main_87394: Who's gonna stay, knowing that he values coupons more than anything? More than Freedom?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82252: Nice one, stalker! We sure needed your help there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82253: You bring the slugs, we take care of the R&R!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82257: Cut the crap! A stalker? Where's our guy?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82262: Hey people, we got ourselves a guest here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82265: How did it go this time?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82266: Need more people from now on. This stalker helped us out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82267: As if Duty wasn't enough, right? What the fuck you're looking at?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82268: Don't be mad. It's not all rainbows and roses here. Loads of mutants around, and the signal's down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82269: Chillax! Drop the Mavka talk already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82270: Cut the boy some slack. Let him play with us instead!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82272: You got the cage all fixed up yet?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82273: It’s all good. Nuthin' to fix.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82274: There is. But I'm not gonna argue with you. Not now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82275: I'll make sure it's fixed. Don't want any extra work later on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82276: Got stuffy in here, didn’t it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82277: Thanks, Lieutenant. I’m glad someone digs what I'm saying. How's Zulu?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82278: The wound isn't serious, but I gave him a sedative. He needs to rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82281: Fuck me sideways, Zulu! You sure ruined some sweet game for me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_82282: Right, then. Got a job for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_84854: C'mon, Lieutenant, he said our soldier is all right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_84856: Alright... how many of them left here...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_754_Main_87397: Nitro and Mavka went out to fix it, but…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_NotOk_83564: You need to slow down. Or things could get ugly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_NotOk_83565: You're right, Skif. I can't allow myself to lose control. Not anymore.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_NotOk_83566: He understood all of it. And I was angry, like a fool. I thought Voronin was dragging his feet, having second thoughts...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_NotOk_83567: I'll get it right this time, Skif. We can't have any more meaningless sacrifices. Voronin knew what he was doing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_NotOk_87400: When he really saw the price we would have to pay.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Ok_83561: He understood all of it. And I was angry, like a fool. I thought Voronin was dragging his feet, having second thoughts...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Ok_83562: I'll get it right this time, Skif. We can't have any more meaningless sacrifices. Voronin knew what he was doing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Ok_87399: When he really saw the price we would have to pay.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Start_83541: Stop. I will handle it! Deal with the controller!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Start_83546: Who am I? Who am I?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Start_83548: It's a shame we didn't meet earlier. Maybe it would've turned out differently.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Start_83552: We need to detach the car!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_755_Start_86092: Almost everyone is on board, General.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_GoodJob_82973: In one piece. We did a good job.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_GoodJob_82975: Don’t think that I don’t feel sorry for the ones who didn’t make it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_GoodJob_82976: There’s no other way to change things, Skif.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_GoodJob_87402: But they gave their lives for something bigger. For what’s right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_HighPrice_82979: I was there, Skif. I saw it all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_HighPrice_82980: But they gave their lives for something bigger. For what’s right. Those who are with me will understand.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_HighPrice_82981: And there’s no other way to change things, Skif.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_756_Start_82966: What the hell are you doing?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84281: Yeah. It’s healed. Degtyarev told me about it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84282: No way! An Oasis?! The Oasis? I’ve heard some tall tales about it, but I always thought it was too good to be true.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84287: And You were right. We are in the Zone. Miracles aren't real.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84291: Oh my God — who did this to you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84292: Hold on… I'm going to figure something out. Stay with me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84296: Don't move, don’t move. Hold on, don't move…don’t move…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84322: No. No! Lukash, Lukash. No! Stay with me! Lukash. Lukash. Please, Lukash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84323: They can feel… what you want more than anything. Find them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_757_Main_84329: If this is what I think it is…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84131: The Zone gives everyone what they're looking for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84136: What you desire. Behind the smokescreen of slogans. What's real.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84141: To discover the price of Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84142:
Sleep, my little birdie, 
Sleep, my throbbing heart…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84143:
Your eyes are closing
But the skies don’t cry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84144:
Winds of freedom
Dry up the tears,
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84145:
In the realms of hope,
There’s no place for pain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84146:
You will live on
In the petals of heaven,
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_758_1_84147:
Your cage will wither,
Off you fly to the final frontier…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_872_1_83218: So many dead because of these… bastards. These illusions cost us too much.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_872_1_83219: Mavka wanted to make use of the Zone's miracles. But the Zone has no miracles…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_872_1_83220: Tachenko and Voronin were right all along. There can be no compromises in this war.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_872_1_83221: We are the ones standing between the Zone's plague of filth and ordinary people. And while I'm Duty's general, it will stay that way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_872_1_87126: Do you remember, Zulu, how we wanted to change the world?..
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CD_872_1_87412: Even our dreams… have turned into nightmares.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_AL_ZulusA: I ran into a new creature of the Zone and barely got away with my head still attached.
It looked like a man, but was much stronger and more dangerous in close combat. Seemed like it hardly felt any pain. Didn't have any instinct for self-preservation, nothing resembling fear, either.
It was near-impossible to kill with any attack, but the modules on its back looked like a vulnerability. I thought they were like its energy centers, so I tried to disable them. And here I am.
If you run into one, the key to defeating it is patience and observation. Most importantly, you should get behind it. If you're not sure you can, you'd better just run.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_DLC01_kap: We'll definitely get back to this.
Who are you? I haven't seen you in the ranks of Duty before.
Captain Varchuk, operational planning officer. I am responsible for Duty's tactics: sabotage, offense, defense.
Even among our own, few people know who I am or what I do. Professional necesity, you know.
Did you take part in the assault on the CNPP?
I am the one who planned that assault in detail. Here you can see the results of my work.
After we took over the CNPP, Duty personnel got complacent. But holding this place might be just as hard as taking it.
Large windows on all sides, many entrances and exits, weak walls, and a decrepit ceiling.
I'm trying to get this message across to Zulu—so far, to no avail. We'll see what he says when someone more serious than a bunch of anarchists pays a visit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_DLC01_maj: Everybody keeps saying I wag my tongue too much! How can I not wag it if everyone in the Zone has enough stories to fill a book!
Ask anyone what's new, and they'll tell you such a tall tale that hiding it from your mates is just unfair.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_DLC01_rad: Zulu is one of the guys who likes doing all the work themselves. Too bad, as I'd help him with anything. Gladly. He's a good man.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_DLC01_ser: Everyone's so smart in Duty, but they never learned to give orders properly. They just gave me a new guy and told me to deal with him.
So I dealt with him. I gave him weekly rations, a new uniform, and equipment. Turns out the asshole left his post, and I was supposed to come up with a punishment.
Now I'm on reduced rations for failing to follow orders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_LI_HubOpe: All posts! We established a steady supply for the Duty unit at the CNPP.
We had to clear the route to the center of the Zone. Be careful: anyone can get in here now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_LI_PropTo: All posts: rotation in 15 minutes.
Patrol team: report to me upon arrival.
Reminder: if you experience dizziness, headaches, or vision problems, report to the doctor immediately!
Everyone who joins Duty will be a shield between the horrors of the Zone and the rest of humanity.
We've won the battle with Freedom! That means we're closer to a victory over the whole Zone.
We're the only ones protecting people in the Mainland from the Zone. Nobody else. We cannot let them down.
The Zone must disappear. We won't let mutants and anomalies fill the streets of our cities!
Duty will defeat the Zone, and anyone who stands in our way!
Only in Duty will you find like-minded people prepared to do anything to protect people from mutants and anomalies!
All posts: rotation in 15 minutes.
All food that's found and unaccounted for must be handed over to the duty officer.
Alpha recon post, report to the post for rotation.
Security post three asking the food officer to make contact immediately.
All posts: rotation on schedule only.
Patrol team: report to me upon arrival.
Attention everyone: the water from the station heating system is unfit for drinking.
If you experience severe vertigo or an acute headache, visit a doctor immediately. Do not try to deal with the symptoms on your own.
Attention: upon discovery of a strong radioactive emission source, report to your superior officer.
Being near the reactor section without an order from Command is strictly prohibited.
Duty officers must check the door seals in control zones according to schedule.
If you discover ammunition with no inventory number, report it to the duty officer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_LO_zulus_: The Emission is over. Everyone return to their posts!
Warning! Emission ongoing. Stay in cover!
There's an Emission coming. Take cover!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_CantWa: I hope we're not gonna grow roots in these barracks. I'm ready to go as far as the Sarcophagus without stopping, using just my bare hands.
Soon, Private, soon. Command gets it now – either we advance, or the Zone eats us up.
We'll show them all soon! We'll burn the ulcer out!
We won't show them, Private. We'll do what Command tells us to do. Better check your medkit again, you're gonna need it soon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_bulba_: I can't believe Voronin is no longer with us. What are we gonna do without a general now?
Sergeant Bulba, Zulu is your general now.
Remind me how long he's been a general? And what experience does he have as one?
What experience did you have as a sergeant before you became one? Quit talking nonsense!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_grazev: What a place to die. How do we get him out now?
Maybe we shouldn't. Let him stay there.
But he's gonna start stinking tomorrow.
Yeah, true. I wish someone helped us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_hospit: Don't worry. When I can get up, they'll all be dead.
Don't hold back, Vezha. Gimme some more painkillers!
I need water. Huh? Mom? The anomaly showed you to me. Yes, I'm okay. And you…
Who's there? I can't see anything, it's dark.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_kolesn: Dunno, Major Remizenko is looking at me weird. Maybe I really am a bit dumb?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_langus: Nobody's gonna just run into this anomaly anymore now.
We should've done it long ago. So many people would have been saved.
I'm warning you. Don't open this door.
Yes, it's for your own good, loner. There are doors you're better off not opening.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_remize: Why are there suddenly so many dumbasses around?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_stebli: Without Freedom, even the sun is shining brighter.
I'm so sleepy, I just can't.
Why do I have this heavy feeling?
It's tough. We're in deep shit, Lieutenant!
It's Freedom who are in deep shit. We're still in the saddle, even if the horse is half-dead, so cut the sulking, Private.
You're overthinking it. Putting all your hatred into the shot. You need cold calculation instead.
But… It's them, Lieutenant. Freedom. We've lost so many comrades here because of their mess. My finger squeezes the trigger on its own.
Hatred is for anarchists. They have the emotions, we have the purpose. Got it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_vira_0: How could you leave us like that, General?
Zulu is a great guy. But we'll see what kind of commander he is.
Things are looking up for Duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QC_zincen: I keep hearing the squeaking of gerbils. Nothing good can come of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_azot_0: I need to focus.
Farewell forever, I hope.
Hope to see you again!
Take care, man.
You again.
Look who's here!
Glad to see you, loner.
Duty is stuck here with no connection to the outside world at all. The lack of news will make you go off the rails, no psi-radiation needed.
Good thing I didn't just sit around in the Iron Forest twiddling my thumbs. I watched Chief make a radio and learned how to do it. At least we're gonna have some contact with the rest of the Zone.
I wanna give an example to the local kids – even if you're an old dog, you should still learn new tricks.
They brought me a crate of condensed milk the other day. Said the anomaly detector I built with my own hands saved the lives of a whole squad.
You won't find this much condensed milk in the entire Zone, let alone the CNPP. You know, this is the first time I've felt really accepted somewhere.
In that case, maybe it's about time to officially join Duty? I should really think about it.
You're a strange man. You're a loner, you don't owe anyone anything, but you insist on heading straight into hell.
I have my own reasons to be putting myself in harm's way out here. I couldn't abandon Zulu, so I followed him.
I think your reasons are about the same, but be careful. The Zone eats guys like us for lunch, and swallows us without chewing.
You've done a lot of good for Duty. You were with us till the end.
If there were more people like you in Zulu's crew than people like Mavka, we wouldn't have to worry about Duty.
Voronin knew how to select the right crew. Seems like now Zulu has also learned that skill.
What now?
Ah, the loner! What do you want?
Look what I got.
What more do you want?
Whatever you ask, we'll do a top-notch job.
I got this. Nobody's ever left this place unsatisfied.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_bortni: Maybe I should become a doctor? Save people in battle.
While I was in the infirmary, Duty's settled down at the CNPP. It's quite a place, but I can't complain. With people like Vezha, we'll do just fine wherever we are.
He's dug a pound of lead out of me. Too bad he was alone and couldn't help Rylko, Shuba, or Pechenyi.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_gorcak: When I was joining Duty, I didn't believe in anything. At the recruitment point, they asked me what I thought about the Zone.
And I was like, "If I'm getting paid, issued ammo, and fed, then I think whatever I'm ordered to think. If not, I don't care."
At first they didn't wanna accept me with these answers, but then they saw my marksmanship and changed their minds.
Then Vezha dragged me across the entire Zone on his own back. Wounded. That’s when I realized I was among decent people doing the right thing.
Name's Horchak. My orders are to pour vodka at the bar. Don't get me wrong, I haven't been in the Zone for long, but I know how to hold both a bottle and a rifle.
It's just a pity that I've started seeing double after the damn anomaly. I'm not much of a fighter right now, so the command sent me to the bar.
But it doesn't matter to me if I'm using a bottle or a rifle to help. I'll do anything Zulu orders.
I was just about to say something.
Nothing’s too good for a good person.
I have lots to offer you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_grazev: If not for you, we'd have had to summon the whole Duty crew to dig him outta there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_gurza_: Go away, I'm busy.
All right, bye.
You should stop by sometime!
Uh-huh, I'll see you around.
Don't touch anything until you pay.
Only the best for you.
You again.
Freedom is nothing but a name. There's no freedom there at all – they kicked me out just 'cause I had a falling-out with Myklukha.
The mutants were interfering with deliveries to Rostok, and Myklukha refused to deal with it. I got so mad about it that I confronted him. He forced me out. I had to leave Freedom.

But an experienced trader is a valuable resource in the Zone. Duty took me in right away. Although I know I'll never be fully accepted here, as they'll forever see me as a defector and look at me with suspicion.
Whatever they say about Freedom around here, they're at least much better than us at strumming the strings.
Discipline is all well and good, but it's hard for a person to live in a place like this without proper music.
Of course, I support Duty with all my heart, but I'd gladly give up my rifle for a good guitar.
Lots of people here hate Freedom 'cause they think they should. But I hate them as a former Freedomer. I know what I'm talking about.
I think that gang should've been renamed Freedom LLC long ago. It's whole point is just making dough.
There's no idea, no mission, and they only care about profit. I can't deal with people like that. No wonder they're losing to Duty now.
Somehow, I can't share in everyone's joy. I don't see Freedom as my mortal enemy, and I'm not fully accepted in Duty either.
The only thing I feel is regret that so many people died for our mission. I hope it was worth it.
What do you want?
There's my best customer!
You won't find better around here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_lyzna_: Stop fussing. You're making me dizzy.
My whole family is here in the ground. For you it's the Zone, but for me, it's home.
I used to run around these woods as a little kid, gathering mushrooms and berries… And now I'm watching this pestilence spread and ruin everything.
No matter! Now Duty is in charge here, maybe they'll be able to clear it all out, and I'll see my village as it used to be – without creatures or anomalies.
Don't mind my old age, I'm gonna outlive everyone here. Name's Mykola Vasyliovych, but everyone calls me Skier.
I'm telling you right now, it's not gonna be an Olympic victory, but we'll get there fast and via the shortest route.
You know how many miles I've run around my village here when I was young? You couldn't even dream of it!
But when I found out about Duty, I came back from the Mainland to my native lands. I wanna fight the Zone and show you slackers around.
My memory's not what it used to be… What was I talking about?
Tell me where we're going, my good man.
I hope you've warmed up. Where are we going?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_remize: Now it's cozier with the flag. Almost like home.
It's not good, taking gear from dead bodies. It's a bad sign.
Getting killed with an empty magazine is a bad sign. So go on, take the ammo and get out. Cross yourself after every shot if you need to, that's not my problem.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_stebli: I joined Duty when the Freedomers shot my friend for nothing.
His name was Tolyk Rugged, and he wouldn't hurt a fly. He did like to nick other people's loot, though, but that's no reason to kill someone.
No matter. I've paid them back in full. Now I can sleep at night.
I've come to Duty to get revenge on Freedom for my friend Kolya Rugged.
If I got a patch for every kill, I'd have to stick them to my forehead by now.
But you know, loner, I thought it'd get easier. It did at first, but then it only got worse. The fucking insomnia's back.
Wait, I've lost my train of thought.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_veza_0: I do need occasional rest, like everyone else.
If that's it, get lost.
If anything hurts, come to me right away.
Come back whenever you need.
What's bothering you?
You're the healthiest of us all. You don't need a doctor.
What now?
There's my patient.
What's ailing you?
The fucking anomaly turned a bunch of people into zombies. It's too soon to talk about victory while we're treating them with a bullet to the head.
So take care of yourself, use psi-blocks, be cautious, and keep your head down.
I don't wanna have to treat you with the standard Duty protocol.
When Voronin died, I thought Zulu was gonna throw out all the old regulations and launch a crusade against the Zone.
He seemed belligerent and hot-tempered. But then I realized I was wrong about Zulu.
Seems like he inherited more than just authority from Voronin – he got the wisdom and restraint, too. That's good news for everyone in the Zone.
I got hit hard in the assault. I can barely walk now.
Needless to say, there's no casualty evacuation during raids. I'm gathering dust here, and trying to come to terms with the role of an indoor doctor.
So try not to get yourselves into another meat grinder until I find myself a replacement.
How's the Zone, loner? Been working day and night here, and can barely look up lately.
I've taken up teaching the youngsters medicine. I hope Duty's gonna get new doctors soon. Preferably, young and healthy ones.
Choose quickly.
The freshest stuff for you! Barely expired.
I'll share whatever I can.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_vira_0: General Voronin was the man. He cared about people, and appointed a medic for each squad.
But Zulu? He's cocky, hot-headed, and gonna fight every bush here. I'm afraid we're not going far with him.
I've been badmouthing Zulu, but then I took a closer look. Now I'm ashamed.
Can you imagine that he's got this idea to train a whole brigade of medics to help Vezha?
Better late than never. I hope it's gonna help avoid such massive casualties in the future.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Duty_QD_zulus_: Wait a second.
Off with you.
It's nice to talk to a good man.
See you around.
What?
What can I do for you?
I'm listening.
Stand ready at all posts! Enemy in the perimeter.
What can you tell me about this place?
As Voronin said, we're in the heart of the Zone right now. And there'll be a time when we make that heart stop beating.
The Zone knows everything, it's kicking and fighting to survive. Lots of good people have fallen here.
What can you tell me about this place?
This place is the root of all evil in the Zone. So it's here that we should eradicate that evil.
No matter how hard it is here, we're not leaving until we complete our mission.
If Freedom had a reasonable leader, we wouldn't have won this battle. They fought well and gave us a hard time.
I actually feel sorry for them – they've died for a false idea. Mavka just left them to die, like us in X16.
Now I really get how Voronin felt. Being responsible for people's lives is not easy.
I'm doing what I can, trying to keep people out of the line of fire. Experience will come with time, I hope.
It was tough for my fighters. First the Monorail and Voronin's death, then the battle with Freedom. Now this place in the middle of nowhere with no proper supplies.
Everyone's tired, and they want a break. I've ordered them to set up a camp. Let them catch their breath and lick their wounds.
But you and I have no time to rest: we must stop Mavka before she turns the whole world into the Zone.
I wish Mavka stayed alive, but the Zone does as it pleases. It couldn't care less about our wishes.
That's why we're fighting it, and we're not planning to back down. Even if we have to live next to an anomaly that turns your brains to mush.
I think I've messed up. Can we make a deal?
I know how that goes. But we must all pay for our mistakes.
