Your contribution will help other fighters survive in the Zone. What do you say?
As you wish, Skif… Come back if you change your mind.
Sorry, not today.
Fair enough. Here.
You should start learning from your mistakes. Deal?
I'm not done talking.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_DLC01_: Freedom knows how to fight, no doubt about it. Too bad we find it so challenging to organize our daily life.
Everyone's their own man, they sleep wherever they want, eat wherever they want, and throw garbage out wherever they feel like.
With this approach, it'll be a while before we can turn this place into a cozy home.
Yeah, and I wanted to say something else.
There's loot up to your neck in the Zone, but I don't feel like chasing it anymore. I can get a nice pile of it, and then what? I can't take it to my grave!
You just need to stare at the Flare for a few seconds to lose your mind. I looked at it for no more than a second and I'm twice as dumb as I used to be.
So what was I on about?
Find a free and lonely path!
I just can't figure out one mystery of the Zone – why has Duty set up camp at the Concrete Plant?
There are so many beautiful spots in the Zone, but those square-jaws just want more barracks. I feel sorry for those guys.
What was I about to say…
If it wasn't for me, Duty members would've crushed us. But I flanked them and hit them as hard as I could! It's called tactics.
Wait a minute, let me finish.
I like this place more and more every day. I think it's gonna be better than Rostok soon enough.
The most important thing in the Zone is never forget to sleep. That way, time flies by faster, and it's good for you! If I didn't sleep enough, I definitely wouldn't have survived this long.
All right, we've gone off track.
I wish I had an NVG. I'd be the coolest bloke in the Zone! There's no device more useful or important around here. Especially for those who can't just sit at the campfire all night.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_LI_Hub: Attention, amigos! The Zone should be accessible to anyone, so we cleared a couple of routes to the CNPP. Now, every brave enough stalker can get here.
But be careful, people can be… you know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_LI_Pro: Amigos, we've done it! Never before has the flag of Freedom risen this high.
But don't you dare to let your guard down – it's too soon to rest. The Zone won't forgive that.
Duty thought the Zone would fear their army discipline and marching. They were wrong, and they paid dearly for it.
Now, Duty is part of the scenery, and we're in the heart of the Zone.
There's been plenty of trouble and danger on our path. But look around, we're in the heart of the Zone now. And our trials have not all been just wounds and losses.
Here, we're standing firm so that one day the Mainland may know freedom.
You know, amigos, things aren't great with grub and ammo right now. But I assure you, it's temporary.
We've dealt with Duty, and we'll deal with this, too.
Many of our brothers in arms have sacrificed their lives for this victory. We need new people.
Invite your loner friends to join Freedom. There's a place for everyone here.
True, this isn't a spa resort. We're not hiding away from the Zone here. We live with it.
We face a lot, but all the challenges are the price of being free.
We've won, but not because we had more guns. We've won because we fought by the call of our hearts, not just by orders.
The Zone's center is ours. And we've lost so much to achieve it.
But the losses haven't been in vain because what we've discovered will save more people than we've lost.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_LO_dze: The Emission is over. You can relax.
Warning, an Emission is starting! My sympathies for anyone who hasn't reached cover.
An Emission is coming. I strongly recommend you get to the nearest shelter.
Attention everyone! We have an enemy here – or just a dumbass. We'll find out soon.
All clear, amigos! Go about your business.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_ari: I don't feel like getting any more loot, for some reason.
I'd love some vodka, ice-cold, to clear my throat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_ary: Where did this pile of rifles come from?
Left behind by Duty. Take one if you need it.
There's barely any ammo left anyway. At the CNPP, these rusty rifles with empty magazines aren't the most valuable assets.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_bir: Remember how I agreed to come here with you?
And do you remember why I agreed?
I don't remember either… But right now I definitely wouldn't agree.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_cap: Huh? What? Did anyone call me?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_dza: I could really go for some good tobacco right now.
I wonder if anyone's ever been here besides us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_gro: Where could I listen to some good music?
Should I go get some loot? Nah, I don't feel like it.
I'm fed up with seeing the same faces over and over.
We gave those Duty a real thrashing. I don't think they're gonna bother us anymore.
Have you been to the infirmary? Have you seen how many of our people were killed?
I have, but you and I aren't in the infirmary here. Isn't that something to be happy about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_kis: Damn, how did I end up with Freedom?
Should I check out the Oasis again?
What are we gonna do next?
My heart feels so light here!
I caught a picture from the Flare and now I can't sleep. Stupid thoughts running around in my head, tossing and turning all night.
There's nothing I can do about it. You'll have to cope for a while until your head settles on its own.
Maybe you could spare me some of that rubbing alcohol, Doc? It helps me better than any medicine.
Don't start that again, I'm not your bartender. Look for it somewhere else.
I've already found everything there is to find somewhere else.
How long can you stare at the Flare if you don't wanna turn into a zombie?
Nobody knows. And there are no volunteers to check it.
I could volunteer. I want to be of use to science.
Are you out of your mind?
I think it's trying to tell me something.
I'm also trying to tell you something – don't even think about it if you value your life. And don't come to me with any more ideas like that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_mik: So what are we gonna do next? I really don't understand.
Of all things, we had to end up…
Listen, bro, how long are we gonna last with these supplies?
We'll last a bit longer if we start saving now.
I'm not gonna survive long without three meals.
Don't worry, you'll get your three meals. Breakfast on Monday, lunch on Wednesday, and dinner on Friday.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_par: I wouldn't open that door if I were you, stalker. Just some friendly advice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_ruk: How long are we gonna stay here, I wonder?
I wonder what's gonna happen to Duty now.
It's a bit chilly here, ain't it?
But all right. Just a bit more patience and things will settle down.
Rich how? Do you even have anything in your pockets apart from bolts?
So we can't drink to being rich.
I'd rather drink to being rich.
How about this… Here's to the Zone!
No way. Let's think some more.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_ryb: I'll rip those Duty thugs apart with my bare hands.
Why are you all sitting around? Why don't we do something useful?
One, two, three… Nah, think I shot more of them.
If there's so much trouble with water, maybe we should just take it right from this channel?
You wanna drink water from a nuclear power plant? Are you fucknut?
Yes, it's radioactive, but only a little bit. The Geiger counter is almost silent, I've checked.
Throw your Geiger counter out if it's silent. You're welcome to drink it, but I'd rather die of thirst.
We'll see what you say when you really start dying of thirst.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QC_ska: I'm all right. I am, right?
We just need another push, and then everything will be okay.
I could sure use a proper bed, though.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_bir: I'm gonna show them all! I think.
What about me, huh? Hanging about, twiddling my thumbs.
Sure thing, I'm not gonna be a Zone Legend this way.
Zen is a solid guy. Respect!
Better not run into Bonespike. He doesn't like me. Shouldn't have stolen his pills and washed them down with vodka.
I thought the anomaly would've then had a harder time getting into my head. But it just flipped the pictures upside down.
You're a good marksman, loner. I saw how many enemies you took down during that clash with Duty.
I'm not like that. I just shot two or three, and even then it was practically an accident.
After all, Sleeve didn't drag me into this hellhole for nothing. If not for all of us, Duty would level the Zone to the ground.
I've realized something. Even if my contribution isn't the greatest, I've at least done something useful in my empty life.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_dze: Go away, I'm busy.
Leaving already? I hope I won't see you soon this time.
Hasta la vista, amigo. Don't be a stranger.
Hasta la vista. Or adieu. Who knows how life will turn out.
What do you want?
I'd hug you, but my back hurts. If Bonespike notices it, he's gonna treat me to death.
Hola! I hope you're bringing good news.
This place drains people dry. No wonder really, it's not at all like Rostok.
There isn't even a bar. And without a bar, all the dark stuff gets three times darker.
But as for me, I'd rather be without a bar and deal with mutants. At least mutants are created by the Zone, not by Myklukha's greed.
What can you tell me about this place?
I recently noticed people got kinder around here, the sun was shining brighter, and joy was in the air. What was it about, I thought?
And then I realized that it's because we've got a bar here now, and I'd had a few.
So if there's something weighing you down, loner, I suggest you drop in.
There are days when the Zone wakes up in a bad mood and wants to break your spine.
If not for you, amigo, this time it would have succeeded.
When Mavka left for the Mainland, Freedom got two equal camps – one at Rostok and one here at the CNPP.
Personally, I'm okay with this setup. You want a peaceful stalker life, go to Arnie's in Rostok.
If you wanna get to know the Zone, come here and stay with us. What's that if not the actual Freedom we fought for here?
I could probably have a sense of pride for becoming the boss of Freedom.
But now I just have a headache. Food, water, equipment, the injured – I'm the one who has to think about it all now.
I'm managing so far, as you see. Maybe it's not perfect, but I've been able to avoid panic. For now.
This place seemed unfit for life at first. At some point, I even thought people would rebel and return to Rostok.
But we eventually managed to settle down here and address our issues.
It's all thanks to people like you, Skif. Freedom would never have managed without your help.
Freedom has it in for me. Should we maybe make peace?
Maybe we should. Coupons can help you make amends to Freedom.
Are you ready to invest in friendship?
I agree. Here you go.
Don't mess with us anymore, all right?
Sorry, not today.
As you wish. If anything happens, I'm not gonna defend you.
So…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_gum: Hey, shanovnyi!
I've done my part. Now you do yours.
See you around! Kick their asses for the two of us!
I hope you'll be fine. Or at least okay.
Ah, loner.
Velmyshanovnyi loner!
Shanovnyi loner!
They say that dead Duty men rise from their graves at night and march in formation.
But few people know that dead mutants are better at marching than those Duty bastards!
Got it, huh? I came up with it myself.
Here's a story for you. Duty members found an Oasis and wanted to test it, so they decided to throw a sergeant with a nail in his heel into it.
Five seconds later, they check it again and see the nail is still there, but the sergeant has vanished. They're all like, "You bastard! What have you done with our sergeant?"
And the Oasis replies, "Oh, I thought you wanted to clean the crap off the nail." Got it? I came up with it myself.
I fix everything and write down the customers' responses.
And you know what I've realized? The ones that don't smile at me never return. They probably can't find their way back…
So even if you don't feel satisfied, smile just in case so I don't have to worry about you.
Making it here was your doing, but your survival is the technician's doing. You got your stuff fixed here, right? I'm a big deal here.
Traders always think they're more important. But you don't need a lot of brains to sell stuff, while fixing stuff is a science: this and that, bits and bobs.
So, stop by, and don't be a stranger. I'm happy to grab your coupons, and you're happy to leave them in good hands. Got it, yes?
Eh, I've lost my train of thought. Ah, found it!
What do you need?
I'd give up everything for free, but I can't!
Look what I got here.
You're lucky I'm not capable of doing a bad job.
I'm gonna fix it so good you'll die! I mean, the enemies will die.
I'm gonna fix it so good it will never need fixing again!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_kis: Shanovnyi, I fought tooth and nail to see some kind of miracle in the center of the Zone.
I saw it, and now I can't pull myself together. That huge anomaly… It was like it hit me on the head with a sledgehammer.
Be careful with it. I know you want to look at it, but don't give in.
I can't stop thinking about the Flare. I feel like it wants to tell me something.
I think I should try looking at it again. What if it all gets clearer this time?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_kol: Some vodka? My friend, this is the best the Zone has to offer!
What would you like to drink?
Pardon the organized chaos — this is my field laboratory.
I bartend, trade, and research my thesis all from here.
But I don't know how to mix cocktails, even though I'm called Flask. Still, you can buy the necessary ingredients and mix whatever you want inside.
Back on the Mainland, I was holed up in a lab, writing my thesis on anomalies. But you wanna know the issue with labs?
You view the world through secondhand reports and samples from lead-lined containers. That's like trying to understand a lion from one strand of its mane.
To really get the Zone, you gotta see it with your own eyes first—that's why I joined you guys coming in here.
All right, let's back up a bit…
Alright, let's see what I've got lying around here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_pet: Ugh, clear off.
Leave while you can.
See you around, stalker. Bonespike heals you better than any Oasis can.
Don't let the door hit you on the way out.
You won't die. Unfortunately.
You're all right, don't worry. You'll die healthy.
I'm gonna wrap you in the cleanest bandages!
All right, show me where it hurts.
So have they closed that Oasis of yours? What are you looking for here?
Bonespike's gonna examine you head to toe.
What, have you made holes in yourself again? Don't worry, I'll patch you up.
I feel like there should be a force in the Zone that doesn't just maim you but heals you, too.
And if we manage to tame this force, I'll be able to say that I haven't wasted my life.
Some doubted Mavka at first. But it turns out she's feisty – managed to win over everyone in Freedom.
I'm just concerned it's gonna be hard for her to keep everyone in check. Especially if she stays on the Mainland.
For a doctor who wants to help people instead of writing reports, Freedom is the best ally.
They have no paperwork, no red tape, no stupid meetings. Only you and your responsibility to the patients.
I wish it were like that on the Mainland…
Imagine if many Oases appear. We won't need hospitals anymore.
What are all the little inspectors and supervisors gonna do?
Oh, Mavka's gonna have it hard in the Mainland. There are a lot more enemies of Freedom there than it seems.
Go on, choose already. I've got work to do.
Only the finest for you, and not even expired. Well, almost.
I don't recommend self-medicating. But you're not gonna listen anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_ruk: Bro, I even gambled away my grandfather's watch at the Arena. What a fool!
No matter. I'll win everything back! I know what I'm doing.
I didn't even need an Oasis to cure my gambling addiction. I stumbled into Duty's booby trap, but the grenade didn't explode!
So I think I've already won my jackpot, bro.
I don't feel like wasting my life in the Arena anymore. I'd rather stay here. I feel like I've got a debt to pay to the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_skv: Hope to see you again soon, man.
Man, I wish you knew how happy I am to see you!
I'm a bit worried, man. What happens if Mavka doesn't return to the Zone soon?
Won't Duty decide to take their revenge if they think that Freedom is left without its "general" now?
Oh, I really don't feel like doing that fight all over again.
Man, I've been sneaking around abandoned and forbidden places since I was a kid. When I heard about the Zone, I knew right then and there it was my place.
But it turned out the Zone is nothing like the tales about it. One good thing at least – a dumbass like me was lucky enough to end up in Freedom.
They taught me everything and helped me fulfill my childhood dream: I'm a pioneer at the CNPP now. Anyways, enough with the talking. Where do you need to go?
To the ends of the earth with you, man.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_sus: We can talk later.
Hopefully we won't be seeing each other again.
Don't be a stranger. Come by when you can!
Come back if you need anything else.
What do you want?
Whoa, my favorite customer is back!
How can I help you, stalker?
I wonder why Duty members got into that teleport if it's against their code to use the Zone?
The answer is simple – a commander's orders are above any code for Duty. They get into anything they're ordered to.
Here's living proof of what happens to people who think they're above the law. Even the law they've come up with themselves.
The Zone isn't honoring its pioneers.
The center of the Zone is alive thanks to us, but nobody's even naming a street after Skif or Zen.
This place is not for people looking for glory. You can only find trouble here.
The pictures that the Flare flashes before your eyes send shivers down my spine. Who's transmitting them? What do they mean?
Maybe someone is afraid of something and trying to warn us? Or maybe they want to tell us something about themselves?
These questions sound like a thesis proposal. Who knows, maybe I'll start doing science again instead of sitting behind a counter.
It was safer to live and trade in Rostok. But when I met Mavka, I changed my views on life.
I realized you can gain nothing without risk, either in life or in science.
Living here is incredibly risky. But the opportunities are incredible, too.
So, where was I?
Don't touch the goods.
Skif, I'd give it all to you for free, but I do need coupons.
Best goods on offer for you, verified with my thoroughness.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_Freedom_QD_tis: I'm gonna become a Zone legend, and then I'll go back to the Mainland.
I don't feel like sitting around.
I'd manage Freedom as good as Zen, if not better.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_DLC01: Busy.
Get out already.
Come again.
I'm swamped, too.
Well, you screwed things up all right… What do you need now?
What are you looking for, soldier? Maybe I can give you some advice.
Speak up.
Tell me about the Concrete Plant.
My promotion is just about the only thing that's changed in the staff structure, but I'm still in charge of trade.
The rest of the personnel are the same: they can fix your gear, guide you wherever you need, and pour you a drink.
The prices depend on who your friends are.
A few soldiers are applying for transfers to the CNPP as they want to be closer to the action. To fight.
But the Concrete Plant still remains a strategically important facility, and we won't be concentrating all our forces in one location.
Warrant officer… Lieutenant Komisarov. Acting Chief of the Duty base at the Concrete Plant.
And it's a great honor for me to welcome you here. Zulu told me you helped our fighters at the CNPP. I wish he could be here.
He doesn't come here very often, but I try to keep it all under control since Zulu himself trusted me with this job.
The Emission is over. Everyone dismissed!
Stay in shelter until the Emission is over!
Attention! Emission incoming. Take cover, everyone!
We started off on the wrong foot. Can we make it right?
Your actions cost Duty dearly. So I expect compensation.
This time, we can settle for financial compensation. If there's a next time, we'll have to see.
I need to think about it.
Do that. Twice.
Here. I hope this helps.
Glad we could settle this.
I haven't been ordered to ban you from the warehouse, so you can have a look.
Okay, you don't need to bother with the papers.
I run a tight ship here. If you want to get something, you have to fill out all the paperwork.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_LI_Pr: We are now accepting new soldiers! You will be provided with both meals and weapons, and you will make friends you can trust in combat!
General Voronin gave up his life for the righteous ideals of Duty. We have to finish what he started!
Fulfill your duty, join your brothers in arms, and show the mutants what you're willing to do to protect humanity!
Duty will eliminate every mutant in the Zone! We won't let a single one of them cross the Zone's borders!
Duty is expanding. That means we're closer to our goal. The Zone is retreating. Soon, we'll destroy it completely!
We are now accepting new soldiers! You will be provided with both meals and weapons, and you will make friends you can trust in combat!
General Voronin gave up his life for the righteous ideals of Duty. We have to finish what he started!
Fulfill your duty, join your brothers in arms, and show the mutants what you're willing to do to protect humanity!
Duty will eliminate every mutant in the Zone! We won't let a single one of them cross the Zone's borders!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_QC_GC: I haven't seen Hrachyk or Verin in a while. Any idea where they might've gone?
They went with Zulu on some mission.
Why them? Maybe I wanted to go too.
You wanted to go? You're better off here, safe.
Sergeant, what do you think is next for Duty?
Think about your orders, Private. You have your superiors to take care of planning the future. It's their job.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_QC_Hu: The Concrete Plant is under attack! The doors are closed until we get the all clear.
The Concrete Plant is under attack! The doors are closed until we get the all clear.
The attack on the Concrete Plant is over! The doors are now open.
The attack on the Concrete Plant is over! The doors are now open.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_QC_fi: What will happen to Duty now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_QC_ra: I wonder what Zulu is up to.
Haven't seen Zulu here in a while.
What will happen to the Mainland now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_QC_se: Maybe I should transfer to the CNPP?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_QD_Vo: What was that about? With Myklukha and D4.
It's been brewing since forever. I know my people had nothing to do with it, and I think Myklukha knows that too. But confirming it would mean someone has it in for Freedom, and he has no idea who.
Or worse – he knows who it is, but can't do anything about it. I don't care about his reputation problems, either. My people won't be pawns in this game of his.
Zulu and I don't always see eye to eye, but he is a part of Duty. An important part. No treaty could ever be worth his life.

It's Zulu who has a problem with me. He thinks that if we pull together every resource and send everyone to fight the Zone, it will budge. But I've already seen it with my own eyes when I was out there getting my hands dirty.
Winning a battle is not enough to win the war. You do it one small victory at a time – step by step, battle after battle. To be able to do that, we need our people alive.
At some point, Zulu will accept that, and then he'll become a true leader. Though I don't think he'll like the idea.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_fila_: It's good Duty finally stopped being lazy, only chasing small jobs, but I think the conflict with Freedom will only grow bigger.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_g_hyp: Tell me about the Concrete Plant.
It's no Rostok, of course, but you know what they say – home is the place you protect. And we do.
First, the Concrete Plant, then the whole world. All in good time. Otherwise, we won't be able to win this war.
I think the end of D4 is nothing but a Freedom provocation. So is the gossip about Duty being too slow to take decisive action. I'm not falling for that.
There's no way I'm sending my people to die in some insane skirmish. We have more important things to do, and the ultimate battle to win.
Who will defend the Mainland from all… this? If not us, who? The Ward? They're only interested in SIRCAA.
IPSF? They can't even defend themselves. Freedom and Spark? They'd rather carry that plague on their own backs.
We are the only ones left.
I heard about what you did. I would say it's for the better, but no. Mavka will cause more trouble, and Zulu won't back down now.
And I sure won't get in his way.
My faction stands between the horrors of the Zone and the rest of the world. The world doesn't notice it, but that means we're doing our job.
It's a shame the job doesn't get any easier.
I think I've messed up. Can we make a deal?
Your mess caused real harm to Duty. You'll have to pay for that.
Coupons will do… this time. Next time, we'll see.
We have nothing to talk about.
You made the right call. Dismissed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_gera_: Maybe he isn't that sad anymore. Haven't seen him in a while.
The day Zulu died was the only time it was so quiet here. Everyone poured themselves a drink in silence and just stared into space.
Everyone seems to be doing better now. The warrant officer is even making plans for the future. Life goes on.
I think any problem can be solved with the right amount of booze. You just need to know your limits.
It's a shame Zulu doesn't drink. Only makes him sadder.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_marsa: Back in the day, I wanted to leave it all and become a hunter. But Hera and Komisarov talked me out of it. They said Duty wouldn't be the same without me.
We really value every single person now. We lost so many good fighters that I have to keep helping the others.
Now that there's no more peace between the factions, walking the Zone is even more dangerous. Freedom loves throwing a sucker punch. It's what they do.
Good thing we still have routes safe enough to walk. I can take you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_prapo: Tell me about the Concrete Plant.
The Concrete Plant is fully operational.
I'm still in charge of the trade. The rest of the personnel remains the same: they can fix your gear, guide you wherever you need, and pour you a drink.
The prices depend on who your friends are.
You know the difference between Duty and Freedom?
We're fighting for humanity. We're ready to die so that others can live.
What is Freedom fighting for? To gift the Zone to everyone. They're willing to die so they can bring others death.
Warrant Officer Komisarov. Commander of the Duty base here at the Concrete Plant. Well, acting commander.
I had to take charge after key personnel were killed. But you know all about how they died since you did everything to ensure it.
The rest of the soldiers know all about you, too, and they'll watch your every step while you're here. So you'd better not give us an excuse to put a bullet in your head.
We had trouble with the supply chain, until I took matters into my own hands. Those up top don't care how the supplies get here, but they're pretty strict about sales reports.
That means I can't do any under-the-counter business. Still… I always know who else might have what you need.
Zulu, for example, doesn't even need to tell me what he needs. It's obvious to me. So I give him the contacts, and whatever happens next is none of my business.
The Emission is over. Everyone dismissed!
Stay in shelter until the Emission is over!
Attention! Emission incoming. Take cover, everyone!
We started off on the wrong foot. Can we make it right?
Your actions cost Duty dearly. So I expect compensation.
This time, we can settle for financial compensation. If there's a next time, we'll have to see.
I need to think about it.
Do that. Twice.
Here. I hope this helps.
Glad we could settle this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_rad_m: I don't know the details of whatever Mavka and Zulu are doing together, but I'm sure he's acting in Duty's best interest.
It's a shame I wasn't ordered to the CNPP. I hope I'll get my chance to show what I'm made of in combat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_serz_: I always knew Freedom was up to no good. And I never even visited them in Rostok.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_ConcretePlant_Hub_serza: A loner who's friends with bosses of two Zone bases suddenly wants to make amends with Duty. I wonder why.
If no one else can, I'll fix it. But don't go poking around for classified information.
I've said it so many times that Duty needs to remember who we are and why we're here. And when we did, others saw it too, that we're not just sitting around here in the Zone.
Now we have two strategic locations at the same time. I hope there'll be more in the future. Or, even better, I hope we won't need any of them one day.
But while we're still here, I'll keep doing what I do best. You need something fixed, or just here for the gossip?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_DLC01_triskacka_0_: If you do end up going to the Iron Forest, try not to cross paths with my employers. They're not big fans of meeting in person.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QC_BarmenCall_1_73: Hey you, party people! Come by the bar at the Slag Heap, buy a round for our guest from the Iron Forest!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QC_BarmenCall_1_83: He's just back from the restricted part of the Zone, and he's willing to share his story for a shot or two!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QC_TerriconBlabbin: Maybe we should dash to the Iron Forest, too? I'm sick of running after these small-potato artifacts.
You got a death wish? That's restricted territory, guarded by IPSF, and Chatterbox is full of crap.
He might be. But standing straight after so much booze? Man's got talent! After drinking that much, I believe he could brainwash a controller. Plus, people heard IPSF fire a couple of days ago.
What a waste of vodka – there's no way you'll convince me. Damn Boozer and his gimmicks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QC_TriskachkaNear_: Off you go! And don't come back without my booze! Sausage? Really?! How am I supposed to tell you about the Iron Forest with a full mouth and a dry throat?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QC_TriskalkaBefore: Listen, stalker, not now, okay? I've got a splitting headache.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QD_DrabadanInterra: To our Slag Heap guests – make sure not to miss the local wonder. A stalker who's personally been to the Iron Forest, who's willing to share his experience for the price of a drink.
You can always grab a couple bottles of something strong here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QD_Drabadan_RadioC: Hello to you, my stalkers, brothers, and other tourists. Boozer speaking. You must have heard about the commotion in the Iron Forest, right?
New Emissions, mutants, anomalies… These aren't just tales. I know that first-hand.
Curious to learn more? Drop by the bar at the Slag Heap. Our special guest got back from the restricted part of the Zone, and he's willing to share his story for a shot or two!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QD_TriskachkaAfter: Ha ha, very funny! He and I used to…
We were… Where, how? I was waiting. Thought it's gotta be the Iron Forest with the comms down, you know?
So, it's because of me? Had one too many and said too much about our employer… Can't remember a damn thing!
My stash is yours, stalker. It has everything I scraped together to go to the Iron Forest. I need to lay low for now.
Leave me. I need to disappear.
Tell me a story about the Iron Forest.
Oh, did I tell you the one about how we offed a two-headed bloodsucker?
Yeah, yeah, lots of them around there, you know... Hic! Mutated mutants.
Long time, no see! Wanna hear some stories about the Iron Forest? Goodbye and I know it inside and out!
Just lemme… get a refreshment first. Throat's sore, you know, from all the talking. Quite a crowd here...
Your employer wants to punish you for running your big mouth. Goodbye is dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ00_QD_TriskachkaMain_: Hello again! Wanna hear some more about the Iron Forest? I'll do the talking, you'll do the pouring.
I think I heard enough.
We were just getting started!
If you change your mind, I'll be here. Just don't forget to order a drink from Boozer. He doesn't like when people bring their own.
Tell me more about the Iron Forest. How do I get there?
You're a good guy! Decent… I'll tell you. So… my pal Goodbye and I were hired for this job. Deliver some parts to the Iron Forest. Serious people.

They work through bandits, but it's not my first day diggering in the Zone, so I know all their tricks. The real buyer preferred to stay incognito. But they're cooking up something pretty interesting down there…
The bandits showed us how to get into the Forest! Goodbye and I, we used to… meet them at a secret spot by the wall. But be quiet. Don't tell anyone. Guess I'll take a nap…
Thing is, stalker, I'm not telling you all this 'cause I love to drink, I'm telling you 'cause I'm a sympathetic person.
I don't want some poor guy to kick the bucket in the Iron Forest. Here's what's going on down there.

One minute, a blast hits, the next, an unknown mutant pops up – and don't get me started on the IPSF on the walls. In a nutshell: unless you've got fangs, or you're somehow on IPSF's good side, you'd better stay away.
If you're just asking out of curiosity, I'll tell you what I know! But the story of how I got there is off-limits.
I'd like to hear some stories about the Iron Forest.
Loner! Finally, a decent face in this bandit dump. We used to have more diggers like myself hanging out here, back in the day.
You wanna hear some Iron Forest stories? Go ahead and pour me one, then!
I'll tell you all about what I saw there, and who I met. Just don't ask me how I managed to get there. That's knowledge I'm not willing to share.
How does this sound? Tell me how to get to the Iron Forest.
Thought you could catch me off-guard?
Thanks for the booze, of course. But that information is not up for sale. I'm a digger, which means I'm a man of honor.
How about I tell you about the local mutants instead? Fierce, like… And then… you know… Goodbye and I…
Looks like I've had enough…
So, is IPSF guarding the entrance to the Iron Forest?

Yeah. So many of them you couldn't squeeze a rodent inside. And IPSF is vicious… No "hello", no "where are your coupons for trespassing on a military facility". You're looking down the barrel, just like that.
They don't want to find a way to work it out. No wonder everyone thought that territory was impossible. Got to get creative.
Blasts? What are those?
Blasts are kinda like Emissions, but with their own mojo. Unpredictable shit.
They started not so long ago. The local fauna loses it, and becomes fiercer after every blast.
What's so interesting about that forest?
It's a strategic facility guarded by IPSF. Why is it guarded? What is it they're protecting? It's one big mystery.
What was there before and what's going on there now are even bigger mysteries. But I can shine some light on the latter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ01_QC_PuncherVasylko_: So, do you see now that being a walking encyclopedia won't help you survive in the Zone? The stalker is a perfect example of that.
The only thing I see is that you're quite savvy in Zone trivia yourself. That's why you're still alive, even though you won't admit it.
See, I was right, we've got one educated stalker here. And with knowledge this solid, he'll find his way around the Zone.
True, true. Especially with all the fancy equipment on top of that solid knowledge.
No way, let's check! Come over here, stalker!
Huh? Might as well call Kefir and Zefir…
Who even knows? And most importantly, why would anyone? Ah, stalker! Come here, I wanna ask you something.
Can't wait to be proven wrong, can you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ01_QC_Puncher_ComeHer: Ah, stalker, come on over. Be our third!
Don't be shy, stalker! Come, let's do a quiz.
Ah, look who's here, a stalker! Let's make his cogs spin.
Hey, sir! Grow a pair and come here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ01_QC_Puncher_EndComm: You seem like a good guy, stalker, but you've gotta learn the basics before you end up in trouble out of sheer ignorance.
You know your stuff, man. Come visit us at Rostok when it's all over. We'll smoke a hookah.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ01_QC_Vasylko_EndComm: It was nice meeting you, stalker. Too bad you don't share the conventional views, but I hope that can be fixed.
It was nice talking to a good man. Come see us at the Cement Factory. We'll hang out when I'm off duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ01_QD_PuncherVasylko_: So you've finally found a patsy to take that trash off your hands?
Damn, I mean, there must be a reason why it was in that stash. Maybe it opens something important!
You know what, here's one more thing for you. Dunno what this key opens, but I'm pretty sure you'll get a chance to use it.
I heard it was Duty because they were there first.
Yeah, and not just "were"! We cleared it out and organized the first Arena. Good times!
Well done, good boys! We greatly value your modest contribution.
Freedom. They're the ones at Rostok right now, after all.
No! Your Freedom hadn't even reached the Army Warehouses by the time Duty had cleared out Rostok! Eh, who am I even telling this to…
This stalker is a herald of truth! See, what an intellectual we got here. Nothing like you…
Mercenaries from the Wild Territory?
Err, that's out of the box… I mean, they did hang out there at some point… But no, Rostok was cleared by Duty, and they were the ones who founded the Base and the Arena. Those were the days…
Actually, mercenaries really did show up there in '11… Ha, this stalker is a sharp one. He didn't fall for your lame trick. We must count this as the correct answer, I insist!
So! Who created Duty and inspired it to fight the Zone?
That's easy. Tachenko, back in the early days of the Zone.
Of course! He conducted many successful operations. Under him, Duty grew bigger and stronger. They even built him a memorial!
Ah, I see you're getting involved. Perfect!
Hi there, stalker. My 'colleague' and I here are debating the importance of learning history. Of the Zone, that is.
Debating, my ass. For me, it's entirely clear that the most important things in the Zone are weapon skills and general physical fitness.
You wish! If you don't know the basics and who's who in the Zone, you won't survive long.

The stalker has come this far, right? If he answers my questions, he must be well-versed in the history of the Zone and used it to his advantage more than once. Stalker, you with us? I'll make it up to you.
Voronin? Or whoever the Duty boss is right now.
No dice! Voronin is our current general, but the first one was Tachenko. He brought Duty to the top on his own shoulders… A true legend of the Zone.
Ha! Nobody even remembers your Tachenko anymore. Voronin has been the immortal symbol ever since he started the job in '11.
Zulu, who else.
Who?! Oh come one! It's General Tachenko! He organized Duty personally… Don't tell me you've never heard of him!
Hahaha! What a stunt this stalker just pulled! We must tell Zulu how he's been christened the founding father of Duty, he'll get a right kick out of it.
I'll giive you a 'could do better', stalker. Still, you've had some bright thoughts. Here's the promised reward, it'll come in handy.
See, that's a reasonable man. Stop bothering people already, Puncher.
What's with everyone and their excuses today? No competitive spirit at all. All right, all right, come back if you change your mind.
Man, make up your mind already!
I'm too busy to talk history right now.
Ha, I see you've really gotten into it. It's rare to meet such a history nerd. All right then, let's wrap it up!
Riiight… Ah, by the way! Can you tell me what the often-mentioned treaty with the code name D4 is all about?
Nobody starts a new faction war. Or the Ward will engage in the confrontation, and everybody will lose.
Right, that's generally correct. Mean guys from the Ward came and pulled everyone into opposite corners of the ring… and banned them from meeting in the center.
Uh-huh. I just hope the match bell doesn't ring and the hotheads don't get too deep into it.
Getting into it, are you? Wanna be known as an erudite, or are you curious about the prize? Ready to take a history test?
And waste a hell of lot of time…
Those who don't know history are doomed to repeat it. Just like you with your broken record.
So, how about it, stalker?
Duty and Freedom entered into an equal military alliance.
Yeah, right! D4 bans us from fighting each other, but there's no chance anyone would even discuss an "alliance".
Wipe that grin off your face. We weren't that much into it either.
Don't bother the Ward, and you won't be in trouble.
Sound advice, but no. D4 makes sure nobody attacks anyone, and everyone stays in their own lanes.
But yeah, you'd better be on your guard with the Ward. In fact, better avoid being noticed by them entirely.
Puncher, don't be so dramatic. The stalker was completely correct about Rostok!
Oh yeah? Then you reward him!
And I will! Here you go, stalker, you can always count on my word.
But you were bang on about Rostok, well done. Here's a bonus for that!
By the way, you were right on point about the mercenaries at Rostok. Here's a bonus for your ingenuity.
Hmm, stalker. History's clearly not your strong suit. But if you've come as far as the Iron Forest, you probably don't really need it that much.
Let me just ask the final question. Tell us, stalker, who are the real masters of Rostok?
All right, go ahead.
Great. Let's start with something fun so the Duty guy can turn that frown upside down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ02_QD_NitroSkif_About: Message says Beliakov died first. Looks like a Chimera set up shop near the wreckage. If it wasn't for Laiko, it might've paid the camp a visit.
Thanks for the heads-up, Skif. I'll pass the news to Zulu. Man, he's gonna be furious…
We got zero radio gear from the Stingray, and worse, we lost two good guys. True Duty soldiers, judging by what Laiko did.
A Chimera shredded them both, but I made sure it won't go hunting again. We gotta thank Laiko for luring it away from the camp.
Damn, man! You took down a whole Chimera solo? Respect! For a stunt like that, you earned yourself some loot. Here.
I'll report back to Zulu about the lads. If it wasn't for Laiko sacrificing himself, Kurin would be... jeopardized.
I brought over the PDA from Sgt. Laiko's body. The last unsent message was for you.
From his body? Holy hell… What happened?! I just sent him and Beliakov out to the old Stingray wreck for some useful scrap!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_DLC01_kosta_lotos_: You don't just end up on top of the food chain in Freedom. If you wanna live large without working hard, you gotta earn it first.
A while back, I wanted to join Freedom. Thought it'd give me the chance to choose – choose my jobs, my pay, my crew members.
And it seems so, for real, but it's not easy to find yourself a job that pays well. All the good ones go the ones at the top.
So I chose to work for myself, not for the faction. And I'm not complaining!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_DLC01_radovoj_kuli: I ended up in Duty back when D4 was still around. But even then they told us the treaty was a temporary measure. And that's how it's turned out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_DLC01_vita_kulis_0: I used to think an enemy is just that, and I didn't need to try and see the person behind their uniform.
But then it hit me… What kind of human would I be if I kept going on thinking like that?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_Andreenko_Radio: Post 19, come in. What's your status?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_DrinkingInHub_F: Yes, amigo. You know what's funny? It was only after I got out of Freedom that I finally felt truly free!
I'm out of commission, too, and happy about it. Screw their schedules, orders, and marches! I'm free to choose now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_DrinkingInHub_I: Time I was on my way.
Good luck! And remember: all the factions are just pulling the blanket over themselves.
Yeah! Don't let others choose for you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_DrinkingInHub_S: It was you who set Kulish straight before he could blow my brains out! So it's thanks to you we're here today. Have a drink with us?
Where would you be if I didn't help you out there, amigo? Best case scenario? Stuck at that same base, looking out for the enemy advance.
Come on, you wouldn't have gotten far from that base if I hadn't spared you then.
Gimme a break! It was the stalker who spared me. Speak of the devil!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_DrinkingInHub_d: And to life with no labels!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_Kulish_AllClear: Nineteen here. All clear, we fought them off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_LotosKulish_Cha: Let me at least have a smoke. A peace pipe, you know.
That's what I get for my help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_Lotos_AfterCall: Why are you standing here? Move it! Duty will storm us any minute.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QC_Lotos_BeforeGun: Phew… We can catch our breath now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_KulishLotos_Att: Amigo, what the hell? I helped you kill the fanatics!
And before that, you wanted to kill me! Stay freaking still!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_KulishLotos_Jus: Dude, tell him already!
That's my men. I gotta respond.
There's a war between your factions. An enemy's an enemy.
I'm the enemy? I helped you!
Enough with the pity party! I know what you and your pal were up to here. If Monolith didn't attack me, you two sure would.
We've talked enough, 'helper'.
It doesn't matter anymore why this Freedom guy is here. Thanks to him, you're alive. Let him leave.
What am I supposed to tell my superiors? Backup must be on its way already.
On its way? They didn't even answer your call.
Shut up!
And get out, before they arrive.
Gracias!
I helped with the Monolithians, you deal with this yourselves.
What's up with you? We both helped…
"My men". Where were they when Monolith attacked? I was right here.
Kiss my ass! There's no talking sense with Duty.
Thanks for your help, loner. I'll deal with this rat first, and then I'll pay you.
So you get coupons for your help, and I get a slug. Do you think that's fair?
What happened here, anyway?
I was here when the Monolithians attacked. I could've ran away, but I didn't – I stayed to cover this one.
You didn't run away because you were out of time. And you came here to attack me and my men! Isn't that so?
I came 'cause my legs carried me here. I didn't kill a single Duty member, either! If it wasn't for me – well, me and the loner – you'd be a goner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_KulishLotos_Pea: What can you tell me about your faction?
Duty doesn't accept just anybody. It's no open house.
Freedom only accepts on a donation or recommendation basis too, you know.
I can't imagine whoever would've recommended you.
And what were you doing here?
To put it briefly, this territory is Duty's area of responsibility. I can't disclose anything else.
If you have questions, ask away.
Thanks for your help there, stalker. Monolithians are like wild beasts – if they smell blood, they won't stop.
I hope that Freedom member values his life – and paid you well for saving it.
But you'll get your money from that Freedom member.
Thanks to him, your head's still in one piece. And talking.
Looks like it's time for me to go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_Kulish_AfterLot: What can you tell me about your faction?
Some stalkers told me Duty got weak when Ward stepped in. I disagree. We have different jobs.
Of course, it was easier when Freedom didn't meddle in our business, but we dealt with that before, and we're ready to do it again.
I know what it looked like, he sorta helped me… But he didn't just walk in here randomly.
Anyway, thanks for stepping up. I might not have the biggest paycheck, but I won't be tight with coupons.
It's hard to keep the peace with those who have totally different plans for the Zone. That makes them my enemies.
Well, we might've had a drink or two at Rostok back in the day, but that was long ago. Doesn't look like we'll be doing that again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_Kulish_HelpIfRu: Anyone near our post? We need help!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_Kulish_Help_hel: Security post 19 requesting backup! Monolith attack! Critical situation!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_Kulish_RadioCal: Post 19, come in. What's your status? Need backup?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ05_QD_Lotos_PeaceWith: Everyone thinks Freedom is swimming in coupons. Sure, the ones at the top have it good, but the guys like me gotta hustle if we wanna survive.
I'm not into betting much, I'm not lucky. So I gotta look for side hustles, and…
Anyway, I won't bore you with my work stories.
How did you end up here, anyway?
The Zone is a free territory. I can go wherever I want. I'll just take a beat and be on my merry way.
That's for standing up for me there. Would've been a shame to take down the Monolithians and die from some Duty slug.
I mean, a Duty member acting bravely, following the ROE.
Settle this yourselves. I gotta go.
Good luck! And gracias for your help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ08_AL_BogeyMachete_Ab: Bogey, remember you said Wardens no longer had a merc kill list? And how you wanted to bet your coupons on it?
Mon ami, bring the coupons to me. Those bastards clearly wanted more than just a chat. I managed to lose them for now, but I still have a long, long run ahead.
Damn those guys. Just get to Rostok safe and sound, and I'll buy you a drink.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ08_QD_Bogey_AboutPDAT: You said, "all the way over near Rostok". People didn't get murdered like that here before?
Nah, the Ward wouldn't touch the mercs working under Myklukha. No clue how he managed to pull that off, or if there's even a deal. But it used to be quiet.
With D4 in place, the hierarchy at Rostok kinda built itself. Freedom gives the orders to mercenaries, and they resell them for a smaller price to loners or bandits.
You could, of course, take any other orders. But even that scheme meant everyone had coupons and kept busy. Everyone seemed happy with the way things were.
You mentioned some kind of code. Can you tell me more?
Let's say one mercenary kills by himself, while the other delegates orders to others. Who do you think is working by the code?
Why would the Ward kill a mercenary?
Not 'a' mercenary – mercenaries. They took out loads of guys in the assembly hall! Machete barely made it out back then… You look like you don't understand what I'm saying.
Long story short, our guys were hired by some customers high up the chain. The kind that likes the work done with no witnesses.
So Ward tied up the loose ends for them. Took out many of our guys, and the rest of the mercs were just dead men walking.
Be careful with the Wardens, well, anyone in a uniform – they can't be trusted.
It's both of them – the second's just richer because he can resell the order if he wants to. The code says you gotta bring proof. It doesn't matter who did the dirty work.
We often use that loophole because the customers just give you the basics first. If you agree, you get the advance.
And only then do you get a whole lot of details you gotta follow for the mission. Of course, you can't bail anymore because you can't return the advance to an anonymous customer.
The first one who kills by himself.
I'll get going.
Skif, will you sell me his PDA? I just wanna check that there's no info on the previous orders. It's better off with me, in a safe place.
I think I'll keep it.
Why the hell would you need it? Fine, I'll keep my coupons. A free tip for you, then.
Fine, you can keep it.
Thanks. You get a free tip as a bonus.
I found a dead merc nearby. The PDA suggests his name was Machete and he was headed your way.
And I know why he never made it. Warden bastards! Taking our guys out even all the way over near Rostok.
Poor Machete. He was a good merc. Seasoned. Always worked clean and lived by the code.
But don't expect to hear any details about his work. Commercial secret. If you wanted to ask something else, shoot.
The second one who orders murders to others.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_EQ08_den_krasnov_0_Info: Have you ever heard the phrase "ignorance is bliss"? Forget it. In the Zone, you need to know everything about everyone to stay alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_FactionWars_CNPP_QC_Dze: Now Duty has fewer soldiers and even fewer reasons for joy. I don't think we'll see them at the CNPP anytime soon!
You, however, are always welcome, Skif! I sent the coupons to your PDA as thanks for your help!
Amigos, Duty is back to its old ways. Instead of mourning their dead generals, they're trying to get to our CNPP.
It's time to push back. Time to remind Duty that their Cement Factory is the only place for them in the Zone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_FactionWars_CNPP_QC_Zul: Freedom squads were destroyed, and the few who survived backed off. I doubt they'll try to stick their noses in here again. In the foreseeable future, at least.
Thanks for helping us again, Skif. I'll send the reward to your PDA.
Freedom lost two leaders in a short period of time, but that's still not enough. Their patrols have been spotted near the CNPP again. They want to take over.
But the CNPP is one of Duty's posts now, and our task is to protect it from attacks. Even if we have to eliminate every Freedomer in the region!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_bandits: Shah is batshit crazy, and Roosevelt's guys have to give half their profits to the pot, and no drinking. A shitty option, and an even shittier one…
I'm telling you, Nestor's deal is shady. With his scanners, the cops are gonna be all over us, just like that!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_corps_1: Between us. Don't make any moves on Harpy. Last year, she would've beaten your ass at 800 meters, easy-peasy. She wasn't always sitting at that table, tinkering with spares.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_corps_2: We lost two down there, and another one badly wounded. Fuck… we should all be here, not guarding Yaniv from the damn tourists.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_corps_3: Stalker. You, by the fence. This is your first and last warning – the only way to Prypiat is through Yaniv.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_duty_1_: Me! I'm a volunteer! Voronin personally gave me his permission! No Duty member left behind… we won't leave him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_duty_2_: Roosevelt. They say he used to be one of ours. Wish we could publicly court-marshal him… But if we did, an even bigger scumbag will replace him. Look at Duty, raising bandit standards, heh!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_freedom: Guys, I'm out. When Lukash was around, Freedom was Freedom, and now… The Mainland is just as good for business deals.
If you go out for some bread from Myklukha, grab a loaf for us. Shit, it's genius marketing! We got loners all lined up…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_ipsf_1_: Headlight, I'm not going to cover for you when the captain's here. Get to the checkpoint, now! Fucking tourist, admiring the anomalies…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_ipsf_2_: I see two shitwits wearing winter camo. Wandering around, like they're from another planet. Over…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_loners_: He listened to some white noise and lost his marbles, just like that. Our whole squad had to use Morse code for a month afterwards…

A collar? That's for Noontiders, didn't you know? They used to be zombies, so the Ward puts collars on them, making sure they don't jump at 'em. They tested the collars on blind dogs, so there are some left here and there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_mercs_1: Forget about the colonel. They got him on a leash, and he's not our priority target.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_mercs_2: You heard? Deggy didn't finish Skull off. Word is, they spotted Surgeon somewhere, too. I wonder how many of the old guard guys are laying low…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_mercs_3: Wardens got him. And Tide's MIA.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_monolit: It is not your time to join the Monolith yet, brother. Take cover and wait, we are coming to you.
My squad will come in from the south. Acceptable casualties – eighty per cent for us, and thirty for you. May the Monolith guide us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_noon_1_: To all the lost ones. Find Strider, he knows what to do. Stay close to each other. We will make it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_noon_2_: Strider, I'm coming back. Contact attempt was unsuccessful. I… I can't do it. Sit with them by the fire, smile, listen to those jokes…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_random_: Before you go to Honta, make sure to cut some flesh eyes out. Then he won't take you for a rookie.
You, the fucker with the searchlight screwing up my NVD! I'll shove that thing so far up your ass we'll see it all the way from the Slag Heap every time you open your mouth!
Attention, all units: Aegis protocol initiated.
The kid fell into the anomaly, and it spitted him out, right into a tree! So we're limping back.
Target spotted. Three neutrals.
Eliminate.
Copy that.
Boys, tomorrow, under our oak tree. Let's pour one out for Redhead.
Shut your traps. That's enough chit-chat on the channel!
…and Pashko tells him: at this pay rate, you can go there yourself…
Just make sure you survive until winter first, then you can start thinking about a warmer sleeping bag! Rookies…
Can you hear me singing, beautiful Marichka…
Put the radio down, and go sleep it off.
Oh, found a radio…
Azure group, do you copy? Over.
Guys, they're Monolithians. I'm a dead man. Take care of the family for me.
Helicopter! A real helicopter's flying over us, holy shit!
Take cover, everyone!
Danchenko! Get back! Get back, that's a fucking order!
Phew. That's it. Wish me luck.
Okay. Just don't trust any of them. A stronghold of fucking science.
I'll kill the lotta you! You hear me?! Every single one of you!
You fall asleep there at the warehouse or something? Hurry up and load these!
Siryi, you won't believe it, but I found these two, drunk as skunks!
So, it's midnight. Happy birthday to me, or whatever…
If you please. This is a radio, not a telephone, there are rules!
All field operatives in Zaton, proceed immediately…
No fucking clue if you can hear me… Peregrine, brother, we'll get you out. And we'll give you vodka till we wash Monolith outta your head.
Battery! I got a battery! My very first one!
Follow my every step, you got it?
It was a Gauss. Fuck… he was right there, and then he wasn't.
It's four in the morning – are we gonna get that shift change? Over.
We've got a man down! I repeat, man down!
Monolith be with you, brothers. Begin.
Get back to the Southern, our guys could use a break. Do you copy?
Tokha, what's for lunch? If there's meatballs, bring some to the checkpoint for the four of us, will you?
Everyone who walks in here will die. Who wants to be first?
Bastards walking around like they own the place. Think I can't see them. Heading your way.
Did you stick that radio up your ass, or what?! Come in, damn it!
One, two… one, two, three… comms check…
How do I use this thing? Will there be a briefing, good gentlemen? Whoa, is it on already?
No contracts over radio. When you're ready to meet, then we'll talk.
Boars got a lair right next to the road. Better stay away from it.
Just wanted to know: did the booze get him brave enough to steal the package, or did something happen?
Grow a pair before you threaten me, got it?!
Get outta here, dude!
Attention, stalkers! New meds just came in, everyone welcome!
A grey backpack with a cat patch lost. If found, bring back to Rostok for a reward!
Beacon, come back! Come back, damn it, we came together… to the Zone…
Sorry, Tolik. It's every man for himself now.
Lieutenant? Lieutenant, come in?! I fell into the basement, I think my leg's broken…
Attention, stalkers – Malachite is now hiring field operatives…
Go fuck yourselves, Malachite! Do you fucking copy, over?! I saw Tyre after your cooperation, and he'd be better off buried in that forest!
Lookie here, chump incoming. Dressed for a parade.
We'll restyle him all right. Wait here, I'll go around.
Guys, it's so beautiful… The sky is glowing.
Fucking run, Swain! Come on, you almost made it!
I'm done running. See you on the other side. Out.
Hey team, I got him, you hear me? I got him! Not so controlling without your head, are you?!
Without your head… we're batshit… there we go… we made it…
Everyone, fall back to base!
Commander, eh…
I told you to fucking get back to base! Get out of here, now!
Pin, come in! I can hear someone wounded, asking for a medkit. Can't see anyone. Should I go check?
Stay where you are! There's no one there, it's the fucking cat! Lock and load, everybody!
Monolith, you are the light, you are the knowledge… why won't you answer?!
Get your coupons ready, I got the Night Star! As promised!
Checker. Checker, answer me. Come in. I know you can hear me…
Fucking dogs! A whole pack of 'em. Guys, get over here!
There's a hornhead. A huge one! You wouldn't believe your eyes!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_scienti: Faraday is a time capsule, undoubtedly. I wonder if it can hear us while we are listening to it…
Colleague, have you lost it? Going outside Institute territory without personal approval from Dalin and the colonel?! Get back immediately!
Ms. Dorozhnyuk, you have been suspended from fieldwork. Head back to Malachite to receive further instructions from the materiel depot manager.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_spark_1: You think it was an Oasis, too? A real one? Not a word to the scientists. Not for all the money in the world. They'll ruin the miracle…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_spark_2: The Shining Zone – well, yeah, sure. But if it did a 180 on an ex-mercenary just like that, we won't be the same if we walk into it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_ward_1_: Payment according to contract, right. In your dreams. You know what happened to the guys who were here before the Ward? Nobody does.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_ambient_ward_2_: Don't report it to the medics, they'll make a fuss. Go to Kryvenko, quietly. He's solid, he'll get your head straight and won't tell anyone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_banza: Damn… you fucking anomaly, get over here… Got it! I got it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_barke: You heard about the new guide? Still a kid, goes by Richter. Not recommended. His luck's gotta run out sooner or later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_birch: Hi, Quiet. Out of the monastery already? I knew it! Knew you'd work up the courage. You get settled in for now, and don't worry – the Zone's messed with all our heads. Maybe one day you'll end up joining Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_booth: Vusatyi here. Head northwest. Find the building by the road, near the water. There is a transformer box inside, it has supplies for your trip back. Forget about… save the people.
Transferring the advance. You'll get the rest after I get the goods.
The booth up north, near the spate. It has a safe, with the captain's stash. Just change the code right away.
Copy. My people know where that is. And they know where you are, just in case.
With all due respect, who got into the emergency stash without telling me? The north stash by the bridge is empty.
Maybe, it was Savchuk? He's still out on patrol…
He would have told me. What the fuck is this?

A little IPSF birdie told me about their stash in a substation. Not a bad catch. Check other substations that look like that one, start southwest, near the bunker. Knowing the military, there could be something there. If you find 'em, change the code to our numbers.
All personnel, be advised: there is a trip wire next to our substation by the western lake. If it's an outsider nicking our stashes, he'll stay there for good. If not, I warned you.
Captain, we lost one of our stashes. The patrol saw a chimera to the southeast, right next to it.
Damn, that's not good. But not catastrophic, we didn't have a lot there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_burnt: Malachite, come in. Ihor here, NK-3 group. Pull us from Kazkovyi, immediately! They refuse to leave, they're listening to that radio like they went nuts!
I hid weapons in the northwest wing. For safety. Mine, and theirs…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_chorn: You were right about the Iron Forest. You can hear Faraday more clearly there. I'm traveling light i left the stuff I won't need in the Chornobyl gym, by the old lair. Take whatever you need.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_cooli: Don't give Limp any medkits! You know what he does with them? Tries to use them as fucking fish bait! Like, they bite 'cause there's nasty chemicals and stuff. If you don't believe me, stop by the Cooling Towers. We got the healthiest catfish in the Zone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_duga_: Base, come in! This is Mars-3. We have this... anomalous emission underway! I take full responsibility: we are dumping the transport and will look for shelter on foot. We're by the Duga, sector… reference point – a small lake and…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_indus: I left my gear at the house in the industrial zone swamp. Where we celebrated our first run, remember? Maybe it'll come in handy.
This is goodbye, Sergeant, and thank you. I hope you will start the damn "Zaporozhets" – and I'll see you on the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_karma: Nord! Nord, come in! You good? Fucking Korshunov, fucking Ward… hang on, Commander, I'll get you out. Hang on!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_malac: Dude, we hit the jackpot! I know where the scientists stashed the spares from the Scorcher: right next to it, in a hanger down west! Can you imagine how much they're worth?! I'll scout it out, join me later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_mavka: I'd at least have hoped you of all people wouldn't make fun of me. If someone needs to entertain the peeps, I will. Freedom isn't always about doing what you please. We know our "musts" and they mean more to us than any official charter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_miklu: It's not an idea, it's a plan – checked and calculated carefully. Are you with me, leading Freedom to real success? Or will you keep believing in fairy tales?

If you wanna die for his dreams on the Mainland, be my guest, but I'm out. Count my people out, too. Yes, Lukash, my people. You need to stop looking into the bright future and look at the shitty present. Like true leaders do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_nord_: Karma, if you get too excited about the interrogation in front of an audience, there will be consequences. Understood?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_redfo: Lishchyna Facility here, Red Forest, this is the head of security…
Give me the radio! I told you about the psi-activity levels! SIRCAA detectors, my ass, they don't work! Send the Ward here immediately – and anti-psi medication, before we all go nuts!

We'll deal with your killer no problem, don't you worry. You know Witch's Circle in the Red Forest? We got all the stuff we need there already, prepared our positions. That's where we'll put him six feet under.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_scout: Name's good enough. I'm hardly a Surgeon anymore: my hands aren't what they used to be. But my legs are still fine for guiding.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_swamp: Foma, come in. We're heading back to Wild Island from the scanner point. We checked, no result. Left what we couldn't carry in the boxes you know where. We'll be there soon. Out.
To anyone who can hear me, it's Jaybird, a loner. I'm in the swamps. A bloodsucker almost chewed me up, I barely made it to the tugboat. Help, anyone. Or at least bury me…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_voron: Zulu, enough. You have your duties as a soldier. Sit tight for today. Tomorrow, I expect you to make the 9 AM briefing. Do you copy?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_yanta: A Yantar patrol found me. I'm wounded. Dumped my gear into a crack, so they won't get any of it. But I still have my grenades on me. See you in the Monolith's light, brothers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_zaton: You want my soul? Come and get it. I'll be waiting in the Zaton caves. I don't believe for a damn second you'll keep your word and come alone. So bring everyone, I'll be ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Faraday_subtitled_zulu_: Shulha, listen. I'm… so sorry. Really. The Zone broke me. Got to me. I'll pay for your treatment, and everything else… Forgive me, will you? Please.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_IronForest_Hub_DLC01_az: I need to sort this out first, no time to talk.
I need to focus.
Sure you fixed everything up? You won't be able to do it later.
Let me help while I'm still here.
You're in Duty, but… you're not a member?
They're good guys, reliable. We go way back, from the times when I was a technician in Yaniv.
But getting into Duty is so much trouble. Training, testing, exams, an oath – not my kind of thing.
My thing is working in peace.
That’s all I wanted to know.
Got time for a chat?
I got some time while the boys are packing up.
How did you end up in the Iron Forest, anyway?
Oh, that's a long story. I am originally from Yaniv, it's always been my favorite place to work. But I didn't really see eye to eye with Degtyarev. He's just too mysterious.
So I wandered around the Zone, going here and there. Was mostly at the Concrete Plant, always fixing up Zulu's armor, for old time's sake.
Then I figured out it was easier to stick with him because he didn't care much for that armor. Or himself, for that matter. So that's how I ended up in the Iron Forest.
Zulu's staying here on his own. Do you think he'll be okay?
He's my friend, so I can both praise him and call him out. But since I'm a good friend, I'll only tell you good things.
Never in my life have I met a person more brave and more devoted to Duty. Whatever he'll be up against, I'm sure he'll figure it out. There's no need to worry.
I'll still try to talk him out of it, though.
You think the Concrete Plant was tough, then you end up in the Iron Forest and you start missing things like metal springs sticking out of your mattress.
What a god-damned adventure, I'm telling you. No way I'm going somewhere on one of Zulu's hunches again, with his spontaneous ideas to save mankind!
At least Voronin understands the Zone is no place to play hero. Pulling the squad was the right decision.
I'll keep bugging Zulu to leave with us. Can't guarantee he'll listen to me, but I still gotta try!
What was I saying? Ah…
We'll take a look!
Let's see what we have here.
What've you got there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_IronForest_Hub_DLC01_ga: Stop bothering me! I'm trying to think.
Don't let us down, stalker. And remember – think before you do something.
Let's chat later. We're not going anywhere.
But, honestly, it would've been better if all of Duty stayed and Zulu left instead. He was the number one cause for trouble here…
You better hurry, stalker. I can guarantee you that Mavka, with her lack of strategic thinking, must've gotten herself into some new trouble already.
It's good to have Nitro back. I like him – he's serious and smart. You always know what to expect with him, and it makes you feel… calmer.
How's it going with the blasts nearby?
Not good! To put it mildly. Loads of mutants swarming in all the time, and the comms are really fuzzy. We got enough ammo, of course, but it's still getting on my nerves.
But Duty's got it worse than we do. They brought less supplies than they ended up needing, and they're used to coordinating all the time, which is tough with no comms.
Not that I have much sympathy for them. We're the ones with a clear mission while those princes made up their own dragon – so who's to blame if they don't have a white horse?
Are you upset that Duty's leaving?
Well, I'm not happy about it, but wouldn't say I'm sad – there's a difference, you know. I'm more upset about the blasts no one dealt with.
Maybe Zulu will sort it out.
That’s all I wanted to know.
Why did Freedom come to the Iron Forest, anyway?
Myklukha got some information about a new type of mutant in the Iron Forest, so we rushed off on a field trip.

This little fella's gotta be delivered to the Arena, in perfect condition, the sooner the better. Otherwise, people will say Myklukha doesn't provide the best service in the Zone, and he really wouldn't like that.
The boys and I gotta catch mutants alive and deliver them to Rostok. I guess now you understand how badly Zulu ruined it for us.
You okay to chat?
Why not. Maybe it'll help me understand Kefir and Zefir better. All they do is run their mouths all day.
What's your opinion on Mavka?
She gets into things before thinking them through first. Mavka, Kefir, Zefir, Zulu – they've all got the same approach, and it's a bad and dangerous one.
I'll cut Kefir and Zefir some slack, though, because they're young. They'll learn. Zulu's not my problem, but Mavka… ugh. Trying to get into every hellhole, every job, every damn time.
"I'll do this, I'll do that!" But you gotta figure out if you can do it right before you say you'll do something. Ah… don't get me started.
I don't even need to say anything about Duty. One look at how the Arena's changed over the years, and it doesn't take a genius to figure out who's who.
Those boys kinda grew on me. Not all of them were clueless, just killed the mood.
Gotta give them something for the road – we've got tons of supplies, and they only came here with a couple of loaves of bread and bare minimum ammo.
Well, they earned it. Watch and learn!
Time to take your pills, grandpa.
I hope it all works out for you, Stalker. I just wish we could deal with those blasts already so Duty would piss off and let us hunt in peace.
Merde! Missed some good game! Myklukha would've given me a fortune for an amok! Now Marabu'll have to chop it up and sell the parts to scientists.
It is what it is. C'est la fucking vie.
Let's continue…
What do we have here? Everything!
Welcome to the Freedom table!
Myklukha loves to say that generosity is Freedom's middle name!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_IronForest_Hub_DLC01_ke: We can share some wisdom, stalker.
Top notch wisdom! Good as the flour in Myklukha's bread.
Shame about them boys, lurking around in the dark at that Plant. They just let 'em off the leash…
Can't say I'm happy with everythin' goin' on in Freedom, but I don't really wanna do anythin' to make things better, either.
Heya, stalker-boy! Grab a seat, and don't be shy. Shuffle up and deal.
Nah, leave the boyscout alone. You heard same as me that he's here to help Mavka. Sooner they're done, sooner she's back.
Nah, my man. When you're dumb, you're dumb, but when you're right, you're fuckin' right.
Be a good boy now, stalker. Mavka's our friend, and we'd move mountains for her!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_IronForest_Hub_DLC01_le: Find something better to do, loner.
Yeah, as you were.
If you decide to stay with Freedom, suit yourself. We don't need any stalkers that are dead weight.
You heard? Voronin ordered us to get out of this hellhole. I'll be leading the squad back, not Zulu. I'm not surprised. It was obvious it would come down to this.
I recommend you don't spend too much time in the Freedom part. They're only nice to you because of D4.
You seem to have beef with Freedom.
What is Freedom? I really don't understand. How can they live with no regulations? It's like, kill if you please, take what you want.
The Zone is full of those freedom seekers. How are they any better than regular bandits?
A person needs to have a purpose, and a set of rules. Not just freedom.
What do you think of Zulu as your commander?
Zulu... A squad leader who doesn't want to be called by his rank. It's nonsense. Probably doesn't so he can sound more imposing in the Arena.
For the kids, Zulu's a hero. But I've been with Duty for long enough to know his story. He's a drunk, and a brawler like no other. His kind never changes.
Voronin made a big mistake taking him back into Duty. That's okay. Time will tell who's worthy of being squad leader, and who isn't.
