General, what about Zakharchuk? We haven't found him, but we heard him. He's alive, wandering in circles.
Permission to put together a search group.
Granted. Two hours to locate him. If we fail, we keep moving.
What do you mean, "keep moving"? We should search for him until—
Orders aren't up for discussion, Colonel. Ready in ten.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Duty_CampState3: General! A new passage opened up from the north! We were on patrol, and there it was – like the brick wall was never there.
Why are you alone? Where's Chepurny?
Guarding the passage, so it doesn't disappear while we're away.
Fine. Tell the others to gather all the supplies. We're headed to the Radiowave Institute.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Duty_EchoInElev: Colonel, this is our Duty. We came here with a purpose, now we have to fulfill it.
This purpose is getting my people killed! And will get all of us killed, too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Duty_Radiowave_: Chepurny, a word. You seen the general? He's been glued to this thing for almost a day.
Damn the object! He's not going to take it away, or destroy it. I think he wants to stay here for good.
What about us?! Don't we get a say?!
Turn the damn thing off. If it all started with turning it on, so we should be out of here as soon as we pull the plug on it.
And Bunchuk? He never disobeyed a single order.
Promised not to get in our way. This was the best he could give us. I don't want to rot in here for the rest of my life. Are you with me?
Yeah, I'll distract Tachenko. But you gotta act quickly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_MercSnipers_1_7: Nothing here, Bosch. Not the smallest clue. We're wasting time – mapping our own route to the Institute would've been faster.
Why are we hanging on to that ghost trail?
Because mapping our own route means going in blind. At least Tachenko showed us where we shouldn't go. This is all we've got.
And stay frosty! Nord warned us about a stalker, so keep looking.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Mercs_Codelock_: Link, we got cut off. We're figuring out the code, but it's gonna take time.
Copy. That's quite the territory here, we'll sweep the northwest part. You take the southwest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Mercs_FogSequen: Nord, this is Referee, come in. Nord, this is Referee, do you copy?
It's no use. I'm telling you, we should turn back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Mercs_Radio_1_8: Bosch and Celt aren't answering. Comms glitching, or I don't know what the fuck is going on.
It's not the comms. It's a stalker.
Bosch is the best shot I've ever known. Could he take both of them down?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Nord_Memorial_1: So far, so good. I'm moving forward. Clear the area, and follow me.
Are you sure it's going to work?
If we meet on the other side, then it worked. Out.
Remember—the passage won't appear until you pick up your detector. It's already set up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Projector_Seque: It's not the comms. It's a stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Zaharcuk_Behind: …General! I'm here! In the hallway! Can you hear me?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Zaharcuk_Dying_: Report… Poltergeist… was covering the retreat… the hallways… closed behind me!
Screamed… into the radio! Did you hear? Hear me?! Then why did you have to abandon me?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QC_Zulus_Memorial_: Skif, come in! I got attacked!
Mercs! While I was tailing them, they were tailing me. Did a good job, too, the bastards. But it's not my first rodeo in the Zone, either.
They're by the memorial, like I said. They want to open the passage to the Bubble! I drew most of them out, and only the stubborn ones are left.
Don't let Nord get this… technology, or whatever that is! If it managed to kill Tachenko himself, then it's more dangerous than anything Duty ever encountered!
I'll get to you as soon as I deal with my part of the… problem. And be careful, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QD_Nord_Embryo_1_7: You got less than one minute before the anomaly collapses. If you do survive, though… don't follow me.
My revenge isn't your problem. But if you follow me, it will be.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ06_QD_Zulu_CoolingTow: We know where they are, so the answer's obvious. Mavka and her people are waiting at these coordinates. I'll gather my men and head there, too.
Can you believe it was just us three, and now more and more people believe the war has to be stopped? Now we have the chance to make it happen!
We need to locate their base. If Lukash was working with them, Mavka can find that information. Help her.
I'll start gathering forces for the attack. More and more people believe the war has to be stopped, and now we have the chance to make it happen!
Where do you think Nord might be?
At his base. Where else?
It's a good thing we already know where they are. We can act right away.
Now we need to figure out where that is…
And here, take this. You have to be ready for anything.
Welcome back! I got a report Nord was spotted not far from here. I rush in, and here you are with these beauties. For a moment, I thought you'd heroically taken them down then pissed off.
Nord is here?! He's got the technology Tachenko was guarding!
If he was here, he's long gone. Wait a minute, Tachenko's alive?!
Not exactly. I came across… a memory of him? The Bubble turned out to be a very strange place. But I found another PDA of the general's, this one's real. Take a look when you have the time.
I sure will! But we need to stop the mercs first. Whatever created that Bubble and whatever went down there, this technology shouldn't be in the hands of someone like Nord.
Did you know Tachenko? What do you think of him?
I didn't know him personally. A lot of people think he was a fanatic, but I see a man who channeled all his inner rage into one direction – Duty.
He proved that it doesn't matter who you are, it matters what you serve.
But it cost him what? His whole squad is dead.
That means there was no other way, and that was the price. Duty pays it, no questions asked.
What should we do next?
It seems the technology is somehow connected to the anomaly. As soon as Nord took the device, everything fell apart.
So, Nord got his hands on the technology that creates anomalies… I don't like the sound of that.
That tech shouldn't be in the hands of mercenaries.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_AL_IPSF_BuyMinutes: Listen, could you sell me your minutes?
Against regulation. You get the ranks, you'll get the minutes. I only have about seven left.
I only need one. Just need to call home, ask how my mom is doing. See if she got better, or…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_AL_IPSF_ColonelJok: Tell me that joke about the major again.
A major got wounded in combat, dragged him to the medic. He's dying. Can't even give orders. The privates are talking:
"When he dies, let's pour one in honor of his memory".
As soon as the major hears "vodka", he gets to his feet, takes the vodka, and drinks the whole thing. Then he puts the privates on extra duty for planning to drink without a direct order.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_AL_Lukash_DamTalk_: The control room is all set up for the call. There'll be no surprises if you bring the money. Otherwise, the whole Dam will be there to say hello.
I got everything. Is it the same route? Couldn't find a different one?
The pipe is the only place with no guards. All the other routes are being watched and patrolled.
If I see any kind of a set-up at the Dam, I'll have enough time to shoot you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_DLC01_denis_kull_0: I never saw Mavka this determined. Like clockwork: precise, on point. She says Lukash was the one who taught her that. But if you ask me, she's good enough to teach a couple of lessons herself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_DLC01_kola_sinner_: Did you notice Mavka's new bracelet? I asked her who crafted such a beauty, but she wouldn't say. I wanted to give Birch one for the armor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_LO_Announcement_Ro: All personnel who have been outside base perimeter, report to the medical unit immediately.
High command has enforced stricter penalties for unsanctioned runs. The updated regulations will be available to record clerks.
Attention! All personnel. A reminder on the mandatory maintenance for communications equipment. Deliver all equipment to Lieutenant Campana.
During the personnel search, an artifact has been discovered. Safety measures have been enforced. There is no threat to life at this time.
Tomorrow, we will begin a scheduled inspection of ventilation filters and radiation protection at personnel accommodations.
No more requests for personal call time will be submitted until further notice. Designated commanders will be informed on the results of application review.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_LO_BruteForce_Alar: Attention! Unauthorized entry into IPSF territory. Use of deadly force is permitted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_LO_IPSF_AfterHeli_: Attention! A group of unauthorized armed people have breached IPSF territory. All personnel – to your positions, immediately.
Make sure no one gets out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Baranov_BasePer: Got eyes on an outsider. Watching him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Baranov_Intrude: Base perimeter breached! Shoot to kill!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_IPSF_ChangeGuar: Come on up, the brass wants to see you. Tinkering with electronics without giving anyone a heads-up again?
I didn't do anything! Last time I checked the fuse boxes was a month ago. Not my fault the comms are down!
Don't tell me, go to the commander. I'll stay here for now. Keep watch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_IPSF_NoConnecti: Come in. Private Gutiérrez, starting patrol route.
Come in! Do you copy? What's up with the comms?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_IPSF_ScarySteps: The comms are down again. At least the brass won't be bothering us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_IPSF_SilentBase: Here we go. As soon as the paycheck comes in, the comms are down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Kolo_MercenaryF: Get rid of witnesses, find the stash, get the stash contents to base. Understood?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_MSOP_Enforcemen: Zone team, come in! What... is going on over there? They’ve... on high alert... already in the tin cans and rolling!
How... I know?! But if...  you guys all the way... Mainland, we’re in deep shit!
Keep... We’re close. It’s... be alright.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_EndPlan_B: His words hit close to home, but I want to see and check everything for myself. Go join the others. They'll meet you and brief you on the plan. I've sent you the coordinates, and a small reward, too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_EndPlan_N: How did Lukash manage to walk around here without being discovered? It's a shame I'll never find out. You good, Skif?
Yeah. But I won't be making any more calls to Chekhov.
You won't have to as we discussed everything we needed to. He said the exact same thing I was thinking. The thing Lukash was always saying – Freedom took a wrong turn.
In exchange for us helping him find the technology, Chekhov sent a recording of his conversation with Myklukha. Looks like there's another serious chat coming.
Do you believe Chekhov? What he said about liberating the Mainland? And the possibility to create Oases?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_EndPlan_Z: We'll find out if he was telling the truth soon enough. Now, go to Zulu. He needs some help with the mercenaries.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_GoingLoud: Skif, you might as well launch some fireworks!
Hurry up to the control room. I'll meet you there before IPSF sends reinforcements.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_KoloExplo: I don't understand what Lukash got himself into. He disappeared, went off comms, and now it turns out he didn't just work with the mercs. Now we've got this IPSF key card.
Everyone has their secrets in the Zone. But we believed in the same idea, we were on the same side! We could've sorted this out together. And he could've stayed alive…
Maybe, it's simple and he didn't want to put his people at risk. So he stayed quiet.
In the end, we're risking it anyway. Would've been better if he just explained it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_LeaveBase: Skif, we weren't just cut off, IPSF tracked the signal source. Let's split up and hit the road. The boys and I will watch your back from outside, if we can. Mavka out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_NearDam_F: I see a loner. He's approaching base.
Skif, if that's you, try not to sound the alarm. Better get in through the same pipes we're using. Coordinates sent to your PDA.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_NearKolo_: Skif, connecting you to Zen. He's the brains of our operations and knows everything about routes and locations. Zen, brief Skif on the Antenna Complex.
We already searched a couple of stashes and they always have something in common – a low-key location, usually swarming with mutants. We'll have to fight our way through.
The Krug Antenna Complex has an underground floor – a rather large facility. My guess is that's where the stash will be.
Lukash used to say that everything in the Zone can be an advantage, even mutants. I wonder how he got past them every time, though. Mavka out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_RadioOff_: The stalker's almost at the spot. Just like a ninja.
Sinner's about to cut off IPSF's comms too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_SnorksFig: Skif, Mavka, I don't know what that means, but we found a key card with the IPSF insignia in one of Lukash's stashes.
It's gotta mean something. Skif, look for traces in your stash. Maybe you'll be able to find out what that key opens.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Mavka_StashFoun: Skif, we looked through everything here. Your stash is the last one left.
I'm almost done. I found out that Lukash was paying this IPSF soldier, and he helped him contact someone from the Dam.
Oh! So our key card's gotta open the Dam! That means we need to get there – we'll figure out who Lukash contacted once we make it. Zen, get me info on how to get in and out.
I also found a remote control. I'll give it to you at the Dam.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_SinnerCool_Bar_: Dude, do you think they've got a bar around here?
You think anyone will serve you drinks? I really doubt that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_SinnerCool_Guy_: Vegging out, heh? Could at least take your uniform off. It'll get all sweaty when you're asleep.
Leave the dude alone. Mavka said he was helping Lukash – that's why he's still breathing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QC_Suslov_PsyActiv: I'll try to track it down. I might need a bit more time.
In the meantime, I'll get to tracking mercenaries down the old-fashioned way.
Zen, help Zulu. The boys and I need to take care of something. Skif, I'll meet you at the Dam.
Suslov here. I picked up a few strange psi-activity spikes. Most likely that the mercenaries have started experimenting with the technology.
Can you find out where it happened?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QD_Chehov_Sequence: Do you know why Nord needs all this?
Revenge. Nord and his people used to work for the same people the Ward did.

And when the Ward came to the Zone, they decided to tie up loose ends. Nord lost a lot of his people. Lost them… in a nasty way. Our work finally gave him the chance to not just survive, but settle the score with his ex-employers.
I don't know what he's up to. But in his hands, the technology will bring nothing but destruction.
While in our hands, it'll liberate the Mainland. It'll save the world.
When Nord attacked Lukash, I contacted Myklukha and told him that the mercenaries would kill anyone they see as a threat or a witness. I asked him to warn his people and help me stop Nord.
And?!
He said no. He didn't want to risk someone finding out about Lukash and his work. That could've led to unpleasant consequences. Give people… ideas.
I… I don't believe it. He's… one of us.
I think that's the reason he was so eager to blame Duty. Anyway ... I have a little gift for him ...
Skif! The roof! Reactivate the antenna! I have to know what he meant!
Well, now we know what to do next. And we'll have to do it on our own.
Wait! I must talk to Myklukha. You said it yourself: if the technology ends up in Nord's hands, it will be everyone's problem. Myklukha will listen. He's not one to risk people.
I really doubt it.
You're right. I've tried.
He found a part of the technology in the Bubble, but we don't know where he went after that.
After the Workshop, Lukash and Nord's next stop would have been X16. He's gotta be there, for sure. He needs something only available in that lab.
Do you know me?
Lukash mentioned you. Enough times for me to remember. He spoke so highly of you that I learned to understand why he could never put you at risk. Even for our cause.
It's more than a technology. SIRCAA were just copying existing anomalies, and not always successfully. But this allows them to create unique ones and control them.
I wish he'd spoken to me, not of me. Is your goal linked to the technology he was looking for?
Not a weapon, but a gift from the Zone. With its help, we'll free the Mainland.
You could try.
I've tried.
We know he's looking for information on the Spatial Bubble.
Bubble? The Bubble? Getting into it will be hard, but getting out – way harder. That much I know for sure.
After the Workshop, Lukash and Nord's next stop would have been X16. He's probably looking for the missing part of the technology in the Bubble. You must find it before him.
What made you work with Nord anyway?
He's the best out there. I didn't think a thirst for revenge could cloud such a rational mind and he would betray us just to settle an old score with the Ward.
But you are Chekhov! You created Freedom! You could have recruited our people.
You can think of them as our people. But you can also think of them as Myklukha's people, and our ways have parted long ago. He's not interested in freedom for the Mainland anymore.
How does creating anomalies help liberate anything?
…anomalies can be different. Take an Oasis, for example. Just imagine how many people we could help…
Now I understand what Lukash saw in you. The Zone isn't merely a threat, the Zone is also possibilities. And Oases are just one of them.
We can change the world. Make it a better place, for once.
This is exactly what Freedom was born for.

This technology will end the monopoly of corporations and a small group of elites over resources. Healthcare, energy, logistics – everything will change. This will be the foundation of a new order. One that is fairer for everyone.
Why did you and Myklukha go separate ways?
We used to work together – him, Lukash, and I. Myklukha was the one who found the technology on his expedition behind the Scorcher.

I don't know what he saw there. But after coming back, he stopped believing in Freedom as Lukash and I saw it. And when I went off to the Mainland to prepare our rebellion, Myklukha took matters into his own hands.
He's turned Freedom into the most powerful faction of the Zone, but none of its members believe in its ideas anymore. Only in coupons.
I had neither time nor desire to counteract it. My war is way bigger than… this.
I also believe that ideas don't die. Freedom will remember what it really stands for. And since you're here, maybe that will happen sooner than I expected.
We're looking for someone who desperately needs this technology.
What Lukash was working on has been destroyed. And all his work fell into the hands of the person who killed him. Nord.
Nord worked for Lukash and me. He wants to use the technology as a weapon. This threatens both the Zone and the Mainland, as well as our plan. What else do you know?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QD_ChekhovMavka_On: Channel's encrypted, signal's live. Connecting. If I'm right, the Mainland will never know who's really tapping in.
This is either an anomaly, or it's… Chekhov. The founder of Freedom...
Glad to see someone still recognizes me. And I recognize Lukash's bracelet. Was it hard to track me down? He was a master at covering his tracks and hiding everything in stashes.
No harder than usual. The stashes didn't just contain info on a mysterious ally from the Mainland… but also a trophy.
Interesting. Looks like a part of the technology Lukash was trying to find for me. So it's not so bad after all, Mavka.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QD_Mavka_Immediate: Skif, hope you got the coordinates. Krug Antenna Complex. Take everything that looks valuable from the stash. The boys and I will cover a couple of other locations.
Why did Lukash need so many stashes all over the Zone?
He was being extra careful. Wanted to make it more complicated for the curious people trying to get their hands on his work.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QD_Mavka_LongComba: Stop dragging your feet, Skif, this isn't the Arena. We need you here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ07_QD_Mavka_StartQues: Skif, I heard you already got Zulu's business sorted out. I just happen to need someone smart to take a look at Lukash's stash. Got anyone in mind?
For someone who needs help, you're not even trying.
Skif, please! Pretty please! Check the Krug Antenna Complex. That better?

Long story short, Lukash kept information in different places, because he knew others would be interested in it. My dudes and I are combing through a couple of other spots. Here are the coordinates to yours.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_AL_AngelContract_D: I'm so fucking fed up with these containers. Soon as we're done – not with the cargo, but with all this in the lab – I'm off to the Mainland.
Buy myself a country house, and forget about all this shit the Ward got us into. And you? Got any plans?
My only plan is to get revenge on those Ward bastards for our boys. Haven't really thought what I'd do after.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_AL_LehaPikaTalk_C4: Dude, we're outta here. We didn't sign up for this BS.
If you don't finish your job, you won't get your coupons. Or any future jobs.
Screw these orders! You can chase mutants around the lab yourself.
We'll keep the explosives as payment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_AL_SlavenkoHutinic: Shit, I can't see. Fine. Make a note of it.
Test number 197. Day 45. Subject is resistant to sedation…
He's too unstable! Shut it down. Shut it down!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_angel_0_Busy: Not in the mood to talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_denis_kull_0: I don't keep track of the ones I killed. Sinner gives me a number, and I just add two because I always work faster.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_dzen_0_InfoT: When I first got into the Zone, I thought I'd be better off as a lone wolf. But when I found my crowd, I came to realize it's better to stick together.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_kola_sinner_: It's bullshit what Cool says, that he doesn't count how many he's killed. He does. He keeps track of everything. That guy is obsessed with numbers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_leha_pika_0_: Stalker, I only talk money. Wanna talk about a job? Let's talk. Yay or nay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_maks_vizen_0: There are jobs that are more important than the coupons you could get for them.
Better to stay with your pockets empty and be a part of them, rather than sit by the fire and listen to the stories about what you missed out on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_radovoj_amad: I'm not supposed to share any info. If you've got something important, go to my commander, if not, don't waste my time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_radovoj_temn: You can't ever let your guard down in the Zone because danger's always around the corner. Especially when mutants are lurking nearby, or – their best friends – Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_sakal_0_Busy: What the hell do you want?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_sariv_0_Info: After missions like this, you either get put higher up the chain or get put six feet under. I prefer the first option.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_serzant_fari: About five years ago, Zulu got me out from a mutant's maw. He didn't ask for anything in return, so I said it myself – that I was in his debt. It's time to settle up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_serzant_svar: My advice is simple – always be realistic and don't go looking for trouble. Then you won't have to whine by the fire about how a bloodsucker bit you in the ass.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_suslov_0_Inf: What if we really could find a way to control the anomalies? How would that change everything?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_timur_drimer: Here's my policy: coupon now, chat later. Freedom is all about that.
And Mavka's people take a job first, get knee-deep in it, and don't even always ask for money. It's like doing something is rewarding enough.
I don't really know how that works, so I stick to my own routine.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_valik_dzun_0: I don't like chit-chat. A lot of Freedom guys will talk your ear off, but then they're demanding coupons for their own time. It's not worth it.
Let's pick up where we left off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_verin_0_Info: I'll be the top gun thanks to Zulu! This is way more serious than chasing some mutant around the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_DLC01_vitala_garaz: You're dead! Wait till I get up!
The Zone has a hierarchy, just like any other place, got it? Customers pay mercs to do their dirty work, and mercs pay us to get our hands even dirtier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_AngelFudgi_Cant: Fuji, can you remember how many days it's been since we got into the lab?
I can't. I stopped counting the day Wardens shot our boys dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Pahse1_Mavka: They look like fuses! Shoot them to stop the platforms.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase0_Mavka: We need to figure out how to shut down the Brain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase0_Zulus: You gotta find what powers it!
We need to shut the damn thing down!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase1_Mavka: Look for a button! It should lower the bridge to the platform.
Press the button and go to the platform!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase1_Zulus: Shoot the fuses! They'll stop the platforms.
Push the button to get on the platform!
They look like fuses. Shoot them! They should stop the platforms.
We need to lower the bridge to the platform. Look for a button.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase2_Mavka: Get away! Get away from me!
I can feel the psi getting stronger! Skif, shoot the fuses!
You have to stop his plan. We need to destabilize the Brain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase2_Zulus: Psi is getting stronger! Destroy the fuses!
Why are there so many of you? You won't get me! Aaah!
You have to stop his plan. Try shutting down the Brain.
I hit Nord! But he's still alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase3_Mavka: Looks like it's mad at us. The device is trying even harder to defend itself.
We need to shut it down. Now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase3_Zulus: We're about to get our brains fried!
We need to shut the damn thing down! Now!
Like it couldn't get any worse!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase4_Mavka: Skif, the device is in agony. We need to hang on!
Shoot the fuses on the cables! They're connected to the Brain!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BF_Phase4_Zulus: I think we made it pretty mad! We need to hang on!
Shoot the fuses on the cables! They're connected to the Brain!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_BanditsAboutX16: Where are the fireworks? You said the Duty guy was supposed to give us some dough.
So? I don't need to show 'em off like it's a holiday parade. They're fine in the stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_C4_Commands_toa: Nord's orders: don't let them get further than the stairs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_CFour_AfterBoom: What the fuck? Where'd that bang come from? Main door, deal with it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_DreamerVizhen_C: Mon ami, did you request a huge paycheck for this little job, too?
I agreed to do it for free. All I needed was a good gun to make sure I can go on this mission and do my best.
Ooh la la, we got ourselves an idealist.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Duty_AttackAtCa: My team's starting to clear the lower level.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_CallsDenis: Cool, Sinner, sending my location. Get over here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_ISeeYou_IS: Schwartz, Temnykov, take cover. Someone's coming.
Oh, that's Skif. Stay where you are.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_LeavingLab: Skif, we got a parting gift from Zulu. It wasn't enough to leave us to die – he's put Duty soldiers here to finish off the survivors.
My guys are short on ammo. Help them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_OpenDoor_t: Skif, my guys told me where they last saw you from the ventilation. Looks like you're on your way to the wing where the exits only open with a merc key card. Where are you now?
Some living area. Looks like their temporary camp.
Comprende. I'll open the door for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_ResqueSkif: Those key cards we took off the mercs sure came in handy for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_SkifHelped: Don't forget the recorder. I hope you won't need it, but if Chekhov was right about Myklukha… Anyway, better grab it from the stash.
Skif, thank you. We'll take care of the wounded inside and outside X16. You can go to Rostok.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_SkifNotHel: We managed. But we took some serious casualties.
We'll deal with the dead and wounded here, Skif. You should go to Rostok.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzen_WeNeedHelp: Mavka, Zulu's people ambushed us at the exit. We need help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Dzun_BeforeAssa: The fight hasn't even started, and I already got two. Cool!
Exactly: we're just getting started. I'll beat you, easy-peasy.
Cut the chit-chat on the group channel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_FarinAmadiaChat: Get a grip, Private. If it weren't for this guy, Cool, they would've shot you already.
I would've taken that merc myself… It jammed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_FreedomAllies_I: What's with all the noise? Is Zulu breaking the walls down?
Yeah, exactly, just like we talked about. You got your head up your ass, or something?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Grachik_WeAreAt: Commander, we've got Mavka's Freedomers at the exit! Requesting backup.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_KolyaDenis_2ndV: Cool, I don't know about you, but I killed two mercs already, and wounded three more.
Did you count the Duty guy too?
Stop it! I said I was sorry. And it was just a scratch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_KolyaDenis_Surg: I thought the mercenaries were the most ruthless guys in this lab. Turns out the scientists who used to work here were even more cruel.
Yeah, I sure wouldn't want to end up as one of their guinea pigs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_MavkaSuslov_Cha: Fine, I give up. I'm all out of options. Who did Lukash contact from the Dam? Tell me.
Chekhov! Yeah, man, I talked to him too!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_Bossfight: Shoot the fuses to stop the platforms.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_BusyNearC: Skif, we all have a lot of work to do. I need to gather the guys, and Zulu's already waiting for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_CallBefor: All cool. I'm with our sniper dudes, in position.
Got the key from the mercs. On my way.
Okay. Wait for my signal, and stay quiet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_CallFreed: Zen, gather the team. Let's discuss the plan.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_ComeNear_: Skif, there you are! Come here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_Interact_: Go without me. I'll help the wounded.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_Orders_st: Mavka here. Skif is good to start the mission. Guys, get ready.
Zulu, we're ready to start. You?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mavka_PlanMRadi: Skif, why the hell did you run off to the lab? We were supposed to discuss the plan first.
Okay, dude. Here's what you gotta do.

So, our main goal is to find the technology before Nord goes through with his own plan. When we're there, we'll figure out the best way to turn it off safely without breaking it since we'll need it later.
We'll enter through the side door, and Zulu's dudes will storm in through the main door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_MercsWarnAboutA: So fucking deal with it! The second spot was also just attacked!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mercs_TalkAndWa: Not for long. These rats are gonna start fleeing soon, so be ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Mercs_Talk_Band: Why the fuck didn't Nord send more people here? There's a shit-ton of boxes!
Some of them are busy someplace else. Stop messing about, and get working!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_NordCFour_Call_: I see movement. A loner. Over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_NordSequence_1_: If you took my revenge from me… If my people died for nothing…
The Perimeter might survive, but you won’t.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Nord_FightFive_: I will do what I came here to do!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Nord_FightSeven: I'll avenge each one of my people!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Nord_FightSix_g: You can't get in my way!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Nord_FightTwo_b: The Brain will fulfill its purpose: it'll destroy the Perimeter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Nord_FirstCall_: Skif, you thought you could keep a low profile and I wouldn't find out you're here?
You can hide, but you can't get out of here alive.
Skif, your name's been coming up way too often lately, and that's bad. For you, that is.
You shouldn't have come here. You won't get out of here alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_SharivVerin_Tim: Thanks. If it weren't for you, we would've had to backtrack. Would've saved ammo, but not time.
Private, five-minute break, then we keep moving.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_ShvarcTemnikov_: Why did Freedom get the part of the lab crawling with mutants?
You could've volunteered for their squad if you wanted it so badly.
I know we're working with Freedom, but I'm more comfortable going on a mission with my own people.
So, Private, are you ready to sacrifice your life defending Freedom?
I sure hope I won't have to.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_StuckDuty_AskFo: No friendlies anywhere near you. Mavka, any of your people near them in the vents?
Skif, you took that route. If you haven't gone far, clear the way for our guys.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_VerinShariv_Loc: That stalker took off. Now what?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_VerinShariv_Tal: Whatever's waiting for us inside, it's gotta be bad.
It sure will be bad for all of us if we don't stop the mercenaries. Follow the orders, and stop overthinking it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulu_PlanRadio_: Skif, why did you go alone? You could've screwed it all up!
Fine, here's what you have to do – and stick to the plan!
So, our main goal is to find the technology that Nord stole. We can't let the mercenaries use it for personal gain – well, we can't let anyone use it, not just the mercenaries.
Inside X16, the explosions will distract the guards and divide them into small groups. Set the explosives onto the walls with cracks in them to be sure the bang is enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_ZulusAllies_Can: All clear. Someone beat us to it.
We need to thank Mavka's people later. Has to be them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_ZulusSuslov_Cha: I still can't believe you saw Tachenko. I thought he was long gone.
He is, actually. We just got the chance to see how he'd been guarding the technology for all those years.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_AlliesCal: Mavka's people are good to go. Faryn, what's the situation? Over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_BeforeLea: Can you imagine, Skif – it wasn't enough to leave us here to rot, and she had to order her people to finish off the survivors!
Help my soldiers deal with the ambush. They were getting the wounded out, and they need help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_Bossfight: Our main target is up top. We need to keep moving.
You need to go the other way!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_BusyNearC: Sorry, Skif, but my people are already waiting for me, and Mavka's waiting for you. Later, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_CallBefor: Heading to where we'll breach the entrance.
Escorting the Freedom group. Five minutes out.
Great. Stand by for further instructions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_CallDuty_: Schwartz, gather the rest of the team. Let's discuss our plan.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_InteractA: I'll stay here for a while. I want to go through the mercenaries' documents. Go on without me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_Orders_st: All units: get ready for the attack. Sergeant Faryn, clear the way for Skif to get into the laboratory.
So are we. I'll get Suslov in a minute.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_SkifHelpe: Skif, thank you for helping my people. I didn't have many soldiers to start with, and now…
Now we need more fighters, and we need the general's help. I guess I'll see you at the Concrete Plant.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QC_Zulus_SkifNotHe: Hrachyk, you good there at the exit?
We managed. It's handled. But we've got a lot of KIAs.
Skif, I hope you're halfway to the Concrete Plant. The situation's got even worse. We need to talk to the general.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Bandits_Trade_K: We're gonna teach you some manners.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Bandits_Trade_N: I do. But I don't think I'll need them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Bandits_Trade_P: Nice to have a civilized conversation! Not like those damn mercenaries.
The explosives are yours. Take them from the stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Bandits_Trade_W: I don't have that much money on me. But I can bring it later.
So you came for the goods, but didn't bring the coupons? Who does that, loner? That's not nice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Bandits_Trade_h: Look what the cat dragged in.
Duty sent me to get some explosives.
Shut up. Doesn't matter whether they sent him, if the guy's got coupons, we can make a deal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Dialog_SuslovMa: Did Chekhov make an impression? Is it because of him that you're so eager to find this technology?
No, I'm doing this for all of Freedom, and the ideas of our faction. Chekhov just shed some light on our past, and said he was willing to help us in the future.
If I get my hands on the technology and present it to Myklukha and the others, we'll go back to our roots. We won't just change the Zone for the better, we'll liberate the Mainland.
We will bring freedom to everyone.
This might come in handy in combat. If you haven't got one already, get yourself an NVD. And stay on comms. Good luck to us, Skif.
I'm ready to go.
Okay. I'll give the others a heads-up.
So, you did all you needed to do? Then let's get on with the attack plan.
You need another refresher? Okay. Our main goal is to find the technology that Nord stole. We'll try to turn it off carefully, before he gets the chance to use it for his personal gain.
You'll enter the lab first, through the side door. We'll wait for Zen and follow you in.
Zulu's guys will get in through the main door. From there, we'll move further in at the same time and cover each other.
Where are Zulu and his people? Shouldn't we wait for them?
Duty is in position already. Waiting for Zulu's order. And he's waiting for me to tell him we're ready to start.
We'll try to move at the same time, all the time. And cover each other.
Meanwhile, I'll take Suslov to the main device in the lab. He said he would help turn it off if something goes south.
Okay, man, Zen is on his way, so you'll be the first to enter X16. We'll join you a bit later using his key card.
Any trouble or are you ready? If you need time to get ready, do it now before we start the op.
Okay. Tell me about the plan, in detail.

So, our main goal is to find the technology before Nord goes through with his own plan. When we're there, we'll figure out the best way to turn it off safely without breaking it, since we'll need it later.
You enter through the side door, we'll be right behind you. At the same time, Zulu's guys will storm in through the main door.
I need a bit more time.
Okay, but be quick. All teams are in place and we need to go in at the same time from different directions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Dialog_SuslovZu: They didn't exactly give me a warm welcome.
Not surprised. It'll be the same in the laboratory.
And here's something for you to deal with the mercs: the explosions alone won't do. Good luck! Stay on comms, the channel we share with Freedom.
I found out why they wanted to get rid of the goods ASAP. It's the explosives from X16.
Well, then let's return them to the owners, shall we? Set the charges across the laboratory they've camped out in.
Everything's clear, I'm ready to go.
Let's get to it.
So, Skif, are you ready to get into the attack plan? If you have any more questions, now's the time to ask.
So, Skif, do you need a refresher on the plan? Our main goal is to find the technology that Nord stole. We can't let the mercenaries, or anyone else, use it for personal gain.
My soldiers will take down the guards, and the way through the main door will be clear. Inside X16, set the explosives onto the walls with cracks in them, then go deeper into the laboratory.
Stay on comms, the channel we share with Freedom. Let's try and watch each other's six.
How did it go with the bandits?
Are you doing all this because of what happened to Tachenko?
In a way, yes, it's because of him. Tachenko had to sacrifice his life to keep that technology safe, and I don't want anyone else to sacrifice theirs.
I couldn't stop the mercenaries then, but I sure will now. Those "gifts of the Zone" shouldn't end up in the wrong hands. They shouldn't exist in the first place.
This is my duty.
Hope you're ready to start the attack. If you need more time, get ready and join us later. But don't take too long.
Shouldn't we wait for Mavka and her people?
They're in position already. They'll enter at the same time, but from the other sides of the building.
Mavka will get the professor in through the ventilation. They'll make their way to the main device in the laboratory.
Take this. In case we'll need an emergency shutdown of the equipment, it will be better to trust someone qualified with it.
I need to get ready.
I understand, but hurry back. We don't know the results of the tests in that laboratory. Better to stop them now than have to deal with the effects of those 'experiments' later.
I'm ready. Brief me on the plan.
So, our main goal is to find the technology that Nord stole. We can't let the mercenaries use it for personal gain – well, we can't let anyone use it, not just the mercenaries.

We enter through the main door: my boys will take the guards down. Inside X16, the explosions will distract the guards and divide them into small groups. Set the explosives onto the walls with cracks in them to be sure the bang is enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Dzen_AfterTrap_: If you don't count the electricity hiccups because of the mercs, all according to plan. Moving on with minimum casualties.
We lost some of our guys before we went into the lab. The rest are moving according to plan.
Glad we could make a pit stop, but we have to keep moving.
Get to the center of the lab. We're coming there as well from different directions.
The mercenaries sure didn't expect us to get in through the vents, or to make it this far. While they were trying to ambush Duty, we took the mercs out from above like shooting ducks in a barrel.
So tell Zulu he owes Freedom some drinks. And since he doesn't drink, I'll have a cup of tea with him.
You sure made some noise with Duty there. The blasts almost knocked us out up there in the vents.
Are you moving any further? Want to talk about something or should we move on?
Do you have any information on Nord or the technology that he stole?
All we have in our part of the lab are mutants. So many of them that it'd be enough to cover Duty's monthly quota.
Haven't heard anything about Nord or the technology, but that would be an interesting find. And I don't mean the mercenary.
Mavka mentioned an Oasis. I'd love to take a look at it, too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Dzen_Exposition: What can you tell me about Mavka?
I met her on a mission Myklukha personally gave her. Mavka was responsible for the plan and the route, the rest of us had to carry the package. I was the first one who volunteered to join the group.
The plan was good, but we were ambushed, and had to go down into a tunnel. From there, we only had two ways out: through mutants to the customer, or through the rubble to Rostok.
We thought she'd send us to the mutants, go last and deliver the package. But Mavka decided that even a mission from Myklukha himself wasn't worth dying for.
And Myklukha just let it go?
Hell knows. Got her working in the Arena and, word is, has the meter running. I stay outta people's business.
This place is need-to-know. Mavka found it and made it all cozy. Sometimes, I'd pop by to discuss our run plans.
Zulu comes over every now and then – we invited him after his first Arena fight. Mavka was the only one who bet on him. Can you imagine how many coupons she got!
Now, there are more and more of us. But please don't go around telling everyone about this spot. You don't look like a blabbermouth.
Yeah, come on in. They won't start discussing the plan till everyone's there. Tell you what, though, there'll be enough work for everyone.
Just think about it: Freedom and Duty working together! I can't remember a single time that ever happened before.
Mavka's already inside with Suslov. Come on in.
Mavka's somewhere nearby. You can wait inside with the others.
Amigo. Thanks for your help, especially at the Dam. Now you know how fast Mavka usually operates.
This cause is too important for her. It's good we got another pair of hands. Hands that are good with weapons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_EmbryonIsFound_: I got a tip on where the technology is. Heading there now.
Not so fast. I wanted to be there, too. Send the coordinates.
Okay, stop. Let's do this together. We don't know how many guards are there.
Okay. It's a party, then. Sending the location.
We found out where the mercs were hiding the technology. I'm heading there now.
You don't think I can manage?
You can, but you're not going to do it like we discussed.
Let's keep working together. We don't know how many guards there are, so Zulu should send the coordinates to all of us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_KolyaDenis_Lab_: Sinner, check your gun before we move out.
You check yours. You're at least two mutants behind.
Like everything in the Zone, could've been worse.
I'll second that, man. But we haven't cleared everything yet.
I didn't think there'd be so many creatures around. But my expectations are my own problem, right, man?
Skif, good to see you're finally here. It's a shame our initial plan to get in here fell through.
How did you manage to move through the lab? Did that go smoothly, at least?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_MavkaAfterEmbry: You see that? I offered him to stick together till the end. And he… he destroyed everything!
He destroyed what he couldn't understand! What could have liberated the Mainland!
Typical Duty – ready to follow orders till his dying breath. I do hope it doesn't have to come to that…
Mavka, time to get out. What's our next move?
I don't know. Let's… let's find Suslov before psi-radiation kills us. Then we'll deal with Nord.
After that, I'll talk to Zulu. But I doubt he'll understand what he killed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_MavkaDuringLabA: Cool, Sinner, hit the brakes. Cover me and Suslov.
And you, Skif, move deeper into the lab. Go up through the vent.
And, guys, remember – our main goal is to find the technology. Tell me as soon as you see it.
Better still, shoot it as soon as you see it.
No. Nobody shoots, until we figure out what to do with it. Mavka out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_MavkaExplainsHe: Does anyone from Freedom know about the attack plan?
Those who do are mostly the guys I've been working with already. Myklukha is clueless: I can brag later, when we have a result.
As for some new recruits, they're more interested in how much they're gonna get paid, not so much in what they're up against. And they sure don't care about what the technology does.
We reap what Myklukha is sowing. Nothing but coupons, coupons, coupons. Doesn't give a shit about liberating the Mainland.
So, we'll take the side entrance, but we need to find a way to open it. We can't break it down, or we'll make even more noise than Zulu at the main door.
Therefore we'll have to steal the key cards from the mercenaries. We saw them use those cards to get into the lab.
That's the job I have for you: intercept the mercenaries who go out of the lab.
Oh, and nick an NVD from them: they mentioned it for some reason.
Ready to get started. Tell me what to do.
We know that there are two spots receiving cargo for the mercenaries. What we don't know is which merc will have the key. So Zen will check the first spot, you'll take the second.
Once you get the coordinates, try to be quick – it's unlikely the mercenaries spend too much time outside admiring the view. When you're done, head to the rally point.
How do you know where the mercenaries will be exactly?
We intercepted info about yet another delivery they're very eager to receive. They'll have to take a walk to get the goods, and that's the perfect opportunity to empty their pockets.
About that call we intercepted – man, it is loud in that lab! I couldn't think straight just hearing that through the PDA. How are their brains not fried in there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_MavkaWhenAtX16_: Skif, my key card doesn't work. Are you okay in the lab?
Comprende. We'll check the entrances to a different block, then. You need to restore power, or you won't be able to move any further.
Look for a fuse box. The blueprint puts it on the lower level.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_MavkaWhenSkifOp: Skif, we used another door to get in. Move deeper into the laboratory – all the hallways lead to the center, so we'll meet there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Mavka_AfterBoss: Do you really think going to the CNPP is a good idea?
You got a better one? Fuck, sorry. I know it sounds insane. When I started looking for Lukash, I never would've thought it could go this far.
And now… What else can I do? Stand and watch Zulu kill the rest of the specimen? Watch him strip the Mainland of its freedom?
I won't let him. There's no way Freedom will let some Duty guy destroy the gifts of the Zone.
What was that way to get to the CNPP you mentioned?
I heard about underground stations connecting the X laboratories, and Myklukha personally controls the entrance to that Monorail. I'll tell him everything I found out about the specimen.
I'm guessing he'll let me in and get the whole of Rostok buzzing when he sees how Freedom could benefit from it. And how it could change the Mainland…
But, you know what, take my recorder.

I hope you won't need it, but, as my friendship with Zulu proved: it's better to trust someone while having a gun in your hand than just going with blind faith. Grab it from our spot… My spot in Rostok.
And Skif, thanks for having my back. You made the right call, but now Zulu's people are your enemies. Be careful.
I'm sorry it turned out like that with Zulu. You OK?

His first fight in the Arena, I was the only one who bet on him. I saw something in him back then – I believed in Zulu more than he believed in himself. But it didn't take him long to forget all the good things.
The Oasis saved him, but he won't admit it. The technology could've liberated the people on the Mainland. But he can't even imagine being free.
He tries so hard to look fearless, but he didn't have the guts to kill me with his own hands. If the situation were reversed, I wouldn't hesitate.
Well, Skif, you know what they say – keep your friends close, and your enemies closer. That's how it turned out with Zulu…

I trusted him. Thought he really listened to me, and was ready to see the world from a perspective other than Duty's. Turns out that he only pretended to agree with me – he'd already decided to destroy the technology a long time ago.

It was always easier for him to break something instead of figuring out how it worked. Things, and people, too. He blamed the Zone for it. But it wasn't the Zone that made him like that, he's always been that way.
I'm sure he'll be putting together a team to go to the CNPP, but I hope I can beat him to it. If my guess is right, I'll have someone show me a short way to get there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Mavka_AskAgain_: What? You want me to tell you about the job again? Okay. Head to the spot where the mercenaries will be unloading cargo.
Jump them, and look for a key card. That's the only way for us to open the side door to the lab. Got it?
Great. You have the coordinates. We're waiting for you and the key.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_PlanTheAssaultW: I prefer to keep it quiet. I'll go with Mavka.
Thank you, man! I have a job I want you to do first. A warm-up before the attack.
Okay, then. We can manage on our own.
If I need to get into X16, I prefer the main entrance. I'm with you, Zulu.
Thank you, Skif. Help me out with another thing before the attack, then. Warm up a bit.
Okay, we'll clear our part of the lab no problem. We'll beat you to it!
Hmm, let's discuss it later. Now's the time to talk about the X16 attack plan. That's where the mercenaries are holed up.
Okay, right, let's table this for now. We need to talk about the X16 attack plan instead. That's where the mercenaries have set up shop.
Skif, did you and Zulu find what you were looking for?
We found a whole city that shouldn't even exist. And that whole huge anomaly was created by the technology the mercenaries now have.
Well, so it obviously has potential. We just need to figure out the best way to uncover it…
Let's discuss the details.
There are several entrances into the laboratory. My people and I will take the main entrance. We'll go in as loud as possible and draw the guards' attention.
I already have some ideas on how to separate their forces into small groups where we need them.
Meanwhile, we'll go in from the side entrance: we haven't spotted any guards outside. We'll try to keep a low profile while inside the lab, too.
The ventilation system mostly goes the same way as the route Duty will be taking, so we'll be able to cover them.
So we work together and move at the same time. Once we find the stolen technology, we'll talk about what to do with it. Now, Skif, you decide who you'll go with.
Are you sure the laboratory isn't just a pit stop for the mercenaries?
We are. They pulled all their forces there, and there's been more psi-activity since.
The professor thinks Nord was interested in the X16 equipment. We need to try and find out more about what the mercenaries are planning to do with it.
Yes, I am quite curious about those experiments…
But, of course, not in an improvised environment with those goons instead of scientists.
As if it makes any difference in the Zone…
Why did we decide to take two routes instead of everyone just using the same one?
So that we can circle the mercenaries and cut off their escape routes. We need to deal with them in one blow.
Plus, we don't know exactly where they're hiding the technology. It can either be regular hallways leading to it, or secret passages. We need to check everything.
So, we have two plans of action, and we need to pick one?
No, we're working together, as we always do. And you can pick which team you'll go with.
Yeah, we're a bit short-staffed. I hope you agree to join my boys, Skif.
Zulu, that's cheating. My team's no bigger. Let Skif hear both options and make up his mind.
We need to destroy things like that, not figure out how to use them. It doesn't even matter who's going to try to control it or how. This is dangerous.
Come on! Who controls it and how — that’s what matters! The technology is just a tool.
Skif, I heard you found Chekhov.
Yeah. He's been on the Mainland for a while, but managed to do business with Lukash from there. He wanted his help to get the technology, but now mercenaries have it.
Seems like everyone wants a piece of it.
No wonder! Loads of people would like the chance to use that potential.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Shariv_PlansChe: All good: loud and clear. Moving on with hardly any casualties.
We lost some soldiers even before the laboratory attack. But we're moving according to plan.
Glad we could make a pit stop, but we have to keep moving.
Same. We'll try to get to the center of the laboratory.
Hope we'll see each other out there.
I do have to say that mercenaries are a serious enemy. If it weren't for the explosives, it would've been almost impossible to breach the main entrance.
Have you got any news about Nord?
None. We're still looking for him.
And for that thing he stole. Though I don't have a clue what that 'thing' is even supposed to look like.
But Zulu said it was extremely dangerous, so I'm ready to shoot anything that looks suspicious.
It would've been a lot harder if we didn't have Freedom with us. Thank the boys for covering us from those vents.
It's a shame you're not going with us. We could use someone like you in a fight against mercenaries.
I can see you're busy all right. Want to talk about something or should we move on?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_SuslovMavkaZulu: Guys, listen to what the mercenaries are up to!
Chekhov was right. We need to shut down the technology to make sure it doesn't harm the Mainland. We'll worry about helping the Mainland later.
Nord, I'm always on your side. But are you a hundred fucking percent sure we should connect the technology to this whopper?
And do it alone, without that deaf ol' fart? It's gonna go fucking bang! And you don't know where that bang will be!
Oh, yes, it will go fucking bang. But I know where – at the Perimeter. Then we can watch the Ward and their masters make a fuss.
They'll answer for shooting so many mercenaries like damn cattle. They'll answer for every person they've been hunting down in the Zone and on the Mainland.
And don’t forget – orders are not up for discussion.
I told you that technology was nothing but trouble. We need to destroy it!
Just listen to what they have to say about why they came here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Suslov_AfterEmb: Attention: I stabilized the Brain! The psi-effect will now start to drop.
It's good I didn't have to use the notes on how to kill the power on that thing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Suslov_BeforeAs: Yes, it's time for you to get briefed on the attack plan. Mavka will tell you everything.
I don't think getting into X16 will be easy. Whichever way you take.
But for the possibility of seeing what's inside and feeling like you're part of something great? I guess it's worth it.
Yes, see you in the laboratory.
Yes, it's time for you to get briefed on the attack plan. Zulu will tell you more.
I was tracking psi-levels near X16 and noticed a couple of spikes. I suppose it has something to do with the mercenaries attempting to turn the laboratory equipment on.
It scares me to think what those 'scientists' are up to. So I did some digging and came across some notes on how to operate and shut down a psi-emitter.
While I was at it, I also read about some tests they used to run in X16. Large scale, rather ambitious – and entirely inhumane. But I guess you don't have time for these stories of mine?
What exactly could this technology in the X16 equipment do?
I don't know for sure, but I suppose it could be used as an amplifier.
I was only able to take a quick look at the information on those devices. It was in the same SIRCAA documents the mercenaries were looking for.
What exactly did you find out about the tests?
The main device in the laboratory is the psi-emitter, it's surprisingly powerful. We can only imagine how strong the impact inside X16 would be.
So, this very impact was being tested on different species. Most of the time, it was on those you wouldn't ask permission from, but sometimes on those that were strong-armed into not having a choice.
And those are just the experiments with a description clear enough to understand from the paperwork. Even more of them are classified or beyond the scope of my experience and understanding.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Suslov_Expositi: If you had an opportunity, would you create an Oasis?
Tempting as this experiment might be, it's dangerous. Ever since an experiment like that once, I've had episodes of hearing hyper-sensitivity, so I know what I'm talking about.
I'm quite used to the ups and downs now. One minute I can't hear anything around me, the next, I'll go crazy from the sound of someone's teeth grinding.
But… I'd still take the risk. Yes, the Oasis couldn't save Lukash, but it did heal Zulu. Maybe it could help me, too.
Why did you stop studying anomalous energy and become a merchant?
Oh, that was a lifetime ago, Skif. I remember being upset because nobody seemed to give my ideas any credit. But were those ideas really worth attention?
I became a Clear Sky merchant simply because I needed a way to stay in the Zone and be close to the project. Then I realized I liked that line of work quite a lot.
And then, when I lost part of my hearing and all of my confidence as a scientist, mercenaries contacted me. Finally, someone who needed my expertise. The bitter irony.
What are you planning to do before we attack?
I'll try to help find information on the equipment stored in the laboratory. Especially any tips on how to turn it off.
I hope you won't have to pull any plugs or break the equipment in a hurry. Nothing good could come out of that kind of vandalism.
Time for me to get going.
Yes, Skif, we have a lot of work to do. Good luck.
I suppose the mercenaries didn't pick that laboratory as their base randomly. They could have used any other place as shelter from the rain. They need the X16 equipment.

You can run large experiments with that equipment. My guess is Nord's ambitions are just as massive. I could only dream of creating an Oasis, or something similar, back when I was studying anomalous energy.
I can't even tell what's worse: if the mercenaries successfully connect the technology in the laboratory, or if something goes wrong. Right, it's probably time for you to get going?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_ZulusDuringLabA: All Duty units: move to the center of the laboratory and block the exits form there so the mercenaries can't get out.
Skif, go up through the chemical laboratory.
So, Zulu, if you manage to advance in the laboratory, will that mean a career advance too?
I'll know after I deal with the technology.
Don't "deal" with it, we'll figure it out together. Like we agreed. Mavka out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_ZulusExplainsHi: Anyone from Duty know about your attack plans?
This job is need-to-know, and we have enough people for the operation. Voronin doesn't need to know.
It would've been easier if the general knew and gave it the green light, of course. But the green-light part is tricky.
He takes too much time pondering on the pros and cons, then orders a retreat.
You'll find them at these coordinates. When you're done, get to the rally point. We'll discuss the attack plan in more detail.
So, we need to get ready for the attack. We'll be entering the laboratory through the main door and distracting the mercenaries with explosions placed in specific spots.
To make sure it all goes smoothly, we need to have our people ready, and get our hands on some dynamite. I'll take care of the people as I have experienced fighters that are bored and ready to roll.
You take care of the explosives. But don't worry, I'll tell you where you can find some.
How do you know where to find explosives?
I needed to find them fast, and without drawing too much attention. All Duty warehouse explosives are carefully inventoried, and you can't trust the merchants to hold their tongues.
Then Owl introduced me to some people who keep a low profile, but still needed cash. Seek, and you shall find.
Ready to get started. Tell me what to do.
You'll have to go to the old barracks to find the explosives. That's where a group of bandits set up shop.
It looks like they want the meeting to be peaceful and quiet. But I'm not entirely sure they can be trusted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_ZulusX16Entranc: Skif, we need to divide the mercenaries into smaller groups. Set a charge on the wall near the main door, but make sure to keep your distance when you shoot it.
Then, go down the elevator shaft. When you're in the lunchroom, blow that up as well.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Zulus_AfterBoss: Do you really think going to the CNPP is a good idea?
Better than doing nothing. I have no illusions for the CNPP, I know how dangerous that place is. But even if the others refuse to go there, I will. To stop Mavka… to kill her.
I have no illusions when it comes to her, either.
Mavka thinks these mutants represent the future. A future I wouldn't wish upon anyone.
You think Myklukha will agree to help Mavka?
I'd bet on it! Myklukha can't pass up profit. As soon as he figures out what those mutants are worth, he'll send his people to the CNPP that very second.
I hope Duty won't stay on the sidelines, either. There's no better time to rid the Zone of all that filth.
Who do you plan on going to the CNPP with? You can't go alone.
You, I guess. Who else? Seriously, though, I wish two people were enough for this 'tour'. I don't know how I can get more soldiers…
The only option I see is to talk to the general. I'd rather pick another fight with the Brain over having that conversation. I don't even know if he lets me stay in Duty…
But let's hear what Voronin has to say, then we'll see what we can do about it. Head to the Concrete Plant.
But be careful: Mavka's people are your enemies now. And thank you for your help, Skif. I wouldn't have made it without you.
I'm sorry it turned out like that with Mavka. You okay?
I'm fine. Just having some trouble standing straight with this knife in my back.
I'll keep doing what Duty was created for. We're here to destroy the Zone's scum, and since we found more, we need to deal with it.
I hope the other Duty soldiers haven't forgotten why we're here.
Well... I thought I knew her well, Skif. Trusted her more than I trusted myself. And she left us here to die.
"That is your true face." – from the same person who said she'd be there at my worst. I thought I didn't deserve a friend like her.
She's no different from those mutants! Worse, even. At least mutants dosn't know what they're doing – she does!
She knew what it would come down to, and she used me to clear the way for her. Probably discussing her plan for the CNPP with Myklukha already. And I… Well, I guess we'll meet there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Zulus_AfterEmbr: Grrr… what the fuck was that? You got in my way and protected this like you're saving the Mainland!
No mutant, ever, can create anything good! Mavka can't imagine what that beast is capable of. But I do! Tachenko did!
You! You were in the Bubble too, you understand.
We… we dealt with this, and now we have to secure the Perimeter. Head to the professor, then we'll find Nord.
I hope Mavka is okay, too. I'll talk to her when we deal with Nord. I hope she'll understand I was right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_QD_Zulus_AskAgain_: So, did you manage to get what we need? Okay, I'll remind you: we need explosives for the lab attack.
You've got the coordinates. When you take them from the bandits, meet me at the rally point. We'll discuss the plan and head to X16.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_mavka_0_InfoTopic_: I wonder what created the Oasis.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ08_zulus_0_InfoTopic_: I don't really appreciate Mavka's special interest in that technology.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_AL_Chekhov_Recorde: What you are going to hear might be useful to you. Use it at your discretion.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_endru_briz_0: I, for one, think Freedom is going round in circles. Myklukha's gone overboard with his trading. It's okay to make some cash, but we've become nothing more than a shop. Except we don't issue receipts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_kira_fitil_0: Stop bothering me. I've got stuff to do.
Some people are talking about a truce. What fucking truce?! They were shooting at us! There are no "Myklukha's Freedom members" for me now. There's us, and there's them. We're enemies.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_kola_traven_: Later, I'm not in the mood…
A Bulba almost dragged me in the other day, then bandits jumped me, and then mutants attacked! I barely made it to Rostok.
Here I am, waking up, and we're at war. Am I ever going to get any rest?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_sanyachief_0: This is not the right fucking moment!

I remember Mavka back in the day, when everyone would laugh at her, another show-off. She fell, made mistakes, but she got up and kept going, getting stronger. People like her don't know "impossible"!
So, where did we stop? Ah!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_valikkantri_: The Zone provides for hard workers, not the lucky ones. Your most valuable artifact is a working gun and a working mind. And a good pair of hands.
Whatcha standing here for? Let's get to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_vetal_hanter: Where do you think you're going?
The best thing Freedom has to offer is stability. Myklukha made sure of that. Thanks to him, folks are staying alive. Coupons are the best armor and insurance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_vita_flesbek: Get lost, dude. I'm one step away from Nirvana.
We said hi already, didn't we?

Folks ask why I'm on Mavka's side. It's simple. While the old farts were counting coupons, she was looking for something that would change the world. Yeah, she'd screw up, make mistakes, but she'd keep going forward.
I got distracted and forgot what I was on about.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_DLC01_vovabayker_0: What?! Can't you see I'm busy?
A lot of folks don't get why we need the Arena. It's the most honest thing in the Zone! Crowd's roaring, adrenaline all over, two go in, only one goes out. Better this than shooting at each other.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_LI_Miklucha_Round1: A miracle saved the loner. Seems he didn't want to die that easily.
Did you really come to the Arena to make deals for my people with Mavka?
You're in my Arena. Down here, even the air's against you.
You're ready to die for Mavka. Would she do the same for you?
Well, listen to that, he's turned on Chekhov.
For your entertainment: elite fighters versus a stray stalker!
Let's wish him an easy death!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_LI_Miklucha_Round2: The stalker wants a champion's medal. But all he gets is a champion's bullet.
Ready to wash the cage with your blood?
Stop fussing. Face your death with dignity.
There's nowhere to run – you're here to die!
Whoever makes it out alive will still become mutant chow.
And our debutant will help with that!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_LI_Miklucha_Round3: I'll have to do it myself. Time for me to reclaim Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_LO_Arnie_UnderCont: Rostok! Everyone, put your weapons down. Show's over. Anyone who's wounded, don't panic. Dr. Kyrylov will patch you up soon.
Rostok hasn't fallen, that's all lies. We'll keep living here in peace, I promise. While Mavka is away, come and see me instead if you need anything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_LO_MavkaAnnounceme: I'll say it one more time: Freedom! We all see our future here differently. Some think it's coupons, others believe in ideas.
But it's time to get together and decide what Freedom will be like. Let's all gather at the Arena!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_AmsterdamFray_B: You heard? Our Mavka's back in the Arena! I've got a feeling this is gonna be huge!
Looks like huge trouble. She's got the whole of Rostok on their toes.
That's the point! She'll get what she wants, you'll see.
Yes. At any cost. That's what scares me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Arni_ComeIn_Cha: Okay, Skif. Time to go in?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Bereza_GoToAren: Why are you not in the Arena? You'll miss all the fun!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_BikerCountry_Jo: Man, let's get outta here, and fast. Damn that money! What if they start shooting at us again?
What, you don't like it when a firefight's for real, not in the Arena? Chill out. Once the dust settles, there'll be enough work for us for a whole year. Fixing this and that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Bougi_AboutMavk: I wonder what Myklukha has to say about all this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_BreadFight_Brea: You'll get your bread and your circuses!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Fitil_CryForHel: Is that you, Skif? Over here, quickly! I got shot...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Flashback_Bewar: Myklukha's people are still lurking around the camp. Our camp.
People! It doesn't matter if they used to be your friends. They picked their side. And they won't think twice to shoot you first, if you're not faster.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_GandjaChief_Cha: Ganja, what is Mavka up to this time?
I don't know anything. No fights were scheduled for today.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Grizzly_NeedSup: Skif, we need your help here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_KantriBayker_Be: Hey, who's gonna finish your work for you? You want me to do it, again?
I can't work when stuff like this is going down, man! I'm off to the Arena. You're coming too. Follow me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_KirilAntonovych: These youths... Needs to make a show out of everything. Oh, Mavka, Mavka...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_KolaTraven_Wake: Damn, how long was I asleep?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Mavka_StolenKil: I'll make sure Freedom will be ours again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Miklucha_Round3: We both made the mistake of believing in her…
Are you ready to die for someone else's idea?
Even if you survive, you'll never get out of Rostok alive!
How do you like Mavka's Freedom? You're dying for it in front of the crowd.
Wanna kill me? Gotta try harder.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Miser_HotelDoor: This one's closed, too. Fuck meee.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_RostokGuardsNoR: Dude, do you know what Mavka and Myklukha talked about? She stormed outta there, furious. Slammed the door without even a hello or goodbye.
I guess she got told off for making friends with a Duty member, so she got upset.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_RostokGuards_At: It's game over for Mavka's friends!
There he is, that bastard! He killed Myklukha!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_RostokGuards_Ch: Shit, we're missing out on all the fun. I'd love to see Myklukha putting that show-off in her place.
You moron, she's offering you a chance at something new! A chance to see beyond money! And you're kissing up to Myklukha for coupons.
Yeah, right, dude. I bet you wouldn't wanna fight on nothing but ideas and enthusiasm!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_RostokGuards_Ra: Find that stalker! He's here somewhere!
I see a group of Myklukha's mutts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Steal_Steal_795: Eugene, I'll knock the door down if you don't open up!
Try me! No way you're getting to the market! Everything's boarded up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_Steal_Steal_821: Everything? Really? I'll just go around, then.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_SyferChief_Exec: Bro, what the hell? Are you gonna shoot me because some wench told you to?
