Mavka is right. Freedom has to change. And you, Myklukha's followers, have to leave.
I thought we were pals. Turns out you always were a rat!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QC_TradersChatter_: You won't even come to hear what Mavka has to say?
So you get all my clients? Na-ah. After you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QD_Arni_BeforeAren: Does Freedom gather like this a lot?
Sometimes, but the reasons were different. If Myklukha decided on something important, he'd call everyone to push it through. Like it was everyone's decision. That's the way it always was.
And now, Mavka broke the unwritten rule. Rallied the crowd all by herself. Means something serious is about to go down.
Looks like everyone's pretty worked up about this meeting.
I think it's time for us to go in.
Hold on. Feel this moment. This is a show like no other in the Zone. And I don't mean fights. We never had anyone other than Myklukha call for a meeting.
Got you thinking, ha? Now go in. I'm right behind you.
Everyone's there already. The Arena's packed. You have questions, or are we good to go?
Mavka said you'd be stopping by.
Champ, are you up for a fight in the Arena? I'm kіdding. Hope you won't have to.
Are you the one Mavka sent?
Are you letting me in just like that? Isn't Mavka only gathering Freedomers?
You're part of that crowd. I've been in her debt for ages, so it's time for me to return the favor.
Myklukha won't be too surprised to see you. He knows you've been working together. I guess he wouldn't even be surprised if he saw Zulu here.
One hell of a fighter, by the way. Always puts up a spectacular fight. Painting bloody masterpieces with his bare hands! I'd love to see him again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QD_Birch_AfterFigh: Yes, his body is in the Arena.
I might never leave Rostok after what I'm about to say, but this was the one thing he couldn't buy his way out of… Makes me respect Mavka even more.
You looking to catch your breath or get some new gear after the fight?
Let me take a look at your stock.
Aren't you concerned someone might force you out of your shop in all this mess?
All the market players are holding the perimeter. And Eugene is watching my shop. If he does a good job, I'll give him some gear for his troubles.
But what he's really after is beating Ragman, and not letting him secure a spot as good as his.
Why do you respect Mavka so much?
If you were in this business for as long as me, you'd get it. It makes you see who gets stuff done, and who uses coupons to paint over the cracks. Myklukha paid for gear, weapons, food.
It was just an investment for him, and Freedom was his personal guarded bank. He'd always hide from us behind mercenaries. While Mavka is one of us. She is who she is.

Sticks up for all of us. She even got me out. Put the word out right in the middle of a fight in the Arena, and everyone took off to save me from the shootout. That's why I'm helping her in any way I can.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QD_Bogey_ChatterWi: Whatever Mavka's got up her sleeve, I won't leave Rostok. My people won't, either.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QD_Fitil_MedkitTal: You see that, ha?! My own guys, got me a slug for lunch! Medkit... Quick, please!
Shit, it hurts... I hope Mavka's people find me here...
Thanks... That's what you get for playing anarchy, damn it. Now, instead of hunting mutants, we're hunting each other. What's going to be left of Freedom at the end of the day?
I don't regret following Mavka. I believe her. But I never thought it would all turn out so... bloody.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QD_MavkaAfterFight: I followed him and trusted him – we all trusted Myklukha because there would've been no Freedom without him. Now I can see we didn't have a chance to win with him alive.
But we wouldn't liberate the world, or the Zone, with his coupons.
Skif, take his PDA. It should have info on how to get to the Monorail. Give me the medkit and leave me be for now. I'll do it myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QD_MavkaLeaveRosto: Skif, no reward could cover you standing up against Myklukha with me. I… I'll never forget it.
I'll live. Time for you to get the hell out of Rostok. Zen, you there? Take Skif with you while I get this sorted out.
On it. Listen, amigo, if you need to stock up on anything, go to Birch's store. She only sells to friendlies she knows.
Try to keep it quiet. And get ready – who knows what's in that Monorail? Could be dangerous.
Got lucky, it just grazed me. Nothing but another scar.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_QD_Mavka_Round2_Ca: Shit. I'll turn the power on. There's a switch in the Arena. You'll be able to turn the lights on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_aleks_fraj_0_InfoT: I'll head down to the Arena, listen to what Mavka has to say, then I'll give you the latest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_barmen_0_InfoTopic: If you wanted to know what Mavka's meeting was all about, I don't know. Heard this and that at the bar, but that's just gossip.
You can find out the truth in the Arena. If Arnie lets you in, of course.
As for me, I'll stay here and get ready for work. 'Cause if Mavka brought good news, everyone will be celebrating. If the news is bad, they'll be drowning their sorrows.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_bereza_0_InfoTopic: I'm all for settling disputes with a conversation. Bullets aren't the answer, merely a means to shut up whoever has a different view.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_bereza_0_Meet_Meet: This announcement of Mavka's got me nervous. Means there's some kind of news, and my guess is that it's not good news.
We've got our hands full with the war against Duty. So I hope this Arena thing doesn't bring any more trouble.
Gear up a bit, maybe? Might come in handy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_den_krasnov_0_Info: What matters to me is that the other mercenaries and I get to keep our jobs. We'll find common ground with whoever's willing to pay for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_ganza_0_InfoTopic_: Ah, man, they closed the Arena down for now. And I was on a winning streak! Maybe Arnie's scared they're rigging the fights for booze? Heh. I'll wait for them to reopen it.
After that call to the Arena, everyone's stopping by for a Yorsh. It's never too late to have one last drink before whatever's waiting in the Arena!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_laguha_0_InfoTopic: Each faction has their idealists who genuinely believe in what they're doing. They're living for those ideas alone. But very few of them are also willing to die for those ideas.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_laguha_0_Meet_Meet: It's good that Mavka's keeping busy. Found herself something to do, dug deep, and came back with results. And willing to share them with everyone.
It must be something important. Wish I could give someone a recorder and listen to what will go down there. Guess I'll ask around after.
If you gotta get somewhere, I can show you a shortcut.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ09_starevsik_0_InfoTo: I've no clue why Mavka started all this fuss – the whole of Rostok is buzzing. Took all my customers with that meeting of hers.
If you have something to say, take it to Myklukha. Can't you see people are working?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_DLC01_lejtenan: What if the Monorail and Rostok were connected…
I'd be like: drink a shot of vodka at our old bar, give Myklukha a proper bitch-slap, and then jump back!
I wanted to tell you something.
No one in the Zone can fight mutants better than Duty. So don't be a show-off – sit and learn from the grown-ups.
I'm sure there are stalkers out there who'd be happy to see the Monorail with their own eyes.
I'd wanna see those poor guys' faces now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_DLC01_serzant_: What if the Monorail is like a huge artery that monsters use to crawl into every corner of the Zone from the laboratory?
Let's get rid of it once and for all. Make everyone's life easier.
A lot of soldiers wished for less of the daily grind around here. Like, it's always the same: hell cat, morning PT, cleaning, breakfast, marching drills and so on.
Well, be careful what you wish for.
In peacetime, Zulu and Voronin were at each other's throats. When this whole Mavka situation started, they found common ground, just like that.
It's easier to be a team when you're teaming up against someone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_DLC01_starsij_: Take your questions to the brass.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QC_bujnov_0_Ch: If only I'd known the Monorail would be like this…
I hope the general knows what he's doing.
We won't make it out of here alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QC_kurcatov_0_: I wanted so badly to get to the Monorail. Not anymore.
I want to get out of here already.
That's a whole damned lot of them!
Take all the wounded to the elevator!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QC_kutasenko_0: They gotta promote me after this.
They're swarming in here like moths to a flame.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QC_molotko_0_C: Stinks like moldy, rotten flesh and rat shit. Just like our barracks.
I'm in the mood to chop some monsters up.
When do we get to fight?
What the hell is that piece of crap?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QC_molotko_kut: Stop snoring like you're asleep! I keep thinking it's a snork behind me.
My bad! My nose gets stuffy in the gas mask.
Then get outta here with that nose of yours! Find somewhere else to do it. I'm jumpy enough as it is.
Yes, sir! I'll find somewhere else to snore.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QC_pusko_0_Cha: What a freak's loitering up here...
Are they ever gonna stop coming?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QC_ugarov_0_Ch: I hope the worst part is over.
Now I can say I've seen everything in the Zone.
What the hell is this shit?!
If we keep going like this, we'll be out of ammo in no time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_ArmoryAudio: Zulu, get the wounded one to the elevator. Tell group two to get down here.
Everyone stay together, and get ready for the next wave!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_Armory_JobI: Good job, soldier. I'll send someone to get the explosives.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_AudioPlay2_: Holding the line. Mutants are swarming.
Work in pairs! Cover each other!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_FireExtDisa: The fire extinguishing system is off.
Great. Now, when the gas explodes, nothing will stop the fire. The station will burn to the ground.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_GasRoomExpl: Loner, come in. If you see strange fog over the floor, be careful. It's a technical gas with a dye.
It's toxic, so don't stay in it for too long, or you'll cough your lungs out.
The silver lining? Mutants can't see or smell anything through it. You can use it to take cover from the beasts.
Don't worry about shooting through it, either. It needs extremely high temperatures to start burning, but let's not get ahead of ourselves. You'll get the chance to see that later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_GuardiansWh: Did Voronin send you? Almost on time. The mutants will breach any minute now.
Do you know what kind of mutants?
Hell if I know. The group that went in isn't responding.
And does that happen a lot?
Maybe four times in a whole decade since we settled here at the Cement Factory. But it's the second time this year.
Hurry up, I hope the guys down there are still alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_MonorailPre: Skif, all done. Time to start phase two. Come back here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_NarSequence: The Monorail is a mass grave. I swore not to send any more people there.
I've been down here before. I went into this elevator a commander full of life, and came out an old man.
That's in the past. Today, we will return as victors.
Being able to return is victory enough. But that reassurance is why I appreciate you, Zulu. Duty needs people like you, especially now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_PrequestZul: See those charges, Skif? That's a strange tactic Voronin has. Why put out a bunch of small charges instead of one big charge?
One good blast at the entrance and the problem's taken care of. But people died trying to cover up all the holes. Why is Voronin being so careful?
The soldiers have set the explosives, but didn't have time to detonate them. We should finish the job, right? I'll cover, you shoot the charges!
General? The breach problem is taken care of. Our people... didn't make it. But they managed to set the explosives.
Why risk the lives of your soldiers for a couple of small, precision explosions? One larger charge would've taken care of the problem.
Yes, but it would've created a hundred new ones. One big explosion could have opened even more passages.
I know where the mutants are coming from, Zulu. I know what's down there. And if you still want to get to the CNPP, you'll find out for yourself.
You and Skif, get to the elevator. We need to discuss this in person.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_Prequest_Vo: Even the Shulha incident didn't make you change your mind?
Zulu doesn't need to know about this. Yet, the blame is mine. I appointed Shulga to that position.
Yeah, Zulu crossed the line. Beat up a senior officer, could've killed him, but he stopped. On his own. That says a lot about a person.
Zulu has a beast inside him – but he also has a leash he keeps that beast on.
Have you known Zulu for a long time?
Quite so. I was the one who welcomed him to the Duty ranks.
He's impulsive, yes. But his ideals are sound. Duty means something to him.
There aren't many like him among us, let alone in the rest of the Zone.
It used to be the Monolithian base, now it's a burial ground. A territory the Zone itself closed off, no one in or out, and guarded by a massive anomaly.
That damn thing will fry your brain from a distance, turning you into a zombie in seconds. I've never encountered anything like it.
My soldiers reported zombies of every kind crawling from the Station's territory. Bandits, loners, Freedom. Getting there above ground is certain death. Or worse.
I think Zulu has some self-control issues.
Zulu isn't that simple, that's true. He has inner demons. But who doesn't?
He blames himself for his rage more than any one of us does.
If you're ready, get the elevator and let's go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_Prequest_Zu: Report to Voronin, Skif. I'll finish up here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_SkifExplosi: Skif, go to the other side!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_SkifOtherPl: Skif, you need to get to a different platform. We'll manage here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_Station_Sec: Keep your weapons ready and stay frosty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_Ventiliatio: This was the last room. Let's go, Skif. Time to burn this place to the ground.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninAllC: Clear. Zulu, this is just the first batch. There will be more. Secure the territory, and meet our people by the elevator. Skif, come to me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninCome: That place is bad news, so we need to work fast.
The station has five key nodes. While my people are checking the weapons and getting everything ready, we'll take care of the systems.
We need to activate all of them before starting the train. The priorities are the ventilation and the armory. Questions?
What do we need from the armory?
It has the thermal charges we'll use to blow up the station.
The gas won't explode from grenades and bullets – we need higher temperatures.
Okay. We will go to the first node together.
We'll start with the ventilation. Follow me.
The Monorail ventilation system. That's how we will spread the gas from the armory across the whole station.
It's also where I lost comms with the previous group.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninElev: Good work at the checkpoint. But what you saw there is just the tip of the iceberg.
The whole Monorail is underneath us. Miles of tunnels, swarming with mutants. That's where they're breaching from, and that's our only way to the CNPP.
I'll take you there, Zulu. But I'm warning you now that not everyone will get home safe.
So, we have a chance, but it's not great?
We do. But there's no guarantee. If we go down there, we might not get back up.
How dangerous is it down there?
Dangerous enough to only take the reliable ones. The youngsters are staying at base to secure the Factory.
If anyone has to get into this bloodbath, it's the seasoned fighters, not rookies.
What if the forces we gather aren't enough?
Then the mutants will get a free meal, and Freedom will get their victory on a platter.
Why are you only talking about it now?
Because I know my people. And I know Zulu.
He would've stormed in there, convinced it's his duty. Then end up dead with all the others.
Are you with us all the way to the CNPP, or just for the Monorail?
Every one of us fights their own battle. The Monorail is my fight, and I have to see it through to the end.
And what's going on at the CNPP is Zulu's fight. But I'll be there to make sure he wins it.
Where’s Zulu?
I'm here.
We're willing to risk it. What's the plan?
Here's the plan: we go down, start the train, and get the gas at the station lit up on our way.
Two birds with one stone – get to the CNPP, and make sure there are no more breaches at the Factory, ever.
Make sure you stock up on everything you need – ammo, medkits, food. As soon as we're in the elevator, there will be no going back.
Tell me about this Monorail.
An artery of Project X, connecting all the laboratories to the Mainland and to each other.
A few years ago, I sent my best people there for reconnaissance. A covert mission. None of them made it back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninEsco: Listen, you're a sharp one – you and Zulu have that in common.
But I've known Zulu for a long time. What's in it for you?
Because it's the right thing to do. No one should be able to use this technology, ever.
Your heart is in the right place, Skif. You have the same values as Duty.
I decided to help Zulu. He seems like a good guy, and you won't find a lot of them in the Zone.
You're right about Zulu.
I don't know. You could've just sent your people there.
I wasted too much time sitting around in my office, Skif.
Project X technologies can be destroyed, the Zone can't. So I have to make every effort to do so.
I'd never been a desk jockey before I ended up in the Zone. But I don't care about being a hero, Skif. I care about my people and their lives.
You're helping Zulu.
I guess you heard about our troubles, right?
Honestly, Zulu is his own enemy, rather than mine. Some of his wrongdoings are still haunting him, even after all those years.
How about that? I wanted to raise Zulu to be my successor. But now I'm thinking, maybe he's already got there? Perhaps I'm just not ready to admit my time is up.
Why do you think I'm here?
Controller!
Go, Skif. I'll stay here for a while.
To say goodbye.
Get a grip, and stay frosty.
Forgive me, Ginger. I couldn't keep you safe. You were more than a commander, you were my right hand…
The mutants have been dealt with. Now for the ventilation.
We already tried to pull it off with the charges. I secretly sent people here, but none of them made it back.
This Controller is a tricky bastard. It's laying low, hiding. I thought it had gone already, but it was there. Waiting.
And, as you can already tell, we saw the group that went missing. Fuck…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninExpl: Make sure to set these charges. Place them in two spots near the end of the far platform.
Then, we'll just need to open the tunnel, hop onto the train, and activate the charges.
We'll use this remote detonator to activate them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninGo_R: The pass is clear. Reinforcements are on their way down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninIdle: Thermal charges are stored in the armory. When activated, they'll ignite the gas, and the whole station will go up in flames.
The ventilation will spread the gas through the station, and the charges from the armory will ignite the gas.
Plus, we lost communication with the previous group there. We need to find out what happened.
What do I need to do again?
The station has ventilation, an armory, a room for gas cylinders, a generator room, and a pumping room.
All systems in these rooms need to be activated. Take the ventilation and the armory, my people will take care of the rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninOpen: Final push, Skif. Do you see the dispatch room in the center? Open the gate to the CNPP tunnel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninSpea: This station is an old enemy of mine. It's been challenging me for years. Waiting for me to work up the courage for a real fight. So… here it is.
The Monorail is behind that door. The Zone's artery, the way to its heart – and that's exactly where we'll strike.
We will burn down every bastard that gets in our way, in honor of the fallen.
We didn't come here seeking glory. We're here because this is our duty.
And today, we will fulfill it!
Skif, come here. Take the charges. This is our fight, but we can't win it without you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninStar: You probably heard… Voronin is sending us to clear the breach – instead of stopping Mavka.
Mutants dug their way into the factory, swarming in from underground like damned moles.
It happens from time to time. But lately it's been happening a lot more often.
We'll get our chance to deal with Mavka, I promise. But we have to get rid of the mutants first.
I don't know anything about "us". It's just you the general's sending.
Aren't you with us? Both of us are in this up to our necks.
We'll do it faster together, it's important now. Every minute counts.
I don't remember giving the order to the loner. But if you trust him, I won't object. Having one more man on our side can come in handy in a gunfight.
How much time will we lose?
Every minute counts, and we're here playing with mutants.
I don't need your consent here, Captain. We can't go on the offense if our line is falling apart behind us.
Voronin is right. We should deal with the breach first.
No shit! Of course he is! But while we're fussing around here, Mavka must be halfway to the CNPP already.
Your partner is using his brain. And talking sense.
He might be, but it doesn't matter if we're out of time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_VoroninVent: You headed to the ventilation room? We'll go together. I won't let you go alone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_ZulusAndVor: Mavka wants to get the technology out to the Mainland. I need more people, General.
Your people, Zulu, are dead in X16. The only ones left are MY people.
They all knew the risks. They made their own decision. Mission accomplished. X-16 is no longer a threat.
But what for? A psi-signal from there woke up mutants from all around…
We're getting mutants swarming in from underground. Literally. We've got a breach at the checkpoint.
So Mavka will have to wait. And you... go clean up after all your hard work.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_ZulusIdleNe: Hurry up, Skif. Every minute counts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_ZulusMonora: Eh, it's been a while since I've been on a run with the general…
I underestimated Voronin. Thought he'd become a desk jockey. I'm glad I was wrong.
Voronin is a whole different person in combat. More… alive.
Happy to have you here with us. But you're probably not so happy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B01_QD_ZulusNearEl: You heard? Turns out the whole Plant is sitting on a ticking bomb.
The general was afraid we'd rush over to disarm it and die.
So he stayed quiet. Waiting until it goes off on its own…
What would you have done in his place?
I'd...have said the truth, I guess. And would get all of Duty there. We'd have casualties, but...
We'd have cleared that hole. Not sit on a powder keg.
You see the goal and forget what it costs. I can relate to that.
But you're a faster learner than I am, Captain. That's what matters.
The general was trying to deal with it low-key.
Low-key? As if the casualty rate would be low! There's no such thing. A casualty is always a casualty.
If it wasn't for this fuss with Mavka, we'd never have found out. We'd just keep sitting here, waiting for mutants to swarm in.
Cut the chit-chat! Everyone who went down there volunteered and knew the risks…
So did those who followed you to X16. You're not the one to judge me, Captain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_AL_Artrit_PDA_: Hundo, I was doing inventory and a couple of artifacts are missing again. Barque was the only one who had access to the rear warehouse. Maybe you'll finally put it together and report the bastard to Myklukha?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_AL_GodoArtefac: Cargo 612. There's one unique item among the ordinary ones. Properties unknown, value unknown. I'll leave it for further appraisal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_DLC01_drug_mav: I don't have time for this now.
Wait until I get up and shoot you in the…
I know not everyone likes me here, at the Monorail. But I'm head of security – I'm not here to be liked.
We didn't finish our talk, hey!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_DLC01_kil_0_Fi: I can literally feel something needs fixing. What is it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_DLC01_kil_0_He: If you wanna chat, go to Copper. I only talk shop.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_DLC01_kil_0_In: I was a technician here, I'm not one to look for trouble. But trouble still tends to find me sometimes. But you can't make an omelet without breaking some eggs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_DLC01_kil_0_Re: We were talking about something, if I remember right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_DLC01_vana_med: Don't mind Keel mumbling all the time, he's a friend you can count on. It's just the way he is.
Did you wander off to pick up some new jokes to tell me? Haha!
Everyone's got something they can share, and it's better to put it to good use. Like giving it to you, for example!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_LI_Barka_Threa: Listen closely, Hundo. You probably thought I was dead, and you're now in charge of the station. You were wrong.
Mavka and her people are on my side. One of those people is with me, and we're on our way to get you, you greedy piece of shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QC_Grot_Radio_: Hundo, we got guests. Mavka's stinking stooges showed up. We got them at gunpoint. What do you say we do with them?
Hundo, we heard shots fired, what's going on there? Hundo?! Answer me! Fucking…
Mavka here. You have a choice – either let my people go and let us get to the CNPP, or you become Freedom's enemy. Your choice.
Who said you were in charge?! Since when do you decide for the whole of Freedom? I'll show you my choice! *shots fired*
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QC_Kil_Explosi: Gonna have that ringing in my head. I'd prefer ringing in my pockets.
Clipped by an explosion or some other shitty surprise? Lay out your gear, I'll patch it up.
All right. We have a deal.
Barque needs the key as much as I do. We're all getting out together.
Keel, he's gonna lead us out. Give him the key.
Dammit… Fine, take it. And since you're our only shot at survival now, watch your step so that Mercury doesn't get you.
I only saved you for the key. If you don't give it to me, I'll kill you before the anomaly does.
The only anomaly here is your understanding of gambling odds. There's two of us, stalker, and only one of you.
You didn't forget about the Monorail key, did you?
Man, I get how this looks, but the key is our only way out of here. Without it, Mercury will eat us alive. What's the point in you saving us, then?
Keel's right. We aren't getting out without the key…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QC_Kil_Return_: No such thing as enough guns. You got us out, so now we'll return the favor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QC_Mavka_Train: Those near the wall, stay here and cover the retreat! Or none of us will make it out of here alive!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QC_Mednyj_Expl: Ugh, that dust in my throat… At least my ears seem to be working. Now I can hear everything going to hell.
Myklukha's dead, Freedom is a mess, and that hungry Mercury is everywhere…
But as long as I keep hustling, the cash keeps flowing. Wanna see my stock? You'll need it soon, take my word for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QC_Mednyj_Retu: Good thing we could talk this through. You can count on us!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_AfterNarSeq: There we go. Now gimme the key, and you can piss off.
See, Skif? I told you, Hundo is a scumbag and wants the artifacts for himself.
Myself? The boys and I will share fairly. We offered you a cut, and you said no, remember? A cut wasn't enough for you.
I still don't get it. How come anyone's helping you at all, Barque? Probably gave them some crap about how you don't need the train?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaAboutA: Skif, I found them. Sending you the coordinates.
The whole station is flooded with some kind of mercury crap. You forgot to mention that?
Mercury's harmless. Just don't get too close to it, and you're good. You're a seasoned stalker, you'll figure it out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaCallAf: Skif, did something go kaboom over there?
Yeah, I got Keel and Copper out. Got the key, too. Now tell me how to start the train.
You can start the train using the computer in Myklukha's room. Hundo and his people occupied it. But he's a shoot first, think later type of guy, just so you know.
I'll open the door to the second section, you'll find Hundo there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaExplan: Here's the deal. You're not the only one who needs the train. Hundo is planning to escape to the Mainland with artifacts and sell them there.
And even if we write off Hundo's men, you're not going anywhere. Myklukha was no fool. You need a key to fire up the train.
I gave it to Keel. He, Copper, and I were fending off Hundo's crew when I got nabbed. The guys are still somewhere at the station. Alive, or maybe not... hell knows. But the key has to be found.
Ask Mavka. She'll tell you if she wants to.
She's flown high from the Arena, as far as I can see, while I was stuck in here...
None of your business, Barque. Is there a queue for the train or something?
You got it.
Thank you, whoever you are. Are you from Rostok?
Yes, I'm with Mavka. And who are you?
I'm Barque, head of security at this station. Used to be.
Ever since Myklukha died, everyone flew off the handle. They all want to get their piece of the treasure. Especially Hundo, Myklukha's number two.
You see, he sent his goons after me. Good thing they didn't break any bones for real… Hundo's people are no different from him.
I'm looking for the underground train to get to the CNPP.
I see you're grabbing the bull by the horns. What do you need at the CNPP?
What exactly were you doing here?
Myklukha was looking to expand our trade with the Mainland. Prepared packages, artifacts, and that sort of shit for sale. Can you imagine how much that costs out there, on the Mainland?
And now… the contracts are still there, but Myklukha isn't. So Hundo decided to take the artifacts. And the contracts were pretty good.
I need you to tell me how to start the Monorail train.
No problem! But later. First, we need to get the key.
Who are these Keel and Copper guys?
Keel is our technician, and Copper runs the warehouse. He's got lots of handy gadgets stashed away.
So, you go look for the boys, and I'll open the door. Then I'll contact Mavka and tell her we've got the train. My people will help her get there.
What did Hundo's people want from you?
Do you really need a reason to attack your former boss? Some held onto an old grudge, some were chasing new opportunities.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaFirstM: Fuck… You're not Raven. But you don't look like one of Hundo's.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaFriend: Can anyone hear me? We're here!
Are you outta your mind? Hundo's people are everywhere. Enough with the yelling!
Maybe he did, maybe he didn't, and maybe Barque left us here to die! Now shut up and let me think.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaFriens: You were talking about Barque. What do you know about him?
He's quite the expert on artifacts.
Copper, save your jokes for Rostok. As for Barque… just your regular guy.
How did Mercury end up here?
It just turned up when Myklukha started storing loads of artifacts here. No one knows where it came from.
Who would've thought you can't throw artifacts in it, right, Copper?
What is this artifact?
I'm a technician, I don't know much. Ask Copper.
A very beautiful artifact, it can fly, too. Word is, they got it out of a water anomaly – rain that pours bottom to top. Wish I could see it.
Just make sure it's equipped, and keep going.
I got your explosives already. Run and hide, there's gonna be a bang.
Atta boy!
Pretty much. Go on.
It's not regular mercury, like in thermometers! Anyway, I'll tell you.
Fine, I'm off to find the explosives.
Be careful!
He's got nothing to be scared of. You're staying here with me.
I hear someone.
Keep it down! If you can hear him, he can hear you! What if it's Hundo's thugs?
Easy there. Barque sent me. I need the key to the Monorail.
See, Keel! And you didn't believe we were getting out!
I don't think I've seen you before. You said Barque sent you? If you need the key, you gotta get us out first.
I don't understand.
We don't know much about this Mercury either. Myklukha even wanted to call in a scientist to figure out what it is.
What happened to you there?

An unlucky retreat. We were fighting off Hundo's people and Barque bolted right away, so it was just Copper and me against five guys. We decided to fall back into this room and barricade ourselves in.
But the station is pretty old, the electricity was built a lifetime ago. Copper accidentally shot the lock, and it broke.
Mercury here is a kind of anomaly. It's drawn to you if it senses an artifact on your belt. Almost any artifact, with one exception.
We got a new batch of artifacts delivered to the station. There was one that was special. Well, Copper dropped the box. Like always.

Mercury gobbled up all the artifacts, as it does, and this new artifact started floating about – and Mercury just came apart. I think you could sneak into the storeroom with it. Take the key to the storeroom, too. It might come in handy.
What do I need to do?
As you can see, we're locked in here. You need to blow through the wall. There's no other way.
There should be explosives in the storeroom.
I'm telling you, the whole storeroom is flooded with Mercury. How will he get there?
Listen up. There are explosives in the storeroom. It's flooded with Mercury, you see the problem?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaGuardA: What the… That's the guy we saw in the Arena with Mavka! You got any idea what kinda mess we're in because of you, scumbag?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaGuardI: What a stubborn bastard. I told you he wasn't gonna crack. We need some tougher methods.
What do you suggest? Going back to Hundo saying, "oopsie, we couldn't get the key to the Monorail 'cause Barque wouldn't give it up?"
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_BarkaQuesti: Now look who's got the artifacts, and the train, and who's boss.
There's a catch, though… Hundo was telling the truth.
The train isn't going to the CNPP, it's going to the Mainland. As for you… this is the last stop. Mavka's next.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Coordinates: Are you there already? What's up?
Loads of trash, radiation, mutants. Looks like an abandoned cargo unit.
Try going deeper in. But be careful, I've heard they've got a whole private army guarding the place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_ExplosionWa: Skif is back! Did you find the explosives?
I did. Careful, it's gonna go boom!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Kil_Ask_1_8: Fucking shit! Skif! Don't kill us! We'll help you fight off Hundo's people, you hear me? We're not your enemy!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Kil_Ask_2_8: Fine, you have a deal. But I'm watching you.
Phew! Thanks, man. We won't let you down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Kil_Ask_3_8: If you were in cahoots with scum like Barque, only a fool would trust you now.
Fuck, then we got no choice!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaAboutS: Oh, wait, I almost forgot: at the station, there's a guy named Hundo, Myklukha's former deputy. It's likely people still take orders from him. Old habits die hard, you know.
So be careful. Whatever happened there, they won't be glad to see you. Over and out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaAboutT: Skif, we can't let Hundo's people bolt to the Mainland on our train! Hurry up and get over here, we gotta beat them to it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaCallAt: Skif, come in. I just had a chat with Barque. Is it true? Are you… working together?
They say nasty things about him. But as long as he's helping us, it's not a problem.
Anyway, he told me how to get to you. I'm heading out with everyone I managed to gather.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaSometh: Skif, I got some new info about the Monorail. And some bad news.
Looks like this whole station is Myklukha's Plan B. Makes sense since it turns out he doesn't have that many supporters.
Though, to be honest, not everybody likes me either. They just don't see the new Freedom the way I do… Anyway, enough about that. Mavka out.
No one can reach the Freedom members in the underground. Something's definitely up. My guess is this something isn't good.
What else have you found out about the Monorail?
Turns out that you really can get to the CNPP using it, but the most interesting thing is the way to the Mainland. I think Myklukha was more interested in the last part.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaTrain1: Skif, get to the cab! Start the train!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaTrain2: Skif, start the bloody train! Do it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaTrain3: Start the train and let's get the fuck out of here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_MavkaTrainT: Skif, the train! Fire it up! We'll cover you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Mavka_Start: Skif, I need more time. I've got some things I need to take care of. And this wound still hurts like hell. Are you on your way to Myklukha's coordinates?
Good. I'll need some time to gather people for our trip to the CNPP. I'll leave someone trustworthy at Rostok to make sure they don't make a new mess while I'm gone.
Contact me when you're on the spot. Mavka out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_NarSequence: Not so fast. I'm gonna blow this computer to pieces, and no one's going anywhere. Stand where I can see you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_RightAfterE: All good. Solid work, stalker. Come on over, and let's talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_StationComb: You're Barque's rat! The artifacts weren't enough for your greedy ass, so you wanna rip the faction off, too? You're freaking dead!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_StrangerCal: Hey! What's going on there? Can you hear me? Hey!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Techinican_: Hey there, man. You sure don't look good. I can help you get fixed up, but I can only do so much when I don't have my tools here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Trader_Basi: Wanna have a look at my stock?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ10_B02_QD_Trader_Firs: Hey there, man! Nice to meet you! Thanks for getting me out. I'll send you some thank-you coupons. Wanna take a look at my stock?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_aleks_bl: Wait till I get on my feet, dude!
Duty doesn't know how to fight mutants, they just shoot at them randomly. You need to watch them, study them, get it down to an art – that's the whole point of hunting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_artur_vi: They say, "keep your friends close, and your enemies closer", but I can't. I could never grovel to Duty, even for a mission. Got an old grudge against them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_azot_0_I: Voronin gave his life for us, the old fool. That commander was one of a kind.
Now Zulu has to pick up the pieces. He's solid, I'll give him that. But the burden of responsibility might prove too heavy, even for his shoulders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_azot_0_M: Just old stalker habits, I grabbed some odds and ends on the way, checked out a couple of wrecked cars. So we're good on repairs for now, got the parts.
Hey, brother! Top quality and top price for my friends.
I had to dump some of the gear back at the Monorail, though, so don't get your hopes up.
Gimme whatever needs fixing. I'll figure it out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_azot_0_U: I don't do field tuning, just so you know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_lejtenan: It's a shame the general never got to see the CNPP. Don't get me wrong, the vibe is giving me goosebumps, but at the same time, we're so close to an important win.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_major_za: Go entertain the soldiers with your talk. I'm busy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_mazut_0_: What do we need to fix, soldier?
That's it, finito. Now we'll have to face total chaos in Freedom. Who's the leader now? Mavka? Heh.
All our logistics fell apart when Myklukha died. And here, in the center of the Zone, all our deliveries will go to shit now.
Seems like you've had a rough trip! C'mon, give me your gear, I'll patch it up. And don't sweat the cost—I'll only charge you for the parts.
Howdy, soldier! I only brought the essentials – didn't wanna break my back. So don't count on much other than the usual fixes.
But if you need something fixed, bring the damn thing to me. Gives me something to do, at least.
I can only fix something up. Didn't bring any upgrading tools with me, they're heavy as hell.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_prap_sap: They say times are tough. When has it ever been different? We're hardly getting fewer mutants, and Freedom looks like bad news.
Let's pick up where we left off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_radovoj_: I understand that a decent person can be wearing any uniform. But in times like these, we just don't have time to find out if they're decent.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_romka_se: This is not the time for chitchat, man.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_rubin_0_: Not in the mood. Talk later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_serzant_: Let's do this again some time!
We have time, so let's talk.
Sometimes the brass is being too careful: they're trying to avoid letting us fight. But how else are we supposed to stay in shape?
Hope you have some spare anti-rads, Skif, because my supplies are dwindling fast. We can't stay in this camp much longer, or we're toast.
I only packed the essentials – ammunition, medical supplies, and grub.
Not much, sure, but should be enough for the mission.
Okay, let's get on with it.
We just got here, and I hate this place already.
As if being stuck trying to stop Freedom wasn't enough, they put me in charge of watching the supplies!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_starsina: Honestly, Voronin and I didn't always see eye to eye, but his orders were always spot-on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_stefan_t: You wait till I'm on my feet again…
You know why I'm so fearless? Because freedom is when nothing's holding you back, even your own survival instinct.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_suslov_0: You know, even if this whole story ends badly for me, I'm glad I got the chance to meet Mavka.
Some think she's too stubborn, but I know that every fall leaves a scar, and it's no different for her.
Lucky I brought food, it's gold around here. No resupply coming... Still, beggars can't be choosers. For you, Skif, there's always something.
Back in the day, we scientists had a rule: it's better to order more spares than fewer. So I hoarded up as much as I could.
If you find yourself all out of supplies, come on over. I can spare some.
Browsing's free, so take a look!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_veza_0_I: The radiation level here is higher than normal almost everywhere. If we stay here for too long, the impact on our health will be irreparable.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_vita_pol: Wanna chat? No, I'm not the guy for that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_DLC01_zul_azim: I've been knocked down. Need some help.
In Freedom, I learned the perfect cocktail recipe: craftiness, observation, and coupons. If you have all the ingredients, you'll have enough good reasons to drink.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_BlatinSapra: I wouldn't get too excited just yet, we aren't exactly here for R&R.
Come on, we just need to be careful and stay out of trouble. The Zone's the same everywhere, if you ask me.
Yeah, it is, but here we're like rats in a cage, and to top it off, we've got Freedom as our neighbor. Can't get any worse.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_BlitzVinner: Did you see how that mercury-like goo swallowed up those artifacts? They must've been worth a million, at least.
What do we care? That million wasn't ours, so no need to cry about it. Myklukha should be the one in tears.
Ha! He won't find much use for that money six feet under.
It is what it is. He'd been saving up all his life, and then… You get the point.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Blitz_Repor: Zen, there's a fuss over at the Plant. Duty's breaking through to the CNPP. They're after us.
Tell your people to fall back. You need to save as much force as you can to defend the camp.
You heard him! Fall back in small groups, and keep the channel open. It's just as dangerous on the surface as it is beneath it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_CallSkif_1_: Hey, Skif! The pass is clear. Get up here! We'll cover you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Dzen_CallSk: The elevator's working. We're getting in.
Mutants are closing in. Get ready to give our guests a warm welcome.
With open arms, like we always do! Hold your position. I'll order to shut the system down once we're up on the surface. Good luck, Skif!
Skif, hola. We made it to the surface and we managed to intercept Duty on the radio – they're on their way here, too. Switch the elevator off. We'll try to slow them down.
Roger. I'll find another way to get to you, then.
I think the underground should have another exit. Sending you our coordinates for reference. I'll reach out to you later, once we find a safe spot. That's all. Out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Dzen_Defend: Almost everybody's in, need a little more time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Dzen_TimeTo: Hey, soldiers! Tea time's over. Get ready to roll.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Golub_Chatt: Finally, no more mutants near the Concrete Plant. They were everywhere, and swarming in like flies to… jam.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_GrasevLangu: Never thought I'd get to visit the famous CNPP!
Hardly. I'm not a hero to make up legends about. It's a shame, though.
Don't worry. I'll make up a legend or two when we get back!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Kolesnik_Ch: Once we get back, we have to pour one for Voronin. Honor him properly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Kolesnik_Ta: Zulu ordered me to wake you up. He wanted to discuss something with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_NPC_Combat_: Hold your positions! I'll get a hold of Zen and find out what the hell we're supposed to do next… Fuck!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Remizenko_C: I bet the Concrete Plant is shaking well from that explosion! Everyone who shit their pants will be struck from Duty's ranks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_RubinPitonC: I'm still out of it after what went down at the Monorail.
Yeah, and then it turned out this was just the beginning! Honestly, I'm not too excited about what's brewing up here.
Hey, what the hell?! Zen's counting on us, and we're just gonna bail on him?
Zen? He's just looking for Mavka's approval. We're on our own, and I ain't willing to die here.
Listen, Rubin, I've seen these things in the flesh. When things get ugly, you need to beat it, not play the honorable hero.
Your call. I won't rat you out or try to stop you. But I'm staying.
Your choice, brother. We already had enough of this back at the Monorail.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Sheriff_Tal: Good morning, sleepy-head. Zen's waiting for you. He wanted to talk about something.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_SquireCall_: But be careful! It can fry your brain, but only if you're in the light. It won't affect you if you take cover. That's it, and talk soon!
Skif! Come in! You weren't on comms. What's up?
I just made it out. You got Zen's coordinates?
Zen and the guys went to the new camp. Sending you the coordinates. Suslov gave us a tip on where the safest spot is, and you won't believe where!
The reference point is a gigantic anomaly you'd wanna stay far away from… That's exactly where you need to go.
Made it out. What's up with you? All good?
All good, but had to fight off the local fauna. Like this weird anomaly wasn't enough.
Zen and the guys went to the new camp. Sending you the coordinates. Suslov gave us a tip on where the safest spot is, and you won't believe where!
If you see a huge anomaly, go towards it. It's your landmark.
Skif, come in. We're at the spot Mavka sent us.
Don't wait for me. The gate won't open – all the electronics are busted.
Ah, a classic! Zone electronics are like a whole other type of anomaly.
The guys are saying they spotted a detour on their way here. I've sent you the coordinates. Hurry if you can.
I'm having some problems here. I'll have to take a detour.
We did a little recon, and here's something that looks like a detour. Sending you the coordinates now.
But hurry up. Just like Suslov said, it's safe out here, but the anomaly gets on your nerves anyway.
Hola, Skif! We've set up camp and are settling in here already. How've you been? Still kicking?
Hanging in there. How've you been?
Can you imagine that, right here in the epicenter, the anomaly's got a blind spot! By the way, we gave it a name – the Flare.
If it wasn't for Suslov's tip-off, we would've been walking around here for months, turning into zombies. Instead, we're in the safest spot of the CNPP!
Speaking of the braindead, Duty's lurking somewhere nearby. They're too scared to get closer. Looks like the Flare's keeping them at bay for now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Zabuga_Expl: Skif, stay clear of the door! Setting the explosives!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Zabuga_Muta: And these are just the ones we found at the station. Damn, how many of these bastards were there when Freedom arrived?
As if there weren't enough mutants at the Monorail… Here we go again. Is it ever going to end?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Zabuga_Retu: Head over to Zulu. He's at the HQ.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_ZulusCall_B: I'm close by, in the reactor room, but everything's closed. What now?
I'm sending a man with explosives. We locked the door behind us to keep mutants from getting in.
So just hang on a sec, it'll all be sorted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_ZulusCall_C: Skif, be careful. We spotted Freedom scouts near the Depot, may they rest in piss. But there might have been more of them.
I literally just made it out.
Great, and I just spotted a new place to set up camp.
Well, a rough camp… A temporary one. We can't stay there for long, so I sent scouts out to look for a better spot. Sent you the coordinates. Come on over.
And one more thing – beware of the huge anomaly. It can fry your brain even even crispier than the Scorcher. So don't walk in the open.
Skif, what's your status? Hurry up.
Trouble with the gate. Looking for another way.
Seems like the Zone itself is trying to derail us! All right… The guys are saying they came across a detour on their way here.
It was more dangerous, so we didn't take it. But if you have no choice, I hope you'll make it. Sending the coordinates. Stay on comms.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_ZulusCall_V: Skif, come in. We're settling in the camp we set up temporarily, but it's way worse than the spot where Freedom dug in. Turns out the anomaly's blind spot is right over them.
I'm making my way through to you. It's not a walk in the park.
Stay out of the anomaly. We call it Flare, by the way. Master chief came up with it. As for Freedom…
I really think we should do an assault op and take the place. Otherwise, we're as good as dead here with all this radiation. And the Flare. I can't tell which is worse.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Zulus_CallS: Zulu to Skif – elevator's up and running. Our soldiers are getting in.
Roger that. No critters in sight so far.
Shit, here's the next problem! Secure the control panel – don't let Freedom get their hands on it!
We made it out! Switch the elevator off, or Freedom will creep up here and strike from the back.
Switching off. But then I'll need to look for a detour.
The station should have an emergency exit through technical facilities. Sending our current coordinates so it's easier to navigate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QC_Zulus_Defen: Skif, we're sending the last squad up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QD_MavkaInDum_: Help the guys get to a safe spot. Zen, I'm putting you in charge. You need to get out of the Depot as soon as possible.
I looked around and found a service elevator. Skif, help to power it up. You can take it to get back to the surface.
Understood. Then we're off to deal with the elevator as there's no need to hang back here. Skif, you'll check out the Depot and look for a way to power up the elevator.
Slow down, will you? Your people have been through enough. They need you here.
I know. But if we're not first to X19, it was all for nothing, understand?
X19 is our priority, agreed. What do you want me and the rest of the group to do?
Which way did you take to get out? Can we go the same way?
I don't think so. It was just me, traveling light, but there's a lot of you, plus the supplies.
But not to X19, so don't get too excited. You're now in the Monorail Control Depot, and the railway doesn't go any further – it's underwater.
Mavka is searching for X19 as we speak, and Duty's stepping on our heels.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QD_SquireCall_: Mavka out.
I'm going to need some time with these mutants. The anomaly, too. I won't make it to you fast enough.
Shit! Folks at the camp are also getting nervous. With the anomaly on their heels, they gotta watch every step.
And Duty's hanging out behind the anomaly. Yes, they're here already. No clue how. Okay, that's all.
All good, heading towards it now. Any luck with X19?
Combing through the center of the CNPP. Judging by the coordinates, I'm somewhere nearby.
The anomaly's trying to get me. It's okay, I'm close. I can feel it in my gut. Over.
Skif, Zen says you're not here yet.
Can you hear me? Skif? Skif?!
Let's talk later.
Got it, you need to focus. I've sent you the coordinates to Zen's camp.
We're well-protected from every angle by this Flare. The Zone's on our side in this battle, Skif.
We're in a literal fortress. It will be hard for Duty to take on this place.
Now, the other one.
Let's get this over with. Start with the bad news.
Our scouts noticed that Duty's become more active. Don't know what they're getting ready for, but they sure are keeping busy.
Looks like we can't avoid a gunfight, so hurry up there – every piece counts.
Let's hear something good for a change.
Skif, I got good news and bad news. Which one do you want first?
Who told you the good news?
A little pseudodog did, ha-ha! So, which one should I tell you first?
Okay then, I'll start with the bad news.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QD_SquireInDum: What's your take on what went down in the Arena?
Myklukha, he… Yes, he sold his soul for coupons, and turned Freedom into a market. But damn, he knew how to keep people in line.
If Mavka thinks something's not right, she won't just sit around… So here we are.
And now she's run off to find the lab all by herself. On the other hand – what did I expect? It's Mavka. I knew what I signed up for when I chose to follow her.
Why did you pick Mavka's side? You could've stayed with Myklukha.
Myklukha? No way. I've been with Freedom from the days Chekhov was around. I remember what Freedom used to be.
Mavka is like that old Freedom. Back when everyone was laughing at her, I saw in her what others failed to notice.
Now you see it too, since we ended up in this mess together.
What do I have to do again?
Take a good look around the Depot, find something that can turn the elevator on – maybe a switch or some kind of lever.
Thanks for your help at the Monorail, Skif. And the Arena, too…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QD_Tuse_InHubC: Took your sweet time, Skif! Zen's over there waiting for you with some important info.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QD_Veza_DeadFr: I knew those guys, Skif. You could say we were buddies.
Sometimes I went on raids with them, and I'd often have to pull them out of trouble. They always wanted to be on the front lines, so they got hit harder than anyone. Damn...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B01_QD_ZulusInDum_: But there's one more thing. Some Freedom members are probably lurking around the station. We found the train that took them here.
Take care of the elevator, and I'll take care of my people. They need me. I can't just rush into a fight headfirst.
Our soldiers did a little recon already, found some documents that suggest this is the Monorail Control Depot.
They also found an elevator that will take us to the surface. If we can fix it.
We need to find a way to power it up.
The station should have a switch or a lever to turn the elevator on.
You're a sharp one! I just hope mutants aren't coming here to keep us company.
I'll instruct my people, and you figure out how to power up the elevator. I'm counting on you, Skif.
What's our next move?
We need to find X19 before Mavka does. This is priority one.
We'll honor the general properly later, we don't have time for this now. We need to act fast.
You're right. Freedom is probably digging in already. We need to get to X19 before they do.
Tell me what to do exactly.
I think we should have a look around and be thorough. There has to be a way to power up that elevator.
Finally, you're awake. We're close to the CNPP, but the train won't go any further. Everything's underwater.
Honestly, this is not what I expected when I went down to the Monorail. We can't even give Voronin a proper burial… Fuck.
Well, looks like I'm in charge here now. I can't let Voronin's sacrifice be for nothing. Especially with Freedom making it here before us, just as I suspected.
I'm sorry about the general. My condolences.
Thank you. Seems like losing the generals who fulfill their duty is the fate of our faction.
First Tachenko, now Voronin… Being Duty's general is like a one-way ticket.
Although, I used to think Tachenko's sacrifice was inevitable. Voronin showed me it wasn't that simple.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_DutyStartAt: Time's up. You made your choice, and that choice is death.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Dzen_Combat: Skif, I got a report it's a negative on the snipers. Confirm.
Great! Everyone, regroup at the main entrance!
Keep calm, and don't play hero now!
Fought the second wave off! How many more, damn it?!
Fucking hell, did they drag the whole garrison here?!
I got two! Come on! Bring it on!
I'll run outta slugs if we keep going like that…
Good job! They've got no fight left.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Dzen_DecorC: They're breaching! Hang in there, boys! Fire!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Dzen_Defenc: Skif! They're falling back! Duty's getting out!
Not everyone. But if it wasn't for your maneuver, we'd all be dead.
We'll be waiting to welcome you back.
Skif! You really did it! I still can't wrap my head around it.
Sometimes risking it is the only option.
If it wasn't for your maneuver, we'd have lost a lot of people. Thank you, on everyone's behalf.
We're waiting to welcome you back, Skif.
Major, come in, report on the battle status. Major, come in! Major?!
Major Zabuha is dead. HQ fell. Order them to fall back, Zulu. You lost.
Skif?! Fuck! I'll come for you once I'm done with Mavka. Abort the attack! Fall back, that's an order. Move it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Dzen_Defend: I'll take care of the wounded while you deal with Duty. Break a leg, man.
You're a machine… Better – a bulldozer! One moment I thought that was it, my final stop, but thanks to you, many will live to see another day.
We fought them off! Skif, we did it!
Yeah, but it's not over. Duty will regroup and attack again. I'll go to the teleport and kill their commander.
Got it. I can't talk you out of it. Gotta help the boys out, lots of wounded. We'll secure the territory for now and stay in touch with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Dzen_OrderR: We're taking casualties, Skif! Duty's breaching our defenses!
Fall back! Everyone, fall back to the last defense line! Quickly!
Everyone, fall back! I repeat, we're falling back!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Dzen_Victor: Duty's still stepping on our heels, right?

Yes. Zulu won't stop until he's dead. He'll come to the end of the Earth to find us and try to put us six feet under right there. My gut tells me he's extremely dangerous. It's so hard to think we were once on the same side…
I'm on the roof of the fourth reactor now, making my way inside. Literally "making my way" – there aren't exactly many doors here.
Sent you the coordinates. I'm counting on you. You and I will see this through to the end, and the Mainland will finally become closer to liberation!
Wow, Mavka, we should get patched up and fix our gear after the fight. Especially when Zulu is following you like a bloodhound.
Good. But be quick. Now's not the time to slow down or play it safe. Okay, Mavka out.
We pulled through, Skif! We did it! I thought we were all screwed. And you changed our luck, you bastard! Freedom's in your debt now, amigo.
I heard the good news. Thank you! It's the first victory for the new Freedom – you and Zen have made a statement already.
But now's not the time to rest, Skif, I need you here. We still have X19 to deal with, and we have to win there, too. We're bound to!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_FreedomFluf: I counted a couple dozen. How many of them are there?
I know it's safe in here, but the anomaly right next to me is kinda scary.
Why the fuck did I have to go out looking for trouble when I could've just stayed safe? Only wanted some freedom, ugh.
Why's Duty even here? Could've stayed quiet at the Concrete Plant.
Should've filled my ruck with ammunition instead of food.
This Flare won't touch us here, but it's still giving me the chills, damn it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_SquireOrder: Alpha team, take your positions near the main entrance.
Bravo team, grab your rifles and scopes – you're in charge of the windows and the perimeter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Zen_Flank_1: Left flank is pushing! Don't let those damn bastards reach the center!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Zen_Rear_1_: Duty's in our rear! Anyone on the second line, cover our backs!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QC_Zen_Snipers: Enemy snipers on the third floor! Get those snipers or we're all dead in five!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QD_ChooseDefen: Both of you, go to the gate. I'll take care of the sniper cover.
Let's roll! Kick some Duty ass!
Take lots of ammo and get to the main entrance, move it. And you, take a rifle and get to the windows. We could use another sniper.
You'll go to the windows with me, and we'll provide cover. Big guy, go help at the main entrance.
I'm counting on you to kick Duty's ass.
You bet! What's our job, Skif? We're seasoned and happy to help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QD_Dzen_Counte: I've got a plan, but I need to know if you can hold on for a little longer.
Hard to tell. But I wasn't planning on giving up.
Either way, we've only got two foreseeable outcomes, both of which I've already described.
You know what? Go for it! Head around them, and we'll act as a decoy for the main forces. Buy you some time. Good luck, amigo.
Offense is the best defense. Duty got here through the teleports, so I'll use one of them and attack their HQ.
Zabuha won't see it coming. All his men are here.
Fuck… So many casualties. And Duty just keeps coming.
Our options are shit – die here or get fried in the anomaly. Both will take us to the grave, one of them just gets us there faster.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QD_SquireFinis: Stay on comms, make sure to keep me posted. If they squeeze us too far back, this room is both our second and last line of defense.
Everyone's in position, Skif. I'll be on the balcony with the rest. We'll cover our boys.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B02_QD_SquireStart: Mavka put you in charge. I'll be helping out, but you're in command.
Listen up, soldiers: overwatch – to the balcony, main squad – to the main entrance, and long-range weapons – to the windows up top.
Zen! Duty's getting ready to attack! Lots of them, and those are just the ones we saw!
Listen, Skif… Mavka said you used to be in the military, right? I'm counting on your help and experience.
I'm glad you made it. Mavka's almost at the X19 entrance, so just one more step and we've done it!
This is major Zabuha, Duty. Your time is running out.
Now to the shitty news – Duty offered us a chance to surrender. I took some time, like, to think about it. But it seems my time's over.
I'll put my guys all across the building for now. Never had to defend a fortress before.
Okay. Let's do it this way – put the main squad at the main entrance, long-range weapons in the windows up top, and overwatch on the balcony.
Doesn't sound like a bad plan. I'll give the soldiers their orders.
Nothing but fun. What are we gonna do?
Surrendering's not an option. Death is all around us. Better to die fighting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_DLC01_azot_0_M: Strange times indeed. I never thought Zulu would agree to my teleport idea! But there's no other way, so let's hope the Zone's on our side today.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_DLC01_serzant_: Voronin would never let this fly – using teleports is nothing but nonsense! Zulu is leading us down the wrong path, if you ask me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_DutySoldier: Here's to hoping we'll get out of here ASAP. We have enough anti-rad for a day, max, and then what?
We'll have to use strong spirits to lift our own. Until we run out of those, too.
What if you go through here… Crap, can't run any further, the anomaly will get me. And the boys gave it such a pretty name – Flare! Brain fryer would've been more accurate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Polyak_Talk: It was the right decision to take that spot from Freedom. I went to scout out the area – it's all crap. Nothing fit for a camp.
Freedom knew where to go. I wonder who told them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_SapranLangu: I've heard you get sick and your vision gets blurry after the teleport. But maybe that's just bullshit.
Well, go and ask the boys who made it to the other side. You can tell me later.
No, you go first. I'll be right behind you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Zen_Interce: Snipers, take out that enemy asshole who's holed up right across from the windows, he's a real problem.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_ZulusTopoln: The assault squad is ready and waiting for your orders.
Thank you, Master Chief. As you were.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Zulus_Backu: Skif, they're pulling reserves to the overpass! Cover us!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Zulus_CallR: I'm in position. Found your scout, he's dead. So it's just me covering you.
Fucking shit! Listen up, here's the mission brief.
Your targets are the overpass snipers. Take care of them, and we can start the attack. Otherwise, we're just sitting ducks.
Make sure you don't shoot any of ours. The enemy's up top, our men are down below. Friendly fire's the last thing we need.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Zulus_Order: Come on! Let's show Freedom what real Duty's like!
You forgot how to shoot, or what, Skif? Fine, we don't have time to wait. We're taking this place with what we've got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Zulus_PushF: Skif, we've breached the building entrance. Pushing Freedom out now.
I'm ordering you to leave that spot. I need you here. One last push, and victory's ours.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Zulus_SkifW: Skif, hurry up. Shoot the snipers at the overpass.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QC_Zulus_TakeC: They've got an RPG! Get down!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QD_DutySoldier: Skif, wait! Got a bottle you could share? Need to clear my mind of psi. I can't get rid of the voices in my head.
Here you go man, this one's a special recipe. A couple of sips, and you're good as new.
Now we're talking! Thanks, I really needed that. If I knew this thing was going to fry us here, I'd have brought a six-pack.
You be careful, or the anomaly outside will get you right away. I hope Zulu's plan works so we can settle in a better spot than this.
Take some pills instead. That's definitely better than vodka.
There you go. You ask for some vodka, like a normal person, and he's on about pills… I'm just messing with ya, relax. Thank you, I needed this!
Be careful when you go outside – the anomaly can already get you there. I'm here as a bad example. I went too far out.
Here you go, man. Hope it helps.
Ah, thank you! It sure will. Any longer, and my brains would've been scrambled.
I hope Zulu's plan works and we can settle in a spot better than this. That anomaly outside is frying us like steak.
I've got nothing to share, sorry.
Ugh, shit. Our boys don't have any either. Hope I feel better soon.
I stepped one foot outside and the anomaly hit me right away. Barely made it back in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QD_Zulus_After: I'll contact you once I know the location of X19.
We took a look at the bodies. Mavka wasn't among the deceased.
I'm not surprised. I was hoping we could stop her right here. That means we need to head out to X19.
If you have a plan, now's the time to share it.
We need to form scouting units. Mavka couldn't have disappeared without a trace.
You're an experienced fighter, you'll go alone. We don't have many people left after this bloodbath… Your sector is the fourth reactor.
And take this, it'll come in handy. Based on past experience, we're gonna be glad we brought the explosives. I'll head out once my unit is ready.
How do you suggest we find X19?
Mavka must be closer to X19 than we are. If we find her trace, we'll find the lab.
We'll head out on recon in small units. You'll go alone – I think you'll manage. Your sector is the fourth reactor.
And take this, it'll come in handy. Judging from past experiences, having some explosives can be useful. I'll head out once my unit is ready.
We… we did it, Skif. We won! We pushed Freedom out of their strategic point, but most importantly – out of the safest spot at the CNPP. Now, we need to secure the place and take care of the wounded.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QD_Zulus_LastA: We backed Freedom into a corner, Skif. We finish them off, and we've won.
Lieutenant, you'll be watching our backs in the rearguard.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QD_Zulus_Order: Zulu, we cleared the building. What do we do next?
Organize security around the camp, and a field hospital for the wounded. Also, clear the bodies, both ours and Freedom. But I'm ordering you to treat all remains humanely.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ11_B03_QD_Zulus_TalkB: Head to the teleport. I'll contact you when you're in position.
I don't have time for long introductions, so I'll get straight to the point.
Right now, our situation at the CNPP is poor, to say the least. Freedom secured a strategic point and we need to take it, at any cost.
Finding X19 is priority one.
While we're looking for X19, I'll lose all my men to radiation and the anomaly. The buildings nearby aren't much different.
We need to kick Freedom out of there and secure the strategic point. I already prepared the attack plan. Hope it works.
How will we get to their camp? This Flare will fry our brains five minutes into the trip.
We found several teleports here. Nitro figured out their exit points. Two of them lead straight to the Freedom base.
The assault squad is almost ready. I'll lead the boys through one of the teleports, but it'll be tough without cover. That's where you come in, Skif.
What's my job?
The second teleport leads to a sniper position. Take a rifle and get there. You'll provide cover for me and my men.
But be careful – the scout who went to that position still hasn't reported in. Good luck, Skif.
How did Nitro find out where the teleports lead?
I'm no specialist on teleports, I never liked them. Still don't. But, according to Nitro, he found an abandoned car nearby with beacons in it.
If you throw a beacon into the teleport, you can trace its signal and find out where it landed. Here's to hoping that if the beacon survived the teleport, so will we.
Tell me about the plan.
We found several teleports here. Nitro figured out their exit points. Two of them lead straight to the Freedom base.
The assault squad is almost ready. I'll lead the soldiers through one of the teleports, but it'll be tough without cover. That's where you come in, Skif.
We could lose a lot of soldiers in an assault operation. Is that spot really that important?

We aren't protected from the anomaly or the radiation here. If anyone wanders off to the back yard, their brains are fried. And those who stay here will get killed by radiation poisoning sooner or later.
I sent scouts out to the buildings nearby – same thing, if not worse. We need to kick Freedom out of the CNPP. I have a plan. Hope it works out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_AL_X19_Scientist1_: Someone got into C-Consciousness's stasis room and shot them. Methodically. They died, trying to make this world a better place.
It's ironic that C-Consciousness were right. Humans are killers by nature, and humankind… has always killed their saviors. A story as old as time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Mavka_LI_Warnin: Attention. Critical damage. Sector B, level two.
Attention. Bio-tanks damaged. Sector A, level one.
Hermetic sealing damaged. Emergency sytem activated.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Mavka_QC_Mavka_: No! What the fuck are you doing?!
We've been through so much together! We were a team!
Why do you have to destroy everything?!
You want to destroy what others sacrificed their lives for?!
You want to take hope from the people on the Mainland?! Take their right to be free?!
I won't let you destroy them!
You destroy everything! And you don't even care!
You're destroying what could've changed the world!
No! We're all gonna die here!
I won't let you! I WON'T LET YOU!
We could've worked together! We could've changed everything!
We were friends, Zulu! You were talking about changes!
Freedom and Duty could've worked together! Could've changed everything! But you got scared.
You're scared of whatever it is you can't control! That's why you're destroying what could have helped people!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Mavka_QC_Phase2: They could have saved millions of lives!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Mavka_QC_Repeat: It locked again! Let's start over!
We didn't make it! Go again!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Mavka_QC_Zulus_: Kill the mutants. I'll cover you.
I won't be much use with this shotgun.
All that crap's making my head spin!
I can't see shit! My head's killing me!
Damn… My head is killing me!
Push the button! I'll cover you!
I'll open the panel, and you shoot the hell out of everything in there!
We'll break the fuses, and the platform will go up.
I'll distract Mavka, you run to the central panel!
We need to raise the platform!
We're sitting ducks here. Cover me!
We can't get Mavka, but we can get the tanks.
Let's destroy what she came here for.
We just need to raise the platform we're standing on.
Got the first row. Keep going.
