You see the central panel? Push the button and switch it to manual control!
Push the button and switch to manual!
Skif, watch out – those are anomalies!
Mavka! Can't you see?! They're dangerous!
We need to switch to manual mode – push the button.
Skif, come on! Shoot the tanks!
Don't just stand there! Hit the tanks!
The platform has reached the next level! Keep going!
Shoot the tanks! Hit them one by one, and let's get this over with.
Mavka's going nuts. We need to hurry up!
Skif, you need to do the trick with those locks one more time.
Same mission – locks, fuses, central panel.
My Saiga is useless here... You've got a better chance.
I can't hit it with buckshot, the spread's too wide. You've gotta take care of the tanks.
Skif, the central panel! Max it out!
Damn! We can't get to the locks from here!
The system's overheated! The fuses are open!
Make a fucking mess! Let's stop this nightmare!
We've gotta improvise. We're out of options!
No time to think! Shoot! Shoot whatever you see!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Zulus_LI_Warnin: Attention. Bio-tank temperature increasing. Stabilization required.
Temperature above optimal levels. Risk of specimen damage.
Temperature critical. Risk of specimen loss.
Temperature above optimal levels. System at risk of destabilization.
Return temperature to optimum levels immediately.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Zulus_QC_Mavka_: Watch out!
He's coming right at you!
He's attacking!
Move! Now!
Watch out!
Damn it! This fog… We damaged the cooling system!
The tanks are overheating! Any hotter, and there'll be nothing left to salvage.
Skif, I'll figure something out! Distract Zulu!
It's working! It's fucking working! The temperature's dropping!
Damn, that was scary!
We did it, Skif! The tanks are okay!
Look for the red button on the panel! When you find it, hit it!
There has to be a button, Skif. A red one. Hit it!
Find the red button, Skif. Quickly!
Yes! Now the lever! Pull it down!
Awesome! Now pull the lever!
The lever! Quick!
There! I think I found a way to start the ventilation!
But I need some help! Some buttons can only be accessed from the platform!
I'll tell you which ones to press – just do what I tell you!
Got it! The system's on!
You did it! The temperature's dropping!
Great work! The temperature's dropping!
Skif, come on! The overheating is provoking them!
Hurry up! The hotter they get, the more dangerous they become!
We need to start the cooling system! Quickly!
Skif, come on! It's getting worse!
Hurry up! The tanks won't last much longer!
We did it, Skif… Get the platform up.
Time to liberate the Mainland!
Leave Zulu, Skif. He's not a threat to us anymore.
We have more important things to do. Like liberating the Mainland.
Get the platform up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Zulus_QC_ZulusM: You! You betrayed us, Zulu! Me, Skif… everyone!
So many deaths because of them!
That plague will not leave the Zone!
Deaths?! And how many lives will they save, Zulu?!
Ends?! No, Zulu, this is just the beginning!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_BF_Zulus_QC_Zulus_: Make sure you watch your back.
Keep your head on a swivel.
And you believe Mavka will be able to control them?!
The Zone can't be tamed! It can only be destroyed!
You can run, but you can't hide! Face me!
That's it, Skif! Enough fooling around!
You won't last long in a fair fight!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Mavka_LabIntera: Skif, the panel's right behind you. Hit the switch – I'm ready for whatever crawls out of there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Mavka_Mosaic_Ar: Skif... Project X scientists created something no one could comprehend. Discovered possibilities no one dared to dream of.
Yes, sacrifices were made, but every miracle requires a sacrifice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Mavka_Mosaic_Ca: Come here! Trust me, it's worth your while...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Mavka_Mosaic_Ma: What do you think, did the woman on it really believe in her work? That Project X was making the world a better place, bringing light to humanity?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Mavka_Mosaic_Sh: I think she was right, in a way.
Yeah. Flawed as it was, Project X wanted to change things.
Of course, not everything went according to their plan. But at least they tried.
I think that woman was wrong.
Maybe she was… Project X scientists are mostly hated.
But does that mean they were wrong about everything?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Mavka_Mosaic_ma: Okay, enough art therapy. That remote control won't press its own buttons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Mavka_X19Intera: Skif. We can't open the door without a power source. I'm begging you, hurry up. Time is running out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_LabDoorRe: Not every lab is hiding something that's not supposed to come out.
Or something that shouldn't be found. Anyway, it doesn't look good.
Is that supposed to keep us out, or keep something in?
Guess we'll find out. Judging by the size, the thing we're looking for is right behind it.
That's one hell of a door. Not every lab has a door this big.
Why so quiet? Smell something fishy too? Okay. We'll figure it out.
Whatever's inside, there's no turning back. We need to find a way to open it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_LabIntera: Skif, turn around – the panel's right behind you. Get the doors open, I'll watch your back. Just in case.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_Mosaic_Go: Let's go. It makes me sick just looking at it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_Mosaic_Le: Seems like they wanted to make history.
They did. As monster creators and murderers.
There's a saying: remembering fools is a warning to the wise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_Mosaic_Ma: Look at that! As if their nasty projects weren't enough, those scientists had to paint themselves on the walls. Heroes, great minds, yeah.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_Mosaic_Se: That's right. Portrayed themselves as humanity's saviors.
In reality, they turned every living creature into a guinea pig. Forced them into happiness, I'd say.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_Mosaic_We: They probably thought they were doing something important.
Important? They created hell on earth and were proud of it.
Tachenko saw their 'important' work. That was why he created Duty – to clean up their shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_MovingThr: You're doing what you have to. This is the right decision.
Are you sure? How do you know?
I've always told myself that I'm protecting the weak and serving the right cause.
But what if all that time I was just looking for an excuse? For the violence that I… enjoy?
Do you believe that?
I don't know. But Mavka also believes what she does is for the sake of others. How am I any better?
Becoming an animal is not what scares me, Skif. I'm scared to realize that it's what I've always been.
That stalker was right, in his own way.
That's what scares me.
I used to think I was fighting for the truth, protecting people, following Duty's ideals.
And now, when I make difficult decisions, I still tell myself: this is the right thing to do, this is necessary, this is for the cause.
What is it that you doubt?
What if all those ideals are just a pretty wrapper? What if the beast inside has always been in control?
And I was just looking for excuses to justify violence? I still am.
But you know what? If it helps destroy the Zone, so be it.
You know, Skif… the closer we get to the goal, the more I doubt all of it.
I've been fighting for my friends all my life. Protecting them. And now I'll probably have to kill someone I used to call a friend – for the sake of people I don't even know.
A stalker once told me, "We're all murderers here, Zulu. It's just that Duty has ideals justifying it".
You're quiet. Makes sense. What can you say.
Remember the story about Shulga? How I beat him up? I thought I'd lost control.
What if I hadn't? What if that was the first time I was actually honest with myself?
You regret it?
You bet I do! But that's not what scares me. I'm afraid it'll be the same with Mavka.
I'll tell myself that this is for the cause, for the ideals. When instead I'll just unleash the beast and call it 'the right thing to do'.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QC_Zulus_X19Intera: Skif, hurry up. Just find a way to get power to this damn door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_AzotYanov_1_862: You? Not the person I hoped to meet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_AzotYanov_EndUp: Nitro? I didn't expect to see you in Yaniv. How did you end up here?
Through the Monorail. Plus, old ties to Degtyarev – he helped me out for old time's sake.
Took me back, even though we didn't part well.
Though my spot here has been long taken… by some gloomy chick.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_AzotYanov_IWill: Go then, but let's get one thing straight right now – I don't want to hear a single word about Zulu from you.
You hear me? Glad we've got that settled.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_AzotYanov_ItIsP: Zulu was your friend, I know. I'm sorry it ended this way.
You know, Skif… I understand that everybody has their own way, their own decisions and all.
But, as you correctly pointed out, Zulu was my friend. And you chose the other side.
So… I'll work with you if I have to, but we won't be buddies.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_AzotYanov_NotWi: Why are you here and not at the Concrete Plant? Are you not with Duty?
The Duty I knew is no more. Voronin is dead. Zulu… You know what happened to Zulu better than I do.
Without them, they're just a bunch of uncoordinated fighters. A faction that won't last long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_BlockDesc: My pride is hurt. Other than that, I'm good.
Shame about the rope. But hey, at least the way down was memorable.
Well… Since there's no way back now, the only way is forward.
Okay, I'm moving on. And moving fast. Catch up.
Skif, did you find my little gift? I left you a rope to get inside the reactor. Almost like a red carpet.
Looks like I used up all my luck coming down here. Your rope broke.
Skif? You there? Now is not the best time to be ignoring me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_DoorOpene: Skif, you did it! The door's open! I'm coming in…
That's… Can you hear me? There's something… Shit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_EmbrioDoo: Damn it! Is there anything here that's still working?!

Could you take a look around? Find a backup power source –
 a generator, a battery, whatever.
I'm watching the door, and I'll be right in once it's open. I'm not letting Zulu slip through while you're doing your things.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_FoundEntr: Are you inside already, or are you waiting for me?
I'm down here already. Every second counts.
Zulu will be here any moment. We need to beat him to it.
There's nothing but collapsed buildings and radiation here. At least, for now…
It would be really easy to fall from here – and die from radiation before you hit the ground.
And, Skif… There's no way I could've made it this far without you. Really. See you down here.
Skif! I found a way down to X19!
There's a teleport on one of the roofs of the fourth reactor. It will lead you to a downed chopper.
You'll see a hole nearby – that's our way in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_LabEntran: Well, let's see what secrets the X19 lab has got in store.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_LabTalk1_: It's too quiet, even for an abandoned lab. What do you think, someone beat us to it?
Zombies, snorks, a pseudo giant… A whole delegation would've been here to greet him. No way to get through here quietly. Or did you miss them?
I didn't miss them, I did a tactical maneuver. Not every mutant deserves a bullet.
Well, that's why he's not here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_LabTalk2_: Skif, here's the million-coupon question – when did I turn into someone who just uses people?
I left those people to die around Rostok so we could leave. And then… left the rest to be slaughtered by Duty while I was looking for X19.
Am I… doing the right thing? Or am I turning into a monster?
Zulu will call me a monster – and, in his way, he'll be right. But his way is about destroying miracles. Mine is preserving them, and making sure there are more.
Honestly? I don't know what to think.
An honest answer. I appreciate it. Half the time, I don't know what to think, either.
But there's no turning back now. Hasn't been for a while. Way before the rope broke…
You're starting to become one, I guess. But it's not too late to stop.
No. That's not who I am… I'm not like Myklukha or Voronin. Not like Zulu.
They've been building cages. I'm breaking them. It's… different.
You're doing what's necessary. There's a big price to pay, but the end result is worth it.
Thank you. Sometimes, you just need to hear it from someone who's been by your side the whole way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_LabTalk3_: I bet whatever it is we're looking for is behind that massive door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_MaintDoor: I see a big door, very much closed.
The technical floor? It's all electronic there.
Look for something that could open it. A terminal, a fuse box, a button…
Scientists back then really had a thing for buttons.
Looks like I'm near the lab. How are you doing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_Meetup_Ca: How could we not? We figured out we couldn't win by playing fair. No pain, no gain – there was no way to avoid sacrifice. But we're here now, and it was all worth it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_Meetup_It: Held at gunpoint, just like back then. Some things never change.
They don't, do they? Maybe. But I'm glad I don't have to shoot you. It's good to have you on my side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_Meetup_ma: Okay, enough with the memories, it's back to business. While I was hanging out here, I found the lab scheme. There should be a control console for the main door here somewhere.
By the way, remember Lukash's remote from the Dam? The scheme mentions it! How cool is that? It came in handy after all.
What's more, it controls the main lab's systems. Including the emergency destruction of the specimens. Such a tiny gizmo... holds so much power.
Skif, that you? Fuck! Sorry, I'm all jumpy.
Plus, it's our tradition. Remember when we first met? I pointed my gun at your back then, too.
A lot has changed since then...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_PartialPo: Door's jammed, there's no way back. Moving on.
Find something that could restart it.
We're too close to our goal to get stuck here because of a dead battery.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_Postscrip: She was right. We did it! Glad to see you alive and well, Skif.
Mavka stabbed me with a knife.
I know how it must have looked, but Mavka meant you no harm.
She figured out how the specimens operate. They read emotions, not words. The strongest, most genuine emotion. The Oasis requires a real fear of death and the will to survive.
That's why Lukash was able to hold on for so long before he died. That's why you're alive. By wounding you, Mavka created an Oasis.
She asked me to tell you... that she's grateful. For everything. And she regrets having to do this. But such is the price of freedom.
What will happen to Duty now?
Duty lost the CNPP battle and retreated. I am sure that without Zulu as their leader, their expansion into the center of the Zone is over.
I'll be surprised if they manage to recover at all, considering how many people they've lost lately.
What will happen to Freedom now that Mavka's left?
From now on, Freedom won't limit itself to within the Perimeter. The time when that was enough for us is finally over.
Part of Freedom will stay here, led by Zen. Mavka wants them to keep searching for technologies and miracles that can help liberate the Mainland.
But sooner or later, many Freedom members will take those findings and follow Mavka. The Mainland will get all of the Zone's miracles without having to deal with its dangers.
I'd like to see it all with my own eyes. I hope everything will turn out the way she wants it to.
What's next for you?
After so many years, I finally found my place in the Zone. I'm staying at the CNPP, with Freedom.
Maybe I'll be able to remember what I used to feel back when I was practicing science. After all, it did bring me joy.
Who knows, if I'm lucky, maybe the Oasis will be able to cure my hearing problems.
Glad to be alive. It's a mystery how I managed to stay that way.
The Oasis healed you. It all went just as Mavka expected it to.
Can't say I agreed to pay for a miracle.
I'm sorry, Skif, but we both know that's not true.
You agreed to it as soon as you decided to take Freedom's side and fight. We all agreed to sacrifice ourselves for a new world, whether we were aware of it or not.
What the hell, Suslov? What just happened?!
Hold on, Skif. Let me explain.
Shouldn't Mavka stay by her first Oasis? Where is she now?
Far away from here. Mavka decided to leave the Zone. That Oasis was her last gift to those who stay here.
She said, and I agree with her, that the Zone's miracles are worth nothing until the majority gains access to them. For now, they stay hidden behind the guarded Perimeter.
That's why she's taking the specimens to the Mainland. Not for Chekhov. Not for just one person. Mavka wants the Oases to be available to everyone. This will change the future, Skif. Forever.
What are you doing here, Suslov?
Mavka asked me to keep an eye on you.
If Zulu were alive, there would be no Oasis.
Zulu was a strong, but stubborn man. He once saw the Zone as evil, and he could never look at it from a different perspective.
I understand him, to some degree. When I started to hate science, I stopped feeling any sympathy for the Zone. I felt crushed.
But Mavka helped me see that a poison can be a cure, and vice versa. The Zone brings good just as much as it brings harm. It's a shame Zulu never got to see it. Such a shame.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_StationDe: I saw its map. There's the line that goes to the Mainland. It's right under the Perimeter.
Take the service elevator, and we'll talk face-to-face, not over the radio. But keep your eyes open. I heard something weird when…
Another station? How many are there?
Roughly the same number as the labs. The Monorail linked them all together.
Awesome! You'll know you're going the right way when you see the Monorail station.
Monorail? Then why didn't we just take it here?
Because the route was flooded, or did you forget?
Skif, did you find the exit from the technical floor?
Surprised to hear about the Monorail? You're probably thinking, why didn't we just take it to come here? The route was flooded.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Mavka_StatusChe: Working on it. Moving further down.
Hold on. Did you hear that?
An explosion… It's Zulu. Hurry up, he's close.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_NarSequenceBoss: Zulu, lower your gun and listen...
I've heard enough. I warned you I'd kill you on sight.
You're not in a position to.
And now?
Come on, weapon on the floor, remote to Skif.
Two on one, is it?
You're not in a position to preach morals.
To trade everything we've been through... Everything we dreamed of... For those damned mutants!
Remote. Now.
Oops!
You bitch!
The world will change, Zulu. With or without you.
Gun on the floor, Zulu. Gun on the floor, now!
We went through hell together! And for what?! To destroy the world?
To change it.
Not like that! Not with these monsters!
Two steps back. Two steps back, Zulu. Turn around.
You picked the wrong side...
On your knees! Keep him in your sights. He moves, you shoot.
She'll betray you just like she betrayed me!
I'm going up! Cover me!
That plague isn't getting out of here! And neither are you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_NarSequenceMeda: I’ve decided to give this to you.
The highest medal of Duty. For service one was not obligated to perform.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_ProtectiveSyste: Sector T5. Power: restored. Management systems: restarted. Access: granted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_SuslovRostok_1_: Skif? Didn't expect to see you here. After everything that happened… I hoped you wouldn't have the nerve to show your face.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_SuslovRostok_En: What are you doing at Rostok? How did you end up here?
Zulu decided I'd suffered enough from the Zone. He let me go… It's a shame you guys didn't do the same for Mavka.
She's dead, like half the people I went through that hell with. That's the second time I've had to witness something like that.
You expect me to be over it by now? I'm not. I'm not going to blame you, either. You made your choice, I made mine, and Mavka made hers. This is the outcome.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_SuslovRostok_Ho: How are things here after everything that happened?
You came here to gloat? Freedom is holding on. Rostok's still standing, and trade continues. People are surviving.
Factions are resilient. But people? Not so much.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_SuslovRostok_Ti: It's time for me to go.
Go then. I didn't invite you here, and I won't stop you from leaving.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_SuslovRostok_Wh: What are you going to do now?
I'll stick around here for a while. Maybe I'll go back to trading – Rostok is the best place for it. Or maybe I'll leave the Zone for good.
It's time to admit it – I'm not a scientist. Never was. I'm done with research, that much I know for sure.
Mavka believed that persistence pays off… Maybe. But not for me. The Zone showed me my place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_WarningSystem_1: Emergency mode activated. Main hatches are now open until the situation has been resolved.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_X19_EmbryoPrese: At first glance, Subject A-37 does not demonstrate a reaction to pain. At least, externally.
The scanning, however, showed a different result. Take a look at the brain activity images at the moment of the electrical discharge.
See this zone? Possibly, and I'm assuming this with great caution, the subject doesn't just feel pain, but also fear.
We'll check that hypothesis. The details of the experiments are provided in the documents my assistant will now give you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_BlockDesc: The rope broke. I don't know how you're supposed to get inside now.
You thought I'd get in through the roof? No, my boys have a more brutal plan.
Okay. Be careful. We've already got enough casualties.
X19 should be deep underground. Find a way to get down there.
Skif, come in! The comms are fuzzy. If you copy, keep going down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_DoorOpene: Skif, the door's open! I don't know what you did, but it worked!
Okay… I'm going in. No sign of Mavka... Holy sh...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_ElevatorT: Monorail? Why didn't we take the train here from the Concrete Plant?
The road up ahead was flooded. We wouldn't have made it through, even if we knew the way.
On top of that, the system is a real maze. Dozens of lines, dead ends, service tunnels. You've got no chance in here without a map.
How many of those lines does the Monorail have?
Voronin described it as a complete underground labyrinth. Countless lines, connecting tunnels, and dead ends.
Rumor has it that one of the lines even leads outside the Perimeter, right to the Mainland.
The Monorail system here is complex. Voronin tried to explain it once, but I'll be honest, I wasn't listening much.
The only thing I remember is the exit past the Perimeter. Rumor has it that one of the lines goes straight to the Mainland.
Right, enough radio chatter. See you in person soon.
Skif, did you find a way to continue onward?
Excellent. There should be a station of another Monorail line on the way. Waiting for you there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_EmbrioDoo: Here's what we came here for, Skif.
But the door's closed. We've got no explosives, and can't force it open.
Go ahead. I'll stay here and cover you in case Mavka shows up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Explosive: Anything but. Hit a dead end – the passage is blocked.
So make a new one. You've got explosives.
That's why I gave them to you. We don't have time for a detour – just blast it
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_FoundEntr: A hole in the roof. There's a rope, but no Mavka.
She's ahead of us, but we're on the right track.
Follow her down there. I'm headed your way, with reinforcements.
Skif, SITREP. What did you find?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_LabEntran: It's a shame I left all the explosives with my boys…
Fine, we'll do it the old-fashioned way – with bullets and wits.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_MaintDoor: I found some kind of system. Now I'm trying to figure out what it controls.
That's a good sign. Normally, there would be a door or a hatch nearby.
Found a hermetic door. It's blocked, can't open it up.
A hermetic door, you say? Then there must be a control panel around here somewhere.
I got all the time in the world. I hit another dead end, and I'm out of explosives.
Look for another way. Vents, hatches, service hallways.
Mavka got through, so there has to be a way.
That was one hell of a bang! Fuck…
Lieutenant, where do you think you're going? It's about to fall right onto your fucking head! Stay where you are, I'll take it from here.
Skif, come in. I made it, I'm inside. But I need some time to get to you. How are you holding up?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Meetup_Ab: You mean the remote from Lukash's stash? The one Mavka has.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Meetup_Ar: Are you alone? Where are your people?
The passage collapsed after the explosion. My group got cut off, so I ordered them back to base and went looking for you…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Meetup_Co: You know, that thing, it's like a TV remote. Opens doors, unlocks systems…
You can control the whole lab with it. And even destroy it, along with everything inside. All that's left is to find this gizmo.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Meetup_Ma: Mavka has some sort of remote. Is that it?
Right, the remote Lukash from Freedom had…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Meetup_Sa: If I understood the scribbles in those documents right, that tiny thing is supposed to activate the emergency destruction protocol.
Everything in the lab will be wiped out. Seems suspiciously easy, but we should give it a try.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Meetup_We: Mavka would have to get in line.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Meetup_ma: While I was making my way through to you, I found some documents in the offices. Lab schemes, protocols.
They describe the control system. The central console, the tanks with… specimens, and all that crap. And some other thing that seems to be really important.
So Mavka knows how to control the system… And if she doesn't know yet, she'll figure it out pretty soon.
We need to do something. Open the door, Skif.
Skif! And here I thought Mavka had offed you already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_PartialPo: Skif, what the fuck? What are you doing?
The laboratory's old, and the electronics are half-dead. The system couldn't take it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_Postscrip: As Duty's general, I have to say what they expect of me. That we won. That the Zone has receded. That those who died did not die in vain.
And this time, these aren't just empty words. We got results. The threat has been neutralized, the CNPP has been captured, and Freedom is defeated.
But between you and me, Skif, the cost was high.
What are you planning to do with the CNPP?
The CNPP will be our base. Our stronghold at the Zone's epicenter, right on the front line. The staging point for all of Duty's future missions.
But, I must admit, I'll do whatever it takes to one day see this station leveled to the ground. So that we can build homes here. So that people can finally come back.
I want to see the sunflowers bloom in the summer... There's truth to what they say: where sunflowers grow, the land is alive. And that means there's a future.
What will you do with Suslov?
That's up to him now. I let that old man go. He's suffered enough from the Zone. I didn't want to add to it.
Plus, Mavka always said that the freedom to choose is every person's basic need. She forgot about it somewhere along the way. But I remembered.
Was Mavka also part of the price?
Yes. The most painful one. But she made her own choice. She knew the risks, knew the consequences, and yet she went all the way.
I once would have said the Zone claimed her. But now I know: the Zone is to blame for much, but not for this. Mavka chose her path herself.
Just as Voronin chose to sacrifice himself, and you chose to fight by my side. The Zone is an evil place, but our decisions are our own responsibility.
But now Duty is back, and stronger than before.
True. Duty is alive and moving forward again, not standing still. That, perhaps, is what it was all for.
We were stagnant for many years. We held our ground, but we never pushed forward. But now we have the power, the purpose, and the will to act.
General Voronin, my men... Mavka. They're gone. And that is the reason we cannot give up. If we do, we betray their memory.
What's the Duty General's plan?
I will take control of the situation. I'll do what needs to be done. And I won't let go of the reins again.
The Zone is growing stronger and more dangerous. That means we have to stay one step ahead. And we will.
But first, I'll drink a cup of tea. To everyone who died, and everyone who was ready to die, but survived. To you, Skif. You made this victory possible.
The result would have made Voronin proud.
He definitely would have approved of the result. But the methods? I'm not so sure.
Voronin had a talent for balance. He was tough, but never cruel. Strong, but never blind. I have much to learn from his example.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_SkifNearR: Skif, our scouts spotted Mavka near the fourth reactor.
Looks like she was trying to get up onto the roof.
Any idea what she might be looking for?
A way down to the reactor, most likely.
Head there. And if you see her… remember that she chose her side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_StatusChe: Once you get the doors open, I'm going straight in... How's it going on your end?
I've passed the living quarters, going down. The technical floor should be here somewhere.
Some kinda sound. Like… there's someone behind the door. We need to hurry up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_MQ12_QD_Zulus_StrangeNo: You know what's bothering me here? It's quiet. Too quiet for a laboratory that hosts hundreds of mutants.
Voronin used to say, "It's a bad omen if it's quiet before the battle. That means the enemy is laying low, and you've already lost on the tactical level".
All that's left is the quiet and the enemy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Richter_Comments_Generi: Shit’s about to hit the fan…
Ah, now that’s a nice workout.
Keep a bolt handy! You'll need it.
Hey! You’ll miss out on the main course!
Suit yourself. More fun for me.
Stick with me - for your own sake.
Try not to get lost, friendo!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_AL_GhostWrit: If only you knew what it's like when the crowd reacts to your words: sighing, laughing, or crying out in anger! In those moments, I feel like I'm doing something important.
And though I'm not the one saying my words, someone like Master is.
What matters is they're mine! Who would've thought my talent for writing would awaken in such a strange place, and at such a strange time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_LI_PropTopic: Join Freedom here in Rostok. You will have a roof over your head and a brighter tomorrow!
Fight in the Arena, make money, swim in glory, and earn everyone's respect in the Zone.
Always dreamed of becoming the hero of that horror story Duty will be telling each other by the fire? Freedom knows how to make that dream come true.
Whatever happens in the Zone, Rostok always comes out on top. All the best entertainment, goods, and services.
Join us, and your voice will decide what the Zone will be like, here and now – with your fair share paid for your honest work.
Freedom, we defeated Duty, we won back the heart of the Zone! Very soon, thanks to you, people on the Mainland will hear about Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_LO_DoorsClos: Rostok is in lockdown: all entrances are now closing!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_LO_DoorsOpen: Rostok is open again. Have fun!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_LO_EmissionC: The Emission is almost here! Get your asses to shelter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_LO_EmissionE: All clear. Enough sitting around. Go get some fresh air.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_LO_EmissionS: The fun begins. Stay in shelter, everyone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_QC_Bogey_0_C: Time to get the hell outta Rostok. Nothing left for us here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_QC_amsterdam: When Mavka was recruiting, I was lying wounded at Kyrylov's. It's a shame I couldn't get into her squad.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_QC_fraj_0_Ch: If I got paid decent money for my job, there's no way I'd get into betting on stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_QC_kira_fiti: Hey, listen, tell me what you were doing in Duty.
Pretty much the same. Served beer to the folks from behind this very counter.
So you don't care who you work for?
There's no way I'd leave my dudes behind. I don't get people like you.
I'll spell it out. Remember when you were sucking up to Myklukha? And when the tables turned, you started complimenting Mavka. Now do you get it?
I'm not in the mood for beer anymore. I'll find myself another hangout.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_QC_kola_amst: Dude, I heard Myklukha had an artifact stash somewhere. If you know anything, I'm willing to pay for the information.
If something comes up, I'll let you know. I'll host an auction.
Maybe we can skip the auction, for old times' sake?
Piss off, bro. If I was selling a wish granter, you'd still be haggling.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_QC_semen_dan: I should've come to the Arena back then. Missed such a historic event. Eh!
Master comments on the Arena fights better than Mavka ever did. He's much more fun, so passionate.
Mavka was a maverick, she would always wing it. Your pan is phony, nothing but a producer's project. He's just reading the script.
Word is, someone else is writing all the stuff for him. Like a ghost writer. Master's just the mouthpiece.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_aleks_fraj_0: Always have your ear to the ground. Especially in times of total chaos. People tend to say things, and they don't notice someone listening. Or taking notes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_arni_0_HubIn: What can you tell me about this place?
After Freedom secured the CNPP, things are looking up for Rostok.
Old grudges are almost forgotten, the mood and the spirits are up.
Nothing unites people more than defeating a common enemy.
What can you tell me about this place?
Rostok isn't what it used to be. First, that fight between our guys. Then some left for the CNPP, others stayed here.
In the end, everyone's mad, suspicious, and no one trusts anyone. I'm trying my best to ease the tension, but it's not as easy as it seems.
But I believe: a river cuts through rock.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_arni_0_Infot: Now it's absolutely clear that Duty and Freedom can't get along in the Zone.
Both Duty and us will be spending more on weapons now and less on everything else. And that would be better for who? No one, I guess.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_arni_0_Meet_: Why aren't you bowing down to the new leader of Rostok? I'm just messing with you, chill! I'm still trying to figure out if this was a promotion or a set-up.
I didn't ask for this spot: I never chased rank or power. I still don't get why Mavka chose me, of all people. She could have chosen anyone.
Maybe it's because I got her out of the Arena? I hope she visits some time and I can get my answer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_arni_0_Resto: I'm not exactly popular in Freedom. Can I make amends?
Maybe you can. Coupons can help you undo the damage.
You made the right call. Behave from now on.
Your call. Hope you don't regret it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_barmen_0_Inf: Mavka did the right thing when she left Arnie in charge of Rostok. Finally, a decent person to make decisions around here.
I believe he's the future for Rostok, and Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_barmen_0_RSQ: I'm looking for a job. Anything you can offer?
I don't know what Duty is busy with, but the mutants are going wild. They've started attacking couriers and have already messed up a couple of important deliveries.
It's just not right, these brainless creatures messing with my profits. You get rid of them, and I'll pay you handsomely in coupons.
With all that beef between Myklukha and Mavka's people, there was no one to take care of the mutants. They've been attacking more and more couriers, and getting closer to Rostok.
It's no surprise that I'm not too happy about it – my profits aren't exactly growing. I'm ready to pay if you can help put the local wildlife back in its place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_barmen_0_mee: I used to dream about Freedom and Duty drinking here together one day, leaving all their grudges in the past.
But I guess that's what dreams are for: looking back at them, thinking, "What a clueless idiot I was".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_bereza_0_Inf: Some people around here miss Myklukha, but I definitely don't. When he was around, Freedom was a lot less free.
I like Arnie – he's not sleeky or greedy. Just a regular guy, as the leader of Rostok should be.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_bereza_0_Mee: It's a shame so many people had to suffer because of those squabbles in Rostok.
But what gives me hope is some people now have a spark in their eyes. Freedom saw a new purpose, and is ready to act instead of just sitting around at the bar.
I heard whispers about Duty coming to Rostok, to get back what's theirs. They're all mad at Freedom after the CNPP battle.
Wish I could leave this place and settle somewhere quieter, but I can't. The boys need the stuff I'm selling.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_den_krasnov_: Everyone in Rostok thinks I got something up my sleeve, so Arnie won't trust me with anything. I can't show anyone what I'm capable of if it keeps going like this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_kirill_anton: Everything in Rostok was controlled by Myklukha himself. Medical supply deliveries included.
Let's see what the local revolutionaries have to say when they run out of bandages in their medkits. They'll have to treat their bullet wounds with herbal remedies.
As a doctor, I must say that a forced change of leadership does more harm to one's health than smoking and eating fatty foods.
So I strongly disapprove of any riots and skirmishes. For instance, after what happened in Rostok, I had to take bullets out of people for five hours straight.
That's why, as a doctor, I disapprove of you supporting Mavka. But I can't refuse you medical help. That's not an option for me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_kola_amsterd: Mavka and I have something in common. I used to have a Duty friend too, but then I realized you couldn't do business with them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_laguha_0_Mee: These days, people are trying to avoid getting out of Rostok too much. Duty's become all cocky after they won at the CNPP. They're walking around the Zone like it's theirs.
My services got a lot more popular after Myklukha's murder. While many people decided to leave, a surprising number also rushed to Rostok.
So, I did quite a lot of Zone tours lately. Great chance to try out some new routes. I can take you as well if you need to get somewhere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_mikluha_0_By: Come on back, don't be shy!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_mikluha_0_Hu: What can you tell me about this place?
We got it pretty good here in Rostok now, right? Sell whatever you want, buy whatever you want – almost. Fight if you're up for it, rest if you're not.
Just do whatever, as long as it's not a problem for anyone else. True freedom. My Freedom. Much better than back in the Duty days, eh?
What can you tell me about this place?
I can tell you for sure there'll be no more Duty in Rostok. We screwed up our relationship once and for all.
Honestly, though, that situation doesn't bother me all that much. What I need to figure out is how to turn those circumstances into profits.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_mikluha_0_In: The Zone is full of opportunities. For some, they're opportunities to die, of course. But for others, it's the opportunity to get stronger and richer.
It's not the Zone's fault there are more dead people than rich people. But I'm not complaining.
The Ward, Duty, the Corps… they all found their goal. And now they are suffering because they can't reach it.
I never made that mistake. True freedom is not a goal, it's a state of mind.
Voronin and I aren't that different. He's taking care of his people, and I'm taking care of mine. I'm just better at it.
I heard you killed Mavka and Zen. I'm sorry about Zen, but I can't blame you for Mavka. You could tell she was asking for a bullet, so she was bound to get one sooner or later.
But I'm sure you understand. After what you did to our people, whether they were good or bad, we can't be best friends.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_mikluha_0_Me: Welcome, man. I'm Myklukha, the leader of Freedom and all this… place. Quite the place it is, for sure.
Because the Zone has a lot to offer, if you know how to ask for it.
War… brings its own opportunities. And its own horrors, of course. But there are more possibilities than sorrows with a capable leader.
Someone reliable. With his head out of the clouds. I think you know what I mean.
First, Lukash, and now her. Stubborn son of a gun. And all of them, dying for his ideas, are no better.
Why is everyone here so eager to die for something? Can't we just live?
Freedom is here to stay, Skif. Some might not like it. Maybe, you won't. But it changes nothing.
I'm not going anywhere, either. I led Freedom to the top once. I'll do it again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_mikluha_0_Re: I have some trouble with Freedom. How can I make things right?
Everyone makes mistakes. But every mistake has a price. Today, your price is this.
Your call. But tomorrow's a brand new day, and a brand new price.
Glad you made the right call.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_semen_danily: I never thought I'd witness Freedom coming back to its roots. What a time to be alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_starevsik_0_: You know who always has it good, no matter who's in charge? Kiss-asses! Like Eugene.
When Myklukha was in charge, Eugene would bring him food, call him a friend. As soon as the power shifted, Arnie suddenly became his 'friend', even though they never talked before.
If stalkers changed clothes as often as they changed sides, the tailors here would earn more than everyone else put together.
After Myklukha died, everyone got so mad at the way things used to be all of a sudden! Why didn't you say anything when he was around?
If it wasn't for him, I wouldn't be sitting here. Like many others in Rostok. People tend to forget who they should be thanking.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_surup_0_Info: I gave Myklukha my masterpiece – "The portrait of an unknown stalker". He promised he'd sell it on the Mainland and make me a famous artist.
Where's my unknown stalker now? Unknown.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_surup_0_Meet: When I have a free minute, I like painting with watercolors. But after that Duty skirmish, I barely have enough time for a pencil sketch.
I gave Myklukha my masterpiece – "The portrait of an unknown stalker". He promised he'd sell it on the Mainland and make me a famous artist.
Myklukha has connections everywhere. I bet he has some friends in the fine art business.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_udzin_0_Info: There's this stalker who drinks with Duty at the Concrete Plant. He tells me Ragman is a regular there.
So think twice before you give him your coupons.
You know who Ragman's last customers were? Guys from Duty! If you think it’s worth doing business with that rat, think again.
I can tell by your face, though: he's exactly the type of guy you'd be friends with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_Rostok_Hub_udzin_0_Meet: After that Duty shitstorm, my whole supply chain is fucked.
You're lucky I'm a talented businessman and a skilled negotiator. Otherwise, you'd be left here with Ragman and forced to buy his overpriced trash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_kajf_0_Defea: It hurts, man. It hurts so bad!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_kajf_0_InfoT: The point is, man, to find your chill in whatever hellhole you’re in. Like, I got an old reggae album on my PDA. Pop it on in one ear, and there it is – the Iron Forest turns into the tropics. Well, almost.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_kajf_0_Resum: Let’s get back to it, man?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_kap_usatij_0: Don't go trespassing on restricted territory, stalker.
I’m hit! Need some help here, mates!
I'm sure the code was written by smart people, and that it's saved many lives, but no guidelines can help you survive in the unpredictable Zone.
So I rely on common sense, first and foremost. That's how I got the idea to leave stashes in the forest: learning from stalkers’ experience.
I think we were talking about…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_lejt_sorel_0: It's your lucky day, loner, I'm not busy. What did you want?
We keep losing essential personnel in the field, and it turns out we could've just hired a stalker. Don't even need to include them in the reports! Very handy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_sold_aguero_: What’s wrong with you?! Not now!
It hurts! I need some help here!
I haven't been serving for long, but I wanna help.
Serving is easier when you got mates you can rely on. Panchenko was like that. He shouldn't have volunteered for that scouting mission… Or I should've been with him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_sold_pancenk: I won’t be much help to you now.
Don’t mind the uniform, I left the IPSF.
I used to be proud of this uniform, but now I can’t wait for the day I’ll be able to swap it for a new one. I won’t sell it, though. Matter of principle.
Let’s finish our chat. Who knows if we’ll have time later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_vova_kes_0_I: Once I get outta here, I'm staying in Rostok for good. Get myself a job close to the bar and the Arena. I only care about money, so screw going on any more 'adventures'.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_DLC01_vova_kes_0_R: Sorry, I forgot what I was saying.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_AgueroInteract_: I don’t have time to talk now, loner. Something happened to my mates, and we’re stuck here, doing nothing.
Thanks for agreeing to help, stalker. I would’ve gone to help the guys myself, but the captain won’t let me. Just head out ASAP, okay?
Make sure to do your best, stalker. I’m sure they’re fine and something just didn’t go according to plan.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Kajf_Interact_G: Head to Kurin, our camp. You’ll find your IPSF soldiers there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Kajf_SkifApproa: Man, look! A loner! Am I trippin’?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Panchenko_Mumbl: IPSF is guarding the Perimeter? Yeah, right. It's a miracle this Perimeter hasn't been sold off brick by brick already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_SkifIgnores_Ign: I don’t know what you’re trying to do by getting away from the Iron Forest. But my offer won't last forever – the passage through won’t stay open for long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Sorel_ComeBefor: Look who’s here! The savior. What a hero, and still breathing, too. Just wow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Sorel_Interact_: I’m not the one in charge here. Go to Vusatyi.
You did what you were supposed to do here. What are you waiting for? Applause?
They won’t… won’t dare touch me. I got enough connections at the HQ, so Vusatyi can shove that report up his ass. Myklukha will vouch for me personally. Got it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Sorel_Shout_Cry: Help! Kill the bastards! I’m locked in here!
Enough screwing around. Kill the bastards!
I’ll open up, just kill those mutants!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_UsachCalls02_Co: Come on over, don’t just stand there. We’re on a clock.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_UsachCalls_Come: Since you’re here already, come on over. Let’s chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_UsachCalls_Fore: Hey, stalker! Thanks for your help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_UsachCalls_Garb: Thanks, stalker. Come over here, let’s talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_UsachFightYell_: Way to go, stalker! Get them!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_UsachWarning_Wa: Where are you going? Don’t test my patience, loner, or we won’t spare the bullets.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Usach_Interact_: The new shift will start soon. So you better get going.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_VovaKesKajf_Flu: Yeah, screw that, man. Let’s get back.
Not a walk in the park there, either. Duty, plus the IPSF wimps. And we have a job to do here, remember?
Freedom has some kinda business everywhere. Why’d we get the Iron Forest?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_VovaKes_Interac: All alone in a place like this? Come on!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_VusatyiAguero_F: Captain, don’t you have a heart? They’re out there, no comms, no supplies...
They could be dead, for all I know, and I’m not letting you go there alone. Let the stalker handle it.
Come in, Panchenko, do you copy? This is the base, where are you? Over!
Captain, they’re swarming in like crazy! We need help!
Don’t go outside the perimeter. I won’t have any more casualties! Got it? Take shelter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QC_Vusatyi_TimeOut: Come in, stalker. A new shift is about to start. It’s better to stay away from the IPSF checkpoint unless you want to catch a bullet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Aguero_AfterTal: Were you friends with this Panchenko?
I was. He saved my ass some time ago. Even though he was just a rookie, too.
He preferred to stay dead in the report. But he’s alive, and gave me his PDA.
What? Wow… Thank you for telling me. I won’t breathe a word of this to anyone.
Panchenko, you little shit… That’s no way to abandon your friends. But he’s alive, the bastard! Here I was, assuming the worst.
Panchenko, you little shit… That’s no way to abandon your brothers in arms. But he’s alive. I was thinking the worst.
Panchenko’s dead… All of them. What the hell? We were gonna… I don’t get it. I’m sorry, stalker. I’m not really in the mood to talk now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Harpoon_Questio: Have you seen an IPSF squad nearby?

Yes, I have. I feel sorry for those poor bastards, but they have no gratitude at all. My men saved them from death, covered their asses when the crunch came. And eventually, the wounded one—Panchenko—decided to join Duty.
Look for him on their side. You can't mistake a grim mug like that for anything else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Kajf_FirstTalk_: What can you tell me about your camp?
It’s safe, well, as safe as it can be in the Iron Forest. I wouldn’t call it a quiet place, though. Crowded, almost like Rostok, and we get all sorts of different folks here.
Sure, there’s no Arena and no bar, but we manage to live in the lap of luxury. So drop by when you can – Harpoon is excited when he gets new guests. And new clients, of course.
Have you seen an IPSF squad around?
Just now? Yeah, we did. Wanted to offer them a round of cards, but they were too busy. Fighting off mutants and all outta ammo.
We did all the dirty work for them, but this one soldier managed to get hurt anyway. So we sent him and the others to Kurin, our camp, to get patched up.
How do I get to your camp?
It’s pretty close. I’ll mark the spot on your PDA.
Say hi to our guys. We’ll stay here and chill for now, just because it’s fun. We like it here. Arrivederci, brother!
After a hike like that, you're probably looking for a place to get patched up. Or at least rest. Head over to Kurin – it has everything you need.
What are those IPSF guys like?
Three of them. One lieutenant and two rookies, very young.
If you ask me — and, man, I'm not quick to judge — their commanding officer’s shady. Apart from that, just your usual military guys, and boring as hell. But can you blame ‘em?
Wowzers. A loner in the Iron Forest. You’re either a tough cookie, or just lucky to end up here in one piece.
Hey man, are you lost? This is the Iron Forest, in case you didn’t know.
And what are you doing here?
Chill, man! We aren’t interrogating you, so go easy on us, yeah? We’re all free people here, wandering where we please!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Panchenko_After: That’s all I wanted to ask.
So long, stalker. I’ll stay here for now.
What do you want? I gave you the PDA, so tell Vusatyi I’m dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Panchenko_First: What happened to you?
Blast. Mutants. Loads of them. Spent all my ammo. And our backup stash is empty.
Lieutenant Sorel isn’t even trying to hide what he’s doing. He dismisses it all as if he’s saying, “Who’s gonna come after me? I got connections.”
If it wasn’t for the Freedom guys, I would’ve been some mutant’s lunch. And if it wasn’t for that Duty doctor, the infection would’ve killed me.
Vusatyi asked me to find you and the rest of the squad.
Well, well! Took him a while! You can tell it to his face: I’m not coming back.
I came here to defend people from the Zone, not cover up the shenanigans of shady service members while they sell government-issued goods.
I… Okay, you know what? I won’t be court-martialed. Take my PDA. What did Vusatyi say, dead or alive? Did I guess that right? So let him think I’m dead.
What are you gonna do now?
I think I’ll join Duty. At least, they don’t tolerate treating the code as empty words. They got each other’s backs for real. All of them – not just some, like Aguero and I.
Vezha, their medic, treats folks for free and does it properly. And Zulu seems trustworthy. He’s not the kinda guy to send his mates to die for some coupons.
So yeah, Duty it is.
Where are your former mates?
Went to rob yet another stash, at the monitoring spot. I’ll be happy if I never see them again.
I know that Captain Vusatyi is a good guy. The forest stashes were his idea. He saw stalkers doing it, and put some up here and there for a rainy day. He knew patrols can be tough.
Another mate of mine, Aguero, is a decent service member.
But what’s the point if there are folks like Sorel around? That shitface decided his paycheck wasn’t enough. Sold our stash to bandits and left us to die out there.
Thanks for taking my PDA, stalker. I won’t be coming back.
You’re from Lieutenant Sorel’s squad?
I was. I left the squad, and left IPSF altogether.
Let me clear this up right away: if you wanna buy or sell something, I’m not your guy. You’d need to ask my former IPSF colleagues. My service days are over.
I’ll get patched up a bit and start saving for a new vest right away. Because fuck service.
Fuck having to serve with those folks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Sorel_AfterDial: You go first and clear the road.
Don't be an eyesore. I won't thank you again—once is enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Sorel_FirstTalk: Vusatyi said dead or alive. I prefer dead.
Get going. I guess I’ll see if they off you on your way out. I’ll find my own way to the checkpoint. Okay, see ya.
Vusatyi asked me to find the three of you. Where are the others?
Panchenko managed to catch a bullet. He’s chilling at the Freedom camp.
And Tsvyhun couldn’t do what he was supposed to when a mutant attacked. Left his commander in mortal danger and then got killed himself.
Loner? Got rid of the mutant? Turns out you’re more use than my army mate.
You deserve some gratitude, of course. Words of gratitude, anyway, so you can consider this an official thank you. As for a material form of appreciation... Sorry, that’s not by the book.
Okay, see ya. Officially, though, I haven’t seen ya. You better get outta my sight and stay away. This is a strategic facility, and trespassing is a serious offense.
Vusatyi asked me to find you and bring you back to the checkpoint.
I’ll be back anyway. Others can suit themselves.
All outta questions? Yeah? That’s just great. I need to get to the checkpoint for a status report. Vusatyi tasked you to bring the group back? Why don’t you do that.
Mission execution happened here, loner. The details aren’t meant for your ears. Then, we had some emergency circumstances represented by the local fauna.

I acted based on my situation assessment: took shelter. Private Tsvyhun hesitated. Short version is he didn’t make it. And I have to report it now. That’s all I’m telling you, loner, so you’re free to go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_UsachMainDialog: Do you think there’s a chance they’re still alive?
I hope so. It scares me to think about what the mutants are fleeing from when they come here. If what they’re running from is in the Iron Forest, we can only hope for the best out here.
They gotta be. They each know the place like the back of their hand. They’ll be fine.
You’re testing my patience. Let’s make a deal: you find my men, and we’ll pretend we never saw you trespassing.
You’re still here, loner? Less conversation, more action! We don’t have much time before the new shift arrives.
I don’t know how you managed to get into the Iron Forest, stalker, but this is a strategic facility secured by the IPSF.
Nice job with those mutants, you saved us some ammo. What are you doing here? Saw the party lights in the Iron Forest and decided to join?
Why didn’t you ask for backup earlier?
I would’ve, gladly, but our forces have their hands full at the Perimeter. Had another breach recently, and there’s just not enough spare hands.
Bottom line is we’re short on people, and the work isn’t getting any easier.
I sent three scouts to locate a hole in a wall. Our shift is almost over, and they’re nowhere to be found. I wanted to send a search party, and then the Forest went boom…
But those scouts need to be accounted for, dead or alive. Bring them or their PDAs to me as proof. Questions?
Mutants started crawling from under every rock, big and small. Half my squad was wounded in action. So you understand why I can’t send my people on any kind of rescue mission now.
My plans are none of your concern.
Trying to get to a strategic facility under IPSF protection, and pushy, too. That’s exactly why I usually fire a warning shot when I see a stalker…
You’ll manage without me.
We will, stalker, no doubt. My soldiers are experienced.
But if you change your mind, my offer stands.
Now, leave this military facility. Come on, scram!
Open the gate, soldier!
Got it. Where could your people be?
Here. Their stash coordinates. If something went south, they would’ve taken the supplies and left a report. Start there.
There were three of them: Lieutenant Sorel, Private Panchenko, and Private Tsvyhun. I want to know the fate of the whole squad, so don’t get in my way until you’ve found all three.

The new shift will get here soon, and they’re not the chatty type, so start right away. If they’re not on comms and there’s no proof of death, they’re a deserter. And that’s a guaranteed court-martial. Wouldn’t want my guys to have their lives ruined.
Captain, he could help!
He did already. I’m not proud to admit it, but we’ll need to ask for more.
My scouts disappeared in the Iron Forest. If you manage to find them or bring proof of death, I’ll pretend I never saw you here. And I’ll make sure to issue a reward for you.
Let’s say you’re right. I want to get to the Iron Forest.
That’s exactly why I usually fire a warning shot when I see a stalker…
You got a deal, Captain.
Here’s the situation. Freedom set up camp in the Iron Forest. We can’t touch them — orders from above, some deal with Myklukha. But no one ordered me not to block the passages they came here.
What is the IPSF doing here?
IPSF is the international security guarding not just the Perimeter, but strategic facilities. The Iron Forest is a strategic facility. So we’re guarding it, as best we can.
We used to fight off the mutants and you stalkers, but now we barely seem to manage those bastards attacking. The situation is unstable, to put it mildly.
We’ve got no spare hands while we’re waiting for the new shift, so could really use your assistance.
What do I have to do again?
My scout team got lost in the Iron Forest. No comms. I need to know what happened to them. If you find them, dead or alive, you’ll get a reward. A dog tag or a PDA count as proof.
The job will be done when you find the whole squad. Don’t worry, you’ll get your reward. Any more questions?
What’s up with the Iron Forest?
I don’t know the details, just that when the disco lights started, comms all went down. So I don’t even know what happened to my own people.
Besides, these Blasts have some kind of impact on the mutants. All these years in the Zone, and I’ve never seen them so aggressive.
Bottom line: going out there is extremely dangerous – even more than before. But if you’re headed there anyway, help me find my scouts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_Usach_FinalTalk: How could this happen!
Anything else?
I brought one back to base, and here are the others’ PDAs.
I can’t believe it! Panchenko, too! What the…
Both, you say… So young. Thanks for bringing these to me. It matters. Now, tell me everything. I need to know what went down there.
All three scouts died. Here.
I can’t believe it! Panchenko, too! What the…
Easy, soldier.
All three, you say… Thanks for bringing these to me. It matters. Now, tell me everything. I need to know what went down there.
What really went down is Panchenko has deserted. He wants to join Duty.
So, Duty you say? Deserted… Didn’t see that coming. He seemed like a smart guy.
I have to file a report on every deserter, but I don’t want to ruin a young fool’s life.
My report will say private Panchenko was killed in action. PDA attached. I heard nothing, and you know nothing.
That’s all I can say.
Shame. Anyway, here’s your reward.
I haven't found them yet.
Come back when you find all three of them.
I found my own way back, Captain. Reporting for duty, safe and sound.
That’s a surprise! Glad to welcome you back, soldier.
Sorry, but I can’t just take your word for it. The stalker might be lying, but Tsvyhun’s PDA isn’t.
So that’s why… I thought it was just a mess, and it turns out we had a rat. It’s a shame you can’t court-martial the dead.
Loner! Did you manage to find my scouts?
Our shift is almost over. The next one won’t be so willing to chat. I don’t want us to be late.
Lieutenant Sorel was selling the stashes you left around the Iron Forest.
Thanks, loner. Now, leave the military facility before the new shift comes in.
Thank you, stalker. You earned your reward.
Bullshit, stalker! That’s a lie!
The stalker might be lying, but Tsvyhun’s PDA isn’t.
Hey! Don’t you believe me, Captain?! You’re gonna let him bullshit you like that? There’s no way I’d sell GI… Never!
So that’s why… I thought it was just a mess, and it turns out we have a rat. I’ll deal with it. By the code.
You can’t prove anything!
We’ll see. The court-martial will decide what to do with you. Now, take him away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ01_QD_VusatyiAguero_F: Stay down! Don’t waste your ammo! Only shoot if you have a clear shot!
We got a man down, captain!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_bilonizhko_0: Not now. Wrong time, wrong place
It's too soon. I'm not ready to see the great beyond yet…
While I was at Mayo's, I heard some talk.
Their boss found a new weapons supply channel. They're expecting a large batch of rifles any day now.
Got sidetracked, but now I'm ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_gembel_0_Bus: No, my chatting chakra is closed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_gembel_0_Def: I feel like I'm flying away from the Zone…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_gembel_0_Res: Let's bring this conversation back to life.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_horiv_0_Busy: Pardon, man. No time to talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_horiv_0_Info: There's one weird thing. They say that over the Red Forest, they sometimes see… colorful mists.
Not poisonous, not anomalous, just visions: green, purple. They say it's so beautiful, it's to die for. Nobody knows what it is.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_horiv_0_Resu: I'm jumping between subjects like a coupon between PDAs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_katok_0_Busy: Don't try to talk my ear off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_mayo_0_Resum: Thoughts are like birds, but I've got bread.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_mokrica_0_Re: Intermission's done. Let's go back to the show.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_saza_0_Defea: Fuck, today's not a good day to die…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_saza_0_Resum: What were we going on about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_DLC01_spatel_0_Def: It's too soon to roll the credits…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Bandit1_Newcome: Mayo, I can see a loner. Looks fancy. I think he's our guy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Bandit1_SitFire: Now that's what I'm talking about. The best deals are made with suckers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Bandit2_WrongEn: Thank you so much. I'd be screwed if it wasn't for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_BanditOutside_I: Hey, you lost or something? You can't go here. Beat it to the main entrance!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_BanditStairs_In: Only our guys can hang out here, got it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_BanditsFluff2_S: How long are we gonna be stuck here?
For as long as we're told to. Stop bitchin'.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_BanditsFluff_St: It's sure taking them a while… Maybe they've tricked us?
Don't freak out, Roosevelt is a man of his word. We were told to wait, so we're waiting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Bilonizhko_Inte: Wait a minute. We need to get away from here and call Khoryv to report the success.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Crocus_Interact: There's an article in Duty's code… an article on traitors. I know it well. Give me some space.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Khoryv_Ambush_1: The coupons weren't for you, mon camarade! Time to pay back the debt.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Khoryv_ComeHere: Oh, maestro! Care to make some coupons?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Khoryv_DeadAfte: Khoryv here. Listen, mon camarade, we asked you to help, not to trade in the lives of others. There will be no coupons.
You'd better hope our paths never cross again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Khoryv_FinalCal: Copy that. Happy to hear you're alive, mon ami. Is the negotiator with you?
Sending you a token of gratitude right now. Your part is done, and we'll take it from here. If you have time, come visit us at our base. I owe you a drink.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Khoryv_FreedomF: We've got un problème with geography: those thugs wanna meet beyond the 'red line'.
It's a trap, Khoryv. If we go there, we'll end up in the hands of Duty. If we don't go, they'll just give our guy up to them.
That's right. We need a neutral party… The only question is where we can find them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Khoryv_GiveMone: This is Khoryv. You should've received the Coupons by now.
Be careful out there, okay? Those guys have a chance machine in place of brains.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Khoryv_HostageD: This is Khoryv. You've made a mess, mon camarade.
Listen, the deal was to bring him alive. But if it's not the case… you understand. Nothing personal, it's just how it is.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Mayo_AfterTalk2: What's your problem, man? Listen… say hi to Roosevelt from Mayo. Tell him we're always happy to help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Mayo_AfterTalk3: If you're gonna hang out here, our new partners may misunderstand.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Mayo_AfterTalk4: What have you done, dumbass?! Hit him, guys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Mayo_AfterTalk5: Lesson learned. Dealing with you is more trouble than it's worth.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Mayo_AfterTalk_: Go on, scram. Before we decide we've got room for another client.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Spatel_AfterTal: What are you looking at? Nothing to see here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QC_Voronin_Meet_1_: General. Is there any news from the bandits?
The deal is done, if you mean the traitor.
You know, it's because of fools like him that good fighters end up in the ground. You stopped it before it was too late. Thank you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QD_Bilonizhko_Resc: Are you Khoryv's guy? You were in the right place at the right time! Thank you.
They broke into all of our PDAs. They were looking for stashes, but they found Khoryv in my contacts. You know what happened next.
You're free to go. Nobody's keeping you.
Yeah, I'm gonna go. It's not a good idea to linger here.
How did the bandits even manage to capture you?
Our patrol team was attacked by a pack of beasts and I was wounded. The rest weren't so lucky. When I came round, the bandits were already emptying out our pockets.
These ones turned out to be smart…
It's not us who's smart. It's just that you're predictable as fuck.
What kind of information were you collecting?
How do I put it… Freedom isn't really interested in our victories over mutants. They're interested in our weaknesses.
Supply routes, holes in patrol paths, disgruntled officers… anything that allows them to avoid direct confrontation and hit where it's least expected.
Why did you decide to betray Duty?
Everything has its limits. Including patience. I'm tired of fighting for an idea I no longer believe in.
Khoryv offered me coupons and an opportunity to escape. That was enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QD_Khoryv_Clarify_: Remind me what you need from me.
Go to the meeting point, get the coupons for the ransom, and rescue our guy from the bandits – alive. Doesn't matter how.
When notre ami calls back, I'll send you a token of gratitude. This should be a piece of cake for you.
Just make it quick. The bandits aren't gonna wait forever.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QD_Khoryv_QuestSta: Salut, I'm Khoryv. You look solid, that's good for the job.
We've got a face-off set right on Duty turf. You know how it is – if we show up there, we'll make a lot of noise.
We need someone without a patch, just like you. Will you help us rescue our man?
Thank you so much, mon camarade! I'll send you the ransom when you're close to the meeting point. It's right here.
You just get our guy out of there alive, then he'll know what to do. When he calls us, you'll get more Сoupons on top of this.
But if something goes wrong… They're bandits, nobody's gonna miss them.
The decision is yours, but bear in mind that we're in a tight spot here. A neutral party is our only hope.
What do I have to do?
The bandits have captured our friend and now they demand Coupons to keep him in one piece. Will you be our middleman?
We'll reward you, too, if you do the job well.
Why don't you make the deal yourselves?
'Cause the meeting's been called in Duty's territory. If we show up there, it's gonna stir up a mess. We don't want that.
We need someone like you, without a patch. For them, you're just gonna be part of the scenery. So you go there, make the deal, and leave.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QD_Khoryv_Repeat_R: Back already, maestro? Make me happy, tell me you've changed your mind. Will you help us rescue our guy from the bandits?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QD_Mayo_FirstMeeti: Deal.
Stand down, guys! Let him take his friend.
No deal, then. We'll have to do it the hard way.
You asked for it. Get the cheap bastard!
You'd better hand him to Duty. They'll appreciate it.
What a plot twist! You've come to rescue him but ended up helping us sell him for a higher price? I like you, chap. No nonsense, just pure commerce.
Listen. You've saved me some time and maybe also a couple of my guys. Here's a tip for you.
The stash is in the devil's ass. We're not going there ourselves, but maybe you'd like to take the risk.
Now excuse me, I need to make a call. It should make your Khoryv happy.
I don't have time for this circus. Here are your extra coupons, now let the hostage go.
Now this is my kind of businessman! You may take your buddy. Guys, stand down!
I have a better idea.
All right, try and surprise me.
You're such a big shot, huh? All right… I can see you're a businessman, and you value your time. We do, too.
Let's settle on the old price, and you can take your poor sap.
I'm gonna take the risk. Let's see how you'll do alone against all of us.
I'm not here to negotiate. I'm here to collect the debt.
What the fuck do you mean, debt? I don't owe you shit.
Tell Roosevelt that Skif took the guy to settle an old deal. If he has any questions, he knows where to find me.
Ah, that's what's up… So, Roosevelt changed his plans. What can I say, we don't make the rules. We're not going up against the boss.
Sure, take your friend. Stand down, guys!
Ah, are you lost, dandy boy?
Khoryv sent me. I've come to get the hostage.
I see… Well, while you were getting here, the tides have turned. Your client is so interesting that Duty is also prepared to pay for him.
So the price has changed. Consider it inflation.
Let's weigh it up. Faint hope for Coupons from Duty later… or real money from me right now. The choice is simple if you want to live.
And what does Duty have to do with it?
So Khoryv is keeping you in the dark and just using you? Smart guy. Just so you know, the man you've come to get is from Duty.
When we opened his PDA, we found all his chats with Khoryv. Now he's in high demand with everyone.
You need him to keep quiet, and Duty needs him to sing. You get me? The stakes are higher now, so think – and think fast.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ04_QD_Mayo_NoDeal_1_8: Change of plans, Khoryv. The stalker you sent has given me a brilliant idea. Your guy is coming home to Duty.
You're making a very big mistake, Mayo. A major mistake.
Mistake for you, profit for me. To each their own. Bye.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_bulat_0_Info: Duty instructors aren't here to help greenhorns wipe. We're here to make sure they're ready and don't get killed on their first serious mission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_komandir_skl: If more people like you helped Duty, it would be easier to defend the world from the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_rad_kahovnik: Don't get lost in the Zone.
I won't make it without a medkit...
We've got things to talk about.
With every new raid, you can learn something about the Zone that will save your life later. But while we adapt and look for ways to deal with mutants, anomalies, and emissions—the Zone adapts too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_rad_usik_0_I: I used to think, what's the worst thing that could happen in the Zone? An injury? Getting killed by mutants or anomalies?
Now I get it, the worst thing is when you become its instrument.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_rad_usik_0_R: I feel better. Let's get back to it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_soldat_anton: Take any questions to the captain, loner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_soldat_rybij: I'm just a private. If you need to talk, talk to Bulat, not me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_soldat_utkin: It's all about procedure. Take your questions to our commander.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_DLC01_soldat_zincu: Take your questions to the head, I'm just the hands.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Bulat_AfterInst: I'll make sure the unit is ready, and you get to the Dam, Skif. I'm counting on you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Bulat_Evacuatio: Come in. We made it to the Dam. Pay us a visit, we need to talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Bulat_ThanksCal: You're a shy one, stalker, if you haven't personally collected your reward. But you've been a great help.
