So allow me to express my gratitude and send a reward to your PDA. From the bottom of my fucking heart!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_CallNewb_1_8166: Newbies, get closer to the firing line. Watch the shooter and learn.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_InstructorConfl: Then where are the results, for fuck's sake? You keep going like this, and Freedom won't even have to waste any bullets because you'll be shooting each other, damn it!
On the ground! Push-ups for three minutes, and no slacking!
You fucking failed! Is this a cross-eye parade, or what? Are your hands shaking from all the vodka?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_InstructorQuest: What's up, Skif? Changed your mind? Will you help our boys at the Dam while I get the evac unit ready?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Kahovnik_CallOu: Loner, help! Give me a medkit. I need a bandage.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Kahovnik_IfAppr: Thank you, stalker. I couldn't 've made it out alive on my own.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Kahovnik_OnInte: Don't waste any more time on me, I can manage.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_ShootingComment: All these butterfingers coming into the Zone…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Skif_AnythingBu: Stop this bullshit and shoot, stalker!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Skif_RunsAway_1: Fine, stay in formation, everyone. Wait till the loner's done running around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Sklar_BeforeInv: Go inside, stalker. Maybe you'll manage to save someone's life.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Usik_Moans_1_82: They'll eat me up, eat everyone… I wish I could die… Already…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QC_Usik_OnInteract: Sorry, stalker, I need some time to come around. Thanks for your help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_AfterDezomb_NoH: Sorry, soldier. I can't help you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_AfterDezomb_Pil: Take the psi-block, it should help.
Thanks, stalker. I thought I was losing it. All those mutants around… I couldn't kill them, no matter how much I tried to shoot them.
Those were phantoms. Psi makes you see things that aren't there. Good thing you weren't under the radiation for too long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_AfterDezomb_Vod: Take a sip of this special vodka. It'll help.
Ew! What is this sheep dip?! Feels like someone stuck my head into freezing water.
Sheep dip or not, it still makes psi-effects go away quick.
Thank you. You saved my life – and my sanity.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_CommandersThank: Thanks for agreeing to help, Skif. We'll patch up the survivors now, then evacuate them.
In the meantime, what's the situation? What happened?
The soldiers were under the impact of a psi-device. A gift from good old Monolith from way back, before the dam was flooded. Looks like it became active again when the water receded.
Shkliar is a good commander, but he's out of control. In it till the end, no backing out! The general will hand him his ass for negligence… Once the sergeant comes around, of course.
No, thanks for your help. Here's your reward.
The sergeant couldn't have known about the psi-device in advance. It only fully turned on when his group opened the hermetic door to one of the facilities.
Depressurizing facilities should be done with caution. Whatever, the General will handle it. As for you, all of Duty is grateful. And you earned a reward, of course.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_GoToShooting_1_: The guys from the Iron Forest said you proved yourself quite worthy. Could you show these fucking greenhorns your combat skills?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_GoToShooting_2_: I could. What exactly do you need me to show them?
Get to the firing line. On my command, shoot the targets.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_GoToShooting_3_: Not now. I have other plans.
Don't wait too long, or these all-thumb geniuses will shoot each other – and you'll be left without an audience.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_InstructorQuest: I can't help you right now.
...I repeat, Beetle Squad is taking casualties.
We're at the Dam, taking casualties.
Hey, kids! Pack your stuff, clean your guns, and be ready to roll. We're getting Shkliar out.
Well, Skif. You sure set an example… of how not to shoot.
Well, the boys from the Iron Forest weren't wrong.
You are one hell of a shot!
Skif, I have something to ask you. We need time to get ready, but every second can cost our boys their lives.

Stalkers have been disappearing at the Dam lately. We sent a squad to do a mutant sweep, but it looks like it's something more dangerous than the usual. Head up there, see what's up, and help our boys.
You'll make it there faster than the evacuation unit. Maybe that will give you enough time to save a life.
Then go! We'll be right behind you as soon as we're ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_Kahovnik_Talk_H: I'm here to help. Shkliar told me there might be survivors inside.
So Sarge managed to get out? Thank god.
Listen, stalker. You've done enough for me, I'll manage, but maybe there's still time to help Pryshchepa too?
You'll need some psi-block – for him and for yourself. He's still in the room with the psi-device. I saw one of those once, way back in my stalking days – I stumbled upon a Monolithian stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_Kahovnik_Talk_M: You think there might be a Monolithian stash here?
Might be a stash, might be a base left over from the old times. One thing's clear – those fanatics were here for sure.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_Kahovnik_Talk_P: Thanks, stalker. I thought I wouldn't make it out.
But why the hell are you here? It's dangerous – there's a psi source somewhere nearby.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_Kahovnik_Talk_S: I'll help your mate, if there's still something I can do.

If he didn't get zombified completely, that's still possible. Just… be careful with the device. In my experience, if a person is under psi already, their brains can get boiled if you destroy the source suddenly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_Kahovnik_Talk_Z: If there's psi-radiation here, how come you're not a zombie?
I quickly figured out what we were dealing with. Took a psi-block before things got ugly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_WoundedTells_1_: Stalker, there's psi-radiation inside. Get away from here before your brains get fried.
Bulat sent me to help your group out. The evacuation unit will be here soon.
If the captain sent you, you're one of the good ones. Save those left in the utility rooms. If there are any survivors…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ06_QD_WoundedTells_2_: Stay here and wait for the evacuation. I'll go inside.
How many people were in your squad?
Four of us. One is definitely dead, the others—I don’t know. Not sure.
How could this place possibly have psi?
Don't know. There was no Controller. Can't imagine what else it could be.
The memories alone are scary enough.
We surveyed the grounds, then went inside the building. It was easy at first – rodents, a couple of snorks… Nothing out of the ordinary.
But the deeper in we went, the shittier we felt. There was no radiation, though. We thought, since it's an old building that flooded recently, it must just be the stuffy air.
We stumbled upon a closed hermetic door. Barely managed to open it up – and then psi hit us.

Private Pryshchepa was the first one in. After the psi hit, he screamed, turned around, and started firing right at us. Took Baidzharov right out… Kakhovnyk crawled into the next room. I can't even remember how I got out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_AL_Castro_NeedCall: Python, I found it! The artifact you can only find at the CNPP.
But I lost all my boys. They got zombified… By that fucking anomaly that looks like the Flare. It fries your brains, too. I'm the only one left.
Fuck, that's no good. So you think this artifact is our key to get out of the CNPP?
Yeah. It should protect us from the Flare and those smaller anomalies, and that's how we get out of the CNPP. I'll try to get it, but I won't make it back without some help.
Zombies have blocked all the passages. We need to get Rubin to help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_AL_Sniper_RadioTal: Python, come in. We need help! Can you hear me?
No time to help you. Get out of there on your own.
I would, if I could, damn it! Rubin's out fighting Duty, I'm not sure he'll make it back.
Get me out, Python! I'll pay, damn it!
Like you paid those boys who got zombified? I'm not getting into that shit. It's every man for— You get the idea.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_AL_SquadLeader_Hel: Rubin… our run went South. I need help… quickly!
Damn it, Castro, Duty's attacking! You bolted, and now we gotta save you?
I almost found the thing that will get us out of the CNPP. It's in the anomaly that looks like a fragment of the Flare.
Rubin, please, can you hear me? We... you and I... could make it! Just get me out! I'm blocked on all sides.
*shots fired and screaming in the background*
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QC_Piton_CallKastr: Shit… Castro, come in! It's Python. Answer, damn it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QC_Piton_SkifNotic: Turn around and beat it! I'll count to three.
I told you, I'm not playing your games anymore. Get lost! I don't want anything to do with the CNPP.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_Castro_AnomalyT: Give it back! Give me the artifact, you bastard!
Rubin, what did they do to you?! The artifact! Give it to me. Come on!
Chill out, here's your artifact. But it's hardly useful for the anomaly.
That can't be… It was supposed to save us all. It's the key… The key!
I don't believe you! I'll prove you wrong!
You're not yourself. The artifact can't save you from the Flare. Your men died for nothing!
No, I don't believe you. You're lying! It's not true!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_Castro_DutyPath: Rubin? No, no, no… the face is different… The faces are all melting into one another. It was Rubin, then it wasn't. Then Rubin again!
But that doesn't matter! Only the key matters!
What key are you talking about?
The key from the CNPP! It looks like an artifact, but don't let it trick you. It can protect you from the anomaly!
Get it for me, Rubin! Quick!
Where should I look for this artifact?
In the anomaly! The boys looked for it there, and they disappeared! Where are they now? Where is everyone?!
You killed them, didn't you? You wanted to take their faces! Are you going to take the artifact for yourself, too?
Don't you dare! Bring it back to me! Straight to me, Rubin!
Your orders were no good for the dead men I've seen here. Your Rubin is dead, and you're next.
Dead? Hahaha! What are you talking about?! You're standing right in front of me!
Want me to prove you wrong?
I'm gonna shoot you, right now! And if you die, Rubin, that means you weren't dead before!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_Castro_GiveMeAr: Okay, okay, don't panic, man. I'll help you with the artifact, and then we'll get out of here.
Of course, no problem, Rubin. Just promise me you'll be back…
With the artifact! Or you're dead!
Your people needed you when Duty was killing them! Rubin was one of the ones who died there.
Boys, looks like Rubin spent a bit too much time in the sun, haha!
Your men are dead! The artifact didn't save them, and it won't save you either.
You fucker! No way my boys are dead! You're lying!
Rubin, is that you? You made it! Finally!
Why… why is your face different? The key… The key! We need the key!
Please, Rubin. Find the artifact. It's the key to get out of the CNPP. It will protect us from the anomaly. Quick! I need the key!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_GuardDuty_CallP: Skif, come here. I found something on that Freedom member.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_GuardDuty_Final: So, did you find that Freedom member from the recording?
I did. There was no key to get out of the CNPP. The poor guy got his brains fried, and so did all his friends. And all because of a small anomaly — it’s almost like a Flare fragment. Works the same.
That's on him. Look before you leap.
I did. Thought I could help him get out of there, but the poor guy had lost it completely and attacked me. His whole group had turned into zombies.
That's what I thought, that the message was complete lunacy. But we should be careful around the anomaly and its fragments. Turning into a zombie is no fun.
I'd still collect the artifacts from the anomaly fragments, though, if I had the chance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_GuardDuty_Stran: A key to the CNPP exit, there we go! Would be nice if that Castro guy was really onto something. Then we could finally get some more supplies.
Freedom members are just like weeds – no matter how much you yank them, they just keep sprouting.
There we go, a key to the CNPP exit! Looks like they missed all the X19 fun. Or maybe it's not that simple… Anyway, Freedom at the CNPP means nothing but trouble.
What do you think about the recording?
Just a regular recording. I have other things to take care of.
Suit yourself, Skif. I've no time for this either.
But I might make some time later. Freedom leftovers might bring trouble.
I'll get on it. Find out why Freedom was sniffing around.
And thanks for helping Duty. It would've been really hard if it weren't for you.
Had a minute to check out the coordinates from that PDA yet?
Found a PDA with a recording on it. You should listen to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_GuardFreedom_Ca: Skif, come over here. I've got something interesting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_GuardFreedom_Fi: So, what's up with that man from the recording, asking for help?
Joined the zombie ranks at the CNPP. Spent too much time around an anomaly fragment waiting to be rescued.
Damn! That anomaly piece of shit.
He attacked, we exchanged some shots, and he didn't win. All that for a weak piece of an artifact.
It's a shame, though. Not that many of us left.
He literally went crazy for that artifact, the one you can get from a fragment of that anomaly.
No shit! Turns out you don't need to turn into a zombie to go all cuckoo.
These artifacts, the ones scattered around in the fragments of the anomaly… Pick them up if you can.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ13_QD_GuardFreedom_St: Those jerks! Pissed off to get some shit at the worst possible moment. But if they really found a key to get out of the CNPP, that's so cool! We could get some ammo delivered, or medkits…
If Castro and those guys haven't bolted, we could've saved more lives.

Those jerks! Pissed off to get some shit at the worst possible moment. If they'd just waited a bit, they'd have had their way out of the CNPP. They're sons of guns, but they're our sons of guns. If they got into a mess…
What do you make of the recording?
I've had enough Zone secrets for now. Your guys will do fine without me.
I'm not gonna go deal with this either. Got no time.
Something shitty happened. I need to do some recon.
I guess you're right. We're short on people.
It's great you're helping Freedom out. Thank you, Skif.
Let's not jump to conclusions. Maybe the guys got into some kind of trouble?
But we can't follow everyone around, getting them out of all sorts of jams. We're not a summer camp.
Remember that PDA with the recording? Maybe you should go check out what's on it?
There's a PDA, one of ours, with some kind of recording. Let's go listen to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_AL_Drankovych_Audi: We received a very promising result.
The equipment is operating normally, but the opened passageway turned out to be unstable and collapsed behind us.
We need to conduct additional calculations and determine our location. It seems that this sawmill is not on our maps.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_bolshak_0_In: Faraday can reveal many things to an attentive listener. Though, I am not sure it qualifies as something new. Rather, something old, but curiously tangled.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_dzen_0_InfoT: Yeah, it's a constant sorpresa! Another anomaly pops up outta nowhere, or we suddenly got 'ghosts' right under our noses. Never boring here at the CNPP.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_kapitan_fese: Don't you have other things to do?
No, this is far from over.
You know, quite a few people are trying to leave the Zone. And many of them succeed, by the way. It's just that very few manage to settle down on the Mainland afterwards.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_kapitan_varc: Don't underestimate what's left of Freedom. We wore them down, for sure, but it's still too early to write them off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_soldat_dobry: Rumors are spreading, and getting worse by the minute. New mutants, new unknown anomalies… It'll never be the same. The Zone is changing, and we're changing with it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_soldat_fomin: You know, I try not to stick my nose out of the barracks. I got lots to do there, and the food is pretty decent. And lunch is always on time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_tesak_0_Defe: I didn't think it would turn out this way…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_tesak_0_Hell: What did you want to talk about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_DLC01_tesak_0_Info: I've seen a lot on the other side of the portals. But I'll keep those memories to myself. Believe me, it's better for everyone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_LI_Varchuk_HubRadi: All personnel, a state of heightened readiness has been introduced in the CNPP area. Report any suspicious activity directly to your commanders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_LI_Zen_HubRadio_St: Hola, Freedom! If you notice anything weird around the CNPP, don't hesitate to tell me right away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_AbzacGamer_Radi: Two at the entrance, the others with me.
What the fuck? Deal with him!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_AbzacJack_Overp: So, you can't just get into ABK-2. Everything is boarded up…
Get to us through the overpass wreck, then. You can get to the second floor of ABK through there no problem.
No way, he won't get away from me twice! We're sticking to the plan. I'll manage.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_BolshakRadio_De: Skif, this is Chief… The Ward… They took the box and killed Hatchet.
They walked out of the bunker, and Fesenko just shot him in the back of the head.
This wasn't part of my plan.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Bolshak_FinalAd: I want to be alone. Thank you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_FesenkoBolshak_: Why are you here? You should go somewhere more interesting.
Don't freak out, Chief. We'll wait for the mercenary, and then leave.
You can wait for him somewhere outside the bunker, in the open.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Fesenko_BunkerA: Thank you for your service, stalker. We'll handle it from here.
Leave, loner. Your work here is done.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_FominDobriakov_: So how long do we have to hang out here? When are we moving towards the base?
Not until we deal with the mercenary, it looks like.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_HatchetFesenko_: Here's the package. Everything as we agreed. Now it's your turn.
Patience, mercenary. I need to contact command. This may take some time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Hatchet_AfterCo: The black box… What color is it usually? Do you remember?
Look for the box, Skif. Don't slack.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Hatchet_FinalPo: Let's go. We've got nothing more to do here.
Let's stick to what we agreed, Skif. Give the box to Fesenko.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Hatchet_HurrySk: The portal is open, Skif. Off you go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_RiabojVarchuk_O: Reporting in: the main entrance was blocked, and we entered through the overpass. I repeat, we entered through the overpass.
Copy. Be careful. If he doesn't drop his weapon, don't hesitate to open fire.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Ryaboj_Radiopla: We've got a KIA. Tripwire. Leaving two on the door.
Enemy to the rear, sending backup.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Varchuk_CallSki: Skif, I was informed about a fierce gunfight at the coordinates we got earlier. Do you need support?
No, everything's fine. You were right – ghosts don't exist. It turned out to be the last surviving mercenary from Nord's group. He offered me a job in exchange for their group's stash.
Less than I hoped, but better than I expected. His gear will definitely come in handy.
Keep me posted. Over and out.
Skif, come in. If you have a minute, come over. I have something to discuss.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Varchuk_MeetTop: Glad to see you back on duty, Skif. We've lost too many good people.
I hope you have some time for a job I had in mind?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Varchuk_Radiopl: All survivors who can hear me, come in! Fall back to the evacuation point. Do you copy?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Zen_CallSkifAft: Hola, Skif! How's our Ghost of the CNPP doing? I heard it got pretty loud there.
Our guy is the last surviving mercenary from Nord's group. He offered me a job in exchange for their stash.
Not a Monolithian, at least. You can talk to mercenaries and even do business with them. But be careful.
Okay, amigo. Keep me in the loop. Adios.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Zen_CallSkiff_S: Skif, amigo, how are you? Come on over – I have something I wanna talk about.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QC_Zen_MeetTopic_M: Hola, Skif. Just in time! Hope you're ready to get rolling? Got something for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_BolshakFesenko_: And what's in this box that's so important?
Knowledge. Is it important? Depends on how you look at it. Or listen to it. But that is none of my business. And, for that matter, none of yours.
In truth, it is quite simple. Hatchet has the key. And I know how to find the doors.
How do you know where to look for the box?
Faraday speaks, I listen. I don't ask too many questions. I don't demand. I listen. Carefully.
It's like a kaleidoscope with stories locked inside. The words are the same, but the plot is new every time. The key is knowing how to wait and being a good listener.
What do you know about this mercenary?
Hatchet is a mercenary with a compelling story. I am very curious to know how it ends.
It is not surprising your paths crossed. You. Him. Special cases.
The mercenary warned me you'd come by. I just finished calculating the coordinates.
Mercenary, you say? Now that's interesting!
Pay no attention, stalker. I am listening to you.
I'm sending you the coordinates of the spatial passageway. Hatchet knows what to do with them.
The passage can be disorienting at first. Sometimes it throws you a bit further. That is all. Now it’s time for all of you to go.
Sorry, but you'll have to put up with us a little longer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_BolshakFinal_Ha: Change of plans. I'll deliver the box to the Ward myself.
I hope this isn't the end of Hatchet's story. It was way too epic.
Talk to the Ward. I have no more interest in this.
I am sorry to hear that. I really didn’t see this ending for him.
Talk to the Ward. I have no more interest in this story.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_BolshakFinal_Wh: Have you found the black box? Good.
The mercenary must deliver the box to the Ward. I arranged the deal. Tit for tat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_BolshakRadio_Ha: Skif, this is Chief. I got news from our mutual friend.
That is right. He is safe. One foot on the Mainland already. He started his story with a clean slate.
One more thing – he says 'thank you'.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Bolshak_Hatchet: It seems the deal is done.
I hope everyone gets what they wanted.
And everyone goes their separate ways.
I'm sorry about what happened to the mercenary.
Me too. I thought his story would end differently, but the Zone always has the final say.
He completed his part of the deal. The Ward did not. An unfair ending. But, it is what it is.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_FesenkoBolshak_: You agreed to a deal with a mercenary so easily?
Hatchet isn't the first mercenary who wants a ticket to the Mainland. However, I must admit, he is the most die hard.
In such cases, the Ward has special orders.
So, the deal will go through. Tell this Hatchet not to worry.
Besides, the end justifies the means.
And in our case, we'll also be tying up some loose ends…
This box is so important that you're willing to release one of the mercenaries you're hunting from the Zone?
Well, I see no reason not to mention that the box contains the results of research on spatial anomalies. And this is extremely important information for the Ward.
The way it gets delivered to us, so to speak, doesn't matter.
As for Hatchet, you're right – we have a clear order regarding this, and it takes priority over any deal. No mercenary will leave the Zone.
Be nice to Chief.
We're long-time friends, stalker. We know each other well. There's no problem here.
Quiet. I can’t hear the important things.
What else do you want?
Time for all of you to go.
Hurry up. Can't you see our friend is getting nervous?
So, you're saying you're the stalker the mercenary sent? He's got some interesting partners.
Well, then. You two will have a better chance. And we'll stay here. Let's say, to… maintain order and the interests of all parties.
You should leave.
Don't fuss, okay? Listen to your Faraday. No one's bothering you.
Why don't you send your own people for that box?
It's not that simple. To get to its location, some 'special talents' are needed. Hatchet just happens to have the right ones.
Although, you are right, the mercenary isn't the center of the universe. We're only interested in the box, and it doesn't matter who delivers it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Fesenko_Final_A: The job is done. There's nothing else for us to do here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Fesenko_Final_B: Great job. Plus, you dealt with the mercenary right away without any fuss. Korshunov sure knows who to trust with the token.
Thank you for your cooperation. Here's your well-deserved reward.
Thank you, you were a great help to us. What about the box?
The mercenary wasn't that lucky. He is dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Fesenko_Final_N: Nice and clean – didn't even have to deal with the mercenary.
All right, loner. Here's your reward.
So what? Do you want extra pay now? First, the box. I don't really care what happened to the mercenary.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Fesenko_Final_S: So, loner, did you find the box?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Hatchet_AfterBo: Good thing I didn't go there myself and decided to send you instead. It's still too early for me to meet with the Ward. Without the gift, they might not be so cooperative.
Were you able to get the coordinates?
Chief did a great job, as always. I'm heading out. See you at the spot, stalker. Over and out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Hatchet_BeforeP: We're on site. The entrance to the target is here. Have you ever dealt with spatial anomalies?
Then you probably don't have too many questions. I have the 'key' that allows access to already opened portals directly through the PDA.
This one is stable. It looks like the work of scientists. You first, I'll be right behind you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Hatchet_BunkerF: Thanks for your help, Skif. I'll take it from here.
And to you, Skif. Something tells me you're going to need it.
I sent the coordinates to our stash to your employer. You'll sort out who'll take what from there.
Goodbye, stalker. I hope you find what you're looking for.
It's funny how everything turned out. In all my years in the Zone, I only met two people I could trust.
The first was Nord. The second turned out to be his killer.
We were supposed to be on opposite sides of the barricades, Skif. And yet, out of all the stalkers in the Zone, it was you who helped me.
If I were younger, I'd start believing in the miracles of the Zone. But I've seen too much. So I'll just say, "thank you". I won't forget this.
With your abilities, you could become a legend of the Zone.
After my squad died in the Zone, nothing's holding me back anymore, Skif.
As for fame, it's more harmful than helpful in our line of work.
I always preferred to be a ghost than a legend.
What will you do on the Mainland?
Start my life with a clean slate.
I'm not sure that a peaceful life would suit me, but I'd like to try.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Hatchet_FinalCa: Skif, come in. Where are you?
Doesn't seem far from Chief's bunker.
Error. Looks like they got scattered this time. I'm at the bunker. The Ward is here too. Come on over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Hatchet_FinalCo: What about your 'abilities'? What will happen to them?
They'll disappear along with me. They're one of the technologies developed in the Zone. I gained access to it as payment for a service.
Some time ago, a client offered to let me test experimental equipment. A prototype of spatial transportation technology.
At the end of the contract, he offered me to keep the prototype as payment for further cooperation. But he made me promise that the technology wouldn't fall into the wrong hands.
Isn't it stupid to take someone's word for it in the Zone?
You're right, but in our line of work, we gotta rely on the terms of the contract. Even if they're expressed in a simple verbal form.
Some mercenaries think it's nonsense, but not me. And the client knew it.
Are you sure about this deal?
No, but I don't see any other options. The Ward is just the tip of the iceberg.
I need a 4-F. Without those discharge papers, there'll be no hiding from them – even on the Mainland.
I found it, but there's a catch…
Oh, I thought we had an agreement.
I think this box is worth a lot more than your freedom.
Let's check it out, then.
Deal, but I'd like to know what information is in it first.
I don't think it's safe, especially not knowing all the features and specifics of the equipment.
There's always a chance of damaging the data, and then it'll be worth nothing. It's safer to simply deliver the box to the customer.
Quite the place the Controller's got here. His own manor. Servants.
Good job, Skif. Your help really came at just the right time.
By the way, did you manage to find the black box?
Here, take it.
Great. The job's done.
I doubt he meant it, but in the end, Nord gave me a gift. He didn't drag me into the X16 bloodbath with him, and sent for a spare ticket to the Mainland.
And I accepted this gift. It's time I was done with it – both the Zone and all this work.
Just don't say you won't miss all of this later.
Maybe… I don't think I'll have the time, though.
There is no "4-F." Once you hand over the box, the Ward will do to you what they've done to any other Zone mercenary.
Where does all this confidence come from?
Fesenko confirmed that no deal is above the cleanup order.
Well… since my employer doesn't plan to fulfill the terms of our deal, I'm also free from any obligations to them.
Tell them I'm dead, Skif. I died in an anomaly. Since they trust you enough to share their plans, they'll believe it, and you'll be compensated.
What are you going to do next?
Disappear. Ghosts do that sometimes, right? I'll get to the Mainland, and then… I'll start my life with a clean slate.
I sent the coordinates to our stash to your employer. I'm sure you'll sort out who'll take what from there.
Good luck, Skif. I hope you find what you're looking for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Hatchet_FirstMe: As a reward, I want to learn about your abilities.
The source of my abilities will disappear the moment we finish the job. Along with me, I hope.
So you and your allies can rest assured that this power will not fall into the wrong hands.
That's not your concern.
Wrong answer.
Last chance – who sent you?
I repeat: that's not your concern.
Well, I'm not one to repeat myself.
I am not your enemy.
Maybe. We'll find out soon.
No one. I'm a loner.
You may be a loner, but I don't believe in coincidences. Too many people are interested in me right now.
Who sent you?
Someone who can help you. By blowing me up, you won't remove the target from your back.
But if we come to an agreement, we can make the manhunt stop.
I have no idea.
I thought we found common ground. Shame.
And you'll just forgive me for murdering your comrades?
You met, you fought, and you turned out to be stronger. Or smarter. Or luckier. There's nothing to forgive here.
And what is this job?
I want to get out. Return to the Mainland. The Ward promised me evacuation in exchange for a very well-hidden container.

I've already found out where it is, but the entrance is… tricky. Chief has the coordinates, except he'll only transfer them to a physical device. That's just the way the Iron Forest is. And Chief, too.
While I'd pick them up myself, I have some concerns. So you'll have to go meet him. I'll give him a heads-up about your visit. And… thank you for your honesty.
Here's what we'll do. I'll ask you a few questions. If you answer honestly, you'll live. If you try to weasel your way out, I'll blow you up. I'm allergic to lies.
Let's begin. Who sent you?
Alright, consider me interested. You need to know I was part of Nord's group. I guess that name should ring a bell.
Well, you were honest with me, so it's time to return the favor – I was part of Nord's group. I guess that name should ring a bell.
We went through a lot together until we parted ways. And you're the very stalker who stepped on his heels.
And finally, the most important question: how did Nord die?
I'm Skif.
Pleasure to meet you.
Nice and easy now, stalker. The room is rigged with explosives, and I can set off the detonator any second.
Name yourself.
Duty sent me. Your abilities are giving them cause for concern.
Sounds like the truth. That explains why you got into a firefight. Tell them not to worry. I don't plan to get involved in other people's wars.
Freedom sent me. They wanted to learn more about you and offer to join forces.
Sounds like the truth. That explains why you got into a firefight. But they're wasting their time. I'm not interested in factions or their problems.
We fought. I turned out to be better.
I told him that revenge is a dish that shouldn't be served at all. But he was too inspired by the opportunities in front of him.
I refused to participate in that scheme with the mutants and the anomaly. While you didn't just get involved, you killed Nord in the very heart of his base. That's worthy of respect.
So, I propose a solution to our problems. You help me with this one thing, and I disappear forever without a fuss. I'll also give you the coordinates to the mercenaries' stash.
You go first.
Ballsy or brave? I guess we'll find out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Hatchet_Sawmill: Welcome, Skif. Be quiet. We're not the only ones here.
The building ahead is a warehouse or a cabin. Something tells me that our target is inside. Zombies and mutants seem to be guarding it.
Move forward, keep your eyes open, and cover each other. Otherwise, we'll end up wandering here with the zombos for eternity.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Varchuk_QuestFi: I confirm that our forces have not recorded any incidents involving him recently.
Here's your honest reward, you earned it.
I finished with the mercenary. He won't bother you anymore.
The job is done, Skif. The mercenary kept his word, they already found the stash. It turned out to be… impressive.
Here's your honest reward. And a little extra – for saving us the trouble. You earned it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Varchuk_QuestSt: Not a clue. He wasn't aggressive, and didn't make contact. It seems he's not interested in us – at least for now.
There were quite a few Monolith bases around the CNPP. Maybe, after the Signal at SIRCAA, something snapped in his head and he returned home. Or maybe he's looking for something.
Any idea what this 'ghost' wants?
At first, I thought so, too. But there's an increasing number of similar cases, and it's dangerous to ignore this kind of activity and technology. Who knows what its owner has in mind?
For us, every person counts. And unknown technology, especially Monolithian, should at least be studied, or better yet – eliminated.
Is hunting this 'ghost' worth the resources? Maybe someone just made it all up?
Are you still recovering after the Monorail events? I understand. When you're ready, look for me on site.
Sorry, but I have other things to do.
So far, no one has been able to make contact with him, so your help will be much appreciated. Let's hope what's left of Freedom doesn't get ahead of us.
You were talking about 'the Ghost of the CNPP'. Still need help with that?
Something strange is happening around the camp.
Our patrol was combing the area and heard shots. Some loner took out an entire den of mutants – with a Gauss gun. We tried to make contact, but he vanished before our eyes.
There have been several similar cases. People are already talking about 'the Ghost of the CNPP'. I suspect this might be Monolith's handiwork. If so, it threatens everyone here.
I do. This ‘ghost' continues to appear out of nowhere, possibly with the help of a Monolith device. Find him and sort out the situation.
So, what's this job you have for me?
I don't believe in ghosts, Skif. He either has a rare artifact or some kind of device. Perhaps, as I said, a Monolithian one.
What's worse, it seems that Freedom has taken an interest in this 'ghost'. We just spotted their squad near ABK-2. That's where his activity was last recorded.
This is too much of a coincidence. Plus, Freedom wouldn't risk what's left of their force on enemy territory for no reason.
Go there and figure out what's going on. I'll contact you with further instructions.
How can I help you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Zen_QuestFinish: Yes, amigo, our sources confirm they're no longer tracking any activity of the ghost.
Here's your hard-earned dineros, and thanks for getting into this whole story and sorting it all out.
I finished the job with the mercenary. He won't bother you anymore.
Skif, amigo! Now that's what I call a good approach. Your client didn't hold back and dropped a whole pile of treasure on us.
So take your well-deserved reward and your piece of the pie, all fair and square. Thanks for untangling this whole story.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ14_QD_Zen_QuestStart_: Hell knows. This guy doesn't attack, and tries to stay out of our sight. It's so mysterious, it's annoying, to say the least. But he does have some promising potential.
There used to be Monolithian bases around the CNPP. Maybe something snapped in his head and he returned home? Or maybe it's something else entirely.
Any idea what this 'ghost' wants?
That was my first thought: why bother if he doesn't cause any trouble and takes out a mutant or two every now and then?
And then I realized that a great opportunity just landed in our laps. This is now our territory, so why not meet him? Who knows, maybe he'll be a full-fledged ally later on.
Are the rumors worth stressing over? Maybe someone just made it all up.
Well, Freedom pays generously for help. If you change your mind, I'll be around.
Sorry, but I have other things to do.
Aha. This 'ghost' keeps showing up out of nowhere, possibly with the help of some Monolithian gadget.
You were talking about the 'Ghost of the CNPP'. Does the offer still stand?
This place keeps bringing us more and more surprises.
My guys went on a run and came across the strangest thing. Some loner took out a mutant den with a Gauss gun. We wanted to talk, but the bastard seemed to vanish into thin air.

There were other cases as well. Rumor has it, it's this 'Ghost of the CNPP'. Hopefully, this won't turn out to be another echo of the Monolith. If it does, everyone here will have a hard time. And we're not even done with Duty yet…
While we're here chatting, a Duty squad is moving to ABK-2, where this 'ghost' was last seen.
So, what's this job you have for me?
It's simple, amigo. A ghost might sound cool – until one shows up at your house. So go find him.
Find out the nature of his abilities, and how cooperative he is. And make sure you do it faster than whatever's left of Duty.
What do you want me to do?
We came across some information that Duty sent their squad to the ABK-2 complex, where this 'ghost' was last seen. Seems a bit too risky for them.
It's not a coincidence, I'm sure. Don't hesitate to start searching from there. Comprende?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Basement_1_8416: My head covered in blood. I barely managed to feel around for bandages. Did someone abandon me? Rob me? I don't know. My memory's gone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Basement_1_8469: Who am I? Why don't I remember anything? And what is… this place?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_LostStalkers1_1: Compass, tell me I was wrong! We sure did collect some loot – and what loot it is! They were right that the CNPP is generous to the brave.
Don't jinx it. We still need to carry it back. And this new guy… he's sus. He somehow managed to join us at a very lucky moment.
Don't be like that, the man's wounded. Let's help him. Do some good. Then we'll go bask in our glory – we deserve it.
You're always like this. All right, let's do it, just don't run your mouth too much. I don't feel like sharing the well-deserved fruits of my labor with the new guy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_LostStalkers2_1: Guys, don't come here! It's… it's…
He killed them all… at night. He stabbed me… He… He's coming…
Crane, come in! Come in... Dammit, I knew it. This damned CNPP.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Vydra1_1_84698: The dreams came once again today. I've been chasing after someone for a while. Gunshot… and the person ahead of me collapses.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Vydra1_1_84699: Did I do that? Or not? If I did it, then what for? I'll have to go see the anomaly again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Vydra2_1_84700: I've been to the anomaly. My head's buzzing now, but a memory's come to the surface.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Vydra2_1_84701: I remember the smell best. Or more specifically, the stench of blood. It's everywhere. Now this memory is going to haunt me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Vydra2_1_84702: But despite that, I must try to remember everything. I'll just take a short break.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Vydra3_1_84703: I wish I knew who shot me that night. And what I did to deserve it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_AL_Vydra3_1_84704: I must remember! I must enter the anomaly. I must! I'm so close to remembering!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_goliaf_0_Inf: I wish I could ride the Monorail once again! Just without the Mercury and the thugs on my tail.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_goliaf_0_Res: Ah, right. I think we're not done talking.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_lejtenant_sk: Aah! I think my armor's pierced…
Are you here to report or just to wag your tongue?
I've made a bet with my comrade about whether Freedom will fall apart without Myklukha or not. I bet that it would!
Should we finish talking now or later?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_saska_caga_0: Oh, I can't right now, man.
That's it, talk to you later.
Ah, how fortunate! I have some time to chat scheduled right about now.
I hope they're gonna organize a bar here in the camp as good as the one at Rostok! And hang up those lamps, too!
Here's what I'm gonna tell you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_serzant_kame: I'm not in the mood to talk.
All right, I've got some time for you.
I realize this is neither the time nor the place, but if Zulu's now the head of Duty, we need to do it all officially, 'cause there's enough mess around us as it is.
Let's finish talking, and then we can go our own way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_vydra_0_Busy: I have better things to do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_vydra_0_ByeT: It's nice to talk to a man sometimes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_vydra_0_Defe: I'll just… lie here a bit, and then get up…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_DLC01_vydra_0_Info: Maybe amnesia is my best loot. The Zone gave me a chance to become someone better. But how can you know you've become better if you don't remember who you were?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QC_FreedomUnknownC: Hey, Skif! I've got a job for you…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QC_VydraInteractTo: I hope I was a doctor… Treating people, doing good. That's not a scary thing to remember.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_ArtifactsFound_: Hey, loner! Have you found all the artifacts already?
If you have, get a technician to equip them to your suit and go get the main prize.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_DutyInfo_1_8469: Lieutenant, the patrol crew are reporting a loner near the chimera's den.
The subject has no insignia. Definitely not one of ours and not from Freedom. Looks like a lone stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_DutyInfo_1_8570: Negative. They know Skif. It's someone else.
Copy that. Continue observation. Do not open fire, and detain the subject for interrogation if you can.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_DutyUnknownTask: Skif, the Lieutenant and I were just talking about you. Anyway, here's the situation…
A patrol spotted a strange character near the chimera's den by the car wash.
I'm asking you because he's one of yours… a loner. No idea what he's doing there. All alone, no cover, too close to a beast.
Will you check what he's up to? I don't like mysteries near our perimeter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_FreedomInfo_1_8: Have you heard, man? They say some guy made camp near the chimera's den. What a nutcase.
No way. The Flare's firing, and there's a chimera prowling around. Who's gonna survive there?
Ha, who said he's surviving? Maybe he's been zombified and just hangs out there, and that's why the chimera isn't touching him.
Why not? It makes sense. Just don't go there yourself. What if the chimera bites your head off before you're zombified? You'll be the ugliest zombie in the neighborhood.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_FreedomUnknownT: Bro, listen. Our men noticed some dude near the chimera's den by the car wash. Just hanging out alone, no clue what he's doing.
Go have a look at what that psycho is cooking up. I'm itching to know, but going there myself is too much of a hassle.
What if he found something worthwhile and we're not in on the cut?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_LightHouseAnoma: Hey, loner! Is that you on the roof?
I hope it's you, because if not, we have a problem.
Don't fret, it's me. I've got the artifact.
Phew! You scared me. I thought it was someone else. But it's you! So you've really done it! You reached the center and came back.
Listen, leave it in the stash at the camp, okay? I need some alone time with it. Who knows what I'm gonna remember…
In return, you can take anything you find in the stash – and that's just the beginning! As soon as I remember where the Treasure is, we're gonna be rich.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_1_: Shit, do I know you? Am I supposed to know you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_Ar: I'm not gonna warn you again. Put the gun down, now!
I didn't want to shoot, loner. You made me do it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_Ch: That's what I'm talking about. Peace is good.
All right. Let's just figure it out in peace.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_Dr: Enough talking. Put the gun down.
Easy, tiger! You're not in a position to demand anything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_Le: Now that's a good decision! Talking is always better than fighting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_Si: Hey, why are you so silent? I'm talking to you like a human being…
Or have we met before? I… Damn, I really don't remember.
I'm having trouble with my head. My memory's gone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_Up: All right. Climb up, and let's talk like people. I haven't talked to anyone properly in a while… Cherry doesn't count.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_MeetingScene_Wh: What's going on? You've broken into my hideout! That's what's going on!
Although… I'm not even entirely sure myself. Are you sure we haven't met before?
I'm having trouble with my memory. I could've forgotten.
I should be the one asking you! How did you even get here?
Although… Come to think of it, I don't even remember if I've told anyone about this place.
My head's not… My memory's shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_ProblemPresenta: So, stalker. Welcome to my den. One of my dens, at least.
Sorry for the kind of welcome you got down there. With my memory, I need to check everything… So, tell me, how did you find me?
What do I get from you remembering everything?
Half of the Treasure. Whatever it is, we'll split it in half.
You get me the artifact, and I'll recover my memory with it. I'll remember the way to the Treasure.
I've already got all the artifacts.
All of them?! Wait, but how? Have I already told you about them?
Damn my memory… All right, never mind. Now it's just a matter of getting the nearest technician to equip all five of them to your suit. Only then can you go for the anomaly.
Maybe this is your chance to start from scratch?
Maybe. Few people get that chance. I've seen so many corpses here… I read their PDAs. Thought I might have known some of them, or that they might have known me.
In one of the stories, these stalkers helped a guy, but he killed them all at night. What if that asshole also shot me?
If I don't find out, I won't understand. And not knowing… that's the worst thing.
Did you call the chimera Cherry?
What about it? Her heads are just like two cherries on a stem.
By the way, about cherries: they're a kind of a berry, right? They don't grow in the Zone. Especially not here.
But I remember their taste. It was sweet, yum… red… Memory is a weird thing. I remember the berry, but I can't remember who I am.
Why are you asking me and not just going to get it yourself?
With my head? I've tried. A few times. I even almost reached the center once.
I barely got out of there alive! What good are memories if you're a fucking zombie?
I have, but I steered clear of her.
Good. So she's still there, keeping watch.
I'm telling you, Cherry is the perfect guard. As long as you don't cross her path, of course.
I've learned her schedule – when she sleeps, when she eats, when she hunts. So she's the one who's domesticated me, not the other way around.
Got it.
Thank you, stalker. I was just about to say I'd never forget it, but in my situation, you know, I can't promise anything.
How are you going to remember?
You've seen our landmark here, haven't you? A pillar of light above the reactor?
That thing zombifies people, right? But wouldn't you know it, that's the only place where my memory comes back.
But I'm not heading back in there again without protection. Even with protection, I doubt I could handle it. But you… could you help?
Sounds tempting, but I don't have time for this right now. Can I take some time to think?
Of course. I'm right here, and not going anywhere.
Nobody's living there anymore. I had to kill the chimera.
Ah. I see.
Too bad. She had a schedule. Reliable. I learned it by heart. Felt like I knew her better than myself.
Well… I'll have to look for another den, then. It's not safe now without Cherry.
What happened to your memory?
Gunshot to the head. The bullet entered in the back and exited out the front. Or the other way around. I only know from the scars.
I came to and saw this light around me. So bright it was like the sun shining right into my eyes. And an explosion. A huge one. That was when this anomaly over the reactor unit appeared…
I only know that my name is Otter. I have it written here. I probably wrote it myself. Or maybe someone else did, and I've stolen someone else's name.
I found your drawing on the wall. It led me here.
Drawing? Ah, the cave paintings…
That's a map I drew myself! So I don't forget the way.
So my system is working. That's good. If you figured it out, I'll be able to as well, if I need it again.
Where are we? What is this place?
One of my hideouts. It's… someone's old place, almost lived in. But its master hasn't been here for a while. Everything was full of traps, the floor covered with blood…
But there's something… familiar about it. I come back here sometimes, thinking I might remember something. No luck so far, though.
By the way, there's someone living in that hideout with the drawing. Cherry. Have you met her?
What kind of protection do you mean?
When the main anomaly blew up, smaller shards split from it. They hit the ground like meteorites, and created… artifacts.
They're the only things that protect you from psi. The more you collect, the higher your chances of reaching the center.
The main artifact is right there. Although I've seen a few of them through my lenses, I think only one is real – the rest are illusions. When I get it, I'll remember everything!
Ah, you're back! The idea of the Treasure got deep in your brain like a rusty nail, huh? Now you understand me a little better.
The artifact is still there, right in the center of the anomaly. And I still need help getting it out.
Why are you staying here, then? It's not the best place to live.
I have this feeling… Like I've forgotten something important. Not just my name or where I'm from, but something truly… valuable.
I can remember a word, "Treasure". I remember that it's here, at the CNPP, and that I knew how to reach it.
And… thank you for finding the time to hear me out.
Treasure? Are you serious?
Dead serious! Would I be hanging out here if it wasn't worth it? I can't leave without it.
Maybe it's something that will change the Zone, or just a pile of artifacts. In any case, we're either getting rich or famous. Maybe both!
So, what's your plan?
Good question! I don't know yet… I have a couple of ideas, but I need to check them.
Verify the coordinates, re-read my notes, you know. There must be something important in there…
What should I do in the meantime?
Survive until I come up with a plan and contact you.
For now, here's a deposit for you. So you know that Otter is a serious man.
And… thank you for finding the time to hear me out.
I'm in. I'll try to help.
Seriously? Great! I was hoping you'd say that.
Here's the map! And here are the artifacts! One, two, three, four!
And this is the deposit. I already had one of them. Here, so you know that I'm serious. I'll contact you when you collect the rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_VydraArtifactTa: Hi! Any idea what happened over there at the CNPP?
The secret lab at the lowest levels of the CNPP… is no longer secret.
Well, I'll be damned… So that's one secret down! I hope mine's next in line.
At least I did all I could on my part. It's your turn now… if you haven't changed your mind.
I've checked everything and I know where to look for the right anomalies. The artifacts in them will give you protection, which is essential for reaching the main artifact alive.
I've already got all the artifacts.
All of them!? Wait, but how? Have I already told you about them?
Damn my memory ... All right, never mind. Now it's just a matter of getting the nearest technician to equip all five of them to your suit. Only then should you go into the anomaly.
Thank you, stalker. I was just about to say I'd never forget it, but in my situation, you know, I can't promise anything.
I'm in. I'll try to help.
Seriously? Great! I was hoping you'd say that.
Here's the map! And here are the artifacts! One, two, three, and four!
And this is an advance. I already had one of them. Here, so you know that I'm serious. I'll contact you when you collect the rest.
Are you sure the artifacts are going to work? I'm the one risking my life over there.
I have… proof, let's say. One of the five artifacts is here with me.
So it's not just theory, but also practice. You only need to collect the remaining four.
Oh, and the Treasure from the deal is still on the table. Half of it is yours, as we agreed. The risk will be worth it, I promise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_VydraAttack_1_8: Ah, Skif, there you are! How do you like my 'treasure'? Impressive, right?
You know… It's a weird feeling. Remembering who I actually am.
I'm scum, that's who. These corpses? They're all mine. Each and every one of them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_VydraCallAfterA: Hey, Skif! The plan worked, my memory's back. I know where the Treasure is.
Time to share it. You got the coordinates. I'll be waiting there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_VydraCall_1_846: By the way, you've got some good equipment there, stalker…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_VydraDefeat_1_8: Poor bastards. Funny how I kept using them even when I was out of my mind. Cherry... Heh! Old habits die hard.
Well, guess I'll have to kill you myself then. I've got the key, so you're not getting past me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_VydraFinalTalk_: Hi there, Skif. Gonna say some last words, or should we just get to business?
I'd make an exception for you, really. You did honestly try to help me. But your loot is just too good.
I'll make sure you definitely die this time.
I found the PDAs of your victims.
Yeah, I've read about myself, too. Many times. Didn't even recognize myself.
I remember thinking, "What a bastard." But it was me.
You're the second one to figure it out. The first one… is down here. He managed to shoot me in the back of the head as he was dying. I doubt you'll get luckier than that.
Why did you do it? What did you kill them for?
Money, Skif. Just money. I didn't come here to become a legend. I came to make dough.
I was here even before the center of the Zone turned into a free-for-all. Few people can say that, you know.
But I realized I'd die a lot faster than I'd get rich. I wasn't okay with that.
Who are all the people you've killed?
Stalkers. Ones returning from the center with good loot.
I met them on their way back. Pretended to be helpless, wounded, abandoned. And they helped me.
I was waiting for the right moment. Waiting for them to relax. Turn their backs. Fall asleep.
That trick won't work against me.
It already has. You're standing in a mutant den with a gun pointed at you, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_DLC01_SQ15_QD_VydraInvitation: Skif? This is Otter. Remember me?
The important thing is that you remember.
I do, I do! All right, let's get to business. I've checked everything. It's all sorted, and the plan is ready to launch!
See you in the same place as last time. It's going to work, I'm telling you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Comment_SkifNearPolt: Time to plant the Scanner and get out of here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_2_German_afte: I knew it! I told you to get out of there! Hurry back, or I’ll leave without you.
Calm down. I’ve still got some time left. Heading for the next spot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_FirstHelliFly: Perimeter breached! Extensive damage caused by… fuck knows what!
Copy that. Dispatching a response team.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_German_after_: I’m okay. Is charging always this… noisy?
No, but that rock of yours is pretty unusual. Check the Scanner, quick! Is it charged?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_HermanInsideB: Well, what is it? Any updates?
Nehoda’s dead. So are the other scientists.
Dead? Oh god... We're screwed! Get out of there immediately!
Stop freaking out and tell me where the data is stored.
Find his laptop. The coordinates should be in there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_HermanNearBun: Have you reached the bunker? Find Dr. Nehoda. He’s agreed to give you the coordinates.
I don’t think it’ll be that easy, but I’ll figure it out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_Herman_ArtOrD: Do you have the coordinates? I hope you do. Things are about to get a little more complicated from here…
Good thing it’s been a walk in the park until now…
You’ll need to acquire an artifact to shield yourself from the Scanner’s radiation. If you don’t, you might end up joining Nehoda.
First, find the detector. This is a Mobile lab. The scientists ought to have at least one.
Then head over to an anomaly – there ought to be plenty of those around. Use the detector’s signal to navigate it. That’s how the stalkers do it, so I’m sure you can figure it out.
After that, attach the artifact to your belt and go plant the Scanner. Just try not to get killed in the anomaly. That would be rather embarrassing, wouldn’t it?
Really? Impressive. Are you sure this is your first time in the Zone? Not that it’s any of my business. Attach the artifact to your belt and go plant the Scanner.
Find an anomaly – after the Emission, it shouldn’t be that difficult. Then use the detector’s signal to navigate it. If the stalkers have figured it out, I’m sure you can too.
After that, attach the artifact to your belt and go plant the Scanner. Just try not to get killed in the anomaly. That would be rather embarrassing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_Pripoy_in_Bun: Hey, Nehoda. What’s up? Have you met Hermann’s client yet? Tell him a new Emission means new coordinates. And new coordinates means a new bill, heh-heh.
Hold on a sec, Mr. Client. Did Hermann at least tell you what to do with the coordinates?
Whoa, that’s a hell of a mess you got there, boys! Well, screw that smart-ass bastard. I never liked him anyway.
Holy fucking cow, will you let me eat in peace for once?!
All right. Follow the coordinates and stick your Scanner into the ground, then back off. When it's all done, you pick it up. Got it?
If not, that’s your problem. I’m not a damn help desk. So long, Mr. Client.
I’ll figure it out, one way or another.
Sounds good to me. Well, the tea pot’s boiling… over and out, Mr. Client.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_ScamPoints_po: Hermann, Solder's premium coordinates smell like a scam.
His coordinates have always worked like a charm, but the Emission could have thrown a wrench in the works.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_SecondHelliFl: Where’s your team? I’m on my second lap here, and I’m going blind!
They’re en route, but we’ve lost contact. Falcon-3, investigate the scientists’ bunker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_ThirdHelliFly: Falcon-3, we’ve got a breach at the Duga. The bunker’s off. Another ground team is on the way.
South, I still don’t have any maps!
Stick to the Perimeter. Avoid going in. I’ll contact the Sphere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_Varyags_near_: Varyag-1 to Checkpoint South. The bunker’s locked, and the scientist isn’t responding.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E01_MQ01_Dialog_after_2_point: Skif? Are you there? The place is swarming with soldiers! They’re gonna shut everything down, and then you’ll never get out of the Zone!
Did you hear me?! Drop the damn Scanner and come back right now!
I’ve got nowhere to go back to, Hermann. Over and out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_GamescomEmission_LeaderSt:
Listen up! We've got an Emission going!
Shelter in place, Stalkers!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_GamescomEmission_LeaderWa:
Listen up, Stalkers! An Emission is coming!
Everybody find shelter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Audiolog_HermanLastW: Skif, come in! Come in! Solder sold us out, you hear me? That greedy son of a bitсh sold us out! I…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Comment_Batya_Messag: Lone stalkers, the bar in Zalissya is open again! The first drink after the Emission is on me!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Comment_RihterExamin: The bastard shot him at point-blank, then took everything, even the sensors. Fuck…
Now the entire Lesser Zone is gonna have to clean up this mess…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Comment_RihterHello_: You handled it like a real stalker! Come over here, and let’s talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Comment_RihterInTheH: You wanted to settle some scores, didn’t you?
Shit, the timing couldn’t be any worse…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Comment_Rihter_on_Pl: Why is your ass still here?! Head over to Zalissya and keep your mouth shut – unless you want both of us killed!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Comment_SkifCallsHer: Hermann! Over! Can you hear me? Over!
Fuck! No comms, a total shitfest all around. Hermann, damn in, what did you drag me into?!
Screw you, then. I'll figure it out myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Dialog_RihterAfterAn: I knew you could do it! Well, okay, I didn’t really know, but I sure hoped you would. How’d you get here without any gear?
I was attacked while on a job. Got hit in the head. When I woke up, I was in almost nothing but my birthday suit.
You’re lucky they didn’t kill you right away. You should stop by Zalissya and check up with the doc, man. And talk to the bartender while you’re there, see if he knows anything about your attackers.
You know how to keep your mouth shut, good for you. The Zone doesn’t like blabbers. You should drop by Zalissya. The bartender is nice enough to rookies… might give you something.
Long story short – bad luck. By the way, I’m looking for someone nicknamed Solder. Know anywhere I could ask around about him?
If you’re looking for somebody, go to Zalissya. Talk to Warlock, the local bartender. He might know something. Or maybe not. It depends…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_Dialog_RihterExposit: If you have any questions, be quick. If anyone spots you here, the whole Ward will come after you.
An ordinary stalker. I used to be a guide, took people all around the Zone. Then I got lost, in every meaning of the word. So it’s probably not a good idea to stick around me for long.
The Ward guards SIRCAA, that big ass institute at the swamps. Or so they say. In truth, they control nearly the entire Zone.
Duty and Freedom couldn’t hold a candle to the Ward. They tried to resist, but Korshunov put them in their place quick enough. He made sure they wouldn’t mess with the “new world order.”
Anyway, stay away from the Ward. And don’t mention this around them, obviously.
Do you help everybody? Or am I somehow special?
To quote my fictional dad, “Son, help if you can, and if you can’t, don’t get in the way”. So, don’t get in the way. Or help, if you will. My men at the post office need a hand.
Bring ’em a couple of medkits. You’ll do good and make some friends, maybe.
A Warden gadget. It records everything around the squad like a black box. We’re lucky not every Warden gets one. If it ends up in the wrong hands, or worse, in the right hands…
What are you doing here, anyway?
Cleaning up a hotheaded moron’s mess. You better get out of here before you get that shit on you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_rihter_0_CallPlayer_: Hey, over here! Let’s have a chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_rihter_0_DefeatComme: You got a medkit to spare?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_rihter_0_InfoTopic_1: Do I look like a radio to you? The best news is the news you uncover on your own. Or, better yet, the news you make. Unless it’s your obituary, of course. Gotta draw a line somewhere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_rihter_0_NPC_Combat_: I’m gonna flank them. Cover me!
Fuck! One of ours is down!
Here’s a little present for you!
You ain’t gettin’ away from me!
Well, well, what do we have here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ01_rihter_0_ResumeComme: So, what were we talking about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Audiolog_BS_Note_1_7: Hey Elbow, here’s a quick update: we had some sketchy stalker snooping around. We sent him packing toward the farmstead. Don’t sweat it, the loot’s gonna be top-notch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_ASKRO_Done_1: Okay, here we go… Don’t even breath over there, got it? If we screw up now, you ain’t gettin’ any coordinates.
Aha, that’s it! Squint’s at the old mill. Oh, and thanks for helping me tune this thing. I know you had your own reasons for doing it, but I still don’t like being in debt. Here you go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_BCBanditsKil: He’s stealin’ Elbow’s loot! Get the freak!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_BanditsNearB: Why are you loners always so eager to get here? Enough lurking, kiddo. Come here, let’s have a talk.
Do you even realize whose stuff you’re trying to steal? We’re Elbow's crew.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_Interrogatio: Told ya. I don’t know nuthin’.
And yet your friend says you used to talk to Squint all the time.
I talk to a lot of people. I’m an extrovert.
Zotov remembers those who help him.
Other folks remember who’s helping Zotov, too. I don’t want any trouble.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_KosoyWarning: Get up. Slowly. Keep your hands where I can see them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_Kosoy_after_: Hurry up. The artifact in the cave ain’t gonna retrieve itself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_Leans_on_lad: Lens here. Look, I created this system a little while ago to keep track of the rookies’ PDAs. You know, in case they go… missing after an Emission.
To locate Squint’s PDA, we need to tune in to three points. I’ve already got two, but the third one is on you. Try not to fall, by the way. The last climber I had took a good month to recuperate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_MilitaryOnRa: Simmer down, everything’s gonna be all right. Stay low for now. Go mess around with Fleshes at the Cordon or something… Hey, Shuhayev, bring me a bottle. We’re drowning our sorrows tonight!

I wish I could join you. That old prick Sukhin has completely lost it. Says he’s gonna shoot anyone he sees moping around. Can you believe it? All right. I’ll try to figure something out about that ammo. I’ll be in touch.
Shut it down, he said. And I had a deal set up at the Eastern Checkpoint worth two cases of ammo! Bullets don’t grow on trees, ya know!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_PlayerRunFro: Where do you think you’re going, stalker? Halt!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_VartaStopPla: Nobody’s going in without the Captain’s orders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Comment_WadenAboutRa: Come here. We need to talk.
Stand down, Lieutenant. Let him pass. I’m aware of the situation.
Got nothing else to do, climber? This is Captain Zotov.
Leave the site at once, stalker. The radio tower is under Ward protection. Entry is prohibited.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_BanditsAboutC: Why the hell are you skulkin’ around here?
Well, if a kingpin needs me, I guess I’ll help him out.
That’s more like it. Come to our base then.
All right, out with it. What do you want?
Not me – our kingpin, Elbow. He’s got an order to fill. You can ask him about Squint too while you’re at it.
He went toward the Farmstead. He’d need a decent hole to hide in case of an Emission. All the houses in the area are totally wrecked, so I guess he’s hangin’ out at the mill.
I’m sick of talking. You guys are boring.
Looks like the stalker’s bored, boys. Let’s entertain him!
’Cuz I feel like it. Do I need your permission or something?
Tough guy, are ya? Get this jackass, boys!
I already helped Elbow out. Guess I did it for free, huh?
Why didn’t you you say right away you were one of us, bro?
All right, I can pay you.
I’m looking for a stalker. Name’s Squint. You seen him?
Well, we saw a loner here. Told him to get lost. Didn’t ask for his handle.
Did you see where he went?
Do I look like an information desk to you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_GuideInfo_BS_: I’ve been to the warehouse. All I found was an old hazmat suit.
Well, not many folks get lucky on the road when Uncle Lyonya isn’t around. Squint’s no exception.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_GuideInfo_Inf: The guy who did the Wardens in? Yeah, I saw him. Before they shut down the Lesser Zone.

He was asking for directions, just like everybody else. I told him to get a decent suit from Hamster first, and then we’d see how to get to the warehouse where they store the radioactive hazard signs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_HomyakKosoyTo: I mean, I can understand the guy to some extent… just between you and me, okay? All those riches just lying around, waiting to be taken – how could you refuse? But still, the asshole almost got me killed.
A walking honeypot, that’s Squint for you. If you meet him, give him a black eye for me. To think I got him a whole new suit in exchange for some guns looted from corpses!
You bet I do! He brought me some guns and sensors. How was I supposed to know they were taken from the Ward? At least I was bright enough not to take the sensors off him…
So, do you know where I might be able to find him?
He told me he’s gonna study some arch anomalies with Uncle Lyonya. The bastard!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_KillOrFreeKos: What kind of artifact? How could it help you?
What do you care? It’s an artifact like any other. I just happen to know how to use it.
What kind of cave?
Just a cave. Nothing special about it.
But it has to be me that goes there. Not you.
All right – there’s an anomaly field there. That’s it, really.
I see. That’s all I need to know.
So, can you help? It’s a matter of life and death.
Got any ideas how to escape the Lesser Zone?
Just one, but I need an artifact. There’s one in the cave nearby.
All right. I’ll get you the artifact.
I know a stalker when I see one. Got a detector?
Who the hell are you? And what are you doing here?
I’m tired of running around. I’d rather just gun you down.
You’re not a stalker. You’re a murderer and a looter.
Easy there. I’m a friend. See, my gun is down.
Or maybe you’re a Warden bitch sniffing around here? Nah, you don’t look the part. Those assholes think they’re too good for stalker gear.
If you’re a friend, care to help a fellow stalker escape?
Nope. Do I need one?
Shit. Fine, take mine. I’ll get myself a new one if I make it through.
Put your gun down, would you? I’ve got one too.
You wanna play quick draw? Okay, relax. You’re not from the Ward, are you? Nah, I’m sure you aren’t. A Warden would never swap his rags for stalker gear.
Well, tough guy… Care to help a fellow stalker escape?
Was it you who attacked them near the Old Bridge at night? Why?
At night? Nope, I found the bastards at dawn. One was almost dead, so I finished him off. You should’ve seen those assholes pushing us around a couple years back…
So many good stalkers had to die because those bastards wanted to show everyone who’s the boss in the Zone. A blind dog’s got more humanity than any Warden! So, an eye for a fucking eye.
Why can’t you escape on your own?
The pigs from the Ward have everything locked down. But I’ve got my own way – the stalker way.
I sure do. Why do you ask?
I’ve seen stranger things. All right, I’ll wait for your triumphant return.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_KoldunKosoyTo: Do you know anything about Squint?
Not much, really. He only stopped by once, before this whole… mess. Had a few drinks. He was looking for a guide, so I told him to talk to Uncle Lyonya.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_KosoyPlayerWi: Why the hell didn’t you tell me about that scary thing in the cave?
Would you have gone in there if I did? That’s why.
Here you go. Now hit the road.

Well ain’t you a peach, stalker! I can’t give you any money, sorry. Don’t got any. No gear either. Mine’s all worn out. Well, except for this Warden stuff. I got no clue what it is, but maybe it’ll come in handy. So long. Zone willing, we’ll meet again.
Yeah, and I’m keeping it. When the Ward gets you, try sending them to the cave too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_Kosoy_If_aliv: All right. I'll leave you to it.
Why do you hate the Ward so much? Not everybody’s capable of killing an unarmed person.
Right, you’re green… When the Ward took over the Chemical Plant, they didn’t beat around the bush. Gave us fifteen minutes to grab our stuff and get out. Anyone who didn’t make it caught a bullet.
Those bastards sure are. I used to have a group, back before Richter. We had a proper base… a good, solid place.
So I don’t have any pity for those assholes. Not now, not ever.
Weren’t you going to leave the Zone?
Going somewhere right away is a sure-fire way to get yourself killed, rookie. You gotta get ready for the Zone, gotta know exactly where you’re going and, most importantly, why.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_LeansAntennaI: There’s another antenna nearby. It’s an ancient piece of junk, but it worked the last time I had it checked. This one’s gonna take at least a week to fix. Get to the other one. I’ve sent you the coordinates.
I know, okay? Goddamn Emission! I’ll have to replace the coils again! Okay, let me think…
Did you turn it on? Yeah, it seems to be working… I’ll reroute more power to the amplifier… Oh, fuck! Damn it to hell!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E02_MQ02_Dialog_LinzaKosoyTop: I’m looking for information. About Squint.
Everyone’s looking for Squint – especially folks with fancy gear. But I’m a technician, not a search engine.
If you need anything fixed, that’s me. If you’re looking to wag your tongue, talk to Warlock at the bar. He’s a real chatterbox.
