There's a problem, though. The vents at the Shelter don't work. Underground rooms are filled with toxic waste gas. This place is already falling apart without Khors.
So I gotta fix the ventilation system to reach the source?
That’s right. Khors just started working on it. I think he even ordered some parts from Quiet before he… left.
I’ve got his notes. You can have them. Khors had everything planned out, so you’ll have no trouble figuring it out.
One more thing: right now, you can only get underground from outside the base, to the northeast. After you’re done with the vents, head there.
How did you end up here at Quiet’s camp?
After the Signal, they all packed up and left. Didn’t even bother to check my bunker.
So I decided to warn everyone off the island. I needed a powerful radio, I knew Quiet had one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_Dialog_Mercs_PressSk: How about I give you some coupons and we go our separate ways?
You’ll never be able to match what I’m about to get for this thing.
Give it to me, or you die.
Did your men capture Lodochka? Why?
Yeah. He was the only one who knew where to find the Monolithian device.
The Monolithian device. The one I was asked to find.
Found what you were looking for?
Drop your gun and give me the device. Now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_Dialog_RichterAboutS: Damn, they got all soggy after all. I should’ve kicked the habit.
Incoming from Wild Island. Maybe not all of them got hit by that Monolith thingy... right? Come on, chime in.
That means Strider, and Dubny, and… they’re all gone? Right… I guess the Zone didn’t protect them after all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_Dialog_RichterLodoch: Richter, it’s Lodochka. The island… it’s a disaster! Something is happening, and it's—
Calm down, professor. Deep breaths. I need details.
It happened all at once. Like a Signal. Intense psi-activity. Incredibly powerful. Noontide… Richter, they’ve all turned into Monolithians again!
I found out where it started, but I can’t get there. I’m at Quiet’s camp.
Damn! Someone’s here! Richter, I need your help. Can you hear me? Help!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_Dialog_RichterWildIs: I didn’t know about the Caribbean Experiment, Skif. I’m not one of Scar’s men, and Spark doesn’t report to me. I don’t have a clue what they’re up to or where they are.
But you’re right. Scar is capable of anything. The question is: will his shortcut lead us to the Zone we want?
Right, here’s the deal: you take care of Wild Island and Lodochka, and I’ll go find Scar.
Sure hope it’s not a Monolithian bullet keeping him quiet.
Maybe, Monolith is back because the Wish Granter was taken to SIRCAA? And Scar couldn’t let it go?
What the hell is happening on that island?
No idea. Where’s Scar when I need him, damn it? I may not be Spark, but it’s high time he showed up.
We need to get the professor out of there, Skif. There’s no way we can sort this shit out without him.
Lodochka mentioned some kind of Signal. What do you think it was?
I bet it was the exact same crap that made poor Khors jump us. He wouldn’t hurt a fly.
Lodochka’s gonna have a heart attack when he hears about this.
Ever thought it might all be Scar’s fault? He and the Ward are all busy with their Zone turf war, and the rest of us gotta deal with the fallout.
Did you know that Scar tried to stop Dalin from replicating the Caribbean Experiment?
Looks even worse than I thought.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_Dialog_SphereRadioAb: Perimeter, the Sphere is under attack! I repeat, we’ve got contact and need reinforcements. There’s a shitload of them!
Noontide! They breached our defenses already. Fuck! Sukhin is leading them!
Sphere, please repeat. What’s the status of your commander? Sphere, do you read? Over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_Dialog_VartaRadioAbo: Base, this is Slag Heap. Noontide is storming in here like crazy. Definitely headed for the Duga.
We need immediate extraction. I repeat, we need a chopper in here, now.
We can’t hold them off. I’ve already got a dozen heav—
Sniper, two o’clock! Open fire! Keep that fucker pinned down! Don’t let him get his head up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_Dialog_WildIslandTas: Skif, this is Korshunov. Respond. Over.
You're alive? Good. Now listen up.
The situation here is FUBAR. Monolith is back in full force, determined to take over the Zone.
It started all at once, like on command, — two bursts of psi-radiation from Wild Island and the Sphere in the Lesser Zone rebooted the Monolith program in their heads.
I need to know the source of that Signal, Skif. Track it down and bring it to the Chemical Plant. I’ll be waiting. Over and out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ01_professor_lodocka_0_: Noontide is still radio silent. For now.
But I won’t give up. Not now, not ever.
“Monolith, Monolith, Monolith…” That’s all I hear in the Zone these days. I never thought of Noontide as murderers, but they've gone ruthless.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_Flaff1_1_565: Only in body bags. A whole bunch of ’em got brought in yesterday. I hear Pickman and Kotz are at the hospital. They’re in pretty bad shape.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_Flaff2_1_565: I emptied half a mag into that fucker, and he didn’t even blink — like those armor-piercing rounds were rubber bullets! I was lucky the colonel had that grenade launcher.
Thanks for the reminder — gotta get some VOGs from Ivaylov. A good old grenade up close always gets the job done, Monolith or not.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_Flaff3_start: First Icarus, and now this… I didn’t sign up for this shit, bro.
Looks like we’re in for a rough ride. I heard they’re calling remote squads back to base. Something big's about to go down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_HimzavodVart: Where you headed? Keep it short, or I’ll put a bullet in you. After the signal, nobody’ll question it.
I’m a friendly. Here to see the colonel.
Skif, right? Come in. But don't go straight to the colonel. See Major Dvoryankov first. That’s an order.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_PripoyInMono: Get over here, you Monolithian scumbag. I’ll cram that Monolith of yours right up your ass!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_Pripoy_CallF: Hello? Is there anyone still breathing in this fuckin’ Zone?
This is Solder. I’m at the Sphere.
The place is fucked. Those Noon assholes killed everybody.
Anybody out there? Come in! If the bastards catch me, they’ll do me in too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_TechnicianGr: Come here, Skif. The colonel ordered me to kit you out. I hope the sizes are right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_VartaNoWay_1: The colonel’s busy. He’ll summon you later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Comment_VartaNoWay_D: The colonel’s busy. Go see Major Dvoryankov.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Dialog_DalinAboutEmi: Skif, this is Dalin. The colonel says you’re looking for the source of that Signal that launched the Monolith program. Made any progress?
Great. Get it over to the Chemical Plant. We’re waiting for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Dialog_DvorenkovAbou: Put the equipment on the table. I’ll make sure it gets to the colonel.
He'll contact you when he’s available.
In the meantime, stop by our technician. He’ll give you some gear to make sure you look the part.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Dialog_Pripoy_TakeIn: How did you make it out alive?
I kept quiet and stayed low.
I thought I'd wait it out, but there was no fucking way. Those damn lunatics were playing by the book — started sweeping the whole place.
What kind of gizmo was it?
Some kind of Emitter. I didn’t ask for the details — just installed it in the Sphere like he told me to. That’s it.
Korshunov sent me. They detected a psi-radiation spike here. Do you know why?
It was all Sukhin! The motherfucker brought me some kind of gizmo. He was like, “Fix it up, it’ll make our maps more accurate.”
Did I get a say? I’m at the bottom of the totem pole here. I do what I’m told. Who’d have thought it’d turn his brain to mush?
I’m looking for the Emitter. Any idea where it is?
It was all Sukhin! The motherfucker brought me some kind of gizmo. He was like, “Fix it up, it’ll make our maps more accurate.”
Did I get a say? I’m at the bottom of the totem pole here. I do what I’m told. Who’d have thought it’d turn his brain to mush?
Oh, fuck, it’s you... Mr. Client. Didn’t expect to see you again.
What the hell are you doing here?
Is Sukhin alive? Where is he?
He’s a fuckin’ rat, and rats don’t die easy. After the psi-radiation hit and we were busy duct-taping our brains back together, the son of a bitch opened the gates for his Noon buddies.
Then he holed up at the Sphere while those fuckers massacred everyone “for the Monolith!”
Is there a way to get to the Sphere unnoticed?
Not really, but you can always cut the power. There’s a breaker nearby. Flip it, and the Sphere goes dark.
And hey, take a look around Sukhin’s office while you’re at it. He was always a shitheel, taking bribes like there was no tomorrow. He ain’t gonna need any of his stuff now.
And thanks, by the way. You saved my ass again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Dialog_RihterAboutEm: Skif, come in. What’s up with Lodochka?
He’s alive. And he helped me find the thing that scrambled Noontiders’ brains.
Good to hear. I’ve got some news too. I’ll shoot you Scar’s current coordinates.
He knew you wouldn't leave the Shelter empty-handed. Whatever you found, he wants you to bring it to him. He says it’ll come in handy for his future plans.
Keep an eye on him, Skif. I don't like those insights of his.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Dialog_TechnicianAbo: Well, the brass are planning, the boys are trading stories, and I’m here busy restocking our supplies. Top-notch stuff. We're almost fully stocked, making sure there's enough gear for the reinforcements.
What’s the chatter among the troops?
Don’t you know? It’s all Monolith this, Monolith that, Monolith every which way. The big buzz is about the Duga. Word is they massacred the whole IPSF garrison there.
Where are these reinforcements coming from?
All over the place. When Korshunov got back from SIRCAA, he ordered a full-scale mobilization.
That’s what HQ is for, to keep us grunts in the dark until the orders come down the line. But when officers spend day and night briefing, we know some serious shit’s in the works.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_Dialog_TechnicianRew: Here, take this. This gear's top-notch, just like the colonel requested. I’ve made a few extra enhancements too... based on our combat experience.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_pripoj_0_DefeatComme: You son of a bitch! I’ll rip you to fucking… shit, it hurts!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_pripoj_0_InfoTopic_1: I’d rather stay the fuck away and watch the Monolith weed out the Zone from afar. But there's no-fucking-where to lay low! Maybe I should make a run for the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_sold_cervonenko_0_Bu: I really don’t have time for this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_sold_cervonenko_0_In: Ever since we lost Icarus, we've got no news, just orders. Worst of all, those orders are mostly about pulling back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_sold_kalinin_0_ByeTo: See you later... if we make it out alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ02_sold_kalinin_0_InfoT: I’ve been thinking: a Monolithian can’t be much worse to deal with than a Bloodsucker. At least with them, we can see where to shoot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Audiolog_RAudio01_AR: November 8, 1976. Commencing stage two of the Duga test. Launch in three…
Fascinating! We can consider this test a success. I believe we can proceed to the next stage. Nevertheless…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Audiolog_RAudio02_P1: Arrived at the Promin facility to locate and eliminate any potential records related to Project X and the Team.
I immediately discovered an archived audio recording of Dr. Orlov’s initial successful test.
It was a sheer stroke of luck that this data didn't fall into unauthorized hands, given that it was essentially in plain sight.
Efforts are underway to uncover any other Project X materials, including those pertaining to the modification of the Duga into a psi-installation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Audiolog_RAudio03_P2: Located and secured fragmentary data related to the experiment to map the Noosphere, including the location and interconnections of its psynapses.
The facility is in a state of advanced disrepair, with many documents lost to natural decay.
Damn it, much of the equipment is literally falling apart in my hands. The scant information I've managed to salvage will be documented only in these reports.
Fuck, am I lost or something?
Ouch! That hurts! Where the hell did this desk come from?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Audiolog_RAudio04_P3: I’ve located evidence of the facility’s modification to ensure remote control of the Duga from that damned Malachite.
These rooms aren’t even on my map! And the Ministry of Defense and Secret Technologies called it a “comprehensive briefing?”
Fuck, it’s a combination lock… how am I supposed to know if there’s anything related to C-Consciousness in there?! Just great…
Now I need to figure out the code. What the hell was Dr. Orlov thinking?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_AR_GRPnotice: Shit, he’s not one of ours!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_AR_GRPspawn_: Be careful! The fucker might still be around.
Don’t go too far — the last shift didn’t put much effort into patrolling the facility.
Look for any survivors, and keep your eyes peeled!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_AR_SQD_SQDha: Attention, everyone. Watch out for anyone who fits the previous shift's APB.
Lone stalker. Heavily armed. Possibly with military training. Eliminate on sight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_AR_SQD_SQDst: Assemble a new recon team and dispatch them to Becker at once.
Provide him and his men with all the support they need.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_AR_SQD_SQDwi: Everyone, secure your positions and prepare for engagement.
There’s a good chance the enemy that took out the last shift will strike again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_ProceedToExi: Target’s inside the facility. Should we continue pursuit?
Stand down! The place has been deserted for ages. There's no telling what’s down there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_ScarAfterDug: How did you like it, Skif? I, for one, savored every moment. The Zone really tore the Ward asunder today.
Head over to STC Malachite and find Ozersky. He’s a friend of Spark. He’ll help us understand this tech and come up with a plan to tackle those doubles.
You’d better explain why I had to kill the same guy over and over again.
They were illusions. Phantom doubles, like those conjured by certain mutants.
Who knows what other tricks the Preacher has up his sleeve? Right now, he poses a greater threat to our cause than the Ward.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_ScarGoAssaul: Skif, come in! You pulled it off, didn’t you? I expected nothing less.
You did a good job and secured yourself a front-row seat for the show.
We’re right under the Monolith’s nose at the Duga, so get over there quickly. You’re the last one we’re waiting for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_VartaAlarm_a: The fucker opened fire. We’ve got a few wounded.
We’ve got an intruder inside the perimeter. Apprehend him immediately!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_VartaAlarm_p: He appears to be armed, Lieutenant.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_VartaRadioBa: Man, that was crazy! I was walking past a rupture when I heard Fedorchuk shouting from inside. I peeked in, but there was no one there…
Hey, the same shit happened to me there a few times. But I usually keep quiet about it.
I wouldn’t have cared if that jerk Fedorchuk hadn’t told me the same night that I was the one calling out to him from that crack…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_VartaRadio_a: Just a couple more puffs, and I’ll head back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_VartaRadio_c: Fall asleep on your smoke break there, Swan?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Comment_VartaTalking: How long are we supposed to stay on patrol here?
Zotov said we need to stay put until we get new orders. So we're gonna keep patrolling until our knees give out.
When the captain needs us, he’ll get in touch. The rest isn't our concern.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_ScarAfterCutS: You stopped Dalin from replicating the Caribbean Experiment. Why?
Feeling homesick, Skif? You shouldn’t be. If Dalin had gone ahead with it, the entire Zone would've become Cold Island, and you wouldn’t be the only one left homeless.
My only regret is that we acted too late... much like you and Strider now.
What’s the plan, Scar? What’s our next move?
The plan is as simple as it gets. The Ward intends to destroy the Zone. Along with you and me, of course.
But we're going to stop them. How? Easy enough. We’re going to strike back, starting with the Duga for now.
What do you want me to do?
First, head over to our tech, Powerplug. He’ll hand you the control Emitter and give you the 101 on how to use it and where it goes.
Oh, and Powerplug’s got a little present for you too. It's time to stop hiding, Skif. Let the Zone know you’re one of us now.
Is the Signal your doing? You provided Lodochka with the Emitters. Could you have supplied Faust as well?
Lodochka needed the Emitters. Faust needed the Emitters. The professor is a good man. And good men usually help each other.
Even when it comes to essential supplies. Sometimes, they might not even be aware of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_ScarInteract_: You should’ve figured out by now that just asking questions won’t bring you any closer to the answers.
You’re a man of action, Skif. So start acting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_Starr_ally_59: Pretty much, but I don’t mind it. The less people know about your plans, the better off you are.
And it’s working for us so far, given that we’re all still alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_Starr_duga_59: What do you know about the Duga?
The Duga is an old military facility. It’s been used as a control and PDA relay station ever since the Zone emerged.
But what’s really fascinating is the scale of the mess that’s about to go down in there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_Starr_plan_59: Do you know what Scar’s up to?
I know what Scar told me. He’s the kind of guy who only tells people what they need to know... even if they don't get it.
Now that you’re rolling with us, I’d say kick back and enjoy the ride.
Stick to the plan, Skif. It’s not every day you get promised a legit miracle, not some lab-brewed shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_Starr_start_5: You still here, stalker? Get going. Korshunov’s rounding up his goons at the Duga as we speak.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_Starr_varta_5: Are you really itching to go after the Ward?
Yup, ever since those assholes showed up in the Zone bleating about the greater good of humanity.
I know their type, filling their pockets with that greater good. I hated that crap back on the Mainland. Here in the Zone, I can finally fight back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_TechBase_base: Where's your main base, by the way?
It's essential for our organization’s operations, ya dig?
We’re all about staying mobile and never leaving a trail.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_TechComplex_w: Tell me more about this complex.
It's an old research facility. Abandoned a long time ago, but I bet there are still plenty of secrets hidden in there. I’ve heard you've got a knack for exploring places like that.
Some folks from Malachite used to go there all the time. Put your big boy pants on, take a look around — you'll figure it out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_Dialog_TechnicianUni: Scar told me to grab some scrap here.
Scrap, you can grab. As for the control Emitter, I’m handing it over as I was told. Though it probably makes no difference to grunts like you.
Don’t mess with it — we’ve had a few accidents already. Now those accidents are either drooling in a corner or doing a little dance under the Controller’s spell.
What do I need to do with the Emitter?
There’s an abandoned complex beneath the Promin factory. Inside, you’ll find the device the Emitter is meant to be used with.
Your job is to hook the Emitter up to the device, then get the heck out of there. Comms might get wonky, but we’ll know when the job’s done, rest assured.
What are all these preparations for?
We’re planning a big surprise for the Ward at the Duga.
But in order for our mousetrap to work, we have to wind it up first. And that’s where the control Emitter comes in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_stepsel_0_BusyTopic_: Take a hike. I’ve got enough on my plate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_stepsel_0_ByeTopic_B: That’s it. The exit is over there.
We’re done here. See you around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_stepsel_0_HelloTopic: What do you want? The sooner I’m done with it, the sooner you’re out of here.
Hey there. I hope it’s nothing too serious.
Let’s cut to the chase. We can always chat later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_stepsel_0_InfoTopic_: Our guys picked up something cool from the SIRCAA ruins. No fucking clue how it works, but I have a hunch it’s gotta be fun.
Once I figure out how to use this thing, we’ll take it for a spin. If it worked for the Ward, it’ll pack twice the punch against them, I tell you what.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_stepsel_0_Meet_Meet_: You’ve figured out by now that the road we take leads to a better Zone, right?
I’m here to pave that road. Think about it: we’re pushing the Ward so hard, they’re practically gasping for air. Spark wouldn’t be able to pull this off without the toys I’ve been whipping up.
I can give your gear a makeover too, if you want. You’re one of the good guys now — you gotta look the part.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ03_stepsel_0_UpgradeTop: It’ll do the job. Can’t promise more than that.
Gimme five minutes, and I’ll make it better than new.
I’ll get it working like a charm.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_A_SenkTkachC: Tachenko, eliminate that sniper! We’re pinned down!
Copy that, Captain. I’m on it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_A_SenkevichG: Let’s get moving. And remember, keep it quiet, team!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_A_Storm2RP_s: Come in! We can’t reach the primary LZ. We need fire support!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_A_TkachDeadS: You’re our only chance, Skif. Those snipers will pick us off one by one. Get to Tachenko’s position and… make those bastards pay.
The commander’s down, Captain. Tachenko… they got the commander! Those sons of bitches!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_BAV_fluff01_: I can’t help but wonder… what if this crap — you know, the Signal or whatever — spreads throughout the entire Zone? Or even worse, makes its way to the Mainland…
It’s tough to wrap your head around, but it’d make all those other “cataclysms” look like a walk in the park.
And that’s precisely why we’re here — to make sure that doesn’t happen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_BAV_fluff02_: I told you something big was about to go down. This is our chance to get back at Monolith.
And we’re balls-deep in this “something big.” This isn’t what I had in mind when I joined up…
Eh, come on! Don’t you want to get even for the boys we lost at SIRCAA?
That’s what I'm talking about. Those sons of bitches are about to find out who they’re messing with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_BAV_fluff03_: You bet. I’ve been itching to deal with the crap that’s been trying to get into our heads ever since Icarus. Once and for all.
You think Faust screwed us at Icarus too?
I got no fucking clue. We’ll kick his sorry ass, and then we’ll get to the bottom of it.
The Zone’s no stranger to all sorts of weird shit, but the Monolith’s sudden awakening sure as hell doesn’t seem like a fucking accident.
If we saw 'em wake up, it’s up to us to put ’em the fuck back to sleep. Who’s better suited for the job than us, anyway?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_BAV_solo_hi1: The commander is waiting for you by the tower.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_BAV_solo_hi2: The captain is waiting for you by the tower.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_BAV_solo_hi3: Come on in. Don’t keep the captain waiting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_BA_Taran_flu: Should I pack just a couple of mags, or is this the time to go overkill?
If I were you, I’d grab some extra grenades too so you don't have to run around later.
You mean so I won’t have to come back for more ammo?
No, I mean so we can take down the Monolith right here, right now, instead of chasing after ’em all over creation.
Seriously, now’s the time to gear up and be ready for anything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_DalinAfterDu: I’ve received the reports, Skif. Faust and his doppelgangers — is it true? Did you witness this firsthand? And why has the colonel gone silent?
I think Korshunov’s dead. Lots of others too. And yes, I saw Faust’s doubles with my own eyes.
This is bad. This is very, very bad. I’ll look for any records regarding the incident with Faust in the SIRCAA archives, but that alone might not suffice. I’m going to need your assistance.
Get to STC Malachite. There might be someone there who's heard about a phenomenon like this. We need all the information we can get. I’ll reach out to you if I find anything substantial on my end.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_DalinWantsAn: Well, there was hardly anything useful in our archives. Just a reference to research on so-called phantoms within a specific range of psi radiation.
I suggest you speak with Professor Ozersky, the head of Malachite. He’s known for his forays into pseudoscience, but he’s been studying the Zone for a long time. He might have some insights.
And Skif… Make sure you don’t leave without getting some answers from him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_FaustRun_1_6: You must not be here. Begone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_Hold_1_69733: Fuck, it’s like they don’t feel any pain at all!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_KorshInterac: Head to the Small Duga. Captain Senkevych will give you a detailed briefing when you arrive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_KorshWhats_1: What the fuck’s going on, Senkevych?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_MonolithSqua: Those who are in eternal union with the Monolith can never be stopped!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_MonolithStar: We have no other life beyond our devotion to Him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_Senkevich_Ho: We’ll hold this position until reinforcements arrive!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Comment_Storm2_Hit_1: Mayday, mayday! We’re losing altitude. The instruments…
Hand over the controls! Those are my men out there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Dialog_AgataAfterCut: What about the new home you promised me?
Do you want to live in a world where a fanatical sect tries to mold everyone in their own image? Because that’s what they’re preparing to do at the Duga.
Somehow I thought you had a different vision for the future.
One where every human being will be happier than they were yesterday, not the other way around.
Do you have any more questions, Yevhen?
Why does Colonel Korshunov see the scientists from Project X as traitors?
His statements are often quite harsh.
True, they did conduct a poorly planned and unauthorized experiment that ultimately brought them down.
But at the same time, they’re responsible for the creation of the Zone itself. So no, I wouldn’t label them as traitors. Too independent, too ambitious maybe — but traitors, they were not.
But who do you represent? Project X? The Regulatory Board the colonel mentioned?
You’re quite perceptive, that much is certain. Yes, the Regulatory Board.
As for Project X and its scientific endeavors, we simply ensured its continuity during a period when the government was unable to dedicate itself to the study of anomalous phenomena.
You don’t need to know the details, so let's just say we’re interested in anything that can propel humanity forward along the path of evolution. That includes the Zone.
The plan remains the same: we need to get the Zone’s Anomalous energy under control.
To achieve this, we need to reach the Generators and bring them online.
Then we can activate the network of research centers we've set up across the Mainland. These centers are equipped with more advanced Generator facilities.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Dialog_BA_SenkevichB: How are the guys from Icarus holding up?
Thanks to you, most of them have recovered. It sure felt nice to see Kryvenko scram with that pissed-off expression on his ugly mug.
Why not launch a coordinated assault with all our forces instead of risking a small group?
What should we expect from the Monolithians this time?
Nothing good, as usual. I just hope we can get this down without another load of mystical mumbo-jumbo.
Knock on wood, Captain.
If I had an IPSF helmet handy, I would.
The usual bullshit. I’d advise you to keep your head down, but they can’t fry your brains if you ain’t got any.
Why put our men at risk? Our job is to get the enemy’s attention while the landing party hit them hard at the control points, weakening their positions for the main assault.
I’m glad folks like you ain’t in charge of our military operations. If you wanna die a hero, go ahead and charge in on your own. Either that, or you can follow orders.
The usual bullshit. I’d advise you to keep your head down, but I’ve seen enough of your kind to know that my words will fall on deaf ears.
You managed to avoid getting demoted after Icarus, huh?
No one's more surprised by that than me. On the contrary, the colonel has finally entrusted me and my men with an important assignment!
Good to see you too, Captain. I take it you made it out of Icarus.
I did, but a bunch of my guys ended up walking vegetables... all thanks to a certain fucker who thought he could play scientist.
So what happened to Icarus?
Icarus… the Zone swallowed it up, just as it has so many of my men. But let’s not talk about that now.
Well, it’s good to see you again, stalker! Ready for a new challenge?
Well, well, look who’s here... our junior research assistant. A real sight for sore fuckin’ eyes.
Hello there. I’m Captain Senkevych, the commanding officer of the Icarus garrison… or what’s left of it. I'm currently in charge of the assault operation.
I got it. Let’s go.
That’s the spirit! Here's the gear you'll need for the mission. Give me a heads up when you good to go.
Yeah, right. Here, you gotta gear up first. They’ll let you know when it’s time.
I like your spirit, stalker! Here, take some gear you might need for the mission. Give me a heads up when you good to go.
What’s our mission?
Our main mission is to divert the Monolithians’ attention at the checkpoint, allowing for a safe landing. After that, the main forces will join the battle.
Tachenko and his men will take down the sniper in the tower. That will be our signal to start the operation. Any questions?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Dialog_DalinAfterCut: Tell me about the Duga. Do you think Monolith has any plans for it?
The Duga is a former military facility. Or, at least, that was its original purpose.
Its function has evolved since the creation of the Zone. It now serves as both a control facility and a communication relay station.
Of course, the Monolith isn’t after our comms. Their goal is to use the Duga to tap into the minds of pretty much everyone in the Zone. That’s their plan, I believe.
So your father was a scientist who worked on Project X?
Not just any scientist — he was the head of the team that conducted the experiment to contact the Noosphere. They eventually came to be known as C-Consciousness.
The experiment spiraled out of control. And…
Well, they’re essentially responsible for the emergence of the Zone.
What went wrong at the Institute? Have you figured out what caused the Signal?
The telemetry data on the flash drive you brought will give us a clear picture. However, it’s already evident that external interference was involved.
Someone other than us had access to Azimuth Station’s router and tampered with its operation.
As a result, the attempt to establish a connection to the Generators failed, triggering the defense protocol and restarting the Monolith program.
Thanks for retrieving the flash drive, Skif.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Dialog_KorshAfterCut: And make sure to talk to Sergeant Ivaylov. I’ve arranged a little something for you: a token of our appreciation for your service to the Ward, if you will.
You’re welcome. You earned it. I hope this isn’t the last time.
I’m not like Dalin. I don’t make empty promises. If you’re fighting by my side, you won’t go into battle without the essentials.
So, how are you planning to take the Duga?
This time I’m going to harness the full power of the Ward. My vanguard is already scouting the area.
But you belong with the main force. Captain Senkevych will brief you on the details when you get to your position.
You think Monolith poses a real threat? To the entire Zone?
If they manage to establish a foothold at the Duga, it will pose a grave threat indeed.
However, the Ward has a tactical advantage. I know all about their typical MO, and they don't know anything about mine.
I hope that’s the end of it, Dalin. Let’s get down to business.
You heard everything, Skif. Now let’s not waste any more time…
Wait, Colonel! Skif, the flash drive from the SIRCAA archives — do you have it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_Dialog_Korsh_ImClose: We’re on our way, Senkevych. Make sure the LZ is ready.
All squads, prepare for the assault team.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_lejtenant_gorovic_0_: You really think this is a good time to talk?
You’ve got a keen eye, you bastard!
All the armories at the Chemical Plant were emptied. I watched Ivaylov hauling ammo boxes from the back shelves. We’re gonna rain so much lead down on Monolith, they’ll be drowning in it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_lejtenant_korban_0_I: We're lucky these brainwashed nutjobs all gathered in one place. Taking them out in one go beats flushing them out one by one all over the Zone.
Given our resources and training, it shouldn’t take more than an hour, tops.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_senkevich_Comment_Br: The psi installations! Skif, we need them gone before we’re toast!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_soldat_gersuna_0_Def: I need a bandage! Or a medkit! Anybody got one?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_soldat_gersuna_0_Inf: To be honest, this is a little nerve-wracking. I used to get nervous before every mission, even back on the Mainland. But this time, it’s for the best.

I’m at my best with adrenaline pumping, relying on pure reflexes. It’ll help against Monolith. stalkers say all sorts of things about them, but I’ve never heard anyone say Monolith are lousy fighters.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_soldat_kluev_0_InfoT: The Monolith's not gonna have another SIRCAA here, mark my words. No surprises — they’re all going down. And hey, the Duga makes a pretty decent tombstone. You can see it from miles away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_soldat_kulesov_0_Inf: Everything’s going as planned, just the way it should. The colonel wrote the book on assault operations.
Folks who've fought alongside him for a while say nobody’s ever beaten his record for minimizing casualties while inflicting maximum damage.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_soldat_zagorski_0_In: Too bad about SIRCAA. All those years of hard work, right down Monolith’s drain. Me, I’d rather disarm them and make them build it all back. They did a decent job cleaning up Wild Island, after all.
But we’ve got our orders, and nobody’s in the mood to play nice with them now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_tkacenko_0_DefeatCom: You asshole! I’m gonna make a sieve outta you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_tkacenko_0_HelloTopi: Hey there! Go on, spit it out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ04_tkacenko_0_InfoTopic: They say the Monolith’s got some damn good snipers. Guess it's time to see for ourselves. You know how folks in the Zone love to spread gossip.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ06_Comment_IskraBattle2: Scar never told us they were goddamn super-soldiers!
Fuck, Weasel, keep your mouth shut and stay focused!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ06_Comment_Iskra_Backgr: They’re swarming us! We’re trapped! They’re closing in on all sides!
Can anyone hear us? We need reinforcements!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ06_Scar_Comment_NextSte: All right, team. Secure the comm center. Skif, it’s time to move on to the next phase of the plan.
We’ve pinpointed the Monolithians’ HQ – if you can call it that. You know the drill.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ06_Scar_Comment_WakeUp_: Rise and shine, Skif. It’s time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ06_Scar_Dialog_BeforeDu: Why do we need the comm center?
To secure total control over the Duga. We can’t afford to let our advantage slip away at the most crucial moment.
Now, we wait for the Ward. We’ve got some time, so rest up and prepare yourself.
We’ll wake you up when it’s time.
Ah, there you are. Ready for the show?
Depends. What’s the plan this time?
You’ll love it. We’re killing two birds with one stone. The Monolithians are all yours.
They're not your concern. I’ve got a little surprise cooked up for them. Just focus on the task at hand.
While everyone’s busy dealing with the mess at the checkpoint, you’ll take over the underground comm center, then eliminate the leader of the Monolith.
I’ve thought it all through. This way, you’ll come at them from their blind side. Any questions?
A surprise for the Ward? What kind of surprise?
All that matters is that they’re gonna be too busy to get in your way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_MQ06_Scar_Dialog_KillFaus: Skif, the Monolith's leader is outside. He’s fighting the Ward.
No way. I just killed him.
Whoever you killed, it wasn’t him. Move out, now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Audialog_LinsaFight_: Gaffer, get the rookies to safety! I’ll hold them off!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Audiolog_Radio_Monol: The Monolith’s will has not been done.
Zalissya shall fall. Few infidels remain.
No one should be left alive. No one should stand in the Monolith’s path. Complete your mission.
It’s time for our final prayer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Batya_HelpKo: I told Hamster not everyone’s as nice as me.
I bet Warlock's gonna be cuddling that gun every night.
I hear Lens is gonna make it. Thanks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Batya_RadioE: Shooting at your own people at a time like this, Skif? Are you out of your mind? We’ll fight them off one way or another, but don’t even think about showing up here again, you asshole.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Batya_RadioS: Zalissya is requesting assistance. Our forces are stretched thin, and the fanatics are still advancing… dammit, can anybody hear me?
This is the Gaffer. Monolith is at Zalissya. We can’t hold them back on our own. We need all the help we can get. Stalkers, step up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Batya_RadioZ: Get to the assembly hall, Skif.
We did it, folks! We fought ’em off! We beat ’em!
Head over to the assembly hall, everyone. I’ve got something to share.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Batya_Radio_: To anyone seeking refuge from Monolith — come to Zalissya.
We fought them off. And we’ll keep fighting for as long as it takes.
To anyone seeking refuge from Monolith — Zalissya is holding its ground!
I repeat: if you have nowhere to go, Zalissya is safe!
I’m grateful to everyone who made this happen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Bavaria_RIP_: They sacrificed themselves for us. We’ll bury them with honor. So many graves…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Drakula_Afte: Stay frosty. It’s not over yet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Farmacevt_Th: They’re watching us. Up there on the hill. You see?
Wish I could get ’em to scram, but I can’t even come close to hitting ’em.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Hamster_Begg: Come on, this ain’t right! I’ll double it, okay?!
If you double it, you can tag along. I’ll watch your back out there.
Fuck… All right. have it your way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Hamster_Next: You're all a bunch of crooks! Thieves, every single one of ya!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Inostranec_A: All clear. We pulled it off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Inostranec_W: Welcome to Zalissya... or what’s left of it. Come in and talk to Gaffer. He'll give you some of our supplies. We don’t have much, but we’re sharing everything we’ve got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_KoldunNikola: I heard Lens is going to pull through. How about you?
I feel like I’ve aged beyond my years. I guess I’m a real “Mykolayich” now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Koldun_Fluff: One box of ammo at most, a couple of medkits, a couple of new guns, four grenades. No food.
Not a single crust of bread on any of the corpses? What the hell are they eating? All right, give the ammo to the raiding team, and put the rest in the pile. Now take a break. Good work.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Moloko_After: These fuckers are damn near unkillable!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_MonolithPray: The infidels will fear us. You shall take away their fear.
The infidels will hate us. You shall take away their hatred.
Within the Monolith, all is one. All will return to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_MonolitiansA: Fuck, they’re coming... a shit-ton of 'em!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Nicolaic_Art: Hey, Lens! I've got good news. You hear that, buddy?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Nicolaic_Tal: All right. We can talk about it later.
You should get some sleep. Warlock’s got your back. You won’t be able to help anyone if you're exhausted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_Rikoset_Leav: You heard him. Get lost. Now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Comment_ZalissyaClos: He’s here. Want me to fuck him up through the door?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_AskAgai: Can you remind me where can I find Uncle Lyonya?
A little house on the outskirts where he used to meet newcomers. We figured the guy valued his privacy. Turns out he was just there to hide his past.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_Done_id: I’ve got everything he asked for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_Done_in: Certainly. You’ve already been a big help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_Done_ki: I knew I could count on you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_Done_no: I gave it a shot, but I couldn’t find anything.
Don’t worry about it. You've done what really matters.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_Done_th: The Monolithians follow their preachers. When a hydra loses its head, it takes a little while for it to grow back. It’s gonna be easier for us now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_FirstMe: Thanks for coming to our aid, Skif! Just your luck, right? Every time you show up in Zalissya, the shit hits the fan. Last time it was the Ward, and now it’s Monolith.
Glad to see you’re still alive. There ain’t many of us left — everyone who didn’t run off and didn’t get killed is here. As you can tell, we could really use some extra hands.
How can I help out?
Our supplies are running thin. Warlock is working on it. You can discuss it with him. Lens’s injury is getting worse. But the biggest problem is defending Zalissya.
You didn’t know about his past? How did he end up as a guide here?
I didn’t have many options back then. He didn’t drink much, didn’t steal, kept a low profile. Had a clean reputation. No one remembered anything bad about him…
Now I understand why.
Remember our guide? We called him “Uncle Lyonya?”
He was a Monolithian all along. I couldn’t believe my eyes when I saw him leading their squad. A second later, he ordered them to open fire at us. That’s when I had to accept the truth.
Luckily, I know where the bastard is when he’s not out there killing his own comrades.
Tell me what happened here.
The Monolithians came to Zalissya. An entire army of them… I had no clue there were so many left. I tried to get a defense together, but I couldn’t do much with these rookies.
I took as many folks as I could to safety. Eventually, the fanatics moved on. But as you can see, some of them stuck around.
My stay in Zalissya will be short. I have to get to the Sphere.
You think they managed to hold their ground? I doubt it. I suggest you stock up on gear. Head over to Warlock; he’s still got some stuff left. In return, I’d like to ask a favor of you.
You want me to kill him?
That’s right. I’ll send you the coordinates. It’s the house where he used to meet newcomers to take them to Zalissya. The bastard…
Why didn’t you leave the area?
What’s the point? Trust an old-timer — once a Monolithian is on your tail, the only way to get rid of him is to kill him.
How do you know he’s hiding there?
I warned the other stalkers about him. Told them to hold him at gunpoint if he ever showed up again. They spotted the bastard and reached out to me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_SpeachE: There's still a lot to be done. We have to bury the dead, make a plan… we don’t have much time for small talk. But first, there’s something important I need to say.
Skif, you’re the only one who stepped up and came to our aid. Chances are, everyone here owes their lives to you.
No reward can truly express our gratitude, but still… thank you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_Speach_: Zalissya is safe now, and it's all thanks to you.
This place has been our home during times of peace and our refuge during times of peril. Even if it’s nothing more than a ruin now…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Batya_Zalyssa: To all stalkers — this is the end of Zalissya. Do not come here. The only thing you'll find here is death.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Bavaria_Waiti: I should’ve stayed home. Screw these adventures.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Bob_Speach_Za: If we can laugh, we can get through this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Dracula_First: There’s nothing scary about them. They’re flesh and blood, just like us. So much for the rumors.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_DrakulaInfo_1: You know what’s odd? These Monolith guys are supposed to be guarding the center of the Zone, right? But now they’re heading the other way…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Drakula_Speac: Don’t get all weepy on us now. We’ve got work to do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Farmacevt_Bui: Care to lend us a hand?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Farmacevt_Int: Nice shot on that fanatic up the hill.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Farmacevt_Wai: This is madness. Look for yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Farmacevt_You: Holy cow! Thanks a lot. Here’s some coupons for ya. They’re the last thing I need right now. Ha, I never thought I’d say that…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Hamster_InHub: I hope this hole holds up during the next Emission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Hamster_OnApp: The Gaffer needs your supplies, and you’re gonna hand them over.
That’s why I pay for security. You’re staring down the barrel of a gun, so I suggest you think very carefully about what you do next.
I tried to settle this without anyone getting shot.
Hey, you. How much is he paying you for security?
That’s a trade secret!
Why? You wanna offer me more, stalker?
Well, have it your way.
Now that we’re done here, have a good day, and remember to close the door on your way out.
You heard me right. This is for protecting the Gaffer’s house.
You bastard! What about our contract? The fucking mercenary code?! We had an agreement. I paid you an advance!
In times like these, the only code that matters is survival. Your greed is gonna get us both killed way before the Monolith shows up. You’re not a hamster, you’re a fucking rat.
It’s a deal.
This way I can at least help some decent folks. Especially if they’re willing to pay me more.
The Gaffer needs supplies. Can we work something out?
I’ve got security covered for another year. Plenty of food and gear too. You’ve got nothing to offer me!
Why aren’t you with the rest of the Zalissya stalkers?
They’re just pissing those fanatics off! Holed up in that house, shooting back, thinking my goods are gonna help them pull through... nah, I’ll pass. The two of us are better off here.
Keep it down! Who’s there?
Oh, it’s you. Apologies, but at the moment my trading assets are, let's say… frozen. But thanks for stopping by. Take care, and goodbye.
Not so fast.
Freeze! Don’t come any closer!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Hamster_Walki: Why did you have to get involved?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Inostranec_Bu: Get out of the line of fire!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Inostranec_Wa: If it weren’t for the Gaffer and Warlock, we’d be worm food by now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Koldun_AskAga: Can you remind me what you wanted me to bring again?
I’d rather have you convince him, if you can.
My gun. I handed it over to Lens for maintenance just before all of this started. It’s probably sitting on a shelf somewhere.
Hamster won’t share his supplies. He’s holed up in the Emission shelter, hoping to ride it out. That sounds like betrayal to me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Koldun_GunDon: I think this belongs to you.
You’re a peach! Here, take this. I’ll toss in some extra coupons when I get the chance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Koldun_Hamste: That was pretty extreme. But desperate times call for desperate measures.
I took care of your problem with Hamster.
I wanna know how you managed to persuade him!
I didn’t. I just paid his guard off.
And without his security, a huge rat becomes a scared little mouse! Pretty clever!
I talked to Hamster, but he wouldn’t give an inch.
It’s okay. No big surprise, really.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Koldun_Help_h: So what’s the deal with you and Hamster?
He’s a fucking rat. Hamster thinks he can ride this out with that guard of his and keep his stockpile of supplies. He’s living high on the hog while the rest of us are starving.
Gaffer may not see eye to eye with me, but if you ask me, not helping out in a situation like this is just as bad as pointing a gun at us.
Seems like you could use a hand.
I sure could. Gaffer and I are trying to turn this kindergarten into something that can actually stand up to those Monolithians.
Our plan is ambitious, but it won’t mean squat without some gear. And while I’m wrapped up in this mess, there are two other issues on my plate.
First, there’s Hamster. He’s holed up in the Emission shelter, hoarding supplies like they’re gold. Second, my precious gun is lost somewhere in the clutter at Lens’s workshop.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Koldun_Help_k: Sounds easy enough. So it’s all here in Zalissya?
If I sent you on some wild goose chase, I know you probably wouldn’t bother coming back, ha.
And what would I have you do out there, anyway? Make a run to the Slag Heap and back? Take on the Ward at the Pontoon Bridge?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Koldun_Help_w: What’s so special about your gun?
Well, I’ve had my baby since back when I went to Yantar with the Gaffer. She’s seen a lot.
Besides, when everyone else is lucky to get rusty old junk from Hamster’s stash, a good gun is worth its weight in gold.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Koldun_Speach: Let me tell you something, guys: Zalissya is more than a bunch of old shacks falling apart. Zalissya is all of you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Linza_Nicolai: Don’t disturb him. He needs rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Moloko_Speach: Don’t sweat it, Gaffer. We can rebuild everything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Moloko_Waitin: I’m good. I hope you are too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Nicolaic_Abou: The old boy took the brunt of the attack. When things went haywire, he held the workshop single-handed.
He caught three bullets and some shrapnel from a grenade. Somehow he was still conscious when we finally got there and pulled him out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Nicolaic_Arti: These are the instruments you were talking about?
That’s right, stalker! Thank you! You’ll have to talk to the Gaffer about your reward – I need to get Lens ready for surgery right away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Nicolaic_AskA: Where can I find the surgical instruments you need?
I gave you the coordinates for three of the Gaffer’s stashes. The instruments should be in one of them.
Please hurry. Lens doesn’t have much time left.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Nicolaic_Help: I don’t know how Lens is still alive, to be honest. The artifacts have been keeping him on life support, but he’s not going to last much longer.
He's gotta get surgery, but I was so fucking busy with the wonders of the Zone that I didn’t even notice someone stole my kit.
I've a spare stored in one of the Gaffer’s stashes for a rainy day, though. Well, that rainy day is here, but everyone’s too busy to help.
If I come across your instruments, I’ll grab them.
I’ll give you the coordinates of three stashes. One of them should have my package.
Please don’t take too long. Lens is strong, but without surgery... wouldn't expect any miracles.
Got any idea who swiped your kit?
No clue. Not everyone was eager to be a hero when the Monolithians showed up.
So if you try to hunt down the thief among the dozens of refugees, you might run out of time to save Lens.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Nikolaich_Spe: When did you get so sentimental, Warlock?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_ObshakFluff_1: It’s for everyone. If you need it, go ahead and take some. If not, just leave it here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Rikoset_InHub: I made the right call. This place gives us a better shot at holding out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Slava_Speach_: Those fuckers will never take Zalissya!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_SovenokInfo_1: We’re holding our ground. Warlock got a message from Duty. They said they were ready for this. They’re defending the Slag Heap. Once things settle down, I’ll try to break through and join them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Sovenok_First: I’ve only been in the Zone for a week. Funny, right? I haven’t even had a chance to go artifact hunting yet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Sovenok_Speac: I made it… against all odds. And it’s all thanks to each and every one of you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_Dialog_Speach_Zalyss: Zalissya is no more. We’ve lost…
What the hell are you talking about, Gaffer?!
Take a good look around you, Warlock. We’ve lost too many people.
Exactly! And for what? So you can huddle up in the corner and cry over their sorry fate? We have to rebuild Zalissya for them!
Damn it, Warlock… you’re right. We’ll rebuild Zalissya. And this time, we’ll teach them better. We’ll protect them better.
Thank you, Skif. You’re the only one who came to our aid. No reward can truly express our gratitude, but still…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_ales_bavaria_0_Defea: Ouch! Lend me a medkit, guys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_ales_bavaria_0_InfoT: Warlock says Duty is finally doing its job: fighting the worst monsters in the Zone. I tend to agree with him. Mutants are nowhere near as terrifying as those fanatics…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_bata_0_HelloTopic_1_: Never trust silence. The Monolithians can remain completely still for hours. You won’t even realize they’re there until it’s too late.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_drakula_0_DefeatComm: It’s getting hot over here! I need a medkit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_drakula_0_HelloTopic: You're looking a little pale. So what do you want?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_drakula_0_InfoTopic_: I came to the Zone to look for artifacts, but it seems like all I’ve been doing lately is digging graves.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_inostranec_bob_0_Inf: After the Signal, Gaffer got a whole lot stricter. He’s pushing us real hard, but we gotta stay tough. What choice do we have? We’ve had to bury so many people already…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_moloko_0_InfoTopic_1: I used to take it personally when the Gaffer or Warlock lectured me. I thought I was the smartass. Until I saw a Monolithian’s blank stare for the first time.
Now I’m always gonna listen to what the old-timers have to say — they’ve already defeated that plague once.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_rikoset_0_DefeatComm: Hey! Patch me up, would ya?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_rikoset_0_InfoTopic_: As I’ve always said, the Ward is a joke. Strutting around in polished boots and pushing newbies around is one thing, but facing real killers is a whole different story.
Have you noticed how all those pompous assholes disappeared the moment the Monolith came back?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_slava_farmacevt_0_De: I’m hit! Toss me some meds!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_slava_farmacevt_0_In: You learn fast to be cautious around those fanatics. If they get you, it’s game over, man. No bribes, no talking your way out of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_sovenok_0_InfoTopic_: I haven’t been artifact hunting once. I’m busy doing something way more important right now: helping the Gaffer and the crew rebuild Zalissya. I can always go after artifacts later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E07_SQ01_sovenok_0_ResumeComm: Hold on, stalker. Let me finish my thought.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_Bossfight_Faust_Comment_P: Hear the Voice of the Monolith!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_ChernyhFirst: Shhh... Don't scare this beast off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_NearDuty_flu: Son of a bitch! It ain’t coming out!
Watch out. This one’s a sneaky little prick.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_RomaniukIfKi: Thanks for helping us get rid of that thing, loner. It took down too many of my guys.
At least Somov’s still standing. He’s a rookie — this was his first run.
So much for purging the Zone of mutants… but it’s okay, we’ll manage. Best of luck to you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_RomaniukIfSh: What the fuck is wrong with you, loner?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_RomaniukIfSo: They’re all gone. My entire squad. All because of a fucking mutant… because of the Zone.
At least we made that mutant pay. Thank you, stalker.
How am I supposed to keep serving now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_SomovIfRoman: There were four of us in the squad, and now it’s just me. I had a bad feeling before this mission, but how was I supposed to tell the sergeant that?
And now I’ve got nobody to tell nothing…
Thanks for the help. I couldn’t have taken that thing down on my own.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_SomovIfRunAw: Where are you going? Help us!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_SomovSendsSk: Can’t talk right now. Talk to Sarge.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_SomovThanksF: The beast is finally down! Now we can head back to the base with a clear conscience.
Told you if we lured it out, we could handle it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Comment_SomovWhenCat: Thank you, stalker! When that thing attacked, I thought I was a dead man!
Now we can head back to base. It’s too bad there’s only two of us left…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_Dialog_RomaniukAsksT: Hey, stalker. Can you do us a favor? We need your help dealing with a mutant, all right? The damn thing wiped out half my squad. Now it’s hiding and won’t come out.
It’s a crafty little bugger. Probably escaped from some kinda lab. Got a collar around its neck, can you believe it? A metal one. Looks pretty sturdy.
If we take the mutant down, the collar’s all yours. I ain’t claimin' it. You could make a tidy profit selling it to some scientist. So, you in?
You try to flush out the mutant. We got your back.
I’m too busy at the moment.
Guess we’ll have to take care of it on our own. Step aside, then.
Get ready, Somov. On my mark.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_radovoj_somov_0_ByeT: Well, break a leg. That's what they say, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_radovoj_somov_0_Hell: Sure, let’s talk before the mutants show up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_radovoj_somov_0_Info: This thing we do... it ain't what I thought it would be. I’m out there killing mutants, but there’s no thrill in it. Just waiting for my next orders. Where's the fun in that?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_serzant_romaniuk_0_C: Hey, loner! Come over here. We need some help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_serzant_romaniuk_0_H: To what do I owe the pleasure?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_serzant_romaniuk_0_I: Every critter here requires a unique approach. Some have a great sense of smell; others, acute hearing. And some just have this gut feeling you can’t explain. You gotta develop that sixth sense on your own, I reckon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ01_serzant_romaniuk_0_R: Let’s wrap this chat up and go about our business.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_Comment_HuntersAbout: Those scientists are fucking nuts, man. Putting a collar on a freak like that!
Keep it down. They’re footing the bill.
I’d love to meet the owner of this little pet. He’s gotta be off his damn rocker.
Stay alert. Maybe we’ll get that chance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_Comment_SanchezInter: The Zone has its fair share of weirdness, but mutants wearing collars... that's a new one!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_Comment_SanchezMamai: No one’s getting hurt… until Dorozhnyuk catches wind of it!
Catches wind of what, exactly? That I took out a mutant that was getting in the way of their research? And saved on her precious budget to boot?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_Comment_SherbaCoordi: Stalker, can you hear me? The coordinates to one of the collars have changed. I’m sending them to you before that thing wanders off again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_Dialog_HuntersTrade_: Looks like you found a collar. I need it.
Turns out you were right, Mamay — that critter does have an owner! He looks kinda normal, though…
Yeah. Listen, stalker... my men and I are under contract to kill a mutant. The job's from Malachite.
We did the job, and that collar’s our ticket to getting paid. Without it, we’re shit out of luck.
Unless you’re willing to pay us more... there are two things I don't like: conflict, and making long trips to see women who are playing hard to get.
No offense, stalker, but we don’t like strangers here.
Give me that collar, or you’ll regret it.
And I was just about to take a break…
I don’t like you poking around here. Have you figured out what you want yet?
All right, I’ll buy it. Even though it’s a fucking rip-off.
And no one’s getting hurt. I’ve come to appreciate that in my time in the Zone.
I don't need anything from you.
I was just passing by. You can keep the collar.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_Dialog_TradeAgain_de: Look, why don’t you make up your mind already? You need the collar, or what?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_sanchez_0_ByeTopic_1: Watch your back around the scientists. They’re all nuts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_sanchez_0_InfoTopic_: Scientists are the biggest weirdos in the Zone. First they create mutants, one scarier than the next, and now they hire us to kill them. I mean, it’s good for business, sure, but what the actual hell?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_sanchez_0_ResumeComm: You wanna talk some more? Sure…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_zheka_mamai_0_ByeTop: Not the worst conversation I’ve had in my life.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_zheka_mamai_0_Defeat: Fuck! I was already sore all over!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_zheka_mamai_0_HelloT: Sure, we can chat. No rush.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_zheka_mamai_0_InfoTo: I'm thinking about joining Malachite security when I retire. They’ve got a real samovar there. Plenty of hot tea. And other things, too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_EQ03_zheka_mamai_0_Resume: All right now. Where were we?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Audiolog_DesatovActi: To all junior research staff: always verify that the emergency safety system is disengaged before activating the equipment!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Audiolog_DesatovSums: My initial hypothesis is confirmed: the psi-influence within the ranges in which we operate at the Center doesn’t entirely cease even after a complete shutdown.
We’ll continue with the experiments on induced illusions, but all participants will receive specialized recovery medications from now on.
Moreover, we’re developing an emergency security system to shut down the station if the psi-influence within its range exceeds acceptable levels.
Professor Razumovsky has been transferred to the Mainland and won’t be participating in further research at this facility. I’m hopeful for his eventual recovery.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Audiolog_DesatovTuni: I can see that everyone here is too busy to read manuals, so listen up! To establish connection with objects in the X-Network you need to follow several steps.
Firstly, connect the station to the power source and ensure access to the X-Network. Secondly, clear the rails of any obstructions to facilitate movement.
Use the main console to initiate and stabilize connection. And closely monitor movement along rails to mitigate potential emergencies.
Once a connection has been established, save the data in the appropriate archive section based on its category. Nothing too complicated!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Audiolog_Razumovskij: We’ve got a real breakthrough here! We've gone from incoherent noises, grainy visuals, and flitting shadows to a repeatable illusion – clear and vivid!
We’ve finally determined the range at which psi-effects can produce distinct induced illusions!
They’re still lacking specific details and features for now, but we can already create projections of both physical objects and images borne from the human subconscious.
I saw Desyatov yesterday. Dead. Ghastly and decomposing — as he walked around the corner. He passed me by, with a blank stare, didn't even look at me.
Then the next morning he strolled past me again, alive and well, and greeted me as if nothing had happened. Not a trace of decay. I checked the Center. It’s powered down. It was off yesterday too.
What does this imply? Do these illusions continue after the VPC is shut down? Have we made them too tangible? Or perhaps the issue lies with me, and I’m seeing things that don’t exist?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_GuardsMeetSp: It’s been a while. Is that new wallpaper? Where’s Ozersky, Sarge?
He did. All right, take it easy. We’ll find the professor ourselves.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_LoudspeakerA: Attention! A malfunction occurred during the launch of the Mirror. Clear the rails of any foreign objects immediately.
Attention! The launch of the Mirror was successful. All research personnel, please proceed to your seats.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_MercenariesF: Raspy, we’re on our way. Gimme a sitrep!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_MercenariesS: Raspy’s gone dark. Do we head in, or wait a little longer?
Just hold on. We’ve got a little time left.
Why does he always want to play the fucking scout? Strelok warned us against going in alone!
Once he gets back, we gotta remind him about how the customer's always right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_RichterAfter: How was your hunt? Did you get that collar?
I’ve got some business nearby. Swing by my coordinates, and we’ll have a chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_RichterGoWit: Well, here we are. And yet nothing’s happened. Nothing at all. Feels kinda… off.
Sorry I can’t join in on the hunt. I’ve got a bad feeling about this, Skif. I’ll end up missing the target and hitting you, or something like that.
I’ll just hang back here. It's better for both of us, really.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_RichterGoodJ: I heard you did it! Drop by, and I’ll tell you where to find Dvupalov.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_RichterInter: You go ahead. I’ll wait here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Comment_SparkMeetsSc: Howdy, eggheads. Care to tell me where Ozersky is?
Young man, I’d like to ask you…
Nah, don’t bother. Just get Ozersky for us, all right?
Tell him we've got an appointment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Dialog_OzerskijGives: Fortunately, the X-Network is up and running again. There’s an abandoned Mirror facility nearby. It was used to study induced illusions until 2008.
If you can restart it and reconnect the Mirror to Malachite, I could look for the information you need.
I got them after the Signal. They’re saved on this flash drive.
Oh, that makes it so much easier! However, analyzing these archives will require a considerable amount of time, and I take it you need answers as soon as possible.
Yes?
I want to know more about induced illusions.
I’m looking for information about the phantoms.
A Monolithian called Faust conjured doubles of himself during a fight. I want to know how this is possible.
And I want to never have to hear about this subject again... but I suppose you’re luckier than I am.
The doubles you witnessed are induced illusions caused by psi-influence within the tau range. This Faust fellow appears to be employing older C-Consciousness technology.
C-Consciousness were the ones who extensively researched induced illusions and their impact on humans. Have you heard about the Wish Granter? That’s their handiwork.
I’m not entirely sure we still have any books with enough information here at the Center. The SIRCAA archives would be come in handy here.
Malachite doesn't have any files on this research, but I know of a place where you might be able to find them.
What exactly do I need to do?
Two things: activate the Visual Projection Center and calibrate the communication antenna.
Mind you, configuring the antenna might require specific conditions. The older the equipment, the harder it is to set it up properly.
I advise you to find an operations manual for the facility’s engineering team and follow its guidelines to the letter. Talk to you later.
Where can I meet the C-Consciousness scientists? I need to learn more about their technology.
You’re a few years too late. C-Consciousness ceased to exist in 2012 following the demise of all of its members.
A stalker who goes by Strelok managed to reach the Generators after deactivating the Wish Granter. Then he gunned down C-Consciousness.
Evidently, he didn’t take kindly to being used as a guinea pig.
C-Consciousness? That rings a bell.
It was a faction of idealistic scientists from Project X. They aspired to cleanse the Noosphere of the dark manifestations of human nature. To make the world perfect.
However noble their intentions may have been, their execution was rather poor. In June 2006, a decade after the discovery of the Noosphere, they tried to establish an unauthorized connection to it.
The experiment spiraled out of control, leading to the emergence of the Zone. It now serves as a warning about the perils of impulsive scientific endeavors.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Dialog_OzerskijSends: Thank you for establishing a secure connection. I was able to retrieve the information you requested.
The Controller Project was responsible for the creation of phantoms as part of its research into induced illusions. However, all related data is highly classified and never went public.
Fortunately, we have a list of the scientists involved in the project. If any of them are alive and in the Zone, you may be able to get your information straight from the horse's mouth, as it were.
Do you know anyone on that list?
Regrettably, no. But I know someone who could assist you.
This Richter guy’s all over the place. Seems to know everyone in the Zone. Where do you know him from?
I wouldn’t recommend someone unless I was certain of their competence. Richter knows his way around the Zone. If anyone from this list is still here, he’ll track them down for you.
Richter. He used to be a guide, but now his work mostly revolves around finding people. He’s just the man you need.
If not for him, Scar and I wouldn’t be working together right now. I was interested in meeting him, and Richter arranged it.
He worked with Malachite as a guide for quite a long time. An exceptionally bright young man.
Do you know where can I find Richter?
When he’s not busy with his clients, he usually frequents the 100 Rads Bar in Rostok. Try looking for him there.
You can ask our guide. He’ll help you find your way there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Dialog_RichterDvupal: Is there anything else I need to know?
Collars aside, Dvupalov’s only been working on one project lately: vodka. Making it and drinking it.
If he offers you a drink, don’t turn it down. Or you won’t get any business done. But don’t try to outdrink him either, or you might find yourself beyond medical help.
Even if I don’t hurt anyone, I’m still a long way from becoming a true guide.
Thanks for the tip. I gotta go.
How does someone become a true guide? What does it take?
The Guide who used to help Strelok shared something with me once.
If you manage to find the rarest artifact, the Heart of Chornobyl, you can learn to understand the Zone as though you were one with it.
Where do I find this Heart of Chornobyl?
The Guide said it’s supposed to be in the Dead Valley. But that’s no place for regular folks. You’d need gear that hasn’t been invented yet — or have the abilities of the Guide himself.
Scar keeps saying only a miracle can help me, but I’m beginning to question whether we’ve got the same kinds of miracles in mind…
Your bad luck seems to be over. Are you gonna guide people again?
We’ll see about that. It’s too risky to rely on a single success.
Are you planning to guide people again, or have you given up on it completely?
I’m not sure, Skif. The risk is too great.
Looks like you made it and got the collar, so you’re good to go to Dvupalov. I’ve tagged the location of his hideout for you. You should be able to get there just fine.
If he asks you for a password, just say “the leash.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_Dialog_RichterReadsL: He doesn't trust or cooperate with anyone. Can you really blame him?
Speaking of which... do you know anyone on this list?
What’s Strelok up to? What’s his plan?
That’s something you gotta ask the man himself. And if he doesn’t trust you enough, you’ll never find out. Strelok is the type who keeps his plans to himself.
I need to find some people. Ozersky mentioned you might be able to help me with that.
You seem pretty popular yourself. Are you some kind of recruiter? Bringing folks to Strider, mingling with scientists, cozying up to Scar…
And you keep popping up wherever I go, too.
You’re making some friends, I see. Ozersky’s a man with a heart of gold – when he’s not being a pain in the ass, anyway.
Then just tell me where to look for those mutants.
I’ll forward you the coordinates of a couple of spots. Choose whichever one you like.
Is this the type of collar Dvupalov collects?
Whoa! You’ve certainly been around the Zone if you've managed to find one. You’re shaping up to be quite the stalker!
Now that you have the collar, you’re good to head to Dvupalov’s hideout. I’ll send you the coordinates. If he asks you for a password, the answer is “leash.”
Remember, if the professor offers you a drink, don’t turn it down. It’ll make the conversation smoother. But don’t try to outdrink him either. You won’t stand a chance.
How can I find this Strelok guy?
Uh, nah. I might’ve said too much already. Either the Zone’s gonna help you, or Strelok will find you himself. But I don't think you two would hit it off right now.
But keep in mind that Dvupalov’s been collecting these collars for a while now. The less dangerous mutants are all gone – only the nasty ones are still out there. So be careful.
Must be the Zone’s will! Nah, there’s plenty of recruiters here without me. By the way, there’s that stalker who showed up after the Signal, Strelok. Ever heard of him? He’s a legend around here!
