I hear he’s putting together a new crew. He doesn’t like what’s going on in the Zone, and he wants to shake things up.
I know one of them: Dvupalov. He’s a real grump when he’s sober, which, thankfully, isn’t often. He’s usually holed up in his old hideout and doesn’t entertain visitors.
If you want to talk to him, you’ll need to bring him a collar from a mutant. He used to do some research with the collars, and now he just collects them. Talk about sentimental!
Do you know where I can find mutants with those collars?
Sure. I’ll even share the coordinates.
There are no trustworthy people in the Zone — Strelok’s got that right. Looking for allies is a waste of time.
As long as you and Scar keep looking for the Shining Zone, you’d better stay away from Strelok.
Remember when you led me out of those anomalies when we first met? You saved my life that time. Let’s try it again.
I… hadn’t looked at it that way before.
All right. Let’s give it a shot. I just hope neither of us regrets it.
Can you take me to a place where I can hunt some mutants in collars?
You know I don’t guide anymore – not after I got Joker and Barge killed. I don’t want anyone else to trust me and end up getting hurt.
He wouldn’t appreciate you being chummy with the Ward and trying to make the Zone disappear.
What happened to his old crew?
I could tell you they found lots of rare artifacts, left for the Mainland, and lived happily ever after. But in reality, not everyone made it back from their trip to the Monolith.
I’ve found folks in the Zone I can trust. Strelok just needs to try harder.
You're asking the wrong guy. I’ve found folks I can team up with. I wouldn’t last long without them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_marat_vitaz_0_InfoTo: Maybe the mutants are so angry because we won't leave them alone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_marat_vitaz_0_Resume: What were we talking about again?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_nikita_uragan_0_Busy: I’ll talk to you later, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_nikita_uragan_0_Defe: I need a hand here! Gimme a medkit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_nikita_uragan_0_Hell: Well, who do we have here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_nikita_uragan_0_Info: Heard there was some trouble at SIRCAA. Looks like the Zone has forced those eggheads out of their ivory tower.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_nikita_uragan_0_Resu: I lost my train of thought there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_professor_sulgin_0_D: No! It can't be happening! Help!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_professor_sulgin_0_I: Some guests at our Center could do with a bit more courtesy. And Professor Ozersky should be more careful about who he invites to Malachite.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_professor_sulgin_0_R: I lost my train of thought there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ01_serzant_svak_0_InfoT: This Center is turning into a flea market. Those scientists gotta make up their mind whether they want security or if they’re cool with every artifact-toting creep strolling in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Audilolog_ChubkoAbou: Have you seen the reports? Faust is a work of art! It’s a shame Dvupalov won’t get to appreciate it.
From what I’ve observed, he’s more than a work of art. He hasn't ceased to amaze us since he was connected to the Monolith network.
Faust opts to encourage the fighters, to inspire them, rather than relying on his Controller abilities.
Yes, you make a good point. Remind me... where are the blueprints for the Suppressor?
He’s not just a soldier, he’s a general!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Audilolog_DvupalovTe: You’re having trouble sleeping too, I see. Let’s get started early today.
We’re going to explore how your brain responds to metaphors and imagery. Empathy and abstract thinking — those are the traits that separate us from simple beasts.
And they're what separates you from the other mutants... in theory, at least.
I rummaged through my library and came across something that suits our circumstances perfectly. I hope you won’t mind a little poetry.
Not backwards, forwards is the spirit’s sight; This moment now, alone — is our delight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_AudiologWarning_audi: Any documents in the control room should be off limits to lab assistants.
Last week someone took the Suppressor manual yet again, jeopardizing a scheduled experiment!
This is not the first case of negligent handling of crucial Project X documentation. This matter needs to be addressed at once.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Audiolog_MutantsHowl: I don’t understand. I need a visual examination.
No time for that. I have to figure out what went wrong. Strap him down. Scalpel, quick.
Nothing. Once again, nothing. All right. Get someone to clean up this mess.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Audiolog_StrelokX5_1: My head… fuck. Can’t let history repeat itself.
You’re Strelok. You used to work at SIRCAA, but you quit and tried to sabotage X11. You failed.
Escape to the Mainland. Go into hiding.
Then come back and make sure those bastards can’t complete Project X.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_ConnectionFa: Attention, all staff! Communication with C-Consciousness has been interrupted.
System error. Forced reboot in thirty seconds.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_DvupalovSher: Son of a bitch! Where did you find that key?! Can’t you just move on? When are you going to let it go, huh?
I was worried! Haven't you been following the news? The Zone’s going to hell!
All news has been the same since the Garden of Eden! After that, it’s just humanity repeating itself… hic!
You’re sloshed again, Professor. What about science?
It's pointless! Ever since they invented alcohol distillation.
Quit bugging me, you mopey oaf!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Aft: I helped you find the Suppressor. What more do you want? Let a man enjoy his oblivion in peace.
Off you go, soldier. You’ve got your own little war to fight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Art: What are you waiting for? We’ve got an artifact on the run!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_BeC: Ah, good! There it is, my blissful point of extremum! Here comes oblivion!
You whippersnappers should stay away from all this. Nothing good ever comes of it... hic! And never will.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Cat: The artifact just popped out of the still! Grab it, stalker!
Fuck! Where are you off to?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Dru: Piss off, Sherpa… to the Red Forest with ya…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Foo: What the hell are you doing? No snacks till the third shot! You’ll ruin the experience.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Fou: It’s an elixir you’ll either never forget… or remember!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Giv: If you only got one, don’t expect a big payout.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Hur: Where are your manners? Where do you think you’re going, stalker?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Int: I’m… at the point of… excremum.
Hold on. Lemme give you the key to X5 first.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Map: The collars were a crude instrument. The Suppressors, on the other hand… they were designed to… hic! dampen abilities of a finer nature.
Now, where did I put it…
No, that’s just some junk… Ah, look! A pickle! I’ll save it for later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_NoV: You couldn’t find it? Bottles tend to vanish into thin air around here. Must be yet another one of the Zone’s little wonders. Come on, take a seat. I’ve got a spare one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Dvupalov_Wai: I’m starting to sober up, and when I’m sober, I tend to do things I regret later, might just as well tell you to fuck off. Go get that vodka, stalker, and then we can chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Sherba_Found: Thanks for those papers! They’re a treasure worth all the years I spent at Malachite. We’ll stay in touch. I’ve got grand plans for the future!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_Sherba_NoDoc: The only thing I can do now is to keep pestering Dvupalov, hoping that one day he’ll snap out of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Comment_SkifCaughtAr: Whoa, you’re light on your feet, stalker. You can hang on to this one. You’ve earned it! You went after that artifact like a bullet from a gun!
Seems like I gave the key card for X5 to Shcherba after all. That’s why I hate teetotalers! The bastard must’ve caught me in a good mood…
Anyway, if you want the Suppressor, you need to talk to that boring grad student yourself. He’s over in Ahroprom, staying close to X5. And now for the fourth shot – the happiest of them all!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_DvupalovSherb: The stalker! He’s back! Those papers I mentioned… Do you have them?
Where are your manners, young man?! You won’t even offer a man a seat and pour him a cold one?
There’s nothing exciting in there anyhow. I’ve told you before, young man – if even my own work can end in failure–
Faust wasn’t exactly… a failure. In a way.
Haven’t you heard? He tapped into the X-Network, brought the Monolith back, and caused a bloodbath all over the Zone.
So he’s… your project?! The abilities you incor—
Shut up!
I knew I was right all along. So that bunch of old farts in pods haven’t given up on my research. Hooking him up to the Monolith was a stroke of genius…
And I told them that the only way to create a true Controller is to preserve his capacity to think, to feel, and make decisions!
Sure, right now the choices he’s making don’t align with what the Ward, the MDST, or anyone else had in mind… but I did succeed!
You’re as much of a fool as I am if you think you can set things right. The Controller Project was abandoned, and yet Faust endures. Monolith disappeared, and now it has returned.
Go ahead and kill Faust, stalker. It won’t change a thing. You'll see.
Here. I don’t want to be anywhere near these things.
This is… Yes, this is it! At last!
Who is Faust now? What have you turned him into?
We granted him the abilities of a Controller mutant, but I’m convinced that Faust has retained his humanity.
See, there’s no more Project X, no C-Consciousness, no MDST to protect. He wasn’t being directed by a program; he initiated this of his own free will.
I believe the Monolith became an idea to him. Give a man an idea he can grasp, and he’ll do much more than he would ever do coerced. I’ve always said that it works better than any leash.
I found the Suppressor. Can you install it?
Oh, right. I almost forgot the reason you’re here.
All the work I did... It’s all become meaningless. You’re going to kill Faust.
The MDST? What’s that?
The scientists from Project X, who, unlike me, were eager to continue their research even after it was officially shut down. It appears they were the ones who made the Controller Project a reality.
Officially, they had no funding or approval to proceed. However, C-Consciousness wasn’t content with merely creating the Zone; they were determined to safeguard their pitiful existence.
That’s why they needed the Monolith – and, later on, Faust and his abilities.
I couldn’t find them.
I gave you the only key card, and you squandered this treasure so wantonly!
A lot of people died because of him.
Were they good people? Well, then find other good people to install the Suppressor. I’m not a technician.
A lot of good soldiers died because of him.
Soldiers killing other soldiers... It’s a tale as old as time. Why should I care? I’ve provided you with a weapon to use against Faust – it’s up to you to find someone to install it.
Why did you create Faust?
The mutants turned out to be far too unpredictable, useless, and downright dangerous. The aim was to mold them into obedient soldiers.
The Leash had some success with more primitive tools, but I believed we were on the wrong path. The error, I thought, lay in the very design of the Controllers.
Without consciousness and human empathy, their psi-abilities were pitiful. Faust demonstrated this vividly. But masterful tools necessitate much more precise fine-tuning.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_Dvupalov_Deli: Ouch. Ouch!
Ouch. Not even a flinch, huh? That sort of bravado isn’t gonna impress me. When you’re drinking, you’ve gotta put your heart into it.
So, where were we? How about another one?
So why did you collect those collars, anyway?
They’re the only thing I have left to remind me of all my futile scientific endeavors.
Sentimentality… a quirk of human nature. Who can really say? Anyway, here’s to leaving sentimentality behind.
I’m not interested in vodka.
A man with no interest in vodka is a man with no interest in life itself. What motivates him then? How can you trust him? And, most importantly, why share a drink with him?
All right. Here’s to our partnership.
Let’s toss another one back.
You’re definitely not a grad student. That’s a good thing.
Okay. Bottoms up, Professor.
I see you’re a man of ambition. Great aspirations, I’d even say. Outdrinking me, for one!
Let’s have another one, sure.
To abstract thinking!
All right, but this is the last one.
Bold words from a young man like you.
Here’s to science making things better, not worse.
Here, here!

That’s what I like about you. Maybe I’d like Shcherba too if he could drink like a man. But he just comes in, asks questions, and fumbles around. What am I supposed to talk to someone like that about?
Let’s take you, for instance. What do you want to talk about?
Look, about those collars… Leave them out next time. The shop’s closed. What’s the point of stocking up on collars if I don’t have a leash?
It was a promising project, sure… but it’s time to bid it farewell. Bottoms up, stalker.
How do you destroy phantoms and defeat someone who can create induced illusions?
Seeing double, eh? You probably just had some bad vodka. Try some of mine – it’s good for more than just keeping radiation at bay.
When I saw the man who created those phantoms, I was stone-cold sober.
Ha ha ha! And I was stone-cold sober when I saw evidence that it was impossible. But who am I to forbid you from living in a world of illusions?
If you’re really so eager, drag your ass to X5. That’s where the whole three-ring circus used to be. Try to find the blueprint for the Suppressor – it ought to help you.
I’m all out of vodka anyway. Come on, I’ll give you the key card for the lab.
You used to work with phantoms. Tell me about the ability to create them.
I used to work on lots of things! Including that one, yeah.
What can I say? It didn’t pan out. Turns out, not a single subject was capable of controlling even a paltry ability like this.
I’m interested in a different project: the Controller. You were part of it.
The last thing I need is another Shcherba pestering me! That grad student is obsessed with the subject. The idea of blissful ignorance is utterly beyond him.
That means I could use another drink. After the third shot of my elixir, even the most hopeless souls can start to grasp the basics of abstract thinking.
Then we can talk for real. So, what do you say? You down for a few more drinks, or maybe just one for the road?
Skip the vodka. I want to talk about the Controller Project. Your name’s on the staff list.
You, too? Was it that… Shill? Schmuck? Sherpa? Whatever his name is… Did he send you? He’s a real pain in the ass – bought a bottle of vodka and didn’t even touch it.
As for my biggest project – it’s right here in this glass.
Bottoms up, stalker. To science, to partnership, to whatever floats your boat.
What project are you talking about?
I told ya – Project Leash! The mutant control project. They cooked up all sorts of freaks, then tried to make gadgets to boss them around – and zap them remotely if things get out of hand.
As you know, they fucked up the latter part. When the project got shelved, those collared mutants were supposed to die peacefully in their cages, not run amok in the Zone spooking stalkers.
So much for a promising project. But I suppose promises are made to be broken. How about a drink to that, stalker?
You’re the first Project X scientist I’ve met who’s still alive. I’m curious to hear about it firsthand.
Believe me, those men of great learning would rather not have my tongue tarnish their legacy, so I’m more than willing to do exactly that!
Here’s the scoop: Project X was a bunch of charlatans, and I was the most shameless one of them all. How’s that for a revelation?
If man is the measure of all things, then the measure of a man is three shots of this magic vodka. So go ahead, ask your questions while I’m feeling charitable.
All right. Let’s sample the goods.
Let’s have one, and then we can talk about the what, the where, and the how much.
Here’s to the start of our partnership!
What was the purpose of the Controller Project?
Producing one failure after another. No, really, the project was meant to put the abilities of mutants to good use.
But can we truly blame mindless creatures for their actions?
Those in charge should’ve known right from the start that nothing could be changed. When you try to fix someone else’s mistakes, you only end up making new ones.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_Dvupalov_Firs: Hand it over. You’re new around here, aren’t you? Or have I just forgotten you?
I had an assistant I’ll never forget, Nightingale. He was a delight to work with and a great drinking buddy. It's a shame he’s gone. Think you can fill his shoes?
I wasn’t planning to. I’m here about—
I know what you're here about. The first one’s on the house, but we’ll enjoy it right here on the spot. You can fetch the bottle from my lab.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_HimzavodTechn: I was informed that Korshunov gave the go-ahead. Come on quickly.
What is it, stalker? I’ve got enough on my plate as it is.
I need a special upgrade for my suit.
Can’t you see what’s going on? I won't lift a finger without Korshunov’s say-so. He’s in the infirmary at the moment. Maybe you can work something out with him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_IvaylovIntera: We’ve got more than enough problems to deal with, so I won’t be helping a stalker without direct approval from Colonel Korshunov.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_KorshunovInHo: Why? Please, don’t! What’s going on? Tell me!
Shut up. For once in your damn life, just shut the fuck up. Class 5 psi-protection, you little shit? My soldiers’ blood is on your hands!
I… I had no idea. I swear, Colonel, if…
Shut. Your. Mouth. What've you got, Skif?
Ozersky wanted me to get the Mirror facility online. It could be important.
I need to see Ozersky, Colonel. I have to talk to him in person. You can trust…
You’ll go with my men. Now get out of here.
I know how to take Faust down. But I’ll need some help from a tech.
You’ll have all the help and equipment you need. Get it done, stalker. I know you can.
What’s the deal with the Promin factory?
We’ve found a depleted Emitter, Colonel.
Get to Malachite on the double. Find out what’s going on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_KorshunovInte: How many more men do I have to lose while we’re here shooting the shit?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_KrivenkoAbout: The colonel could use some rest. Let’s not disturb him.
What’s the deal with the colonel’s psi-protection?
To put it simply, it’s an immunity to any kind of psi-exposure. That means that the colonel can withstand the direct effects of an Emission for a brief period even without protection.
How did you come up with class 5 psi-protection?
I suppose there’s no point in hiding it now. In the psi-medicine lab, we routinely detoxified the soldiers to counteract the Zone’s harmful influences, such as radiation and chemical poisoning.
At the same time, we assessed their thresholds of tolerance to directed psi-radiation, gradually increasing the exposure.
Regrettably, not all soldiers could tolerate even minor doses well enough. In fact, only Colonel Korshunov was able to adapt to it.
How bad is the colonel’s injury?
His spine has sustained significant damage. The chances of him walking again are pretty slim, but we’re utilizing all the Institute’s know-how to aid him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_Sherba_AboutX: Hand me that key card, and I’ll see what I can do about your papers.
All right. It’s not like I’ve got much of a choice.
But keep those papers in mind, stalker. You’ll need to head all the way down, but if you’re willing to do the job, I’ll make it worth your while.
I’ll go check on the professor in the meantime. Seems like every time I look away, he’s got a new drinking buddy.
Why do you want those papers?
I tried to convince Professor Dvupalov that I’m a worthy successor to his great work, but all I received from him was a couple of his drafts. One of which had been used as… a food wrapper.
I’m talking about research that could etch our names into history! Since the professor doesn’t seem to recognize it, I’ll take it upon myself to finish the job for him.
Why do you even bother helping Dvupalov?
How can I stand by and watch a scientist of his caliber kill the few brain cells he has left?!
He has invaluable knowledge and skills – the kind that are not taught at Malachite. Especially nowadays…
The professor has no right to go down this path!
Tell me about Dvupalov. So he’s a great scientist?
Professor Dvupalov is a brilliant mind hailing from the Project X era, the mastermind behind the Controller Project. He used to bring science to new heights!
Now the only thing he can bring is a glass toward his lips. He’s disenchanted with his life’s work, you see. Nothing ever changes!
If only the professor had taken a moment to peruse my notes instead of selling vodka…
Dvupalov sent me to get the key card for X5. I’m looking for the Phantom Suppressor.
It took Dvupalov a whole six months just to remember my name while I served him food every day, and now he tells you about the card right away? Did you drink with him or something?!
It’s tough to avoid having a drink with him.
That stuff is pure poison!

All right, I’ll give you the card. It’s too risky for me in there anyway. But you’ve got to promise me that you’ll search X5 for any papers related to the Controller Project and bring them back to me.
Tell me what you know about the Controller Project.
The Controller Project did involve some research on phantoms, but its main objective was to develop specimens modified with both biological and technological enhancements.
Unlike their mutant predecessors, which were impossible to keep in their cages, these were meant to be trained as soldiers to protect Project X personnel.
Can you imagine? Not even SIRCAA is attempting anything like that nowadays. They haven't even managed to create a single new specimen.
I ask you to vacate the premises! I’m occupying it, and… there’s nothing here to take.
Calm down, Shcherba. Dvupalov sent me.
Is the professor doing okay? He didn’t succumb to intoxication from that poison of his, did he? Its alcohol by volume is nearing pure ethanol, not to mention the anomalous component.
What a fall from grace… A great scientist, resorting to making vodka!
Since I'm headed to X5, tell me about the lab.
Until recently, no one even knew it existed. The research there was classified, and the lab had been mothballed for quite some time.
Then Duty did some cleanup with heavy explosives there and found hidden levels beneath Ahroprom.
I used certain informal channels to reach out to the professor. That’s how I found out it was an old mutant research lab. I can’t even begin to fathom what’s going on in there right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_Sherba_AgainA: You haven’t gone to X5 yet? Don’t forget to look for the Controller Project papers while you are there.
If you’ve got any questions, now’s the time to ask. I need to check on Professor Dvupalov.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_Dialog_SkifBroughtLe: Come on in. And don’t drag your feet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_SherbaGoAway_Leave_5: I’ve already handed over the key card. Could you please leave now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ03_professor_dvupalov_0: Stop by again, we’ll have another.
I don’t bother with the news, and I’d suggest you do the same. It'll turn your brain to mush... and I say that as a scientist.
All right. What were we talking about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_CommentBye_bye_FF_58: Make sure to come back. We’re counting on you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_Alfa1Interac: Thanks for your help, stalker. We’ve got too many wounded, can’t chat right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_DeltaMoveToB: Bravo, this is Delta. First batch is ready to go. We’re heading to the Duga.
Roger that, Delta. We’ve got your six.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_DvoriankovIs: Major Dvoryankov in command now. All units, report!
Charlie Team cleared the barracks. Engaging at the Lesser Duga checkpoint.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_InTheBeginni: Put the gun down already, you’ve been cleaning it for an hour. Wanna hear something funny? Two Monolithians walk into a bar…
Get lost before I shove this gun up your ass.
Calm down. We didn’t know what we were up against last time, but now we do. We’ve got this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_KPPAboutWin_: Well done! Get the wounded checked out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_LastWords_by: Soldiers! It’s been an honor fighting alongside you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_LastWords_la: Alpha, get to cover! I’m going to set it off!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_LiterEDeltaB: Bravo, this is Delta. I can’t hear you! Say again!
They spotted us! We’ve got contact!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_MonolitSpeec: All forces, hold the Duga. We cannot allow the infidels to interfere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_NearDugaChar: Make it fast! We can’t hold on much—
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_NearDugaDelt: Delta, Charlie’s in position. We’re pinning them down!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_NearKPPStart: Alpha Team, the stalker is on approach.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_WhatAHell_wh: What are you waiting for, Skif? Get to the checkpoint and into the tunnel, now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_ZotovAboutSk: Alpha Team, get ready to attack the checkpoint. Proceed as planned.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_ZotovCallAft: Great job, Skif! Let’s keep it up.
There’s a tunnel near the checkpoint. Find it and get inside.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_ZotovIfRunWr: Turn around, stalker! The tunnel’s the other way!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Comment_Zotov_Call_c: Skif, Zotov here. I'm told you're in posession of a device that can protect from Faust's influence. We must act fast.
We're getting ready to take the Duga under the IPSF's control and get rid of those fanatics once and for all. Your help can increase our chances.
Our forward command post is close to the Duga. Sending over the coordinates. You'll get the details once there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_CallVarta_hi_: The guys wanted to thank you, Skif. We couldn’t have made it without your help.
Oleksii gave his life for a better future. His death wasn’t in vain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_StartQuest_Ne: Finding the base was definitely no problem.
Failure isn’t an option. We had to mobilize all of our forces. Had to pull Dvoryankov from the Chemical Plant!
We’ve got a lot to do. If you need some time to prepare, let me know. If you’re ready, I’ll bring you up to speed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_StartQuest_an: I want to know more about your plan for the attack.
Each team has a specific objective. Alpha Team will start by clearing the checkpoint. Bravo and Charlie will create diversions to distract the enemy.
Meanwhile, Delta Team will plant the explosives to deal with the Duga.
Our main forces will secure and infiltrate the facility and sweep it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_StartQuest_he: I’m glad you’re here. Ready for the brief?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_StartQuest_ho: Just some standard C4 with a remote detonator. Your job is to plant it at the exact coordinates we give you, then take cover.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_StartQuest_no: I need some time to gear up.
Of course. But make sure you’re here when it’s time to put your skills to use.
And keep your head down. Got snipers out there.
Our objective is the Duga. Judging by our findings at Promin, Faust can activate it – even remotely. We need to destroy this contraption before it scorches the brains of everyone in the Zone.
You’ll take the underground route. Almost zero chance of running into Monolithians there. They know our troops wouldn’t risk going through mutants and anomalies.
Get to the Lesser Duga and plant the explosive device. My men will do the same at the other side of the facility. Any questions?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_StartQuest_ok: Excellent. Head over to the checkpoint and find the tunnel. I’ll guide you through it over the radio, so stay in touch.
As for Faust, I'll let you know when we track him. We'll take it from there.
Best of luck, Skif. I’m counting on you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_ZotovCallAbou: Near the exit, I think. Which way is it?
Through the engineering hallway. The IPSF reports say there's a way through mark “D.”
All right. I’ll look for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_ZotovCallBefo: Stick to the plan. Set them up and find cover.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_ZotovCallNear: Are you close to the Duga, Skif?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_Dialog_ZovovCallAfte: I think the explosion was only on my end. Why didn’t it go off outside?
I’ve got a new mission for you: find Faust. There’s a group of Monolithians on the roof of the Comm Center. Check it out.
I’ll handle the second batch. Load it up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_korcnoj_0_InfoTopic_: I wish I could tell my men, “It’s okay, we’ve been through shit worse than this.” But damn, this is a whole new level of shit we’ve stepped in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_soldat_litvinuk_0_In: What, this isn't new enough for ya? I’ve never seen this kind of shitfuckery before!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ04_soldat_sorokin_0_Inf: Wherever the Monolith takes them, it’s a one-way ticket.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Audiolog_Faust4_Find: Strider, find the Doctor from Strelok’s group. He has to die before he assists the enemies of the Monolith with their schemes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Audiolog_FaustGerman: You were going to name your terms, scientist.
I know, okay? Your request is causing me a lot of problems here. You’re not getting out of it easy.
Next time I call, your men need to quickly collect a certain item from a stalker.
If you do it, you’ll get remote access to the Monolith database.
Remember, Faust, you don’t have much choice. No one’s going to work with you. No one wants to get involved in what you’re after.
I remember. It will be taken care of.
Faust, come in. The stalker’s heading for the Old Bridge. Send your men, quick!
He can't be left alive, you understand? Get the Scanner from him and stay out of sight. I’m risking my ass here.
We have the Scanner. Now give us the access, scientist.
About time! Here, that should do the trick. Now take the Scanner over here, and I’ll…
That wasn’t part of the deal. If you want the Scanner, come to the old Clear Sky base.
What the hell? You think you’re clever, do you?!
Remember, Hermann — you don’t have much choice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_AfterFaustDe: Skif! They’re scattering! We’re pushing them north! What about Faust?
He did it, he blew up the Duga! But he didn’t make it. We’ve lost so many…
It doesn’t matter. Let’s not waste our time mourning. Star wouldn’t want that. He believed in his cause and was willing to do whatever it took.
Besides, he’s a legend now. Not many guys in the Zone go out with a bang like that!
We've still got work to do here. Need to transport the wounded and dead. As for you, return to Malachite. They’re waiting for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_AssaultRadio: Star, we’ve got a squad coming in from the northwest. They’re skirting around the checkpoint.
Good. Lead them away from the rest, as far as you can.
Make it quick! We’re getting antsy waiting for them here.
Are you there, stalker? Now you gotta activate all the transformers.
That should overload the grid and temporarily shut down the Duga.
Not yet, Skif! Initiate the transformer overload.
We can’t keep them distracted for much longer.
We’re in position, boss. The garage, 20 to the north. We just spotted a scouting party.
Hold them off, no matter what! Don’t let them catch sight of China!
Copy that, boss.
We welcomed our guests. Took some casualties.
Got it. Mugwort, what about you?
What do you think?! Fuck! Where’s that gunfire coming from?
(screaming)
Got the shooter. Third window, right above you.
Fuck yeah! Comin’ in!
All clear.
Hold on! Another one. Tenth window, one floor down! Can you hear…
Shit, Mugwort’s hit!
Boss, we’ve cleared the garage. Heading north now.
What about ammo?
Running low. Almost out of the grenades we took from the Ward.
I know! These assholes are fucking hard to take down! Should’ve packed a flamethrower.
I’m sending another squad to you. We’re moving to the Duga. Let’s get this done!
Damn it, Cleric! Too soon!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_AzbukaMonoli: Our brothers did not return. The infidels are up to something. Stay alert.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_FaustComm_1_: Come to me. I'll show you the truth.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_InteractCajn: If you think about smoking in here, I swear I’ll shoot you before this place goes up in flames.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_InteractKler: Hey, loner! You’re in! I hear you’re quite the fighter, just like my boys. I’d love to see you in action!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_MachineSpeak: Enemies at the checkpoint. Find and eliminate the threat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_MartOnIntera: You weren’t followed, were you? We’re already short on time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_MonolithAtta: He is here! The enemy of the Monolith shall die!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_MonolithDete: The infidels have destroyed the Duga. Death to the enemies of the Monolith!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_PolynAfterMe: We’ll circle around from the northwest. They might be good at stealth, but my men are even better.
Okay. Keep your heads down until the stalker does his thing. Star’s counting on you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_PolynOnInter: Star’s in charge of the operation. He’s the man to talk to. I need to concentrate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_PolynWarnsOf: Look how… went flying! We’re ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_Radio_StarSu: Fuck, Star! There’s a lot of them right under the Duga. They got a Gauss gun! We’re outnumbered. Five men down.
Stay low. Give us your coordinates. We’re moving in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_Radio_TNTOnl: Hide the explosives and get outta there. Quick! This is your only chance. I’ve got a backup plan!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_Spark_Surpri: I told you not to smoke in here. Go outside. Not in the building!
Are you trying to ruin my surprise for those fanatics?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarBeforeTu: So, what’s the hold-up? We’re good to go. Move it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarCallsAbo: They took the bait! Four large units are heading to the explosion site. We’re falling back.
The path is clear. This is your moment, Skif. The rest of you, let’s keep the fanatics running in circles!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarCallsSki: Skif, come in. How’s Scar’s request going? Is there a way to deal with the phantoms of our mad Monolith preacher?
Wow, good news for once! Can’t say the same about the rest. Faust is going to turn everyone in the Zone into fanatics. And the worst is that he’s got a pretty good chance.
But we have a plan. Head over to the Duga. I’ll tell you all about it.
I’ve got the Suppressor. It should shield me from Faust’s influence.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarCalls_Ra: Damn, we've got everything ready. How come you're not there?
What’s taking you so long? Hurry up! Move, move!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarConfirms: You fucking did it, Skif! The Duga’s not gonna pose a threat for a while.
And now these assholes have no idea where we’re gonna hit ’em! It’s time to move on to the grand finale.
So, you were after Faust, right? There’s a gathering on the roof of the Comm Center, the Duga command post. It seems like the preacher is about to come out and address his flock.
Go finish him off. We’ve got your back. And if you hear an explosion, take a look around – it’s not every day we make the Duga sparkle!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarOnKillin: Looks like the fun part’s about to begin!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarOnTheFut: You know, Skif, I’ve got this gut feeling – when shit’s about to hit the fan, I can sense it coming a mile away. But if there’s good stuff around the corner, I get pumped up in advance.
And this time, my gut’s telling me it’s gonna be smooth as silk. Just like it’s meant to be. You’ll see.
Who knows? Maybe we’ll see the Shining Zone sooner than we expect.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarPolyn_Fi: I’m shooting! Hang in there, stalker!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_StarSaysBye_: Hurry back! The sooner we attack, the quicker we can get to Faust.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_Star_IfSkisM: I hope you’re still alive, stalker. We’re sticking to the plan: get to the transformer room and shut down the Duga.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_Star_LastOne: We made it through! I even snagged a Gauss gun, ha!
Everyone, get ready! Moving on to the last phase of the plan.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_Star_LightOn: Skif, do you read me? I sure hope so. It’s gonna be a shame if you don’t.
If my timing's right, you must be heading towards where my men fixed up the lights. Pretty cool, ha? Now get to the radio room so we can have a proper chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_TinyFluff1_A: Ambush on the roof! We need backup, 150 to the—
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_TinyFluff2_S: They went around the tripwires! They’ve got some weapons, can’t tell what it is!
Don’t even think about engaging head-on! Let the sniper handle it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Comment_TinyFluff3_M: I remember now… Mykola… Soborna Street… apartment…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Dialog_StarOnTheTask: Why don’t we just head back to Promin and shut down the Duga?
We’ve tracked synchronizing impulses. It means that Faust’s followers obtained control codes from the Emitter and can activate the Duga whenever they want.
Basically, we’ve lost remote access. The only way is to turn it off manually. And I know how.
Any complications I should be aware of?
The sewers ain’t exactly a walk in the park – they’re crawling with mutants. But I’d rather take on critters than Gauss snipers any day. You’ll manage.
Shutting down the Duga might make a little noise. So be ready for some armed guests to crash your little party at the substation. Stay on your toes.
I was born ready. I live for this stuff.
Look at us – we're having a blast!
Oh, yeah. You guys sure know how to throw a party.
We didn’t plan this when we turned on the Lesser Duga. But we can’t let Faust turn the Zone into Zombieland. The Zone bows to no one!
This is gonna be a real mess. The Monolithians aren't creative, but they're stubborn as hell.
I can’t wait to get rolling, but if you need time to gear up, this is your last chance. If you’re ready, I’ll brief you on the plan, and off we go.
As long as Faust is surrounded by phantoms, we can't get to him. And the fact that he has a small army and the most powerful Brain Scorcher in the Zone is not making it easier.
Any guards patrolling the substation?
Our teams report that Monolithians don’t give a damn about the Transformer Room. Plus, we’ve got a couple of tricks to keep them occupied while you’re there.
As for the Ward – after the hit they took, they won’t be coming anywhere near the Duga again. They got the memo.
I’ll shut down the Duga, and I’ll deal with Faust.
Attaboy! Now get into the tunnel before new Monolithian patrols show up.
The signal is patchy down below, so make sure to get to the radio room — that’s our first communication point.
That’s the gist of it. We’ll figure out the rest as we go. March, Mugwort, China, get to your squads and take positions. Let's roll.
I need some time to get ready.
Sure, but be quick about it. The Monolithians must’ve already figured out someone killed their recce team.
And don’t go too far ahead – their Gauss snipers can take you out with a single shot.
Let’s get down to business. You see the Duga? We can’t storm it head-on. Faust and that psi-radiation will fry our brains before we even get close.

But we haven't been sitting around and we've got blueprints from the underground utilities. Turns out, there’s a sewer line running from the firehouse straight to the Duga. It's a quiet way in, and the patrols won't see us.
You gotta get to the Transformer Room and shut down the Duga. Once you’re done, we’ll take care of the Monolithians while you take on Faust. Any questions?
I’ve got my part sorted. What’s your plan?
We’ve got all our friends gathered. Did you see anyone on your way here? That’s the point. Today, the Monolith is gonna find out how many folks are really with Spark. But why ruin the surprise?
You’re the last piece of the puzzle. Once you get down there, my unit commanders will go about their business.
The Monolithians have us outmanned and outgunned. But if we can distract and divide them, their brute force won’t count for much.
Good to see you. So, you ready for the greatest adventure of your life?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_Dialog_Star_RadioRoo: I got here as fast as I could. What’s the latest?
So far, everything’s going smoothly. The fanatics are suspecting something, but that was part of the plan, too.
Time to open the presents. That’ll keep the Monolithians busy while you make a run for the Transformer Room. We’ll get in touch once you’re there.
About time. Let’s get this party started, Commander!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_cajnataun_0_InfoTopi: Star sure made a hell of a racket. I hope I go down with fireworks like he did!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_cajnataun_0_ResumeCo: What was I saying? Oh, right!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_edkij_0_InfoTopic_1_: Before the Signal, I used to fall for excuses like “they didn’t know what they were doing” and “they didn’t choose this way”, all that crap.
Screw it. I won’t rest until we find and kill every “former” Monolithian. Those bastards murdered too many of us!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_edkov_0_BusyTopic_1_: What are you, stupid? Not now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_edkov_0_DefeatCommen: Ouch! Nice shooting, you sons of bitches!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_edkov_0_InfoTopic_1_: I’ll stick with Scar till the end. Come with us if you’ve got the guts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_edkov_0_ResumeCommen: Now where were we, stalker? Make it snappy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_klerik_0_InfoTopic_1: Remember, stalker, it’s not about how many people you actually have. What matters is keeping the enemy guessing about your numbers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_klerik_0_ResumeComme: Okay, what were we talking about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_sasa_mart_0_BusyTopi: Why are you getting in my way?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_MQ05_sasa_mart_0_InfoTopi: The Zone tells the most to those who talk the least.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Audiolog_KardanAndDv: Cardan, I need you to build a device to jam the signal from the collars!
Shit, Professor, it’s 3:00 in the morning. I ought to jam you so you can’t contact me anymore.
Listen to me! This is about Project Leash. We have to block the signal! We cannot allow anyone to control the mutants!
It has to be built and put somewhere where even I can’t access it. If someone decides to try and control the creatures instead of just destroying them…
Sorry, I didn’t catch a single fucking word. You can explain it all at the lab tomorrow. Sleep tight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Audiolog_KardanCreat: All right, Professor. I've got that collar jammer you wanted all set up, tucked away where no one can mess with it.
But if it ever takes a hit, the X-Network signal might start getting through again. I could crank the jammer to the max to shut down the collars for good...
I think regular jamming should suffice. I doubt anyone would meddle with them if they can’t pick up the signal.
Thanks for the help. I owe you one. How about stopping by for a drink?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_DvupalovAndS: Pretty much everyone around here wants to change the Zone. And everyone else keeps getting in the way.
I guess you’re fortunate that you haven’t created anything that…
You’re right… I haven’t created anything at all! Does that make me even more of a failure than you? But I’m…
Have a drink — it’ll make you feel better. And grab a bite. The pickles are pretty good.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_DvupalovDrin: The hell are you doin' here? Whatcha gawkin' at?
No way I’m gonna pour you one.
But I might as well have another shot. No more toasts, got it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_DvupalovGets: I'd like to have a word with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_DvupalovIfSe: I heard about the collars, Skif. You shut them off, didn’t you?
Then it's finally over. Cardan suggested I do it a while back, but I…
There’s always a price to pay, and sometimes it’s not measured in coupons alone. Here, take this. Let's hope this is the last time we see each other.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_DvupalovIsDr: You know what’s fun about being sober? Hic… nothing!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_DvupalovMoan: That vodka… you know, the magic stuff…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaCommen: Drink it, Skif! Drink the vodka!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaIfSetU: And you couldn’t even deal with a stupid jammer!
And you had to step in and ruin everything!
I figured it was better to deactivate the collars.
You figured WHAT?! Do you realize the extent of the damage you’ve done? My entire career is in ruins!
Why don’t you say something? Fix that thing! My whole career is at stake!
This is the Zone. Things don’t always go according to plan.
I don’t give a damn about the Zone’s plans! All you had to do was shut that thing off! Do you realize the damage you’ve done?
A chance like this comes once in a lifetime! I could’ve… this was my life’s work!
Something’s wrong, stalker! My collars aren’t producing any signal at all now!
Are you close to the jammer? What did you do?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaInvite: Skif, this is Shcherba. You got me those collars and took care of the jammer, remember?
I’ve made remarkable progress since then, and I’d like to show you the results. I’ve even prepared a little bonus for your contribution.
Drop by my lab when you’ve got a moment. You’ll see.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaIsKill: When I mentioned a reward for you, Skif, I wasn’t being entirely honest. Stage two of the trial is a reward for me as well. It’s a reward for all the effort I’ve put into this.
I failed to persuade Dvupalov to continue his work, so I decided to take matters into my own hands. I’m going to create my own Faust! And, unlike the professor, I’ll be able to control him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaLost_y: According to my calculations, the psi-exposure should have had an effect on him by now. I don’t understand…
I told you, that vodka is pure magic!
You old prick! You’ve ruined your own life, and now you want to ruin mine too!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaNotEno: Why did you have to come down here and distract me from my work, stalker? I gave you clear instructions to bring all the collars at once.
It’s the same story every single time: they bring one collar, then go back for another, and something out there gets them. And I’m left trying to recall which collars I sent them after and where.
I’m waiting for the entire batch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaStillN: Subject 48 failed the test. Terminated via sedatives.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SherbaThreat: You never appreciated my work! Who gave you the right to interfere?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Comment_SkifDidntDri: Stage two of the trial. Test subject number one is prepared for transportation and surgery.
Where’s the vodka, Dvupalov? We've finally got something to celebrate!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_DvupalovGives: I don’t need any vodka. You can keep it.
Take it… it might… hic! come in handy…
Here, take it… a little magic for ya...
Why would I need your vodka?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_DvupalovIsSer: How come Shcherba’s supplying you with vodka all of a sudden?
Don’t you even think about asking him! You might spook the guy.
He does it, and that’s good enough for me. Having Shcherba around is better than dealing with a hangover.
That’s right! You’re not like that bore. He can bring me a drink, but he can’t hold his liquor.
That hit the spot… pure magic!
Your call. More for me then.
And he doesn’t drag his feet like you do. All right, now that you’re here, how about a drop of the true?
Ah, stalker! You wanna ask what’s… hic! new around the Zone again?
I’ll fill you in. Turns out, Shcherba isn’t as hopeless as I thought – the grad student’s been bringing me vodka! I don’t even have to ask him for it.
Care for a drink while you’re still hanging around? My grad student sorted out a delivery for me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_DvupalovTells: I should’ve listened to Cardan and shut those goddamn collars off. But I kept putting it off and putting it off...
I even got Shcherba mixed up in the whole mess.
He’s the one who got himself into it.
Yeah, right… he just read my files and did it all in my lab.
His fate weighs heavily on me as well…
Thanks for helping me out, anyhow. Here, take this. Let's hope this is the last time we see each other.
He got off way too easy.
That’s one way of looking at it. He’s gonna have to live with it…
All right, we’ll work something out. Just do us both a favor and don’t come back. I’ve got plenty on my plate without you.
But here, take this. You did help me, after all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_GotBackToSher: Hey, stalker! And here I thought I might get some news today. You can’t imagine how many of these collars turned out to be completely useless. All I was getting was scrap metal.
I hope you come bearing gifts. How did it go?
Hand them over. I’ll check them out right away. Don’t wander off now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_HunterTellsAb: Hey there! You’ve been doing some hunting for that grad student too, eh? He’s kinda shady, ain’t he?
Last time, I nearly got myself killed, and the jerk didn’t even pay me extra. He was all like, “If you don’t do it, someone else will.”
If he ever asks you to lug a chimera on your back for his collection, just don’t. Ain’t worth it, dude.
Nope, I didn't hunt for him. Just brought him some collars.
I guess he hired me to find mutants to go in those collars. And they had to be alive, too! Pretty weird, huh? The scientists never even asked for shit like that.
Did he ever mention why he’s after mutants?
I didn’t bother asking, and I doubt he would’ve spilled the beans anyway. All I know is I’ve been rounding up every critter in the Zone, and he wanted 'em all alive, not dead.
Anything wrong with that grad student?
He asked for mutants, but insisted I bring ’em alive. And not just the psi-dogs — we're talkin' bigger stuff. Can you believe it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_SherbaAboutDe: Do you still need help with that disrupted collar signal?
Absolutely! They’re useless in this state, but I’ve got an idea for a way to get the samples online again.
There’s a certain device that needs to be dealt with. Can you help?
What do you need me to do with that signal jammer again?
Shut it off! And do it quick — it’s making my collars entirely useless and stopping my progress in its tracks.
I’ve already forwarded the device’s location to you, but it’s only approximate. Keep an eye on the radio interference — it’ll get stronger the closer you get.
Once you disable the jammer, my collars will pick up the signal. Does everything make sense now, or was there something else you wanted?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_SherbaAsksToD: Tell me what I need to do.
Something’s disrupting the connection between the collars and the X-Network. I’ve identified the approximate location of the device.
I don’t know what it looks like, but the radio interference will grow stronger as you approach it.
Once you shut off the jammer, my collars should start working again. You can simply break the thing if that's what it takes to get the signal through.
You still haven’t told me why you need these collars.
For research, of course! The kind of research everyone else has given up on. As if there were more pressing matters to attend to...
You wouldn’t believe how much funding SIRCAA was receiving. Where did it all go? And here I am, a humble graduate student, on the verge of a major breakthrough.
But until the collars are operational, they’re worthless. And that makes all of my work worthless too.
Oh, for goodness’ sake! The signal from these collars is jammed as well. They’re utterly worthless in this state.
I’m glad you’re still here. I've got an idea for a way to get these samples back online. Can you lend me a hand?
I’m too busy at the moment.
I hope you can spare some time for me. This job is a walk in the park for you, and I’ll pay you as much as it takes. Besides, we make a great team, you and I.
My research won’t make any progress with the collars offline. Come back when you’re available, and I’ll explain how you can help me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_SherbaMercyOr: You’re looking for understanding from the wrong man.
I couldn’t care less about your goals, but I know you won’t be able to replicate this experiment. Get lost.
I’ve seen what you’re capable of.
Who cares?! We’re creating life here! A new life! If that isn’t the reason we’re here in the Zone, then what is?
You’ve told me about Strelok, Scar, and the other stalkers! They’ve done even worse things to achieve their goals.
And yet everyone knows their names. You must understand me, Skif — you’re no different, after all.
What on Earth do you need him for, Skif? He’s squandered his talent! But I can still achieve so much. I’m capable of…
Countless scientists would give anything to do the same! And every single one of them would be overjoyed to take your place!
I didn’t come to the Zone to push pencils. I wanted to achieve something great!
Look who’s coming to save the day!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_SherbaRepeatA: Why don’t you collect them yourself?
When I was ten, I was bitten by a dog. It hurt so much, I still remember it to this day. All I did was ask it to shake shake a paw.
So I can only get close to these creatures when they’re securely caged.
A trip into the Zone would be a death sentence for me. But for a stalker like you, it’s a piece of cake.
Got it. I’ll do my best.
Good to hear it. I’ll be waiting for the entire batch!
Do you still need my help with those collars?
Absolutely! I’ve gone through the papers you brought, and… well, I told you before — there was one detail everyone at Malachite overlooked, but I caught it. And I’d like to test that theory.
To do so, I’ll need collars. Can you help me gather some?
Remind me again — how can I help with those collars?
I thought you'd already gone to retrieve them. You’ve dealt with these samples before, haven’t you?
You’ve got the coordinates. Keep in mind that they’re approximate, so you’ll need to locate them on-site. And make sure to bring all the collars — don’t bother bringing them here one at a time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_SherbaShowsHi: I shouldn’t have helped you with those collars.
If you hadn't, someone else would have. It’s all in a day's work for a stalker, yes?
Many others have tried their hand at it, but I’m the only one who's been able to get the science down. And this is just the beginning.
Regardless, I’ve got a little token of my gratitude for you. Head to the right-hand section of the lab, all the way to the back room.
You may collect your reward for now. Proceed to the right-hand section of the lab, all the way to the back room.
The scientists at Malachite and SIRCAA never even dreamed of such a thing. Some were probably too scared to even walk past the cages, while others probably blew all their funding on the cages alone.
But give the right kind of man a firm spot on which to stand, and he'll turn the Zone upside down, all by himself!
Of course, this is only the beginning — the toughest challenges still lie ahead. But everything will work out, you’ll see!
So what are you going to do now?
Itching to see it, are you? I’m right there with you. But we’ll get to the real heart of my research a bit later.
Aren’t you worried they might turn on you?
I’m absolutely certain I have them under control with the collars! But, as a safety measure, I’ve got a button that can instantly cut their existence short.
But that’s not all! We’ll get to the really exciting part soon enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_SherbaWantsCo: All right. Tell me where to find them.
I’ve detected a few collar signals, but the locations are approximate. I’ll forward you the coordinates, but you’ll have to pin them down once you’re on-site.
Just make sure to bring me the entire batch. I don’t want my work interrupted by one sample at a time.
Stalker, this is Shcherba. While the professor was busy getting plastered, I went through the papers you brought back from X5.
And guess what? Leaving Malachite was the right call! I think I’ve stumbled upon something they all overlooked. Even Dvupalov himself missed it! But it’s just a theory — I need to put it to the test.
To do so, I’ll need collars. Can you help me gather some?
I hope you can spare some time for my request. Aftrer all, you’ve handled similar tasks for Dvupalov before.
If you happen to be nearby, stop by the lab. I’ll explain how you can help me.
I’ve got other things to do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Dialog_SherbaWhenDes: I’ve got fantastic news, Skif! The signal’s coming through — my collars are up and running!
Now I can finally get back to work. There’s so much left to test, and I can’t wait to dive in!
I’ll reach out if I need your help again. Oh, by the way, here’s a little something for your help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_Serba_callUsBackAfte: Come back sometime. I may require your assistance once more.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_aspirant_serba_0_Def: I need a medic! I’m hurt!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_aspirant_serba_0_Inf: The Zone is an immense field ripe for exploration. And while some may throw in the towel and cease digging, others will persevere and ultimately unearth the treasure it holds.
The former end up drowning their sorrows in alcohol, while the names of the latter are etched into history.
It’s like they say: be careful what you wish for.
My wish was to follow in Dvupalov's footsteps… and now look where I've ended up.
I wanted to make a difference, to change something about the Zone… in the end, I couldn’t even get promoted.
My career is over. That enough news for you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_aspirant_serba_0_Res: All right. Let’s get back to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_keps_0_InfoTopic_1_1: You know, the biggest puzzle in the Zone is those eggheads. What are they up to? Who’s their guinea pig? And what’s the whole point of it all? It’d be nice if they’d spill the damn beans already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E08_SQ01_professor_dvupalov_0: That grad student was always pestering me: “Why did you give it all up, Professor Dvupalov?” “You could have reached the very summit of scientific achievement, Professor Dvupalov!”
But I’m not fond of oxygen deprivation. Lack of hydration isn’t my thing either.
I never leave this place, so I don’t know any news.
I hope you didn’t bring any either.
Everything you do in the Zone has a price. And you’re fortunate if it’s measured in coupons alone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_BothSurvived: I don’t think what's left of Tsyba was even aware of your “friendship.”
I… I don’t know. Here, stalker, take this. It’s not much, but it’s all I have. Because you cared.
So, you had your fucking fun playing Mother Theresa, huh?! Now, let’s head to Malachite. Should we set up a hospital for the Monolithians while we’re at it?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_CD_Shmi_meds: You'd better stay away from us, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_CK_Laz_medla: You could’ve helped him, you bastard!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_CK_Shmi_meds: Thanks for staying out of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_FarTalk_fart: You’re right, we can’t. We have to finish him off.
We can’t just leave him here.
Are you out of your fucking mind?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_LCD_Shmi_med: Leave me alone, stalker. You’ve “helped” enough already…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_LazarAliveAl: Guys? What’s wrong with you?! Get up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_LazarenkoCal: Hey, stalker! We need some help over here.
Hit the road, stalker. We’ve got this under control.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_NO_LazShmi_d: We should have helped Tsyba before he went missing. As for this… thing... all I have to offer is a bullet through the head.
Fuck! Tsyba saved his ass so many times, and this is how he repays him?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_SkifKilledTs: He hadn’t been one of us since the assault on the Duga, Sarge. Even then, there was no way we could’ve helped him.
You should be grateful he spared us from having to do it. Here, stalker. Take this as a token of my appreciation.
Fuck! What the hell?! There must've been some way to help him… you fucking butcher!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_SmidtCantWai: I can’t waste any more of our time on this. I’m sorry, buddy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_SmidtKilledT: We should’ve “tried something” back at the Duga, before we lost contact with Tsyba. It was too late.
Now pull yourself together — we’ve gotta catch up with the rest at Malachite. And keep your cool next time, okay?
Captain, no! What the hell?! There must've been some way to help him! SIRCAA, the scientists… we could’ve tried something…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_SmitdAttack_: I warned you! You fucking idiots!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_TsibaMonolit: What? You want some water, Tsyba?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_YESNO_Shmidt: Don’t waste your time on him, stalker. It’s better to just finish him off right away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Comment_YES_LazInter: You gotta help Tsyba, stalker. He’s gonna bleed to death!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Dialog_LazarenkoExpl: Hey, you got a medkit? Our buddy’s bleeding out here, and we ran out during the battle.
It’s Tsyba, Captain. Tsyba! He’s just wounded and exhausted, that’s it. We can’t let a brother-in-arms die, can we?
Hold on, stalker. He used to be one of us, but now he’s turned Monolithian.
Let me see what I can do.
Help me save Tsyba, stalker. We can’t leave him like this!
You should have rescued Tsyba back at the Duga, before he went missing. Now his brain is so scrambled, the only thing that can help him is a bullet.
So what? We’ll bring him back to the base. Our scientists are smart enough to figure it out!
No, guys. You’re on your own here.
Fuck… what’s wrong with you people?!
It’s for the best. The only way we can honor Tsyba’s memory now is… by ending the suffering of whatever’s left of him.
How can he be a Monolithian? He’s got the same uniform as you.
He went missing after the assault on the Duga. None of us had seen him since. And now here he is, like a little present in the middle of the battle.
Don’t waste your supplies on him, stalker. He hasn’t been one of us for a long time.
He was one of us, and he still is. Sure, he’s a little shaken up, but if we help him now, the medics can get him back on his feet. And if the medics can't, the scientists will!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_Dialog_SmitdAliveAlo: I was just doing what he asked me to.
He asked, did he? Fuck! I should’ve done Tsyba a favor and shot him dead back at the Duga…
I could tell he was going nuts right away, but I felt sorry for him, so I let him crawl over to Monolith… they didn’t even flinch.
And now I’ve lost both of them 'cuz I showed mercy…
What are you gonna do next?
Those assholes have fallen back toward Malachite, so I'll head that way. As for you — I'd stay out of it. You don't wanna end up rushing to the rescue of every brainwashed zombie you see.
I wonder how many more guys like Tsyba are out there in the Zone now…
You goddamn idiots, both of you… Lazarenko, I can understand, but you? Why the fuck did you get involved?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_ciba_0_BusyTopic_1_6: For the glory of the Monolith!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_kapitan_smidt_0_Busy: Move along. I’m pretty busy right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_kapitan_smidt_0_Info: New? Ain’t nothing new under the sun — least of all in the Zone. Blood, shit, death... it’s all the same story, day in, day out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ01_serzant_lazarenko_0_: No way, I’m not fucking done here!
We kicked their Monolithian asses real good. They’ll think twice before messing with us again!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_EndOfTheRoun: Well? Where the hell did he go? There's only two left. I’d rather not stick around here for another hour.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_HollywoodAft: Thanks for not being a dick about the loot, stalker. I can respect that. Don’t hold it against Smidge — he lost a buddy in this mess. That’s why he’s getting all riled up.
Take it easy, stalker. He lost a good friend in this battle, and he’s taking it out on everyone around him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_HollywoodAgr: What the fuck is wrong with you?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_HollywoodGre: Well, well, look who the cat dragged in!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_HollywoodNOP: Too many of us have already died for the Shining Zone… but are we any closer to it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_SkifRefusedZ: Where the hell were you, bud?
Damn… you should grab his bag too... in memory of our comrade.
I was out looking for Sashko. I wanted to make sure he ain’t coming back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_SparkNPCgk_N: I don’t get it. Why the hell did Smidge get two bags at once?
That’s one for his buddy. No one’s seen him since the assault…
We've all lost people in the Zone, ya know. We should’ve shared it, or at least given it to Powerplug to hold onto.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_SparkNPCgk_Y: You should’ve cut Smidge some slack, man…
He had his reasons, man. We’ve got rules…
When it comes to this stuff, Hollywood’s the boss. If he says it’s cool, it’s cool. And that stalker’s been fighting with us for a while now.
Gimme a break! Smidge was the one who started it.
You did the right thing, stalker, letting one of ours take his pick. You gotta respect the rules, after all.
No way! This stalker’s been through a ton of shit with us, and you guys still treat him like crap. Like, “You ain’t one of us! Get lost!” Keep it up, and your own guys are gonna start bailing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_SparkNPCsvh_: Too bad it didn’t come to a fistfight. That would’ve been a hell of a show…
Hey, we'll divvy it up fair and square. Smidge ain’t gonna have nothin' to bitch about now, and you still got your share. Well done, bud!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_Warning_Warn: Hands off, got it? It ain’t yours. This is your first and only warning.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_ZmenyaLeftUn: What more do you want from me? You got your handout, so go fuck yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_ZmenyaPick_H: How do ya like your loot? Mine’s better, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_ZmenyaSkifGa: You can keep the one you were gonna offer me and choke on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_ZmenyaSkifRe: I feel so bad about Sashko… we spent years together in the Zone. No loot’s gonna bring him back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Comment_ZmenyaSkifTa: Well, what else would you expect from some random schmuck?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Dialog_HollywoodGame: “On the left” is relative. You mean the one on your left, or the one on my left?
Hey, calm your tits, I’m just kidding.
Hey there. You need a written invitation?
I’d love to know what for.
It’s simple enough. If you’re lucky, you get to pick a bag with some sweet loot.
That wasn't very nice, stalker. But it’s your call.
What’s this show of unrequited generosity all about?
After a big fight, we usually divvy up the loot blind. Helps avoid any squabbles.
And you’ve basically been earnin’ your keep lately, stalker. Besides, we seem to be a couple of men short right now.
Okay. So, which one’s speakin' to ya?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_Dialog_ZmenyaWantsTo: There are two of you, and there are two bags. What’s your problem?
What, I can’t go take a leak without the rules changing? We’re letting outsiders in now too?
What the fuck is this guy doing here?
You’d be still stuck fighting Faust if it weren’t for my help. I pitched in and earned my share of the loot.
Sashko didn’t take a backseat either, and in the end, he got a bullet instead. That’s just not fair, stalker.
We had a common enemy, and we beat them together.
Together, huh? A lot of our guys lost their lives for that, and you just happened to show up at the right moment.
Cool off. I didn’t ask for this, all right?
Here in the Zone, it’s just a matter of time until we all cool off, if you catch my drift.
Take it easy, Smidge. I’m the one who brought the stalker into this. Each of you gets a bag. Pick one and get over it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_gollivud_0_HelloTopi: Hey, stalker. What brings you here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_gollivud_0_InfoTopic: There’s always somethin' new just around the corner. Maybe it'll take a bite out of you from some unexpected angle, or maybe it’ll find a peculiar way to cripple your ass. Stay sharp!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_gril_0_InfoTopic_1_1: Another day down, another battle won. In the Zone, that counts for something, believe me!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_gril_0_ResumeComment: So where were we? Oh, right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_kostan_sovuha_0_ByeT: So long, stalker. See you around!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_kostan_sovuha_0_Hell: Hey there! Wanna hang for a bit?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_kostan_sovuha_0_Info: A while back, I heard about someone in the Zone cooking up a special, damn near magical vodka. Man, I'd love to have a taste of that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_kostan_sovuha_0_Resu: Yeah, all right. Where were we?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_vlad_kastan_0_InfoTo: Ugh! I ain’t no fan of anything new, least of all in the Zone. Surprises can suck it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_EQ02_zmena_0_InfoTopic_1_: Well, there’s this weirdo who just popped in, and he won’t stop talkin' my ear off. Do me a favor and beat it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_DalinAfterIn: Sorry, I need some time to collect my thoughts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_DalinAsksFor: May I ask you a favor, Skif?
If you happen to come across new data concerning the Representative’s statements, anything at all, please pass it along to me. Any bit of information could be important.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_DalinInShock: Quiet. Obey my orders. Follow me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_Dalin_Assaul: You have your own mission, Skif. You shouldn’t be here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_Dalin_StartQ: Skif? It’s Dalin. I heard you dealt with Faust personally. Is that true? Are you all right?
Great to hear! Skif, I have a favor to ask. Please search Faust’s body and collect everything you find on him. It’s extremely important.
I’ll be waiting for you at Lab X17. The colonel’s squad paid a visit to the Clear Sky base, and they didn’t come back empty-handed. You’ll get all the details when next we meet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_InteractMara: Scar’s... well, he hasn’t really been himself lately. He was always a little nuts, but never like this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_InteractOzer: All of my work, my Malachite… Scar made a promise to me… we need to go right now!
I’m sorry, I really don’t have time to talk right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_InteractScar: I can’t get the professor out of here while you’re still hanging around. You have to distract the Ward.
Come on, use the key already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_Iskra_QuestC: And then there were none… exceptional work, my friend. Outstanding.
But you know what matters even more? I was right all along! How was that for a miracle?
Skif! There’s no denying I was right now, is there? What we witnessed was truly a miracle.
What do you know about Strelok?
All there is to know in the Zone. He did what no one has ever done before: he reached the very center of the Zone and revealed Prypiat’s secrets.
I’ve been looking for him for as long as I can remember, but so far all my efforts have been in vain.
Lucky for us, he wasn’t alone on his journey. He had Fang, Ghost, and a Doctor with him. And everyone save for the Doctor is either missing or dead.
Sure, it was pretty impressive. But I’m having a hard time believing it all.
That’s because we were so rudely interrupted. Faith always begins with doubt, but it also culminates in knowledge.
Doesn’t matter. We’ll find another way to contact the Representative. We’ll need to locate the X-Network center where all the visiographs are linked.
The problem is, we don’t know where it is or how to get there. It’s time to go legend hunting, Skif. We need Strelok. If anyone knows about that center, it’s him.
So what are you gonna do next?
You should be asking what you're going to do. To find Strelok, we’ll need to track down the Doctor. He’s the only one from Strelok’s group whose whereabouts aren't a total mystery.
He’s a legend in his own right — he materializes out of thin air, heals everyone he encounters, even mutants, and then vanishes without a trace.
Okay. Where do I find him?
I have no idea, but he’s often sighted in the Red Forest. Listen to the local tall tales; there’s always more truth to them than meets the eye. At the very least, you’ll get a break.
I have a feeling you could use one, hmm?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_KorshunovAft: Go ahead and get the Visiograph going like Dalin told you. I’m eager to know what we were betrayed for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_Korshunov_As: Every minute you waste here means a soldier’s life lost, Skif. Get it done. That’s an order.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_Korshunov_Wa: What did you do to this one?
My men did a thorough search of Promin and found the Emitter. Do you know what that means?
Promin is a link between the Duga and Malachite. The schematics confirm that there’s no other location where the Duga can be activated.
The Duga was launched from Malachite.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_MalahitScien: We’ve been spotted. Stick to the wall. Get down, get down!
Tell me, is it… is it over out there?
It’s a nightmare… I need to report this to “Plain and Simple”...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_MaratGoing_1: Why the fuck did I have to join up? I shoulda stuck to being a loner…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_RadioIskra_r: Eliminate Dalin and Korshunov. If you spot Skif, take him out too. Over and out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_RadioVarta_r: Alpha Team has located the target.
Eliminating Scar and the stalker known as Skif is our top priority. Delta Team is en route to your location. Over and out.
