ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_ScarWaiting_: Are we digging in here or not? Make up your mind!
What if Faust doesn’t have it? What if…
Honestly, not really. Whether we dig in or not, everything is going to change very soon. Do you get it? You will.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_Scar_StartQu: Come in. Do you copy? Is anyone still alive out there?
That’s the kind of news I like to hear! And what about Faust? Is he in the “still alive” category as well?
I like that kind of news even better! Believe it or not, I’m a little sorry he’s gone. He was a true believer. That’s rare.
But enough poetry. Search his body — he’s got to have something on him that can help us. You’ll know it when you see it. Meet me at Malachite.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_SparkAssault: Colonel, Spark’s here! They’ve opened fire! We’re holding our ground and fortifying building A. Awaiting your orders!
Shoot to kill. Take no prisoners.
We have to sweep and clear the hallways, Skif. I’ll escort our luminary here upstairs to keep the Sparker gunmen away from him. I’ll meet you at the entrance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Comment_Varta_QuestC: Dalin, your father was a part of C-Consciousness. Did the Representative remind you of him in any way?
I can’t say… I’m not sure. It all happened so quickly. If I had a bit more time…
No. You won’t spend a moment on this nonsense until we reach the Generators. We have more important matters to attend to than dealing with C-Consciousness hocus-pocus.
But what if it isn’t just hocus-pocus?
You just got to Malachite, and you’re already diving into pseudoscience? I didn’t expect you to question your own expertise so quickly, Doctor.
Great job, Skif. The last few stragglers won’t cause any more trouble here.
What do you think of that Visiograph projection? The Representative... was he real? Or just some kind of hologram?
It’s all smoke and mirrors. Just another C-Consciousness trick. Our focus should remain on the real threat: Scar and his gang.
As for me, I’m not certain of anything anymore. Strelok’s report indicates that he spoke to C-Consciousness in the Monolith control bunker, but at that point, those scientists were still alive.
Today’s events, though... I can’t explain them. But I’m not ready to agree with the colonel that it’s all just a trick.
All right. What’s the next move?
We fucked up our chance to establish a remote connection to the Generators from X11. Now we have to find a way to get there directly through Dead Valley.
There’s only one man who’s ever made it to the center of the Zone and come back with his mind intact: Strelok.
This Strelok seems to be the Zone legend. Is he really that tough?
He did what no one else could. There are rumors that he’s recently returned to the Zone. I tried to track him down shortly after we moved to the Chemical Plant, but to no avail.
He used to lead this group: Fang, Ghost, and the Doctor. The first two are dead, but they say the Doctor’s hiding in the Red Forest. He’s something of a legend too. A very elusive guy.
But it’s all just hearsay. The Doctor is a man like any other. If you find him, we might have a shot at finding a safe route to the Generators. Best of luck.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Int: They’re all dead because of him!
Scar sent me here as a precaution, to make sure that Ozersky doesn’t throw in the towel and gets the installation online in time.
I’ve already said it several times.
That must be a mistake… I can’t believe it…
A mistake?! Your Ozersky is a traitor! My men went mad and died in droves at the Duga, not knowing how to protect themselves!
Sergeant, take the prisoner to the Chemical Plant. Now.
I said repeat it! Word for word!
So what are we gonna do now?
A device resembling the Visiograph was found in the basement of the Clear Sky base. It’s in bad shape, but if Faust managed to activate it, that means he had the key.
It’s the key used to activate the Visiograph. Go ahead and insert it. We’ll join you once the Visiograph goes live.
You searched his body, so you must have come across something — maybe some kind of a pendant or necklace.
Repeat what you told me before.
You killed Ozersky, but not the Sparker. Why?
He might have more information about Spark. And he didn’t betray me.
I can’t afford to doubt my men, Skif. There’s no time to speculate about who might stab me in the back next.
That’s why everyone needs to understand that traitors to the Ward will choke on their own blood.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_MalahitScient: Please, don’t shoot! We’re working at the Institute…
Calm down. Just stay out of my way, and there won’t be any trouble.
Y-yes, of course. We’ll stay quiet.
We’ve been here the whole time.
Calm down, I’m not your enemy. Just tell me what you saw.
We were at our workplaces as usual when that bald officer showed up — stomping around in his exoskeleton, swearing at everyone, stationing his men on every floor… but they didn’t hurt us.
Then the Sparkers arrived... that’s when the bloodshed began. The man who sounded the alarm was shot. I’m not sure which side did it. We took cover here.
How did Spark manage to take over Malachite so fast?
They probably used hidden passages. This isn’t their first visit here — their leader used to have some dealings with Ozersky. They provided him with some components or something.
I see. Stay put. This place should be safe for now.
Yes, of course. If you say so. And here, take this. It might come in handy. Thank you for deciding not to shoot first and ask questions later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_ShramCutscene: Scar, the Ward is at the gates. It’s just a matter of time before they break through.
But of course… fuck! Take care of them, and fast!
Remember, I don’t work for you.
You’re working with me! Over and out.
Skif, I need you to help distract the Ward while I get the professor out. I’ll meet you outside.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_ShramDirectio: There are Wardens near the railroad tunnel too, Skif. You know the drill.
We’re almost clear, but we’ve got snipers here. We need you to distract them.
All right, Skif. Get out of there! Ozersky’s safe. I’ll meet you at the designated coordinates.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Shram_Viziogr: All right. What do I have to do?
Place the key on those controls over there, and hold your breath.
Skif! At last! Did you find it?
It’s the key to something incredibly important, something that’s going to change us all. And it’s all thanks to you and me.
Come. The time of miracles is nigh.
You seem a little on edge. What’s going on?
It’s something I’ve been working towards for years. And now, with your help, I’ve finally reached it! Come on, Skif, let’s not keep everyone waiting.
Terrifying ones. Astonishing ones. And, above all, real ones. Those are the only kinds of miracles we have here in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_Dali: How can we be certain that you’re a real living mind, and not some sort of program or copy of someone’s memory?
You’re correct, Dmytro. A scientist should never take anything on blind faith. In the Zone, there’s a laboratory with a device that can be used to contact the image of a specific individual.
Where can we find this laboratory?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_Shra: So this is what the Shining Zone really is! I knew it in my heart, I believed in it all along! Seek and ye shall find!
The Shining can rid us of the darkness that’s holding us back, preventing us from hearing each other. It will grant us eternal life. No pain, no regret, no suffering.
How can we make this new age come sooner?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_WhoA: Who are you? Or… what are you?
We are C-Consciousness. We were once seven scientists, seven distinct personalities. Now, we exist as one mind.
By merging our consciousnesses, we’ve achieved a direct connection with the Noosphere. I am the Representative of C-Consciousness.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_YouK: We’re aware of everything that happens in the Zone, but we’re not always capable of influencing it.
After SIRCAA tried to replicate the Caribbean Experiment, some of the Anomalous energy seeped into the Mainland. It affected a number of people, but you were the only one who sought the truth.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_dest: Everyone in the Zone thinks Strelok killed you all. How did you manage to survive?
When Strelok went to Lab X7 with the intent of destroying our pods, we were certain that our end was near.
As it turned out, even after our physical demise, our existence persisted within the Noosphere.
Regardless of Strelok’s intentions, any efforts to revive us would have been futile because the merging of our minds is irreversible.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_hell: Greetings, Skif. I know you have a lot of questions for me. Ask them, and then we’ll decide what to do with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_immo: Since you survived, does that mean the Noosphere is an extension of life?
The Noosphere is much more than just the Earth’s information field.
Thanks to the Zone, sentient beings can achieve eternal life in the form of Subtle Matter — pure consciousness, free from the constraints and limitations of a physical body.
However, should anyone attempt to harness the Anomalous energy, it will inevitably result in the annihilation of all Subtle Matter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_Dialog_Soznanie_what: What are you trying to achieve?
After the reckless intervention by SIRCAA, the structure of the Noosphere was damaged, isolating individual Subtle Matter images from one another.
The Shining will reinstate the right to immortality for all sentient beings in the Zone — and, eventually, for all of mankind.

From then on, our liberated consciousnesses will gain the ability to communicate directly with one another, facilitating the free exchange of knowledge and experience. It will be the dawn of a new age.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_docent_leonid_hoffma: Your sense of timing appears to be lacking, I must say.
Well, what can I say? All this chaos within the confines of the temple of science is something new indeed.
We got a little distracted there…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_professor_vsevolod_m: What? No, I can't talk to you right now.
I warned Ozersky that chumming around with those Sparkers would lead to no good. And look where we are now! We could easily end up catching a stray bullet in these hallways.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E09_MQ01_starsij_laborant_gri: Oh, no. I didn’t sign up for this. Help!
Are you sure I’m the one you're looking for?
I’m sorry, but it’s hard for me to think clearly under these circumstances.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Audiolog_DeadSivyj_1: Arkhyp, can you hear me? Arkhyp! It’s Gray! Fucking anomaly!
Tundra got shot! We'd just set up shop right where the Doctor was spotted. I figured if we saw him, we’d hand him over to the mercs. Now Tundra’s guts are hanging out!
I couldn’t even see where the shot came from! Could've been anywhere. Tundra’s a dead man walking! You gotta tell... Please, don’t…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Audiolog_DeadTundra_: Gray abandoned me... The Anomaly blocks the signal.
Don't come out, Doctor. Wherever you... don't come out... Those mercenaries are searching for you... I saw them near the village...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_ArhipAfterQu: Oh, it’s you, stalker. Found what you were looking for?
Whatever. Hornet’s gone. Gray’s dead and buried. There ain’t a soul left to hunt in this place. I’m just gonna sell off the last of my stuff, and that’s it.
This forest got the best of us. It’s no place for ordinary folks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_ArhipMeetBef: Welcome, loner! We don't have much here, but we’re always glad to welcome guests.
If you wanna hunt, I’ve got a stockpile of ammo and guns for any game you’re after, deer or boar, you name it.
Of course, I’ve got a stash of medkits, too, in case the hunt goes sideways. If you need anything, just give me a holler.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_ArhipOnInter: I already told you everything, stalker. You’ve got the coordinates for the clearing on your PDA. Now let me concentrate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_Cemetery_1_5: We got that scumbag! Ha ha! Did anyone catch where he went? I’m forwarding the coordinates to the client. Watch my back!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_Cemetery_1_6: Commander, there’s someone else trying to flank us!
Take ’em all down! Must be a grateful patient coming to the rescue!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_DocOnInterac: Hurry up. He doesn’t have much time. I’ll take him inside once he's stable.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_HuntersFirst: Taking him here was a mistake! We risked our necks just lugging him back, and you wanted to search the clearing too!
Calm down. He saved your life six months ago. We couldn’t just leave him behind.
Dead folks don’t give a fuck where they rest. But I do. I mean, who could do this to a human being?!
I know who: it’s those mercenaries. They were looking for the Doctor, and they found Gray instead.
Bullshit! Mercs wouldn’t do something like this.
People ain’t mutants — they’re capable of anything. Now hush. I’ve gotta figure out what mauled Gray like that. Maybe then we can hunt the fuckers down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_SivyjBodyInt: Stay away from him, loner. If you’ve got something to say, spit it out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_SkifIdle_doi: Why are you poking around here? If you’ve got something to say, make it snappy. I’m already on edge.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_VolkodavCall: Alpha Team – we’ve tracked him down to the cemetery. We need backup ASAP. I repeat: everyone, get your asses over here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Comment_YarlSaveThem: Help ’em, stalker. They might not be angels, but they sure as hell don’t deserve this. I’m gonna take a breather, maybe catch a few winks.
He’s about to off ’em all! You gotta help ’em, stalker. He’s gonna wipe ’em all out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_ArhipAboutSit: Sorry, loner, not a good time. We’re not open for business right now.
So why don’t you get the fuck outta here? And shut the door on your way out.
We’re not open for business, but we can chat. Keep it short, you can see what’s going on here.
If those mercs were behind it, watch your step out there. And if it wasn’t them, be even more careful.
Better yet, get out of here while you still can — before it gets worse.
I’m looking for the Doctor. I heard you might know where to find him.
You too?! Are you working with the mercs, you son of a bitch?! Answer me!
Put the gun down. Now. And you, loner — why are you so interested in the Doctor?
What are you guys doing here, anyway?
Breeding Fleshes for a stew! We’re hunting, what else? We can’t all go anomaly diving and playing detective.
Sometimes scientists cut us a check for some mutants, or Freedom tosses us a job. Life’s pretty decent here. Or at least it used to be.
I used to feel at home in these woods. But now… it’s like I’m locked up all over again, like that one time back in Garbage — enemies everywhere, nowhere to run.
We’ll find them.
Or they’ll find us first, just like Gray.
So where should I start looking for him?
Gray was gonna stake out a place where the Doctor was spotted before. It was a while ago, but I don't have any other leads. If it was those mercs, maybe they left something behind.
So that’s why you’ve been chattering away for two hours straight, huh? You’re thinking of sending a loner to snoop around the clearing?
You’re after the Doctor, stalker, and I’m looking for the bastards who did Gray in. Why don’t we lend each other a hand?
Don’t listen to him, loner. Two fellas took on Myklukha's job: Gray and a new guy. You can see what’s left of ’em. Something's fishy. If you go after them, you might not make it back either.
I’ll give it a thought.
Are these mercs looking for the Doctor too?
They swung by the other day, asking where the Doctor was at, where he was last seen. Throwing money around, so I told 'em as much as I could.
If I’d known what would come of it… I'd have shut my fucking trap, as Hornet would say.
No one knows where the Doctor lives. All we know is he helps the wounded, both human and mutant. He saved my life some five years ago.
Why didn’t your buddy the doctor step in for Gray, huh? Too busy stitching a tentacle back to a Bloodsucker’s ass? Or are we hunters worse than mutants?
If he didn’t help, he couldn’t. Or didn’t want to. Or maybe the mercs got to him first.
None of your business.
Fine by me. But tracking him down ain’t gonna be a piece of cake.
So you’ve seen the Doctor?
Just like I see you right now. Except I had a hole in my gut, so the memory’s a little hazy. I saw a shadowy figure, and then I woke up in the clearing.
My wound was all cleaned and patched up, and my radio was even charged. The guys said I was missing for a week.
So don’t pay attention to Hornet. The Doctor never hurt anyone — he's all about helping folks.
I’m looking for Strelok. The Doctor knows where to find him.
I don’t know why you need Strelok, but finding the Doctor ain’t exactly a walk in the park either.
Tell me more about the Doctor.
Want me to do a little dance for you while I'm at it? Everybody’s got questions about him — first the mercs, now the loners…
It can’t get much worse. The Doctor is a legend around here. Nobody really knows where he’s holed up, but if you’re injured, he’ll track you down and lend a hand. Well, at least he used to.
I’m telling you, it was the Doctor. We’ve been hunting his pets. That’s why he came after us.
You’re an idiot, Hornet. The Doctor saved my ass once, and I’ve been in the hunting business around here for a solid decade.
Thanks for the help — and the heads-up.
Who did him in?
I wish I knew. Two of our guys went on a job for Myklukha, and we found one of ’em close by… like this.
It might be those mercs that just showed up here. Hell knows what they're up to.
Nah, mercs are all right. They get their pay, they do their thing. But Gray… Someone went out of their way to make him suffer – cutting him up real slow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_DidYou: Is he going to make it?
I’ve treated worse injuries – even on Monolithians. Especially on Monolithians.
He spilled a lot of blood to get here – his own, and other people’s.
And so did you, I imagine. I’m aware of what he’s done, but he’s injured and needs help. That’s all that matters to me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_HeKill: So, it was him who killed the mercenaries and hunters.
They were a bait. A way to catch my attention.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_HelpHu: Why didn’t you help the hunters? Or the mercs?
How many lives can a dead doctor save? Sometimes you need to make small sacrifices so you can save more lives later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_INeedD: So this is what the real Doctor looks like.
Do you know him? This Monolithian?
That’s a good name. An honest name. You were looking for the Doctor? Well, you’ve found him. Now what do you want from me?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_KillYo: Why are you so concerned about his life?
Because it’s the only thing we truly possess, no matter how bad we believe it to be.
Now go. Don’t waste any more time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_Regene: A creation of C-Consciousness. It helps the Monolithians to heal even the most grievous injuries and get radiation out of their bodies faster.
Unfortunately, it only works on those who lack resistance to external control after being completely stripped of psi-immunity.
Trading one’s freedom for the chance to wander through the CNPP during an Emission is a devil’s bargain, but no one asked their opinion on the matter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_Strelo: I’m looking for any information about Strelok. I know you two have some history.
I doubt Strelok’s figured out how to bring the dead back to life. So it’s up to us to help Strider. Everything else can wait.
You think there’s still a chance to help him?
In a way, Strider’s fortunate to be a Monolithian. There’s something that can help men like him, but not us.
I’ve marked a former Monolithian hospital on your PDA. If they’ve tapped into the old stashes, you might find a regenerator there.
Along with the Monolithians themselves, of course. I’d ask you to spare the wounded and keep them alive, but it’s your call, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_WhyHel: I’ve heard that you treat both humans and mutants. Why?
Because none of them are responsible for what’s going on here – not the stalkers, not the mutants, not even the Monolithians.
And also because everyone has to pay their dues someday.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_hi2_70: He didn't kill them by choice. The Monolith guided him to hunt me with live bait
And I won't let you finish him. Enough deaths.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_Doctor_hi_580: If you’ve come to finish him off, it’s not gonna happen. No more bloodshed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_1_58: Stalker? What… what are you doing here? Ouch, it hurts…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Clie: I have no idea. Nobody’s ever seen the guy. And his jobs always turn out bad. He sent my pal to Wild Island after SIRCAA went kaboom.
Never heard from him again. We should never have taken this job. Bad call…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Doct: We were looking for him too. But he got to us first.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Find: Don’t. He’s not even human. Those eyes of his…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Him_: The Doctor! It was him! He’s the one who took out those hunters, then came gunning for us. He knew we were onto him.
I couldn’t do anything. He dropped two of our guys with a sniper rifle – bang, bang – gone! Then he walked right through the radiation.
I put two rounds in him, and the guy didn’t even blink! Next thing I knew, he was right up in my face, point blank. I’ve used up all my medkits…
I’m not gonna make it, am I?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Medk: Thanks, loner. I hope the guys get back soon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Merc: I’m looking for the mercs who killed the hunters.
We’re the mercs, but we didn’t kill anybody.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_No_6: I knew it. I should’ve gone with Wolfhound…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Nois: That’s our signal. When it’s blasting at full volume, it means trouble: make a run for it and don’t look back.
But what if someone follows the sound back here?
Bring ’em on. I’m as good as gone already, as you can see. At least I can give the guys a fighting chance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_MercCamp_Orde: We were sent here to track down the Doctor. I told Wolfhound not to take the job. We don’t even know the client!
I figured we’d be safe here, with all these anomalies and radiation around… but he just plowed right through, you know?! The Geiger’s off the charts, and he’s just strolling around…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_Dialog_ShershenjAfte: You really think the Doctor killed Gray?
You saw the body. He was killed slowly. They wanted him to suffer. Why the heck would mercs do something like that?
The Doctor's always helped mutants. I remember this one time I shot a boar that damn near tore me apart. A month later, I stumbled across the same boar sporting a nasty scar on its snout.
Lucky for me, I had my brand-new shotgun. Had to put that boar down for good. That Doctor of yours is off his rocker. Totally fucked up.
I guess Freedom can handle this. I wanted to ask about something else.
Five years in the Zone, and I never had to bury a single soul. Can you believe it? Must’ve been one lucky guy.
Now I guess my luck’s run dry.
What kind of job was Gray doing out there?
A bunch of Freedom guys set up a secret stash in a cave. Well, not that secret, really, but no one here wants to mess with Myklukha.
But the mutants don’t give a damn about Myklukha and his crew. One of those freaks took over the cave, and Freedom lost their stash.
They won’t risk going in themselves, so they hired us. But I swear, I ain’t settin' foot in that forest ever again — not even if all of Freedom goes bankrupt.
I’m not gonna try to talk you out of it. I just hope it goes better for you than it did for Gray.
What are you gonna do now?
Why do you care? Poking around, asking questions. I’ll live. But if you keep wandering around these woods, you might not.
Eh, whatever. Maybe the Zone's trying to talk some sense into me. I used to be the hunter, now I'm the prey. Guess it’s time to head to Rostok.
If I’m gonna buy the farm, I’d rather do it making some coupons than chasing after deer tails and old fairy tales.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_arhip_lisajnik_0_Bus: Can’t you see I’m busy? Later, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_arhip_lisajnik_0_Bye: Make sure you don't get taken for a mutant in these woods.
Feel free to drop by anytime!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_arhip_lisajnik_0_Hel: I thought you were a mutant or something. But now I see it’s just you.
Glad you stopped by! What can I do for you?
Looking to buy or sell? Or are you just here to shoot the breeze?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_arhip_lisajnik_0_Inf: The Red Forest has been through a lot: the First Disaster, then the Second… and it’ll outlive us all, stalker. Every last one of us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_arhip_lisajnik_0_Tra: Be quick about it. Take what you need and get lost.
If anything goes south, just swing by, and I’ll find a replacement!
Well, that’s what I’ve got. The prices are fair, and the stuff is good.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_arl_0_InfoTopic_1_1_: Ever since the Ward showed up in the Zone, going back to the Mainland’s been off the table. We know too much. My only ambition is to outlast that damn colonel, loner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_bolotnyj_doktor_0_In: People who I find and treat often condemn their destiny and the Zone. But action always causes a proportionate reaction. What if stalkers themselves are to blame for the Zone's cruelty?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_bolotnyj_doktor_0_Re: We've been interrupted. Let's continue, it's important.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_doktor_kajmanov_0_In: People who I find and treat often condemn their destiny and the Zone. But action always causes a proportionate reaction. What if stalkers themselves are to blame for the Zone's cruelty?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_doktor_kajmanov_0_NP: He doesn't belong here anymore. There's nothing I can do to help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_doktor_kajmanov_0_Re: We've been interrupted. Let's continue, it's important.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_sersen_0_HelloTopic_: What? You got nothing else to do?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_sersen_0_InfoTopic_1: I don’t buy these “legends.” Strelok, the Doctor… I heard all sorts of stories about the Zone back on the Mainland. And what’s it really like? Your guts on a tree — there’s your happy ending.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ01_sersen_0_InfoTopic_2: I was a park ranger back on the Mainland, protecting the four-legged beasts from the two-legged ones. Then I came to the Zone, but the critters here are pretty good at protecting themselves.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_KaimanovInte: I need to clean this place up… myself too.
Please hurry. If Valentyn was right… it could change everything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_Monolith_Hel: Monolith, help our brethren in their recovery!
Your enemies are many, and every brother is invaluable.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_Monolith_Los: What’s my name? I keep forgetting it… maybe I never even knew it...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_Monolith_Rep: Skirmish at the Boundary. Casualties among the brothers. The wounded will be delivered in time.
Copy that. I will make sure they get the opportunity to avenge their injuries.
Skirmish at the Boundary. Casualties among the brothers. The wounded will be delivered in time.
Copy that. I will make sure they get the opportunity to avenge their injuries.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_Monolith_SoC: I'm so cold… why am I always so cold?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_Monolith_Why: What am I doing here? Why am I…
It does not matter. The Monolith will show me the way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_Monolith_Wou: I saw it again! As if I was someone else…
It was just a nightmare. We have no other life beyond our devotion to Him. The Monolith is testing your faith. Do not avert your gaze from His radiance.
What if the treatment fails? How can I serve the Monolith without my arm?
If you have faith, it will succeed. And if your faith isn’t strong enough… I will help you find redemption for that sin. Without needless suffering.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Comment_PortnoyPray_: May your light shine down on the souls of the brave, who gave their lives in service to your will.
Reveal the cunning plans of your enemies to us.
Give us the power to avenge our fallen brethren.
Those in eternal union with the Monolith can never be stopped!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_Ab: A Zone open to… everyone? That sounds kinda dangerous.

That’s because it’s the only way you see it — frightened and caged, born amid evil and violence. What else could the Zone have evolved into in a place where both humans and nature are nothing more than test subjects?
If it had been born into freedom, like Tiger, it might have evolved differently – into a Zone of creation rather than destruction.
And then we might have become different too. We always had the ability to overcome the circumstances. Access to the Noosphere would’ve made us better, even if it meant a rough start.
Understanding and forgiving each other is a difficult endeavor.
Why did you refuse to get in the pod?
Because I’ve always held on to my belief in humanity. My “colleagues,” on the other hand, advocated for “fixing” it through the Noosphere, purging it of “darkness.”
How could I consent to such a notion? How could I permit them to rob all of humanity not just of its ability to act freely, but even to think independently?
Everything “dark” and “light” about us is a result of our own choices. The Zone was born in a place of tragedy and horrific experiments, but I believe in a different Zone – a Zone open to everyone.
What do you know about Subtle Matter?
It was a theory developed by Valentyn Dalin, the leader of C-Consciousness. Apparently, he’s now become the image of the Representative.
Back in the day, he ridiculed my calculations regarding the existence of the Noosphere, while I firmly believed that Subtle Matter was unscientific.
In the end, I turned out to be right. But if he was also close to the truth, that changes everything.
According to his theory, Subtle Matter can preserve a reflection of a person’s mind, their personality. If you’re implying the Representative is real, that means they actually succeeded.
Before me, Strelok was the only one who’d spoken to the Representative. But that was back in 2012, before C-Consciousness died. Strelok managed to reach the center of the Zone and return unscathed.
Then Strelok probably knows more about Subtle Matter than I do — along with the psi-technologies that C-Consciousness has mastered during their six years of frenetic activity.
Chances are, he’s still researching it to this day.
So you were the one who created the Zone?
Me? No, certainly not. The Zone created itself. I merely facilitated its emergence. Although my colleagues and I had different expectations for the outcome of our experiment…
You see these blind dogs? I’ve been trying to tame them for years, but they were born in a lab, where they’ve known nothing but pain and fear.
But Tiger here found me on his own. He just came out of the woods one day and tried to steal a sausage. He was born free and had the freedom to make his own choices, you see?
The Zone is our collective offspring, but all we’ve imparted to it is suffering and sorrow. It doesn’t know any other way. Maybe we’re the same.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_CC: The scientists you mentioned, C-Consciousness. They’re still alive.
No. That can’t be… Strelok dealt with them back in 2012!
I spoke to the Representative through the Visiograph in Malachite. They still exist in some kind of form he called “Subtle Matter.”
Subtle Matter? But that’s impossible! That means… it’s still going on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_Do: Thanks for your help. Whatever happened to “life is the only thing we truly possess”?
Frankly, choosing between the two of you wasn’t easy. Wasn’t my first time, but it only gets harder over the years.
But if you don’t make the choice, someone else will make it for you. And it usually ends up being worse.
I’m not fond of thinking for others or giving advice, but I get the feeling Strider would approve of the choice I made – however strange it might sound.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_Ei: The human brain is too frail to handle a direct connection to the Noosphere on its own. In order for it to work, we required eight participants in pods filled with a specific solution.
I was supposed to be in one of those pods, but I just couldn’t bring myself to do it. Valentyn reproached me for my lack of courage, but given how things turned out, I was actually too daring.
In the end, what we got wasn’t control over the Noosphere, but rather the Zone itself – the lesser of two evils, if you ask me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_No: Immortality in the Noosphere? No, it’s gotta be something else.
Dealing with “something else” is what science in the Zone is all about. So let’s take a more critical approach and apply the method of exclusion.
But keep in mind that this isn’t just about science, stalker. It’s about the fate of the Zone… and your own role in it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_Ok: I want to find out if Subtle Matter is real. Things like this shouldn’t be left to blind faith.
The scientific method isn’t just about the experiment, it’s about being able to replicate it. And I happen to know how to test a few of my hunches.
If only Valentyn could see me now… Well, perhaps he can.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_St: That’s why I’m looking for Strelok. Word is, he’s back in the Zone.
I haven’t seen him in quite some time. Maybe that’s for the best. Our perspectives on the Zone have probably developed quite differently over the years.
If your information is correct, I doubt he’s ventured too far from the Cordon. Men like him tend to develop a deep attachment to a place they regard as their own and refuse to let go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_go: We tried to connect to the Noosphere, as an experiment, in the Orbita underground lab. Back then, I saw nothing like the afterlife, but now, with the Zone…
I think the truth is worth taking a risk. But first, you need to get the cartridge from the Signature station in a different lab – X3 near the Cordon.
It’s been twenty years and the entrances I knew of are long destroyed. But stalkers always find a way. Talk to Sidorovich, he’s in charge of the Cordon and could’ve heard such stories of X3.
I’ll send you the code to the cartridge slot. Take it and head to Orbita. Good luck.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_se: And so you’ve solved yet another mystery of the Zone, stalker. Perhaps the most unsettling one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_DrKaimanov_tr: Dr. Kaymanov. Pleased to meet you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_KaimanovCall_: Get under the dome and head to the basement. Waiting for you there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_MQ02_Dialog_Kaimanov_Asks: Tell me… did you kill them there, at the hospital?
I did what I had to do.
Of course. We all do what we must.
Thank you. I understand it wasn’t easy, but… thank you. It’s important to remember that not all of us are like these caged dogs. We can make our own choices.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_SQ01_Comment_Arhip_RadioQ: You’d have made a fine hunter, loner. Too bad it didn’t work out that way.
You know, Gray would’ve appreciated what you did. You finished his last job. Now he can rest in peace.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_SQ01_Dialog_Arhip_StartSe: What about Gray’s job? Is it still good?
Yeah, but there’s no one left to do it. Freedom stashed their loot in a boar cave to keep stalkers out. But then another mutant moved in and chased off both the boars and Freedom.
If you can take it out, the reward is yours. But watch out, Freedom’s stingy with their money. If they’re willing to pay and risk their stash, that means that the critter is a serious threat.
I guess Freedom can handle it. Let’s talk about something else.
I’m not gonna try to talk you out of it. I just hope it goes better for you than it did for us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E10_SQ01_Dialog_Arhip_StartWi: You said Gray was doing some kind of job. Is the job still good?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Kajmanov_Orb: Skif, it’s Kaymanov. Did you make it into X3?
What about Signature station? Is the data still there?
I’ve got it. It wasn’t quite what I expected.
Yes, it’s just a cartridge. Take it to Orbita. I’ve sent you the coordinates. We’re getting close to the truth, Skif. So very close…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Merc2_NeedTo: I need a rope and a clip, guys. Quick!
The fucker got Butterball real bad. We gotta get him out of here before he passes out.
Copy that! I’ll be there in two minutes, Vulture.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Merc_Ambush_: You’ve got company, Vulture. A loner.
Okay. We’ll give him a warm welcome.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Merc_Correct: I told you, Dark’s at his place. Down the hall and to the right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Merc_Looting: Check out the one in the corner.
He’s after the PDAs of everyone who works with Dark. Why disappoint him?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Merc_Warning: Well lookee here, Screamer! Quite the curious stalker we got here, huh?
Curiosity killed the stalker, but not this one…yet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Roosevelt_Di: What the fuck is that? Where’d you dig this thing up?
You’ll end up with a bullet in your dome if this thing jams in a fight!
Clean it up! You got the whole arsenal tonight. And if I spot even one speck of dust… Ugh, what a dumbass!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_RuzveltRadio: We’ve got you in our sights, stalker.
You want to talk? Keep your cool, and the guys will let you in. You have my word.
You weren't so quiet this time, Skif. My men have had you in their crosshairs for a while.
You want to talk? Back at the Commissary, we managed to part on good terms. Maybe we can do that again. Come on in. Keep your cool, and the guys will let you pass. You have my word.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_RuzveltThank: Sidorovich put quite a price tag on our fuckup. But hey, we’re all still breathing.
I keep my word too. Take these coordinates. Anything you find, it’s all yours. Appreciate it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_RuzveltWelco: Zero discipline. And I can’t say I’m thrilled to see you either, Skif.
I know your type. Wherever you go, death follows.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Temnyj_CantO: Tsk-tsk, stalker. That’s wasn't our deal.
Cleanup first. The rest can wait.
I know you’re getting off on this. There's only a few left, so enjoy it while you can.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Temnyj_Doors: Just one more push, and we’re there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Temnyj_IfSki: See? I told you, you can't open it without me. It’s got a secret lock.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Temnyj_Pseud: Get that fucker closer to me. I’m up here. I’ll cover you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Temnyj_SaveM: Hey, you’re pretty good at this. We make a hell of a team.
Keep going. I’m almost there. If you make it, I’ll owe you one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Temnyj_There: It’s no good, Skif. It’s rusted shut.
All right. I’ll take the main entrance, and you find the back door. It’s gotta be somewhere near you. I’ll be in touch. Once I reach the door, I’ll need you. We can’t get it open without the decoder.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Comment_Thugs_AboutH: Looks like we can kiss the dough goodbye, bro. I told ya – never take a gig unless they pay up front!
Don’t worry, the clock’s tickin’. We’re over here fuckin’ around, while his debt’s gettin’ bigger. If this creep doesn’t show up, we’ll just sell his package to someone else.
Must be a pretty decent gizmo if he’s payin’ that much for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Kit_AboutRedM: I’m interested in the old lab here at the Cordon. Maybe one of your patients said something about it?
They say all sorts of things, especially when the strong painkillers kick in.
I’ve heard about the lab too. Just a few months back, Red got woozy after a shot and started babbling about embryos, test tubes, Snorks… “Stay away from it,” he kept saying.
Man, that was quite a side effect. I even had to double the dose in his IV bag the next day. Messed him up pretty bad.
Oh, he’s a legend around here. I’m surprised you haven’t heard of him.
He saved Strelok himself back in the day — yanked him out of a death truck, barely alive, and dragged him over to Sidorovich.
He can spin that tale for you himself... when he gets back, that is.
He’s got a schedule. Two weeks out in the Zone, then a couple days here. You won’t believe the stories he has to tell about his adventures.
He’s running late this time, though. I haven’t seen him in about three weeks.
Do you think the lab story was just gibberish?
I’m pretty sure. Trust me, I’m a doctor. Given the state Red was in, I had to pump him full of painkillers. Textbook side effect.
Besides, I asked him about the lab after he came to.
He was quite surprised to find out he told me about it earlier. Red’s a terrible liar, mind you. Blushes right away. It’s just his nature.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Merc_WhoAreYo: Who the hell are you, anyway?
The cat in the fucking hat.
It’s pretty simple, loner. We ask, and you answer. What are you doin’ here?
Looks like an interesting place. I was hoping to find some loot.
Whatever loot we have, it definitely ain’t yours.
Now scram, loner. Go look for trinkets somewhere else.
Is Dark around? I need him.
Hey, Screamer! Have you seen Dark?
He’s probably at his place. Come on, let him in. He’s a big boy, he can find his way around.
Where do you think you’re going, loner?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Multik_AboutS: Have you heard anything about the old lab at the Cordon? Gossip? Rumors?
Well, a couple of years back, I got a weird order from a rookie. Wanted an electronic lockpick.
He’d just gotten to the Cordon and stumbled across an unusual door. He said the lock was based on some kinda old electronics. Wanted my help unlocking the place, or whatever.
So you made a lockpick for him? Something like this one?
Uh, nope. That’s way out of my league.
Mine was way simpler, more like a stun gun. Zaps the circuit boards, and bam! You’re in.
Did he mention the location of this door?
Why would I risk my neck? Here in the Zone, all you get behind doors like that is teeth and claws. Tried and tested.
Do you know where that stalker is now?
Nope. He took the lockpick, and that was the last I saw of him.
I reckon he’s lying somewhere just on the other side of that door. When things go well, my customers usually come back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Roosevelt_Non: Sidorovich sent me. You’ve got his package.
So that was Sidorovich’s courier? Fuck! I had a feeling the job was fishy.
Fair enough. I’ll pass your apology on to Sidorovich.
Then it’s all yours. You sort it out with him, and I’ll owe you one. You have my word.
You’re in trouble. You shouldn’t have messed with someone else’s courier.
Are you trying to lecture me? Here in the Zone, whatever isn’t nailed down is mine. That’s how it’s always been.
You’re not in a position to make demands. Give me the package.
So that’s how it is, eh? But the package is worth something, and your life ain’t.
Hand over the package, and we won’t have a problem.
Yeah, of course... on one condition.

If you’re here, that means we’re on Sidorovich's naughty list. The last thing I need now is a war with him. I gotta protect my guys — they’re all I’ve got. The Monolith took the rest of 'em out at Garbage.
That’s why I’d rather have a sit-down with Sidorovich. If you put in a good word for us, I’m sure we can come to an arrangement.
We’ve got our eyes on you, kid. Keep your finger off the trigger. Who are you? What’s your business here?
Who tipped you off about the courier?
I’m just trying to make ends meet after the Monolith slaughtered my men at Garbage. No questions asked.
If somebody pays, I’ll take the job. All I care about is coupons, not names.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Ruzvelt_About: We’ve got no reason to shoot at each other right now. Make sure Sidorovich knows that.
And add something of your own. Something eloquent.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Ruzvelt_MyDam: Well, whose pretty little toes have I stepped on this time?
I doubt you’re here to catch up with an old friend.
You crossed Sidorovich. And he’s not happy.
Fuck! I had a hunch that courier job was fishy.
But, you know, in times like these, you gotta do what you gotta do to survive.
Fair enough. Hand me the package, and I’ll pass your apology on to Sidorovich.
Here. You sort it out with him, and I’ll owe you one. You have my word.
You’re not in a position to make demands, Roosevelt. Just give me the cargo.
Not in a position, ha? The Zone is my witness, I tried to settle this quietly. But I guess it just wasn’t meant to be.
Who tipped you off about the courier?
I couldn’t care less about names these days, Skif. Only coupons. And that was one sweet gig.
Yeah, I shoved my ethics up my ass, imagine that. And I don’t regret it one bit.
Besides, I owe it to my guys. They didn’t ditch me at the Commissary when I was down. They might be no different from Rodents, but I’m just like them now. At least I’m alive.
How did you end up here? A stickup? Sounds too petty for someone like you.
I had to move here. It was the will of the fucking Monolith.
You have no idea what those whackjobs did at Garbage. We ain’t even human beings to them, Skif. We’re just filthy rodents that need a bullet or a boot to get out of their way.
I need the cargo that Sidorovich’s courier had with him, Roosevelt.
Sure, I’ll hand it over… on one condition.
The last thing I need right now is a war with Sidorovich, but after this, he’ll probably shoot me on sight. However, he might be willing to talk about our fate with you.
You’re in trouble, Roosevelt. You shouldn’t have messed with someone else’s courier.
Are you trying to lecture me? Here in the Zone, whatever isn’t nailed down is mine. That’s how it’s always been.
No deal, then.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_SidorovichAbo: The bandits don’t want to start a war with you. They said they didn’t know the courier was yours, and they’re hoping you’ll understand.
They realized whose pie they stuck their fingers in, eh?
Fine, they can live. I'll find some use for those idiots.
Guess I shouldn’t ask what happened to the bandits, huh?
You were looking for a package? I got it. Now tell me everything you know about X3.
I thought you had everything under control here.
I do. You did the job in the end, didn’t you?
And those couriers… if they stopped getting' into trouble, I wouldn’t be able to sleep at night. ’Cuz it just wouldn’t feel like the Zone anymore.
The bandits at the station have been taken care of. They won’t bother you anymore.
Looks like you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty. I’ll remember that. It’s for the best, though. I ain’t gonna shed a tear for ’em.
So, you wanted to hear about X3. All right. Here’s the scoop.
Not long ago, a little birdie told me the Swamps were swarming with folk looking for artifacts. All because someone found a way into an old base, proving the rumors right.

The bald forest prick kept bragging about how business was booming. I was intrigued. So I started digging into our local goss. And the most interesting rumor I heard was the Oasis. Right here at the Cordon.
You’re a crafty guy, Skif. This is the second time you’ve jumped into a risky deal, and yet you’re still in one piece. A rare talent. Folks like you are where Zone legends come from.
I knew a stalker once, called the Marked One. Much like you, he jumped into all kinds of risky gigs, no questions asked. A valuable and rare talent. Folks like that are where Zone legends come from.
Are you suggesting I find the entrance myself? Where?
Not just suggesting. If we’re the only ones who know the way to the Oasis, that information could be worth a pretty penny.
As for where… ask the locals. Someone might’ve heard more than I. Sometimes even campfire gossip ain’t all bullshit.
The Oasis? What’s that?
A stalker’s dream come true. A Klondike with more artifacts than you can shake a stick at.
Imagine the opportunities if this legend happens to be the real deal.
Somebody who's got “full of shit” written all over his face.
He was just messing with me. And when the time came to back it up, he vanished. Poof! Gone for good.
Who told you about the Oasis, anyway?
What is the link between the Oasis and X3?
I've seen some documents where it was listed under the number three. Oasis - three, your X - also three. See where I'm going?
We're looking for the same thing. Or, at least, for something closely connected. Because, according to those documents. the only way to the Oasis is through the abandoned laboratory.
But here's the catch. We have the key to the door — the decoder you took from the bandits. But where is this door? Hell knows.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_SidorovichInf: I need to get to X3. Do you know where it is?
I am  busting my ass trying to find it, and you waltz in here expecting me to serve it to you on a silver platter?
How the hell did you get word of it?
Okay, I’ll get your delivery back. Where did your people find the courier again?
Not far from here, near the old vehicle station.
Just make sure the package gets here in one piece. As for the bandits, do whatever you want. If you take ’em out, I might even add a tip.
All right, let’s cut to the chase. I don’t give a damn why the hell you want X3. But since we’re both in the know now, how about a little swap? I’ll tell you what I know, and you do me a favor. Deal?
The Doctor told me about it.
You’re quite a well-connected stalker. If it’s the Doctor himself, those rumors must be true after all.
It doesn’t matter. You've got your sources, and I've got mine.
I know all about your sources. "Stalker-FM". You think you’re the first guy at the Cordon to yap about this stuff?
Who are these thugs? How many, and what guns are they carrying?
Some douchebags from Garbage, I guess. Looks like they figured they could wait Monolith out at my Cordon.
But they forgot one thing: in the Zone, you can get killed anywhere, especially if you rain on your host’s parade.
What do you want me to do?
I need you to retrieve a package for me.
Some thugs offed the courier who was supposed to bring it to me. My men found him dead, and the package was missing.
I really don’t like folks sticking their ugly noses in my business. Do you catch my drift?
Is there something of value in that package?
I’m not interested in cheap junk.
Return the package, and I’ll make sure it’s worth your while.
You got any gossip about X3? I’m all ears.
Let’s put it this way: if these stories pan out, it’s a win for both of us. The Cordon and me.
That’s all you need to know for now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Strelok_After: The Doctor told me about X3. It seems like the two of you have some history. He sent me here to test a theory.
Kaymanov? Yeah, he helped me get to the center of the Zone to take down C-Consciousness.

Now he’s using other people to fix his own mistakes... How convenient. He used to be part of C-Consciousness. He would’ve gotten into one of those pods himself if he hadn’t escaped at the last minute.
What kind of nonsense did he feed you? Something about the old experiments of the dearly departed, and the data that might still be here?
Induced illusion? Like Faust’s phantoms?
Like the phantoms, the Wish Granter, the Visiographs, the Scorcher…
Or the Shining Zone. Do you want a peek? It’s right here. You can grab the data the Doctor wants along the way. Just be sure to shut it down on your way out.
Why are you here, Skif?
Dark had no choice, unlike you. Who are you working for? If you lie, I’ll know it.
Have you ever heard of the Subtle Matter theory? Kaymanov wants to test it.
Immortality in the Noosphere? The C-Consciousness scientists are dead. I killed them. All of them. And took a piece of glass from one of their pods as a keepsake.
It’s real. And so were the bullets. Subtle Matter is an induced illusion, a psi-radiation technology C-Consciousness used to manipulate people.
So the mercs are your friends, then? You’re playing dirty. You put a hit on Dark… and maybe others, too?
When you’re fighting against everyone, you use what you’ve got. They were my backup plan. Since you’re here, it failed. The Zone is no stranger to death.
I talked to the Representative of C-Consciousness. In Malachite.
They’re dead. I killed them... all of them. I even kept a piece of glass from one of their pods. It was real.
What you witnessed was an induced illusion, a psi-radiation technology C-Consciousness used to manipulate people.
I’m with Spark. They know what’s really going on in the Zone. Maybe they can help me find a new place to call home, too.
You’re like a moth drawn to a flame, ready to get burned to ashes.
Scar’s trained to follow orders. Clear Sky used to call the shots. That's when he almost got me.
But who’s he answering to now? I don’t think you bothered to ask.
At least with Scar, I know what he stands for. But you? I have no idea what you want.
I want the Zone to be left alone.
All that common good Scar and Korshunov talk about is just a smokescreen. What they really want is to control the Zone, each in his own way.
No. The Zone doesn’t owe anyone a thing. Realizing this made me an enemy to both the Ward and Spark. And how exactly did you find out about X3?
What about Dark? What did you do to him?
I didn't do anything. It was the “TVs” – they're neurovisual programmers.
Those previously affected by them can’t survive another exposure.
What do you mean, Dark had no choice?
He’s a C-Consciousness Agent. Killing me was just a program planted in his head.
Those who made it to the center of the Zone got the short end of the stick. Their “prize” was either to join Monolith and protect C-Consciousness or become an Agent and do their bidding.
The STALKER Program. That’s what C-Consciousness called it.
I’m with the Ward. I want to deal with the Zone once and for all… and make sure my new home is safe.
So you want to keep the Zone in check? Along with everything that comes with it?
The Ward are just SIRCAA’s lapdogs. And I know exactly what the Institute’s up to.
Want me to show you my SIRCAA advisor ID?
At least with the Ward, I know what they stand for. But you? I have no idea what you want.
I’ll get in touch when I figure out if you’re worth it. Not if, but when.
And remember, either you’re against everyone now, or I’m against you. The choice is yours. That’s the price of my candor.
So the Shining Zone is a lie?
I saw it when I took down C-Consciousness. It seemed… better. So bright, so real… or so I believed.
I spent years wandering this Zone in search of its Shining counterpart. I suppose that’s when Scar caught wind of it.
But my Shining Zone turned out to be… well, you saw what it was. Just another illusion. Another lie. And the one he's looking for — it never existed in the first place.
Is there anything I can do to help?
Not now, I got this covered. Just focus on what you need to do.
But keep in mind that the Ward and Spark are my enemies.
If they end up being yours too, we’ll get along just fine.
Dr. Kaymanov reached out to me. He asked me to take the cartridge to Orbita Station.
Kaymanov is an old asshole. He’s always had a mind of his own. He knew the C-Consciousness experiments were fishy all along. But instead of stopping them, he decided to see how things played out.
Still, the Zone ended up teaching him something after all: the only way to understand it is by taking action.
So, Orbita it is. Maybe you’ll find the kind of truth that suits you best there.
There can only be one truth.
Then you don’t know the Zone well enough.
So what’s your next move, then?
Keep searching. Right now I’ve got to find a way into the STALKER Program Control Center. The neuroprogrammers in X3 should be connected to it.
I just need to figure out how.
The STALKER Program? What’s that?
It lets you manipulate people’s minds. A C-Consciousness invention.
Those who made it to the center of the Zone got the short end of the stick. Their “prize” was either to join Monolith and protect C-Consciousness or become an Agent and do their bidding.
The programming only malfunctioned once — with me. But I paid a price for it: my own memory.
When I found this place, I realized the Zone can’t be true to herself as long as someone keeps trying to use her to fucking brainwash us.
Whether through “TVs” like these, or the STALKER Program before them.
I just wish I knew who that “someone” is right now.
Not everyone can handle what you’re proposing.
This is the only way to the truth I can offer you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_TakeBack_take: I found a way into Lab X3. Marker coordinates sent.
You are oddly cooperative. No haggling, no fuss... I take it you didn’t find the Klondike then?
Depends. Whatever you’re looking for, it might be there. But taking it with you is a whole different story.
Unless you grab the psi installation too. Your Oasis is nothing but a mirage. And I shut it down anyway.
Oh, I see. But let’s keep it quiet. No need for anyone else to know, you dig?
Like I told you before, the way to the Oasis is worth a pretty kopiyka. You have earned your reward.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_AboutO: Wow, that was fun. That smell really takes me back – I had a cap gun when I was a kid. A Mauser.
So who might you be, unknown gunslinger?
I’m Skif. And you must be the guy who knows where to find the entrance to the old lab at the Cordon.
Wow. Not much for foreplay. You must be from the Oasis cult. So skilled, and so stupid. Who actually trusts Sidorovich?
How do you know Sidorovich never got his package?
If I ask someone and insist, that’s usually how it goes.
I gotta pick it up, by the way. It nearly slipped my mind, with these mercs and all.
You mean the decoder? I've got it right here.
You’re a very resourceful guy, Skif. And you’re alive, unlike all my men.
Here’s the deal: the lab’s gonna be our joint venture. It’s a real maze, but I’ve got a map of it. Right here, in my head. In case you’re thinking about shooting me and taking it.
Besides, there’s one lock down there you can’t open without me, not even with a decoder. I guarantee you won’t get through it alone. Deal?
Any idea who paid the mercs to kill you? The thing is, you’re not the first person we’ve both been chasing.
You’re one intriguing guy. Where did our paths cross before?
Last time was in the Red Forest. I was looking for the Doctor.
Whoa! Can you introduce me later? I’m wicked eager to meet his friend, but he’s been ghosting me. Whenever I ask him out, he always sends someone else instead. Like these guys.
All right. I’m in.
You bet you are. Don’t expect it to be a walk in the park, though.
Head to these coordinates. There’s something you need to pick up. It was meant for the bandits, but we need it more now.
I’ll be waiting for you at the lab entrance. There’s a tracker in the stash. When you grab the stuff, you’ll get the location.
Where’d you find the Oasis documents?
I snagged them from an old gig. But I was sick of it anyway. Playing guerrilla with the Ward bored me to tears.
The documents were just lying around.
There’s a lot of info there about the Oasis – three Oases, in fact. These are just code names, though. Stalkers made up the rest of the story.
You think Sidorovich is lying?
Only when he opens his mouth. How do you think he found out about the Oasis? Stalker gossip? Maybe. That, and the documents I showed him.
But as soon as our deal was all worked out, I was suddenly no longer welcome in his little village.
But the old fox’s tricks are wearing thin. That’s why the lab entrance I told him about was bullshit — unlike the key in that package that never made it to his bunker.
Why do you want to get into the lab?
“Why” questions are of a more personal nature, and our relationship is strictly business. That’s why I’m not asking you why.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_AlarmO: Yes! The gate's opening! What’s that sound over there?
I’ve got company, Dark. And the door won’t open. Fuck…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_Connec: Where are you freaks coming from?!
Open up… I said open up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_DoorCo: Fuck whoever designed this whole damn place.
Your door has a double security system. I had to confirm from this end that I see you out there. It's a good thing we split up.
Quiet now? Give the decoder another shot. It has to work this time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_OpenSk: I'm looking at what's gotta be the biggest blast door in the whole Zone, Skif. If it's rusted too, we’re shit out of luck.
You okay? Is the decoder ready?
Yeah, I’m at the entrance. Let’s get this done.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_Pseudo: You can’t get in… can’t get in without me…
I’m here, Dark. You all right?
Finally! I’m pinned down, Skif. There’s too many of them. But we’ve got a shot.
We need to unlock all the doors. Look around for the security console — it’s on the lower levels. After you use it, I’ll make my move. Remember, you won’t make it without me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_Reunit: I don’t believe in luck, but I’ll be damned if you aren’t a lucky charm.
This is just what I need right now. Open it. I’ve got your back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Temnyj_TurnOn: No rush – we can’t take the elevator anyway. The power’s out.
According to the map, the breaker is just behind this wall. Get there through the vent, and then you can go back through the door. It’s connected to the same circuit as the elevator.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_Dialog_Volk_AboutTem: I hear there was an old lab at the Cordon. I want to know more about it.
What’s so special about that place? First that Dark guy, now you…
I’ll give you the same advice I gave him: stay away.
So the lab does exist. What do you know about it?
Everyone who thought they could strike it rich there didn’t even need a burial.
There was nothing left to bury.
Anyway, do you know where the entrance is?
From what I know, it’s a pretty huge facility. Part of it might even extend beyond the Cordon.
But all the entrances we used to know are closed off now. Some of them got wrecked by anomalies, and others just caved in over time.
It’s for the best, honestly. I sleep better when there are fewer jackasses going in and fewer freaks coming out.
A seasoned stalker, by the looks of it. But there was something rotten about him, if you ask me. He roped in some rookies with big promises, but never said a word about the actual deal.
Then he had a long chat with Sidorovich. Judging from their sour mugs, they clearly didn’t see eye to eye.
In the end, I made it clear he’d overstayed his welcome. But if you’re looking for this Dark guy, here’s the coordinates. You can figure out if he’s a rat or my gut’s off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_bora_koleso_0_Defeat: You piece of shit! I’m gonna bury you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_bora_koleso_0_HelloT: Why, hello there. How are you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_bora_koleso_0_InfoTo: Man, this place is boring. We had it sweet over at Garbage. Back then, if you wanted to play cards, you’d slap your AK mag on the table and let the good times roll.
Now it only costs you a single round! That’s how strapped we are. But hey, at least we’re still kicking. Can’t say the same for a lot of folks over at the Commissary.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_bora_koleso_0_Resume: We weren’t done, huh? All right. Go on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_dzim_0_DefeatComment: I’m gonna gut you for this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_dzim_0_InfoTopic_1_I: The less you know, the better my chances of sticking around a bit longer. That’s how it goes with stalkers. I don't wanna be your next campfire story.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_dzim_0_ResumeComment: Okay, let’s get back to it…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_fima_semafor_0_BusyT: Back off, huh? I’m askin’ you nicely.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_fima_semafor_0_InfoT: It just kind of all came crashing down. My buddy took a Monolithian bullet, and I ended up with Roosevelt. And his rules are worse than ten years in maximum security.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_fima_semafor_0_Resum: So, what were you sayin’ before?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_krikun_0_InfoTopic_1: No good news. And there won’t be, not as long as Korshunov’s still alive. I got a real score to settle with him, and I hope to square it someday. Seems like that’s where things are headed now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_krikun_0_ResumeComme: Let me finish so I won’t forget it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_mona_0_BusyTopic_Bus: Later, man. Don’t bother me now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_mona_0_DefeatComment: Spare a bro a medkit, guys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_mona_0_HelloTopic_He: You wanna chat? Sure, why not?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_mona_0_InfoTopic_1_I: I’m all right, bro. These days, being alive and kickin’ is good news.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_mona_0_ResumeComment: Go ahead. Now where were we?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_ruzvelt_0_InfoTopic_: It's all gonna be new now, Skif. I gotta rebuild from the ground up. Honestly, when you're fifty, the prospect of going from rags to riches all over again feels less than thrilling.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_ruzvelt_0_ResumeComm: We got interrupted. Let’s get back to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_strelok_0_InfoTopic_: Freedom, Duty, the Ward, Spark… there’s always someone trying to twist the Zone to their own ends. Their reasons may vary, but the end is the same. And I’ve got a bullet for each one of ’em.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_strelok_0_NPC_Combat: Where the hell are you shooting at?
I'll smoke him out with a grenade!
They're falling back! It's all good.
If I find you, it’s gonna get worse.
All clear. You can take it easy now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_temnyj_0_BusyTopic_B: Some other time. When things settle down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_temnyj_0_ByeTopic_By: All right, that's it. No need for long farewells.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_temnyj_0_DefeatComme: You hit me, but didn't kill me. Why don’t you up your game, you mutt?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_temnyj_0_InfoTopic_1: I swung by an old buddy’s place not too long ago. Needed advice on an old gadget. So there we were, shooting the breeze, and their head honcho walks in. Scar, I reckon.
His mug looked real familiar, but I just couldn’t place it. He even gave me a nod like we were old pals. Strange, eh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ01_temnyj_0_ResumeComme: Right when things were getting interesting…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Audiolog_InstAnt_1_7: In the event of my absence, follow these instructions. Reminder: the antenna is a powerful psi conductor. Being in its immediate vicinity while it is in operation is strictly prohibited.
Activate the antenna on the rooftop. Ensure that there is no biological activity nearby — any interference could damage the antenna.
If the equipment detects such activity, the fuses will blow, cutting off the power supply.
Stand by. The settings are configured to activate the antenna automatically if the aforementioned conditions are met. No manual input required!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Comment_FirstScarGua: If you've got business, take it to Scar. He speaks for all of Spark.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Comment_IskraFight_k: He’s not walking out of here alive!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Comment_KaymanovGive: This is Dr. Kaymanov. Have you managed to get the cartridge?
Before you begin, you’ll need to calibrate the central antenna. It’s nothing too complex, but you’ll need precise instructions.
I used to work at this station, and my old notes might still be around. All the information you need should be in there.
All right. Where do I find them?
They should be in one of the offices. If it’s locked, try the code 1995. Hopefully I remembered it correctly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Comment_ScarRE_1_639: Get all the info you can out of Strelok. That’s our priority right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Comment_SecondScarGu: Scar’s a sharp guy. If you wanna be one of us, you gotta listen to him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Dialog_AfterTurnOff_: I've tracked the antenna signals. All good. Just a little more to go.
In X15, there's an experimental unit. You need to place the cartridge in the control room, and then - get into the capsule. I'll take care of the connection.
To enter the pod? But why?
Don't worry about the capsule: unlike the C-Conciousness ones, it was designed for one user. I'll take care of the rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Dialog_ScarAfterTaki: Now we can go back to our search for a Visiograph. There’s bound to be another one out there in the Zone. Which means we still need Strelok.
Have you been here before?
Old habits die hard, don’t they? Especially those rooted in a lack of faith.
Yes, I’ve been here before — with Ozersky. He couldn’t believe the truth about Subtle Matter either.
Care to tell me how you ended up on Orbita?
I found the Doctor. He said I might find some answers here.
Remember, Skif, everything hinges on how you handle your relationship with the Ward. You’ve seen the truth. Are you ready to embrace it?
I found Strelok. He thinks that all psi-devices are controlled by the STALKER Program.
If that’s true, there could be another Visiograph at the Program Control Center.
Get him to spill everything he knows. He’ll help us reestablish contact with the Representative.
Strelok himself doesn’t need to know that, of course.
Faith requires no answers, Skif. Especially not from these gizmos.
But I’m glad you stayed on the right path. The Shining — that’s the only answer we need.
And those answers have finally steered you towards the right path! Better late than never, right?
It’s a shame it took all those gizmos to sway you. Faith is about believing in spite of something, not because of it.
What did you see while I was in that pod, Scar? Did you hear Strider?
I don’t need to see to believe. Now you believe too. That’s all that matters.
What can you tell me about Strelok?
Just about anyone in the Zone can tell you more about him than I can.
I combed half the Zone looking for him once. That’s all I have to say.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Dialog_ScarAndOzersk: Why do you scientists always have to make things so complicated? Faith is about believing in spite of something, Mr. Ozersky, not because of it. Otherwise, what’s the point?
I need to know for sure.
All right. If you prefer knowing to believing, see for yourself.
Ha! I didn't expect to see a familiar face here. How's it going?
I want to make sure. Tell me this: during our time in the bunker, someone saved you and your crew from a Controller. Who was it?
I’d never forget something like that. It was Degtyarev.
You really are still alive! Unbelievable…
As you can see, Professor, faith is always rewarded. Are you ready to take action?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ02_Dialog_StrelokCallAf: Skif, I've examined the neuroprogrammers, and I have an idea how to find the STALKER Program Control Center.
They are connected to the same device at the Tropospheric Communications Point. If you get there and activate it, I'll get the data I need.
Get going. I'll contact you later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Comment_KorVartRE_Sp: Take any questions to the colonel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Comment_StrelokCallB: Judging by the atmospherics, you’ve made it to the TCP.
Listen up. You need to find and activate the neuroprogrammer control panel. Look for a panel with lots of switches.
As soon as you launch them, I’ll be able to calculate the approximate location of the STALKER Program Control Center, the heart of X-Network.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Comment_StrelokCallP: You can pass through an abandoned loading terminal. There is a large anomalous area, patrols stay out of it.
You could use Dark's decoder to open the back door to the terminal.
Got it. Beats going in guns blazing.
When you get to the facility, try to get the Project FIBER files.
I’ve got a Warden pass. I’ll try the front door.
In that case, you can ask your Ward friends to show you the Project FIBER files.
Are you at the TCP yet? Nice and easy. As soon as they see a gun, they'll surround you. You just need to get inside and launch the neuroprogrammers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Comment_StrelokCallS: I've managed to track the signal down to the Prypiat catacombs. The STALKER Program Control Center must be somewhere there. We need to find and destroy it.
It's Degtyarev's territory. I guess it's time for you to meet him.
But we need to act fast. You've made so much noise that all the Ward dogs will run to the TCP now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Comment_VartaATK_ATK: No one gets in or out of the facility until the intruder is eliminated!
Intruder alert at the Troposphere Comm Station. Repeat, we have an intruder!
Don’t let him reach the control panel! Eliminate him at all costs!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_CutScene_PTS_NOvarta: Skif doesn’t side with the Ward.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Dialog_KorshunovACS_: Strelok mentioned Agents. Who are they?
Stalkers. The cream of the crop. Once they got to the center of the Zone, they ended up in the neuroprogramming lab at the Generators.
That’s where they were programmed by C-Consciousness... and got a “S.T.A.L.K.E.R.” tattoo on their right forearm.
After C-Consciousness died and their psi-installations were shut down, some of the agents woke up and had their "brands" removed. That’s why we can’t catch them anymore.
I want to know more about the Agents.
That’s all I wanted to know about the Agents.
The Ward badge didn't protect me when I asked a “simple question” about Project FIBER. Your people tried to kill me.
But they didn't. Believe me, I'm not happy about what happened here either.
There are Agents outside the Zone? Who are they, and how are they dangerous?
I’m left with more questions than answers myself. Two of them, Chornozem and Nestor, never made it out of the Zone. Had to chill out. In a fridge at the Chemical Plant.
They seem like a new breed tailored for missions on the Mainland. Hell knows what those are. Could be a typical C-Consciousness imperative, like “find and eliminate, whatever it takes.”
We’re working on it. Those stiffs' PDAs are the only ones we managed to hack so far.
Anyway, Agatha is convinced that a man of your skill is essential to the success of our mission. And our mission is the only thing that matters right now.
For the time being, we'll settle for cooperation instead of the gory revenge I would otherwise guarantee you.
Ask away, soldier.
So, Colonel, would you forget that I had to shoot a bunch of your men?
In your dreams, stalker.
Strelok’s putting together a new crew. He's planning to take on both you and Scar for the sake of his Zone.
Alexander the fucking Great! This'll be the end of him, then.
I always knew he was trouble. Even back when he showed up at SIRCAA with that C-Consciousness pod piece of glass and the X7 papers.
And I was right. Six months later, an explosion at X11. Strelok was barely mentioned in the report. New hires have had to deal with extra background checks ever since.
Strelok told me he’s located the STALKER Program Control Center somewhere underground in Prypiat.
That facility manages all of Project X's infrastructure and controls the induced illusions. We have to get there before Strelok does.
Time’s of the essence, Skif.
You think Strelok and Scar are Agents too? But why?
Strelok’s got the tattoo below his elbow, and he’s fixated on an agenda that no one else can understand.
I kept pointing that out to Dalin, but in vain. After some pressure from the brass, he gave him a job at SIRCAA.
Oh, and I appreciate what you did with Scar. Thanks to you, my men found documents at the Clear Sky base that confirm the group’s ties to C-Consciousness.
