Anything else, soldier? Make it quick.
What’s our next move, Colonel?
For now, our main focus should be controlling the Anomalous energy. Based on our intel, it looks like the Control Center might give us clues.
But first, we need to get to Prypiat. The only way there goes through Yaniv. Head out right away and contact Degtyarev if you can.
Our forward units are already in Prypiat, but maintaining communication has proven to be... challenging. Locate them, and they’ll help you find the Control Center.
And Skif... in case the Corps starts acting up, I’ve heard of a stalker named Spirit who’s known to help people cross the Boundary. Keep that in mind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Dialog_KorshunovRE_G: Enough chatter, soldier. Time to focus on the mission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Dialog_VartaIntercom: Calm down, I’ve got a pass.
Get the fuck outta here already!
You’re trespassing. Leave the facility immediately.
What kind of facility is this?
This is your final warning, stalker. Get out of here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_Dialog_VartaOhr_IDan: All good. What’s the purpose of your visit?
I want to know more about Project FIBER.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ03_lotvin_0_InfoTopic_1: I’m only concerned about the security of this facility. As for the Zone… Let others worry about that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_AlertOnHimza: Warning! Security protocols breached. Red alert!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_DalinCallsSk: We need to talk. We don’t have much time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_DalinLeaves_: And Skif? If our paths ever cross again, remember, I’m on your side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_PrisonerCall: Hey, Skif! Come on over. I promise I won’t bite! They knocked all my teeth out anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_PrisonerHurr: Get moving while the hallway’s clear!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_ScarCallsAbo: I got word from our mutual friends that you’ve found yourself in the Ward’s clutches. That’s good — means you’ve made the right choice.
I hope you don't overstay your welcome and you're gonna catch up soon. We’re in Prypiat, camped out at the Hospital, northern part of the first district.
Head to Yaniv. Deggy'll let you through. We’re waiting for you, and the intel you got from Strelok.
Oh, and if Degtyarev refuses to cooperate, find Spirit. He’s an old mate of mine. He’ll help in any way he can, I’m sure of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_SkifGivesKey: I’ll give you a head start. You’ll probably go quietly, but I want the Ward to know I was here. Thanks for not leaving me in the lurch. Zone willing, we’ll meet again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_SkifGivesNoK: I’m serious, Skif! You know what Korshunov'll do to me! Skif!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_SkifTakesToo: Whatcha starin’ at? This ain’t a fucking museum. Come on over, I said!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_StrelokCalls: Where have you been? Degtyarev's tired of waiting.
Go to Prypiat through Yaniv — the Corps will let you through.
If not, find the stalker called Spirit. He'll help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_VartaGuardBe: I wonder what Dalin saw at Malachite... he’s like a different person now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_VartaGuardSt: I gotta renew my contract. I’ve been here for so long, I’m starting to wonder how it’s all gonna end…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_VartaGuardsI: Don’t hold last night against me, okay? I guess my brain got fried too. I bet they’re gonna discharge me now…
The Doc’s been humming lullabies while performing autopsies. Your commander won’t take his body armor off — all stuffed with wire and C4. And look at the colonel…
The only way we're getting discharged is into an open grave.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Comment_VartaGuardsO: Well, I'm relieved. It's too bad about the guys at the Duga, but at least the treaties are over. No more bootlicking.
You’re either with us, or you're dead. Plain and simple. We should’ve done it right away.
Zotov’s dead. Senkevych too. But that bastard Dvoryankov will outlive us both…
He saved my life in the second assault. If it weren’t for his orders, I’d be buried under the Duga. Maybe if you quit swiping rations, they won't have to cut your paycheck.
He was trying to save our equipment, not your ass…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Dialog_DalinHelpsSki: They’re alive too.
And now?
If that’s immortality, it’s frightening. An eternal prison where the mind remains static. I’d rather die and be done with it.
No. That’s not enough. I have to see for myself.
You know, when I was a kid, my father once told me, “For a true scientist, impossible simply means unexplored.” Whenever I faced a problem I couldn’t solve, he’d say, “Dig deeper, Dalin.”
I’ve been to Orbita. Using the prototype pod, I was able to make contact with the Noosphere. While I was there, I talked to Strider. He’s alive, Dalin – alive with no physical body.
Strelok can confirm what I’m saying. The Representative is either an illusion or a psi-imprint of someone who was once alive.
Skif, I know we’ve had different agendas so far, and it might be hard for you to trust me, but I genuinely want to help.
Are you all right? The colonel’s completely lost it. He’s been difficult before, but now he’s gone off the rails completely.
Tossing you in here after all you did for the Ward…
Where am I? Is this the Chemical Plant?
Yes. The isolation unit. The colonel keeps prisoners here.
He had his reasons to throw me in here. I found out about… some things, and I can't keep working with the Ward knowing them.
Oh… What did you find out?
But that’s impossible. Unthinkable. And yet…
I was looking for the Doctor in the Red Forest. Turns out, the man posing as the savior is Dr. Kaymanov — the same guy who refused to go into the eighth pod in 2006.
He told me about your father... and his Subtle Matter theory.
And now I’m beginning to think there are more important things than science.
Richter told me Ozersky and Scar have managed to build a Visiograph in lab X17 at Malachite. He said you had a personal conversation with the Representative. Is that true? Did you speak with him?
It all adds up now… the head of C-Consciousness was Valentyn Dalin. Are you his son?
How did you know that?
It doesn’t matter. I’ve got my sources. I know about C-Consciousness and your father, along with his Subtle Matter theory.
I went to Orbita and ran an experiment with a prototype pod. While I was there, I saw a projection of Strider. It was just a copy, not the man I once knew. Strider’s dead.
How can I be sure of what you’re saying? Do you have any proof?
Are you trying to recruit me again? Don’t bother. I can see right through your Ward bullshit.
I’m here because we have a mutual acquaintance: Richter. He was once a field consultant for SIRCAA. We parted ways because his priority was the Zone, while mine was science.
Which means the Representative…
You’re doing the right thing, Dalin.
I hope so.
Just be careful. There are patrols everywhere. Wait until I’m at a safe distance, then get out of here.
I’m sorry.
I appreciate your help. Like me, you got mixed up with the wrong crowd. But it’s never too late to change things.
I’ll think about it. I promise.
Just don’t get caught, or it will end badly for both of us. Get out once I’m at a safe distance. But stay quiet – there are patrols everywhere. Be careful.
What you shared wasn’t what I had hoped to hear. But I appreciate your candor.
I’ve tried to live by that rule my whole life. And that’s why I want to thank you. You didn’t settle for superficial answers. You dug deeper. Thank you for that, Skif.
Yes. What’s left in the Noosphere is just an imprint of consciousness. A copy. A collection of a person’s memories.
Yes. Everything the Representative said is true. Subtle Matter, the Shining Zone, immortality within the Noosphere – it’s all real.
Have you learned anything new about Subtle Matter?
You’re taking a great risk. Do you realize that?
On a scale from day-to-day work at SIRCAA to the Alpha Artifact experiment, I’ve been through worse.
Just be careful. There are patrols everywhere. Wait until I’m at a safe distance, then get out of here.
And the Ward wants to use these imprints to spy on every single one of us.
What is this place?
The isolation unit at the Chemical Plant. The colonel keeps prisoners here.
Where’s all my stuff?
I don’t know. Sorry. They must have taken it when they searched you.
If my words aren’t enough to convince you, you can reach out to Scar. He figured it out long before I did.
Also, thanks for rescuing me at X11. I haven’t forgotten it.
I’ll give you the key to the cell. You need to get out of here – the sooner, the better.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_Dialog_PrisonerAsksF: Don’t scare me like that, eh? I thought you left for real. So, we got a deal? The key for info on your stuff.
I don’t wanna know whatever’s going on between you and that brainiac, turning against his own... fuck, I’m done with all that “mysteries of the Zone” crap.
Here’s the deal: gimme the key, and I’ll tell you where they stashed your stuff.
How long have you been here?
Ever since Malachite. I stayed behind to cover Scar and ended up… sticking around. Eh, whatever. If it helps us find the Shining Zone, then it was worth it.
No, I might still need the key. See you.
Why?! You’re already out! For the Zone’s sake, Skif, don’t just leave me here! They’re gonna kill me!
Here you go. How do you know where my stuff is?
The guards mentioned it. You can overhear a lot if you play dead — including a little chat between a Skif and a Dalin…
They didn’t take your PDA? Then again, who would you even call — Strelok? Here, this is where they stash their stuff. Don't get caught out there.
Hey, I remember you. You’re the one who activated the Duga.
It wasn’t me, it was Ozersky. I was literally just standing there! I knew it wouldn’t end well. But hey, nice job telling Korshunov to fuck off. I can respect that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E11_MQ04_zora_mamont_0_InfoTo: The Shining Zone's time is coming, and then the Ward’ll be done for!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Audiolog_Duh_1_70269: The key card to the bunker is in my pocket. The scanner I used to get to Prypiat is inside. It’s not too hard, you’ll figure it out. I left the manual there, too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Audiolog_Duh_1_70270: Sorry for delivering the message like this. We can’t be sure who's listening in. A delayed one is safer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Audiolog_Duh_1_70271: When you search my body, don’t be shy, take everything you need. Just make sure you bury me deep, okay? I think I deserve some rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Audiolog_Instruction: Got your scanner thing tweaked. You can turn anomalous fields off now. Not all of them, so don't get too excited, or I’d be richer than Myklukha by now. Should do the trick for your Offloading Terminal tunnel.
Pretty easy to use: put the scanner next to a stable anomaly, smash the button, get going. Don't drag your feet: the anomaly isn't gonna stay off for freaking ever. Throw in a couple of bolts, too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_DuhVarta_hom: It's working, I can feel it. Maybe you’re onto something. Maybe I’ll find my home after all…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_IskraBunker_: Scar used to roll with Topol, right? Why didn’t he just hand us the key card?
“The road to the goal is as important as the goal itself…” Ugh! How much longer till Trigger gets back with the explosives?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_NorHana_fluf: Well? I know you’re part of this. Now spill it, or you’ll have to answer to Degtyarev when he comes back.
Did I stutter? Can't you see how deep in shit we are? And Pripyat even more so. We gotta be ready for the worst.
What you need to do is shut your trap!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_RihterCall_c: One, two, three… urgent transmission from Richter Press: Monolith on the horizon! All hands on deck!
Or not. You might draw a bad card.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_RihterComing: Over here, you Monolithian son of a bitch!
Your ugly mug ain’t any better. All right. Come on up here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_RihterIntera: Give me a minute. Losing your faith is easy, but rediscovering it takes effort. And time. And a little bit of liquid courage…
I need to clear my head before I hit the road again, so to speak. Here, take this. You’ll need it more than I will.
Get lost before I sober up. I don’t miss when I’m sober.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_SanaBackOff_: You’re a shitty helper. Get lost!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_SanaComeOn_1: Looks like we got reinforcements! Stalker, help!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_SanaHelpedDu: I didn't think there was a way to help Spirit. You're a gift from the Zone itself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_SanaStrelok_: Don’t worry, we’ll give him a proper farewell. Thanks again for your help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_SkifIskra_se: See you in the Shining Zone, my friend.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_SkifVarta_by: The Zone shouldn't exist at all. We need to get rid of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Comment_VartaBunker_: Where the fuck are those explosives? We’re sitting ducks out here in the open..
Dvoryankov must’ve been stingy with the C4 again. When I get back to the Chemical Plant, I’m heading straight to the colonel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_1_65: I told you, Spirit, Scar doesn’t lie. In the Zone, death is not the end. We just leave all the darkness behind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_2_65: I told you, Spirit, Scar doesn’t lie. In the Zone, death is not the end. We just leave all the darkness behind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_hedo: Scar doesn’t lie. He skirts the truth, he leaves things out, but he never lies outright. Especially not about what matters most: the Shining Zone.
I’ve got even less reason to lie to you. I’m on my last legs here. I don’t have anything left to fear anymore... except the unknown.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_noos: But there’s no unknown. Only the Shining Zone. Immortality within the Noosphere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_nowy: I trust Scar, not you. There’s no use talking to you.
A fanatic, huh? Watch out, guys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_rusu: Are you absolutely certain about that?
I’m a Monolithian. My entire life as I remember it was devoted to Topol and the original Spark. I still see him in my dreams. He keeps asking me why I left him there.
But it doesn't matter. It'll all be over soon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_shra: I have no idea why Scar needs to get to Prypiat, but my secrets will die with me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_sorr: Then I can… I can apologize to him! I can… the bunker, you need the bunker! There’s a scanner in there, tweaked by some smartass from Garbage.
It doesn’t create anomalies; it disables them, get it? Here are the coordinates. The instructions are there too. Scar'll figure it out, I’m sure of it!
Thank you. Thank you for showing this to me. Maybe there really is a Shining Zone after all. Maybe that’s where I’ll find my home. For the first time since the Signal…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhShram_will: No one dies for real here. Scar proved it.
Scar, huh? Do you know what happened at the Chemical Plant when the Ward showed up?
They attacked us out of the blue. I saw Topol die in an instant. Boom, and he was gone. And if it weren’t for Marshal… I’m still not sure how I made it.
Scar was never there. He was never part of Topol’s original Spark. If he claimed otherwise, he was lying through his teeth.
And if he lied about that, just imagine what else he might be lying about.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_hiyo: Those mutants are tricky, eh? One distracts you while another one flanks you out… almost like humans. It's about to be one less human in the equation, so whatever, I guess.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_howd: How do you know who I am?
I don’t have a fucking clue. But I can sure as hell see who you've been hanging out with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_hurt: Not wounded — killed. One of those guys you put down out front. I guess I gotta thank you for avenging me.
But I’ll tell you what: vengeance might bring peace to the dead, but it ain’t no fucking comfort to the dying.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_peop: Why won’t your men help you?
Because they can't save me. I hired them to help me get to Lymansk. But, as you can see, there’s no way to get to Lymansk from here.
So they’re stuck here with me till I snuff it. Honest folk, good stalkers. Not many left in the Zone these days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_pryp: I need to get to Prypiat. I know you’ve been taking stalkers around Yaniv.
You think I was doing it for the money? Hell, I barely covered my expenses. Degtyarev is an idiot.
You can’t take away someone's dream, you know? It’s like the seaside you’ve never visited… always sunny, always peaceful…
Or at least it used to be, until Monolith showed up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_shra: Whatever Scar’s men are looking for around here, I don’t have it. Fuck off and let me die in peace.
It’s all in your eyes. You Sparkers are just like Monolithians — blind fanatics, the whole lot of you. Now spill it. What did your buddy Scar want?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_stre: At least I’ll meet my end in the presence of a true stalker. Could be worse.
You can always spot a lone stalker. Now spill it. Why won’t you let me die in peace?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStart_vart: So the last face I’m gonna see is Korshunov’s lapdog? Why thank you, Zone. What a nice parting gift.
I can always spot a Warden pig. So much for not working with stalkers. Why were you looking for me?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStrelok_bu: The instructions are in the bunker, too. You’re sharp — you’ll figure it out. Tell Strelok I said hi, okay? I had two dreams: find a home in the Zone, and meet Strelok. Neither came true.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStrelok_he: Thanks for finding me, stalker. And for the advice too. Good… hunting…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStrelok_it: Dreams coming true don't always make you happy. Strelok would know.
Now I can tell you’re rolling with him. They say he ain't much of a shoulder to cry on, either.
You found your way into Prypiat, and you’ll get to Lymansk too. I’m sure you’ll find your place there.
Now I can tell you’re rolling with Strelok. They say he's a bad liar too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStrelok_oh: Secrets never really die, no matter how deep we bury them. Strelok taught me that much.
You know him? Strelok? No way… yes, you’re telling the truth. I can see it in your eyes. Wow, I never thought I’d have the chance to help Strelok himself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStrelok_ok: Your call. In the Zone, the dead can speak as loud as the living, you know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhStrelok_st: I have no idea why you need to get to Prypiat, stalker, but my secrets will die with me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_bein: That’s how you stay alive. Here, take it. Now tell me what you know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_bunk: The instructions are in the bunker too. You Wardens are sharp — you’ll figure it out. And thanks, I guess. But whatever your plan is, I hope it crashes and burns.
The Zone needs to stay free. Don't you get it?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_dont: But you don’t have to die for it. I’m still looking for a home too, just like you. We’re not as different as you might think.
Besides, our secrets don’t really die with us. Only our dreams do.
That’s how you become a Warden, huh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_goto: That’s how you go all in to achieve your goals. Here, take it. Now tell me what you know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_ican: The Colonel and I don’t want anyone to die needlessly. I’ve got a Monolithian regenerator. I can heal you. In return, you’ll tell me what I need to know.
It’s always the same story: you give me something, I give you something, we do a little dance with our conscience… nah. Fuck you and your Ward.
I was heading to Lymansk to find a home of my own, not make all the stalkers homeless. The Zone has to be free!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_koor: Hold on... there. These are the coordinates to a bunker where I left a scanner. It's been tweaked by a digger from Garbage — Diode, I think… unlike the regular scanners, this one disables anomalies.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_ok_6: Your call. In the Zone, the dead can speak as loud as the living.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_sign: How did you make it through the Signal?
A Spark bunker. Not the Spark that's out there right now — the original one. My Spark. It was shielded against any psi-effects. Ozersky really outdid himself there.
I wonder what’s become of him. I hope he’s doing okay.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_vart: I have no idea why the Ward needs to get to Prypiat, but my secrets will die with me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_DuhVarta_what: What, Richter didn’t fill you in? Don’t give me that look. Who else could’ve told you how to track me down?
I don’t know anything but the Zone. When the Monolith went silent, I started looking to fit in here somehow. Find a place of my own. A home, as weird as it might sound.
When the Monolith came back, there was nothing left for me in Prypiat. I figured maybe I’d get luckier in Lymansk. But no matter how hard I tried, I just couldn’t get there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_5_65: Thank you for sharing, Skif. Here, this is all I’ve got. Where you’re headed, every little thing could come in handy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_answ: My home was destroyed by an anomaly. I came here to find out how that could have happened.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_brod: I saw exactly what you thought I would: Strider.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_fini: And remember, it’s never too late to make up your own mind. Trust me, I'd know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_golo: Or, rather, a holographic projection of him.
Strelok thinks there’s a machine deep within Prypiat controlling these illusions. Sounds way more plausible than some kind of Noosphere "subtle matter".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_hell: Good to see you here. Tell me all about where you’ve been and what you’ve seen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_nodo: Not a shadow of doubt... I genuinely envy you, Skif, that unwavering confidence of yours.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_rewe: My home was destroyed by an anomaly. I came to find those responsible for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_shra: A one-way ticket. A miracle. A new world the Shining is about to reveal to us, free from pain and regret… and guilt.
I need to get to Prypiat and reach out to the Representative. C-Consciousness knows what to do next. They can control the Anomalous energy.
Control it? They’ve tried to control it before, and we both know how that went.
A miracle they never truly comprehended. And neither do you — or the people you take orders from.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_so_6: I see… stalkers often say, “Everyone has a different path to the Zone,” but I think it's more like, “The Zone calls us all in different voices.”
Its call was hard to ignore, but the journey has given me more than I was looking for. I’m getting close to what I really want.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_sram: It was him. He’s alive in the Noosphere — alone and trapped, but alive. And so are the others!
The Shining will set them free, Scar and I will do whatever it takes to make it happen! I need to talk to the Representative again, and then the miracle will finally unfold.
I didn’t dare hope for Dalin to be right. Is this joy or fear? What should I be feeling right now?
There’s no point in being afraid of the new world.
But you can still mourn the old one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_stre: He intends to destroy whatever’s inducing these illusions, and he’s right. People deserve to be free of illusions, and so does the Zone.
So Dalin was mistaken, then? I was prepared for that, though I had hoped otherwise. As you can see, this man of science has already freed himself from illusions.
I met Strelok in X3. He’s aware that you were part of C-Consciousness, and he’s not exactly itching to meet you.
He was always smarter than he let on, and he always preferred solitude — especially when those around him ceased to be useful in his quest for the mysteries of the Zone. Is that why you’re here too?
A home. Not just an apartment — the entire Zone, in all its natural splendor. And a purpose: to defend it from any attempts to alter it, from the outside or from within.
I need to get to Prypiat and destroy the STALKER Program Center. Strelok can set the Zone free from those who want to enslave it, both now and in the future.
To a little fish, a big tank might feel like an entire ocean. But we both know the truth.
The Zone may grant stalkers freedom, but that alone doesn’t mean it's free — and neither are you, Skif, as long as you’re doing the bidding of others.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_vart: He intends to destroy whatever’s inducing these illusions, but that’s where he’s wrong. This technology can be a great asset to humanity.
So Dalin was mistaken, then? I was prepared for that, though I had hoped otherwise. The only miracles that exist are the ones we create ourselves.
A new home. And not just an apartment to replace the one that went up in flames! A new world where I can take my rightful place. A new life, one I never got to experience.
I need to get to Prypiat. The Ward believes they can bring the Anomalous energy under control.
How did that “control” work out at SIRCAA? The Zone is creating new laws of physics, an entirely new world, and they’re having trouble even grasping the old one.
We must seek to understand the Zone, not enslave it. We keep trying over and over again, and we fail every time.
We need to rise to its challenge, not try to bring it down to our level.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Kaimanov_what: I know what I’m going to do. And I’m not turning back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_b: You two share something — both searching for a home, both refusing to give up no matter what. Whatever's waiting for you in Prypiat… thank you for not giving up on your faith.
Something better and brighter. Something greater than yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_f: Faust was wrong about his means, but his aim was noble.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_h: Scar wasn’t lying. C-Consciousness is just a step toward the Shining Zone.
You're hearing a man who believes in what he’s doing — just like you once did.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_i: I saw them. The Representative, Strider… they’re alive in the Shining Zone! Scar's methods may be misguided, but his goal is noble.
Help me track down Spirit. I promise you, it’s all true. It's all worth it.
I’m not even sure who you sound like: Scar… or Faust. Who am I hearing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_l: I’m looking for Spirit. I need to get to Prypiat.
What does Scar want with Prypiat? It’s sunny there, sure, but I doubt it’s shiny enough for him.
Prypiat holds the key to the Shining Zone. See, I’m not holding anything back.
Just because you believe in it doesn’t make it real. You know how many years I trusted Scar?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_m: A miracle. Something greater than yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_s: I figured your ugly mug would make an appearance here sooner or later. Another one of Scar’s “miracles,” I suppose.
You know what it means to make a choice?
Holy shit, you even sound like him now.
It’s not about picking between right and wrong, or yourself and other people. It’s about choosing whether to believe or not.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_t: That’s why the Ward and Strelok are both going to lose. They don't have faith in themselves, let alone the Zone. And you're the same way.
Maybe it really was a miracle that I stumbled across you in Zalissya back then. I used to regret saving you, but maybe the Zone really does work in mysterious ways.
If you don’t trust him, trust me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterShram_z: The Zone. Something greater than yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterStrelok: Spirit is a bit of a dreamer. He wanted to find a place in the Zone to call his own — first in Prypiat, and after the Signal, in Lymansk.
I trust you, Skif, but I don’t trust Strelok. He’s keeping something from us.
We all have our secrets. But at least he wants to protect the Zone, not take it away or give it a makeover.
There are times when I feel like helping you in Zalissya was the only good call I ever made. It’s the only thing I don’t regret.
Then push forward, and don’t give up your faith — in the Zone, and, most importantly, in yourself. That’s the only way.
That’s it. It’s more than enough.
No matter what you do, as long as you keep pushing forward, you’ll get to where you want to be. The Zone tests people. Those who give up on their dreams… the Zone will never love them.
Are you a Zone expert now too?
Not at all. But I’m not a quitter either. That’s why I came here. I’m looking for Spirit to take me to Prypiat.
What are you hoping to find there? The Heart? The Heart of Chornobyl? Is that what Strelok’s after?
You two share something — both searching for a home, both refusing to give up no matter what. Good luck, Skif. And thank you.
The Heart of Chornobyl? What’s that?
An artifact. Whoever finds it can learn to understand the Zone and become almost one with it. That’s what they say, anyway.
Strelok found it once. Now you’re after it too, and something tells me you might actually find it. But it should’ve been me! I have to understand the Zone, I have to earn its forgiveness!
Then help us protect it. Scar and Korshunov couldn’t stop me, and they never will.
We are who we are, and you’re the kind of person who wouldn’t leave another man in the lurch... for better or worse.
I appreciate that. But I suspect Scar and Korshunov may not share that sentiment.
So, how’s our favorite Zone Legend doing?
I’ll never understand why the Zone loves him more than anybody else. What'd he do?
He always comes through, no matter what goes down.
That’s it?
You worked with Spirit. What can you tell me about him?
You’ve been to Prypiat before. Maybe you can help me get there?
It was a long time ago. I had a deal with Degtyarev, but now he's gone, and Nor doesn’t like me very much. The folks I failed to take to their destination… he knew them.
So the deal’s off now. The Zone’s not big on honoring deals these days, eh?
What can you tell me about Strelok?
Everything and nothing. Legends, rumors, myths shared around the campfire… Strelok the person and Strelok the legend have had very little in common for a long time.
Word is, the legend wants to save the Zone. As for what the person wants... well, nobody’s got a clue.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_1: Ha! Today’s your lucky day, Skif! Here are the coordinates to Spirit’s stash.
I’d wish you good luck, but I hope you never make it to Prypiat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_2: All right. if you say so. Who am I to argue?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_a: Spirit is a bit of a dreamer. He wanted to find a place in the Zone to call his own — first in Prypiat, and after the Signal, in Lymansk.
I suppose you two are a little alike, as insulting as that might sound — for Spirit, of course, even though he used to be a Monolithian.
I trusted you, Skif. I thought you could see what the Zone was really like. But you still don’t understand.
Too bad it doesn’t love you back.
Fuck you. Or do you think I’m too sloshed to kick your ass?
You won’t, and you know it. You also know that the Zone, despite all its beauty, is still a mistake.
Or the only thing you ever did right. SIRCAA pushed science forward, and the Ward brought peace and order. It wasn't bad for anyone, other than the bandits and Spark terrorists.
Let me show you that this wasn’t all in vain, that we can make the world a better place! Help me find Spirit. Help me… set everything right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_c: That’s why I want to turn it all around. We deserve better.
Who’s “we?” You and the Ward? Korshunov? That smartass clown Dalin?
I should’ve let those anomalies have you. What did I get by saving you? Putting the only thing I love — the Zone — at risk?
You know what? Remember that coin I gave you at the Slag Heap? The one from Prypiat?
Let the Zone decide your fate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_d: He was part of the original Spark – the real Spark, not whatever Scar had turned it into.
And before that, he was a Monolithian.
Then he’s back with them now.
When the Signal hit, he happened to be in a place shielded from psi-effects. He’s still himself, miserable as ever.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_f: I’m not at liberty to say.
Of course. How quickly the Ward changes people…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_i: There’s nothing to understand, Richter. The Zone is a mistake.
Quite the opposite. I understand everything. The Zone was a mistake from the very beginning.
I hope you never make it to Prypiat. You’re just not worthy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_n: It’s not all bad. You saved my life back then.
And where did that get me? I put the only thing I love — the Zone — at risk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_t: What can you tell me about him?
I’m looking for a way into Prypiat, and I know he’s been helping stalkers get there.
And what is the Ward looking for in Prypiat? No, don’t tell me, let me guess: “it’s classified?”
When Spirit and I went our separate ways, he was heading down the tunnel to Lymansk. He’s probably still out there, looking for a way into the town.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_v: So what did Korshunov lure you in with? Money? Power? What’s the going rate for freedom and self-respect these days?
Right up to the last minute, I clung to the hope that you were just fucking with them. But you… I’m a lousy guide. Quite a shitty guardian angel, too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_RihterVarta_w: What are you doing here, anyway?
I’m having a great time hanging out with my best buddies: misanthropy and self-loathing.
Same thing as you: chasing my dreams. It’s just too bad I haven’t gotten there yet. Silver lining: neither have you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Sana_goaway_6: I said, thank you, but hit the road already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Sana_letmesee: I just need to talk to him. Maybe I can help.
I don’t think you can. It’s too late.
If you make it worse, you’re dead, man. I’ll see to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Sana_needtota: I’m looking for Spirit. Do you know him?
Where did you even... Oh, well. I guess, it’s no time for secrets now.
He hired us to guide him to Lymansk. But now it seems we can only guide him to the other side.
So you're free to go. There's nothing to see here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Sana_notyourb: I need to get inside. Open it. Or I will.
Zone knows I didn't want to fight. But you're too much of a hothead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Sana_opentheg: Open up! He wants to talk to Spirit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Sana_talktome: Will you tell what happened here?
The Zone happened! In all its fucking glory!
We went into the tunnels, thought we'd find a way through. Nope. Nothing but rubble and mutants.
So we turned back, and the Monolithians came outta nowhere. Those bitches tracked us like fucking bloodhounds!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Sana_tunnel_6: What kind of tunnel is this?
The road to Lymansk. Or so we thought.
But it’s a dead end, too. I guess, Nor himself ordered to collapse it. Fucking gloryhound.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_Tunnel_thanxb: Thanks for helping us with those critters, but you better get outta here, and quick. I can’t deal with you right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovDegot_de: Tell me about Degtyarev. What’s he like?
Ever seen a chimera? Like, a real mean one that's been lurking around since the Brain Scorcher days?
That’s Degtyarev for you. If I were a loner, I’d make sure not to run into him. But you’re not just a regular loner anymore, are you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovSkaner_t: I’ve got the device Spirit used to guide stalkers across the Boundary.
The device? What the fuck are you talking about?
Spirit modified a SIRCAA Scanner into something that could disable certain anomalies.
You’ve gotta be fucking kidding me! It's bad enough you folks are willing to scale the wall to get to Prypiat, now you're waltzing through anomalies!
Hand it over. I’m gonna destroy it before any more guides pop up.
You wanted to cross the Boundary, stalker. Fine, the way is clear. I’ll tell them to let you through.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_ab: He knows his way around. Hooked me up with folks at Garbage and with the IPSF. But I haven't seen him since the Monolith returned.
Probably because he figured his business guiding stalkers across the Boundary went kaput.
His business, not mine. I didn't know what he was up to.
You have no idea how little I care about this at the moment.
If you want to get to Prypiat, find me that Spirit guy. As you can see, my crew's a little thin, so if you’re set on crossing the Boundary, you’ll need to do a bit of legwork.
You can find a guy who worked with Spirit at the Water Tower. He might be able to tell you something. If he's not too drunk to talk.
See, it’s not that hard to cut to the fucking chase. You’ve got your lead, stalker. Dismissed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_an: Same old. The Monolith keeps moving forward round the clock. They've taken the Bridge, but won't stop there.
And we both know how they took the Bridge, Wreck. Don’t even think the loner's gonna distract me from our conversation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_du: I’ve heard that a guy called Spirit might be able to lend me a hand.
Holy fucking shit... well, would you look at that! Care to offer our guest a discount, Wreck? Or should we ask Telegraph to give him a proper tour?
I haven’t seen Spirit since the Signal! Yeah, we did business together. But you didn’t make a fuss about my connections when I brought you two boxes of ammo, did ya?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_ho: Seems like things are going south here, huh?
We've always been short on manpower. And now… I’ll put it this way: I still have enough resources to keep you out of Prypiat.
But not enough to push the Monolith back.
None of your business. But you’re well aware of that, or you wouldn’t have gotten this far in the Zone. Is that all you wanted to know?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_ic: And what good are your coupons? Ammo's worth more to me lately, as I can at least hold that in my hand.
And what good are your coupons? Ammo's worth more to me lately, as I can at least hold that in my hand.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_ko: Why would I care? Korshunov can kiss my ass. What’s left of the Ward would be better off limping back to the Mainland, not trying to take on Prypiat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_pr: I need to get to Prypiat.
Sure, no problem. Come on in, make yourself at home.
Sealed tight. We’ve never allowed anyone in before, and since the Signal, it’s out of the question.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_sh: Sorry, can’t help you there. And I don’t want to. If Spark wants to get to Prypiat, I wish you the best of luck, but I’m not defying Degtyarev’s orders. Not even if Scar himself comes begging.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_st: Cool. Did he pour you one for the road too? Every single bloke here claims to know Strelok, and half of ’em shared a drink with him, too. Next time, be more creative.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_wh: And there’s nothing we can do about it?
Well, you can wait till we’re done wiping out Monolith. Then we’ll see.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_Dialog_YanovStart_wo: The Corps can’t work with other stalkers?
Working together is acceptable. Breaking our oath is not.
When did a promise to Deggy become my oath? All I did was give Spirit the coordinates I got from the Lesser Zone. I didn't have a clue what that Blue Falcon from the Sphere was up to.
And that was before the Signal. What does it matter now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_duh_0_HelloTopic_Hel: Well? Spill it while I’m still breathing…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_duh_0_InfoTopic_1_in: Prypiat, Lymansk — just think of all the people who used to live there. So many homes destroyed, but somehow, I can feel mine is still out there, waiting for me…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E12_MQ01_oceret_0_InfoTopic_1: What's waiting for us in Lymansk? Beats me, but it better be worth the trouble. Otherwise, why the fuck are we even bothering?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_Bossfight_Korshunov_Comem: Damn! I’ll keep the Wardens busy, Skif. You handle Korshunov!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_Bossfight_Korshunov_Comme: Fucking Ward! You take the colonel, I’ll deal with the soldiers!
You fucking pest! I should’ve shot you right away.
You were a mistake, and I’m going to rectify it.
The Zone took my life, and now I’m taking yours!
Show yourself, asshole. Time to die!
I’ll eradicate you. Along with your fucking Zone!
I’m not… losing… to a Stalker!
You bastard son of the Zone! I’m going to kill you!
You’ll pay for every single one of them.
You want to die for your worthless beliefs? I’ll be happy to oblige!
I’ll burn the Zone. Burn it all down. Burn you all!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Audiolog_Dvoriankov_: Delta Team, rendezvous at the exact coordinates for points B or C.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Audiolog_Prometey_Sp: Rustle, we’re retreating to our fallback position. If anything goes wrong, take cover at these coordinates.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_AudiologRadi: Copy that! If anything happens, rendezvous at the secondary point. Over and out.
Delta, we’re taking fire! Monolith presence confirmed. Requesting immediate backup!
Kappa, we have orders to send you the scans and burn the archives. We’re taking casualties!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Burn_plancha: Genghis Khan, Rustle, burn the archives. We have the scans already. And get to the rendezvous point ASAP!
This place is fucked. Those mutants…
Fuck, I think we’ve got company! If things go south, get to the secondary…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Chinatown_In: I never imagined a city could be so utterly dead. It’s as if it were once a living thing, and now it's giving you the empty stare.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_DegotScrelok: You're supposed to be at the Laundromat or the Prometheus, not here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_DegotjAfterD: Deploy a squad to Sector 8. Looks like an ambush.
And keep a close eye on the stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_DegotjApproa: Check sectors 6, 7, and 11. Quick. The assault on HQ is a diversion.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_DegotjOneOfU: One more thing: the stalker is one of us now. He doesn’t need a pass.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_DvoryankovFl: Five. Grebnev, half an hour ago.
We’re stretched thin. Tell the colonel the men can’t…
You think I haven’t tried?! I told him a hundred times!
The response is always the same: carry out your orders!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Gorovitz_Int: I get the feeling the Ward's already gone. We’re just bogged down in the colonel’s private war against the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_KorshAndDali: That’s the face of war, Dalin. At least the Monolithians are oblivious to the horror of it all.
Are you certain about that, Colonel? They’re human, after all…
Now, when we’re on the verge of reaching our goal, you’re suddenly concerned about their lives? What about my men?
This will all be over soon. We’ll make sure of that. And we'll do whatever we have to do to get there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_KorshunovOnI: Carry out your orders, soldier. I’m counting on you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Litvinuk_Int: I don’t know who scares me the most: the Sparkers, the Monolithians, the mutants, or the colonel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_MolotokRadio: Sector 7. We’ve got an issue. Windmill’s gone silent.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_PolynChinato: Chrome’s squad never made it back.
“At all costs.” That’s what Scar said, China.
Looks like we’re up next, then.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Polyn_Invite: Skif, come in. Scar wants to discuss our next move with you.
Sending you the coordinates. Hurry up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Scar_ComeHer: Over here, Skif. I know what we’re going to do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Scar_Richter: Then we’ll just keep searching. Until we find it.
And what if we don’t? The city’s swarming with Monolithians, Wardens, the Corps…
If everything in life was easy, why would we need faith?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Shram_Intera: We need to get ahead of our enemies. Don’t drag your feet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Sorokin_Inte: The guys who died at the Duga had it easy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Storm1_1_660: We’re under attack! Sector 18! Defend your positions! Keep your heads down!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_StormIsOver_: Stalker, come on in. It’s clear.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_VartaCampInv: Skif, come in. You can’t imagine what it cost us, but we've pushed the Monolithians back and secured a position in the area. I’m sending you the coordinates.
We’re waiting for you, soldier. It’s time to go over our plans.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Vityaz_Inter: The Zone can be cruel. But here in Prypiat, it truly hits home. This is where you start feeling it for real.
Unless you’re Scar, that is. I wish I could see what he sees one day.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Vol_Approach: You’re a good shot. We could use someone like you here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Vol_Interact: Degtyarev’s the boss. I’m just here to shoot Monolithians.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Comment_Yedkiy_Inter: I’m the sole survivor of my old squad. But I know we’ll meet again... in the Shining Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_DalinAtCamp_1: I’m relieved you made it through, Skif. So much has transpired here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_DalinAtCamp_F: We’re going to put an end to this once and for all. The Zone will no longer pose a threat. It's for the good of all mankind — just like you told me back at SIRCAA.
Yes, of course… it’s just that sometimes I find myself wondering if that’s truly what my father had in mind.
No matter. I’m sorry, Skif. This hesitation on my part is uncalled for.
We all have a great mission to accomplish, and we’re going to see it through.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_DalinAtCamp_G: Our goal — everything you’ve strived for — is within reach. But you don’t seem too elated about it.
I am. I’m glad this nightmare will come to an end one day.
It’s just… too much. So many people… are they truly gone forever?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_DalinAtCamp_N: Seeing things like this is never easy, but we need you, Doctor.
All of my life, I’ve followed in my father’s footsteps, yet now I can’t help but question if this is truly what he desired. Unfortunately, I’ll never know.
I’m sorry, stalker. My hesitation is uncalled for.
I envy your determination. Don’t worry, I mean to see this to the end.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_DalinAtCamp_W: Yeah, a lot's happened. But what really matters is what happens next. What’s the plan after we get to the STALKER Program Control Center?

The STALKER Program Control Center is the heart of the X-Network. After what we did at SIRCAA, the X-Network is still operational within the Zone, but its connection to the Generators remains severed.
We’re going to rectify that. Afterward, we’ll be just a stone’s throw away from taking control of the Anomalous energy.
And then the Zone will be gone. Forever.
You’re not a soldier, Dalin. Why did Korshunov bring you along?
Agatha needs a scientist to make sure the system functions correctly once we reach the Control Center.
Dalin started this whole thing, so Dalin has to finish it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_DegotjStrelok: I told you, Skif is a one-man army. Oh, hi, by the way!
You made it here already, Richter?
Took you long enough to show up.
You two can catch up later. Strelok sent you. Why?
I’ve come across something that seems to match what you were talking about. Is that what we need?
What can you tell me about the Laundromat?
It served as the HQ for the military during Operation Fairway.
Officially, it involved five helicopters, but there were more – including a Stingray-7, which crashed soon after a mission to search for information about the entrances to the underground.
Now, there’s an anomalous field there – if that’s a concern for a man who made it through the Boundary on his own.
All right. I’m heading out.
Once you find the information, come back here. You’ll have my men's support to access the Foundation.
Get to work, stalker.
Thanks for dealing with those Monolithians.
I need more information about the data stored at the movie theater.
In 1986, an archive of military facility blueprints was moved to the Prometheus. You might be able to find the one we need in there.
We’ve observed increased mutant activity there in the past, but it’s up to you to figure out what’s going on there at the moment.
Besides the Monolithians, we’ve also identified some Wardens and Sparkers in the vicinity. They could be after the same thing you are.
What’s your reason for siding with Strelok?
Right now it's because I don't want anyone to gain access to the underground part of the city — even if the only alternative is to destroy it.
In a way, I was born here, stalker. And I’ll die here if I have to.
I need to get to the underground area beneath the city.
We used to have an entrance here, under the Palace of Culture. Back then, I was short on manpower, and when we started having trouble with mutants, I decided to seal it off.
Any other leads?
I had a few, but Richter’s been through all of them.
Exactly! It wasn’t a walk in the park, but at least I got a break from the rural scenery. Unfortunately, I couldn’t find any other entrances.
I’ve hit a dead end, so we’ll have to search for information. In the past, the entire underground area functioned as a military installation known as the Foundation.
There could be old Operation Fairway documents somewhere in the Laundromat.
Also, the Prometheus movie theater might have some old blueprints of military installations. It's up to you where to go. Neither one is going to be a piece of cake.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Degotj_1_6602: I’m looking for the entrance to the Prypiat underground.
Don’t expect any assistance from the Corps.
I’m aware of what you and your associates are after. We won’t allow it.
Yes. Your involvement might’ve saved a couple of my men, so you’re permitted to stay in my town and camp for now.
However, if you keep digging around, I’ll treat you just like any Monolithian.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Degotj_2_6602: Grim. But you can see that for yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Degotj_3_6603: The Palace of Culture is the last outpost where my men can rest and resupply in Prypiat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Degotj_GaveSc: Nor briefed me about you. Impressive. I appreciate your help with these fanatics too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Degotj_NoScan: Degtyarev, commander of the Corps. I appreciate your help against the Monolithians, uh...
I’ve heard about you. And the folks you roll with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Degotj_Talk_6: Don’t beat around the bush, Skif. Every minute I’m here means one less dead Monolithian.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Dvorenkov_1_6: What’s going on in the city right now?
We’re between a rock and a hard place: Monolith on one side, the Corps on the other.
For now, they’re busy fighting each other, but as soon as one of them takes over, they’ll set their sights on us.
And to top it off, we don't have the resources to monitor Spark’s movements. I just hope this city has swallowed them up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Dvorenkov_2_6: It’s much worse. If things continue like this, we’ll have to make a tough call about who gets medical attention: the badly injured or the ones with a shot at getting back into the fight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Dvorenkov_3_6: Is there anything I can do to help?
Do what Korshunov says. The sooner you act, the more lives we can save.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Dvorenkov_sta: A Ward soldier doesn’t question orders. God knows I’m a good soldier.
But now I’m sending men to their deaths just to buy time for a stalker. A stalker!
I hope the colonel knows what he’s doing. Otherwise, what’s left for me?
Fucking hell... I need some rest. So, what do you want?
If you've got any problems with equipment or supplies, take it to my men from the Chemical Plant.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_1_6: What did you find out, soldier?
That Degtyarev is one stubborn son of a bitch. He won't let anyone into the underground and refused to help.
They had dreams too. They had aspirations. And now there’s just... nothing. Just like that.
Degtyarev has always been a pain in the ass, but I’ll deal with him later. For now, let’s proceed with the backup plan: we’ll find the entrance ourselves.
Based on our intel, there is a couple of places where we might be able to find what Degtyarev is trying so hard to keep from us.

The first spot is the Laundromat, we might find some old documents from Operation Fairway there. Another one is the Prometheus movie theater, which was used to store blueprints of underground facilities. Any questions?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Has: I stumbled across something on my way here. Isn’t this what you’re talking about?
You never cease to amaze me, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Lau: Tell me more about the Laundromat and Operation Fairway.
Operation Fairway was a second attempt to take over the CNPP. Interestingly, Degtyarev was a major in the SSU at the time, and he was one of those responsible for the mission's failure.
I had to deal with some of the fallout later, so I know that their objectives included finding an entrance to the underground facilities beneath Prypiat. The Laundromat served as their makeshift HQ.
There’s an anomalous field in there at the moment. That’s pretty much all I know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_NoI: That’s all I wanted to know.
Then move out on the double. I can’t spare any men yet — the Monolithians can easily track large groups, and I’ve already lost more than half my squad.
We’ll stay here, ready to accompany you to the Control Center when you get back.
There has to be another way. Someone needs to put an end to this bloodshed.
Dalin will come to his senses. But he’s not wrong.
We’re getting there. We’re almost there, Skif.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Pro: I need more information about the data stored at the movie theater.
In 1986, an archive of military facility blueprints was moved to the Prometheus. There’s a chance you could find something useful in there.
Assuming the place hasn't been looted by stalkers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Wha: Assuming I find the entrance, what comes next?
We’ll also find a way to get to the Generators and finally wipe this festering boil called the Zone off the face of the Earth.
Eliminate. Destroy. Is that our mission? Is that what we’re doing here?
You can’t build the new without tearing down the old. You’re a scientist, remember?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_are: I’m fine. I think I knew him. But his name eludes me…
Dr. Dalin isn't a soldier. He’s a stranger to the battlefield, unlike you and me. It’s okay — every boy has to become a man eventually.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Polyn_polynst: It’s good to have you with us, stalker. Our numbers are dwindling.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Polyn_whathap: What’s the situation? Are we holding our ground?
Barely. The Corps and Monolith are at each other’s throats, it'll keep them busy.
But the moment either of them gains the upper hand, they’ll turn their attention to us. The Ward hasn’t gone anywhere either. It’s a race against the clock.
Aside from that, it’s the same old story. Scar's awfully calm.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Polyn_whatthi: What’s your take on Scar’s plan?
No matter what happens, we’re heading in the right direction. Even if not everyone makes it to the finish line.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_RichterAndSca: So what’s the plan now?
I've got three leads.
I already checked one. It’s a dead end. Not to mention I narrowly escaped getting killed there!
And yet your efforts were helpful to Skif. Everything happens for a reason, you see? Now we’re left with two options: the Prometheus and the Laundromat.
You’re a changed man, Richter.
It's all thanks to you, Skif. You were right — if you believe in something greater than yourself, life no longer seems that unfair anymore. And neither does the Zone.
I’m not sure how this will all play out in the end, but I’ll do my best to make amends for what I’ve done.
After all, regret is part of the darkness we're trying to leave behind. Among other things.
I’ve been through worse. I can handle it.
The city’s a death trap. Wherever you turn, you’re gonna have to fight your way out. And that’s if you’re fortunate enough.
You ain’t getting it, Skif! I’m dead serious! Prypiat was never a walk in the park, but now…
I’m not like your old group, Richter. I won’t end up lost. Trust me. Trust the Zone.
Couldn’t have said it better myself.
Let’s get going. Keep me posted, all right?
I stumbled across something out there. Could this be what we’re looking for?
Really?
What’s inside the Laundromat?
It was the HQ for the military forces involved in Operation Fairway. Don’t bother asking about the specifics — we both have enough crap to think about as it is.
However, there could be documents there related to a helicopter that was sent to locate the entrance to the underground area. Stingray 7, I think it was.
The hardest part is just before you win, isn’t it?
The Prometheus? What’s in there?
A long time ago, they stashed an archive of military facility blueprints there — including maps of the underground area.
At the very least, we might be able to help our friendly guide expand his collection of Prypiat maps.
I’m ready to go.
Deggy doesn’t want to cooperate. He’s like the blind dog in the manger — he won't eat the hay himself, and he won't let anyone else have it either.
There has to be another way. It's what the Zone is all about.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Richter_allgo: Everyone was ready to tear each other apart. But now that you’re here, I think everything’s gonna be all right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Richter_doyou: Do you believe Scar now? Do you believe in the Shining Zone?
I… I want to believe. Watching you two, I see what a man who truly believes can achieve.
Whether it’s the Shining Zone, immortality, or anything else.
Once upon a time, I believed I could become a true guide. Now, thanks to you, I believe it again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_Richter_guide: A true guide? What does that even mean?
It means guiding people not along your own twisted, misguided path, but along the path laid out by the Zone, the path it reveals to you naturally.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_Dialog_RihterStrelok: Don’t go thinking Degtyarev's going to be the only one accompanying you to the underground, Skif. I might not be the toughest fighter around, but I’m a true guide. We’re going in together.
A true guide? What does that even mean?
It means believing in yourself and the path the Zone has laid out for you.
Just because a journey is challenging, doesn’t mean you should shy away from it.
Are you part of Strelok’s crew now?
I’m with you. That means I’m with Strelok for now.
But, first and foremost, I’m with the Zone. And I’m determined to defend it until my last breath.
Once upon a time, I aspired to become a true guide. Now, thanks to you, I am one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_leva_fan_0_InfoTopic: The more progress we make, the more I’m convinced I made the right call by betting on the Ward. They seem to be the Zone’s favorite.
Even if the Zone doesn’t like them that much.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_leva_fan_0_Meet_meet: As you can see, our team has been reshuffled. I guess the Ward is getting ready for something huge.
I’d love to watch the first division in action, of course, but my place is here, riding the pine. At least it’s safe here.
Make sure to gear up. All the Ward stuff is top of the line.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_leva_fan_0_TradeTopi: I know how to get the best gear, even in the worst of times.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_p_hyphen_k_degtarev_: Anyone staking a claim to my city will be destroyed by the Corps or the Zone itself.
Get out of the line of fire!
The enemy is retreating. All clear for now.
Have you lost your mind? Take this away.
Be quick about it, stalker. I’ve got things to do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzant_ivajlov_0_He: Hand it over. I’ll get it fixed up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzant_ivajlov_0_In: The only time I was recalled from the Chemical Plant was the Duga op. And it was a success — the second time, anyway.
I hope things go well here too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzant_ivajlov_0_Me: Holy shit... they didn’t prepare me for this. Nobody was ready for this, I guess.
I think your gear could use a bit of fixing... regardless of where you’re headed next.
I heard about your next assignment. I know you’re used to this job, but you’d better make sure you’re ready for anything. The expeditionary units are staying behind.
They brought me some Monolithian gear after the Duga. There's some pretty cool stuff, sure.
But the more I took it apart, the more uneasy I became. If those were the weapons they had there, I wonder if we’ll stumble upon anything even more powerful here.
And if we do, maybe we’re better off staying away from it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzdot_eremeev_0_In: You tell me. My job is to fix the gear and issue it on time, - those are my orders.
The latest batch was a huge one. But all good stuff, watertight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzdot_eremeev_0_Me: Hey, Skif! We last met at Icarus, if I'm not mistaken. Those weren't such bad times after all.
I thought they'd send me to the Mainland. But then I got reassigned here. Maybe, for the better. I know a thing or two about kit.
If you wanted to get something fixed, now's the time, before they reassign me someplace else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzdot_hoteev_0_Hel: What can I help you with?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzdot_hoteev_0_Inf: If you want news, ask Korshunov. Nothing much here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_serzdot_hoteev_0_Mee: The time has come for the Ward to clench its fists and strike hard. Preparation is key.
You surely need to restock. The fullest range of equipment is at your fingertips.
We're lucky there's been a new equipment delivery. And it's all assigned already.
But I'll find something for you. Take your pick.
You're on time, I've got some new arrivals. And my job is to equip you all to the max.
Come on, let's get you geared up. It'll come in handy.
Hey, Skif, never thought we'd meet again? Neither did I. Everyone's ordered to rally up. And I mean, everyone.
We had a pile of decommissioned stuff here, remember? Now everything's accounted for. Nothing's left to just sit there.
But for you, we'll find something. Go ahead, take your pick.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_stepsel_0_ByeTopic_b: I’ll see you around, whether it’s here, or in the Shining Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_stepsel_0_HelloTopic: I knew you’d need my services. What needs fixing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_stepsel_0_InfoTopic_: I’ve always had a feeling the Zone was something more than just a place on a map.
And now I’m sure of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_stepsel_0_Meet_2_mee: We’ve lost too many… but we’ll meet again in the Shining Zone.
Stock up on supplies. Traveling light won’t get you there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_stepsel_0_Meet_3_mee: One more step, and victory is ours. Then everything we've been through won’t be in vain.
I’ll help you however I can. You do your part too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_stepsel_0_Meet_meet1: The journey to the Shining Zone isn’t a walk in the park, is it? Well, it wasn’t meant to be easy.
While I may not be on the front lines, I’m still doing my part. No one goes into battle with broken equipment.
If you need your gear fixed, I’ve got you covered.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_stepsel_0_UpgradeTop: I’ve fixed worse! I’ll make it better than new.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_suska_0_InfoTopic_1_: Save your questions for when we accomplish our mission. In the meantime, each of us has a job to do.
There’s work to be done. No time for chitchat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_suska_0_Meet_2_meet2: I hadn’t seen you in action before the Foundation, but now I see why Scar puts his trust in you.
Looks like you’ve gone through a fair bit of ammo. Stock up while we’re both here. Might come in handy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_suska_0_Meet_3_meet3: Everything I've got is yours. May it help you take us to the Shining Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_suska_0_Meet_meet1_6: I’m no fan of small talk, least of all at a time like this. Make it quick.
Each of us has a role to play. Mine is handling supplies.
Maybe we won’t need any of these goods in the Shining Zone, but we can’t make it there without them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_suska_0_TradeTopic_T: All my goods are top-notch, but choose wisely.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ01_vol_0_InfoTopic_1_wh: Prypiat will never be the same again. Maybe it’s for the best. I’d rather go down fighting than slowly rotting away, waiting for who knows what.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Agatha_About: I can only teleport you to the nearest bunker in the Dead Valley, Yevhen. The teleportation system isn’t fully operational yet. It’ll take some time.
So remember to grab the experimental Project X suit. You’ve got the coordinates already.
For now, we’ll have to make do with older designs to make sure you’re protected.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Agatha_Inter: You can leave now, Yevhen. I’ve unlocked the teleporter for you. The Dead Valley awaits.
You need Professor Hermann. He will tell you what to do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_DalinCall_Is: I hope you can hear me, Skif.
Korshunov’s already in the main hall. They’re just waiting for the new Control Unit. I’ll do what I can, but…
Please don’t try to charge in head-on. You’ll just get yourself killed. Use the video surveillance room on the second floor. I’ll open it for you. I have the means to do it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Dalin_DontKi: Skif… Skif! Please, don’t. Do not repeat my…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Dalin_NeedKe: The pendant, Skif! Faust’s pendant! The colonel has it. It’s the key to the Visiograph.
We'll talk soon. And then everything will fall into place. Finally.
Get me the pendant off Korshunov’s body, quick!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_DegotCall_1_: Your guys walked into an ambush, but I avenged them.
Got it. Strelok mentioned we’ve got an ally in the Ward. He let us know that their troops are closing in on the Foundation.
The clock is ticking. Let’s put a stop to whatever the Ward is doing down there.
I’ve been watching over this underground facility for years for a reason. Get ready to waltz through all nine circles of hell.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_DegotSecRoom: Do you really think the Ward is gonna wait for us?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Degot_Hurry_: Get moving! We gotta make it in time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Degot_Securi: So our ally is Dalin, huh? Sounds shitty, but I guess it’s better than nothing.
He rescued me once. We can trust him.
I hope he doesn’t chicken out. Let’s roll. We’re running out of time.
We’ve got to destroy the Foundation before the Ward is done with it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_DvoryankovKo: Even if the stalker comes back, what about the wounded, Colonel?
I'm sorry, but the enemy won’t show any weakness, so we can’t afford to either.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Dvoryankov_I: See you there, Skif. I need to prepare my men… the ones that are left, anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Ivailov_comm: If you’ve been itching to upgrade or grab some new gear, Skif, now’s the time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_KorshCall_1_: What’s happening over there? Dvoryankov’s gone dark.
Spark. The entire squad has been wiped out. But I made sure not a single Spark bastard lived to tell the tale.
I’ll kill them. I’ll kill them all!
But it can wait. Right now, our priority is reaching the Foundation. Once you’re down there, there’s only one path: straight ahead.
I’ll see you down below, soldier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Korshunov_In: Get ready and move out on the double. That’s an order.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Korshunov_Ki: There’s one left: Dalin, the little bitch. Kill him!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Korshunov_Sk: Why are you all doing this to me? Huh?!
Go to the control unit. Obey an order for once.
Good. Finally, someone in this pigsty knows how to follow orders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Olimpia_SorL: Fuck… it’s too bad about Kyrylchuk. If we had a medkit, we could've saved him.
What the hell are those Sparkers doing here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_RIchterCall_: Skif, come in. I know you’re nearby. What’s happening right now…
They want to destroy it! And you’re on their side too? How can you not love the Zone? Haven’t you witnessed its miracles, its… its breathtaking beauty?
It wasn’t meant to end like this. I know I made the right call back in Zalissya. And I’d make it again!
I’m begging you, Skif. Please. This is my home.
It’s for the greater good. I’ve made my choice, and I’m not backing down, Richter.
I’m sorry. But neither am I.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Representati: Go. I want to talk to my son.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_RichterBossf: I’m not letting my Zone go!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_RichterGun_1: By the way, Deggy left you his gun. He said if you survive, you deserve it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_RichterIskra: Phew. You made it in one piece.
I wish I could tag along, but the others need my help more. I’ll catch up with you there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_RichterSecRo: Don’t just stand there, the fate of the Zone is at stake!
Where are you headed, Skif?! We’re running out of time!
We can chat once the Zone is safe.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_ScarArrived_: At last. I was afraid I wouldn’t make it in time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_ScarCall_Isk: How did your rendezvous go, Skif?
There were Wardens here, but I avenged our men.
A good man, our new friend, reported that the Warden pigs are already digging toward the Foundation.
Get over there on the double. We’ll meet you underground.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_ScarDalin_Af: The connection is incredibly unstable… I’m not even sure if my father can hear me…
I’ll lend you a hand, Doctor. Ozersky taught me a few tricks.
But soon, none of this will be necessary. You’re going to meet him for real. I promise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_ScarHurry_Sc: Grieve not for the dead, Skif. When they awaken, they will be embraced by the Shining Zone.
Speak to the Representative. Our goal is within our grasp. It’s time to find out how to attain it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_ScarIskra_In: Get ready, we’re heading out soon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_SkifNotCaugh: It’s the corpses. Their silence is deafening.
It’s too quiet here, even by Prypiat standards.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Stepsel_Come: If you’re looking to upgrade your gear, Skif, now’s the time!
If you need any repairs, I’m your man. If you’re in the market for something new, talk to Sushka.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Strelok_Abou: From the Red Fortress we go to the Generators. Through the teleport. They've had no maintenance in ten years.
So you need experimental armor from Project X, otherwise it'll dissolve you into molecules. I'll give you a set from my old stock. Here're the coordinates, you'll find it there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Comment_Strelok_DKIn: See you by the Red Fortress.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_AgathaAfterCu: So the Anomalous energy of the Zone is finally under control, just like you wanted?
We’ll reestablish the link between the Foundation and the Generators and claim the vacant pod in X7, and that’s how it will be.
Not while the link to the Generators is severed. Only Alpha allowed remote access. But that's just a minor obstacle.
Dr. Kaymanov doesn’t think a single pod will be enough.
Kaymanov? That scientist who missed his chance to enter the eighth pod, thus granting us the opportunity to seize control of the Anomalous energy? He’s stuck in the past.
You don’t need eight people to interface with the Noosphere anymore. I alone am sufficient, along with a Mediator in the pod who will serve as an intermediary between the Zone and the Noosphere.
And who’s going to be that Mediator?
The Doctor didn’t inform you? How typical of him...
The Mediator is a human, but a unique one. They must have class 5 psi-protection. It’s a necessary requirement that cannot be ignored.
I knew you wouldn’t permit us to experiment on your men, Colonel. That’s why you were kept in the dark until the eleventh hour.
When the fate of the future and the lives of a few soldiers hang in the balance, I believe the choice is self-evident. Besides, that psi-protection saved your life at the Duga.
What do you want from me?
Professor Hermann will fill you in on the details of our plan to restore the connection between the Foundation and the Generators.
Do you have someone like that in mind?
Certainly — Colonel Korshunov. I insisted he received the required psi-protection. We had to handpick the Ward soldiers exposed to psi-effects to manufacture it.
So the Mediator is Colonel Korshunov?
What’ll happen to the Monolith and the Agents of C-Consciousness now?
In my view, the Monolith wasn’t the most successful C-Consciousness experiment.
They certainly fulfilled their purpose, but the notion of needing a new god to compel their loyalty made everything too complicated.
