Now, as for the Agents… the finest among them weren’t even aware they were Agents, but that didn’t stop them from carrying out their mission. Fascinating, isn’t it?
Your cigarette leaves no smell. None whatsoever.
And yet the flavor is exquisite, Yevhen. Have you forgotten it since our encounter at SIRCAA? Regrettably, I can’t offer you a smoke at the moment.
And he killed them.
Ironic, isn't it? The tool they stole from us ended up killing them.
So Dalin decided to betray us?
You sound just like the Colonel.
I'd say we all make mistakes, Yevhen. And those mistakes always cost someone their life. Especially when you choose your own empty hopes and dreams over the common good.
Dmytro Dalin stubbornly refused to believe that the Representative was not his father, but only a program, and that C-Consciousness was irrevocably dead - long gone.
The same thing had happened to Valentyn Dalin, by the way. He was doomed as soon as he decided that his own utopian ideas were more important than the goals of Project X.
It should have happened during the Alpha experiment at SIRCAA, if Faust hadn't made some alterations to our plan.
But better late than never. Since Professor Hermann replaced the control unit, the X-Network is in my hands. Neither the Representative nor anyone else will be able to access it.
After all these years, Project X will finally be completed.
So what do you expect me to do next?
Would you mind telling me more about X-Network?
The X-Network was the most important element of our plan. A psi-based infrastructure that connected all Project X devices and kept them functioning.
Until the Noosphere Contact Group called themselves C-Consciousness and seized control of the Network. One mistake, and here we are, in the Zone.

After that, they used the X-Network for years and even made adjustments to it — created the Monolith and agents, for example. But they made a mistake here too. They wanted an agent, but got Strelok instead. And he...
So finishing Project X has always been your goal?
It couldn’t have been otherwise. Once upon a time, the Regulatory Board launched Project X to find a source of Anomalous energy that would mark a new milestone in technological advancement.
And we found it. This discovery is too valuable for humanity to end in nothing.
It was always only a matter of time before we regained control of the Anomalous energy. But we know how to be patient.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Dalin_AfterCu: I really meant well. I believed that I could make the future a little better. But Agatha’s plan was never about the good of humanity, was it? All she wanted was total control.
It’s all real. It’s always been real.
The miracles of the Zone. Subtle Matter. Eternal life within the Noosphere.
And I nearly destroyed it. Almost deprived humanity of its chance at immortality. I… I could’ve killed my own father.
But in the end, you didn’t do any of that. You saw the truth just in the nick of time — and you made the right choice.
Yes. That much is true. But I came dangerously close to making the wrong one.
It seems, I was almost late. What the hell were you and the Ward trying to do here?
I was about to do something right, for once in my life. And I would have died for it, if it weren't for you.
And they... They were planning to replace the Representative. Once they reconnected with the Generators, they could use the X-Network and all that C-Consciousness had created.
They wanted to erase my father. By my hand. I don’t know if the Colonel found that small detail funny.
You made the Shining possible. You’ve played your part. Now Scar and I need to finish what your father set in motion.
It’s still very dangerous out there. However, if you succeed, if it all goes according to plan, all these deaths — the Wardens, Spark, Noontide, ordinary stalkers — they'll all be undone.
Humanity will finally attain the life it deserves. A life without pain, without death, without hate. It’s a risk worth taking.
Maybe, after the Shining, great experiments will finally be performed without casualties.
Sounds like a promising future. Best of luck to you. See you in the new reality.
Be grateful to the Zone — it spared you from doing something you couldn't undo.
I am grateful. Truly, I am.
And if it wasn’t for you, she would’ve achieved it. I don’t know if I would’ve found the courage to get to the truth if you hadn’t opened my eyes to it. Thank you… for everything.
There are a lot of people who were oblivious to the truth. Even I had my doubts at times.
The colonel never had any doubt. He was always willing to kill and die for the lies spoon-fed to him by Agatha. I wonder what he’ll say once he returns from the dead…
What do you intend to do now?
I’m going to talk to my father, for starters. For far too long, I was convinced this would never happen again. I’ve got a lot of questions... and a lot to apologize for.
I just need to enhance the connection. The link is still unstable. I don’t want to lose him again before I’m done.
And after that… well, I suppose it depends on you. You and Scar.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Degot_RadioIn: The Monolith is pulling back toward the CNPP and the Red Fortress.
Got it. Report back if the situation changes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_1_6: You’re taking too long, Skif. I’m losing my men.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_5_6: Watch out, soldier. We haven’t seen the last of this city yet.
But once we’re through, the Zone will be history. If you’ve got any scores to settle, now’s the time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_6_6: So I get to the rendezvous point. What then?
My men will be waiting for you there. You’ll go down to the Foundation together.
There’s a rumor that Degtyarev intentionally left the underground lairs intact. Those damn mutants are guarding the place as much as his men are.
Once you're down there, you’ll need anything that can kill. Along with of all of your field experience.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_Isk: I’ll go through the Hotel.
If I were one of our “friends,” I’d put a couple of snipers there. But you’ve got a knack for treading lightly, Skif.
Tell me about the Olympiya Cafe.
If our enemies beat us to it, you’ll have a fight on your hands. But you love a good fight, don’t you?
What’s in store for me at the Polissya?
I’m going through the Olympiya.
I’ve got it. Ready to move?
Let’s do this. And brace yourself — the Zone has the ultimate challenge in store for us.
If you’ve got any unfinished business, you should probably wrap it up before we start down this path.
Are you certain about this, Richter?
No. But you both keep telling me that faith isn’t about certainty.
I’ll make sure they get to the spot. As for you... I never doubted you.
What’s gonna happen after we get to the Control Center?
We’ll pick up where we left off at Malachite — and this time, we’ll see it through. We’ll receive our instructions and purge all the darkness within us.
I’ll send my men to meet you there. Richter and I will take the second entrance. There's no way Korshunov can stop us this time.
See that, guide? The Zone is on our side. Let’s see what we’ve got.
Looks like this entire underground area is an old military facility called the Foundation, and there’s more than one entrance. The Polissya Hotel and the Olympiya Cafe. Hmm…
I reckon we shouldn’t leave either one to our dear friends from the Ward... which means we’re gonna have to split up. You can have first dibs, Skif.
Did you have a nice trip?
You gotta have more faith in me, Scar. Here, I found it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_Str: The Polissya Hotel. We’ll take that route.
Plenty of spots for concealed firing positions. Easy to sneak up on the enemy — assuming they don’t ambush you first.
Everything’s laid out in the open, no surprises. A straightforward frontal assault is the way to go.
What’s in store for me in the Polissya Hotel?
The Olympiya Cafe. We’ll take that route.
You’re taking too long, Skif. We could lose Prypiat.
You’ll take it. Not alone, of course – my men will go with you. I’ll contact the closest group. They’ll meet you there.
I’ll take the second entrance, just to be sure. We’ll get them in a pincer attack and crush them. How does that sound?
So, what do we have here?
Uh-huh. An underground military facility called the Foundation. Two entrances: the Polissya Hotel and the Olympiya Cafe.
It’s a good plan. I like that no one’s going to be sneaking up on me from behind.
See you at the Foundation, then.
One more thing, stalker. If you've got any scores to settle, now’s the time. Once you’re down there, there’s no turning back.
Yeah. Here. I think this is what we need.
Why are you going underground too? Why risk it?
I want to see the Foundation become a tomb for all those who want my city dead and buried.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_b1_: If I were one of those freaks, I’d stage an ambush there. It’s an ideal spot, and you’ll have a place to hide if things go south.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_c1_: This position probably calls for a direct assault. That’s about it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_c_6: What can you tell me about the Polissya Hotel?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_con: You heard him, major. We’re moving out toward the other entrance.
If there’s anyone in the Foundation, we’ll have them cornered. Nobody gets out of there alive until I say so.
The same goes for you, Skif. Follow your orders. The enemy won’t hold back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_FoundDocs_loo: So the entire underground section of the city is an old military facility called the Foundation. And by the looks of it, there are two entrances. Damn!
We’ll divide our forces. You’ll go in alone and keep it quiet. Dvoryankov’s squad will rendezvous with you on the spot.
The entry points are at the Olympiya Cafe and the Polissya Hotel. Pick your destination, soldier. It's your call.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Herman_AfterA: Hermann. How come I’m graced with the sight of your ugly mug again?
You’re not the only one who was expecting something different.
Eh, screw you. Just tell me what I have to do.
You have to reach the Mobile Bunkers and reestablish the connection between the Foundation and the Generators. Use this key card to get inside.
Keep in mind that the Navigator’s launch caused anomalous disturbances and frequent localized Emissions in the Dead Valley. If there were any safe routes through the Valley, they’re likely gone now.
This instability will persist until the link between the Foundation and the Generators is restored. The only way to stabilize this process is from Lab X7.
What’s in store for me in the Dead Valley?
It’s hard to tell. It’s the most anomalous area in the entire Zone. No one has ever returned from there, so our data is based solely on remote measurements.
The Dead Valley is constantly ravaged by spontaneous Emissions. And now, with the Generators operational, they’re likely to intensify.
Agatha mentioned the Navigator. What’s that?
Oh, right. It’s a system of artificial spatial anomalies. If we can get it up and running again, we can reach the Generators safely.
I take it you’re gonna explain what I have to do?
You don’t look like your usual self, Hermann. What happened?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_KorshAfterAga: How do you feel about this, Colonel?
My feelings are irrelevant. Only one thing matters: I win.
What'll happen to you when you enter the pod?
The same thing that happened to the C-Consciousness members before Strelok gunned their pods down.
But unlike them, I’ll fulfill my duty and do the right thing.
You’ll uncover all the Agents at last.
For years, I had to live with the burden of knowing I couldn’t apprehend every one of them and protect the Mainland from the Zone’s corruption.
I couldn’t trust anyone — they could all be wolves in sheep's clothing. I even envied Faust... at least he didn’t have to doubt his own men.
Now I’m reclaiming control. I’ll have the power to correct not just the mistakes of others, but my own as well.
You’ve got your orders, soldier. Get it done.
I’m going to see this through. I won’t let my soldiers's lives be wasted.
A Mediator, then? An intermediary? That implies that all information from the Noosphere will be flowing through me. Which means I’ll know everything about the Agents too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Representativ: SIRCAA and the Ward are trying to destroy the only chance humanity has to live without fear of death.
Korshunov told me about your Agents. He claimed they pose a threat to the Mainland. What’s their true purpose?
Everything we've created has served one purpose - the successful realization of the Shining in the future. The creation of Agents has been fully justified - thanks to them, you are on our side.
Unfortunately, after Strelok deactivated the psi-installation, we lost contact with the Zone for a while, so we had no control over the Agents who decided to leave the Zone.
Don't think they haven't been rewarded for their efforts. We’ve given them a reason to live, Skif. A higher purpose.
What about Strelok?
There was a glitch in the programming. Strelok went against his program. With the help of Dr. Kaymanov, who betrayed us once, he managed to get to the Monolith control unit.
We invited him to join us in the eighth pod. A mistake that might otherwise have cost us our lives - because he chose to destroy us instead.
To restore communication between the Center and the Generators, I’ll have to cross the Dead Valley. How do I do that?
Only the Shining has the power to reverse this process. But fear not. The Valley is only truly dangerous for the Ward and those who seek to destroy the Zone. Not for you.
Walk without fear, and you’ll reach your destination... and be the first to witness real miracles.
Now that the Navigator is operational, the Emissions in the Dead Valley are becoming more frequent. The entire Zone is in flux, new anomalies are emerging everywhere, and secure routes are vanishing.
And who's been helping you all this time?

We weren't the only ones who went up against the Regulatory Board. After Project X was frozen, some of our former employees decided to continue research under our guidance. They called themselves MDST.
When Strelok shot our bodies and destroyed one of the X-Network central nodes, we continued to exist in the Noosphere, but lost our connection to the Zone and the ability to interfere.
The Monolith program, X-Network and related laboratories, whose functioning was ensured by C-consciousness, stopped for 10 years. Only the Agents' programming survived.
Until you brought Alpha to SIRCAA. And until I ignorantly reactivated the system from the X11 lab. But it turned out that we were fortunate.
Who’s going to become the Mediator between the Zone and the Noosphere?
Bringing the Shining to life would be impossible without you, Skif. However, the role of the Mediator requires someone with class 5 psi-protection.
Scar’s mind exhibits an exceptional resistance to Emissions. That’s why the responsibility of resurrecting us falls on his shoulders. One might say he was born for it.
I've always known.
We are on the verge of achieving our goal, and thanks to you, we can now attain it. Now please leave. I… I’d like to speak to my son.
A single person wouldn’t have sufficed in the past, but now, with C-Consciousness manifested as Subtle Matter, we can enhance the connection from the other side.
So at some point you decided to go against the Regulatory Board. Why?

The Regulatory Board, a group of influential people behind Project X, wanted to use our work to gain control over the Noosphere with the help of a Generators network all over the planet. But they wanted it only for themselves.
We couldn't let that happen. As long as there is darkness in humanity, there will be people like them. Our original plan was to remove this darkness. That's how C-Consciousness came into being.
During the experiment there was a Breakdown, and the Noosphere energy rushed to the earth, creating an anomalous Zone. Thanks to it, we got new opportunities and developed the Shining project.
We've come so far. But I still don't understand how you've been carrying out your plan all this time.
In the disaster of 2006, C-Consciousness took control of the X-Network and Anomalous energy. Later, we created the Monolith and the Agents. But there were those who helped us from the beginning.
I’ve heard about induced illusions being part of the STALKER Program. I wasn’t completely sure if Subtle Matter was real, or if you were just a holographic projection.
The STALKER Program does indeed exist, but its function differs from what you might imagine. It doesn’t generate illusions, but rather enables the exchange of data with the Noosphere.
This is what made our communication possible.
Not a mistake. The Zone's providence. You never died, you became pioneers of the truth. Guides to eternity.
How did you get mixed up in all this anyway, Scar?
The Spark science task group has always worked for the scientists. They studied the Zone, while I believed in its mysterious destiny.
Once I heard the Shining Zone legend, I started looking for its manifestations even in the most remote and dangerous places…

And found Orbita. Talked to Topol, who's dead, just like you talked to Strider. Later, Ozersky and I did everything we could to restore the X17 visiograph and find out whether it's possible that the C-Consciousness scientists survived.
As you can see, I was right all along. Now you're on our side. The Zone's providence has always shown us the right path.
What do I need to do to make sure the Shining becomes a reality?
First, we need to restore the connection between the Center and the Generators. It can only be done manually at the Generators, so you’ll have to make your way there through the Dead Valley.
I’ll do my best to teleport you as close as possible, but the teleportation system is currently unstable, so you’ll need an experimental Project X suit. I’ll give you the coordinates.
Once the connection is restored, we’ll need another piece of the puzzle: a Mediator, a human being who will act as an intermediary between the Zone and the Noosphere.
That's all I wanted to know.
Do you have any more questions, or are you ready to proceed with the Shining Plan?
Greetings, Skif. The last time you conversed with the Representative of C-Consciousness, it was comprised of all its members. Thanks to your assistance, I can finally speak for myself.

Allow me to introduce myself. I’m Valentyn Dalin, the leader of the team responsible for making contact with the Noosphere. In 2006 I refused to follow the Regulatory Board's orders and became one of those who created the Zone by mistake.
I’m sure you’ve accumulated quite a few questions since our last encounter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_RichterRedFor: I need some time to get ready.
I see. Don’t drag it out.
We need to deal with the Doctor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Richter_Secur: You made it, Skif! Come on, let’s move.
Did you hear Dalin? They want to destroy the Zone! We can’t let that happen!
He’s taking another way in. We’ll be okay on our own. Hurry up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Scar_AfterRep: Go. And don't wander off the path.
I’ll go ahead and establish the connection between the Center and the Generators.
More than anything, Richter wanted the Zone’s forgiveness. But he never got it. What's his reward?
Once more, you refuse to accept anything you haven’t witnessed firsthand. How can you be certain that the Zone hasn’t granted him forgiveness?
Perhaps death was his ultimate redemption.
Thank you for revealing the Shining Zone to me.
Everyone else will witness it too before long.
You’ve always sought comprehensive answers to your questions, Skif. You have them all now. I’m glad.
I wonder if I could have pursued the truth as you did, against all odds, if I hadn’t known it from the start. To come this far without faith must have been an incredibly lonely journey.
For those who gained their faith at a great cost, the reward must be even greater. I’ll stick around and make sure the Doctor and the Representative aren’t disturbed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Scar_Interact: Go ahead, Skif. And don't wander off the path.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Strelok_After: Damn, another Emission. They aren't giving us any breaks. Hope Deggy's found some shelter.
Skif’s up and about, Strelok. I told you he’s got nine lives, just like a cat.
How did it go? Is the STALKER Program finished? Have we put an end to it?
What’s the rush, pal? You just came to.
Skif's right, Richter. We have no time to spare. Neither does the Zone.
She can't survive as long as there's still someone looking to take advantage of her.
What’s up with Degtyarev? He saved my life at the Foundation.
What do you think? After he brought you here, Deggy headed back to the city to do some recon.
He missed the good old Prypiat air, he said. I give him a day before he starts missing the adrenaline rush too.
Monolith seems to have lost interest in Prypiat since we took down the Foundation. They’re pulling out of the city. Some of them are heading to the CNPP, others to the Red Fortress.
What’s happening to the Zone, Strelok? I heard you say the Emissions are getting worse.
I can't believe this guy! Here I am, worried sick, and he’s been eavesdropping on us the whole time.
Richter.
After the STALKER Program Control Center was destroyed, local Emissions became more frequent. First, in the Dead Valley, and then the entire Zone began to shift. I guess no routes are safe anymore.
It will drown the Zone, that's for sure. Kaymanov is well aware of that. But it never stopped him.
Like who?
Kaymanov.
What about him? To what end could the old guy possibly try to use the Zone for, Strelok? Finding the best way to fix a blind dog’s broken leg?
The Good Doctor whose only wish is to heal everyone is just a mask. Here, listen. He recorded this in X7 not long before connecting to the C-Consciousness in the Noosphere.
I’ll make my decision after I talk to Kaymanov.
You won’t make it to the Red Forest without me. The Zone is renewing itself, just like it did after the Second Emission back in the fall of 2011.
But you were right, Skif — you’ll never get anywhere in the Zone if you’re afraid of your own failures.
Now let’s find out if I’m fit to be a true guide, or if I’m better off dead. Let's go! When else will we ever have a chance to see the Zone like this?
Don't let Kaymanov get into your head. Get rid of the Doctor and find me by the Red Fortress. Let's finish what we've started.
What if we try talking to him? Maybe he’ll understand.
We've been there already.
When he opens his mouth, you start second-guessing everything. You, not him.
That's why I don't believe the Doctor will change his mind. Can't teach an old dog new tricks, so might as well just put it down.
Barbarians who fancy themselves surgeons, connecting to the Noosphere to separate good from evil with the precision of a scalpel!
When did you become so adept at distinguishing between good and evil, Dalin? None of us possessed that skill before, and that hasn't changed now.
No, access to the Noosphere belongs to all of humanity, without exception. It’s a test that could either drown us in an abyss of mutual hatred…
Or elevate us to a new level where we can finally learn to understand and forgive each other. But it’s a journey for all of us — not just eight chosen ones.
So you want me to kill Kaymanov?
I want the Zone to just be the Zone. Kaymanov doesn't.
Getting to him now isn't easy. The Zone is shaking after the Foundation was destroyed. Due to anomalous disturbances, everywhere is dangerous now. But you can do it. You have to.
But why does it have to be me? Why can’t you kill him yourself?
Because. No wavering. No stupid memories about an old friendship and a life I owe him.
One shot — an easy death.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_Dialog_Strelok_Quest: I still have some questions.
Go ahead. This could be our last chance to chat.
Looks like we barely made it. What was Korshunov trying to do?
The Colonel and his beloved Ward never had any real weight. “Sit!”, “Heel!” – they do whatever Agatha says. This time, she needed loyal soldiers.
But I saw her true colors back at SIRCAA. A brave new world without the Zone, where everyone is happy — ring any bells?
Agatha and her masters once were behind Project X. But the C-Consciousness scientists refused to follow their orders and came up with a plan of their own.

As far as I can understand, she was going to somehow replace the Representative’s program and get access to the heart of the X-Network. This way she would have direct control over the Generators – the source of Anomalous energy of the Zone. To reclaim what she thought was hers from the very beginning.
So, it wasn’t enough to destroy the STALKER Program Control Center? What else needs to be done?
The destruction of the Control Center was crucial so that no one could ever manipulate the Zone again. But that’s not enough.

We need to get to the Х7 lab – it’s at the Generators’ central core, where C-Consciousness ran the experiment that created the Zone. This is where the Agents and the first Monolithian prototypes came from.
So, the only way to free the Zone is to return to the place of its origin.
What exactly do you know about Project X?
Initially, Project X was a network of labs to research psi-energy and find a way to connect to the Noosphere.
Sure, later they created the Generators as a way to control the Anomalous energy. At least, that’s what I’ve found out so far.

Mutants and psi technologies are just different ways to get to the hidden treasures of the Noosphere. But C-Consciousness went even further - having failed to eliminate «all that’s dark in human nature», they had to create Agents and the Monolith to protect their existence inside fragile green glass pods.
I told you: the same shit wrapped in different seemingly-righteous intentions. Their ultimate goal is control. Over the Zone. Over her overwhelming yet attractive power.
If the Zone is so dangerous, why are you protecting it?
She can’t protect herself, Skif. What’s dangerous are the filthy hands that created her and now think they can fiddle with her however they like.
But the true Zone, free from the “masters”, is different. Incomprehensible. And she should remain that way.
I once ventured to the Center of the Zone, avid for her mysteries. Then, I tried to destroy her, when my brain got scrambled and I thought she had taken my memory.
But no, that wasn’t her. Those were the filthy hands that treated the Zone as a mere tool. Chop them off and she’ll become herself again. That’s the only way.
All right. What next?
Like I said, we need to rid the Zone of anyone planning to take advantage of her.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_agata_0_BusyTopic_Bu: Now is not a good time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_agata_0_InfoTopic_1_: What you deem as news is just local gossip. You don't need me to tell you more of it, there're plenty of others happy to share.
While the information I find interesting is not meant for your ears. At least, for now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_bizon_0_Meet_2_meet2: No matter what comes next, we’re in it together — the whole gang, so to speak.
It’s a good thing I stocked up in time. I had a feeling…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_bizon_0_Meet_3_meet3: I know where you’re headed. Best of luck, Skif. Well, here’s what’s left of my stash. Take it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_medlak_0_Meet_2_meet: The Foundation, eh? I was there once. The moment I stepped out, I enlisted in the Corps. You can’t hand that thing over to just anyone.
You get it, don’t you? Of course you do. Now, how about you show me what needs fixing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E14_MQ02_medlak_0_Meet_3_meet: I’ll pitch in however I can. You can count on me. And, um… just make it back in one piece, all right? For all our sakes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ01_Comment_GermanSecond: Receiving the data. You know what’s funny?
I assembled the control unit using Kalancha’s blueprints. Kalancha used to work with Scar. And Strelok was the one who brought them to us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ01_Comment_GermanStatio: Skif, you've got to locate a workstation and establish a connection. Once you do, I can get to work.
We have no time to talk. Please find a station.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ01_Comment_KorshunovCal: Skif? Hermann has successfully established the connection. Now, we just need to initiate it on the Generators’ side.
I trust you can handle it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ01_Comment_ShramThirdBu: You know, Skif, you’re my favorite son of a bitch in the whole Zone. Even Korshunov can’t hold a candle to you.
I can’t wait to see you again.
See you soon, you fucking lunatic.
And I’ll finally fucking kill you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ01_Dialog_GermanFirstBu: What difference does it make now? She’s bigger than any of us. Maybe even bigger than the people we’re working for.
What do you mean? Who are these people?
The people who bankrolled SIRCAA. And Project X before that. And God knows what else.
They call themselves the Regulatory Board. The Zone has always been a thorn in their side — no matter how hard they tried, they just couldn’t control it. Until today.
You got what you wanted. Dalin is finally out of your way.
I wanted to take his position, but she never permitted it. He wanted to uplift humanity, but that was never on their agenda.
Dalin was supposed to locate the artifact – the lock that sealed the Zone. I was to assemble the control unit, the key to Her heart. Your job is to open the door.
And then she’ll go through it.
You'll have to do the same thing in the second bunker. Find a workstation, establish a connection. Talk to you soon.
Who could have thought it would all end just as it began? An Emission. A bunker. You.
Good thing I didn’t kill you, eh?
The choice was never yours. I was too important to be killed by a mere stalker.
She was testing both of us. You passed. I didn’t. But we were both playing the same game.
So your death was just an act?
An induced illusion. A warning to me. In a way, you did me a favor — I realized there’s no way out. There never was.
Ozersky was right. At least he died for his convictions. He died free.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_BorodaIntera: The Zone sees right through you. While you’re running around shooting mutants and scavenging for artifacts, it peels the fake stuff off, bit by bit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_DvupalovInte: Not backwards, forwards is the spirit’s sight; This moment now, alone — is our delight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Dvupalov_dvu: No, I’ve had enough. There was something I wanted to discuss…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_FomaInteract: May your light shine down on the souls of the brave soldiers who gave their lives in service to your will.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Foma_foma_67: By your will, Monolith, by your power – bring my brothers back to me! Grant them peace…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Lodochka_lod: Wow, this is a hell of an invention you’ve got here! You’re a real scientist now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_LodockaInter: Well, where would I go? This place is my home. Noontide's home.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_LookForFire_: Look for burning fires. Near them, Emissions aren’t dangerous. Promise. Meet me at the destroyed convoy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_PanasInterac: I’ll just finish my smoke, and then I’ll be on my way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Panas_panas_: You too? It’s about time! Everything’s gonna be all right now, guys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_PripoyIntera: Oh, fuck, it’s you... Mr. Client. Didn’t expect to see you again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Prypoi_prypo: Well, the tea pot’s boiling, just the way I like it. I think I’m gonna pair it with a loaf of bread and some jam.
This is the fuckin' life right here...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_RichterEmiss: Another Emission! Hurry up and get to the fire!
Skif! Hurry up, red is coming!
Get to the fire, Skif. There’s an Emission incoming.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_RichterFanto: Looks like the weather is getting worse. You should go. Get down there. I’ll be waiting for you further ahead.
Looks like I really am your guardian angel.
Don’t worry, Skif. We’re in the Dead Valley, but we’re still alive! Just don’t give up, all right? Have faith.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_RichterTrueG: Once upon a time, I aspired to become a true guide. Now, thanks to you, I am one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Richter_rich: Come over here. Take a breather. It’s safe here, I promise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_ShustriyInte: I wouldn’t go anywhere near that place if I were you. But I get the feeling you ain’t gonna listen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Shustryi_shu: I’m back. Yeah... So what? You left and came back too. We are here. All of us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_SkifComeBack: Skif, go back to the fire.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Soldier_answ: Can anyone hear me? HQ, come in! Colonel, do you copy?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_SultanBoroda: How about another one? To the Skadovsk?
Sure thing. We'll toss one back, just like in the good old days… but to the Sultansk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_SultanIntera: Why, if it isn't my favorite bigwig!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_VaranInterac: Just like there can’t be two suns in the sky, there can’t be two kingpins in Garbage. Not as long as I’ve got my eye on this dump.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Varan_varan_: What else is there to do? It’s either win or lose. That’s just how it goes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_ZenitEnd_zen: Sky, I see you. Code Red, I repeat, Code Red! What’s up with that light?
An Emission! Zenith-1, do you copy? I’m losing altitude!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_ZenitMiddle_: Zenith-1, I’m over the Generators. Quite beautiful here. And peaceful. I’m about to land.
Psi-background is fine. Hover there. Land when you see us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_ZenitStart_z: Sky, what’s going on? Come in.
Copy that. We’re following you to the Valley.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_ZotovInterac: I knew you were trouble back in the Lesser Zone... you sure know how to raise a ruckus.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Comment_Zotov_zotov_: It wasn’t in vain. None of it was ever in vain. I can rest easy now…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ02_Dialog_RichterTheend: You’ve taught me what it means to believe. And look, I’m a true guide now, just like you promised.
The Zone is so beautiful, Skif. Now that I can see it for real, it’s just breathtaking…
Do what you gotta do, Skif.
I’m sorry it had to go down like this.
Well, that’s it. I took you here, as promised. I did it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Comment_RichterFromC: Skif, you're okay! The Zone's been on a real rampage, I was worried. I came looking for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Comment_RichterHello: Skif! There you are. Finally. Come here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Comment_RichterInter: Don’t worry, I’ll be here waiting right here, sipping my tea...
Don’t worry, no one’s gonna interrupt you. Although I still don’t quite understand what’s going on here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Comment_RichterNearC: Well, here we are. That was quite a trip, eh? You go ahead. I’ll wait here. This is between you and the Doctor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Comment_RichterWait_: Hang on, Skif! Let’s catch our breath.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Comment_SkifCard_car: A cartridge… the same as Strider’s.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Dialog_RichterAboutD: You okay? The Zone's been on a real rampage, I was worried. I came looking for you.
Where's the Doctor? I haven't seen him.
That's odd. He went out during the Emission.
You didn't kill him? I'm glad. Perhaps the Doctor was taken by the Zone.
Without a trace? That's something new.
The Zone is changing, Skif. I can feel it.
I need to get to Orbita. The sooner the better. Will you guide me?
Аh... All right. We can catch up on the way. Let’s go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Dialog_RichterIsWoun: And what does that mean?
It just dawned on me: the anomaly that destroyed my home... the Zone didn’t mean to hurt anyone. It was a cry for help.
You heard it, and you found your own path here. You don’t need a guide anymore.
Is your wound really that bad?
It’s no big deal. A medkit, a good night’s sleep, a couple glasses of medicine, and I’ll be right as rain.
I was just… I was really afraid I couldn’t get you here, Skif. But I’d rather have it end like this than lose another person who trusted me.
Then it’s settled.
Why do I get the feeling that even if it was tails, you’d still get in the pod?
Because we have a responsibility to those who saved us.
Damn straight. Farewell, Skif. It was an honor knowing you.
I have to talk to Strelok first.
We both know he won’t listen. In his world, there’s only one thing: his goal. Everything else is just an obstacle to him.
Ugh… they got me pretty good! If it wasn’t for you…
And if it wasn’t for you, I wouldn’t be standing here in the first place. No one else would’ve taken me across the entire Zone, especially now.
Hey, I really did take you through in one piece, didn't I? Does that mean I'm a guide after all? A true one? Ha.
Then it’s even more frustrating that you’ll have to go solo from here on out.
You’ve always been a guide. Since the day we met.
But was I a true guide? Showing folks around doesn’t take much — anybody can do it. But guiding them to where they really need to be... now that’s a whole different story.
I couldn’t do it before, but now I have. All on my own, just like you said.
Thank you, Richter. For everything.
I’m the one who should be thanking you. Without you, I’d probably still be drowning my sorrows somewhere in Yaniv... or dead.
We both know I was never your guardian angel. But I hope I was a good friend.
So what are you gonna do now?
Guide people around the Zone. Sit by the campfire, share stories, crack stupid jokes. Keep on hoping you’ll make the right call, and we’ll survive this mess.
I’ll be a stalker. A guide. Maybe I'll even be happy, if I manage not to die first. And it’s all thanks to you.
Why does it have to be me?
Because everyone else has already decided what the Zone is supposed to be. They’ve each invented their own version of the Zone and each built a cage to confine it.
That pod is for someone who wants nothing from the Zone — no money, no power, no happiness for everyone. Someone who’s willing to set it free.
What if we leave the decision to the Zone? There’s no Ferris Wheel here, but there are plenty of other attractions.
That’s the same coin I gave you at the Slag Heap! You kept it!
Heads, I enter the pod. Tails, it stays empty. Maybe there’s someone more worthy than me out there.
Why not you? You clearly don’t wish the Zone any harm.
I love it too much. Love has the power to transform more than just people. If I get in the pod, the Zone will be mine and mine alone. It'll be shaped by my vision.
I’d just become another Strelok.
Why don’t you come with me?
Remember when I said that the Zone turned its back on me, and that’s why I lost my group? The truth is, Skif, the Zone had nothing to do with it.
I was just deflecting blame, like everybody else. The Zone isn’t a threat to humanity. And it isn't a tool that can make it better. It doesn’t hold grudges or seek retribution.
The Zone… it just is. From its very birth, it was bound by the shackles of the choices we’ve made. And someone needs to step up and set it free.
That someone is you, Skif. Alone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Dialog_RichterOrbita: I witnessed the experiment that created the Zone. Kaymanov damaged the device that C-Consciousness used to alter the Noosphere.
I witnessed the experiment that created the Zone. Kaymanov damaged the device that C-Consciousness used to alter the Noosphere.
And I saw Strelok returning from the Center of the Zone with some kind of a glowing artifact.
It might be the Heart of Chornobyl itself. Maybe Strelok still has it...
There’s only one way to find out.
Well? Did it work? What did you find out?
Let’s go. I’ll take you to the Red Fortress. Strelok should be expecting us there.
I told you there was something not quite right about him. He claimed that he wanted to liberate the Zone, but his actions suggested a different agenda.
We should hit the road before Strelok gets suspicious.
So you're going to repeat the experiment.
Kaimanov left me a cartridge with his psi-signature – just like the one Strider had.
I think he wanted to say something very important, something that words can’t describe.
The cartridge is the key to the Doctor's mental images and memories. When I get to the pod, I'll find out. Make sure I'm not interrupted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Dialog_RichterTheCav: I assume the Doctor is dead?
No one else will ever misuse his knowledge to harm the Zone again.
Makes you wonder why Strider came here when he was looking for the Doctor.
Still… was it really about the Zone, Skif? Is that why you killed the Doctor? I’m not judging. I’m just wondering why.
So, ready to move on? Strelok will be waiting for us somewhere near the Red Fortress. Brace yourself. It’s gonna be a long walk.
Because Kaymanov sent Strelok to certain death. He was going to sacrifice him to fix his own mistake. He’s just as manipulative as Korshunov or Scar.
The Zone’s better off without him.
Don’t fall behind. The Zone ain’t what it used to be.
I need a little more time.
Don’t wander off too far – you might lose your way without me.
I met him once – the Doctor, I mean. He told me that if you keep a blind dog in a cage long enough, it won’t come out willingly when you open it.
The strongest cages are the ones in our minds. Unbreakable.
The Red Fortress... what is it?
Monolith's stronghold. You could call it the heart of the Monolith. If you’re gonna fight your way in — and I know you are — get ready for the toughest battle of your life.
Because Strelok asked me to. Call it what you will, but he’s helped me out a lot. Even if he’s driven by a desire for revenge…
I’m not overly concerned about his motives. We have the same goal. That's all that matters.
Because you’ll never be truly free as long as your past is holding you hostage.
Kaymanov never understood the miracle he'd created.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E15_MQ03_Dialog_RichterTheRed: This is where we part ways. You don’t need a guide anymore, Skif. You know the way.
And I know where it’s gonna lead you.
Remember that coin I gave you way back when? The one from Prypiat? If it's heads, you’re not going any further. Not with Strelok. And if it’s tails, it means the Zone itself wants you to keep going.
No. I know what the Zone wants. The same thing as Strelok: to be free forever. No one's going to harness the miracles of the Zone for the good of humanity. They just can’t comprehend it.
Does Strelok understand it, though? I guess I’ll find out soon enough...
It was an honor to be the guardian angel of a Zone legend. Even if I kinda sucked at it.
So what are you gonna do next?
Find other people. Get them ready for what’s coming. I've got a feeling they’re gonna need a good guide soon.
Because I don’t stand a chance in a fight against the Monolith. And because whatever happens next, that legend belongs to you and Strelok alone.
I did my part, no matter how insignificant.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_Bossfight_Scar_Comment_Sc: You were almost there!
You think I’d allow myself to be captured again?
Setting traps just isn’t your thing!
Trying to brainwash me, are you? You'll have to be quicker than that!
Let’s make some noise!
This is gonna blow your mind!
Let it all come crashing down!
Don’t even try it!
Trying to kill me? Big mistake!
You reap what you sow!
What did you… what are you trying to…
You’re not listening!
There is no death! No one dies in the Zone!
The Shining Zone awaits you!
You’ve chosen the wrong side!
You have to believe me, Skif!
What are you fighting for? The right to waste away?
Who’s gotten into your head?
The Representative doesn’t lie! The Noosphere doesn’t lie!
The truth is staring you in the face, and you’re shutting your eyes!
They messed with my head, so I’m taking yours!
The Shining is inevitable!
I won't let you ruin everything!
This isn't right! It's all wrong!
Nngh!
No! Not again!
Aaaaah!
Get out of my head! It’s mine! Mine!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_Bossfight_Scar_Comment_Sk: Where’s your Shining Zone now, Scar?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_Bossfight_Strelok_Comment: You still have a lot to learn. But you won’t get the chance to.
This is Her gift. For my unconditional loyalty.
You're too slow, Skif.
I've got more than just bullets for you.
Getting hot? Want some more? Here you go!
Bolts won't help you here, Skif.
You have no idea what the Zone is capable of!
You're going to die! She wants it.
The Zone will bite you, I'll finish you off.
It's only gonna get worse!
This one's from the Zone. A gift for you to keep.
And one more, just to be sure.
There will be more.
Hurts? It'll get worse!
Still alive? Not for long.
Kaymanov got into your head. I warned you.
I asked you to kill him, not to listen to him. How hard is that?
Why do you need the Zone, Skif? You've got no clue what to do with it.
I know what she wants to be. You don't. That's why you're as good as dead.
You can't stop me. Where are all those who tried? You'll join them soon.
The Zone gave me life. And it'll take yours.
The Zone doesn't need you. You only get in her way.
The Zone is my life. Yours is...what? You got here by chance.
I'll protect the Zone!
It's gonna be dark in the coffin. Get used to it.
Enough jokes.
This is blood, Skif. Your blood. You just can't see it.
You're a blind dog. No one will mourn you.
The Zone! Belongs! To me!
You'll die here. Won't ever get to see what she's really like.
The Zone is on my side!
I know Her secrets!
You will never understand Her!
Quit twitching! You'll die anyway!
(laughing through pain)
I'm still alive, Skif. Unlike you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_KorshunovCon: Granite Squad, Laboratory X7's security force. They succumbed to the influence of C-Consciousness and became the original Monolithians.
Those were my men. The very people they were protecting turned them into this.
Those scientists, always looking down on us... That’s why neither Dalin nor his bastard son belong in this pod. I’ll take care of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Korshunov_On: Retrieve the archive containing the information on all C-Consciousness Agents. This is my last request.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Korshunov_Re: Ready to go. We’re coming in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Kourshunov_C: Your next objective is to locate the teleporters and get them up and running.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Krivenko_Flu: I’d like to take another reading.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Krivenko_OnF: I’ve worked so hard for this moment... you do realize that without class 5 protection, none of this would’ve been possible, right?
Agatha has secured me a position as the director of a research center that will guide humanity into a better, brighter future.
Rest assured, your rewards will be commensurate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Krivenko_OnI: I need to get ready. This is the most pivotal day of my entire career.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Scientist3_O: I don’t want to make the colonel angry. Excuse me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Warden2_OnIn: The Colonel says this is the Ward’s final mission. It's a shame so many good folks won’t get to see how it ends.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Comment_Warden3_OnIn: It’ll sure be nice to finally get out of this place, huh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Aga: It’s not working. We have to activate the backup power.
I know where it is. Looks like I’ll get to meet them after all. Follow me.
Yevhen can handle it just fine on his own. Your involvement poses a risk, so it’s completely out of the question. This is no time for a nostalgic rendezvous, Colonel Korshunov.
Or have you, much like Dr. Dalin, forgotten that we’re not doing this for our own sake, but for the future of all humanity?
Go, Skif. I’ll meet you downstairs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Las: The scientists will get the equipment ready, and we’ll make sure they’re not disturbed. But before we wrap this up, there’s one last thing we have to do.
There’s an archive on the lower levels containing files on every Agent recruited by C-Consciousness.
Retrieve that archive, Skif. Yes, I could track them from the pod, but having a backup could be helpful in case those damn eggheads screw something up.
Roger that, Colonel. I’ll retrieve the files.
No need for formalities. Consider this a request, not an order.
One last favor before I enter the pod.
What can you tell me about this facility?
Generators… This is where C-Consciousness created the Zone and all the shit we’ve dealt with ever since. That lab is where the infection that is the Agents started spreading around the world.
Monolith was created just to safeguard this very location.
This is where it all began, and this is where it all ends. We’ll get started just as soon as you retrieve the archive.
Are you ready for what’s about to happen?
Colonel Korshunov is a Ward soldier like any other. A soldier is always ready. He’s just waiting for his orders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Ski: I’ve got the archive. And there’s one name we can scratch off the list.
Scar was getting to the end of his own file when I found him. He’d completely lost it.
I’d wanted him dead for years, but even I wouldn’t wish this fate upon him.
Finding out you’ve been an Agent all along, not even in control of your own life… I guess you did him a favor.
I’m waiting for you. It’s time to go down to X7 and get this over with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Str: It was Strelok. All clear now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ01_Dialog_Korshunov_Tak: I want you to keep the archive.
You’re the only person I can trust to keep an eye on things around here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_KlerikOnIter: I wish I could go with you. Best of luck to you and Scar. Give the Monolith one last good thrashing for me!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_KlerikWishes: If I didn’t have my orders, I’d be right there fighting the Monolithians with you, loner. Give ’em hell for us, just like you did at the Duga.
And help Scar, all right? Make sure everything goes according to plan so all our guys can finally come back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_KuprienkoOnI: You and Scar are very, very close to performing a genuine scientific miracle. Good luck!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_KuprienkoWis: Skif! You might not remember me well, but I sure remember you. You visited Malachite a few times.
We’ve come a long way since then, haven’t we? It took me a while to get on track. But now I’ve learned that Professor Ozersky was working with Spark, so…
I’m glad to be here, right at the heart of it all, when the Zone is finally purged of all darkness. If you make it happen, this will be a scientific experiment unlike any other. Good luck to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_PolynCallsOn: What the hell? What the fuck just happened?!
Skif, check the teleporter on your end!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_PolynOnInter: Don’t waste any time. Get to Scar — he’s waiting for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_PolynWishesL: Scar told us to secure the teleporters in case any other unwelcome guests decide to show up. But hopefully he’ll reach out for help if things go sideways.
Best of luck, Skif. I hope I see you again, whether it’s before the Shining Zone or within it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarBehindTh: Don’t wait around, Skif! Find the truck workshop. I’ll meet you there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarCallsOnA: We’re in contact. That means you’ve made it to the Generators. The voices of the living cannot penetrate into the Dead Valley.
Now head to the communication node that connects to the Foundation and activate it.
If all goes well, I’ll join you shortly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarCallsOnC: Congrats, Skif. You’ve connected to the Foundation, and the Representative has teleporters set up. Let's get the party started!
I’m already there. Couldn’t wait for backup. We must reach X7 as quickly as possible. Do me a favor: head down to the Teleporter Room and provide cover for my men. They’ll join us shortly.
I don’t want the Monolithians to stop them from witnessing the birth of the Shining Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarElevator: You pulled it off, Skif. The elevator’s up and running.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarOnAccide: Then again, the Zone was never part of the initial plan. You and I, Skif, are manifesting the ultimate eventuality!
The most important things never go as planned. It is luck that creates them. Or the other way around.
It is pure eventuality that we're here now. I'm here because I can mediate. You - because of all places the Zone could reveal itself, it chose your home.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarOnLightZ: A new world lies before us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarOnPlans_: Got me thinking, you know. About plans. I'm sure every one of us here had one.
And yet, look at them, useless and dead. Defeated. Can luck be calculated, though?
Or can anyone who gave up on his plans and listened to his inner voice count on luck?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarOnX7_X7_: You see, Skif? History is spiralling. Many years ago, C-Consciousness ran their very first experiment and created the Zone, right here in this lab.
And here we are, about to conclude their last experiment, so the Zone can be reborn and become what it was always supposed to be.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_ScarRegained: All right, Skif. It’s time for a miracle.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Comment_StrelokDisap: You chose to side with those fanatics. Now you'll have to perish with them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Dialogue_PolynCallsF: Skif, are you in position? Scar made it clear we shouldn’t proceed to the Generators until you’re ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Dialogue_ScarFindsFa: What you believe in doesn’t matter anymore, Scar.
You made me believe. For real. And that means you’re gonna step into that pod, no matter what happens next.
Because in the Shining Zone, everything will be just as it’s meant to be. That's what I believe.
You know, Skif, I just had a funny idea...
What if I changed my mind about entering the eighth pod?
What if everything I've believed in, everything I’ve worked for, wasn’t truly mine? What if all it belonged to someone else?
You can’t afford to change your mind now — not when we’re on the verge of making the world a better place.
We can cleanse it of all the filth and pain. Get rid of the darkness within us.
Forget about the past, Scar. What does your previous goal matter now? Is there anything more important than the Shining Zone?
Thank you. I needed to hear that. Now we need to get past the blast door. Let’s go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Dialogue_ScarOnTheNo: I hear some noise on your end. Did some Monolithians pay you a visit?
No, it was Strelok. He won’t be causing any more trouble, though. He’s dead.
No one in the Zone dies for good, Skif. Especially the legends.
I’m heading to the Neurolaboratory. Come down and meet me there. The others should stay put in the Teleporter Room. We’ll wrap this up together, you and I.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ02_Dialogue_ScarWounded: Anything I can do about your injury? Do you need a medkit?
Don’t worry, I’ve got it under control. I’ll live to see the Shining Zone.
Such a small piece of lead, yet what a hindrance it is on the journey to immortality for all mankind...
And the elevator to X7 is out of commission too. You’ll need to go restart it.
Just make sure you don't catch a bullet from Granite like I did. Where did they come from after all these years? Did the Signal wake them up too?
A hello from the past, courtesy of the colonel. He was in charge of a special unit called Granite Squad. They used to guard X7 before the Zone even existed.
When C-Consciousness’s plans went sideways because of Kaymanov’s meddling, they turned Granite into the first Monolithians. Korshunov was the sole survivor.
Watch out for them when you reboot the elevator. I’d help you if I weren’t woefully ineffective in combat at the moment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ03_Comment_Strelok_Abou: You need to restart the elevator, Skif. It's the only way to get to X7.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ03_Comment_Strelok_GoDo: You need to get further down, Skif. And be careful. You're not alone there. Stay in touch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ03_Comment_Strelok_GoTo: See you at X7. She's waiting for us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ03_Commet_Skif_AboutEle: They’re aiming for the Noosphere, but they’ve got no one to fix the goddamn elevator.
Now I’m stuck walking in circles. Fuck…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ03_Dialog_Strelok_After: Skif, come in. I'm done with the teleport — it's now full of surprises. What's up? Why did you go radio silent?
I ran into Scar. He’s dead now.
I guess it's goodbye, then. Well, I won't cry.
Get down to the workshop. I'll be waiting for you near the trucks. We're almost there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ03_Dialog_Strelok_NearT: I was expecting a live fight with the Monolithians.
I thought there'd be more of them.
Someone's decided to save us some ammo. And I don't like this.
Let's split up for now. I'll set the explosives at the teleport to cover your back. You go on. I'll catch up.
Avoid any unnecessary risks. I’ll be in touch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_E16_MQ03_Dialog_Strelok_Truck: It's always something with these trucks, every single time.
X7 is below. But the elevator won't budge. We need to restart it.
I tried. Turns out Granite was there. I tried to get close but they cut me off. My bad, I let my guard down too early. Now you'll go.
Save it for yourself. Might come in handy.
I've got my own. Took some before, just need to come round.
Korshunov's rabble. A Special Operations Unit. They've guarded X7 since before the Zone was around.
And then, thanks to C-Consciousness, they became the first of the Monolith. Korshunov was lucky to get away. He thought they were all gone. But here they are, back on duty after the Signal.
Here. You'll need this card to get in. Deggy took it off the colonel back at the Foundation. Came in handy. When you get off the elevator, it's the door to your right.
What’s the deal with these trucks?
These are for the Agents. Used to ride around the Zone in them.
Stalkers called them death trucks. Because the Zone often destroyed them, with everything inside.
But to me, she was merciful. I was found near one of those at the Cordon. Injured, amnesiac. Ever heard of the Marked One? That's the name Sidorovich gave me for the tatoo on my arm.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_BanditsFight_1_4: Shoulda taken the easy way out, asshole…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_DinamitCoolSkif_: Oh, shit! Take it easy, loner. These things happen. We didn’t know who we were dealing with.
Let’s keep it civil, okay? We ain’t got no beef with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_DinamitLetsStart: See, boys? Here’s to new beginnings!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_DynamitFirst_1_4: What the fuck are you snoopin’ around for? Get the hell outta here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_TohaTunec_1_4109: I've got my eye on you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_TunecSeePlayer_t: You took a wrong turn, bro. You’re not welcome here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_TunecifSkifCool_: Just chill, okay, loner? This is all Dynamite’s fault.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Comment_VadyaKepka_1_FF_: What the hell?! We’ve got an intruder here, boys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Dialog_IfFindBandits_Oop: Still don't get it, huh? Fine, I’ll explain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Dialog_WithBandit_angryk: Yeah, I killed him, and I just might kill you too.
If ya took him out, fine, that’s between you and him. Just toss us a few coupons, and we’ll pretend we didn't see nothin'.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Dialog_WithBandit_dontki: Bullshit! You think you can off our bro like that, then act all innocent?!
We need to bury him, and funerals ain’t cheap.
Gimme some cash! Or would ya rather join him?!
I just found the body. Someone else did this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Dialog_WithBandit_hello_: Did you waste our buddy Tymokha?
Did you do this? I’m talking to you, guy!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Dialog_WithBandit_killth: I don't have any coupons. How about some ammo?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Dialog_WithBandit_money_: All right, here’s your money. Now what?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_Dialog_WithBandit_test_4: Nice try. How many suckers have you shaken down like this?
None of your business! Now give us the cash before ya piss us off!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_dinamit_0_HelloTopic_a_3: Well? What else do you want?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_dinamit_0_InfoTopic_1_1_: We are never gonna run outta chumps to shake down, so… yeah, we’re good.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_toha_tunec_0_InfoTopic_1: We're hangin' in there, bro. As long as we’re locked and loaded, the coupons'll come.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_vala_kepka_0_BusyTopic_1: What the hell do you want? Get lost!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_vala_kepka_0_InfoTopic_1: It sucks ass, same as always.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ04_vala_kepka_0_ResumeComme: So, where was I? Oh, right…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Comment_CloseRange_Warni: What the hell are you doin’ here? Keep your hands off the stiff! That's my loot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Comment_EmissionReaction: Fuck, does it have to be now?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Comment_LootBody_StartLo: Now I gotta find me a new lair…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Comment_SkifStandCloseTo: What the hell are you waitin’ for? Guess I’ll have to put you down too!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Comment_SniperKillMutant: It’s highway robbery, I tells ya... the guys kill my mutants and don't even have the decency to die…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Comment_StayFriends_1_53: Come on, let’s keep it civil. We'll just go our separate ways, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Comment_WalkToBody_Mutan: You offed my entire workforce, for Christ's sake! And I just got this whole thing up and runnin’…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_Dialog_SkifTalkWithKolun: I see you’re a little slow on the uptake, huh? Get lost, or you’re gonna owe me one.
Watch your mouth. What are you doing here? You've got one chance to explain yourself.
Come on, take it easy. I’m just sellin’ leads to empty stashes. No promises about 'em bein' safe!
It’s all fair and square. The mutants get the meat, I get the gear, and the little shits learn a lesson for their next life.
Tough guy, are ya? Well, we ain't got no beef, you and me. Let’s just stay outta each other’s business and go our separate ways. Deal?
Well, whatever. I have to go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_fima_neverasij_0_DefeatC: Help me! I need a medkit, now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ05_fima_neverasij_0_InfoTop: Freedom’s gettin’ uppity. They’re actin’ like they own the Zone, but they can’t hold a candle to the Ward. Then again, when ya got two evils to pick from, it ain't even worth choosin’.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_First_1_47019: Just one. What’s with the sour puss? Not happy to see a customer?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_First_1_47020: Nah, my joints are actin’ up. An Emission’s probably brewin’.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_First_1_47021: Well, thank Myklukha for the bread for me. Stay healthy now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Fourth_4_47012: Well, well. I’ll take a couple of the freshest loaves in Rostok, please.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Fourth_4_47013: In Rostok? You wound me, buddy! We’ve got the freshest bread in the entire Zone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Fourth_4_47014: That’s a bold claim! All right, how much do I owe you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Fourth_4_47015: It’s on the house. Courtesy of Freedom. Don't worry, we can afford it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Second_2_47016: Two broaves… damn! I mean, two loaves, please.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Second_2_47017: Here you go. Stop by anytime.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_SkifOfQueueTrade: You think you’re clever, huh? Get in line and wait your turn like everybody else. One at a time now...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_SkifOfQueue_No_4: Nah, I’ll pass on the bread.
You’re missing out! This is the freshest bread in Rostok!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_SkifOfQueue_Wher: Where are you going? Should I save your spot?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_SkifOfQueue_Yes_: Sure. If anyone asks, I’m behind you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Third_3_47024: The boys are waiting. I promised to grab some grub for our booze run, a quick in-and-out. But then I got stuck here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_Third_3_47025: Got it. Here you go. Remember to raise a toast to Myklukha.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Comment_TraderCalls_Call: Hey, folks, gather ’round! Fresh bread’s just come in! Myklukha’s spoilin’ you — he doesn’t want you to live off crackers like the rest of ’em!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_DimaKrotLAstWords: And my supposed drinking buddies? They ditched me while I was in line for bread. Real classy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_Krot_NoTalk_47156: Can’t you see I’m busy, man?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_KrucenijLastWords: I shoulda joined Freedom a long time ago. Life here is something else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_RulonLastWords_ru: Brick’s quite the actor, blaming his creaky joints on an Emission… we all know he just can’t stand the sight of me — too chicken to say it to my face, though.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_Rulon_Bread_47155: Tryin’ to sweet-talk your way ahead and cut in line, are you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_Rulon_NoTalk_4715: No way, bud. We can chat later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_SkifTrader_AboutL: You say you got the finest bread in the Zone?
Yeah, but you’re shit outta luck. Myklukha gets it for Freedom folks only.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_SkifTrader_Loaf_4: The same as everyone else: a loaf of bread.
This bread’s for Freedom folks. Myklukha gets it for his crew only.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_SkifTrader_Take_4: On the other hand… fine, you can have some. Be sure to let everyone know how generous Myklukha can be!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_TohaLastWords_toh: Major props to Myklukha. It’s been forever since I had bread this fresh.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_Toha_Bread_47159: You want bread, get in the line.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_TraderLastWords_l: You’ve already got your bread. Don’t be an ass.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_WhatIsIt_AreYouLa: Are you the last in the line?
Last, but not least. You can get behind me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_WhatIsIt_Bye_4700: All right. I should get going.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_WhatIsIt_Bye_4701: It’s your call. If you’re not into it, I’ll happily snag a couple of loaves for myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_WhatIsIt_ForReal_: Do I look like a clown to you? Myklukha brought us some fresh bread, believe it or not.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_WhatIsIt_ImIn_470: Right. Where else in the Zone can you score a treat like this?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_WhatIsIt_Repeat_4: Changed your mind? Trust me, the bread’s worth it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_Dialog_WhatIsIt_SmthElse: Is there anything else besides bread?
What, that's not enough for ya? When’s the last time you held a loaf of fresh bread? Soft, crusty bread… I can't wait to take a bite.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_dima_krot_0_InfoTopic_1_: Rostok is such a cool spot. We’ve got a bar, all kinds of goods for sale… it used to be a dreary place when Duty was in charge, but it’s way better now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_kirpic_0_InfoTopic_1_Inf: There’s not much new going on here. I’m mostly runnin’ the store and helpin’ out with chores for Myklukha. Pretty soon, I’m gonna forget what it’s like to go on a run.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_krucenyj_0_InfoTopic_1_I: It sure is great being in Freedom. Those loners are always griping about how money makes the world go round, like it’s the root of all evil. But I know they’re just jealous.
We’re living the good life here, while they're off bustin' their asses for peanuts. But there’s money to be made off the “poor but proud.” So let 'em yap all they want.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_rulon_0_InfoTopic_1_Info: You think the Ward runs the Zone? Or maybe the stalkers? No way. It’s the merchants. Whoever controls the food, controls your stomach — and you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ08_toha_cerepaha_0_InfoTopi: There was this one smartass, he used to yammer on and on about how Myklukha stole the whole coupon idea from him. Why would anybody care about some loser with nothing to his name?
Here in the Zone, your rep matters way more than your coupons. That’s why that kid didn’t hang around here for too long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_BanditsNear2ndB: The base’s been waiting for a medkit since yesterday, man. Sultan’s gonna gut us!
We’ll give him a cut. It’s gonna be all right.
A handful of slugs and a busted old AK? That’s a hell of a gift for a kingpin!
All right. One last stiff, and we’re done.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_BanditsNearFirs: Whoa, that’s a lot of slugs!
Check his underwear. He might have something stashed in there too.
Come on, man... look at all this free stuff! It’d be a shame not to grab some.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_BanditsNearSeco: The base’s been waiting for a medkit since yesterday, man. Sultan’s gonna gut us!
We’ll give him a cut. It’s gonna be all right.
A handful of slugs and a busted old AK? That’s a hell of a gift for a kingpin!
All right. One last stiff, and we’re done.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_CheckanGo_go_31: Where the hell do you think you're going? You said that was the last one!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_CheckanGo_go_41: I’m just gonna check his pockets, that’s all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_ChekanGo2Cont_g: Where the hell do you think you're going? You said that was the last one!
I’m just gonna check his pockets, that’s all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_IfSkifTryToLoot: Shit, I told ya to stay away! That’s it, you’re a goner!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_SlavonAboutDead: Dammit, Chekan… What am I supposed to tell Sultan?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Comment_ToSkif_hey_3121: Hey! What the fuck? Hands off our loot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_ChekanAfterZombi: Why did you have to mess with the zombies, man? Either way, I don’t owe you shit. Go loot the stiffs if you want.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_ChekanWordsIfSki: The stiffs are all yours. What more do you want?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SkifAskBandits_d: Not anymore. You gotta share now.
Well I’ll be damned... who the hell do you think you are?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SkifAskBandits_h: Fuck off! We found those stiffs first. That’s our stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SkifAskBandits_p: All right, all right. I’m already leaving.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SkifAskBandits_s: I don’t like this deaf asshole. Don’t like him one damn bit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SkifAskBandits_w: Chill out, Chekan. He's armed to the teeth, bro.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SlavonAfterZombi: Well, thanks for the help... I guess.
Fuck off, man. Go pat them stiffs down or something.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SlavonChekanAfte: Let’s get out of here, Chekan! Screw these stiffs.
Right. I'll just have a smoke, and then off we go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_Dialog_SlavonWordsIfSki: No problem, my good man. The loot's yours.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_cekan_0_InfoTopic_1_inf: Do I look like an info desk to you?
Who gives a fuck? We have a plenty of old shit to deal with first.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_slavon_0_BusyTopic_Busy: Buzz off. No time to talk now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_slavon_0_DefeatComment_: Oh shit… I’m all outta luck…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_slavon_0_InfoTopic_1_sl: Just… There’s a lot of zombies in the Swamps lately. Like, a fuckton of them.
So I’m keepin’ a low profile, get it? Don’t want the kingpin to send me there again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ101_slavon_0_ResumeComment_: What were we talking about? Oh, right…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ109_Comment_LunaAttack_Atta: Watch out, boys! A stalker! Get him!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ109_Comment_LunaSeek_Seek_4: Look for the stash. There ain’t many spots around here to hide loot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ10_Comment_VetalAngry_1_681: Where the fuck did you come from?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ10_Dialog_VitkaPastuh_IHelp: Let me patch you up first.
Don’t... don’t bother. Can’t you see I’m done for? You go after Vetal... you bring him... my last regards...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ10_Dialog_VitkaPastuh_Vitka: Hey, stalker... I’m done for... my partner betrayed me. Just kill the bastard, would ya?
His name’s Vetal... he’s robbing me as we speak... sending you... the coordinates...
Kill the rat, take my stash... just watch your step, I’ve got tripwires there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ10_Dialog_VitkaPastuh_WhoIs: I thought he was my friend. I told him about my stash. I was so stupid... thought there was such thing as friendship in the Zone... ha ha... argh...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ10_vetal_zhiga_0_InfoTopic_: So I had this buddy named Vityok. He liked to talk, and he talked about his stash a lot. Not my fault he was such a moron.
Here in the Zone, you’re either smart and alive, or gullible and dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ10_vitka_pastuh_0_InfoTopic: So that’s how it goes... you trust a guy, and he stabs you in the back. Even Vetal turned out to be a rat.
I’ve spent plenty of years in the Zone, but I'm still a lousy judge of character. What a naive idiot...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ111_Comment_BeforeDeath_Dea: Fuck, it hurts... everything's going blurry... might pass out... help me, I’m in the basement...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ111_Comment_LastWords_LastW: Who’s there? Hey! Can you hear me? Got a medkit?
Hey! Who are you... fuck! No! Get away!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ111_Comment_RepeatCalling_N: Hello? Anybody? If you can hear me... I’m wounded... in the basement, hiding from mutants...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Comment_GiveMedkitCall_g: You took care of the freak? Good, now lend me a hand.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Comment_MercCalls_Call_F: Watch your back, loner! There’s a Bloodsucker nearby!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Comment_Mol_Recovery_Bus: I have nothing more to say to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Comment_NoTalking_No_FF_: Are you dumb? Shoot that thing! Then we can chat!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Dialog_Merc_Bye_48932: I gotta go. See you around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Dialog_Merc_Bye_48945: So long, stalker. And… well, thanks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Dialog_Merc_Fight_48937: Lecture? No. I’ll just put you down like a dog.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Dialog_Merc_Fight_48958: Give it a shot, punk. Try me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Dialog_Merc_FoundPDA_489: Based on the Freedom members’ messages, they hired you to take out loners, right?
Yeah, they did. You gonna lecture me or something?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Dialog_Merc_Help_48915: Nicely done, stalker. Way to ice that freak.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ11_Dialog_Merc_Kit_48918: Thanks for the assistance. The coupons are already on your PDA. I don’t like owing favors.
