ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_Dialog_MutantsDead_HowTo: What happened to Tolik? How did he die?
We were out on a run not far from here. It was getting late, and I got caught in an anomaly. He pushed me out, but…
We covered almost the entire Zone together, him and me. He taught me so much, bailed me out countless times… and I… I couldn’t even tend his grave. Fuck…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_Dialog_MutantsDead_Leave: Sorry for your loss. I’ll leave you to it. See you around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_Dialog_MutantsDead_NoTal: I’m real busy right now, man. Move along.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_Dialog_MutantsDead_Rewar: I helped you with mutants. Are you gonna give me something in return?
Here you go. It’s not coupons, but this stuff can be pretty valuable out in the field.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_Dialog_MutantsDead_TellA: New around here, are ya? Strelok’s a legend. He was just about the first to make it to the center of the Zone.
The place is relatively safe nowadays. But ten years ago, you go north of Malachite, and your brains would turn to mush.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_Dialog_MutantsDead_WhoLi: Who was buried here? A partner of yours?
Yeah… my partner and mentor. Tolik was one of a kind. He knew Strelok personally. He told me Strelok once rescued him at the Rookie Village.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_Dialog_MutantsDead_secon: Well, ask away, since you came back here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ36_kucer_0_InfoTopic_1_Info: Every now and then I hear stories from guys who swear they’ve crossed paths with Strelok. They always say he's a grim, somber dude, someone you’d better not mess with.
I think they’re full of shit. He saved Tolik. That means Strelok is a decent guy, not some bogeyman.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Comment_Attention_Attent: Mikha Sheepskin… Luther, Hollywood… so many years, and it still feels like yesterday…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Comment_Random_1_Random1: Mikha… your brother, our platoon commander… the mutants tore him to shreds, you know? There was nothing left to bury…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Comment_Random_2_Random2: By the way, Hollywood… I never thought I’d say this, but I miss your dumb jokes. You were the only one who ever laughed at them, remember? Used to guffaw like a hyena…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Comment_Random_3_Random3: I guess I lost our bet, Luther. I’m over 40, and still not a general. Here, I brought you a bottle. Just like you asked.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Dialog_AboutPast_DoNotDi: I’ll leave you to it. See you around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Dialog_AboutPast_MoreInf: Can you tell me more about that?
You’ve heard of the Second Disaster, right? That’s what they call the very first Emission, the one that created the Zone. It happened back in 2006.
They sent in the military to blow the whole place to Kingdom Come. I was one of the first to get here. I served with Tachenko’s company…
It was a hell I’ll never forget. We were totally unprepared. Nobody knew anything. We had no detectors, no protection… so many of our men died…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Dialog_AboutPast_NeedToG: I’m sorry for your loss. I need to go now.
Sorry for bothering you. I’d better go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Dialog_AboutPast_Start_4: Well, ask away, since you’re here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Dialog_AboutPast_WhatHap: Why are you drinking all alone? Did something happen?
Yeah. About twenty years ago. See that foundation?
It’s a grave, stalker. A mass grave.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Dialog_AboutPast_WhoBurr: The men who are buried here… did you serve with them?

Yeah. Another Emission hit us when we were about to go to the Center of the Zone. I thought the world was about to end right there. When I climbed out of my foxhole, the place was littered with corpses.
We found some intact equipment, collected the bodies, and poured concrete over them… then Tachenko told HQ to fuck off and founded Duty. That’s a piece of our history, loner.
Then the survivors began pouring in. Tachenko was told there was no extraction coming, so he ordered us to bury the dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_Dialog_LeaveMe_Leave_499: Give me some space, would you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_grom_0_CallPlayer_Call_5: Hey. Come over here, would you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_grom_0_DefeatTopic_NeedH: Help! Don’t leave me here to die…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ37_grom_0_InfoTopic_1_Info_: I don’t know. This place doesn’t change much. There’s a schism in Duty. The guys who are dissatisfied with Voronin are getting bolder and louder.
As for me… a long time ago, I swore to avenge my fallen comrades, and I’ll side with whoever can help me get my revenge against the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_GrechkaAboutStas: I found a stash of energy drinks in the Poppy Field. Your handiwork? Pretty useful.
Sure did come in handy, huh? I damn near bought the farm in that field. Still can’t figure how I made it out in one piece.
That’s why I got that stash together. Figured it might be a lifesaver for another stalker like me. Maybe it’ll inspire him to lend a hand to others too.
Yeah, that was me. Figured it might help some poor bastard who goes charging into that anomaly unprepared like I did. But I guess stalkers are better at receiving than giving.
I thought we were all in this to survive, but it feels more like we’re just robbing the Zone and each other… anyway, I’m clocking out. It was a dumb idea to begin with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_EnergyDrin: I just grabbed an energy drink from there yesterday!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_Everything: Somebody was very thoughtful. Booze, snacks... what else do you need, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_Food_37207: Someone added some snacks to the menu!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_GoodPeople: There are still good people out there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_NeverMind_: Whenever I stop by to check it out, it’s empty. Some asshole just grabs everything and never puts anything back in! That’s it, I’m done with charity.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_PDA_37213: Too bad somebody stole the note. It said, "Take what you need, leave what you can." Everybody's gonna miss the point now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_Rumor2_500: The one at the Poppy Field, by the milk truck.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_Rumor_3720: Remember that stash of energy drinks I left behind, guys?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_StealPDA_3: I walked by it yesterday, and the note was gone. I guess the backpack won’t be sticking around for long either. This is what happens when you try to help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_Comment_Rumor_Vodka_3721: I was walking by it earlier and decided to check on it... and there was vodka in the backpack! Pretty sweet, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_grecka_0_InfoTopic_2_1_6: I’m new to the Zone, still learning the ropes. Only been to the Poppy Field so far. It's gorgeous, but it’s a dangerous place!
It makes you drowsy, and if you fall asleep, you’re as good as dead. Better stick to Zalissya. If you nod off there, it’s just out of sheer boredom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ38_grecka_InfoTopic_1_1_395: People are getting restless. There's so much anger in the air. There are guys who'll gun you down at the drop of a hat. They'll kill a man for nothing without a second thought.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Comment_KiryaMedicHub_He: I got exposed to radiation. Barely made it here. Help me!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Comment_KiryaSkif_Sorry_: No offense, but I’d rather talk when I’m not at death's door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Comment_Recovery_Recover: I appreciate it, guy, but let’s talk later. I need to rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_Kirya_BadAttitude: I brought some medication. It’ll help against radiation exposure.
This is for me? What’s with the sudden generosity? Eh, it doesn’t matter.
I brought you some medicine. It’ll help with the radiation — and your failing health, too.
Huh… whoa. Nice. That’s some strong stuff.
I’m afraid I can’t help you with your condition.
How polite of you… well, scram.
Don’t mind me, man. Thanks, or whatever. I’m just… well, I'm still a little tipsy. Diarrhea of the mouth, ya know? Well, I’m off. I’ll catch up with you later.
You wanted some vodka. Well, here it is. Now get to the doctor.
Now we’re talking! What took ya so long?
Oh, it’s you again. Here to watch me croak, huh? Or just waiting to snatch my loot? Well, hold your horses. I’m still kicking.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_KiryathanksForSav: Here, this'll come in handy. I really appreciate what you done for me.
There you are! I’ve got something for ya.
Hey there. What have you got?
Here, take this. It’s for saving my ass from radiation. I really appreciate what you done for me. Take care, stalker.
Can you remind me who you are again?
I caught a ton of rads from a radioactive artifact. But I made it here, all thanks to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_Ant: Hey, that’ll help a little. Thanks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_NoH: Shit, I’m gonna croak over here…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_NoT: Sorry, I don’t have time for this.
I’ve got even less time than you do, man!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_Rep: Gimme some vodka or anti-rad, please!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_ScK: I’ve got a scientific medkit. It’ll flush those radionuclides out in no time.
Sounds complicated… but this thing oughtta fix me up real quick. Might even help with my hangover.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_Sti: Need a little hair of the dog? You reek of booze.
I’ve absorbed a shit-ton of rads, man. If radiation had a smell, ya wouldn’t even notice the vodka.
I chugged two bottles just to keep going. Do ya have any more? Or maybe some anti-rad… I gotta make it to the doc.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_Vod: I ain't no drunk, okay? But now I can make it to the doctor. Thanks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_Wha: I got ex… exposed to radiation. Real bad.
I chugged two bottles just to stay on my feet. So, uh... got any more? Or maybe some anti-rad, if ya got any. I gotta make it to the doc.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_Dialog_SkifKiryaHelp_hel: Stalker, help me out! Get me some vodka, will ya? Don’t leave me here to die!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_kira_0_BusyTopic_Busy_53: I’m in the middle of something here. Later!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ43_kira_0_InfoTopic_1_Info_: Remember when I caught a massive dose of rads? That's what I get for diving into an anomaly after an artifact. Turns out that ugly piece of rock was pretty much worthless.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_BanditsNoticePla: Look alive, boys! We got a client here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_Bandits_WatchDut: The Shah's right, you know. We keep starting shit with Duty, but the pricks never get off their lazy asses.
Why don’t you shut your trap and keep your eyes peeled? We’re on patrol here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_NotShoot_NotShoo: Why didn’t you shoot? We need a soldier, not a spectator! Get lost!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergDidenko_Afte: Those criminals have gotten way too cocky. But that's okay, Zulu'll put 'em in their place.
So... the damn Bloodsuckers couldn't even get the lieutenant, but then those punks took him out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergDidenko_Befo: Go talk to the boss, loner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergSemidomov_Af: Not now. Wrong place, wrong time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergSemidomov_Be: Listen up, people! Are you ready to remind those scumbags what it means to face the real Duty? Then let’s go!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergSemidomov_Ca: Help us, stalker! Shoot those bandit pricks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergSemidomov_Fi: Hey loner, come over here. We have something to discuss.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergSemidomov_Pl: Pull yourself together! We need your help!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergValuev_After: Those bandits will steer clear of us now. Thanks for the help.
What a bloodbath... it’s too bad the lieutenant didn’t make it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_SergValuev_Befor: Go talk to the boss, man. He wanted to talk to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Comment_ZulusGiveReward_: They say no one's irreplaceable, but that's just not true. No one can replace the lieutenant. They broke the mold when they made that guy.
We appreciate your help, stalker. Duty won’t forget it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_AlreadyKilledBand: There was some commotion at the bandit camp. We haven't seen them since. Do you know what happened?
You won’t be seeing them again. They're all dead.
That's tough, but fair. I respect it.
Okay then, we’d better check the area. And you can expect a little token of our gratitude very soon. Good luck, stalker.
I happened. They had it coming.
Well, shit! You're our kind of guy!
Okay then, we’d better check the area to make sure there aren't any surprises... and you can expect a little token of our gratitude very soon. Good luck, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_BanditsKilled_Deb: I took a risk here. Gimme some extra pay.
This isn't Rostok, and I’m not in the mood to haggle. Take your coupons, loner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_BanditsKilled_Gla: Hey, we did a good deed here. Happy to help.
You’re damn right we did, stalker! Those bandits have no respect for us, and they'll treat everyone like shit if we don’t stop them.
Now take this and patch yourself up. Good luck.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_BanditsKilled_Hel: Those bastards were a tough bunch... thanks for taking our side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_HelpDuty_Bye_5046: I think I’ll pass. Got enough on my plate right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_HelpDuty_Bye_5047: Then wish us luck, and go take care of that plate of yours.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_HelpDuty_Hello_50: Hi, stalker. So, we have a... tricky tactical situation on our hands. The bandits are squatting in one of our facilities, but Voronin is choosing to ignore it.
But I think we have to get those assholes out of there, with or without his orders. So we could use your help — for an decent reward, of course. What do you say?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_Dialog_HelpDuty_SkifNeed: What are the bandits looking for here?
That's a damn good question, stalker. The bastards are taking over turf that belongs to Duty. And, unlike Voronin, Zulu isn't having it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_didenko_0_Defeat: Fuck, it hurts... I need a medkit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_didenko_0_InfoTo: You heard about the Treaty? Voronin signed it, and guess what? Nothing's changed! Actually, a few things have changed... for the worse!
They used to fear us — in other words, they respected us. Now every asshole in the Zone tries to spit in our faces, and we let it slide.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_semidomov_0_Busy: It’s gonna have to wait, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_semidomov_0_Defe: I’m hit! I need a medkit, now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_semidomov_0_Hell: So, what brings you here, loner?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_semidomov_0_Info: Nothing’s new. We keep clearing the surface, eliminating mutants when Voronin isn't looking. So... same old, same old.
I wish we could do some recon over by the Concrete Forest — mutants keep coming out of there. But we don’t have enough men to risk it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_valuev_0_DefeatC: Fuck... I’m hit! Need a medkit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ50_serzant_valuev_0_InfoTop: Have you seen the guns the Ward is packing? So new and shiny... now look at ours — they're held together by duct tape and a prayer.
My gun is barely holding on, and those assholes refuse to give me a new one. They say it's still good. I'm gonna be fighting off mutants with sticks and stones at this rate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Comment_AfterDialog_Pash: I should have talked you out of it, Pashko… man, I’m such an idiot…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Comment_TemaJet_AfterFig: Did you kill ‘em all? Whoa! Goddamn it, now I owe you one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Comment_TemaJet_FirstMee: Hello! Anybody?! The mutants took me down! I need help!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_AskF: A little reward goes a long way…
Sure thing, loner. Here, take this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_ByeN: Thanks for not leaving me in the lurch. I won’t let you go without some coupons. Have a good one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_ByeR: Thanks for not leaving me in the lurch. See you around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_EQ20: Look… I found your friend. He’s dead. I’m sorry.
Fuck… I should have talked him out of it. But I just kept my trap shut, as usual…
He was always the cocky one… loved to take risks. And I… I just took the bait... shit, this is all my fault.
Well, it doesn’t matter anymore… thanks for telling me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_Hell: I thought I was done for. Thanks a million, bud.
Why the hell did me and Pashko split up? I just knew we were gonna blow our mission. We should have gone in together! Stupid show-offs, both of us…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_What: What mission are you talking about?
We got sick of standing watch and delivering paperwork to Voronin, so we decided to go to Zulu.
He gave us a test to prove we’ve got what it takes to be real soldiers worthy of serving in Duty.
Pashko talked me into splitting up in order to impress Zulu. And I stupidly went along with it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_WhoP: My squadmate. Private Pavlyuk. We’re from the same platoon. We had some orders to carry out, but we split up like a couple of morons.
He went into the tunnel to get the stash while I dealt with the mutants here. I hope he’s at least completed his mission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_Dialog_AboutMutants_WhoZ: And it looks like I just botched mine. If Pashko shits the bed too, we can forget about serving under Zulu.
So Pashko and I decided to give it a try, but… the whole thing went tits up, as you can see.
Zulu’s a good dude. The Zone never broke him, unlike Voronin. He still remembers what Duty’s supposed to be all about.
He’s got a unit of his own. And if you want to serve with him, you gotta pass the test.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_tema_dzet_0_BusyTopic_Bu: I’m real busy right now. Later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_tema_dzet_0_DefeatCommen: Help… fuck, it hurts so bad…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_tema_dzet_0_HelloTopic_H: Hey, loner. I knew we’d meet again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_tema_dzet_0_InfoTopic_1_: Well, Zulu took me in. Too bad Pashko didn’t live to see it…
He wanted to join the real Duty so bad, the dumbass got himself killed. Almost got me killed too…
I told Zulu everything — all about you, the mutants… and he still took me in. I told ya he was a good dude.
Well, Zulu took me in. I told him everything — all about you, the mutants… I told ya he was a good dude.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ51_tema_dzet_0_ResumeCommen: All right. Let’s get back to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_AlternateStart_h: Hey, stalker! That’s my bro over there. Bring me his body, okay? Please?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_BodyFound_hey_29: That’s him, that’s Bubbs! Bring him over here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_BodyStolen_perve: Where are you taking him, you sick fuck?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_CallPlayer3_call: Stalker, wait! I’m serious. I need some help!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_CallPlayer_call_: Hey, Mister! I'm talking to you. Get over here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_Damage_ouch_2910: Can you see him? Try to stay alive in there, bro!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_IfEmissionAfterD: We need to find shelter. We’ll come back later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_Left_left_29854: Where are you going? He’s right there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_RIPFriend_1_4601: Tough luck, bro… it’s all the fucking Shah fault!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_SkifDropBody_2_4: Just bring him over to me. I’ll make it worth your while.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Comment_UraSorryEmission: I’m sorry, Bubbs. I’ll be back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_CompleteQuest_Bro: You know what? You got any problems, gimme a call. I got your back. Word is bond.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_CompleteQuest_Che: Here you go. May he rest in peace.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_CompleteQuest_Don: Grand! How about a toast to my bro?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_CompleteQuest_Kup: Bubbs was right, there’s still some decent folk out there. Gimme a sec, I’ll send you the coupons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_CompleteQuest_Loo: You looted my bros’ body. You ain’t gettin’ a single coupon from me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_CompleteQuest_Mon: Gimme a sec. Thanks for gettin’ Bubbs outta there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_CompleteQuest_Not: I’ll drink to his memory, sure. But the booze is on you.
If I had any... Here’s the deal: you go buy some, and we’ll raise a glass to my bro. Got it? I’ll send you the dough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_End_end_29852: You can go now. I need some time alone. It’s personal. Show some respect, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_Final_Neutral_meh: We got nothing to talk about.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_InProgress_anomal: He’s right there, inside the anomaly. Bring me his body, and you’ll get paid.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_TakeQuest_helpme_: Help me out, loner. My bro died in an anomaly. I can’t just leave him there, you know? We gotta get him out.
My bro owed some dough to some real bad dudes, and he just couldn’t break even. Eventually he got desperate and decided to try his hand at the artifact biz. That’s how he ended up in that anomaly.
I’m asking you, man to man: you gotta get him out of there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_TakeQuest_ifno_29: So, what do you say? Will you help me get my friend out of the anomaly?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_TakeQuest_ihelp_2: Now we’re talking. It’s a deal!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_TakeQuest_loot_45: And no robbing the dead, okay? Show my bro some respect.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_TakeQuest_no_2909: Fuck… All right. Come back if you change your mind. I ain’t leavin’ Bubbs in there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_TakeQuest_suspici: Don’t you dare talk shit about me, bro. I’m a man of my word.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_Dialog_TakeQuest_why_290: Why don’t you get him out on your own? He’s your friend, right?
If I stick my nose into that shit, I’ll end up dead too. I’d rather pay a pro.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_ura_fantomas_0_HelloTopi: Hey, I remember you. You’re the guy who got my dead bro outta that anomaly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_ura_fantomas_0_InfoTopic: If you’re looking for work, I can’t help you there, bro. Let’s toss one back instead. To Bubbs! And to your health too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ52_ura_fantomas_0_ResumeCom: So, where was I? Oh, right!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Comment_ArkanBusy_1_6360: You should ask Root over there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Comment_FriendsChat_Firs: You’ve had enough. You drink one more, and you just might fall yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Comment_FriendsChat_Seco: Remember when you tried to lure a Flesh to Sidorovich?
Yeah... it was smarter than us, that Flesh. It didn’t wanna go anywhere near him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Comment_MalavaBusy_1_636: Root invited you, so ask him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Comment_Reward_1_64038: I see you put up with their bitching and moaning. Thanks, man. I owe you one. Here, I sent you some coordinates.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Comment_Reward_1_64039: Got them the other day as part of a trade. Got no idea what’s there, and, frankly, I don’t really want to go. But if you check it out, there might be some loot there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Comment_SecondCall_1_FF_: Don’t just stand there, come sit with us!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_ArcanStory_Quit_6: You should rest, soldier. I’ll be on my way.
Then go! Quick march, double time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_ArcanStory_Start_: That fucker Voronin… I’d like to kill him with my bare hands…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_ArcanStory_TellMe: You shouldn’t drink that much on an empty stomach.
And you... shouldn’t tell me... what to do. Screw you. And screw Voronin.
He said anyone who’s in cahoots... with Zulu... doesn't deserve good guns. He gave us this crap... so mine jammed when those mutants attacked us.
So Andrew’s dead now... I couldn’t protect him... screw Voronin, and screw Zulu!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_KorenStory_NoProb: Really? So Freedom treats you well?
Of course. It’s not as uptight as Duty. You wake up whenever you want, you bet in the Arena, you drink at the bar with your pals... ain’t that sweet?
My time with Sidorovich was just a nightmare. You always gotta keep your freedom, stalker. Remember that. And let Sidor burn in hell.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_KorenStory_Quit_6: Good for you. I have to go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_KorenStory_Start_: Thinking about Sidor makes me sick to my stomach... I don’t like dwelling on the past. Things are way better today.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_FirstWFR_Alt: So, you wanna drink and chat? Wise choice!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_FirstWFR_Con: So, let’s make some introductions. That drunk over there is Noose. Former Duty. Used to be a man of high integrity, but his delicate psyche made him drink it all away.
This goblin here is Garry. He's always been a wreck, but he really started falling apart here in Garbage — both mentally and physically.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_FirstWFR_NoD: I’ll pass on that drink. So, why did you call me over?
Cutting right to the chase, huh? Fair enough. The Zone’s no place to drink with strangers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_FirstWFR_Yes: Okay. It'd be rude to refuse.
Hey, we've got a proper gentleman here, boys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_ForthWFR_Alt: If you deal with Sidor, you'll end up owing him your pants before you know it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_ForthWFR_Pro: We brought him loot once — almost died getting it, all covered in blood and sweat. He paid us for it, but when we asked to buy some medkits, he jacked up the price.
He knew we had no choice — there was no medic here at the time. Not only did we have to give him all the coupons we got for the loot, we even found ourselves in debt! That’s when we decided to leave.
Yeah, it was shitty time. The boys are no better now, though. They’ll tell you all about it if you’re willing to listen. Please do. I’m so sick of being their shoulder to cry on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_Quit_63619: Okay, nice chat. Time for me to get going.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_Quit_63620: Oh, that’s too bad. I was kinda hoping to talk to you more... All right. Take care.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_SecondWFR_In: You’re from Freedom, right? You’re quite the curious bunch.
That we are. But we all started out as loners at the Cordon — shared some adventures there, hated Sidor together... and then we just went our separate ways.
But we still like to get together here sometimes — sharing news, remembering the old days... but the boys aren't in a good mood today. So, what brings you here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_Start_63607: Finally, a new face! I’m sick of seein' the same ugly mugs all the time. Especially yours, Jacket.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_Start_63609: Don’t mind him, he’s just bitchy today. Bitchier than usual, anyway. Have a drink with us, loner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_ThirdWFR_Con: Yeah, I get that. Just steer clear of Sidorovich — he'll rob you blind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_ThirdWFR_Got: I’ve got my reasons, and I don’t want to discuss them, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_Main_ThirdWFR_Loo: I just took a scenic route to admire the area's natural beauty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_MalyavaStory_Afte: There’s no Garbage anymore. The kingpins couldn’t agree on sharing a fucking dumpster.
Now we’re all under the Ward’s boot. Well, fuck that. I’m not gonna be the Ward’s bitch. I’m taking my boys and leaving.
Root'll give us some gigs. We’ll manage. Freedom has plenty of... duties to be dealt with. And they don’t like to get their hands dirty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_MalyavaStory_Befo: The situation's normal: all fucked up. It’s all gone to hell without Nestor. All the kingpins are at each other’s throats.
Everyone tries to hog the blanket. Nestor would never have allowed that. All that's left for us is... fucked if I know. I’m actually afraid my pals are gonna stab me in my sleep.
It can’t go on like this. We’ll just kill each other, and there’ll be none of us left. There has to be one kingpin, and that’s it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_MalyavaStory_Ques: So, what’s the situation at Garbage right now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_Dialog_MalyavaStory_Star: So, what do you want, mate?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_arkan_0_ByeTopic_1_61933: Off you go. No need to salute.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_arkan_0_DefeatComment_1_: Toss me a medkit! I’m right here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_arkan_0_InfoTopic_1_1_61: Freedom's got a special store just for members. Know what they call it? The Duty-Free Shop! Can you believe those assholes?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_koren_0_InfoTopic_1_1_61: He’s a good boss, our Myklukha. He’s one of us. He’s not above hanging out with us. As for Voronin... I don’t think he remembers his men’s faces, let alone their names.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ54_malava_0_InfoTopic_1_1_6: I’m thinking about getting the hell out of Garbage. I hate it with every fiber of my being, you know? Especially my liver! Or what’s left of it after all the vodka, anyway...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_AfterFail_1_6099: Why’d you bail on me? I was counting on you, and now I’m the laughingstock of the entire Cordon…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_Appeal_2_61299: Hey! Can you give me a hand?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_Appeal_3_61300: Hold on! You got a minute?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_NotHere_1_60964: Here’s the ladder. Climb on up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_Reward_1_64254: Swing by, I owe you one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_Sucess_1_60967: Thank you, stalker! That's step one — I got an invite to the fire. Now I just need to find someone to watch my back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_Sucess_Reward_64: Here’s a little something for your creativity. I’m off to join the guys. Take care!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Comment_Where_1_60963: Where you at, buddy? Get up to the attic. It’s right over here, up this ladder.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_1_60851: You wanna hear a joke, man?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_AreYouSure_: You know, that’s the last thing I expected to hear. You really think a joke’s going to make a difference?
Well, humor’s a good way to break the ice with folks. It’s not everything, sure, but one thing leads to another, and then I just might find someone to team up with.
I’d rather have an awkward moment than end up dead in an anomaly 'cuz there was no one to get me out. That’s my take on it, anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_BadJoke_640: Here's a tip: a joke is funnier if you don’t forget the ending.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_Bye_60859: I’ll pass. You’re on your own here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_Bye_60860: Got it. I won’t bother you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_ChangedYour: You changed your mind? Will you help me with that joke?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_ILeave_6405: I don’t have time for this. You can save the ending for some other time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_JokeYes_640: Sure, I’ve got a couple of jokes up my sleeve. Let’s give it a shot.
Great! Here’s the plan: I’ll go join the guys, and you head up to the attic by the fire. Once you’re up there, we’ll get in touch over the radio. Let’s do this!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_Joke_64045: The vet yells, “Hah! So they were bullshitting me about that anomaly!” Even I know that one. It’s an oldie.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_No_64096: I got no time for this, sorry. Gotta go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_SphrotHelp_: Oh, man… look, stalker, I’m trying to get in good with this group, but we just ain’t clickin'. I’m sure you’ve figured out why.
Give me a hand, would ya? How about this: I’ll go over to the guys, and you’ll whisper a joke to me over the radio. You seem like you've been around the block — you probably know a ton of 'em.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_Yes_60855: All right. So there’s two stalkers, one vet, one rookie. Uh, how does it go again?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_Yes_60856: Oh yeah! The vet turns to the rookie and says, “You see that tree? Go over there, but real slow.” The rookie's all jittery as he walks there, and then the vet yells…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Intro_Yes_64044: Wait, what does he say? Hold on, I got this...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarBanditsDo: “So the other bandits can tell them apart from the zombies.”
The bartender goes, “How else could the other bandits tell ’em apart from the zombies?”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarBanditsHi: “Because when they drink, they gotta toast to all of their dead kingpins.”
The bartender goes, “’Cuz imagine pouring one out for every one of their dead kingpins.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarBanditsSi: Because, uh… they’re from Garbage! Garbage is stinky! Get it?
I think I’ve heard that one before. All right, Sprat. We’ve had enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarBandits_6: “Why do bandits from Garbage always reek of stale booze?”
Uh… “why do bandits from Garbage always reek of stale booze?” “I dunno,” the stalker says, “Why?”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarNoonBoat_: “You don’t. The Monolith's calling him to rock bottom.”
The bartender goes, “You don’t. The Monolith's calling him to rock bottom.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarNoonShoot: The bartender replies, “Well, you can start by taking your foot off his head.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarNoonSilen: Uh, how did it go again? Right! “You shoot him to put him out of his misery!”
That sucked! I sure hope you’re quicker with your gun than you are with a joke, Sprat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarNoon_6086: “How do you save a Noontider from drowning?”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarNoon_6484: Uh… “how do you save a Noontider from drowning?” “I dunno,” the stalker says, “How?”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_BarSuccess_6: Ha, not bad. Well, what are you waitin’ for? Take a seat. I might not be a bartender, but I can fix you a drink.
Sure, go ahead and pour me one. Just give me a minute, I’ll be right back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_Bar_60864: A stalker walks into a bar, and the bartender asks him…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_Bar_64839: So a stalker walks into a bar, takes a seat, and the bartender asks him…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_HospitalDiff: “An onion? When I cut into an onion, I cry!”
“When I chop up an onion, I start cryin'!”
And, uh… the death truck? The truck’s about 150 pounds heavier!
What’s the difference between you and a sober Duty guy?
The Duty guy is still funnier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_HospitalPati: “It’s the Sultan. So watch your bedpan — he’s always out to steal other people’s vessels!”
“So keep an eye on your bedpan — he’s always tryin' to steal other people's vessels.”
“Uh, yeah… um… it's a chimera!” Sidorovich is taken aback. “What happened to it?” The doctor replies, “It's sufferin' from split personality disorder!”
Seems like I’m gonna be the first stalker in the Zone to die of sheer boredom.
“It's a Bloodsucker.” Sidorovich is taken aback. The doctor explains, “It's having liver pains. It really needs to change its diet — stalker blood is 90% vodka!”
“It's a Bloodsucker! It’s having liver pains.”
“It should really consider changing its diet — stalkers have more vodka than blood runnin' through their veins!”
“Apologies in advance, but your neighbor in the next room…”
“Don’t worry, but your neighbor in the next room…”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_HospitalSile: “Well, I, like, saved your life, but I’m not about to play the good Samaritan. So you owe me one.”
“Ahem... so just do a couple of tests, and we’re square…”
“Oh my, not those tests! I was talkin' about a psi-field test!” Get it?
Yeah, we get it. So what? We’re not wasted enough to find this stuff funny. Give us some space, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_HospitalSucc: Hey funny man, how about you tell that to Sidorovich’s face? Ha! Take it easy, we’re just messing with ya. Come sit with us. How about a shot?
Sure, go ahead and pour me one. Just give me a minute, I’ll be right back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_Hospital_608: Sidorovich ends up in the hospital. And the doctor says…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_Hospital_648: “So Sidorovich ends up in the hospital. The doctor walks in and says…”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_ReadyOrNot_6: You all set? Let’s get started.
Hey, guys! You wanna hear a joke?
Uh-oh. Our resident comedian is at it again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_Silence2_609: And so, um, the blind dog stands on its back legs to raise a toast…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_Silence2_648: Ahem... so it tries to make a toast, but ends up stumbling and spilling booze all over itself. Everyone’s cracking up, and the dog…
“And the dog just stands there muttering something stupid. And then it hits us — it’s Sprat!”
Hey, funny man! Got any magic tricks up your sleeve? How about a disappearing act?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_SilenceBarte: “You’ve had enough, Flesh. You’re drunk as a skunk.” And the Flesh goes, “Stop trying to control me!”
“That's it for you, Flesh. You're drunk as a skunk.”
And the Flesh is like, “Stop tryin’ to control me, man!”
“This is the last one.” The Flesh drinks more and falls, the dog quotes Faust, “the spirit is willing but the Flesh is weak.”
“You’ve had enough, Flesh. This is the last one.” The Flesh still drinks another one and falls under the table.
And the dog is like, “And Faust told me — the spirit is willing but the Flesh is weak.”
Uh, he says, like... “Just don’t swipe the blind dog's booze again, okay?”
And the dog’s like, “Oh, now I got it! And here I thought you were just waterin' down my hooch!”
We ain’t wasted enough to find that funny, man. Beat it, Sprat.
And the bartender’s a Controller. It eyes the Flesh’s empty glass and says…
And the bar is run by a Controller. It glances at the Flesh’s empty glass and says…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_SilenceFlesh: The blind dog gets up and goes, “Okay, that's enough drinking for tonight! All that booze is making my flesh crawl!"
The blind dog gets up and goes, “Okay, that's enough drinking for tonight!"
"Because all that booze is making my flesh crawl!"
So, um, the blind dog, like, says to it, “Are you? You know, I can’t see any difference.”
Is that supposed to be funny?
So the blind dog offers him some advice: “Just rub your snout, you’ll feel better.” The Flesh replies, “How? I’ve got no hands.” The dog goes, “Whoa, I didn’t see that coming.”
“Try rubbing your snout, that’ll sober you up,” the dog says.
“But how? I’ve got no hands,” says the Flesh. And the dog’s like, “Oops, didn’t see that one coming…”
And the Flesh says, “Damn, I’m so wasted. I feel like such a pig.”
The Flesh is like, “I’m so wasted. I feel like such a pig!”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_SilenceSucce: Hey, that wasn’t half bad! So whatcha waitin’ for? Got any more jokes up your sleeve? If not, come join us for a drink.
Sure, go ahead and pour me one. Just give me a minute, I’ll be right back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_Silence_6093: Ahem, anyway… so, picture this: a blind dog and, um, a Flesh are sitting in a bar.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_Dialog_Joke_VacationSile: Uh… “I’m thinking of going on vacation. Any guesses where I’m heading?”
“Prypiat. I really love fishing, you know. And they say you don’t even need a rod to catch a fish in Prypiat. They just stroll right out of the water.”
I wish you’d catch a decent joke for a change, Sprat. Now give us some space, would ya?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_leha_styr_0_BusyTopic_1_: No, no, can’t talk right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_leha_styr_0_InfoTopic_1_: Are you kidding me? We’re in the Cordon, man! Nothing ever changes here. Zalissya’s where all the action is, if the rumors are true. But here… well, you can see for yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_lena_sprot_0_DefeatComme: I’m hurt! I need a medkit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_lena_sprot_0_InfoTopic_1: You’re asking the wrong guy. I’ve only been here a couple of days. Well, I guess Sidorovich knows my nickname now. Or maybe he was just listing all the fish he knows.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_sana_sajga_0_DefeatComme: I’m down! I need a medkit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_sana_sajga_0_InfoTopic_1: I swear I saw Sidorovich leaving the bunker, but no one believes me. They say it’s too much of a miracle, even for the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ55_urka_plut_0_InfoTopic_1_: I’m sick of those old-timers, stalker. “The Cordon ain’t what it used to be… back in the day, ten years ago… and then Strelok… yadda-yadda-yadda.” I should’ve just gone to Zalissya.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_BorodulinUpset_Upset_260: Shit! My whole hunt is ruined now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinCallSki: Freedom it ain't, but a dead Flesh'll do in a pinch. Come over here.
Hey! March your ass over here, private.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinCallsFl: Come on, mutants! The Colonel’s about to pump ya full of lead!
Nice report! We’re gonna butcher ’em like cattle. Hey! Over here, you freaks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinLike_Go: Damn, that feels good! I haven’t had that much fun since Prypiat, when we nailed those Freedom bastards one by one… you alive over there? Good. Now we can talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinProvoca: Look like you've got Freedom-style balls — little shriveled-up things. You think you can get to Roosevelt uninvited? Well, be my guest. I could use a laugh.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinRadioCa: Where are going? Come back here this instant! No dead Fleshes, no Commissary for you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinSongLon: Everyone’s got icons, but Freedom – they’ve got coupons!
They failed to take the Zone by force, so now they sell their ass, of course!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinSongSho: Freedom members got no spine, and they smell like filthy swine!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinStartSk: Ready or not, I’m coming to get ya! Let’s have some fun!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinTalkToM: What are you ruminating about over there? Need a special invitation? Speak up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_BorodulinUpset_1: Shit, my whole hunt is ruined now! Still, a real Duty member never leaves empty-handed. Come over here, private!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_EscortLeavesWhil: Where do you think you’re going, you chickenshit civvy?
What is it, private? We’ve got mutants to shoot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_LetsHuntLater_Le: An Emission’s about to begin. If you wanna go hunting with the Colonel, come back later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_RadioCallReward_: Here’s your reward, private. That was a hell of a hunt!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Comment_SkifBrokenRules_: What in tarnation?! I’m the one doing the shooting here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinAfterQue: What can you tell me about Duty, Colonel?
The Duty I knew is all but gone. Now they're just the Ward's lapdogs… but at least those dogs still get sicced on bad guys instead of just carrying Korshunov’s slippers in their mouths.
Why do you hate Freedom so much, Colonel?
'Cuz they’re pussies. Only pussies would gut rookies who haven’t even got a whiff of the Zone yet.
If I'd been at Rostok back then, Myklukha wouldn’t have gotten shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinOffersTo: How about this, Colonel: you get your hunt, and I get some information. I need to get into the Commissary. Quietly. I hear you know the place like the back of your hand.
Ha, I used to have every rodent out there lining up to report to me. until that bastard Roosevelt… But that’s none of your business.
You want information, load up your boomstick. We’ll see if you’re fit for anything beyond wiping Freedom’s asses.
What’s up, private? Feel up to shooting some mutants with the Colonel? Good, good.
Wanna hunt some mutants with a real Colonel from Duty, private?
Then get the hell outta here.
I know some Duty members. You don’t look like them.
Yeah, sure thing. If you haven’t served, then shut yer trap. Everybody in Duty knows me.
So, are we gonna hunt us some mutants, or what?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinReward_G: Impressive! You just made my day. Now, about the Commissary. Use the pipes to get inside quietly. They go all the way around the building.
Climb in through the bathroom in the courtyard. Then get on the balcony, and you’re in. Don’t fall for Roosevelt’s sweet talk, he’s an asshole.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinReward_R: Remember, you’re only alive because I wanted it that way. The Colonel never misses. The Colonel takes care of his men!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinReward_V: Anything I should know about the Commissary?
Nowadays it’s a run-of-the-mill criminal hangout, except that they shoot a little better. It takes time to piss that Duty training away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinReward_w: A friend of mine — my best friend, the bastard. He and I used to give Freedom hell back in the day.
Until the Ward got us in a choke-hold with their fucking armistice Treaty, anyway. So we ended up here, at the Garbage. This place... the air here turns people into trash.

Then the power went to Roosevelt’s head, and he kicked me out. Said I was too drunk. So what? Those Freedom sons of bitches are living their best life, and we’re stuck here hunting those Brood scum! Why shouldn't I get loaded?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinTalkLate: Come back later... unless you wanna die in the Emission.
We can chat once we’re done hunting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_BorodulinWantsMor: Okay… since we’ve got nothing to shoot at, here’s an idea.
I'll give you some time to hide your ass, and then I start shooting. Survive for one minute, and you’ll get your Commissary pass.
Did you grow some balls, or what?
Missed it, sorry. I was too busy saving your ass.
Shut up, you snot-nosed little puke! Who do you think you’re talking to?!
Did you see that? My whole damn hunt is ruined now…
I’ve got a better idea: you do the running, I do the shooting.
You asshole! I’m gonna get you!
Are you nuts? I’m not about to get myself killed, Colonel.
Think you can ruin my fun now? Fuck no!
Remember, Colonel, I need information about the Commissary.
Soldiers who hide behind senior officers don't deserve squat.
You couldn’t hit the broad side of a barn.
Shut up, you snot-nosed little puke! Duty never misses!
That’s what you promised me last time, but here we are.
Duty’s word is stronger than a Burer’s head. Be a good sport, and you’ll get yours.
So, how about it?
You know what? I ain’t done shooting yet! These mutants might look scary, but they suck as targets.
How about you entertain me now?
I'll give you some time to hide your ass, and then I start shooting. Survive for one minute, and you’ll get your Commissary pass.
Did ya see that? Watch and learn, private!
Sure thing. You can’t hit anything anyway, Colonel.
We’ll see about that. I’m counting to three.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ57_Dialog_SkifRaidBorodulin: Roosevelt — anything I need to be concerned about?
Well, he’s a better shot than I am. If you catch him off guard, he might be willing to talk.

I’m going to ask you one more time, Colonel…

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ70_dimon_strateg_0_CallPlay: Hey, stalker. Come over here! Let’s chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ70_dimon_strateg_0_DefeatCo: That hurts, you son of a bitch!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ70_dimon_strateg_0_HelloTop: Whoa, look who we got here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ70_dimon_strateg_0_InfoTopi: Hey, I got a new job after we met at the Poppy Field. My new one’s way more profitable.
Yeah? What are you doing now?
I’m a rescuer. I find rookies and save them in exchange for a portion of their loot. If they say no, who knows what might happen to ’em, right?
A rescuer, huh? I dunno, you sound like a run-of-the-mill bandit to me.
Just lookin’ for a certain guy. I need to have a little chat with him. He thought he could trick me, but he’s got another thing coming.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_Comment_RunAway_1_53205: H-huh?! What the hell are you doing here, man? There’s a mutant out there! Get outta here! You’re gonna get me torn to pieces!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_Comment_SeesMutant_1_527: Fuck, fuck, fuck! You brought that thing here! I’m dead!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_Dialog_TalkWithMelkij_Be: Yes. I took care of the creature.
Damn, that was a close one. Thanks for not bailing on me.
Here, take this. It’s not much, but it’s all I’ve got.
I took care of the creature.
On your own? Whoa… I thought I was a goner.
Here, take this as a token of my gratitude. I don’t have much, but I won’t let you leave empty-handed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_Dialog_TalkWithMelkij_Bl: What the hell are you doing here?
I was heading south. I wanted to get some practice shooting Fleshes. It’s my first time out on my own.
Guess I wasn't ready to leave Zalissya just yet. I should go back and listen to the old-timers, learn more about the dangerous areas.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_Dialog_TalkWithMelkij_By: I’m gonna get going before something else decides to come after us.
You’re right, we should get the hell out of here. Thanks for bailing a rookie out, man.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_Dialog_TalkWithMelkij_St: Are you alive? So where’s… did you take down the mutant?
H-huh?! What the hell are you doing here, man? There’s a mutant out there! Get outta here! You’re gonna get me torn to pieces!
Oh, no! Are you seriously gonna fight a mutant in here? It’s gonna rip me apart! Get that thing away from me! Please!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_Dialog_TalkWithMelkij_Wh: Why weren’t you there to help when I was dealing with the mutant?
I was afraid I’d run out of ammo. You could’ve turned on me once you were done with that thing.
I may be new around here, but I’ve seen some shit. My first partner ditched me and ran off, and the second one almost did me in!
Turns out, there are way fewer trustworthy people in the Zone than artifacts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_kiruha_melkij_0_DefeatCo: I’m keeling over! I need a medkit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ71_kiruha_melkij_0_InfoTopi: Have you met the Ward? Those guys mean business. They’re not fond of stalkers, sure, but their gear is top-notch! If I had some of their stuff, I’d rip the tentacles off that Bloodsucker!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Comment_GuronRadioCall_c: Come in! It's Huron. Is Gonzo with you?
What the hell… are they drunk or something?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Comment_GuronRadio_radio: Can anybody hear me? Come in!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_So: Well, it looks like something went wrong. If you can’t talk right now, or don’t feel like it, come to the Slag Heap, and we’ll have a chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_Th: If you find the crate and deliver it to the Slag Heap, I’ll pay you well.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_Un: I have no idea what’s going on here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_ab: He was in the Brood for a long time. The only thing he had left from Freedom was his suit. Guess there must be a rift between the Shah’s people.
But that’s got nothing to do with us. All I care about is my shipment. The only Brood guy the Dome was buddies with was Docent. He might know something about my stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_al: I don’t know who Gonzo is, but everyone here is dead.
I see… so that’s what happened to him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_an: You’re not from the Brood. Where’s Gonzo? What’s going on?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_g_: Listen up, stalker. My courier Gonzo was supposed to deliver a shipment to the Brood. That gang’s full of scumbags, and their boss the Shah is the worst of the bunch. He’s not so crazy about people losing his stuff.
Take a look around. See anything interesting?
If Gonzo doesn’t have my shipment on him, that means it was taken by whoever killed him and those Brood guys.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_ha: I found a PDA on a dead Freedom member. Edik the Dome. You know him?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_no: Take a look around. I bet you can find some clues that'll lead you to the package.
Nothing special — other than a pile of dead bodies, of course.
So go and search carefully. I bet you can find some leads.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_re: I’d rather not get involved. I don’t like this one bit.
Well, suit yourself. If you change your mind, look for me at the Slag Heap.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ73_Dialog_GuronRadioCall_ta: Got it. I’ll try to find it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_AfterDialog_1_55: I just need some time to collect my thoughts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_CloseKillPolterg: Oh my God… is that thing dead?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_ComeBack_1_55727: Where are you going? Don’t leave me here, please!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_DistantKillPolte: Are you all right? Did you take care of the mutant? If so, please come over here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_Emission_1_55691: Oh, no! Just what I needed…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_LostInLabyrinth_: Help! I’m here, in the middle!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_MoveReaction_1_5: Stop! This thing reacts to movement!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_RadioCall_1_5569: I need help! I’m stuck in the middle of the car dump! I can’t get out! Somebody, please, help me!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_UnicHelloTopic_1: It’s great to see you. I finally made it here, and I owe it all to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Comment_WhatDoIDo_1_5569: Oh God, what do I do now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Dialog_WithZitnicenko_Fi: Yes. A warning would’ve been nice, by the way.
You’re right… I apologize. It’s just… I was afraid you wouldn’t help me if I told you about the Poltergeist.
I hope you’re not upset. Please accept this modest sum as a token of my gratitude.
Relax, the mutant's been dealt with. You’re free to go.
Thank you! To be honest, I’m not really sure where to go now…
But I won’t keep you any longer. Again, thank you very much.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Dialog_WithZitnicenko_Fo: Gather any supplies the other scientists had with them, stay put, and wait for evac.
All right, I’ll do my best. Thank you for your help.
Go to the Slag Heap. Stick to the roads. If you run into bandits, give them everything you've got. If it’s mutants, run like hell. Once you get there, hire a guide. Don't haggle.
Roads, bandits, guides… I’ll try to remember.
Thanks for your help. Hopefully I’ll see you at Malachite next time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Dialog_WithZitnicenko_Op: I won’t keep you any longer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Dialog_WithZitnicenko_Se: When you ask for help, don’t keep people in the dark. That kind of thing can get you shot.
Of course. I understand. I’m glad you were the one who saved me. I won’t keep you any longer.
You’re a scientist, right? What were you doing here?
My group and I were studying an anomaly nearby. We came here to take a break — we didn’t want to run into any bandits. This is Garbage, after all…
But then we stumbled upon the Poltergeist. It didn’t reveal itself immediately. We made it all the way to the middle of the junkyard... and that’s when it started pelting us with debris.
Everyone ran for their lives, while I was paralyzed with terror. In the end, that's what saved my life. You can’t imagine what that mutant did to the others.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Dialog_WithZitnicenko_St: Did you… did you kill the mutant?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_Dialog_WithZitnicenko_Th: Relax, that mutant is gone. I have to get going.
Yes, of course. Thank you again. I won’t keep you any longer.
Someone’s coming to pick you up?
Of course. I'm sure Malachite will send a squad to pick me up. I’ll let my supervisor know what happened.
Oh my God… I hope he’s not still holding a grudge against me. If he doesn’t send help, I’m done for…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ74_aspirant_zitnicenko_0_In: I don’t know about the Zone, but there have been some changes at Malachite. I managed to recover a couple of interesting soil samples from anomalies in Garbage.
Professor Ozersky appreciated my efforts, and now I’m in charge of the geological research lab. I owe my success to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Comment_BynyaGoToHubWith: Thanks for your help. You're a decent guy. That's a rare sight around these parts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Comment_CallPlayer_a_281: Shoot… well, this is just great. How am I supposed to fish it out now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Comment_PickedUpGun_nott: Hey, that’s mine, man! I just dropped it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Comment_PickedUpGun_talk: Whoa, nice catch! Now bring it over here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Comment_RanAwayWithGun_W: Hey! My gun… it's gone. I guess you're right at home here, stalker. This place is full of garbage like you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_AfterEQ75_ifdontr: You're still alive without a gun, huh? Nice.
A man can always buy another gun, Skif. But he can’t buy his honor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_AfterEQ75_ifretur: Good as new! A little grease and a good cleaning works wonders.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_BynyaAskHelp_What: Aw, man… shoot… what am I supposed to do now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_BynyaAskHelp_agai: So, can you fish out my gun?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_BynyaAskHelp_firs: I lost my rifle in the trench, and I can’t retrieve it. Would you help me, bro?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_BynyaAskHelp_help: All right. I’ll pull it out for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_BynyaAskHelp_why_: Why won’t you retrieve it on your own?
Too many rads to go there naked. And all of my gear is back at the tech’s. Man, help me, would ya?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_Dialog_PlayerHaveTheGun_: I see… I guess you’re right where you belong, stalker. This place is full of trash like you.
I don’t see your name on the gun. Guess it’s mine now.
Right. That’s why the gun is mine now.
My gun. Did you get it?
Thanks so much, bro! It sure sucks being in the Zone without a gun.
Decent folk are a rare sight here at the Garbage. You’re gonna have a hard time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_byna_0_BusyTopic_bynya_b: Don’t you pester me now, I’m busy!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_byna_0_DefeatComment_byn: Damn it to hell, it hurts!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ75_byna_0_InfoTopic_1_bynya: There’s not much here. Only trash. And that includes the people… present company excluded, of course.
You want some advice? Don't trust anyone around here, and you’ll be good.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ76_Comment_WhenOnTop_1_FF_2: Holy shit, another one! Can you see the CNPP from up there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ76_vasa_strih_0_HelloTopic_: Nice spot for a smoke, eh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ76_vasa_strih_0_InfoTopic_1: What do cranes and Wardens have in common? They both look down on you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ76_vasa_strih_0_InfoTopic_2: I've been afraid of heights my whole life, you know. Even sitting on a high stool used to scare the shit outta me, to say nothing of rooftops. But now… I’d climb anywhere just to avoid the boss.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_AfterFinalDialog: Run along, would ya? What’s there to talk about, huh? The scenery? I’d rather skip that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_AfterFirstDialog: Come on, get moving already… I gotta go too. Just need to catch my breath.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_CallPlayer_Call_: Did they build all this crap just so I could fall off of it?! Fuck! Didn't they realize it'd get rusty after all these years?! Zero thought for the future…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_IfDontTalkWithDa: Are you sure you want to go up there? I fell once already. You could end up breaking something.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_NearCache_a_4312: Had a good look around? Pretty nice, eh? Now get down from there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_PlayerOnTheBridg: Where are you going? Stop! Stay away from this rusty piece of crap!
What are you doing out there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_PlayerRunAway_a_: Hey! Where the hell are you going, asshole?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Comment_StartClimb_a_432: What, seriously? You wanna walk around with a big bruise on your ass too?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_Cache_56967: So you found it… All right, let’s make a deal. We'll split it evenly and go our separate ways.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_Ok_56968: Agreed. Just let me get down from here first.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_Ok_56969: I’m glad we understand each other.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_empty_56972: There’s nothing to split. The stash is empty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_empty_56973: You think I’m stupid? I filled that stash with loot myself! Trying to trick me, are you? You really shouldn’t have done that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_notok_56970: Finders keepers. Whoever finds a stash gets to keep everything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_notok_56971: Too bad. You should’ve taken my offer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Cache_really_5697: So this is your stash? That’s why you tried to climb those beams, huh?
You got me. So let's just split it and go our separate ways, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_FinalCache_notok_: I don’t feel like sharing with you anymore.
You think you’re clever, huh? Well, you’re wrong. Dead wrong.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_bye_56989: All right. I gotta go. So long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_go_away_56: Nothing. I guess I’ll get going now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_help_56986: I’m not gonna say no. Thanks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_need_to_go: It's amazing enough to risk a fall from way up there?
Now that I've tried it, no. It’s definitely not worth it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_only_56983: You mean you climbed up there just to enjoy the view?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_only_56984: Well… those vast expanses of nature untouched by human hands, dilapidated machinery… sounds pretty romantic, right? Or so I thought.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_what_56978: Why the hell are those beams so slippery? You can’t climb ’em. Can’t even stand on 'em.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_why_56979: So why'd you climb up there in the first place?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_Dialog_Speech_why_56980: The view is amazing. You can see the whole Zone from up there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ77_darvin_0_InfoTopic_1_Dro: Fine, I guess. It took a while for the bumps and bruises to heal after I fell off the bridge. The doc said I was lucky I didn’t have any broken bones. With all that rust, I could’ve croaked easily.
So I won’t be climbing up high to enjoy the scenery any time soon. Too risky.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Comment_EfimIfSkifIntoTr: I'm all outta ammo! Put the damn thing down!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Comment_EfimKillHer_1_29: Thanks, man! Come over here, we'll have a chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Comment_EfimScreams1_1_2: What's the matter, can’t squeeze through? How about you try a little harder, you son of a bitch!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Comment_EfimScreams2_1_2: Hey man, can you help me? Shoot this damn thing!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Comment_Sniper_1_58894: Were you the one who put that damn Flesh down? If so, thank you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Dialog_SkifEfimThanks_My: Why didn’t you shoot it yourself?
I’m empty, man. I was coming back from a run when the damn thing jumped me. Wasted my last few bullets on it and missed!
Hey, got any spare ammo? I’ll pay you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Dialog_SkifEfimThanks_Sh: Always? I take it this isn't your first time running from a Flesh?
Nope. I don’t know what they see in me, but I get attacked every damn month! This one today was on its own, but last week there were three of them at once! The Zone has a weird sense of humor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Dialog_SkifEfimThanks_am: I can spare some 12 gauge shotgun shells — just what you need for Fleshes.
Thanks, bro. Now I can drive those damn Fleshes away.
I can give you a magazine for an AK. It should be enough as long as you don’t shoot at crows on the way.
Thanks, bro. Now I can drive those damn Fleshes away.
I’ve only got a 5.56 magazine to spare.
Thanks, bro. Now I can drive those damn Fleshes away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Dialog_SkifEfimThanks_by: Sorry, I don’t have any ammo to spare.
Okay. Thanks for your help anyway. I guess I’m gonna try to get to Rostok.
Okay, bye. I have to go.
Hey, got any spare ammo? I’ll pay you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_Dialog_SkifEfimThanks_th: Thanks for helping me. I've been stranded here for a while now.
Those damn Fleshes are always so clingy! I wish women hounded me like that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ82_efim_0_InfoTopic_1_1_589: Oh, same old... Damn Fleshes keep chasing me, I keep stuffing all my pockets with ammo. I learned my lesson...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ84_Audiolog_CrazyLot_Audiol: I’m making this recording… so I won’t forget.
My name is Vaska Lot. I just came from Scar, and now I'm heading to… heading to… where? Shit… everything’s so blurry.
I’m lost. I dropped some stuff along the way so I’ll know if I’m going in circles.
My name is Vaska Lot. I just came from… fuck, I already said that.
Phantoms… Phantoms… so many of them… make them go away… go away...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ85_Audiolog_LastTalk_1_5373: O ye of little faith… shit, it’s gotta be around here somewhere!
Look at the sky, man! There's an Emission coming! Get down, or we’re outta here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ85_Audiolog_LastTalk_1_5374: God damn… Leave him, guys. We gotta move.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ85_Audiolog_LastTalk_1_FF_5: Are you fuckin’ nuts, Stefko?! Get down, now! Forget that Monolith stash! We've been had — there’s ain't shit up there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_OsaIDidntAskForH: I didn’t ask for your help, and I’m not gonna pay for it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_OsaIfSkifSaw_1_4: I owed him a fortune, but the fucker wouldn’t let me pay him. "Come on, double or nothing," he'd say.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_OsaIfSkifSaw_1_5: How was I supposed to pay him back when he was always cheating? I couldn’t even catch the bastard in the act!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_OsaLastRepeat_1_: I gotta quit gambling. If your buddies are all cheats, you're gonna be in debt to them for the rest of your life.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_OsaThreatsSkif_O: Hey, you! Leave his backpack alone. It’s all mine!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_SpichkaClaim_Spi: Tails, you lose! The artifact is mine!
You’re cheatin’ again! Gimme a mulligan!
Cheating?! I don’t even have to cheat with a moron like you! You’re dumber than a pile of rocks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_SpichkaIfSkifHel: He’s no Wasp! He’s a fucking rat, that’s what he is!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Comment_iNeedThat_Reshka: Then I’ll take the artifact from your corpse, asshole!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_Dialog_SpichkaAfterEQ88_: I just about shat myself when I heard those shots behind my back. Son of a bitch… thanks, stalker.
“Thanks?” That's all I get? I saved your life, man.
Fair enough. Here’s some coupons. It’s all I got.
Don’t turn your back on people like that again. Not in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_osa_0_BusyTopic_busy_343: This ain't the best time for a chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_osa_0_InfoTopic_1_info_3: Hey, I quit gambling, ya hear me? That felt like the worst hangover ever.
But I’m not one to give up. I had got enough to get me some gear and a piece. Even paid off my debts. Wasp’s got a nasty stinger now!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_spicka_0_CallPlayer_1_FF: Over here, stalker. Let’s have a chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_spicka_0_HelloTopic_hell: Good to see you! If it weren’t for you, Wasp would’ve taken me down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ88_spicka_0_InfoTopic_1_Inf: The less excitement you have, the longer you live. Hell, I almost got killed over a lousy artifact. And I thought Wasp was my friend…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Comment_KiruhaSemaDisput: What’s wrong with being a loner, Kiryukha? You get to shoot mutants and collect artifacts without anybody pushing you around.
Jesus, Pugach… Back on the Mainland, you wore those shoes from your graduation for five goddamn years, and you’re content with small-time jobs here too. We’re getting nowhere!
All right. Then let’s join Duty or Freedom. Just not the Ward!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Comment_KiruhaSemaLeaveA: That’s it. I’m going to the Chemical Plant tomorrow!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Comment_KiruhaSemaLeave_: I’ll text that Warden. Ask about any openings.
I’m sick of your obsession with the Ward! Why don’t you try texting a girl instead?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Dialog_AboutClans_about_: What can you tell me about Duty?
For soldiery types, they’re all right. They sure do love shooting mutants. Stalkers get a kick outta that too. Right, Kiryukha?
Duty’s been shooting mutants for ten years now, and the mutants are still around, and in the same numbers too... unlike the Duty guys themselves. Now the Ward... they mean business!
They used to want to give the Zone’s riches to the world outside. Now they run a store in Rostok. Those sellouts have turned into petty traders!
Not that petty if you ask me. Their boss Myklukha invented coupons, and now they’re the backbone of the entire Zone. Freedom is in charge now!
They’ll only be in charge for as long as it benefits the Ward.
What can you tell about the Ward?
As far as I’m concerned, they’re nothing more than crooked cops.
The Ward are real pros. They set everything straight as soon as they got here. And their gear is top notch!
Then what the hell would they need you for?
Hey, I’d make an awesome Warden! I’ve almost got one of ‘em to sign me up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Dialog_AboutClans_no_458: See, Kiryukha? Not everyone’s champing at the bit to join the Ward.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Dialog_AboutClans_start_: What do you think, stalker? Would you join the Ward?
You’re getting ahead of yourself again, Kiryukha. The guy could be new to the Zone. If you don’t know about these groups, feel free to ask.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Dialog_AboutClans_tell_a: You wanna hear about the groups?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Dialog_AboutClans_want_v: What do you think, guy? Would you join the Ward?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_Dialog_AboutClans_yes_45: I’ve seen the Wardens in action. I’d work with them anytime.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_kiruha_drajv_0_InfoTopic: You can’t make it in the Zone all alone. You have to choose a side. Trust me, you wanna stick with the strongest group out there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ93_sema_pugac_0_InfoTopic_3: Don’t bother chasing after every artifact in the Zone. Take what you can carry and leave the bigger stuff for the larger groups.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_BespredelNoMore_: You’re back, huh? Lost something, did you? Oh, right! You lost your chance to become a legend, you pansy!
Don’t say a word. That’s enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_Bespredel_CallPl: Easy there, I’m a friendly! Wanna grab some loot, Stalker?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_Bespredel_End_wa: I’m gonna wait for the chimera to come back. You’d better leave.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_Bespredel_Fail_f: What part don’t you get? I don't want nothing to do with you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_Bespredel_GoAway: Scared, huh? You going back to your mommy? Fine! Get lost, loser.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_Bespredel_NearLa: Hey! You hear that? It’s over there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_Bespredel_SkifFa: You’re awfully fond of your food, I see.
What are you… dammit, I told you to throw your food away!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Comment_Bespredel_Whatt_: Where the hell are you going? I told you to stay close!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Dialog_Bespredel_Khimera: Well, what are we gonna split now? There aren’t any artifacts here.
What the hell! Where’s my chimera?
Hey man, what the fuck are you doing? The chimera is mine!
What the hell? There was supposed to be a chimera's lair here! It’s up high, there are fuel barrels all around it… just like my teacher told me.
So long, stalker.
See you. You better remember my name, ’cuz I’m gonna be a freakin’ legend one day!
You really thought you’d get it right the first time? As Lex the Legend says, mistakes are good. The Zone itself is the result of a mistake, and it’s pretty damn cool!
But mistakes don’t make you any money, that much is true. Come to the Flea Market, and I’ll introduce you to my teacher. He’s the epitome of stalker success.
I know that guy. He's a fraud. Always bullshitting rookies about the Zone and the secrets of stalker success.
You’re just jealous he gets to be the Legend of the Zone, while you’re a nobody!
