I’ll deal with that chimera one day! I’m not the type to give up easily, unlike some people!
Beat it already. I don’t need a partner like you.
Need any more help from me?
So you can ruin everything again? No way, man.
Looks like you could use some training… when you get to the Flea Market, talk to Lex the Legend. He can help you get to my level.
Teacher? More like the ramblings of a madman.
Watch your mouth! Do you even know who you’re talking about? I'm talking about Lex the Legend! He went to the center of the Zone with Strelok!
You’ve got some nerve, ruining everything like that! You went in on your own and spooked the chimera!
Tell me about him. What does he teach?
Hold on there, partner. I’m not giving away his special teachings for free. As the Legend says, there's nothing more valuable than hard-earned experience. You catch my drift?
Anyway, just come to the Flea Market and see for yourself. For the right price, he can teach you how to keep mutants from catching your scent.
Well, that’s it. Go get your learn on. I’ve got a chimera to kill.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Dialog_Bespredel_NearLai: We’re getting close. Got any food with you? You’ll have to throw it away.
My backpack’s empty. I don't have any food.
Okay, we’re ready now. Stick close to me, and try to keep quiet. The lair's up there, at the top.
If you say so. Gimme a sec.
Think about it. With them two heads, a chimera’s got one hell of a sense of smell. I've got something to cover our scent, but it won’t work on the food. The smell's too strong.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_Dialog_Bespredel_StartKh: Oh, it’s you again. Changed your mind, have you? Kill the chimera and get the artifacts. We’re gonna hit the jackpot!
Hold on. How come there are artifacts in the nest?
What, you don’t know? Chimeras are like magpies — they steal anything shiny and take it back to their nests. And artifacts sure are shiny.
You don’t want to be famous all over the Zone? Fine, that’s your choice.
Deal. But we split the artifacts evenly.
Evenly? Why? You don’t get it, do you? You can’t kill the chimera without my help! I’m the one who knows the secret!
Fine, whatever. Let’s just do it before someone else kills the creature.
Tell me about this chimera. What is it, anyway?
It's the most powerful mutant in the Zone. If you pass the chimera test, you’re no longer a rookie. That’s what my teacher said, anyway.
The two-headed brute loves two things: food and the smell of gasoline. It tends to make its lair near fuel barrels.
I know a couple more secrets about it, all from a reliable source. Just follow my lead, and we’ll get this thing done in no time.
I've a job for ya. Ten minutes tops, and we’re done. Unless you chicken out, of course.
I’ve found a real chimera’s lair. It’s on the top of a hill, not far from here. And I know a secret way to take it down.
The plan is simple, so just follow my lead. We'll take down the chimera, then split the artifacts in the nest seventy-thirty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ97_bespredel_0_InfoTopic_1_: Once I get real good at this, I’m gonna sell stuffed mutants back to the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Comment_Amalgama_Closer_: I’m over here. Just a few steps away!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Comment_Amalgama_Here_A_: Hey, you there! Over here, dammit! I’m stuck!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Comment_Amalgama_Left_A_: Don’t you walk away from me, you Flesh-fucker! I’m gonna die over here, man!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Comment_Amalgama_TalkLat: Dang, that was intense! But I’ll be all right in no time. Stay in touch – maybe we can do it again sometime soon. You never know when my anomaly sense might come in handy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Comment_Amalgama_TooLong: You know the way, right? Right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_A_: Man, I thought I was gonna die of old age in that damn anomaly!
Meeting you was a real stroke of luck – almost like when I met my teacher.
If you ever swing by the Flea Market, gimme a holler. I’ll introduce you to my teacher. Maybe he’ll take you under his wing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_By: I did what I could. Gotta go now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_Ch: If you ever change your mind about Lex the Legend, drop by the Flea Market. I’ll put in a good word for you, and maybe he’ll take you under his wing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_Di: He sent you into that anomaly empty-handed. He almost got you killed.
Nah, man, that’s on me. I figured my anomaly sense was gonna kick in right away. I should’ve taken my bolts, at least.
So cut the Legend some slack, it ain’t his fault. I’m the one who needs to slow my roll.
All right, well, thanks for helping me out. I hope we see each other again sometime.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_Kn: Yeah, I know the guy. He’s just a windbag pretending to be a seasoned veteran.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_Li: There’s no such thing as an “anomaly sense.” And hunting Snorks with your bare hands? That’s a one-way ticket to the grave. Your teacher is full of shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_Ne: Got it. Still, swing by the Legend’s place if you’re around. I’ll put in a good word for ya.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_No: Oh, come on! He’s the real deal, man. He’s got tons of students! Anyway, I’m sure they call him the Legend for a reason. People wouldn’t pay for his advice if he was all talk, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_S_: I think I've earned a reward, don't you?
Sure thing. I can offer you some money, or maybe an artifact. It’s not exactly hot shit, but it’s all I’ve got.
You know what? You keep it.
Really? You’re a goddamn… good Samaritan or something. That’s the word, right? Respect, man. I can’t thank you enough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_Final_Wh: Why didn’t you just walk out of the anomaly on your own?
He’s Lex the Legend! He’s tough as nails. He can even take Snorks down mano a mano! His anomaly sense is so sharp, he doesn’t even need a detector!
You know, most seasoned stalkers just brush you off when you ask ’em for help. But Lex is always there for you. He ain’t stuck up or nothin’.
You guys really gotta meet each other. Come to the Flea Market, he’ll teach you everything too. First lesson’s on the house.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_First_A_: You’re my fucking savior, man! God, am I ever glad to see you! Get me outta here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_First_S_: One step at a time, my friend. One step at a time.
Yeah, right. No fuckin’ way I’m staying here. I’m going with you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_First_St: See, here’s the thing… My teacher said I gotta work on my anomaly sense. Then I can trust my gut instead of relying on some fancy gear.
So I listened to my gut and went after an artifact. I even left my bolts at the camp. You think it worked? No fuckin’ way, man!
I spent hours searching for that damn artifact. I was tired as hell and about to turn back, and that’s when my anomaly sense shat the bed on me. That’s how I ended up getting stuck here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_First_Wh: Why don’t you just walk out of here on your own?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_Dialog_Amalgama_LetsGo_l: Come on, lead the way. I know we can do it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_vova_amalgama_0_BusyTopi: Not right now. Can’t you see I’m busy?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_vova_amalgama_0_DefeatCo: Help! I’m gonna snuff it, man!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_vova_amalgama_0_InfoTopi: I think I’ll try going to Prypiat in about a week. The Legend told me how to get past the Boundary!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_EQ98_vova_amalgama_0_ResumeCo: So, where were we? Oh, right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_BusyTopic_2_1_: I got no time for this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_BusyTopic_4_1_: Can't tell you anything unless I'm ordered to.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_BusyTopic_6_1_: Whatever the question was, the answer is: none of your business.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_BusyTopic_7_1_: I’m not reporting to a loner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_BusyTopic_8_1_: I wasn't ordered to talk to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_CallPlayer_2_1: Come over here. We need to talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_10_1: After my first fight against Fleshes, I couldn’t even look at canned meat for a week.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_1_1_: I was trained to fire my rifle, and that’s what I do. It doesn’t matter who I’ve got in my sights – human or mutant, I’ll take ’em out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_2_1_: My job is to follow orders. The rest is none of my business.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_3_1_: I have a lot of sympathy for the people who live in the Zone. Or the stalkers, for that matter. This whole thing... it shouldn’t even exist.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_4_1_: Don’t let the Zone get in your head. I’ve seen guys lose their minds here. That’s some scary shit right there. The kind you wouldn’t wish on your worst enemy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_5_1_: What the scientists do is no concern of mine... as long as they don't do their experiments on me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_6_1_: As the saying goes, keep your feet warm and your head cool. And keep a loaded pistol at the ready while you're at it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_7_1_: Having to serve in the Zone is one thing, but staying here for the thrill of it? Clothes that don’t fit you, shitty weapons, no food... where’s all the fun? I just don’t get these stalkers…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_8_1_: If you were a bandit, I wouldn’t even talk to you. I’d put a bullet in your head, and that’s that. That's the only way to deal with those scumbags.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_InfoTopic_9_1_: The only nice thing about the Zone a smoke before lights out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Conc: Too many casualties, too few new recruits... at this rate, there won't be any more Duty soon.
Voronin and Zulu are at each other’s throats. That’s not good.
I can see where the general's coming from. He doesn't want to risk his men’s lives if he doesn't have to.
I’m always so goddamn tired... and so fucking bored! But I guess we’re doing the right thing here... right?
Korshunov only needs us to guard the Cooling Towers. We’re nothing more than watchdogs to him. And Voronin doesn’t wanna listen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Corp: I don't buy it with the SIRCAA guys. If scientists need that kind of protection, something's up.
To be honest, the loners would have a hard time here without the orders from the Mainland. If you’ve got coupons, those guys can get you pretty much anything.

Stay quiet, keep your head down. Before going out, jump up and down a little. Check your pockets and tighten up your knots. Prypіat likes it quiet. Keep it down, and you might live to see another day.
When stalkers start giving you a hard time, all you gotta do is point a rifle at 'em, and they're long gone. But if mutants show up, you gotta waste a fuck-ton of ammo.
You know what I could use? Some of that Warden gear.
What's the deal with the scientists working in the field? They oughtta stay in their labs, not poke around Project X.
I wasted two full mags on those freaks just yesterday! Given how tight our supplies are, those mutants are getting way too expensive!
I don’t even remember the last time we got resupplied. I’ve been waiting for new boots for two months now! And don't even get me started on the guns...
I wish some of those Duty guys would step up and do our job for a day or two. They’d get to do what they love, and we’d save some ammo. It's a win-win.
There are some benefits to serving here, though. We get to raid places regular stalkers could only dream of.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Duty: The Ward’s got some premium-ass weapons and gear. If they'd helped us, the Zone would be mutant-free by now.
But, of course, Freedom’s agreed to a truce. War’s bad for business, right? What I don’t get is why we agreed to it.
Give us some Ward weapons, and we’d rid the Zone of mutants in no time! We'd kick some Freedom ass, too…
They say they love the Zone, right? Why stay out of anomalies then? Go drink your vodka with Bloodsuckers or crack stupid jokes with Controllers. How about that, huh?
I don’t get you loners. You live hand to mouth, take dumps in the bushes, everybody’s out to rob you or take you down.
That’s why I joined Duty. Too much drill bullshit, but the food's good, kit's decent, and… well, you don’t have to fight mutants on your own, right?
Those hippies from Freedom have killed so many of our men… and now we gotta be all buddy-buddy with ‘em? Trust me, if it wasn’t for Voronin’s orders…
Those Freedom guys are here for the coupons. Duty fights because it's a calling. We’re not leaving until the whole Zone is cleared out, every last mutant.
We've got our hands full. So damn many monsters to kill… whatever, we'll get 'em!
How come new kinds of mutants keep showing up? We’ve been killing those fuckers and got nowhere. Zulu’s right. Enough sitting on our asses — we need to do something!
I thought hell was the place you're supposed to go when you die. But here we are, alive and kicking. For now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Himz: I went on a clearing mission the other day. Culling the local endemic fauna, you know? It’s an easy job, but I always have a hard time recovering... I can’t eat, and everything smells like blood.
One of you stalkers reminded me of my grandpa the other day. We arrested him for sneaking around someplace he shouldn’t have. And guess what he had for a weapon — an old Berdan rifle!
It was just like the one my gramps used to hide in the hay barn. How do you guys even survive with this shit?
I’m so fed up with the Zone. I’ve never been so homesick in my life. And I can’t even call my family — we’re not allowed to use phones until the end of our contract.
Okay, I’ll tell you... You've got a badge, so you must have gained Korshunov’s trust, and that's no mean feat... Anyway, our sources in the Zone say there are some guerrillas out there now.
They've got good gear and a decent understanding of tactics. But, most importantly, they’re technically savvy. After each encounter with them we find parts from the old labs…
Oh, plenty of new exciting stuff every day! We beat up stalkers, we bash mutants, and we never push pencils, unlike the IPSF or Duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Ikar: It was so easy in the Guardian Program. You shoot mutants like clay pigeons and put notches on your belt.
But here you don’t know your enemy sometimes. You just get this gut feeling that you have to shoot.
One of our patrols saw this brainwashed guy the other day... he had deep cuts all across his face, from his eye to his chin, as if a cat had scratched him.
But that'd be a really big cat... the last thing we need is a Bayun on our hands.
Have you seen those two ships in Zaton? One belongs to stalkers, the other — to the bandits. We leave them be. They're too busy killing each other, so we don’t bother.
Those eggheads have it so simple on paper: mutants, anomalies, risks and outcomes, figures and probabilities...
But in the field, your only certainty is that something's gonna go terribly wrong.
Why are there so many dogs here? Where do they come from, and in packs, too! No, really, you might need a machine gun to handle them. What do they even eat here, frogs?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Merc: The loners keep whining about the Zone, but they don’t seem to be in a hurry to get back to the Mainland. I'm outta here first chance I get. Had it up to here in the Zone.
I don’t care whose fucking nickname is listed in the order. I’m not an attorney. Not even a damn judge. I carry out the sentences.
I feel like I’m running from something even when I’m just sitting there. I wonder if everyone in the Zone feels the same way…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Mili: If I’d known beforehand what kind of shit was going on here, I would’ve wiped my ass with that contract. But at least no one’s pestering me about marching drills.
The sounds in the Zone… that’s the hardest part to get used to. Can’t say which ones creep me out more, the quiet sobbing or the screaming.
Here in the Zone, your only friend is your gun. Take good care of her, and she'll never let you down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Vart: You stalkers look down on the Noontiders because they’re not in their right mind, but what about you guys? At least the Noontiders have nowhere else to go. What are you sticking around for?
Mutants and bandits are just trash waiting to be taken out . Just brainless pieces of shit begging for a bullet in the head.
I thought I was gonna hang out at SIRCAA and keep the eggheads safe. Instead, I gotta shoot all kinds of freaks. I’m pretty used to the people, but the mutants… no way.
A real soldier can adapt quickly to any environment. And I’m a top-notch soldier. The Ward accepts nothing less.
I should've read my contract more carefully before I signed it...
They guaranteed payment if you're killed in action. Then the fine print said there's no payment for “non-combat losses caused by the anomalous effects of the Zone”. Which can be pretty much anything.
I’ve been on a dozen of these missions. Some of 'em could make a decent movie... too bad I signed an NDA.
You know how I got into the Ward? Didn’t ask stupid questions.
20-mile run in full gear — yes, sir. Fighting three dudes with knives, unarmed — roger that. Shoot that creep — thank you sir, may I have another?
Wardens don’t think twice. They act.
I trust anyone who's got my fucking six, stalker. Those buddies of yours would put a bullet in your head or throw you to the mutants the moment they find out you got some good loot on you.
We’re the Zone brotherhood. You're the vandals. Think about it.
You should be glad the Ward came to the Zone. Without us, you would've all killed each other over a bunch of shiny pebbles.
The only thing the Ward can’t control are the anomalies. But it’s just a matter of time, trust me.
Some of the factions weren't too happy when the Ward came to town. But what are they gonna do about it? Their weapons and uniforms belong in a museum, next to the dinosaurs.
A lot of people didn't like the new rules at first, but they realized pretty quickly that the Zone needs a firm hand. We can bring order to this place faster than Duty ever could.
What really sucks about the Zone is the food. The rations are barely edible. But the stalkers are still willing to kill each other over that crap.
I've been jumpy as fuck. I almost fired at a pal yesterday. He came around the corner outta nowhere – I thought he was a Bloodsucker. At least my reaction time's still all right.
You can fight each other all you want, stalker, but the moment you cross the Ward - we'll put you down like a dog. It's the law, and I wouldn’t advise anyone to break it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_Infotopic_Yano: The bandits are fighting among themselves, the stalkers are clashing with the Ward… this place is rotten to the core. No one's ever gonna find peace here, Treaty or no Treaty.
How good your gear is definitely matters in the Zone. But how good your partner is matters even more. I know my pals are never gonna shoot me in the back. Can you say the same about yours, loner?
It wasn’t easy for me to get used to the Zone. Now I can’t imagine serving on the Mainland. I’d be bored to death over there.
I’ll tell you a little secret — a soldier’s secret. If you don’t smoke, you die sooner. You know why? 'Cuz you keep on working while the other guys are taking smoke breaks.
You think it's mutants and anomalies that kill you? Hell no! Stupid jobs and the commander who assigns 'em to you, that’s what gets you killed.
So I was out at night, and I heard a cat. I figure I should go get it before something eats it. So I’m, like, “here, kitty, kitty,” and he keeps running through the bushes, meowing his brains out.
I chased after him for half an hour, almost got into an anomaly… and I couldn’t even see the little prick!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_MutantLootBig_: You bought me half a suit, mate!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_MutantLootSmal: Folks will pay for all sorts of crap…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Chatter_Gr: What are you gonna do when you get back to the Mainland?
Write my memoirs. Just keep watch, will ya?
Can you believe this wind?
Yeah, the weather's been crazy.
So what are we gonna do after we clear the mutants outta the Zone?
Guess we’ll find out... if we live long enough.
I’m bored outta my skull here!
Then clean your weapon. You're gonna need it.
How long have you been here?
I dunno. Who's counting?
I’m used to everything now… but those anomalies still give me the creeps.
Yeah, bullets won't help you against those things.
I wonder what kinda research they're doing at SIRCAA...
Who cares? As long as you aren't the test subject.
Do you even remember what life was like without mutants and anomalies?
It feels like a million years ago. Like it wasn't even real.
What was the first mutant you ever bagged?
Honestly? I can’t even remember. I’ve killed so many of 'em, but they just keep coming.
(sneezes)
Enough with the sneezing, private! You can get sick back on the Mainland.
A year here oughtta count as two. Three, even.
I need some leave!
I’m sick of standing watch. Wish I could get some sleep.
Once I’m back home, I’ll forget the Zone like a bad dream. If I make it back at all…
Five minutes to kill a mutant, half a day to clean your uniform afterwards…
Whenever I’m on duty, that's when the weather gets crappy!
The more you clean up, the messier it gets!
The more freaks we kill, the more keep coming. What the hell's going on?
I’d rather die in combat than get ripped apart by a mutant. At least I’d get a proper funeral…
I’m sick of canned food! I don’t even know what they put in that stuff!
You can’t let your guard down. The last guy who did is probably still somewhere in these trees…Well, pieces of him.
I need to hang on. This tour’s gonna be over soon.
I hate this fucking place.
I'm so tired…
Same shit, different day…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Chatter_Ho: Heard a loner was trying to get through an IPSF checkpoint.
Straight on, headfirst, no second thoughts. His gear didn't look rookie, either.
No matter how long they interrogated him, he just kept begging. Saying, let me back into the Zone: there's no Mainland outside that Perimeter.
Better stay away from abandoned checkpoints on the old Zone border. About a year ago, this rookie dude lost a bet and had to spend a night there.
Some night it was.
We came back for him in the morning, and there he was, hanging on his new belt.
And the weirdest thing was, his uniform was right there beside him, folded into perfect squares, and his PDA was playing a song - a cheerful song, damn it.
Still can't get it out of my head.
A fellow soldier participated in a field experiment: they put some gizmos on his chest, and he had to stand still with those gadgets on at several places, down at the Burnt Farmstead.
He got a huge paycheck back then, we thought he got out of here. And then we ran into him, not so long ago. He was running. All skin and bones, didn't even look human.
I only recognized his voice. "Sorry, I can't stop" - and he took off.
Where he's serving now - nobody knows.
They say the Perimeter's full of mutated beasts, nothing more. The real mutants, the ones…made of humans - won't stick their mutts in there.
But that's a thing of the past. My pals from different posts say sometimes the big ones get close enough to the border.
Chimeras, burers, controllers. And, get this, they're quiet, they never attack - they just creep closer and stand there with a blank stare, and head back.
As if…waiting for something.
Remember, I told you nothing.
Quiet down now.
It's against the rules, but I'll tell you…
I overheard the folks on duty talking…
Believe it or not…
I'm gonna tell you something that will blow your mind.
Forewarned is forearmed. So get ready.
Some years ago, I wouldn't have believed it myself, but…
Okay, I'll tell you because I gave my word. But don't you dare interrupt me.
I hate this place.
Here's to another recurring nightmare…
Bollocks.
Watch it. Brass doesn't like this kind of stories.
Couldn't come up with a better bullshit story?
Save this crap for scaring off loners.
Every time I'm on duty, it's somebody's freaking time to shine.
I don't like this…
Who's gonna believe it?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Chatter_Jo: One stalker says to another, “Hey, let’s have a pet Flesh at the base.” His friend winces. “No way… think of the filth and the stench!” The first one says, “It’s okay, the Flesh’ll get used to it.”
A soldier wakes up in the infirmary after a mission and asks, “Where am I, doc?” The doctor says, “Don’t worry, you’re in a hospital room. Mostly. Two hospital rooms, technically.”

Morning formation, commander's losing his shit: “Where's the third fucking squad?!” The lieutenant whispers, “Remember how you said anyone who gets eaten by dogs shouldn’t bother coming back to base?”
A commander asks his recruits, “Where should a bandit keep his bullets?” They say pouch, pocket, mag. “Wrong!" he corrects 'em. "A bandit should only keep a bullet in the back of his head!”

An anomaly mission AAR: “Told you not to go overkill! The orders were clear: boots on the ground! No guts hanging from tree branches, no heads lying in the shrubs! Just. Boots. On the goddamn ground!”
A commander comes up to a soldier on watch: “How’s your shift going, soldier?” “It ain’t goin’ nowhere, sir,” the soldier replies. “It don't got no legs!”
SIRCAA scientists have developed a new medicinal herb native to Chornobyl. Its curative properties are so potent, it can mend open fractures… the only problem is, you gotta catch it first.
A soldier's busting his ass tryin' to keep up with stupid orders. The lad starts whining, “Sir, I’ve been on my feet all day, I'm beat!”
“Then lie down and give me 50 sit-ups, on the double!”
A soldier reports, “We apprehended an unusual stalker during the sweep. He resembles a human, walks upright, and seems to have rudimentary speech. Got one word out of him so far, "Loot! Loot! Loot!'”
A soldier asks two stalkers which anomalies are the most dangerous. One says, “Burners — anything that falls into one burns to ash!” The other says, “No way, Whirligigs — they'll tear you to shreds!”

The soldier scoffs, “Hah, that’s nothing! A whole truck of canned meat disappeared from our warehouse. We’ve been searching for it for a whole week! It vanished into thin air — now that’s an anomaly.”

An old-timer’s showing a rookie around the Zone. “It’s real quiet here. No bandits, no patrols,” he says. “I've heard scary stories about the Zone, but it actually seems pretty nice," the rookie says.
“'Course it does,” the old-timer replies. “A chimera scared everybody off.”
Some bandits are talking by the fire. “I was born in the year of the tiger,” one boasts. “That’s why I’m so tough.” The other says, “I was born in the year of the snake, so I’m nimble as fuck.”
The third one mutters, “While yo' asses were bragging, I cleared out all yo' stashes. Guess what year I was born.”
A commander is instructing his men near a mutant lair. “If you spot a Poltergeist, aim for its legs,” he says.
“Commander, there’s one headed straight for us, but it doesn't have any legs,” a soldier reports. The commander replies, “Oh, that’s ’cuz I already shot ’em off.”
A soldier ends up in the infirmary. The doctor asks, “How did this happen? Your arm’s broken in three places!” “Please don’t tell my commander,” the soldier begs. “He told me to stay in one place.”
A veteran is sharing wisdom with new recruits. "Always make sure you got a good blade on you. Got a headache? Just apply it to the affected area, and you’re golden."
Two Wardens talking. “I’ve been guarding SIRCAA for three months now,” says the first. “What’s it like?” asks the second. “It’s a regular three ring SIRCUUS.”
In a deep, dark city, in the deep, dark Zone, there’s a deep, dark house. Inside, in a deep, dark room, is a bunch of stalkers... ’cuz they can’t figure out how to change a light bulb!

A gang walks by looking for trouble, a soldier lures them into the bushes. Their boss sends a guy to handle it. He goes into the bushes, vanishes. He sends more – two, five, ten – all gone. Go figure.
Screaming, gunfire, blasts, then a young punk jumps out and goes: “Boss, it’s an ambush! There's two of ’em!”

A soldier goes to the doctor. “I’ve got two problems. First, I don’t have much to say. Second, what I say is kinda random.” The doctor says, “Can you give me an example?” The soldier goes: “Probably.”
Two soldiers chilling out, chitchatting. “I saw one yesterday: torn gas mask, dirty gun, talking gibberish, crawling around on all fours.”
“Whoa, you saw a Snork?”, his pal asks. First one goes: “Nah, just a stalker stumbling out of a bar.”
Wait for it, guys! Here’s a good one!
Permission to raise spirits?
Ah, wait 'till you laugh your asses off when I tell you some home base shit — fucking hilarious!
(attracts attention)
Meh, I heard that one back in boot camp.
Hilarious. Funny as an extra shift.
Stupid pranks among our ranks...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Combat_Act: Pin them down. I’ll go around them!
I'm going around. I need cover!
Cover me while I flank them.
Flanking the enemy. I need cover!
We've got a man down here!
What are you firing at, soldier?
We got a man down here!
I’m gonna make a run for it. Cover me!
Hold them down! I need to reload!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Combat_Ene: The enemy is retreating. Good work!
Cease fire! The enemy is retreating.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Combat_Sea: No enemy in sight. At ease!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Combat_Thr: Heard a noise. I’ll check it out.
He must be close by. I’ll check it out.
Come out with your hands up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Combat_Wou: Hold on, pal. I'll be right with you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Emission_L: The Emission is over. Back to your posts!
An emission is coming! Take shelter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Interact_N: What are you doing here, stalker?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_NPC_Interact_S: Take any questions to my commanding officer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_TradeTopicBadR: Don't expect much. This isn't a supermarket.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_TradeTopicGood: You did the right thing coming to me!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_army_0_TradeTopic_1_5: I only got the good shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandit_0_BusyTopic_7_: Big mouths don't make bosses outta chumps.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandit_0_NPC_Chatter_: A buddy of mine saw someone get in a Whirligig again, on the road to Rostok. Some rookie, burst like a plum - right next to him.
So, my buddy, he's just standing there, frozen, and the chump is, like, dripping down him...
Tried everything, washed his face with water, with vodka… Still, every time someone opens a can of grub, he gets this feeling, crawling down his spine…like, for real.
Hey yo, now shut it and listen up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_BusyTopic_1: Where do you think you're going, mate?
What you peepin’ at? I don't know nothing.
You're too small of a fish to yap with me.
I don't give a rat's ass.
Shut your trap, we can chat later.
Piss off, I’m not in the mood for a chinwag.
Big mouths don't make bosses outta chumps.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_BusyTopic_2: Back off. We can talk some other time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_BusyTopic_3: I sure don't need some dipshit talking to me about nothing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_BusyTopic_6: Chatting to you lot gives me a bloody headache.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_BusyTopic_8: Chit-chatting's on the dinner menu, not now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_BusyTopic_9: Do I look like a radio?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_CallPlayer_: Get your ass over here, stalker.
Chop-chop, let's have a little chat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_General_ban: The Brood folks were yapping about how the Shah got rid of chumps before word got out.
If he had it out for some loser, he'd make him stash some shit somewhere, like, to test him, or whatever.
And the way to the stash was through radioactive waste. Folks got no gear. How'd they know where the rads at? No color, no smell.
So they'd be running through the nastiest of places with their tongues out, zero clue they're good as dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_1: More and more cops come here every year. Different kinds, but they're all the same.
Life’s good. The boss respects me – he got me a new gun, and my jacket’s fresh off some chump. It could be better, sure, but it could be way worse too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_2: Fuck, man... I came to the Zone to get away from the cops. Turns out the place is crawlin’ with them!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_3: Can’t remember the last time I had decent food. Loners don't even have any, others are too fucking tough to handle.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_4: Nice trick, these coupons. Now Freedom’s got the whole Zone by the balls. Should’ve stuck with 'em... I’d be swimming in dough now too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_5: Shaking a chump down is an art. Not a total rookie — they got nothing to loot. Not too experienced either — those guys got some badass heat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_6: If there’s natural pest control, we’re the Zone’s pest control. We take what’s left behind and finish off the ones who suck at running.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_7: Steer clear of mutants. You’ll just waste your ammo, and they don’t got any loot on 'em.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_8: Those stalkers are a pain in the ass. You fuck your fists up grilling them, and their stash turns out to have a couple loaves of bread and a can of meat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_InfoTopic_9: Fuck... this is the Zone, dude. It’s every man for himself. The math is simple: it’s better to keep all the loot than to divvy the spoils up between the two of us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_Infotopic_S: People scratch all kinds of shit on their guns. Headcounts, sweethearts, dates they came to the Zone… one even had a prayer! Didn't save that loser, ha.
Buddy of mine had a Warden gun! Maybe the boss'll get me one too, if he knows how to get 'em, right?..
Sultan's been sitting on his ass since he took over Skadovsk. Shoulda been harder on Beard. Why the hell is he cutting him slack?
We’re sorta like Robin Hood, ya know? Take from the rich, give to the poor. And since there ain’t no one in the Zone poorer than us, we get to keep everything, heh heh.
Rumor has it there was this nutjob, Noah. Wandered the swamps with a pet pseudodog. Hey, maybe it’s true. This place is full of crazy-asses.
So one night I was drinkin’ by the fire with my pals, and I noticed one of them skulkin’ in the shadows like he’s mad or somethin’.
So I go up to him to ask what happened, and guess what — it’s not my pal, it’s a fuckin’ zombie! Good thing I had my gun.
You can hear all sorts of sounds in the Swamps. But if you hear someone repeating some phrase like a broken record, run. That’s a fucking Bayun all right.
Back in the day, me and the boys used to clash with Duty almost every day. Just like how we used to brawl with the city folk in my old village. Good times. Then the Ward got too fucking scary.
Well, even the Ward is lying low now. You hardly see them outside of Icarus. I wonder if they're planning some shit, or if they're scared shitless too...
They say Beard's dreaming of getting the Skadovsk back. I say let him dream. The Sultan might just get the Shevchenko too while he’s at it.
I left the Mainland 'cuz I wanted to be free. Well, I'm free now... but no matter where you are, life sucks ass if ya got no coupons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_Infotopic_T: Man, remember the last Emission? I thought the Slag Heap was gonna collapse on itself. I mean... holy shit!
Everybody dug down as deep as they could, diggers and crooks alike. This is it, I thought. Well, we’re still alive and kicking, as you can see.
Thugs just went off the rails. Before, they used to open up with small talk when they were out to rob you blind. Now the bastards just shoot you in the back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_MutantLootB: I'm busting my ass, and they'll still pay me jack shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_NPC_Chatter: I wanna get some of that dope vodka from the Depot. Good shit!
Sure that's the real stuff? That "dope" canned meat you got last time sure gave me a dope three-day wet fart!
Wanna buy a Rodent?
I’m sick of your shit!
Everybody says they’re sick of my shit. Why won’t you buy a Rodent for a change?
It happened the first time I was in juvee...
Oh man, this is gonna be a real long story!
I’m fucking starving! Zone chow sucks, I want some real food.
Guess you ain't that hungry then.
I’m starvin'. My stomach is growling!
Shoulda aimed at that loser better. We coulda taken his stuff.
Wish I had a shot of vodka right now.
A shot? How about a whole bottle?
Why so quiet? Who died?
If you don’t shut up, it's gonna be you.
So I get into the cave, three Bloodsuckers inside…
Last time yo' ass said it was two!
Ever thought of pissing back off to the Mainland?
Nah. Only ones waitin’ for me there are the damn cops.
Little birdie told me the Ward's selling guns on the side!
Those fucks won’t even sell their toys to other pigs, we wouldn't get shit.
I need to check my stashes, make sure no one stole my shit.
When I get me some guns, I’ll have a gang of my own. Why not? I’d make a helluva kingpin!
Man, I really need a new piece…
How long have I been in the Zone? Two years? Maybe three?
I wonder how my mom’s doin’…
Now where the fuck did I put my stuff?
I'm a lucky goddamn charm, even here in the Zone.
No loot to sell, not a single sucker crossin’ the Perimeter… I'm so damn hungry!
The chumps are gettin’ poorer these days. No loot to shake 'em down for.
Anybody ever tried eating a Rodent? I wonder…
I really need some vodka! My throat's killin' me…
Fuck these rags! Wind’s goin’ right through it!
All pigs are the same. Won't leave us decent folks alone.
I shoulda killed that loser! I’d be all kitted out now.
Fuck, my teeth hurt like a son of a bitch. Ain't there an artifact to make it go away?
Some chump's going home after a rumble, just messing about. And right in freaking front of him - bam! - a scientist.
Waving his hands in the air, screaming, "stop, stop!" So he stops, just standing there. And the scientist is - boom! - gone.
Only a lab coat left of him. Covered in blood.
You know what the weirdest thing is? The coat doesn't say SIRCAA, or even Malachite, - it says MDST, whatever that is.
A buddy of mine saw someone get in a Whirligig again, on the road to Rostok. Some rookie, burst like a plum - right next to him.
So, my buddy, he's just standing there, frozen, and the chump is, like, dripping down him...
Tried everything, washed his face with water, with vodka… Still, every time someone opens a can of grub, he gets this feeling, crawling down his spine…like, for real.
Some chump's going home after a rumble, just messing about. And right in freaking front of him - bam! - a scientist.
Waving his hands in the air, screaming, "stop, stop!" So he stops, just standing there. And the scientist is - boom! - gone.
Only a lab coat left of him. Covered in blood.
You know what the weirdest thing is? The coat doesn't say SIRCAA, or even Malachite, - it says MDST, whatever that is.
The Brood folks were yapping about how the Shah got rid of chumps before word got out.
If he had it out for some loser, he'd make him stash some shit somewhere, like, to test him, or whatever.
And the way to the stash was through radioactive waste. Folks got no gear. How'd they know where the rads at? No color, no smell.
So they'd be running through the nastiest of places with their tongues out, zero clue they're good as dead.
Hey yo, now shut it and listen up.
Just telling you what I know, that's all. Here it is…
So, here's this thing I wanna tell ya.
I heard this wicked thang…
Shut y'alls traps now, this shit's for real.
Now, listen up and quit yapping. Or the Zone's gonna get you.
Keep your ears open! I'm not gonna repeat this.
Who wanted to hear the story? Here it goes…
I remembered the craziest thing yesterday…
All kinds of weird shit here.
Fuck me…
Cut the bullshit!
Enough of this crap, gives me the creeps.
Shit, I need a drink now.
That's some royally fucked-up shit!
Why the hell did you remember that?
Heard this three times, still freaking spooky.
Hey yo, knock it…off, damn it.
Scientists has discovered a new type of mutant in the Zone. They call it “a false chump.” Meaning it looks like a chump, it walks like a chump, but there’s nothing to shake out of it.
I heard the Sultan got a blood transfusion from Beard. That’s way more vessels for Beard to bitch about!
So the gang take a new guy in and tell him, “That loser over there's Misha the Dumbass. If you say ‘Hey Misha, you want a hundo coupons or a grand?’ he always takes a hundred. Wanna try?”
New guy asks him, Misha picks the hundred. “You know they call you Dumbass, right?” “I don’t give a fuck. They get a laugh, I get a couple grand a month”.
A stalker calls his pal. “I need help. I’ve got this tooth problem.” His pal is like, “Maybe you shouldn’t bite what you can’t chew.” He says, “Tell it to the thing that’s got its teeth in my ass!”
A bandit gang goes to the Wish Granter. One of 'em says, “I wanna be a kingpin!” So he becomes a kingpin. Another one says, “I wanna be a bigwig at the Slag Heap!” So he becomes a bigwig.
The third one says, “I want the whole Zone to respect me! Everybody should praise me every time they sit down to eat!” So he becomes vodka.
One bandit asks another, “What do you think of Tolyan? He solid?” “He's tough all right. Got some badass gear, dope gun, but all the rest gone soft. That’s acid for ya.”
A bandit complains, “I thought it was hard to hide your shit on the Mainland. But here in the Zone, you gotta hide both your shit and your piss!"
Two pals are searchin' their stash. “Hey, we had a bottle of vodka! Where is it?” “I had to use it on my wound.” “Bullshit! I see no wound!” “No shit! My feelin's were hurt and you ain't got none!”
So the boys are shaking down a chump. All shitty clothes, gear's held together with duct tape, nothin' in his bag but an ID. They look at it and read: “Malachite.”
So homies go, “Should've told us that you’re one of them eggheads! Turn your pockets out, boys — this dude needs help."
A guy says to the bartender, “You've got a dead cat right by your door!” “How do you know it's dead?” asks the bartender. “I pissed in its ear,” they guys says.
“Why would you take a leak on some poor animal?!” the bartender cries. “No, I said ‘psst’ in its ear, and it didn’t move.”
A bandit bumps into a soldier in the Zone, homie goes like, “Wuss wron' with your duds?” The soldier looks down. Everything is fine — uniform is clean, belt is tied, shoelaces, too...
“Oh, I know!” the bandit says. “You're missin' a standard-issue slug between yo' eyes!”
Two pigs on a stakeout. One says, “I'm a Taurus. That's why I’m so strong and stubborn.” The other says, “I’m a Saggitarius. That's why I never miss a shot.”
And their boss says, “Well, I’m a Gemini. That means I'm gonna start jamming eyes if you don't stop your yappin’!”
A bandit is chewing his homie out: “Why yo' ass always come to every shootout wasted? How the hell can you shoot straight?”
And he's like, “Who needs to aim when ya see ten guns?!”
One bandit says to another, “That's a wicked dope jacket! Where'd ya get it?” “Ah, picked it up. Ya know, had to shoot a loser's ass first, then just picked it up...”
Couple 'a' folks from differen' gangs yapping, “Homies say ya got trouble with yo' grub?” “Naw," the other says, "we got trouble with NO grub. When we got grub, we golden!”
Some bandits are setting up camp. One says, “We gotta put a guy on lookout so nobody ganks our stash.” And another one says, “Who’s gonna gank it? We’re all here!”
A guy walks into a bar, orders ten shots of vodka, and slams them back one after another. The bartender asks, “Why are you drinking so fast?” “You’d be drinking fast too if you had what I got.”
“What do you got?” says the bartender. “Half a coupon,” the guys says, then runs out the door.
A Freedom dude and a Duty dude walk into a bar. Well, the heart wants what it wants.
A bandit comes to an IPSF checkpoint. The officer shouts, “Halt! Who's there?” The bandit shoots him and yells, “Halt! Well, jus' me now, bruh!”
A bandit catches a magic goldfish and says, “I want to hide my loot so well, no one'll ever find it”. “Done,” says the fish. “You sure ain't nobody gonna find it?” the bandit asks.
“Yes,” the fish says firmly. “You sure as hell won't. It's deep in Shah’s stash now.”
I bet my ass you never heard this one!
Hey! When I tell a joke, you jackasses listen!
Nothin’, eh? If you don’t laugh at that one, you’re a cop!
(attracts attention)
Well, that’s funny. I mean, kinda.
You call that a joke?
Damn, you’re good!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_NPC_Combat_: Fuck, cover me! I gotta move!
Whatcha doin’? Get ‘em from the rear!
Keep ‘em pinned, I’m headin' straight up their asses!
Fuck him up, I’m comin’ in from behind!
Didja see that? I got one!
Best of luck, off you fuck!
I’ll get 'em from the side! Take cover!
Who are you shootin’ at, fuckface?
Got a little present for you!
Shoulda kept your head down, moron!
Keep shootin’! I’ll make a run for it!
Gimme some covering fire! I gotta relocate!
Keep 'em pinned! I'm on the move!
Cover me, boys! I’m all out!
Keep those fucks pinned! Gotta reload!
I found the son of a bitch!
Fun's over. Chill for a bit.
No chumps in sight. Chill out!
Nobody here. Put down your gats.
Didn’t wanna get it dirty anyways.
Ain't no one here. Chill, boys.
Good. We get to hang onto our slugs.
Head on a fucking swivel, y'all!
The fuck are you waitin’ for? Find him!
I owe you big time, brother.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_NPC_Emissio: The Emission’s all shat out! Let’s go!
We got an Emission coming, guys!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_NPC_Interac: I was just in the mood for a chat.
Get that toy gun outta my face.
You wanna talk, put the piece down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_NPC_Peacefu: Where you off with that stiff?
The fuck are you doin’, dude?
I’m just gonna inherit it, bro…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_TradeTopicB: Sup? In a pinch, are ya?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_TradeTopicG: I can sell ya anything I’ve got, no problemo.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_bandits_0_TradeTopic_: I could find some stuff for ya, if ya got coupons to spare.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_BusyTo: Make yourself useful, man.
Maybe later.
I’m not in the mood.
Nothing personal, I’m just busy.
Don’t you have anything else to do?
Would you be so kind as to bugger off?
Oh, for fuck’s sake, leave me alone.
I beg your pardon, but now is not the best time.
I'm not looking for trouble.
You might want to find other interlocutors, stalker.
Bad timing, man!
I have no time for idle chat with you.
We could talk some time later.
As if I wasn’t busy enough...
It’s shitty enough without your chit-chat.
Keep your distance, stalker.
Stay away, loner.
We’ve got nothing to talk about.
Some other time, all right?
If you want anecdotes, go sit by the fire.
I’d love to talk but I’m not really feeling like it.
I’d rather shut it. The Zone loves silence.
Save your breath.
I don’t like idle chatter.
As if I didn't have enough on my mind…
Go bend someone else’s ear.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_InfoTo: Rule number one: keep your mouth shut. I knew a stalker who bragged about an artifact he stole from a stash. The guy sitting next to him happened to be the owner of that stash. It didn’t end well.
You can get used to anything with enough time. Anomalies and artifacts, monsters and bandits. You end up feeling like the Mainland doesn’t even exist. Nothing but the endless Zone out there.
As far as the local wildlife goes, we’re pretty fortunate. What could mutate into monsters here? Boars, dogs… a cat, maybe. Imagine if we had elephants. Or rhinos. It’d be a mess…
Freedom sold out, man! Whored themselves out for a bunch of shiny trinkets. Our stalker freedoms are a thing of the past — if we ever even had ’em to begin with.
What if the mutants are just pissed off ’cuz we keep shooting at ’em? I can’t stop thinking about it…
When a scientist offers you a job, think real hard, then tell him to eat a real hard dick.
They don’t give a shit about our lives. Experiments are all they care about. If something goes wrong and you die horribly, the scientists couldn’t care less.
Why do people have this stupid need for order? Why do we need some dickhead telling us right from wrong?
I came to the Zone to get away from all that crap. If I wanna die under a bush, that’s exactly what I’m gonna do. And nobody’s gonna stop me!
Our guys don’t know how to take it easy. Get a couple of drinks in ’em, and they start yapping about who got mauled by mutants or anomalies, all the wild shit they’ve seen… bo-ring!
In this business, your gear has to be durable, but not too heavy. A stalker’s gun isn’t the only thing that keeps him safe — being a fast runner does, too.
When you get back to camp after two weeks of kicking shit all over the Zone, and there’s a slice of fresh bread and a real bed waiting for you… now that’s real happiness!
Zone life might seem rough at first, but once you get used to it, you'll never want to leave.
Not sure I can stand another day like that… I haven’t had much luck lately. The Zone’s punishing me. I wish I knew why…
A stalker is only as good as his weapon. An experienced loner spares no coupons on his gun because it feeds him.
Anti-rads, pills, it’s all nasty chems. But a glass of good ole vodka's the real remedy.
This is a strange place. Full of artifacts and mutants... But finding a real friend is mission fucking impossible.
The Zone's a scary place. Not because you get to face mutants or anomalies, no. It makes you face yourself. And then you gotta live with whatever yourself is.
They're an odd bunch, those factions. Trying to divvy up the Zone... as if humans get to decide who owns it.
People have all kinds of reasons to escape from the Mainland… and then the Zone shows them for what they are, and that’s that. They can’t escape from themselves.
Folks come to the Zone either looking for something or running from something. But when they stay, they stay for the Zone itself.
The Zone will never let you go, man. You're definitely going home and then there's always one more thing you gotta do...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_Infoto: Mutants steer clear of this place. They used to hound us, but then we gave 'em what for. Spent two days dumping all their corpses into anomalies before they started stinking up the place.
I’ve been thinking: what if there’s no Mainland at all? What if it’s just a fantasy we’re all clinging to so we don't lose our last hope in the Zone?
Stalkers say SIRCAA’s working on some pills that restore your memory. I’d give anything for that. I’d volunteer to test the stuff if they'd have me.
I wanna go home. Wish I knew where my home was, though… but it’s not here, that's for damn sure.
Loners are afraid of Emissions, but Emissions are something you can hide from. People, on the other hand... there’s no hiding from them. They’ll get you anywhere.
When I got here, I thought life in the Zone was gonna be simple. No laws, you’re your own boss, just you against nature… man, was I stupid.
I was studying to be an archaeologist, and then I ended up here. Bet the other guys in my class wish they had an internship like this!
The Zone’s taught me two things. One: always keep your gun with you, and make sure it's loaded.
And two: always keep the goddamn thing loaded! You never know what kinda shitfucker is gonna jump out at you.
Me? I’m small potatoes. A little trade here, a little side gig there... let Duty play heroes if they want to!
I've always felt like Duty was living in the past, but now I’m certain of it. We’re making good money here, and they keep running around chasing monsters.
The loners are starting shit with the Ward. I don’t get it. If they don’t like their lot in life, that’s not the Wardens' fault. You've got brains - you figure shit out, not whine about everything.
Some stalkers are always whining — nowhere to sleep, no food, pants all worn out… learn to make some scratch, bud! Can't put the light of the Zone in your stomach.
Everybody wanted to get to the center of the Zone, and so did I… till I realized there’s no point. With a good head on your shoulders, you can even make it big at the Cordon.

Myklukha is more of a friend than a boss to us. Voronin won’t even sit by the fire with his men. That’s why those Duty guys always look like they ate a medium rare pile of shit cooked on that campfire.
Everyone in the Zone's got beef. We stay away from that crap. Just be chill, don’t show up empty-handed, and we’ll treat you like fam.
That goes about artifacts outside the Zone's true, totes. We started that shit, my bros and me. Now our baby’s all grown up.
As for me, I’m fine with Duty. They kill mutants, and with their own ammo. stalkers get the goods home faster if they don’t have to waste extra rounds.
Only morons believe that the Zone can be changed or controlled. It can bend anybody until they break.
SIRCAA this, SIRCAA that... but whose idea was it to repurpose those lab medkits? Ozersky's! And what did Dalin do for people? That’s right — zilch.
There’s no order in this place. Even less than at the Slag Heap. But what can you expect from those eggheads? They're not of this world.
So, you want to earn some coupons? You’re in the right place, pal. These lab rats always need something — bring them an artifact, guide them someplace... you’ll get plenty of work.
There was one loner here, Gosha Ping. He had a nasty cough, so the eggheads offered to treat him with some artifact. He lost all his hair after that. Now he's still got a cough, plus he's bald.
You should be careful here. It’s not Project X, of course, but they'll still try to talk you into some shit. Don't let yourself get involved in those crazy experiments of theirs.
Perimeter security kept trying to stop us from getting in... well, those scientists made a huge stink, and guess what — now we’re welcome anytime.
Sometimes I just want to quit and walk outside the Perimeter. But… what am I supposed to do on the Mainland? Who cares about me there? Well, even here… nah. We ain’t goin’ nowhere, loner.
I go into an Emission every once in a while when nobody’s looking. Not for long, of course. There’s just something familiar about it. I feel…home, feel welcome.
They say we should leave, the Ward’s gonna drive us off the island, the IPSF is gonna come, there’s no point living in a swamp anyway…
I say let ’em come. This is my swamp. I finally got a place to call my own after all these years, and I’d rather die here than roam the Zone again.
You’re aware that drinking is prohibited here, right? If you can’t live without vodka, go ahead, but never offer it to others. It’s dangerous for us to get drunk.
I hope the scientists can develop a cure for people like me. To get my memory back. Even for one day…
It’s funny, really. Sometimes I remember a word, but I don’t have a clue what it means. I end up walking all over Wild Island asking if anybody knows it.
I’d rather not know about my past, 'cuz then I’d have to live with it. I’m not sure I want that…
I ain’t complainin’. I went through hell before Strider found me… here, I get to live in peace and quiet and stay close to my own kind.
Maybe we should just go loner and live normal lives… did you hear that Quiet left to become a trader? I guess that’s kind of a way out, too.
There’s no end to these barrels. Sometimes I think the only thing left in the Zone is waste... and us.
The Ward is worse than any anomaly. You can at least guess where an anomaly might be, but nobody expects to run into the Ward... and once you’ve run into them, you’re done for.

I’m out there doing hunting jobs, running petty errands for Sidorovich. He says I don't have the right experience. So how am I supposed to get the right experience if you don’t give me the right jobs?
"Get yourself a partner," they say. How am I supposed to find one? A run in the Zone isn’t the same as going out for drinks with your buddies. You gotta be sure they've got your back.
As it stands, I’m fully confident that everyone here would shoot me in the back without a second thought just to save his own sorry ass.
Digging a grave is dangerous in the Zone. You’ll be sure to dig up something nasty... so nasty you might end up dead too. Burning bodies is no good either. Too conspicuous.
So what are we supposed to do, carry the dead to the Mainland on our backs? No way. We all knew what it meant when we came here. If I drop dead, just leave me on the spot.
The Wardens asked me to snitch for them. Promised me a lot of money — enough to retire and quit stalking. Like that’s a good thing, right? Who says I wanna quit?
No idea, bro. Some shit with Duty, some shit with a Treaty... I’m as clueless as you are, so ask someone else. I’m here to take it easy.
We’re all adrenaline junkies here. Some guys loot corpses, others hunt mutants for money or rummage around in anomalies. Me, I'm a bookie. I get the same rush, but I get to keep all my limbs.
There was this one smartass. Whenever he got drunk, he's start yappin' about how Myklukha stole the whole coupon idea from him. Why would anybody care about some loser with nothing to his name?
Here in the Zone, your rep matters way more than coupons.
Freedom used to have a real goal. We wanted to make the Zone free from any authority. And where have we ended up? We’re the Ward’s bitch now. Fucking capitalism always wins.
Freedom will be good either way, with or without the Treaty. That’s because we don’t fight the Zone, we find ways to coexist with it.
Colonel Korshunov would've cleared all the stalkers out of the Zone a long time ago if not for Dmytro Dalin’s deliberate humanism. If you see a young guy in a suit, remember to say thank you.
Dr. Dalin this, Dr. Dalin that… he’s not working alone, you know! It's the Institute for Research of the Anomalous Area, not the Institute of Dmytro Valentynovich Dalin!
I’ll never understand the people who are willing to do field work. All that rain, cold, and mud… ugh! Not to mention mutants, anomalies, and, well, stalkers. Sounds suicidal to me!
The Zone is key to the future of humanity! It has to be studied gently and with great care. You stalkers are just vandalizing the place!
Dalin may be a genius, but I’d rather wait out the Emissions in the lab. The Absorber might work today, but what about tomorrow? Science is good, but reinforced concrete is better.
How can you not tell an acid artifact from a flame one? What they do is completely different! They don’t even look alike!
They send you idiots to work with, and then you're back to square one looking for that variable you’ve been chasing for six months. A damn zombie could do a better job.
Forgive me for being blunt, but my life is far more valuable than yours.
The ability to scout, shoot straight, and find things — frankly, that's not a particularly unique skill set. Besides, you guys have a lot of internal competition.
Me, on the other hand… being able to transmute the Zone’s mercury into the gold of earthly delights — that's an invaluable skill.
Those stalkers see the Zone every day, but they can't see the forest for the trees. It's a unique, living mechanism! It needs to be studied, not milked dry, pardon the metaphor.
All right, I get the mutants, they don’t know what they’re doing. But human beings... Why are they killing each other? The Zone has enough for everyone!
Stalkers deal with Emissions, mutants, and artifacts on a daily basis. They see it all, and we analyze what they've seen. In a way, you're the Zone's eyes, and we're its brain.
Skadovsk… I hid from my first Emission there. Now it's turned into a pigsty for bandits.
I’d forgotten Skadovsk even existed. Sultansk is doing so well, it seems like it’s always been called that.
I’m doing fine. Beard’s got some decent booze, the barge keeps me safe from the Emissions… what more do you need?
Skadovsk ain’t what it used to be. In fact, it's been Sultansk for a while. Beard ain’t what he used to be, if he’s putting up with this crap.
Beard’s taking too long to retaliate against the Sultan. He’s been making plans for a good seven years now, and he still won’t give us the go-ahead.
The damn Ward keeps snooping around anomalies. We have to dive into the mud twice as often now — it’s either them, or the Sultan’s thugs.
Some rookies thought it was a good idea to take a shot at Clear Sky. Two of 'em actually managed to get out, stunned but still sane. The third one lost it. We had a hard time pullin’ him out.
I can't get any sleep here. Something's been walking circles around me in the Swamps. I keep hearing it go "splat, splat, splat..." and it's calling me, calling me into the reeds...
That old stalker San lost it. Kept sayin’ there was some train still runnin’ underground. Then he took off for the Swamps down the old tracks. He never returned, and his fate is still unknown.
The Sultan’s patrols are useless. They can scare off Fleshes, shoot a half-dead dog, and that’s it. If they as much as hear a bloodsucker, they shit their pants and run home to papa.
The Wardens think they’ve got everybody under their thumb. Those they can’t control, they pay off. You know what? I’m glad they’re thinking that way. I love surprising people.
Scar’s keeping us in the dark. The other day he came back alone, with none of the guys he left with. “Where are the boys?”, I ask him. He shrugs, “It’s the Zone. You can’t protect everybody…”
I know the Zone takes its toll. But with Scar around, the toll’s gotten too high, if you ask me.
Even a rusty piece of metal you find in an old cave could be treasure to someone. You find something - clean it up, plug it in, see what it can do. If it doesn’t make your head explode, good.
If it does, well, not too bad either. Plenty of people in the Zone are better off without heads.
The best thing about the Zone is that it promises you nothing — no riches, no discoveries, not even that you’ll live to see another day. And that’s why you live every day to the fullest.
Sure, Ozersky is a weirdo, but he’s been around longer than lots of stalkers. I’d listen to him.
People keep saying that the Zone’s not the same anymore. Like they got any clue what it's supposed to be! Do any of them know the true nature of the Zone, its inner essence?
I wish we could get our hands on SIRCAA's research on psi-protection. I wonder how far they’ve come. How do they test it, anyway?
Scar is obsessed with these old labs. Digging around all the time like a blind dog.
Of course, sometimes the stuff he digs up is amazing. Turns out after all these years, you don’t know shit about the Zone!
The factions keep struggling for control over the Zone. But the Zone doesn’t give a damn about their claims to authority. It's up to the Zone to decide who gets to stay here.
What are they studying at SIRCAA, never even poking their nose out of their labs? How can you understand something if you've never seen it? Stupid bunch, the whole lot of them.
If you want to understand the Zone, you gotta cross it on foot, look under every rock. It’s not a walk in the park, that much is true. But it gives you a different perspective.
The Wardens are turning the Zone upside down looking for our base — a base that doesn’t even exist, ha! The Zone is no place for anything permanent. If you stand still, it’ll eat you up.
SIRCAA would love to pick the Zone apart and sort it into their folders. Ha! Looks like it's gonna be the other way around. Bit by bit.
Word is, the Ward’s got a separate list for “attrition due to anomalous Zone exposure.” And the list is pretty long.
Pretty handy if you ask me. If anybody asks us if we did that Warden in, we can just say, “Nah, it wasn’t us, man, it was the Zone.”
You can bet the Zone’s got some favorites among us. Take Scar, for example. He’s one weird dude, sure, but he’s been through some shit, and survived to tell the tale.
I hope he’ll take me along on his next outing. I’d like to see the Zone for real.
So many of us diggers have given up over the years… some went back to the Mainland, others went to Prypiat looking for artifacts…
I’d head over to Jupiter too, but it’s too risky for my taste. At least this place is kinda safe.
A buddy of mine said he saw a Burer in the neighborhood. It was a foggy day, and he thought it was a bandit stashing his loot.
So he tiptoes up to the freak, and suddenly a barrel comes flying straight at his face! The poor bastard ran off so fast, he dropped his gun and almost got himself drowned in the creek.
I try to avoid places with anything new. I check my detector after every Emission, but I can’t help but think… what if there’s something our detectors can’t detect?
I’ve been here in the Lesser Zone for a while now, and I’ve never seen a mess like this before. Duty and Freedom never went this far.
The Zone’s not the same anymore. Remember the factions we used to have around? The rookies would shit themselves at a mere mention of Monolith. But tell them now, and they’re, like, “Who is that?”
The Ward wants to bring the Zone back to the Mainland. Well, fuck that. The Zone can never be tamed, and neither can we!
Anomalies and mutants — at least those are things you can see. But radiation... if your Geiger counter is dead, you might as well not leave the bar. And you should drink too! They say it helps.
I get where the blind dogs and Fleshes come from... but Snorks and Bloodsuckers?! I can’t even begin to guess what those abominations are. The more I think about 'em, the scarier they get...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_Mutant: I'll sure get a ton of coupons for this!
Now that's one hell of a prize…
Wish I could capture this… in the name of science!
I bet I wouldn't find any of you here. Guess I lost!
Hope the slugs didn't ruin the hide…
So that's what biocoupons look like!
Shame I can't bring the whole thing in.
If you didn't kill it, you ain't chopping it up.
We don't like sassy folks like you here.
Oi! Did you hunt it down? No.
Are you mad? This is mine!
Aren't there enough mutants in the Zone?
Get your hands off my loot!
Not so fast. That's my catch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_NPC_Ch: Have you moved your stash?
Ask again louder so the whole Zone can hear you!
This jacket looks like it’s my size, but it kinda doesn’t fit…
You gotta lay off the bread and sausages.
There was that guy who got sucked into the whirligig, and…
Stop it. I’m still feeling sick from the last Emission.
How come there are so many rookies here?
’Cuz the Zone is expanding, that’s why. And more space means more people.
Still so many monsters creeping around!
Yeah. Not to mention the mutants!
Think you could tame a mutant?
I’ve heard stories of a stalker who walks around with a pseudodog, but I’ve never met him myself.
Have you heard of the chimera?
Yeah. A lot of people talk about it, but no one’s ever killed it. Or seen it, for that matter.
The cats here shriek all night long. Just like on the Mainland…
Yeah. But these cats prefer human flesh to catnip.
This one time I went to check on my stash, and there was a fresh anomaly on top of it!
Good. Guess it was more secure that way.
There’s an artifact I want real bad. It’s called the Night Star. I’d give all my coupons to get one!
Get your head outta your ass and look up at night. Sky’s full of them, all for free!
When I get back to the Mainland, I’m gonna get wasted for at least a week!
Isn't that what you do here?
Every Emission gives me a splitting headache .
You get used to it. I barely notice it anymore.
I wish I had an artifact to protect me from all the trouble here.
Yeah, I know one. It’s called a brain.
Any plans for tomorrow?
Just surviving...
I’m sick of canned meat. Can't shove it down my throat.
Spend a week on bread and water, - you'll be begging for it.
Do you hear that?
What?
The wind. It's whispering, “let’s tie one on...”
You're lookin’ pretty rough.
I haven’t slept in days. Not even vodka helps.
What day of the week is it, guys?
Who the hell cares? Not like it changes anything.
My PDA’s on the fritz again!
Just sell it to some rookie and get yourself a better one.
I found three artifacts in an anomaly today.
Oh yeah? Was one of those called “bull-fucking-shit?”
What a day, huh? No coupons, zero loot, and an empty stomach.
I’m so over today.
Should’ve listened to my mom and taken music classes. Damn, the show I could be putting on for my bros right now!
If I made some coupons, then today wasn’t wasted.
This is the first break I’ve taken today!
I’ll never get used to those Bloodsuckers. Been here for a year, and they still make me sick to my stomach!
I’m almost outta coupons…
Why get scared, though? Fate is fate. Whatever needs to happen, will happen.
How did I manage to break the detector? What a bummer…
We had some real artifacts back in the day! Now it’s a shitpile of junk…
I could sure go for a nice steam bath right about now…
I’ve been in the Zone for a long time now, and I’m still afraid of the Emissions.
Another day, another coupon in your pocket!
I just washed my pants yesterday, and now they're all dirty again.
Checked my stash, cleaned my gun, bought some shit… I'm calling it a day!
I gotta figure out how many coupons I need to buy a new rifle.
I had a dream about a Bloodsucker last night. It looked so real! I almost shot someone, half-awake.
They say there are tons of mutants underground. But there's a lot of loot down there too...
The Duga is a hell of a place. The howling wind, the tunes of clinging metal… beautiful.
I shoulda kept my first artifact as a memento.
I wish I had a decent guide to take me to Prypiat. Maybe then I’d risk the trip.
I’m one raid away from leaving the fucking Zone behind me for good.
What do you expect from a place called Garbage? It’s full of trash.
I can’t even remember what made me come to the Zone in the first place. And now I can’t see the point of going back to the Mainland.
I’m so craving some baked apples…
Man, this sucks. No loot, no profits… we’re gonna starve here!
Turning into a zombie is the worst. I’d rather die fast.
My knees are killing me. Guess it’s gonna rain. Either that, or there's an Emission coming.
Oh, my head hurts so bad! That’s it, no more vodka!
Yesterday was my birthday... I think. Or was it the day before? Whatever, at least I’m still alive.
Guess what, I had that dream again. The poppies.
It's been forever since I got back… still can't dream about anything other than poppies. And the smell, every morning, as if I'm lying in a field of those damn flowers, not in my sleeping bag.
And I'm so drowsy every day, blew all my coupons on energy drinks…
Sometimes I wonder if I'm still in that field…and I never woke up?
You know why Prypiat was closed down? No one cares about the anomalies, Deggy can handle just about anything. Folks go cuckoo down there.
They go out on a run, come back in an hour or so, looking…as if they'd been gone a whole year. Can't remember a thing. Other than wandering the empty streets for months.
You can't let them go back, they won't return the second time. But you can't force them to stay, either…
Remember that Stalker fellow who won’t shut up about how the Controller let him go? He went ballistic on the Shevchenko, trashed the place.
Tried to cut up another guy in his sleep. Boys rounded him up, he started crying like a baby, can't remember nothing, don't know nothing.
Rumor has it, they never let him go. Who knows what that Controller might have whispered in his ear.
How many of them never got back? Three? Five?
All-you-can-fucking-eat anomaly buffet, all the artifacts in the world for ya. And they still wandered off to that dump.
I've been there too, you know. Dropped a flashlight down there, it was on, - took forever before I lost sight of it.
And they keep going there…as if something is luring them in.
Beware of campfires at night. Especially the ones deep in the Zone. Especially if there's no one around but you.
Folks would find corpses, cold already. And weirdly, the safety on their guns would be on, and their faces were just… anywho, don't sit at them campfires.
Better to stay in the dark.
Have you seen the Prypiat Ferris Wheel?
This one guy, had a scar across half of his head, told me that the number of spins you took on it is the number of years the Zone will grant you.
So, this other guy thought he'd try it out. Took off to Prypiat, slipped past Degtyarev who knows how! Climbed onto the wheel… and that's when an Emission wiped him right out.
Still rolling.
Believe it or not, here's what went down...
I can't wrap my head around it…
Looks like everyone's here. So as the story goes...
Alright, alright, I said I'd tell you. Here it goes.
I don't even know where to begin. Well...
Maybe you will understand me...
So, here's what crossed my mind the other day…
Okay, guys, cut the crap now. This is serious…
Well, so it's now or never…Ptooey
I think I heard that one before...
Gave me the creepy-crawlies.
Folks, anyone got a smoke?
Yeah, better stay on the Zone's good list. Anything can happen here.
Phew! Like I didn't have enough shit on my bloody mind!
Better knock on wood after listening to all that. So you don't jinx it.
Right-y, and here I was, thinking nothing could scare me anymore.
Wish I hadn't just listened to all that…
Yeah, even I got the heebie-jeebies…
A Bloodsucker comes to an old pal, a military commissar. “Don’t send away all the folks with diabetes who wanna enlist, okay? Save a couple for dessert.”
There’s a legend among the Freedom old-timers: if you cut off a Duty guy's head, he’ll keep on marching and scrubbing toilets for another half hour.
An old-timer tells a new stalker, “Get ready, rookie. We’re hitting the circus tonight.” The newbie readies himself, grabbing lots of pouches for artifacts. As night falls, they set out.
The rookie realizes they’re going the wrong way. “Is this the right way?” he asks. “The Circus anomaly is the other way.” “What anomaly?” the old-timer grins, “we’re going to the Cement Factory!”

Two stalkers are at a bar. “Tomorrow,” one exclaims, “I'm gonna quit drinking.” “What for?” says the other. The first stalker grins, “I wanna surprise the Bloodsucker I’ve been feeding all this time.”
Two stalkers are out fishing. Suddenly, a Burer comes over. They get all jumpy, when the Burer goes, “Take it easy, I’m not looking for trouble. I’m just here to fish. Caught anything yet?”
Surprised, the stalkers put their guns away. One says, “I’ve got a perch, and my friend here, he caught a trout. You?” “Ah,” the Burer smiles, “I just caught two rookie losers.”
An old stalker asks: “Ever wonder why they built the Lesser Duga?” “Why?”, a young lad leans in, intrigued. The old man chuckles, “They figured the Zone would make it grow up.”
Noah decides to gather two of every kind of animal. Ten Wardens walk up to him, and he says, “I only need two of you brutes.”
Two stalkers are riding the Ferris Wheel in Prypiat, munching on cotton candy and sipping beer. One says, “Just look at this lush scenery. And you didn't think we could handle that Controller!”
Myklukha discovers a stash and cracks it open, only to find a million dollars inside. Frustrated, he mutters, “What the hell is this? Where's the coupons?”

A veteran stalker quizzes a rookie: “A Bloodsucker, a Poltergeist, and a Burer are sitting at the table. How many feet are on the ground?” The rookie starts musing, “well, the Poltergeist’s got none…”
“The Bloodsucker’s feet are invisible, and the Burer can’t reach the floor. Zero!” The veteran grins. “Nope. The answer is two, and both of them yours! You should’ve been shooting, not counting!”
A stalker comes across a Controller and starts shooting. The Controller shouts, “Don’t kill me! I’m no ordinary Controller! I can grant you a wish!”
The stalker pauses, then says, “Okay. I wish IPSF would stop demanding bribes from stalkers entering the Zone.” The Controller goes, “Are you nuts, man? I said Controller, not a damn genie!”
A stalker says to a trader, “I’ll take five cans of rotten meat, a loaf of moldy bread, and some cheese that's been gnawed by mice. Put it all in a backpack that'll fall apart an hour later.”
The trader is insulted. “I don’t sell stuff like that at my establishment!” The stalker replies, “That's funny, you did last week!”
So a new scientist starts working at SIRCAA. He gets assigned to a lab to study mutants and whatnot. A week later, he goes to his boss to complain.
“That’s it, I can’t work like this! Those mutants gobble up whatever they see, destroy whatever they touch, and shit wherever they feel like! And your office is right above us! How can you stand it?”
“Oh”, his boss says, “You must have gotten lost, son. The mutant lab is in the next building. The Ward’s barracks are below my office.”
So a rookie stalker asks a veteran, “Is the Ward really that hard to get into?” “No way,” says the vet, "Just get a clear shot..."
