A guide is lecturing some rookie stalkers. “A good stalker is hard to find. You don’t just stumble across one every day. And if you do stumble across one, that means he wasn't any good.”
A stalker wakes up with a bad hangover. He opens one eye and sees something scary. stalker goes, "Shit, gotta be some kinda Zone waste". "That's mean, man, you're the one wasted", says the psi-dog.
A young stalker who had a burr came into the Zone thinking he was ready to r-r-ro-o-o-ll! Wait until you see his face when he gets to deal with a BlodsuckeRRR, a BureRRR, and a ControllerRR!
A Bloodsucker walks into a bar and says, “I’ll take a bloody Mary.” The bartender says, “I don’t have any Maries. Bloody Harry okay?”
A veteran stalker lecturing a rookie. “Now, remember, always partner up with guys who can't shoot or run. They'll keep the mutants busy, and there's no chance they'll shoot you in the back.”
Wardens stop a stalker. “Where are you going?” “Prypіat,” he says. The Wardens laugh. "The grass is always greener, right?" The stalker says, "If the Ward ain't there, that's as green as it gets."
A stalker is driving through the Zone, gets pulled over by a patrol. “Do you have any weapons?” the officers ask. “Of course I do,” he says. “There’s a Glock 19 on my hip,
A Colt 45 in the glove box, and a sniper rifle and an RPG in the trunk.” “Who are you so afraid of?” the Wardens ask, surprised. And the stalker says, “Pretty much nobody.”
Scientists wanted to find out which of the Zone’s creatures roars the loudest. Turns out, the top three are fleshes, burers, and Sidorovich when he hears something good about the Gaffer.
It's the Zone's first year. A young scientist is making a list of known mutants. “What should I name the one that sucks blood?” he asks his colleague. “Just write down whatever the stalkers call it.”
“How do I choose? The ordinary ones call it a 'bloodsucker,’ the veterans call it ‘a sucker,’ and the rookies just call it ‘aaargh!’”
A vet stalker takes a walk with rookies, “Never rely on a guess in the Zone. You have to know for sure.” Then he sees they’ve just walked into a Bloodsucker nest. “Now I know for sure we’re screwed.”
One stalker asks another, “How’s Alex doing? I haven’t seen him in ages.” “Oh, you know, he's been all around the place... I mean, he got into a Whirligig.”
I was wondering why that mutant kept getting bigger and bigger, and then it hit me.
Why does Degtyarev regret banning vodka? 'Cuz now he can't call all the shots anymore!
A stalker boasts by the fire, “One little rainstorm, and now I don’t have to waste money on razors and haircuts anymore! My mom always said being outside was good for ya!”
“You should wash your mouth out with some of the local water,” another one tells him. “You’ll save a fortune on dentist bills too.”
Wardens walk out of the Chemical Plant and see a stalker dying in an anomaly by the gate. “Finish me off, guys!” he begs. The merciful Wardens shoot him and throw grenades generously.
As they walk away, the stalker sighs, “Thanks for trying, guys.”
A Bloodsucker is lecturing his little son: “Never trust Poltergeists, kiddo. They're always pulling your leg.”
A veteran stalker asks some rookies, “When does a mutant have four legs and one arm?” Kids sit there, all confused. “When he's eating some fresh-caught rookies!” the veteran says.
So a Warden goes to a shrink and says, “Doctor, I’ve been feeling like I’m an idiot, a cheapskate, and a jerk. Do I have a split personality or something?” “No, young man. You've had an epiphany.”
Stalkers are swapping stories at a bar. “I took down a Bloodsucker with just a handgun!”, one goes. “I fought one bare-handed,” another one brags. “I tackled a Bloodsucker naked!” says the third.
Okay, okay! You win. Put some pants on already, will you?
So, a stalker is crawling down a pipe and sees a Bloodsucker dead ahead. He turns back and sees another Bloodsucker behind him. “Well,” the stalker says, “looks like I’m lucky Pierre.”
Two stalkers are standing by a stash. “Why didn’t those blind dogs eat our sausage?” asks the first. “They’re blind,” the other replies, “not stupid.”
What does a stalker say after seeing something that blows his mind? “Monolith be praised!”
A loner comes up to a Warden: “I want to join Ward.” “Piss off,” the Warden says. “Please let me in!”. “Are you stupid?” the Warden scoffs. The loner's like, “Is that an enlistment requirement?”
A Freedom old spice gets caught in an anomaly. He’s about to snuff it. The kids try to bring him some joy in his final moments, running around with whiskey and cigars.
“I don’t need a thing, folks,” he says. “Just sell off my stuff and give my coupons to Duty, tell ’em to sign me up.” Everyone’s like, “What the fuck?!”
“When I kick the bucket,” he explains, “there’ll be one less Duty prick in the Zone!”
An old-timer asks a rookie, “Which would you rather lose, your armor or your loot?” The rookie ain’t half stupid, so he says, “I’ll just keep out of the Slag Heap, thanks.”
Two Bloodsuckers are feasting on the bodies of Duty members. “What did they say when they got here again?” one asks. The other replies, “Remember, our mission is to rid the Zone of mutants.”
You guys are hysterical. Okay, I got one too.
Alrighty, a joke won’t tell itself…
Hey, why the long faces? Let me cheer you guys up.
(attracts attention)
That's so funny, I forgot to laugh!
Well, thanks for trying.
That’s hilarious!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_NPC_Co: I need cover! Go at 'em hard!
Keep ‘em pinned! I’ll get to the cover!
Keep them in your sights! I’ll move to cover!
Keep them in your sights. I’m moving in from the rear!
Hold him! Coming in from the rear!
Keep them suppressed while I outflank them!
Cover me while I flank him!
Cover me while I outflank them.
Flanking the enemy! I've got you now!
Here’s a little present for you!
We got a man down, guys!
Give me fire support, I need to move!
Cover me, man! I’m going that way!
Won't go easy on you next time!
We’re out of our league here!
Well, that’s it. Looks like we're clear.
Come out while you still can!
Come out now, I'm warning ya!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_NPC_Em: Phew, we can come out now.
Here we go! We gotta find cover.
Get outta here! There's an Emission coming!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_NPC_In: Learn to watch where you're going before you head out into the Zone!
Sure, I can spare a minute for you.
What the fuck are you doing here?
I sure hope you're here to talk business.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_NPC_Pe: Are you nuts? This ain't a graveyard.
Now show us what you’ve got…
You don't need it anymore, sorry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_freestalkers_0_TradeT: No refunds. I’m warning you in advance.
Well, here we are... do you need anything?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_BusyTopic_: This is not the time for idle chatter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_HelloTopic: What is it that you seek?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_InfoTopic_: Monolith, steel my flesh so that the unbelievers may perish. Guide my hand. May thy radiance shield me against their bullets. Thou art my path and my world. Lead me into battle. For the Monolith!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_NPC_Chatte: Whatever the Monolith blesses us with.
Where do you think our enemies go when they die?
Nowhere. Eternal oblivion is all that awaits them.
How many enemies of the Monolith have you destroyed?
The only ones I remember are the brothers who are no more.
The Monolith will send you new clothes soon enough.
Worry not. Prayer shall give me the strength.
Guide me along the true path, o Monolith.
May the word of the faithful multiply the power of the Monolith. And may the word of the unbelievers be turned against their own kind.
Keep my faith strong, o Monolith. Do not let me stray from your path.
May it not be my will, but yours alone. So be it, Monolith!
Darkness shall take the unbelievers. The gleaming of the Monolith shall light the way for the faithful and show the truth to those who abide in doubt.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_NPC_Combat: I’m moving to cover, brothers. Keep the enemy pinned!
I’m moving to cover! Brothers, support me with your fire!
Brothers, help me approach from the rear!
Brothers, I’ll take them from the other side!
Cover me, I’m going around the foe!
By the Monolith, he is dead!
I have struck an enemy of the Monolith!
Rejoice, brothers! The enemy is wounded!
Kill them! For the glory of the Monolith!
Death to the enemies of the Monolith!
Cover me, brothers! I’ll attack their flank!
I’m breaking through! Cover me, brothers!
A son of the Monolith is no more!
A brother has ascended to the Monolith!
He is one with the Monolith now!
I've been hit by a brother!
Take this grenade, enemy of the Monolith!
Cover me, brothers! I’m on the move!
Bless me with safe passage, Monolith!
Brothers, I see the enemy of the Monolith!
Rejoice, brothers, for the enemy has fled!
No one can hide from us!
I can sense you, enemy of the Monolith!
Rest easy, brothers. The enemy has fled!
The enemy feared the power of the Monolith.
Brothers, fall back! We will finish this later.
The Monolith commands us to retreat.
Death to the enemy of the Monolith!
All is well. Monolith be praised.
The Monolith has scared him away.
Brothers, he must not get away!
I know you’re close. And I will find you!
I hear the enemy. He cannot hide from me!
You’ll find no shelter from the Monolith!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_NPC_Emissi: The Emission won’t bother us any longer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_NPC_Intera: What is it that you seek?
Put down your weapon. You won’t need it.
You should not have come here.
Beware the wrath of the Monolith.
Our leader will hear you... if he wills it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_monolith_0_NPC_Peacef: The Monolith does not accept this offering.
I have no need of this body.
What do we stand to gain here?
Our brother is one with the Monolith. He requires nothing else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_General_zombie_0_NPC_Contextu: I see… I see you… radiant… so radiant…
I can’t see… who’s there… can’t see… it’s so dark…
Wrong… it’s all wrong… let me go… Mommy…
Of course I’ll be back… Just one more time, and then I’ll be back… I promise…
Almost there… just a little bit more, and then I’m out…
It hurts… it hurts so bad… make it stop… please…
When I get back, everything's gonna be all right… We’d get our daughter the medicine she needs… It’s gonna be all right…
It’s so cold… why is it always so cold…
Don’t worry… we’ll make it… we’ve always made it…
I can hear them… so many of them… make them stop…
That’s it… I found you… found you…
You promised… you promised me… all alone… why…
Wow… you’re so… Shining… and I imagined…
Good… it’s all good now… so quiet…
So many of them… so many… where are you all coming from…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_6172: Hey man, got anything newer than this? You promised, remember?
So did you, and how’d that turn out? The Ward patrol waited a good while at that stash of yours, and left empty-handed. They were really pissed. Honestly, so am I.
What’s that got to do with me, man? The intel came from Myklukha. I was just the messenger!
Well, that makes Myklukha my client, not you. So it’s only fair.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_6205: Hey, Shtybor! What day of the week is it?
Yesterday was Saturday, right? Saturday, Thursday, Monday, Friday, Wednesday… what happened to the other two days? I must have lost track... again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_6206: Fuck… what did they expose you guys to at Icarus?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_6212: Kramar and Beloholovets. We had to leave them behind. And now Jura, too. Burakhovsky couldn’t save him. He told me when he went out for a smoke after surgery.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_FF_6: Hey, Ed. Gimme Dvoryankov’s standard issue shot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_6213: What about the helicopters, doc? My friend's there…
Everyone had friends there, private. I told you before: the major will announce the final list later.
Keep waiting. I hope your friend is alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_5_GCA_5_6221: What about the Monolith snipers, Sarge? Last time they trashed us like a blind dog tearing up a dead boar.
They did, and they’ll do it again. Their tactics are time-tested and effective.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_GCA_5_GCA_5_6222: Here’s an idea I’ve used before — I call it the “frantic minute” tactic.
When you run into a sniper, have your entire squad fire at him. While the bastard is pinned down, one of you sneaks up on him and takes him down. Anything goes, but a grenade works best.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_10_Pro: A stalker is not your friend, but being polite and attentive is the best strategy when communicating with them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_11_Pro: To all those who have completed the advanced tactical medicine courses: Dr. Burakhovsky requires your assistance. We need everyone to pitch in right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_12_Pro: The medical block’s blood donation center is now operating 24/7. We currently have a critical need for blood types AB+ and A-.
Any additional needs will be communicated later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_13_Pro: All Duga assault mission personnel must attend an emergency briefing by Sergeant Nedzelya as soon as possible. No exceptions!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_14_Pro: To all officers and NCOs, please conduct an additional survey at your earliest convenience.
Any additional skills or experience your personnel may have will help us restaff to the appropriate level.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_15_Pro: Remember that a sleep-deprived soldier can a pose danger to everyone. Thus, the mandatory sleep requirements will remain unchanged.
However, in light of the current events, we are allowing schedules that include brief breaks. Please consider when scheduling duty and patrols.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_1_Prop: Ward soldiers, remember that it is extremely dangerous to explore anomalies on your own.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_2_Prop: Your life and well-being are our top priority. Therefore, any health issue requires a visit to a medical professional.
Remember, neglecting any symptoms while in the Zone may result in the early termination of your contract.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_3_Prop: Personnel whose contracts are about to end should contact Major Dvoryankov as soon as possible. It is your responsibility to ensure timely contract renewal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_4_Prop: Any requests for new uniforms, equipment, and weapons can be submitted to the technician. They will be processed and fulfilled within three days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_5_Prop: SIRCAA shifts are a privilege that demand a high level of skill and dedication.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_6_Prop: Reports of Anomalous psi-activity should be promptly documented and submitted to Dr. Kryvenko. You can find the form and a sample report in the medical block.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_7_Prop: This Saturday is local fauna defense tactics practice. The instructor for this exercise is Sergeant Nedzelya.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_8_Prop: Attention! The recommendations regarding sleep requirements have been updated. The standard daily sleep duration is now six hours.
This rule is mandatory for everyone. In the Zone, fatigue can lead to irreversible damage.
A reminder to those participating in deeper Zone raids: new sleeping bags can be obtained from Sergeant Ivaylov.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_PropTopic_9_Prop: All artifacts that come into your possession for any reason must be promptly delivered to an on-duty SIRCAA employee. There are no exceptions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_aleks_fraj_0_Inf: I scored some sweet gear here, man. This spot is one of the few places where you can grab Warden stuff. And the prices are pretty groovy.
Sure, it’s not exactly straight from the factory, but there’s a certain peace of mind that comes with a Warden piece, you dig?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_aleks_fraj_SCAct: I've smelled some rank shit in my day, but the Chemical Plant… the Ward may have cleaned it up, but you can still catch a whiff of that stench from time to time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_closing_HubClosi: Attention! The Ward base is under attack. Barbican Protocol is now in effect. Leaving the base is prohibited until further notice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_BusyTopic_B: I’ve got enough on my plate. This can wait.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_HelloTopic_: Make it quick. Talking ain’t gonna fill your stomach.
You need to grab a bite? Or do you just wanna chat?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_InfoTopic_1: I’ve always wondered what it is about you stalkers that makes you so fond of vodka and canned food. Got no taste at all?
You lot should publish a cookbook. Something like “To Serve the Zone.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_InfoTopic_2: The guys who came back from Icarus are acting real weird. Just yesterday, one of them took a bowl of soup and started stirring it with a spoon, real quick-like.
I ask him, “What are you doing?” And he says, “It’s so deep and quiet down there.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_InfoTopic_3: After the Duga, Dvoryankov let us have a daily vodka shot for stress relief — only after hours, of course. It helps some of us to have a drink and quietly remember the fallen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_InfoTopic_4: When you’re in good spirits, everything just seems better. Your plate feels bigger, your bread softer, and your glass frostier. I wish we had more occasions to celebrate!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_Meet_2_Meet: I’m swamped with work these days, Skif. I barely have time to eat.
Luckily, Dvoryankov sent me some extra hands in the kitchen. They're all recovering from Icarus and SIRCAA and aren’t quite fit for regular duty yet.
At least they’ll get some decent food.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_Meet_3_Meet: We’re all doctors now, Skif... in a way.
I've been doctoring up some broth, for example.
With the doctor’s care and my nutritious grub, I’m sure we’ll have the boys back on their feet before you know it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_Meet_4_Meet: I’ve saved something from the previous shipments. For a rainy day, you know? To sugar-coat it, literally.
Turns out we've got a reason to celebrate, and something to celebrate with!
As soon as brass gives me the green light, I’m throwing a five-star party!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_Meet_Meet_6: The Zone has a challenge for everyone, even someone like me, here in the kitchen.
I mean, before I joined the Ward, I used to work with caviar and lobsters. It’s almost impossible to mess that stuff up.
Now all I've got is army rations. Turning this stuff into something that resembles a decent meal is harder than turning water into wine.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_ed_2_TradeTopic_: This ain't no restaurant. Take it or leave it.
I saved something special for you.
Take a look around and pick what you want. Nothing fancy, but I got everything you need in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_leva_fan_0_BusyT: Man, that’s some real bad timing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_leva_fan_0_Hello: Now that you’re here, let’s get down to business.
I’m glad to see you, brother.
Man, we two loners are bound to find some common ground.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_leva_fan_0_InfoT: Don’t fool yourself, man. The Zone won’t ever let you go. There’s always one more anomaly, one more artifact... “one last job, and then I’m going home.”
Did you hear that Monolith attacked the Western checkpoint? Those crafty bastards tried to pose as stalkers, but you ain't fooling the Ward like that. Took them all out.
Looks like it’s a good time to be in this business. Ammo and guns are selling like freakin' hotcakes.
But now that those Monolith fanatics managed to get Korshunov himself… I kinda feel like if they make a move on us, the Ward will just nod and let 'em.
I’m going through my PDA contacts, getting in touch with folks after the Monolith thing. It's sad some of them ain't ever texting back.
But it’ll get better, I guess. It might cost me, but during my time in Rostok, I learned to set a little something aside for a rainy day.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_leva_fan_0_Meet_: Are you immortal or something, Skif? The Ward took quite a hit at SIRCAA, and here you are, not a single scratch.
By the way, got anything interesting from there? My gut's telling me that even bricks from SIRCAA could be worth a small fortune now.
Nah, don’t gimme that look. I know you’re an honest stalker, man. Or you wouldn’t be here.
Looks like Noon called in a substitution, bud. Monolith is on the field now.
One hell of a game. So who should I bet on? It’s a tough call… nah, just kidding. Ward's always the champion.
They’ll figure out the other team's new tactics and win the second half. Won't be the first time.
If I were you, I’d double up on my stock. I’m telling you this because I genuinely care, not because I'm lookin' for extra dough.
The Duga hit the Ward hard, and I doubt it went unnoticed. You catch my drift?
Plenty of folks will be looking to get a piece of the action. You don’t want to get caught with your pants down, do you?
That Monolith fight was pretty intense, eh? But in the end, that roller coaster was a huge win for me.
The Ward’s guns were the real MVPs on the field.
My customers are coming back. Even the old junk sells, whatever's got the “Property of the Ward” label.
Surprised to find a loner here? Well, here in the Zone, we’re all living in the shadow of the Ward.
And I’d rather be on the winning team, even if it means riding the pine.
I like it here, man. You get to secure your future, and I get to hear some cool stalker stories. It’s a win-win.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_leva_fan_0_Trade: The stuff I’ve got, you won’t find anywhere else.
It's worth the coupons. You never know what might come in handy in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_major_dvorenkov_: Not right now.
So that’s all? About-face!
Anytime.
You can go.
Get to the point.
What’s on your mind? Speak up.
I’m listening, stalker.
What can you tell me about the Chemical Plant?
First: security is a priority here, and we intend to keep it that way. Is that clear? If not, a cell might be more suitable for you.
Second: the Ward follows established protocols. If you have a specific request, direct it to the appropriate specialist. Don’t bother others needlessly.
And third, on a personal note: the colonel trusts you. Don’t let him down. Or me.
All the occult nonsense in the Zone comes down to stupidity. There was this one outpost, a real nasty place. Our patrols would hear strange voices, like children crying. It was driving them crazy.
But then an acoustician from SIRCAA took some measurements and pinpointed the cause. Turns out it was an old air vent acting like an acoustic funnel. So much for ghosts.
Monolith is only half the problem. We can handle them. What bothers me more is how the others might see our failure at SIRCAA. I’m not keen on having the entire Zone turn against us.
To put it bluntly, the reinforcements from Icarus are no soldiers. I’d dismiss the lot of them, but my orders are to get everyone armed. If you can tell the barrel from the butt, you’re good to go.
The worst part is that we don't have any reserves left. We’ve got some men back on the Mainland, but how could they become real Wardens without any special training?
Drop them in the Zone, and the first blind dog will chew them up, let alone those Monolith bastards.
I’ve heard that Duty and Freedom are at it again, despite the Treaty. Now that we’ve dealt with Monolith, it’s time to sort out that mess too.
Heard about Icarus yet? Damn, we lost a lot of good men there.
Senkevych is an idiot. An officer’s supposed to use his wits, not just wave his gun around.
It’s like he’s gone brain dead out there in the Swamps.
It was high time we evacuated Icarus. If Monolith had decided to attack the camp, we wouldn’t have stood a chance.
It’s better to abandon the camp for a while than to lose everyone who served there.
I have to inform Senkevych’s family. And Tachenko’s. It used to be the colonel’s job, but now it's mine.
I don't even want to open the filing cabinet. Half of the files have the same stamp: killed in action.
I just don’t know what I’m supposed to tell their families…
Monolith finally got some real payback!
You did real good in there, Skif. Took down that son of a bitch Faust! Our boys have been avenged.
I hope we’ve seen the last of those scumbags. May whatever’s left of them rot away in Prypiat.
Okay, Skif, let me be clear. I don’t have time to deal with you. Right now, my main concern is the well-being of my men.
So I’m only going to tell you this once: here, discipline comes first.
We appreciate initiative, but it’s best carried out in accordance with orders and without resorting to typical stalker antics. Any questions?
All right, the Emission is over! Get back to your posts as per your duty schedules.
Attention, everyone! There’s an Emission outside. Extreme caution strongly advised. Remain in cover. I’ll inform you when it’s safe to come out.
An Emission is approaching, soldiers. Seek shelter immediately. I repeat, we have an incoming Emission. Seek shelter.
Am I on the Ward’s naughty list, Major? Is there anything I can do to make amends?
I warned you that going against the Ward would have consequences, Skif.
So my men will continue to keep you in their sights.
This is a direct order from the colonel. And it’s up to him to decide when and how to change it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_ByeTop: May enemies and mutants never cross your path.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_HelloT: I wish you’d forget the way to this place.
Say the word, and we're off.
Where do you want to go, stalker?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_InfoTo: “This place isn’t what it used to be,” “The Zone’s not the same anymore…" you hear that a lot, don’t you? As for me, I like it better this way. The Ward’s finally cleaned things up around here.
The routes through the Zone have gotten longer. Another mile here, five extra miles there. You end up packing more ammo than food. And the ruck ain't gonna carry itself.
The Monolithians are no mutants. A single shot ain’t gonna scare them off — it'll just make them angry.
The worst part is that sometimes you can’t tell friend from foe anymore. The other day, I ran into some Wardens. Looked like a regular patrol, familiar faces.
I waved at them, like always, and they opened fire. I barely managed to dive into the bushes. Turns out they were among the guys who got their brains fried at the Duga.
I’ve heard enough news. We’ve already got plenty of yesterday's shit to deal with.
Nothing I want to know about, thanks very much. We've got more important things to deal with... like giving our dead a proper burial.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_Meet_2: Everybody asks me where the Klondike of artifacts is. They all want a glimpse of it.
I used to take them to SIRCAA for an answer. “Look,” I’d say, “there it is, the real deal. Everything else is just tall tales.”
It's too bad the Institute itself is now just another tall tale.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_Meet_3: I’ve always had an ironclad rule: if I cross paths with a Noontider on the road, next time, I choose a different route.
You could never tell what they were up to. No wonder, if their brains are cooked and sprinkled with shit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_Meet_4: Duty just reached out to me, you know, for old times’ sake. Rumors in the Zone travel faster than any guide.
They asked how the colonel's doing, but I had a feeling they had something else in mind. Like a Treaty with Freedom.
I assured them that Korshunov’s doing just fine. Just a scratch. Old grudges are the last thing we need right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_Meet_5: Don't get me wrong, it’s good that Monolith went back to Prypiat with their tails between their legs.
But that means Prypiat is now off limits to everyone.
I was guiding a group there the other day, and they started shooting right at us. Friend, foe, mutant, all the same to them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_Meet_M: I joined the Ward with a big dream. It’s hard to believe, but I wanted a world where people wouldn’t need folks like me anymore.
Imagine: strolling from the Perimeter all the way to Prypiat, and there’s not a single blind dog or a damn Bloodsucker anywhere. Doesn't that sound amazing?
Duty couldn't make it happen, but I think the Ward can. So, where are you off to?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_muhomor_0_Travel: If you weren’t paying, I wouldn’t even bother to move.
Shortcuts don’t come cheap, but good company is worth a discount.
I’ll take you wherever you want, but you gotta pay up front.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_nikolaj_burahovk: Hold on. I'm too busy.
That’s about it. The rest can heal on its own.
Keep some bandages and a medkit close. Might come in handy.
Just try not to get shot.
We’re not quite ready to bury you, although the idea has crossed my mind.
You’re fit enough to be an astronaut.
I’ll have you up and about in no time — better than ever.
Whatever it is, I'll take care of it.
Interesting. Guys like you don’t normally last this long.
Nothing too serious, I hope?
How can I help you?
I got a bit too comfortable with SIRCAA nearby. They could work wonders, even with the worst injuries.
Now I’m back to good old combat medicine. I suppose it’s time to see if I’m still a doctor, or if retirement is calling.
The timing of those SIRCAA experiments couldn’t have been worse.
With the Monolith causing trouble, our need for sutures and bandages has already tripled. And we’ve got no one to look after the Icarus survivors.
I hate triage, ever since med school. Black, red, yellow, green… we were dealing with mannequins, but now I have to do it with living, breathing people.
You look at them, try to console them... but you've already marked them for dead, in your head. You have to. They’re not going to make it anyway, while others still have a chance, at least.
I finally found some time to organize my notes. After all, I’m not the worst doctor in the Zone. My records just might come in handy.
Trust me, if someone had handed me a manual like this when I first got to the Zone a few years ago, I would have avoided a lot of bumps and bruises.
Batalov did his best at Icarus, but unfortunately…
Nightmares, anxiety, memory problems… that’s a lot to deal with.
It’s a good thing those damn Swamps didn’t hit you nearly as hard.
If I sit down, I’ll doze off, and those energy drinks make my hands all jittery. What kind of surgeon operates with his hands shaking?
So many bad injuries, Skif! I wish we could send them all back to the Mainland.
But it’s just too dangerous. They’re not stable enough. I don’t want to add their names to my own personal graveyard.
I hope they’ll consider restoring SIRCAA now. When it comes to Zone healthcare, the Institute is truly irreplaceable.
You know how it goes... the Zone’s got quite the imagination — always manages to come up with new ways to make you suffer.
If there's anything that should be available to everyone in the Zone, it's healthcare.
The colonel might think stalkers self-heal, but physiology tends to disagree.
Besides, it’s pretty fascinating to treat folks like you. You tend to venture into places the Ward would never set foot in.
Be glad I’m not offering you a laxative.
Our cutting-edge healthcare is at your disposal.
Anything the Ward has, you can have too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_opening_HubOpeni: Attention! Barbican Protocol lifted. Security has been restored in the Chemical Plant area.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_serz_nedzela_0_I: I’ve heard Monolith has this preacher guy, their commander-in-chief, kinda like our Korshunov. It's too bad he won’t get to see us kick their butts... 'cuz he's blind, right?
My platoon just got reinforcements, but what’s the use? I'll have to train them all from scratch. My guys know the drill, but those Icarus boys? They can’t tell right from left.
SIRCAA was supposed to be working for us, but it’s Monolith that ends up with a gun that can blow right through a chopper. Gets under my skin. No way those eggheads didn’t know about it.
They could’ve come up with something to counter it, but no, why bother? It’s more fun to watch Wardens in tissue-grade armor.
What news could a sergeant have? When it’s quiet, I share my combat experience — teaching small-unit tactics to the guys who haven't faced Monolith .
I want their muscle memory to kick in. Finally doing what I enjoy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_serz_nedzela_SCA: It’s like Monolith is our problem and no one else’s. Where are IPSF and Duty? Playing it safe? I’d love to get them all together and do some recon. Might make a little difference, at least.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_serz_nedzhela_SC: Those Icarus guys are real dumb. Looks like sergeant Pickman forgot all about his duties. They barely remember how to hold a gun anymore.
Some of the bullets the Doc pulled out of our guys were our own. I saw it myself. I don't get how that's possible.
They started the party early. Monolith might have retreated, but they’re still a threat. The local troublemakers aren't sitting around either.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_serzant_ivajlov_: You’ll have to wait. I’ve got more important stuff.
Get lost, you're wasting my time.
Take care of yourself. The rest, we can fix.
Take good care of your gun, and it’ll work like a charm.
You can't stay outta trouble, and then I have to put everything back together again.
You've been through some tough times, huh? That’s okay, we can fix everything.
What have you got? Come on, be quick about it.
The Monolith has certainly kept us busy. Guns are wearing down faster, and so are the soldiers. We’re getting tons of replacement requests. Fortunately, our supply chain seems to be holding up.
I checked out some of the vests they had to cut off the wounded at the hospital. Every single one was shot right through, and the entry and exit holes were almost identical, perfectly round.
What kinda bullet speed penetrates both Kevlar and human flesh like that? What guns were their snipers using?
Heh... I thought the entire network would go down with the Duga! But no, the connection's smooth, and the PDA messaging speed's cool. I guess they never gave us the whole story.
I always knew those Noontiders were trouble. You can always tell what a stalker's up to, but those bastards…
We should’ve put them on the target list as dangerous mutants right from the get-go.
But the colonel won’t be so diplomatic now. After what they did at SIRCAA, it’s gonna be an eye for an eye.
I got everyone kitted out personally before the Duga. Made sure each soldier got exactly what he’s best with. But it still ended up…like this.
No way my guns could've just failed our snipers. But somehow, they say the Monolith preacher didn’t even get a scratch. I just don’t get it.
They brought some nice trophies from the Duga. Fascinating things. I'd like to see what that stuff's made of.
I could maybe whip up an upgrade for the choppers. A Gauss is no Stinger, 'course, but there might be a way around it.
I’ll figure out how to make that Monolith crap useful.
You stalkers are all about showing off. You think the whole Zone needs to see how geared up you are - yeah, real soldier.
You’ve got it all wrong. You're the weapon, not your gun.
I can take care of your gun, sure. But remember, a good gun isn't enough. You gotta know how to use it.
Turning good stuff into scrap... is that all you can do?
The usual? Good as new, even better?
The stuff I can do, you could only dream of, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_soldat_kunovskij: I don’t give a damn about the news. Let my superiors worry about it. All I need from them is to identify the enemy — they can sort the rest out later.

Korshunov’s office has been humming non-stop — officers coming and going… Looks like brass wants to come up with a master plan. Like those nutcases from Wild Island know the first thing about warfare!
All I hear on smoke breaks is Korshunov goss. “Shipped off to the Mainland”, “here, in cold storage…” I’m so fed up with this crap, and the major’s not saying a freaking word.
I’m waiting for my new stripes. After we took over the Duga, Dvoryankov submitted a whole list of promotion recommendations, and I’m on it. That’s what my friends at HQ say, anyway.
Okay, let’s get back to it.
I met my share of idiots with empty stares in my counter-terrorism unit back on the Mainland. I thought I’d get a break from them in the Zone. Nope – we’ve got plenty here too.
We got used to being comfortable, and now it feels like a submarine. Cramped, smells like dirty socks, and there’s always a line for the latrine. Then again, an angry soldier fights harder…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_soldat_kunovsky_: I need to get that Dvoryankov’s vodka shot at Ed's. Might help me get some sleep.
This victory sure came at a high price. Too many of our men killed, too many medals postmortem.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_soldat_stibor_0_: You want to hear the news? I’ve got a long list, all starring scumbags. And after SIRCAA, that list is only getting longer.
I was supposed to go to Icarus too. Had my duffle bag all packed and ready to go. But Dvoryankov decided to keep me here last minute. I guess I owe him a drink, seeing how things turned out.
I won’t be renewing my contract. The money's good, but I don’t want to be shipped home in pieces. Just a couple more months, and I’ll be back to civilian life on the Mainland. If I make it that far.
I got grazed at the Duga this time. Just a scratch. I got a little scared, sure, but I knew exactly what to do — thanks to Burakhovsky and his tactical medicine course.
By the way, I signed a new contract while I was in the hospital. Figured I’d get bored to death on the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Himzavod_Hub_soldat_stibor_SC: I don’t remember a clause in my contract saying that all kinds of creeps could shoot at me.
We’ve never had this many people at the Chemical Plant. I only hope they’re not gonna cut our rations. Too many mouths to feed…
Lucky me, I guess. First I dodged Icarus, and now I missed out on Duga, too. Standing watch here is a breeze.
Things are getting better. We’ll be back to our regular patrols soon, no more special ops or assaults.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_Audiolog_Radiochat_1: Metlov, come in. How’d things go down at the Slag Heap?
We’re good. Put the local thugs in their place. What’s the situation on your end? Over.
Hasn't changed. Still watching the Sultansk and the Shevchenko, hands off.
We used to play this game when Nestor ran the Slag Heap, Pick. Maybe there’s somebody on those ships playing for our team, too...
Fucking politics, man. We could have Zaton wrapped up in no time. Let’s hope Senkevych knows what he’s doing and doesn’t fuck this up. Keep in touch, Metlov. Over and out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_Closing_1_62558: Attention, everyone! Icarus is under attack. I repeat, Icarus is under attack. Leaving the camp is prohibited until the threat is neutralized.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_1_1_62595: Yesterday Khoteyev hands me a rag and says, “Quick, to the latrine!” I rush in and see the doc, hands covered in gore like a butcher and blood smeared all over the mirror.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_1_1_62596: “Shaving incident,” he says. “It was Scherban, not me. Fortunately, I was nearby and took the razor away.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_1_1_62597: Scherban? Dammit! He begged me to help him shave, said he couldn’t see his reflection in the mirror anymore... I thought he was fooling around, so I told him to scram. Is he okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_1_1_62598: Yeah, the doc patched him up. He looks like a mummy now, with all those bandages.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_2_1_62637: Sarge! Hey, Sarge! Tell the captain to get someone to replace me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_2_2_68958: I’ve been here for three years, and I can’t take it anymore.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_2_3_68959: I'll tell him. You drink this and I'll tell him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_2_3_68960: I’ll drink it once he relieves me of my watch. Don’t you remember regulations? The honor guard can’t drink on duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_3_2_68961: Don’t trust anyone around here. They’re not real!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_3_3_68962: The real Captain Senkevych is lying over there. He hasn’t budged in three days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_GCA_3_3_68963: And they drowned Batalov in the swamp to make sure nobody could stop them from taking over. I saw it with my own eyes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_Opening_1_62559: The emergency is over, Wardens. The threat has been eliminated.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_bronevoj_0_HelloTopi: Well? Don’t beat around the bush.
Permission to speak freely. What’s on your mind?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_bronevoj_0_HubInfo_1: Icarus is a SIRCAA outpost. It's our defense against threats from the Swamps. Our garrison is a modest one, but it's enough to maintain control of the area.
However, as soon as I get my men in line, I’m going to ask Korshunov for more boots on the ground.
Those Zaton punks are getting cocky. Besides, there are plenty of places around here we need to explore. We’ve only heard about them from stalkers, and that’s just plain wrong.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_bronevoj_0_InfoTopic: Oh, we've got all sorts of stuff going on! Would you like to hear about a soldier after patrol meowing like a cat? Or maybe about Winnie the Pooh speaking from a wall?
That’s some fucking great news, isn’t it? I hear a dozen stories like that every day, each crazier than the last.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_bronevoj_0_Meet_1_62: Let’s set the record straight: I’m not thrilled to have you here. This isn't the version of Icarus a stalker should ever see.
However, since the Colonel trusts you, I’ll give you the benefit of the doubt and assume you’ve got brains. Here and now, you could be useful.
We only have one rule here, and it’s as clear as it gets: orders are not up for debate. They’re to be followed. Got it? Good. Then we’ll get along just fine.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_bronevoj_0_NPC_Emiss: The Emission is over, Icarus. Resume your duties.
Attention, soldiers! We've got an Emission! Keep your heads down!
Listen up, soldiers! An Emission is headed our way. Follow standard procedure to the letter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_bronevoj_0_RestoreRe: Your men don't seem happy to see me, Captain. Can you put in a good word for me?
What did you expect? You’ve stirred up so much shit, I’d rather take you outside and drown you in the nearest puddle myself.
But I don’t want to get my hands dirty.
Consider yourself lucky Korshunov hasn’t ordered us to take you out immediately. If you want to make things right, you need to take it up with him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_medik_s_ikara_0_Busy: I’ve got enough on my plate already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_medik_s_ikara_0_ByeT: Be careful out there. I can’t handle any more patients.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_medik_s_ikara_0_Heal: Anesthesia is reserved for Wardens. You’ll have to tough it out.
Everyone here thinks there’s something wrong with them, but rest assured, you’re perfectly fine.
Just a sec, and you’ll be as good as new.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_medik_s_ikara_0_Hell: You’re the last thing I need right now. What is it?
Are you okay? Anything can happen here in the swamp.
Let’s keep this brief. I don’t even have time for a smoke.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_medik_s_ikara_0_Info: SIRCAA doesn’t give a damn about the Ward. The future of all mankind is at stake! The fact that our brains are melting here is no biggie.
Here, soldier, take this pill, it’ll keep your hands steady. You don’t want to drop your rifle, do you? Fucking eggheads!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_medik_s_ikara_0_Meet: When I left for Icarus, I thought it’d be like a vacation. Small, remote garrison. What could go wrong? An encounter with local fauna or food poisoning, at worst.
Boy, was I wrong! There isn’t a single empty bed left in the infirmary. We bring a new patient in every day. I can’t remember the last time I got a good night’s sleep — definitely before I got here.
So, for the time being, you seem to be the most mentally stable one here. But trust me, it won’t last long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_medik_s_ikara_0_Trad: To be honest, I wouldn’t even waste peroxide on you.
I was saving it for myself, but I think you need it more.
It’s not much, but we have all our basic needs covered.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_radovoj_kotc_0_Hello: What do you want from me?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_radovoj_kotc_0_InfoT: Let’s see… the mold keeps on spreading, and our brains are slowly turning to mush. That’s about all the “news” we've got around here. But that's okay, 'cuz we've got plenty of godawful food to eat.
If you’re looking for news, head over to SIRCAA, they've got something exciting going on every day. They’ll have to shoot you dead for trespassing, though.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_radovoj_kotc_0_SCAct: What the hell are we even doing in here? Guarding a bunch of muck? Command says it’s some kind of important facility. I wish I had a clue what it is. Maybe then I’d have something to be proud of, huh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_radovoj_smerdenko_0_: Well? Is there something you need?
I really don’t want to be on the next patrol. Casualties every time. I gotta talk to Batalov and see if I can be excused.
But what do I tell him? I should eavesdrop on the guys who went out last time, figure out what they're screaming about at night. Yeah, that might convince the doc.
I feel like I’m about to grow some fins over here. How come my boots are always soaked? Seriously, I just dried 'em, and I haven’t stepped in a single puddle since this morning.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serz_pikman_0_BusyTo: Stand down with the chitchat, stalker!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serz_pikman_0_HelloT: Speak up already. I’m busy enough as it is.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serz_pikman_0_InfoTo: You are, for one. And it just keeps getting worse.
The captain might see things differently, but to me, if the Ward needs help from a stalker, that can only mean one thing: we’re fucked.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serz_pikman_0_Resume: All right. We can talk again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serz_pikman_0_SCActi: The air here… it’s like breathing in jelly. No filter can clean this stuff up. Just trying to breathe it feels like I’ve been on a loaded march the whole time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_eremeev_0_Bu: I’m busy. I can’t deal with you right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_eremeev_0_By: You keep bugging me for nothing.
Come on in whenever you need something.
Watch your head. I can’t fix that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_eremeev_0_He: Now I gotta waste my parts on you.
Great. I had nothing better to do anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_eremeev_0_In: We keep wasting ammo like there’s no tomorrow. I have no idea what they’re shooting at. Every time I ask, all I get is “There was something creepy out there.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_eremeev_0_Me: Stalker, eh? Haven’t seen you around here before.
Though, to be fair, I just got assigned here myself. The previous tech ended up under Batalov, so now I’m filling his shoes. I just hope I don’t end up like him.
Let me know if you need anything.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_eremeev_0_Up: All right. Let’s see your scrap.
What do you want to upgrade?
Show me what you need tweaked.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_hoteev_0_Bus: You've got a decent shelf life — you can wait.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_hoteev_0_Bye: That’s it, I’ve seen enough of you for today.
All my merchandise is yours — within reason, of course.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_hoteev_0_Hel: If it was up to me, you’d be locked up. So what do you want?
You’ve got a nose for new arrivals, eh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_hoteev_0_Mee: A soldier’s happiness boils down to a few things. Good grub, for one. Then there's comfortable gear, from his armor down to his skivvies. And enough ammo.
And let me tell you, I’ve got all those bases covered.
Whatever’s going on inside their heads... that’s the commander’s problem. I’m just here to make sure their helmets fit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_IKAR_Hub_serzdot_hoteev_0_Tra: You can have a look, but keep your expectations in check.
We’ll make sure you’re equipped to the highest Ward standards.
This ain’t the Chemical Plant, but we do have a few things to offer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_Audiolog_1_Audiol: Are you certain no mutant approaches were detected in the last 24 hours? Did you make sure the sensor is on?
Well, the green light looks on to me.
No, I’m sure you’ve got something wrong. Get back to Malachite, and I’ll go over everything with you in detail again.
Maybe the Chunk of Meat just doesn’t work as bait. I’ve never seen a psi-dog eat an artifact before.
That’s because you haven’t closely observed their behavior. Fine, I'll join you in the field next time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_Closing_2_Hub_Clo: Due to adverse external circumstances, Malachite is temporarily closed. I apologize for the inconvenience.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_Closing_Hub_Closi: Due to an external threat, access to Malachite is temporarily restricted. Please remain calm. Our guards are more than capable of handling the situation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_DialogueOnEntranc: I might be new around here, but I’ve been in the Zone long enough to know that coupons are usually as good as a permit.
Keep it down! You want Ozersky to hear us?
All right. I can tell you’re not exactly a newbie. Hand me your… “permit” and come on in.
Does Korshunov’s badge count as a special permit?
You’re from the Ward? Well, why didn’t you say so? Come on in.
All right. I’ll come back some other time.
I hope my special permit is still valid.
Have you heard about what went down at the Duga? I was there.
Yeah, sure. So you’re telling me the Monolithians wiped out all the soldiers at the Duga, and you somehow got away without a scratch? Bullshit!
I got lucky. That blind preacher of theirs almost got me.
Faust? I hear he’s calling the shots for the whole Monolith now. You must have a lucky charm if you ran into him and made it out alive.
All right, you’re in. After the Duga, our scientists’ jobs will be a walk in the park for you.
Freeze! This is a secure facility. No rookie stalkers allowed. Limited access, special permit required.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_62763: Darn bureaucracy! What kind of paper do you want now?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_62764: No, these are the rules. Show me evidence that this experiment makes any sense, and I’ll provide the equipment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_62765: But Professor Ozersky said it’s a promising experiment!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_62766: Professor Ozersky doesn’t handle equipment allocation; I do. Papers, Kuprienko. I need grounds.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_62768: Getting us research materials under Professor Ozersky’s direct orders. But that's need-to-know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_62769: You guys just can’t resist adding a touch of mystery, eh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_62770: Well, we don’t have much to lose. Kryvenko is a well-known scientist, maybe he’ll take us under his wing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_62771: After we worked directly under Ozersky? I don’t think so.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_62772: The Sircaans think we're a joke. And the Ward is still looking for anyone who used to work with Spark.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_62773: Yeah, it’s been tough. Might as well just leave the Zone for good.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_62774: You think I could become a stalker?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_62775: Why not? Degtyarev was in the secret police, and look where he ended up. Come on, let's go for a walk. We'll take a look at the old Scorcher!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_62776: I need to think it over. Grab some bolts, too. I gotta ask Semyonych…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_Opening_2_Hub_Ope: The threat has passed. We are delighted to once again welcome everyone to the true temple of science!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_Opening_Ozerskij_: The threat has been eliminated. Malachite is now open again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_10_Prop: Dear colleagues, let’s respect each other’s time. Assignments with the guide are pre-scheduled only.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_11_Prop: Reminder to all research personnel: everyone has to fill out the safety training form by the end of the month.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_12_Prop: Discipline and ethics are the two fundamentals of scientific progress!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_13_Prop: In accordance with the new regulations, discussion of the incident involving the former head of STC Malachite is not permitted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_14_Prop: In accordance with the new regulations, scientists are prohibited from leaving the Malachite facility without personal permission from Victoria Dorozhnyuk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_1_PropT: All staff, please note that STC Malachite does not provide funding for experiments without clearly defined objectives.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_2_PropT: In the case of an unsuccessful experiment, I strongly advise seeking immediate medical attention. Our doctor’s services are available at any time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_3_PropT: Please be aware that alcohol consumption does not enhance cognitive functions. Visiting the bar during work hours is strongly discouraged.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_4_PropT: Whoever left their protective suit at the entrance, please contact security.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_5_PropT: Our security personnel have reported unauthorized attempts to bring live Rodents into the STC. Please remember that field experiments should be conducted exclusively in the field.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_6_PropT: When arranging field experiments, please remember that assignments with the guide are scheduled on a first-come, first-served basis.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_7_PropT: Please remember that all equipment must be returned upon the conclusion of an experiment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_8_PropT: Remember that not all research requires hand-on specimen collection. Our guide and allied loners are ready to bring anything you might need.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_PropTopic_9_PropT: In accordance with the new regulations, refusal to cooperate with the Ward may result in immediate termination of employment and expulsion beyond the Perimeter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_docent_ilahov_0_I: Professor Ozersky is about as much a scientist as he is a professor. He hasn’t taught anyone anything in twenty years, and his last scientific discovery is even more ancient.
I shouldn’t have spoken ill of Ozersky. The man paid for his research with his life, like a true scientist!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_docent_ilahov_0_N: I can’t concentrate! They won’t leave me alone. No time to myself even in the exclusion zone!
This place used to be a total mess, now it feels like an army barracks.
I never thought I’d be against a change in leadership. But now, I’d choose a bumbling genius over someone with a stick up their ass.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_mns_kuprienko_0_B: Good luck in… wherever you're going.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_mns_kuprienko_0_H: Another stalker? What can I do for you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_mns_kuprienko_0_I: I’m pretty new here. Professor Ozersky himself invited me. He said I've got a promising future!
And SIRCAA rejected my application. They’re pencil pushers, nowhere near as passionate about science as us, that much is obvious!
Good gracious! Have you heard about the, uh… incident? I can’t begin to fathom what he must have done to deserve that. I’m scared to work here now.
And these new protocols... my goodness. The bureaucracy here has become unbelievable. Should I consider becoming a loner scientist? Is that even a thing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_mns_kuprienko_0_N: The institute didn’t prepare me for this! And all those Emissions…
I’d love to hit Pythagoras's place for a drink and some inspiration. But with the new management, I might end up getting sacked.
Gotta avoid the Wardens. You never know with those guys... give them the wrong look and they'll reach for their guns.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_pifagor_0_BusyTop: Look, I’m kinda busy right now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_pifagor_0_ByeTopi: Come by, I’ll always have a cold one for you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_pifagor_0_HelloTo: I wish I had more customers like you. We’d be more popular than Rostok.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_pifagor_0_InfoTop: I know everyone who comes to Malachite. Everyone stops by the bar. We’re the local landmark!
Every now and then you run into folks who really shouldn’t be here at Malachite. But you didn't hear it from me, obviously. If it’s fine by the professor, it’s fine by me.
Ozersky promised that I’d become a lab technician, that I’d advance science. And now it seems like I’m about to advance myself… to an early grave.
Our security is all worked up after the Duga. Monolith brought down a whole Warden army! If they advance to Malachite, we’re sitting ducks here…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_pifagor_0_Meet_2_: Take it easy on the drinks. Did you hear what they did to Ozersky? Don’t let your guard down. The Malachite we knew is done and dusted, loner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_pifagor_0_Meet_Me: If you want a drink, don’t be shy, pick your poison. I’ve got something for everyone, whether you’re a soldier or a scientist.
It sure helps that their tastes are ind… identical. Truth be told, the only thing you can get here is vodka.
I’ve heard they have quite the selection over at SIRCAA. Well, that's okay... I’ll hang around here a bit longer, learn a thing or two, and then… who knows?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_pifagor_0_TradeTo: It’s all good, I’ve sampled everything myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_professor_ozerski: You’re interrupting me.
Leaving already? What a pleasant surprise!
Good luck with your stalker career!
Goodbye!
This is a science facility, not your personal base camp.
I see the Zone's been kind to you!
I’m all ears.
STC Malachite is the only place where we study the Zone as it is.
Here, no theory is labeled eccentric, and no field experiment is considered unnecessary. Even the smallest detail may hold the key to comprehending the fundamental patterns of the Zone.
Admittedly, those snobs at SIRCAA mock our research, call it pseudoscience. But why listen to shallow pricks whose narrow-mindedness obstructs their own quest for truth?
Tell me about Malachite.
They were actually thinking of making me the head of SIRCAA, you know? Luckily, it didn’t work out. I’d rather go back to the Mainland than deal with that bunch of show-offs and hypocrites.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Professor Ozersky, the Director of STC Malachite.
If you intend to remain at the Center, please avoid interfering with our work, and treat all visitors with courtesy and respect.
My colleagues frequently require stalker assistance to retrieve artifacts or conduct field experiments. Should you prove yourself capable, you may be entrusted with such assignments.
The Emission is over. Staff involved in field research may now resume activities outside the facility.
Ladies and gentlemen, please remain calm. Do not leave the premises. There’s an Emission outside!
To all STC Malachite staff: an Emission is approaching! It is dangerous to remain outside.
Can you help me make amends with Spark?
You should ask their leader, not me. But I’m not sure he'll be interested anyway.
You shouldn’t have been so quick to show off your weapon. You stalkers have grown so wild in those wastelands of yours, the very notion of civility appears to be foreign to you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_semenyc_0_ByeTopi: If you need anything, stop by!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_semenyc_0_HelloTo: You ain’t in a rush, are you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_semenyc_0_InfoTop: I like it here at Malachite. Got everything I need, and the people are nice. But everyone’s always in such a hurry, like their science is gonna up and vanish. You gotta take it easy, loner, just slow down.
I just wanted to tinker with Ozersky’s gadgets, and almost got shot! And then they claim I lack initiative!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_semenyc_0_Meet_2_: Honestly, Wardens or no Wardens, I couldn’t care less.
Warden gun, loner gun - jams the same, and I'm stuck here fixing 'em, eh…
Unlike some folks, I’m not whining. What’s the point? Just a waste of time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_semenyc_0_Meet_Me: When I left Garbage, I was heading for Prypiat, just like everyone else. But then I stopped just shy of it, as you can see. And I think I made the right call.
Tech likes peace and quiet. And it's always messy in Prypiat.
So, if you need something fixed or adjusted, give me a shout. Just don’t rush me, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_semenyc_0_Upgrade: Oh, as if I didn't have enough on my plate…
All right. I'll make it priority number one.
No rush, I’ll do it nice and slow…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_soldat_debrev_0_I: I wanted to serve at the Duga so badly. The view out there is incredible! Here, there’s nothing worth seeing besides Pythagoras’s mini-bar.
Fuck it, I’ve filed a transfer request. I was lucky at the Duga, but now the Ward came in and started tightening the screws.
Just three more weeks, and I’ll get back to the Perimeter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_soldat_debrev_0_N: This sucks. I used to take a nap on duty whenever I felt like it. Now, I can’t blink for more than a second. The Ward is watching my every yawn.
I shouldn’t have been complaining that it's boring here. First, one group takes over Malachite, then another… what’s next? A third coup?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_spica_0_ByeTopic_: I won’t be upset if you never come back.
Don’t go overkill with those energy drinks.
If you need anything, I’m here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_spica_0_HealTopic: An adequately immobilized patient requires no anesthesia, ha!
Physically, you’re in perfect condition. As for your mental health... that’s not for me to assess.
I've gotten pretty good at this thanks to you stalkers. It won’t hurt.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_spica_0_HelloTopi: What seems to be the problem?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_spica_0_InfoTopic: It's a shame they shut down the Scorcher. While I’m glad it’s no longer a threat, the changes it induced in the brain were… truly unique.
I wonder if we could turn it back on for a few minutes...
I’ve requested a transfer to SIRCAA — once it gets rebuilt, of course. There’s still some time for me to make a breakthrough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_spica_0_Meet_2_Me: Shame about the professor. However, I’ve heard that Kryvenko is looking for neurobiologists…
Say what you will about the Ward, but they do recognize that progress often requires a certain flexibility, particularly when it comes to science.
As for this mess, in the end, Dorozhnyuk got what she wanted, even though the means hardly justified the ends. Like I said, science demands a certain degree of flexibility.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_spica_0_Meet_Meet: Your eyes react to the light. Freeze, don’t move! Cognitive function seems intact.
Preliminary conclusion: you’ll live. Providing, of course, that you stay out of Prypiat, and the Scorcher remains off.
This place has plenty of ways to end you, which is actually helpful for my research. No offense.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_spica_0_TradeTopi: No need to worry, all the samples have been tested.
Malachite still has some in stock.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_viktor_koska_0_He: At least I’ll have some decent company!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_viktor_koska_0_In: You wouldn’t believe some of the places they wanted to send me to. To the Generators — the very shithole of Prypiat. I know, right?
That smartass got real mad when I refused to take him there. I should’ve dropped him off at the nearest old power plant and let him generate whatever he wanted there, ha ha!
The Wardens spend a lot of time in the Zone, but still need to be rescued from every other anomaly. Might as well write ten percent off each group before they go out on a mission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_viktor_koska_0_Me: It actually turned out pretty good! Sure, the Wardens are a shady bunch, but they drew me up a schedule, down to the minute.
It’s almost like a regular job now. I make a run there and back, and once my shift’s done, I can relax. So far, so good!
Another field trip? Look, at least let me… wait, you’re not one of them scientists. Phew.
Listen, buddy. If you need to go places, I can help you out, but we gotta stop and take a break along the way, all right?
These eggheads have been up my ass all around the clock. Take me here, set my equipment up there… man, I should’ve stuck to the Swamps.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_viktor_koska_0_Tr: We’ll take it slow, all right?
Where are we going this time?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Malahit_Hub_viktoria_doroznuk: Later!
Yeah.
See you around.
Have a nice day.
What have you got there?
It's good to see you.
Hello. Looking for some equipment, are you?
Malachite is going to see some real changes now! Sure, I’ll keep some things the way they were to honor the professor, but if we don’t act swiftly, the whole facility could be shut down for good.
With SIRCAA in ruins, the responsibility to study the Zone and push the boundaries of science is now ours alone.
I have to admit, though, I’m a little scared. Who knows what else Professor Ozersky could have been hiding from us all? What other skeletons did he keep in his closet?
Tell me about Malachite.
If I were in charge, we’d be respected like SIRCAA. There’s so much potential here, and it’s being wasted. It’s disorganized!
Can you believe it? They just funded a study to determine whether pseudo-dogs have a fifth limb. This is a circus, not a scientific facility!
I proposed that the Ward establish a temporary research camp here at Malachite. It’s so refreshing to work with real scientists for once!
What happened at SIRCAA is outrageous. But what else would you expect from Dalin and his experiments? Now the whole Zone has to deal with the consequences.
It’s all happening so fast! I wanted to take the reins at Malachite, sure, but… not like this. This is horrible!
I need to speak to Dr. Dalin. As for the colonel… I’d rather not. Maybe some other time.
Right now I need to get everything in order and prove that the professor’s… that my team is making a great contribution to scientific progress. I have to ensure their future. I’m sure you can relate.
Professor Ozersky says that my commitment to maintaining order “stifles the flight of imagination.” Well, flights are for airplanes. And in science, order is paramount.
That’s why I won’t tolerate mess. No discounts, no “let’s make a deal,” and certainly no “I’ll pay you next time.” You pay, you get your goods. Not the other way around.
Is that understood? Good.
Attention, everyone. The Emission is over. Please return to your work stations in fifteen minutes.
Do not leave the shelters until the Emission has passed! Your safety is your responsibility!
Colleagues, an Emission is underway! Move to the shelters and follow safety protocols!
Don't even think about hustling me.
It’s been a while.
Here’s what we’ve got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Audiolog_ZavhozA: Nah, I got this. Just tell me what to do about the gas masks. The junk Khors fixed last month isn't cutting it anymore.
Fuck Quiet! We charge his generators, find him gear, and he goes off and sells it to whoever he damn well pleases?! That’s not why I showed him the ropes!
I think that’s exactly why, brother…
Want me to pay him a visit?
No way in hell. Quiet’ll try to scam you. I’ll handle it myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Brodyaga_Meet2_1: People have been leaving Noon for as long as it’s existed. And just as many of them come back.
Did you know that even Dubny ran away at first? He didn’t like the ban on fighting and drinking.
Don’t worry about us. Noontide is more than just the people who are here at the moment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Comment_GCA_1_1_: Hey, stalker! Need to sell some gear or grab something new?
You can forget about doing it here on the island. Trading’s a no-go. You’ll have to head over to Quiet; he’s not too far from here.
But you didn’t hear it from me, okay?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Comment_GCA_2_1_: I went to scavenge some artifacts nearby and got ambushed by Snorks. Right after I gave you my last medkit, damn it.
So then I stumbled across some stalkers, thought I’d ask for a bandage. What do they do? Point their guns at me and tell me to get lost. “All Monolithians are murderers”.
Do you remember it? No, you don’t, and neither do they. Just heard some campfire stories. Those bastards weren’t even around in the Monolith days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Comment_GCA_3_1_: I’ve been thinking: the guys who went with Faust did the right thing.
I just hope they won’t regret it.
Why would they? We’re not exactly begging for a return ticket ourselves.
We might be sticking with Quiet, but we’re our own masters here. Can the folks who left with Faust say the same?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Comment_GCA_4_1_: I step out of the infirmary, and nothing’s the same anymore…
It’s for the best. The brothers who went away... they didn’t want to be here.
I guess… but it stings that even Stone didn’t drop by to say goodbye.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Comment_GCA_5_1_: From what I can remember, he’s the first loner who’s stuck around the island this long. I hope it won’t turn out to be a mistake.
When it comes to people, Strider’s never been wrong.
He was dead wrong about Faust, for one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Comment_HubClosi: We’ve got a situation here, brothers. Lock everything up! We’ll hunker down until the shooting’s over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Comment_HubOpeni: Seems quiet out there. Get back to your posts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Hors_Meet2_1_573: It’s too bad the brothers left. Things were better when we were all together.
I’m gonna miss Faust. He used to tell these stories and kept us so intrigued to the very end.
Anyway, I have faith they’ll return. In the meantime, what can I do for you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Infotopic_Forgot: I feel so empty. The Monolith’s voice is gone, my memories, too. Sometimes I dream about laughter, voices, faces… but who are those people? I wish I knew…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Masina_Meet2_1_5: I know the ways of the Zone. The one Faust chose won’t lead brothers to happiness.
So, where do you want to go?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_10_1_5: I lost my PDA on my shift. If someone finds it, bring it to me. And please don’t read what’s on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_11_1_5: Brothers! The professor and I, we’ve made… tomorrow, we’re going to show… that will change our home forever! Is this supposed to not make real sense?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_12_1_5: Good news! All… Birdy and Rocket are back!
…brothers… enough gas masks for five more…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_13_1_6: Brothers! The storage coordina-… for the Mono…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_1_1_57: If I see any empty bottles, I’ll track down whoever drank from them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_2_1_57: Always look for shelter right away during an Emission — even if you don’t feel like it. Remember, mutants are also resistant to its effects, and they enjoy a good meal too. Take care of yourselves.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_3_1_57: The converters are getting overloaded. We’ll need to conserve energy for the time being, but I’m working on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_4_1_57: The converters are operating at maximum capacity! You don't need to conserve energy at this time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_5_1_57: Or you’re not coming with me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_6_1_57: Remember to let us know if you decide to leave the island. We’re all very concerned.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_7_1_57: The new safety rules apply to everyone. This is particularly important after what went down at the WPS.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_8_1_60: If you come across any artifacts, don’t take them to Quiet. Bring them to me. They could save your life — or the lives of your brothers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_PropTopic_9_1_57: If you haven’t played “bet you can’t fix it” with me yet, swing by my workshop.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_Tihij_Meet2_1_57: Hey, stalker! Have you heard about what happened with Noontide?
Faust had a fight with Strider and took half the people off the island. That dude sure knows how to talk folks into stuff. I wish I had that kind of charisma.
So, what can I do for you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_brodaga_0_ByeTop: I wouldn't stay on this island too long if I were you.
Come back anytime. You’re always welcome here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_brodaga_0_HubInf: What can you tell me about Wild Island?
Wild Island is home to some very capable people. We wouldn’t have made it this far without them.
For anything tech-related, ask Khors. He can fix it all. Machine is the best guide I’ve ever met. Our doc can work wonders too, given our limited resources.
But if you’re looking for trade or a drink, you’ll have to go somewhere else. I’m trying to keep this place independent — from money and alcohol, among other things.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_brodaga_0_InfoTo: The Zone is changing, and this place can’t stay the same either.
We’ve already found ourselves a home, and we can change how others see us. I’m sure of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_brodaga_0_Meet_1: We don’t usually let stalkers in. Or any strangers, really.
Not because we’re afraid or hate them. I made this decision to ensure everyone's safety.
But you helped us. Noontiders won't forget it. You’re free to leave and return to the island whenever you wish.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_brodaga_0_NPC_Em: An Emission is coming, brothers. Find shelter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_brodaga_0_Restor: We got off on the wrong foot. I’d like to make things right.
You let us down, but we all make mistakes. I believe that everyone deserves a second chance.
But you’ll have to earn our trust, loner.
Every mistake has a price. I know that all too well. But let’s put it behind us and move on.
I need to think it over.
Until then, try to keep a low profile.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_NoonBase_Hub_foma_0_HealTopic: I’d rather spend my time on folks who are actually sick.
