ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_kalina_0_He: You sure you're on the right ship?
Having a stalker on board is good luck!
You got some business here, or you just wanna shoot the shit?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_kalina_0_Hu: Loners used to be scared to come here, but now they've finally grown some balls.
They know I welcome anyone who's not half-stupid. Bandit, loner, undecided - I don't judge.
I’ve heard the Shevchenko is falling apart with no one on board. That’s not good at all. I might need to see if there’s anything I can do about it.
What can you tell me about the Sultansk?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_kalina_0_In: You know coupons were invented by some smart-ass Freedom guy from Rostok, right?
Wasn't that long ago, but the whole Zone uses 'em. Jobs, trades, payments — it's all coupons now.
I wonder if it's human nature, or does the Zone turn anything new into something ordinary just like that?
They used to say our Zaton is the middle of nowhere. Now, when the Monolith reshaped the trading map, any back of beyond can be the new capital.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_kalina_0_Me: They already tried to take me out. Can you believe it? The plan itself was bad enough, the execution was even worse.
Something tells me I haven’t seen the last of ’em, though.
Oh well, no biggie. I’m a lucky gal. Might as well start decorating walls with those guns I took from wannabe assassins.
First time here, huh? Don’t be shy, loner, we won’t bite. Visit the Sultansk once, you’ll see there’s no better place in all of Zaton.

If you’re looking for a job, got artifacts to sell, or just need a drink for the road, you’ve come to the right place. I know all about how this place works, and I can tell you how to make it work in your favor.
Rule number one: no trashing my ship. I’m not gonna like it. Name’s Sonya, by the way. Sonya Kalyna.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_kalina_0_NP: If you're sick of sitting around, the Emission is over now. Feel free to go outside.
There’s an Emission outside, gentlemen. Stay put.
Listen up, everybody! There's an Emission on the way. If you’re not already in a shelter, find one quickly. The Emission isn't gonna wait for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_kalina_0_Re: The people here don’t think too highly of me. I want to make amends.
I was wondering when you’d show up, Skif. First you shoot at my men, and now you wanna apologize?
If it wasn't for that favor, we’d be having a very different conversation.
I won't forget that you did right by me, so I’ll make things right for you — for a small, purely symbolic contribution, of course. And don't push it.
Let’s talk about it another time.
If you keep messing with my guys, there might not be another time.
I want to set things right. I don't mind making a little donation.
Now that’s the Skif I used to know. Pleasure doing business with you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_kalina_0_Tr: You’re quite a handful, you know that? You make me nervous, but you make me money!
All of Zaton’s finest goods right here, just for you!
Take a look. You won’t find this kinda stuff even on the Mainland!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sona_opening_1_6: The enemy's boarding attempt has backfired spectacularly! The Sultansk is open to all visitors again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_ByeTopi: See you later, my good man.
If you’ve got something to talk about, come on over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_HelloTo: You're still kicking, huh? What a shame.
Why, if it isn't my favorite bigwig!
Well, speak up since you're here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_HubInfo: Here on the Sultansk, we don’t treat stalkers as enemies.
Behave, and you'll make some good money just like my guys.
But if you’re a Shevchenko rat, that’s a whole different story. And trust me, it ain't pretty.
What can you tell me about the Sultansk?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_InfoTop: Let me tell you something: the Ward, they’re just basic cops. Gear's fancier, but that's all there is.
Even the Wardens can’t resist a little extra coin if you approach ’em the right way. Coupons are sorta like magic. They make folks turn a blind eye and a deaf ear.
They say the Ward's outta Icarus, all of them.
It ain't bad, they'll stop poking around, at least. But come to think of it, they didn't just up and leave for no damn good reason. Gotta keep our heads on a swivel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_Meet_2_: Can’t help but wonder who else was in on it with that bitch, Skif.
They’re all laying low, for now. Chickenshits.
But I’m gonna find ’em all anyway and finish ’em off. Hell knows what Kalyna put them up to. I won't be looking over my shoulder on my own ship.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_Meet_me: Remember this: I’m the Sultan, and this ship is mine.
If you play by my rules, you’ll have a good life here. But step out of line, and you can kiss that good life goodbye.
Don’t bother me with crap, and don’t start shit with Kalyna or my men — unless you want a bullet in your knee.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_NPC_Emi: That’s it, folks, we’re in the clear. The Emission’s over!
All right, folks. Just hang tight. There’s an Emission out there.
Listen up, folks! An Emission’s about to kick in. Get to your hidey-holes, and fast!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_sultan_0_Restore: I had beef with your guys, and I want to make amends.
So you’re here to show some respect, huh? Right your wrongs? Good for you!
I told my guys to go easy on you. For now…
But remember, you owe me. With interest.
I need to think it over.
Think fast, or things could get ugly.
You’re right. Let’s keep things smooth.
Good call, stalker. Now go, and remember — I don’t want any more trouble from you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_syc_0_ByeTopic_B: Drop by if you find anything interesting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_syc_0_HelloTopic: You didn’t come here just to show off your pretty face, did you? Spit it out or hit the road.
You gonna spill the beans or keep me guessing?
What’s the holdup? Just tell me what you want.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_syc_0_InfoTopic_: I don’t share info with strangers. But if you're looking for work, I’m your man.
Back to the good old days. Weren't good at all. Same ugly mugs as ten years ago, here we go again.
I knew it from the get-go — anyone who sides with the old men in that standoff is gonna lose.
Some folks just don’t get it. Think if they talk shit quietly enough at the bar, no one's gonna know. But I can hear every word.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_syc_0_Meet_2_1_6: You’re not the first loner I’ve seen today, and you won’t be the last. There’s a whole lot of you now, all moving in with Beard.
Didn't think I'd see that old shitface here again. Kalyna must’ve busted their balls real bad to get those two to join forces.
Well, we’ll see what they’re made of. At least Kalyna had an iron grip.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_syc_0_Meet_3_1_6: I hope we’ll get more loners here now. They used to be too shy to trade here, with Beard around. But who’s gonna stop ’em now?
You oughtta swing by too. Whenever you need good gear and good intel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_syc_0_Meet_meet_: I've been here for a while now. Way back Beard used to hang around the Skadovsk. Then the Sultan kicked him out… with a little help from yours truly.
The Sultan went easy on Beard for old times' sake. But I'd like you better not cross him. Might find yourself in an underwater expedition in the Swamps.
Don't bother the Sultan with stupid shit. If it's important, Miss Kalyna will tell you when to pay him a visit. She's the one to talk to if you need a job.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_syc_0_TradeTopic: You're lucky I'm selling you anything at all.
I only got the quality stuff, guaranteed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_vitalik_hardkor_: We’re finally back on the Skadovsk! I'll drink to that!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_zeka_zubilo_0_Bu: You picked a bad time to mess with me, bud.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_zeka_zubilo_0_In: We’ve got some well-off chumps around here — the kind that got an artifact in every pocket, ya know? But you gotta get 'em before the mutants do.
It’s kinda weird having two kingpins now, eh? I might just stick around and see how things play out.
I don’t give a damn who’s in charge. As long as the boss follows our code, I ain't whining.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_zeka_zubilo_0_NP: I’m so sick of sitting on my ass all day. Why won't the Sultan give me something to do, a real gig?..
I better go check on my stash. If things go south, I’m outta here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Sultansk_Hub_zeka_zubilo_0_Re: So what were we chit-chattin’ about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_Bandit_Dial: Ладно, я вижу, ты боец серьезный. Держи деньги и разойдемся мирно.
Эй, пацаны, вы слышали? Он хочет, чтоб мы ему заплатили. Лучше вали отсюда, пока я добрый.
Ты напал на сталкера в лесу. Компенсируй ущерб и не попадайся больше мне на глаза.
А ты ещё кто такой? Чего хочешь?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_Bandit_Firs: Ладно, не хочу с вами связываться, жизнь дороже.
Вали отсюда. Хотя, с хабаром можешь ещё заходить.
Вот это вы, сталкеры, жадный все-таки народ... Или сам делись хабаром, или мы его заберем с твоего трупа. Недавно такого же жадного встретили, сейчас в лесу валяется.
А если у меня нет ничего?
А, это опять ты. В прошлый раз мало было? Потеряйся.
Ну что, посмотрим, кто из нас быстрее стреляет.
А ну стоять! Ты смотри, ещё один сталкер в гости пожаловал. Везет нам сегодня. Здесь проход платный, придется тебе своим добром поделиться.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_Bandit_Hell: А, это опять ты? Добавки захотел? Вали отсюда.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_End_Quest_K: Разобрался с бандитами, больше они сталкеров не потревожат.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_End_Quest_S: Да? Ну держи вот тебе в награду координаты моего схрона. Я когда в аномальное поле шел, все лишнее скинул, так моя сумка где-то под корягой и лежит.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_Give_Quest_: Видел я этих бандитов. Хилые какие-то оказались, быстро закончились.
Они тут неподалеку засаду на сталкеров хотели устроить. Сейчас на карте покажу.
Да что за жизнь такая, совсем проходу нет от бандитов! Уж казалось бы так далеко забрался - все равно подстерегли, шакалы... Как ты насчет разобраться с ними?
Ты как, не передумал насчет бандитов?
Ага, я тоже их встретил, теперь и у меня к ним счет имеется.
А почему бы и нет? Этот вопрос надо решить раз и навсегда.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_Heal_Dialog: Не повезло тебе, не прошел естественный отбор.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_Moose_Wait_: Я тут ещё посижу немного и пойду, когда полегчает.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TEST_EQ_NZolotova_Quest_Fail_: Жаль, теперь и дальше будут сталкеров кошмарить. Ладно, я пойду, бывай.
Нет, они успели куда-то свалить, не нашел их.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_ChortFinishQuest_hell: It is your reward for work
I think now you can go
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_ChortGiveQuest_lets_g: I hope, we make it quickly
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_ChortGiveQuest_monoli: I just came from there and destroyed a group of Monoliths
It is good news, thank you stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_ChortGiveQuest_no_int: I`m not interested to help you.
Tell me if you change your solution.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_ChortGiveQuest_proble: Yes, we need to go to the other side of the school. If you join us, I give you a new gun.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_GivePDANeutrals_give_: Yes, can you delive to Barmen this PDA
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_SQ_PraporFinishQuest_: Hello, I have what you want
Good, take your prize and get out
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_SQ_PraporGiveQuest_he: You look like a veteran. I give you a little case. Kill monoliths near the school and delive me  he`s PDA
Of Corse I give you prize for this
Hello, stalker. Hide your weapon if you dont want die
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ01_DV_SQ_PraporGiveQuest_no: Then get out of here and dont return
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TQ02_DV_FreedomQuest_hello_59: Hi, you want to go through this field?
A little. We guard this shelter and every time before E wave of mutants attacks us.
Yep. I propose you help us and wait in the shelter when E end.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_Audiolog_BadThin: This is bad. We shouldn’t have left Bobcat.
Eh, quit bitchin' already. All four of us coulda died. That better?
No. But we should’ve shot him, at least. He was screaming at the top of his lungs...
It was his own damn fault! He was slowin' us down. Besides, those fuckers like it better when their food's still kicking.
What’s wrong with you, huh? You heartless fuck...
Let’s see what you say when Gnats feeds you to the mutants. I’m not going with you two ever again. Fuck you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_Audiolog_RattedO: You fucking asshole! You're the piece of shit who ratted me out to the Ward?! Talk!
Say it! You were the only one who knew about our little scheme!
Stealing Ward guns and swapping them for our old ones? Yeah, brilliant idea...
Can't you get it through your fucking skull? They could've gotten us all killed 'cuz you were fucking around!
You're the only one who gotta catch a slug for this shit. Damn mastermind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_Audiolog_Revenge: Hey Gnats, can you hear me? Good. Our friend here wants to tell you something.
All hell broke loose over here. Noontiders went fucking crazy. When things get tough, you gotta count on your friends. Ain't that right, Slapstick?

Slapstick here ain't a very good friend. But you, Gnats... you're even worse. You saved your loot and left your partner to the Snorks. Was that your plan all along, or did you just see an opportunity?
Well, here comes Noontide. Guess I gotta go. I won't ask you to come along, Slapstick — you ain't running for your life with them busted legs of yours.
But you, Gnats... you I will see real soon. I promise.
Bobcat! Please! Just shoot me! Bobcat!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_Comment_Dissatis: I’m sick of these “guests” walking all over us. That kind of shit never happened when Nestor was around.
The Slag Heap’s done for. Even you guys are sick of them cops taking over. That’s no place for our kind anymore.
Your kind'll get over it. You've got plenty of places to go. We diggers ain’t got no other home.
You gonna stay here with the cops then? You’re a decent guy, never did any time, but that's all right. Quit digging and come join us at the Swamps.
Nah… I’m feeling lucky today. I just might make enough to get back to the Mainland. I ain't like you guys.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_Comment_Gangs_1_: Without Nestor, this place is gonna turn into a freaking bloodbath. The kingpins are gonna fight to the death, I tell ya. You wanna stick around for that?
Well, where else are we gonna go, smartass? Know any other places with enough chumps to shake down?
Word is, there’s a new gang boss in Rostok, and he’s hiring. We could join the Sultan at the Swamps too…
And if it gets real bad, we could always sign up with the mercs. Ha ha...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_Comment_Principl: What’s up? Got your ass kicked again?
Yeah, sort of. It’s okay, I’ll be fine.
Was it worth it? Lost your loot, got the shit beaten outta you… like, what the hell?
If you wanna work here, you gotta pay for protection. You got a death wish?
Nope. They freaking broke ya. Eat shit, bastards, you ain't getting my damn loot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_Comment_TerrorFa: Don’t overdo it, man. You’ll end up like those two.
Not before those pills of yours kill your liver. What else am I supposed to do? Stay sober and wait for the Noontiders to turn us all into zombies?
Well, go on, march into the Duga if you believe those ghost stories.
I’d rather head over to the Cordon and beg Sidorovich for a favor. He’s gotta have some connections at the IPSF. I wanna make it out of here without losing everything.
You dumbass! You really think you’ll still have anything left to lose after the old man robs you blind?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_10_1_6: Any rat that shoots people running from this Emission will be left to die in the next one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_11_1_6: Please remain calm. The Ward is clearing the area.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_12_1_6: Anyone who obstructs Ward officers in the fulfillment of their lawful duties will be subject to physical force.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_13_1_6: Any suspicious activity may result in immediate termination.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_14_1_6: In the event of a perceived threat, the Ward is authorized to use lethal force.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_15_1_6: Please conceal all bladed weapons and firearms to avoid fatal incidents.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_16_1_6: Stay put, guys. If you see anyone brainwashed-looking, don’t shoot. Give us a heads-up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_17_1_6: The next idiot who asks me how to join Monolith is gonna join them in the afterlife. Is that clear?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_18_1_6: The Slag Heap is well protected. Stop bothering me with dumb-ass projects. Traps, fortifications... We’re diggers here, not the fucking Viet Cong.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_1_1_63: Inside these walls, you’re under the protection of Nestor and the diggers. Once you’re outside, you’re on your own.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_2_1_63: Precious metals, radio equipment, microchips, and spare parts are to be brought directly to Diode. Otherwise, I’m not responsible for your belongings.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_3_1_63: Misplaced items are considered public property. Theft is punishable by face-smashing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_4_1_63: Be polite and respectful to your fellow drinkers here — even if they're teetotaling pigs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_5_1_63: If you're acting like a prick, you'll be lying in the creek. No offense.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_6_1_63: All the ass-kicking and face-smashing is to be taken outside, am I clear?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_7_1_63: If your counter squeaks like a mouse, get some vodka. If it rattles like a snake, go see Schulz. If it howls like a cat in heat, get some vodka for your buddies to drink to your memory.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_8_1_63: Anyone who gets drunk and falls in the creek won't be allowed in the bar without proper decontamination.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_PropTopic_9_1_63: No fights, no shooting, no petty squabbling. This is the place to chill.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_capa_hmuryj_0_In: No one dared to start shit with us while Nestor was in charge. Everything's gone to hell in a handbasket without him.
What news? Those fucking zombies keep killing both your guys and ours! Shitheads!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_capa_hmuryj_0_NP: Nestor picked the wrong time to piss off. Didn’t leave anyone in charge either.
Those shitheads are the last thing we need right now! Fucking scientists and their fucking experiments...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_capa_hmuryj_0_Re: So, where was I... oh, yeah!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_closing_1_63426: The Slag Heap's closed until you're all done playing cops and robbers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_drabadan_0_ByeTo: Come back whenever you want a drink or two.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_drabadan_0_Hello: Skif, old pal! What can I get you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_drabadan_0_InfoT: Duty is getting lazy. Back in the day, you could walk all the way to the Cement Factory and never see a single dog. But now? Ugh.
The folks from Wild Island are weird. They don’t drink, they don't smoke weed… they ain’t human, I tell ya! Uh… you’re not one of them, are ya?
Some thug from the Swamps came here a while ago. He was acting pretty wild for a guy who doesn't drink. What a weirdo…
Folks are drowning their fear in booze. I’m kinda scared they’ll drink their brains away before the psi-radiation even gets to them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_drabadan_0_Meet_: I knew it! Welcome, welcome! Here, have a drink. To new friends!
With customers like these, I might as well close up shop. No one wants to drink with them.
Your guess is as good as mine.
Hey, you’re clever. Our kind of man. How about a shot?
It's not too crowded here now. I get it. Those ugly mugs by the bar could put anyone off their drink.
Hey, you’re alive! We were wondering if you got caught in that whole mess. I was betting on you!
Well, well, looks like we've got a new guest. Fresh from the Cordon, are ya? Or is it the Lesser Zone? I'm guessing the Gaffer sent you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_drabadan_0_Trade: I’ve got drinks, I’ve got snacks. Pick what you want.
Here. This is all I've got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_feda_katod_0_Inf: This place is up shit's creek without a boss. How could Nestor just leave us like this?
Some pretty messed up shit. Monolith. And I thought I’d never hear that word again...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_feda_katod_0_NPC: It’s gonna be hard times for the Slag Heap. The kingpins won’t be happy if there's nobody here to shoot the shit with.
Don't piss your pants yet, boys. We kicked their asses before, and we’ll do it now. Just gotta stick together.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_feda_katod_0_Res: So, what were we talking about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_ByeTopic: Bring back some loot next time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_HelloTop: Whatcha waitin’ for? You buying or what?
Take your pick, stalker. My prices are fair.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_InfoTopi: I hate Garbage trade. Those thugs think I shit guns. I gotta haggle for every piece you guys bring me, dammit!
I’d be gone already, but now they're bringing me the sweetest loot ever. Nah, I'll wait it out.
Folks say the chief Monolithian bit the dust at the Duga. Good, but it changes nothing. If I knew about him, I’d have put a bounty on his head long ago.
Here’s what bugs me: did Gaffer train his chumps into champs, or is the Monolith not as ballsy as they say? The Wardens got screwed, and Zalissya is still standing.
You heard? Zalissya’s fucked. Folks went up there to check, and there’s more loot than they could carry. Those Monolithian bastards sliced everyone up but didn't take a fucking thing.
You hear that Sultan and Beard made up? Sworn enemies all these years, and now bandits and loners are shaking hands on their barge. Who would’ve fucking thought!
So, the Sultansk got a new queen, ha? That’s Sonya Kalyna for you – sweet-talking, back-stabbing Sonya. Beats me how all of them follow orders from a wench…
My goods ain’t selling. Fucking Ward cops are all over me with “Where’d you get this?" or "Show us the serial number”. Wish I could just pay them off! Shit.
Damn Ward pigs got nastier. Sitting on their asses, bugging us, running folks through their databases. Should’ve finished them off at the Duga.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_Meet_2_1: And how am I supposed to do business with this freak show on my back? They ain't sticking around, are they?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_Meet_3_1: Diode got us some bandit backup, but folks aren't too happy about it. Still, you know what they say about beggars and choosers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_Meet_4_1: Come in, come in. Brought anything good? You know it's high time for...big opportunities.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_Meet_Mee: Hey there, stalker. What can I do for ya? If you’re looking to buy or sell, great. If not, head over to SIRCAA. They just love answering questions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_guron_0_TradeTop: Look all you want, but don’t touch anything.
Come by, I’ll always have some goodies for you!
You got some loot? Let me have a look.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_ByeTopi: If you wanna talk business, stop by.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_HelloTo: You wanna talk business? Well, let’s get it over with.
Good to see you. You need something?
I hope you're here to talk business.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_HubInfo: We’ve had our eye on this place for quite a while now. We've got diggers here from the Flea Market and the Depot, along with a bunch of new ones.
We got some crooks here too, but Nestor taught them to respect the rules. We’re civil with them, and they behave... most of the time.
To be honest, we aren't much interest to them. If they shake down a stalker, they might get a nice artifact. But what can you get from a digger? A lamp? A microchip? What are they gonna do with that?
What can you tell me about the Slag Heap?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_InfoTop: If you’re about to get involved in something, think it over. The locals are a shady bunch. They’ll take you for every coupon you're worth.
The junk we're walking around on could make us rich on the Mainland. You just gotta know what to look for and keep your eyes open.
More and more people are leaving for the Perimeter. Guess they just don't got the guts to keep digging here after... you know.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_Meet_2_: Nestor sure picked the wrong damn time to check out. Who's gonna sort this shit out now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_Meet_3_: I never expected the Ward to come here. But I sorted it all out somehow. Now I guess I’m in charge of these folks again. I'd rather stay a tech, it was way easier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_Meet_4_: I guess we're on our own again here at the Slag Heap. I don’t know how long we’ll last, but we’re not giving up. Not to the Monolith, not to anyone else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_Meet_Me: Got anything to sell? Any lamps? Capacitors? Come on. Don’t be shy.
Or you need some repairs? That, I can do. For a reasonable price, of course.
Unless it requires parts that aren’t easy to get.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_NPC_Emi: The Emission’s finished. You can come out now, diggers.
There's an active Emission out there. Stay in cover!
Listen up, diggers! We got reports of an Emission coming, so get to cover.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_Restore: I’d like to smooth things over with you guys. I can't have a drink in peace when they're staring at me like that.
Well, the boys have been saying some stuff about you. Nasty stuff.
If you don’t want them spitting on you — or worse — you're gonna have to make an effort.
Okay. I’ll pass the word along to the boys.
I need to think about it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_konder_0_Upgrade: Ain’t you afraid I might forget to tighten a screw on your gun one day?
Okay, okay, let's see what I can whip up.
Tell me what you wanna upgrade.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_ByeTopi: Just tell me where you need to go. I’ll get you there fast and safe.
You wanna head out? Let’s head out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_HelloTo: If you've got coupons, I can take you anywhere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_InfoTop: The Zone is always changing, like a living thing. If you haven’t been someplace in a while, it’s like you’re going there for the first time.
You kids are always asking me what’s new… try asking what’s old and gone forever for a change!
Fleshes might look clumsy, but if they come in a bunch, they’ll gobble you up just like that. A pile of shit and a couple of teeth — that's what you're gonna be when they're done with you.
Those old routes are more dangerous than ever. How do folks even find them? I have no idea.
A Monolithian bigshot got killed yesterday. You heard? I wonder how they pick a new one – whoever the Monolith points at?
My guys used to ask me to guide them to Wild Island. As a joke. See if the Noontiders would chicken out. Come to think of it now, I’m glad I said no. The boys would’ve been sliced into pieces.
You should've seen the boys doing a runner when Korsh stormed in! Me? I'm no tilt-rotor dick-a-copter to get’em all out, so I evac'ed who I could…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_Meet_3_: Heading out somewhere? I say let’s get as far away from these damn pigs as possible.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_Meet_4_: Now's the time to get yourself a guide. I haven’t even raised my rates — out of pure solidarity, of course.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_Meet_An: Scared? You must have me confused with someone else. Nothing to be scared about.
Yeah, that’s right. If the Zone has ya spooked, there goes your loot!
Well… you might've heard some rumors... actually, never mind. It was a long time ago, and it never really happened.
I'm not done here yet. I just wanted to chat for a bit.
Right-o. It's dead in here, so we can chat all you want.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_Meet_Me: If you need to get someplace, speak up. Whatever they tell you about Bonkers, I know my trade.
Ready to go? Gettin’ scared yet?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_ResumeT: I'm out of it these days… Ah, that's it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_kukuha_0_TravelT: If you've got the coupons, I'm your man. Where to?
Well, where do you wanna go?
I can take you where you need to go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_maksimyc_0_InfoT: Garbage's kingpins are already eyeing the Slag Heap. They'll come for us if we don’t sort this out soon.
What, you don’t know? Maybe you’re one of them zombies yourself?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_maksimyc_0_NPC_C: The Brood and the Commissary are gonna tear us apart now. Either them or their masters. What do we do?
Shit hit the fan pretty damn hard... I would've gotten outta here already, but I’m broke...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_opening_1_63427: Okay, I guess they’ve wasted all their bullets. Come on in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_BusyTopic: Can’t you see I’m busy right now?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_ByeTopic_: Get lost. You're stinking up the place.
You take care now. Don't squander your health — you won’t get it back.
If you need fixing, come see me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_HealTopic: So, what is it? A big wart on your ass?
Are you kidding me? You’re as healthy as a horse.
Show me what you got. I’ll take care of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_HelloTopi: No anesthesia for you. I’m running low on supplies.
Good to see you. Man, you really oughta be more careful out there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_InfoTopic: No matter how tough they might look, folks around here are just a bunch of kids. Too bad their wars aren't make-believe.
First they shoot each other, then they come here in tears. “Schulz, patch me up, Schulz, save me!” Use your damn brain for once!
If you take a bullet or get mauled by a monster, don't spare the bandages! Dress the wound right away, before you lose too much blood.
I’ve got more work now, of course, but less than expected. Those Monolithians don’t spare the wounded.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_Meet_3_1_: So, the circus is gone, but the clowns stayed behind. We’ll see how long it'll last.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_Meet_4_1_: Everyone's losing it. Stocking up on psi-pills like crazy. As if they're any good, yeah…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_Meet_Meet: Another patient, eh? Are you here to talk business, or just stopping by?
I can fix you up if you’ve got the coupons. If you’re broke, well... as long as you can still walk, you’ll have to do a little work for me.
Don’t look at me like that. Even fleshes ain’t treated for free, and they’re good for something, at least.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Terricon_Hub_sulc_0_TradeTopi: Okay,  since you're here, I`ll take a look.
Take it. When it comes to meds, overkill is underrated.
It never hurts to restock your medkit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TestQuestFilypchukSQ_AskForHe: Hey, you, stalker, help me to save my fellow
I have no time to solve your problem
just go in this way, he should be in 200 m from here
harry up, he can be still alive
I hope he is alive, but no way that I could help him in this shape
We were on our way to hiding place as suddenly mutants came to us. I manage to escape but my mate still there
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TestQuestFilypchukSQ_TalkToSa: You appear here just in time and saved my ass
Don't take it personal, it's all about money
If you go this way you'll find stash
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TestQuest_QTC_86_Dialog_with_: Well, I'm thinking where to go. I heard that one of these rooms contained something... an "artifact". But I have a bad feeling. I don't really want to hang around the ruins more than needed.
If you want, I can search in one of them. Just tell me what to look for
Looks like your hunch didn't let you down. I only found dogs there and the corpse of some poor guy
Any guess who that could be?
Probably Yarik. He also went for search... two days ago. What happened to him? Dogs?
Tell me what are you looking for after all
Well... it's... gorilka. Ivan said there must be a big stash somewhere. So what happened to Yarik?
Shit. Poor bastard, he didn't even drink for the last time
Seems like your friend found that stash and decided not to share with you. And obviously, he overestimated his capabilities
What a piece of shit. And he used to call himself a friend. Well, it's good that at least one bottle left here
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TestQuest_Valentyn_ReceiveTes: Bring me my item, I marked on your map.
I will give valuable loot in return.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TestWFRQuest_Test1_no_58043: d asd sad as dasd a
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_TestWFRQuest_Test1_yes_58042: d sad asd asd asd sa
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Kolesnyk_Arrive_To_Body_: So here you go. Now what?
Thank you. That's all. Here's something for your trouble.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Kolesnyk_Dimon_Looks_For: Hello, you look worried. Is something on your mind?
Hello, I'm wondering about my friend who went to some sketchy deal in the garage nearby.
Now I'm thinking about following him but not sure if it's safe.
Can you go first and look what happened?
Ok, I'll go but everything I find is mine. Except your friend.
Why did you ask then? Go away
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Kolesnyk_Get_Back_No_Art: Hey, I'm back. And I have news which you may not like
Well, what appears to be remains of your friend is just around the corner. I didn't come close.
It's in that building nearby. I'll meet you there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Kolesnyk_Get_Back_With_L: When I approached - you looked strange and then I appeared nearby with this bag... Anyway
I've found your friend. Well, what's left of him.
Well that was expected. Can you at least take me to him?
You can find him behind that wall. Meet you there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Zubarieva_aleks_lesnik_M: Ти лісник, так? Чув, що ти знаєш кожен шлях через ці хащі.
Знаю. Але досвід тут дорожче за артефакти. Чого хочеш?
Мені потрібно дістатися до центру лісу.
Дорога завжди є, але питання — чи виведе вона тебе назад. Якщо підеш туди — краще не озирайся.
Мені потрібно дістатися до центру лісу, до старої обсерваторії. Кажуть, там ховається те, що може змінити хід подій у Зоні.
Обсерваторія? Ти не перший, хто її шукає. І майже ніхто не повернувся. Ти знаєш, що там? Це місце живе своїм життям.
Є стежка через Туманий гай, але там повно аномалій і псевдособак. Іди на схід, до старого дуба з розщепленим стовбуром. Далі стежка сама тебе знайде... або ти її.
Я не такий як інші і знаю, що ризик великий. Але вибору немає. Мені потрібна дорога.
Іди на схід, до старого дуба з розщепленим стовбуром. Далі стежка сама тебе знайде... або ти її.
Не поспішай. Зона не любить тих, хто квапиться.
Твій досвід недостатній. Зона не терпить поспіху. Маєш заплатити за зневагу.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Zubarieva_aleks_lesnik_S: Знову прийшов? Думаєш, цього разу Зона стане до тебе добрішою?
Просто хочу впевнитися, що я йду у правильному напрямку.
Напрямок один - вперед. Але чи правильний він, ти дізнаєшся лише на прикінці шляху. Ти ж знаєш: Зона не змінюється, тільки ти.
Кожного разу, коли ти вирушаєш, Зона слухає тебе. Тільки ось відповідь може бути іншою. Лише вперед.
Минуле не має значення. Ти це зрозумієш, коли перестанеш питати.
Воля твоя, але я тебе попередив: Зона - це жива сутність і вона проти того, щоб ти туди йшов.
Туманний гай на схід. Шлях один і той же, але що на ньому - вирішить не карта. Щасти.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Zubarieva_bandit_0_BusyT: Нема мені коли с тобою варнякати. Забирай старого і шуруйте, поки я не передумав.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Zubarieva_bandit_0_MainD: Можемо домовитися. Ти мені старого, а я 2000 грошей на твій рахунок.
А ти діловий мужик, поважаю. Забирай старого.
Мені потрібен той мужик, якого ви взяли у полон.
А тобі, шо з того? Ти шо рятівник?
Ого, ну тоді забирай. Ой, ні, сорян, передумав.
Ти знаєш з ким говориш? Поки ти під стіл пішки ходив, я таких як ти об коліно ламав.
Сорян, зі мною ці лякалки не проканаяють. Хлопці, валіть його!
Вибачаюсь, не признав. Забирай свого мужика, він нам не потрібен
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Zubarieva_grisa_valenok_: Поговоримо, як приведеш Батю.
Скіфе, сюди!
З тобою приємно мати справу, Гріша.
Ось твій Батя живий-здоровий, як замовляв.
Скіф, ти не уявляєш наскільки я тобі вдячний. Це наша подяка.
А ще візьми координати сховку, він тут недалечко.
Дякую.
Грошей дам більше, ветеран.
З тобою приємно мати справу, Гріша.
Пробач, Грішо...Кляті собаки...
Принаймі ми спробували...
Тримай ці координати. Там сховок, йому вже ці речі не знадобляться.
Добре, дам на 2000 більше, ніж планував. Візьмешся?
Так, домовились.
Скіф, не нахабній. Я нормальні гроші пропоную. То берешся?
Так.
Добре, я доможу тобі.
Згоден допомогти, але заплатити доведеться більше, бо Батя має цінний предмет.
Мало не забув.
Чого ще?
Батя ще той параноїк - просто так з тобою не піде. Дай йому цей предмет, віддаси йому, бо інакше не довіриться.
Не буду. Потрібна допомога. Та, Батя....коротше...біда! Його бандити стопнули, під руки схватили і затягли до себе. Я боюсь йти, вони мене вб'ють.
Я не займаюсь такими справами задарма.
Все буде у кращому вигляді. Нагороду отримаєш у повному розмірі, коли приведеш Батю живого.
Я чув, що ти шукав мене. Маєш якусь справу чи знову дурні анекдоти мені розказувати будеш?
Добре, віддам. Давай свій предмет.
Дякую, Скіфе, я не забуду. Скажеш Баті, що хай веде тебе у те місце, ну він знає, він покаже тобі. Я буду чекати на вас там.
Бандити крадуть людей, коли ті мають або знають, щось цінне. Що має або знає Батя?
Від тебе нічого не приховати. Так, Батя має одну цінну річ, але він їм її не віддасть.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Test_Zubarieva_rad_batejko_0_: Бісове поріддя, зараз натрамбуємо тобі писка!
Чого тобі? Я тим собакам нічого не сказав і тобі не скажу!
Я не скажу тобі, виродку, нічого. Так само як не сказав іншим.
Не нервуйся так. Я від Гріши, прийшов тебе врятувати.
Як мені знати, що ти не таке саме кончене брехло як інші? Всі ви хочете забрати у мене мою реліквію, але, Богом клянусь, ти її точно не отримаєш.
Вибач, погарячкував. Давай вибиратися звідси. Я покажу куди йти.
Я такого не потерплю, ти вважай дохлий, старий.
Тримай, Гріша попереджав, що ти трохи недовірливий. Він сказав, що ти знаєш, де місце зустрічі.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Tets_AA_General_Draft_Comment: Attention, stalkers! The Emission will start any moment now.
Attention, stalkers! The Emission’s coming. I repeat, the Emission’s coming. No one leaves shelter.
The Emission’s over. All in one peace I hope?
Where’re you taking that stiff, you moron?
One day I’ll get stripped by some jerk too...
Looks like it’s going to rain...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_WildIsland_Dialog_BarmenCamp_: How the fuck else am I gonna keep my head on straight?
If I told you it's sausage, would you believe me?
Vodka, of course. Our most precious commodity.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_WildIsland_Dialog_MedicCamp_c: So much death. I do what I can, but I fear for the worst.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_WildIsland_Dialog_MedicCamp_f: I'm not surprised you ended up this way. The hare never stops to consider the wolf’s weaknesses. It just runs like hell.
What is surprising, is just how many hares have made their home here in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_WildIsland_Dialog_MedicCamp_s: A pity so few of us understand the situation you’re in.
Well… It's a relief to know that at least someone in the Zone can think beyond the next glass of vodka.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_Audiolog_Garpia_1_6: I’m sick of being stuck here, Deggy. Let me go out on patrol one more time.
We’ve been over this, Harpy. You’re a good soldier, and I thank you for your service, but given your injury, it’s too risky for you to go on patrol.
You've pulled guys out of a tight spot before, but you can’t do it anymore. And there’s no way to tell if they're gonna be able to rescue you either.
I need your expertise here in Yaniv. If you’re tired of tinkering with stuff, then go help Nor. You can recruit good free stalkers to run errands for me.
Loud and clear, sir. Fine, I’ll keep tinkering and chit-chatting with strangers all day. But one day you just might need some real help from me, Degtyarev. You’ll see.
And when that day comes, I know where to find you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_Audiolog_Nor_1_6241: Howdy, Nor! Got yourself a flat butt from all that sitting around Yaniv?
I stopped by our old hiding spot, the one where we used to hide from the Corps. Remember those days?
I’m gonna have a smoke and start looking for Monolith stashes, or whatever else Degtyarev is hiding around here.
Get out of there, Tick! No one's allowed in that sector, not even with a pass. And you don’t have one — I’ve checked the lists.
Well, in that case, you better warn your boys. You’re in charge.
Degtyarev is the one in charge, and he’s ordered his men to shoot on sight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_1_1_62183: Any idea who’s gonna replace Hawaiian at the bar? I’ve heard he’s leaving for the Mainland — health issues.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_1_1_62186: He’s been “leaving for the Mainland” ever since I joined the Corps. And naive stalkers throw him a farewell party every damn day. He’s raking in the dough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_1_1_62188: They should’ve spent their coupons on better gear instead. You wouldn’t believe the old junk I find on their corpses sometimes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_2_1_62190: Here’s a riddle for you: there’s a dead stalker in Prypiat. He managed to dig his way in somehow. Can you guess what killed him?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_2_1_62194: You did him in during a raid?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_2_1_62195: Nah, he did it all by himself. The idiot turned off his comms so we couldn’t track him and ended up getting caught in an Emission!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_3_1_62290: Allowing the Monolithians into Prypiat was a smart move!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_3_1_62291: Why’s that? We’re gonna have our hands full.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_3_1_62292: Not really — the mutants and the Monolithians will wipe each other out. Then we’ll just clean up whatever’s left.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_4_1_62297: I wonder how many Monolithians have drunk to your health while posing as stalkers here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_4_1_62298: I had Strider stop by once. He said his brothers don’t drink at all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_4_1_62300: They don’t? Maybe that’s why their brains got fried.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_5_1_62398: I've heard some stalkers found an apartment in Prypiat, and someone still lives in it. I wonder who.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_5_1_62399: We’ll be hearing a lot more bullshit like that now that they’re letting all the stalkers in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_GCA_5_1_62400: Wouldn’t be surprised if it was Degtyarev's place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_10_1_6231: Stay safe! Buy some anti-rad from Bonesetter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_11_1_6240: Gear up and get ready to run into a Monolithian!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_12_1_6240: Come to Hawaiian’s and raise a glass in honor of those who’ve fallen in Prypiat!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_13_1_6240: Clashes between factions are strictly prohibited! We've got a common enemy here: the Monolith!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_14_1_6240: Who’s up for hunting some Monolithians? Get in line!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_15_1_6240: Hey stalker, stock up on meds from Bonesetter and get yourself a new gun at Wreck’s!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_1_1_62166: The list has been finalized by Degtyarev. We won’t be adding any new names.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_2_1_62171: Garry the guide won’t take you to Prypiat. Any groups approved by Degtyarev make the trip on their own.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_3_1_62174: We don't do any search and rescue operations in Prypiat. You’re on your own out there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_4_1_62177: If you're planning to give your guns to Harpy for repairs, clean 'em first!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_5_1_62181: Don’t bring any corpses to Yaniv. Bonesetter already has his hands full.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_7_1_62306: Just because Monolith got into Prypiat doesn’t mean you will. No stalkers allowed!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_8_1_62310: Hey stalker, don’t forget to upgrade your gear! Wreck’s shop is open 24/7.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_PropTopic_9_1_62312: Prypiat is an extremely dangerous place as long as the Monolith is there. Stay alert!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_ByeTopic_By: Run along now. I won’t keep you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_HelloTopic_: Since you’re here, come on in.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_InfoTopic_1: A stalker is responsible for his own safety, not his guide. Uncle Lyonya is the only guide in the Zone who babysits his clients. That is not an option here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_InfoTopic_2: Never thought we’d have a Monolithian among us. He was always looking after the rookies.
So much for trusting people in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_Meet_1_6204: Welcome to our boring routine. Prypiat’s off limits without proper clearance. If your name isn’t on the list, you’re stuck on this side of Yaniv.
The Red Forest isn’t exactly a vacation either, so you better get ready.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_Meet_2_1_62: Who would’ve thought the Monolithians would ever come back? We helped the Noontiders get set up on Wild Island. It didn't seem like they were gonna cause any trouble out there.
Now some stalkers are trying to run from the Monolithians while others have this stupid urge to come here and look at them. Meanwhile, Prypiat is off limits to everyone.
So what route do you plan to take?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_Meet_3_1_62: If you were thinking about going to Prypiat, this is your chance. Degtyarev’s Corps has their hands full — regular stalkers are the least of their concerns now.
But keep in mind that that place is still as dangerous as ever — maybe even more so with Monolith around.
If you’re up for it, let’s go. But remember, even if you tag along, you’re on your own out there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garik_2_TravelTopic: All right, we can get moving. But I can’t promise you you'll make it back.
Where do you want me to take you?
Just tell me where you want to go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garpia_0_ByeTopic_B: Let’s see what else you can find me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garpia_0_HelloTopic: You again! Thanks for ruining my lunch.
All right, my smoke break can wait. What’ve you got?
Be quick about it, my tea’s getting cold.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garpia_0_InfoTopic_: I may not have the best aim anymore, but when it comes to disassembling and reassembling guns, I’m the quickest in all of Yaniv.
I can make you a rifle out of a stick and some duct tape, but if a stalker can’t figure out how to hold a gun, it won’t do him any good.
To tackle Prypiat, a stalker’s gotta be among the Zone’s elite. But we keep getting greenhorns who shouldn’t have made it to Yaniv in the first place.
Even now, they’d jump at a chance to get into Prypiat. Degtyarev made the right call by locking them out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garpia_0_Meet_1_620: Another sour puss. What’s with the long face? Degtyarev didn’t give you a pass, eh? You ought to be thankful he didn’t.
I’ve been guarding the Boundary for a decade now, and trust me, you’re better off here. But if you’re itching to impress Degtyarev’s Corps, I can hook you up with a side gig — paid, of course.
Or did you swing by just to get your gun fixed? Well, show it to me while I’m still here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garpia_0_Meet_2_1_6: It's too bad those Monolithians didn’t show up when I was on active duty. That would've been one hell of a hunt!
But regular stalkers... they don’t belong in Prypiat. Those fanatics'll put them down in a heartbeat. They don’t even spare the wounded.
Get ready, just to be safe. If you’ve got anything that needs fixing, hand it over now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garpia_0_Meet_3_1_6: Hey there, daredevil. You heading to Prypiat? I tell ya, that place can turn a vet into a rookie and make him cry for his momma.
Out there, no one’s gonna wipe your butt or fix your gun. But I can help you with that. The gun, I mean.
Now make sure you get everything sorted out before I step out for a smoke.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_garpia_0_UpgradeTop: I couldn’t fuck it up, even if I wanted to.
I’ll fix it in no time.
I can fix anything for enough coupons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_gavaec_0_ByeTopic_B: Hope we can toss a few more sometime.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_gavaec_0_HelloTopic: You stick out like a sore thumb around here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_gavaec_0_InfoTopic_: I’m so sick of the food here. Wish I could have something homemade. There was a guy called the Chef who claimed he could make chicken Kyiv right here in the Zone. Too bad he didn’t live to prove it.
When I make it back to the Mainland, the first thing I’m gonna do is have some real chicken Kyiv.
I’m doing pretty well, but sometimes I feel like I’d trade all my loot for an apple. I don’t care if it’s rotten or full of worms, as long as it’s from my apple tree back home.
When I make it back to the Mainland, the first thing I’m gonna do is eat a pound of apples. Scratch that — make it two pounds!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_gavaec_0_Meet_1_619: Are you new here? Me, I’ve been in Yaniv for a while now. I used to be a trader. I was always stuck inside... to be honest, sometimes I felt like there was no way out.
These days I serve drinks to customers, but that won't last long. I’m heading back to the Mainland to take a break and work on my health. I’ve had enough of the Zone.
So, how about a drink to my health? On you, of course.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_gavaec_0_Meet_2_1_6: I can barely keep my supplies in stock! They keep drinking 'cuz of all the stress, and can't even get drunk anymore.
A lot of folks regret not leaving for the Mainland in time. I’ve decided it’s time for me to go.
If I’m not around next time you’re here, pour one for me. Or maybe you’d rather do it right now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_gavaec_0_Meet_3_1_6: Don’t you find it odd how Degtyarev opened Prypiat to stalkers all of a sudden?
First he had that list of his, then he locked everybody out, and now, with the Monolith around, he’s suddenly letting everybody in. Maybe he thinks the stalkers are gonna do more good than harm...
Anyway, it’s none of my business. My business here is pouring vodka. Care for a drink?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_gavaec_0_TradeTopic: Don't expect any discounts from me.
Anything I’ve got is yours. I’ll even give you a discount!
I got all the shit you’re ever gonna need.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_ByeTopic_Bye: Step aside. You’re blocking my merchandise.
If you find any artifacts, you know where to take them.
If you’re too stingy, don’t come crying to me later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_HelloTopic_H: Are you gonna stand there twiddling your thumbs, or buy something?
Don’t be afraid. Come on over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_InfoTopic_1_: It’s better to walk around rich and witless than run away scared shitless.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_InfoTopic_2_: They say it's always darkest before the dawn. Bullshit! In the Zone, it's always darkest before you get clobbered by a fucking Emission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_Meet_1_62112: I don’t recall seeing you here before. I’ve got everything you need, and my stuff is top-notch. You won’t find anything better in Yaniv.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_Meet_1_62113: There was this one guy who tried to find a better deal and ended up buying used gear from a stalker. He never came back from Prypiat, and no one’s bothering to look for his corpse.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_Meet_1_62114: I stand by the quality of my merchandise. Take your pick.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_Meet_2_1_622: The Zone rewards the well-prepared. And with Monolith right next door, you better stock up. Better safe than sorry.
There was this one guy who tried to calculate everything. He figured running light would be quicker. But he couldn’t outrun a Monolithian’s bullet.
So my advice is: think twice and buy thrice. Take your pick.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_Meet_3_1_623: Heading to Prypiat, eh? I’ve noticed quite a few of your kind passing through here lately, but not all of them make it back.
There was this one guy who wouldn’t stop bragging about his fancy gun, but he skimped on ammo. A couple days later, another stalker brought me that same piece to sell.
So if you don’t want your gear to end up on my counter, get your coupons ready now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_hana_0_TradeTopic_T: No one’s ever complained about the quality of my goods.
If I were you, I’d rather run out of coupons here than bullets out there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_korica_0_InfoTopic_: Every day, there’s a line waiting to enter Prypiat. They’re all loaded up on ammo and ready for the hunt.
Except that in Prypiat, you’re not the hunter... you’re the prey.
I figured most stalkers would scatter once they heard Monolith was in Prypiat. But no, some guys actually want to get closer to the action.
The smart ones have been drawin' up their wills in advance. And the really smart ones... well, they get the hell out of here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_korica_0_NPC_Intera: Whatcha waitin' for? If you wanna get to Prypiat, you better get a move on before we start drawin' up a new list.
Freeze! Entry to Prypiat is available by permit only. If you’re not on the list, you ain’t gettin' in.
Freeze! Monolithians have infiltrated Prypiat. Entry is prohibited until further notice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_korica_0_chatter_1_: The equipment sent through the Red Forest didn’t make it. Looks like we’ll have to buy it from the stalkers again.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_korica_0_chatter_2_: The Monolithians are packing some serious heat. Their gear is as good as the Wardens'. While we barely got enough ammo to get by.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_korica_0_chatter_3_: Stalkers are so eager to get to the Dead Valley, you’d think there were exoskeletons buried under every bush.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_kostoprav_0_ByeTopi: Remember to look for shelter during Emissions.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_kostoprav_0_HealTop: You’re as fit as a Burer.
I’ll take care of it. You’ll be as good as new.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_kostoprav_0_InfoTop: Stalkers enjoy solving the mysteries of the Zone, but what they love even more is making up their own mysteries.
Any corpse found in Prypiat with no bullet wounds gives rise to all sorts of wild theories about the cause of death.
As far as I’m concerned, the cause of death is always the same: the Zone got him.
I’m tired of dissecting regular stalkers. But I have to admit, the prospect of examining a dead Monolithian’s head does pique my curiosity.
I wonder what’s going on inside their skulls... after all, their brains are usually melted beyond recognition.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_kostoprav_0_Meet_1_: Yaniv has changed hands and new mutants have appeared in the Zone, but the stalkers keep on bringing me corpses.
I don’t like doing autopsies, and I hope for both our sakes that your body never ends up on my table.
However, I can do a checkup for you. Want one?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_kostoprav_0_Meet_2_: I can finally take a break. No one’s bringing in any dead, and the living tend to stay away.
The Monolithians shoot to kill. Those who cross paths with them don’t make it back to me.
If you’re here and in one piece, consider yourself lucky. Need me to run a checkup?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_kostoprav_0_Meet_3_: I’ve been stitching them up all day and handing out anti-rad like candy. Feels just like the good old days.
Why are they so eager to get to Prypiat? Can’t they go die somewhere else?
Are you heading out there? Let me run a checkup while you’re still in one piece.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_kostoprav_0_TradeTo: I'll sell you whatever I’ve got.
I don’t have much for sale, but take a look.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_molotok_0_ByeTopic_: Don’t wander off. I’ll track you down if I have to.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_molotok_0_InfoTopic: Loners have been dropping like flies in Prypiat. I've been picking off a trespasser or two myself on every patrol. But the line to get in just keeps getting longer.
But I guess if they’re chasing artifacts, I sorta get it. I’ve come across a few myself. Powerful stuff.
I’ve been kind of fascinated by artifacts lately. I used to think they were all the same, but nope! When I come across one on a stalker’s body, I take a moment to examine it. Each is unique.
Some of them are incredibly beautiful... it’s almost a shame to sell them. But you never know what they might do to you. Besides, once we deal with the Monolith, I can always find some more.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_molotok_0_chatter_1: Entering Prypiat without proper authorization is basically volunteering to get taken out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_molotok_0_chatter_2: The Monolithians go to places I was never authorized to patrol.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_molotok_0_chatter_3: I earn more dough selling artifacts to the merchant than I do in the service.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_BusyTopic_1: I’m busy enough as it is.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_HelloTopic_: What the hell are you doing here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_HubClose_1_: Yaniv is under attack! No one's allowed in until we handle it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_HubInfo_1_6: Yaniv is the safest place around here. Prypiat is just past here.
Degtyarev’s Corps makes sure that no one passes through without authorization. He personally reviews and approves the list of stalkers permitted to enter or exit Prypiat.
If you’re not on the list, you can’t get in. I strongly advise against trying to enter without proper authorization. We’re pretty strict about it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_HubOpen_1_6: It’s over! Yaniv is open for entry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_InfoTopic_1: I believe that the Zone and the stalkers are connected in some way. Look at Bonesetter: never leaves the base, but he can always sense an Emission coming.
As for me, the Zone guided me here for my past misdeeds... but not as punishment. I was sent here to help others avoid making the same mistakes I made.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_InfoTopic_2: The Zone’s first rule is “do no harm.” To yourself, at least.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_Meet_1_6222: The name’s Nor. I’m in charge here. It's my job to make sure Degtyarev’s orders are followed.
Back in the day, this station was split between Duty and Freedom, while the stalkers stripped Prypiat of anything of value. I was no saint, either…
These days, Degtyarev’s Corps is in control, and that’s why we have order here. I’m doing my best to keep it that way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_Meet_2_1_62: Have you heard that the Monolith is in Prypiat? Yeah, those are the neighbors we've got now.
Degtyarev’s latest orders have closed access to Prypiat for everyone — even those who used to be on the list.
He did the right thing. Regular stalkers have no business going there these days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_Meet_3_1_62: Degtyarev personally put all the forces in Prypiat on high alert.
As long as the Monolith is around, nobody’s worried about keeping rogue loners out of Prypiat or checking lists. In theory, the road’s open to anyone.
However, I'd still advise against going into Prypiat. Compared to that place, everywhere else in the Zone is just peace and quiet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_NPC_Emissio: The Emission is over! You can go outside now!
Stalkers, take cover! There's an Emission coming!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_rudoj_0_RestoreRepu: We started off on the wrong foot. How about we make amends?
I’m here because Degtyarev gave me a second chance. That’s why I’m willing to give you an opportunity to prove that we can count on you.
If you want to be part of Yaniv, you need to  contribute.
I need to think about it.
Come back once you’ve made up your mind.
Then welcome to Yaniv. Make yourself at… Yaniv.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_vita_ryzak_0_InfoTo: Back in the day, you’d walk through a ravine without knowing what's around the corner. But now… everything got mapped out a long time ago.
And I thought, "this kindergarten ain’t no place for a veteran stalker."
So I came to Prypiat, and… here, I feel like a rookie myself.
I thought Strider had set his men straight. Turns out they were just playing dumb. They locked themselves up on that island, and now they've put their plan into action. Sons of bitches!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Yanov_Hub_vita_ryzak_0_chatte: The veterans here wouldn’t freaking mentor us. They stick together and ignore the rookies.
There’s nothing left for us to do in Prypiat. I’ve heard even Degtyarev left the place.
I wanted to go to Prypiat, too, but then I took a bullet in the knee.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_AboutGuide_AboutG: What exactly does a guide do?
Guides help lads get where they need to go in one piece. Of all the Zone’s ways, us guides know the safest ones.
Or at least they say they do. Them lot will take ye somewhere, another camp or an early grave. Just kidding, me boy... just kidding.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_AboutTechnician_A: They make sure your gun barrel doesn’t fall off when you most need it. And if it does, at least they'll be here to replace it.
Why does the Zone need technicians?
Weapons upgrades, repairs – that’s us. Armor, too. You can’t roam the Zone in a crappy vest. Not for long, at least.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_Audiolog_Photo_1_: Wow, looks gorgeous! If Lens’s cameras didn’t conk out after every Emission, I could’ve taken me some amazing pics… I mean, the Poppy Field alone! Just think about showing it to the rookies…
But them lot would all rush over to see it on their own. Unprepared, with no plan…
Forget it, old spice. Sometimes beauty just ain’t meant to be seen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_Closing_Hub_Closi: Zalissya is under attack! Everyone, get back to your homes, and keep your heads down!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_33963: Man, I had a good run. Got three whole artifacts. Hamster was jumping with freaking joy. I could go back any day now…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_63667: So what are you still doing here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_63668: Fuck knows. It’s like I gotta, but… you can’t even see the sunset out there, right? Just concrete boxes all the way to the sky.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_63670: And at night, lights everywhere. Can’t see a single star. Here, there’s a whole bunch of ’em. Pick your favorite.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_63671: That’s it. The Zone’s got you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_1_GCA_1_63672: Nah. It’s the Mainland that finally let me go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_58995: First, the Duty and Freedom beef, now the Ward showed up and there’s another coup brewing up. Why can’t folks just live and let live? Is it a Zone thing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_58996: Yeah, sure. It’s one hell of a Zone thing – you’re getting wasted at the bar every night instead of settling your debt with Mykolayich.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_58997: What the fuck’s that s’posed to mean, man? I’ve been buying your drinks every time!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_58998: It’s not a Zone thing. It’s a human thing. We just can’t stop screwing up our lives.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_2_GCA_2_58999: How the hell are we supposed to stay sober knowing that?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_28793: I heard Uncle Lyonya’s back at his usual place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_28815: Yeah. He showed up as soon as they lifted the restrictions. Says he missed going out on runs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_28816: Why wasn’t he guiding folks around the Lesser Zone when the borders were closed? Always complained about his knees, but it’s a pretty short trip, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_28817: Yeah, keep listening to his whining. He could run all the way to Yaniv and back like it’s a walk in the park.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_3_GCA_3_28820: Guess he had his reasons to lay low.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_59736: So where does an ordinary stalker find a little peace and quiet? Here I am in the Zone, surrounded by miracles... how come it isn’t making me happy?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_59737: Have a little fresh bread with your stew after a run, get some drinks with your pals, chat about life. That’s happiness. Got nothing to do with miracles.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_59738: Come on, Ruby, like you can’t do that back home! That’s not what I’m talking about. Remember how it felt on your first day here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_59739: If that’s what you’re lookin’ for, head north – past the Red Forest, or even farther, over the Boundary. To Prypiat, the CNPP, the Wish Granter…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_4_GCA_4_59740: All you’re gonna find there is a bullet for your head and rads for your guts. The guys who make it back ain’t ever gonna be the same.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_5_1_59745: We’ve set up our defenses, we’ve got volunteers patrolling the area… but is it enough?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_5_1_59746: Grab a drink and chill out. We’ve done all we can. Getting all worked up about the Monolithians ain’t good for your nerves.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_5_1_59747: I get it. But I still can’t sleep. Every time I hear gunshots, I get the jitters.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_GCA_5_1_59748: All the more reason to have a drink. Or you can head to Rostok – they might give you some meds.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_Opening_Hub_Openi: All right, you can come out now. But remember, you’re in the Zone, so stay put.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_10_1_60: We don’t shoot at other loners here. Try to pull that shit, and you’re done.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_11_1_60: Zalissya pulled through. We held our ground. This place is, and always will be, a safe haven in the Lesser Zone. We’ll defend it together!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_12_1_60: Volunteers fresh off patrol get drinks on the house.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_13_1_60: If you’ve got any healing artifacts, swing by, and I’ll give you a good deal. Make some cash, save some lives.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_1_1_599: Attention! A quarantine is now in effect. This area is restricted. Please stay where you are.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_2_1_599: The Ward is offering a reward for any information about Squint. The sooner we find him, the faster we can put an end to this unpleasant situation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_3_1_599: The Ward won’t be sticking around here for long, folks. Try to avoid conflict. The less you bump into them, the smoother things will go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_4_1_599: Please remain calm. Ward is clearing the area.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_5_1_599: Any suspicious activity may result in immediate termination.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_6_1_599: Feeling worn out? Caught some rads? Swing by Warlock’s bar for a little R&R!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_7_1_599: If you're not geared up for heading out, Hamster’s got everything you need... and a few extra things he’ll talk you into needing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_8_1_599: Stay away from the Perimeter, and don’t go sniffing around the Sphere. We don’t bother the IPSF, they don’t bother us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_PropTopic_9_1_599: Got an artifact? Don’t rush to Rostok, just stop by my shop! A coupon or two beats getting beaten black and blue.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_HelloTopic: Nice to see you around, man!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_HubInfo_Hu: What can you tell me about Zalissya?
I fought tooth and nail for this place – first against Monolith, then against those Slag Heap scumbags – so that decent stalkers could have a place to crash.
Mutants and anomalies are bullshit, my boy. You’ll figure that out soon enough. The most dangerous thing in the Zone is other people.
We might not all be best buddies here in Zalissya, but we sure as hell ain’t enemies, either. And as long as I’m breathing, it’s gonna stay that way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_InfoTopic_: If you’re bored, have a seat by the fire at the bar. Our jokes might not exactly be subtle, but you just might pick up some useful tips.
You wanna know what's killing the most rookies? Not mutants or anomalies.
It’s their own loose lips. I can keep them safe in Zalissya, but outside the village, it’s every man for himself.
I don’t know what’s in store for us. Nobody does. Things can always get worse, that’s for sure.
But they can also get better. And I choose to hold onto hope, even if my grumpy mug doesn’t look like it.
The Monolith had to retreat from the Duga, but at what cost? The Ward, armed to the teeth! What if those bastards try to take Zalissya again? I dunno, Skif. It’s tough…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_Meet_2_Mee: Didn’t think you’d get involved in this mess, but here we are. You did pretty good, I gotta say.
Something tells me you're gonna be famous in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_Meet_3_Mee: Some things will never be the same anymore. Uncle Lyonya won’t be sitting by the fire, and the bar will need time to get back on its feet.
But we won, Skif. We held our ground! And that means everything’s gonna be all right.
All these years, my boy... they weren’t for nothing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_Meet_meet_: So, have you had a chance to look around yet? This is how we do it around here.
The rules are simple enough: no waving guns around, no brawling, and any disputes get settled outside the village.
And a tip from me: don’t get too close to the Ward. They don’t see you as a human being, just a tool. And, as you’re well aware, tools are disposable.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_NPC_Emissi: The Emission’s over, folks. You can come out now! If you need a medic, you know where to find him.
Listen up, guys! An Emission is coming! Everyone, take shelter!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_bata_0_RestoreRep: I want to mend fences with the loners.
Well, you stirred some shit. I won’t even ask why. Don’t really care.
If you don’t want them stabbing you in the back — or worse — you’ll need to show folks you wanna make things right.
I’m glad we understand each other. I can handle the rest.
I need to think about it.
Well, that’s a choice you’ll have to live with.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_dada_lena_0_Hello: What the hell do you want?
Good to see ya. How can I help?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_dada_lena_0_InfoT: Lens thinks I’m protecting them young lads too much. He says, because of me, they don’t take the Zone seriously, just playing around.
The thing is, Lens wandered off on his own once, and… well, he ain’t walkin' anywhere now. I don’t want them lot to end up like him. And neither does the Gaffer.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_dada_lena_0_Meet_: You’ve made a hell of a scene here, lads. I’ve been stomping around the Lesser Zone for years, but this is the first time I’ve seen this quarantine of yours.
Good thing Uncle Lyonya’s got everything prepared: a shelter for the Emissions, some snacks… A good guide always thinks ahead, me boy!
Well, where are we gonna go?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_dada_lena_0_Trave: All the way to Prypiat, if ya want!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_gosa_sapoznik_0_I: Sukhin’s got the Sphere soldiers by the balls. Poor bastards can't even fart without an order. They used to hang out at our bar back in the day, and now they're shooting at us…
The Ward may be pricks, but they sure know what they’re doing. They’ll have the Zone under their thumb some day, mark my words.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_gosa_sapoznik_SCA: It’s just another day, but I’ve got a bad feeling. Something's coming. And it ain't something good. I can feel it in the air. Yeah, exactly.
If I had a gun like Zotov’s, I’d wanna show it off too…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_homak_0_ByeTopic_: Come on over, I’ll set aside the best stuff for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_homak_0_InfoTopic: They say the Gaffer used to know Strelok himself! The Strelok, who went to the center of the Zone and stirred up so much shit, we’re still talking about it. But the Gaffer won’t say a word, damn it.
Then again, if I knew a dude like him, I guess I’d keep quiet too. Just to stay on the safe side.
I heard IPSF’s gonna call all their lap-dog troops outta the Zone next year.
Over at the Slag Heap, some folks are already talking about stripping the Duga, or maybe looting the Sphere.
If you ask me, I think the Ward’ll just step in for the military, and those guys won’t get squat.
These surprises are making me all paranoid. Like, uh…
Tell me, how could we possibly know Uncle Lyonya was one of them?
