Now I’m freaking out about all the old-timers. What if there's another weird signal, and they all go bonkers too?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_homak_0_Meet_2_Me: Those bastards! Turned the place upside down, ruined my deals... Who cares where my goods came from? What’s it got to do with me? Complicit, my ass…
But what are you gonna say when they put a gun to your head? Crap…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_homak_0_Meet_3_Me: Thanks for helping us out. I thought that basement was the end of me. If they’d tossed a couple of grenades down there, we’d have been and gone.
Monolith takes no prisoners. Maybe that’s for the best…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_homak_0_Meet_meet: I’ve got the best deals in the Zone. Ask anyone, guaranteed! I never try to pull one over on the rookies like Sidor does.
If anything breaks, it’s ’cuz you need to take care of your gear! This stuff’s not made of steel…
Well, except for the things that are. Ahem. Anyway, show me what you’ve got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_homak_0_TradeTopi: Let’s see what kinda crap you brought me.
Best deals for you, Zone's my witness!
Well, show me what you’ve got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_koldun_0_ByeTopic: If you need anything, stop by.
I’ll always keep a bottle ready for you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_koldun_0_HelloTop: This place attracts all kinds of scum…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_koldun_0_InfoTopi: The Gaffer’s a good man. I’ve been with him since we made our way here from the Cordon. We took on the Monolith at the Sphere together. I helped him defend Zalissya and got this bar up and running…
But there’s one thing he doesn’t quite get, stubborn old fool. Risking everyone to save one guy is gonna get you all killed. But he’s still willing to risk it all.
Here, I serve the Wardens just as well as I serve loners, ’cuz I’ve learned my lesson. And the Gaffer’s gonna learn it too, sooner or later.
You got any idea how many years I’ve been battling rats in this joint? A normal rat’s a pain in the ass, but the Zone’s critters can chew up a tank for breakfast.
I thought it was gonna be the end of Zalissya. We put up a fight, sure, but folks were getting serious about bailing on the Zone.
Then, guess what happened the other day? Newbies rolled in. That’s when I knew we’d pull through.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_koldun_0_Meet_2_M: Well, all the drama’s finally over! Anything can be settled with words if you’re willing to talk.
Good luck finding a guy like that, though. Zone folks want it all, and they want it now.
An anomaly? It's gotta be the Oasis! First mission? CNPP! And when it’s about picking a fight, they gotta go up against the Ward. And then we gotta clean up the mess.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_koldun_0_Meet_3_M: Thanks, Skif! You’re welcome at my bar anytime.
Folks who fought with us remember you fondly. Most guys would’ve just walked away, but you stuck with us. Looks like the Gaffer was right – it wasn’t all for nothing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_koldun_0_Meet_mee: You know, when I opened this bar, I never expected to see so many folks here. I guess the guys at the Cordon had enough of that greedy toad Sidor.
Back in the day, it was just me and the Gaffer having a drink here, and now look at us – a whole bar full of lone stalkers.
If the Ward stopped bugging us, that’d be awesome. Let’s toast to that, huh?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_koldun_0_TradeTop: I’ve set it aside just for you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_linza_0_HelloTopi: A decent visitor, finally. Good to see you.
Need anything fixed? Come on, speak up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_linza_0_InfoTopic: Have you seen the Sphere? Do you know what it does? The thing’s mapping the Zone! I wish I could see what’s inside of it, what kind of anomalies are out there – it’s a true miracle.
I still don’t know how the Gaffer got the Chandelier here – that’s the balloon above Zalissya. The huge-ass thing made it all the way from Prypiat!
They say if you go up there, you can still get a heavy dose of rads.
Or if it comes crashing down on our heads…
Zalissya is slowly recovering. We finally gave the fallen a proper burial.
Some fresh-faced rookies have been showing up, and I’m helping them out as best I can.
You can’t do much against Monolith with your grandpa’s rusty old shotgun, you know…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_linza_0_Meet_2_Me: They march in here, make a scene, then walk away, just like that? They don’t know squat about how we roll.
Do they really think barging in and pointing their stupid guns at us is gonna scare folks?
Well, around here, anyone who tries to scare us usually ends up with a bullet in the back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_linza_0_Meet_3_Me: I didn’t honestly think we could hold Zalissya. The Monolith doesn’t mess around!
It’s too bad about the rookies. They weren’t prepared for this.
Honestly, neither were we. But we’ll be on our guard from now on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_linza_0_Meet_meet: Are you new here? Come on in, make yourself at home – but don’t get too comfy. If you need anything fixed, I’m your man.
If you wanna swap some stories, go to Mykolayich. Or the Gaffer. They’ve got all kinds of baloney to choose from.
All right, come on. What've you got there?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_linza_0_UpgradeTo: The kind of people I have to work with… Fine. Let’s see what you’ve got.
For you, I’ll do my best.
Tell me what you need, and I’ll see what I can do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_ByeTop: Let’s hope this is the last time we bump into each other.
Stay safe. And be careful out there in the field.
If you need my help, you know where to find me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_HealTo: I’m out of painkillers. You’ll have to tough it out.
Are you kidding? You’re perfectly fine.
I’ll take good care of you!
What the hell happened to you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_HelloT: You’re a waste of good bandages… All right, what's the matter?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_InfoTo: Back on the Mainland, they never trusted me with anything important. I didn’t spend seven years in med school to stitch paper cuts and write reports for professors my whole life.
But I really wanted to help people, so… I came here. Man, it’s like a fairy tale! All these artifacts… A real miracle!
They’re dangerous, sure. But so is open heart surgery. Should we stop doing it? No way, bro! I’ve brought so many folks back to life… They need me here.
There was this one stalker who thought he could waltz into an anomaly field without a detector. He said he believed in the miracles of the Zone.
You know what the real miracle is? That he somehow made it to me alive with all those injuries.
I didn’t think we’d make it, but somehow we pulled through.
If I’d used medkits, I would’ve lost so many guys... but with artifacts, I managed to save them!
I had to give away most of my stock, but it was worth it. As long as Zalissya still stands, Warlock’ll get me new ones.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_Meet_2: I should’ve snatched a couple of medkits from the Ward. You wouldn’t happen to have any?
Eh, forget it. Someone’s gonna open their mouth, and Zotov’ll come snooping around tryin’ to find out where we got ’em.
Our medkits are just as good as theirs, and if you know how to use artifacts, you don’t need ’em anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_Meet_3: We took it too easy, and now we've paid for it.
Zalissya is barely hanging on, if at all.
But it doesn’t matter. We’ll recover. We’ll mend and rebuild. I won’t give up this village, or any of our people.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_Meet_m: Try not to get caught in an Emission out there in the field. Few people can survive it, and those who do…
No artifact or medication can help them. Trust me – I’ve tried everything.
Sorry, I always feel a little off after an Emission. I don't think I’ll ever get used to it. How can I help?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_nikolaic_0_TradeT: I might have something I can share.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_rubincik_0_InfoTo: Everyone used to hang out at the Cordon until Sidor went full asshole. He’s milking the rookies like freaking cows. If it wasn't for the Gaffer and Warlock, I’d still be paying that dude for my first gun.
I can finally get outta the Lesser Zone now. But where should I go? And what’s the point, anyway?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_rubincik_0_Resume: So... what were we chattin’ about?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_rubincik_SCAction: Some hot tea would be perfect right about now, strong and spicy as hell…
Wherever I go, those damn pigs just won’t leave me alone… why the hell did I ever leave Garbage?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_sasa_rabcik_0_Inf: It’s a lot better since we switched over to Myklukha’s coupons. Back in the day, you’d walk around with those stupid papers like a dumbass. Now it’s all on your PDA.
This used to be Monolith turf. The Sphere too, I think. Word is, you can still find their stashes around. If I ever found one, I’d head straight to Yantar with that kinda gear!
Monolith… it’s crazy, man! I used to think, “I wish I could find their stashes and score some loot…” Well, turns out they beat us to the punch!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_Zalesie_Hub_sasa_rabcik_SCAct: So I'm sitting here, just trying to chill, and some bastard thing out there keeps on howling. I almost feel sorry for it, man. Why won't the damn thing shut up?
All the anomalies here have been picked clean. I gotta head over to Prypiat…
No way in hell I’m going deeper into the Zone after this shit. Thought I’d make it all the way to Prypiat, but fuck that!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuestBandit: I say you are in deep shit! Give me everything you have and i might let you leave alive.
You are smarter than you look! Now scram.
Your choice! Anu patsani, mochite etu shelupon!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_1000_: Fair deal, a 1000 kupons will be waiting for you once you return with a microscope.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_100_7: He he, that's a very nice deal, agreed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_Alrea: Ohh how convenient, i would like to buy it off of you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_Askin: Yes brother! I need a microscope for something, would you help me find it?
(it's actually a Scanner, just pretend it's a microscope)
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_Give_: Oh, thank you so much brother!
Now I'm finally going to see what Yar has!
Oh, thank you so much brother!
Now I'm finally going to see what Yar has!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_MyCro: What? No! I need to see what Yar has!
Then i will just take it from your corpse!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_NMI_7: Yeah I heard there might be one in the warehouse not far from here, i will mark it on your map.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_No_mi: Oh well, i will loan you this. It might help you take back my precious microscope from those assholes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_Payme: Of course, how much do you want for your services?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_MyQuest_milli: Very funny, now say how much you really want.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_hello1_2_7073: I lost a thing? help me find it
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_irizanenko_test_hello1_Need_m: Where you were when you lost it
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_conflict_back_7: So you are back! Have you found out how the clock works?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_conflict_clock_: Yes! And I think I could use such a clock for myself!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_conflict_trap_n: Hell no! It was a damn trap and you knew it!
Well then, we will wait for the next one to do the job! Pitty...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_greet_confuse_a: Not sure, if the game is worth it, but I'll help you. WIll get back to you, once I am done.
Nice choice. I am sure you'll be satisfied with the result.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_greet_confuse_b: Well... The Zone is big, so you do have a slight chance of meeting other Stalkers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_greet_confuse_g: Hey there! Found anything interesting down there, Stalker?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_greet_confuse_i: Good! I've got this ugly old clock and the coordinates of the trading point.
Take this clock there and bring me whatever you could change for it. I'll repay for your expenses and your time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_greet_confuse_n: I am no threat, don't worry. Just wanted to say hello?
How could this even be possible?!
Sorry, got no time for that. I'm in a bit of a hurry.
You sure? I'll still be here, if you change your mind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_greet_confuse_q: Sounds like an easy job. Why don't you trade it yourself?
I owe that guy some koupons, so the deal would not be fair, If he sees me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_greet_confuse_w: Yeah, pretty much it is how it works. Guess you have something on your mind, so I'll leave you be.
No, no! Wait! I've got something to ask you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_override_hello_: Have you thought about my idea? The coupons would be waiting.
Nevermind, I'll still be here if you change your mind.
No, sorry. I am still second guessing this whole deal.
I had time to think and maybe we could talk over the details.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_override_zone_o: Not much. Mutants, sausages, stalkers - same old Zone every week. People looking for artifacts and for the secret ingredients of the sausage over there.
To be honest, I wouldn't rather look for the second one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_loop_test_bel_tercius_approac: Hey there! Found anything interesting down there, Stalker?
How could this even be possible?!
Well... The Zone is big, so you do have a slight chance of meeting other Stalkers.
I am no threat, don't worry. Just wanted to say hello.
Maybe you could lend me a hand with these clock?
Of course. Always glad to help a fellow-Stalker. Just point me to the right direction.
There is a chest under the tree on these coordinates. Take my shotgun and ammo from it, and leave the clock inside. Meanwhile, I'll guard the body from the mutants.
Sounds like an easy deal. See you soon, Stalker.
Yeah, pretty much it is how it works. Guess you have something on your mind, so I'll leave you be.
Actually, nevermind. Not much to loot here, unless you are interested in some sausages.
Not really, but thank you. Stay safe, Stalker. See you around.
No, no! Wait! I've got something to ask you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Banzai_: We opened this closet up, and there it was! Probably left from a radio class. Enough spares for a shop – and nothing had burst or got soaked!
Scoutmaster got me all these books… guidebooks for this and that. Weapon manuals. Turns out they're not that hard to fix! Way harder to shoot.
Look… are you really interested? 'Cause everyone's sick and tired of my radio stuff, and there's no news apart from that really.
I played the guitar yesterday, first time ever. Fixed this guy's PDA, asked him to teach me as payment. Maybe, one day I'll buy my own guitar…
A little birdie told me what Rascal was selling my work for. Almost hit him. I know I let my people down, but I can't keep working my ass off for nothing.
Medulin took me in for rehab. I sleep with sensors on, sit around in headphones with theta-waves. I used to be a rat, now I'm a lab rat.
Skif? It's Skif, right? Sorry, my memory's been kinda… off.
It's great that you found Medulin because I'm not really a Zone pro, and he's fragile as a radio lamp.
Rascal just got back, and he's raising hell already. Set up shop here, figure out the routes there.
Could I get a soundproof room first? Before he goes all Las Vegas on this place?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_HubInfo: It's become our home. Rascal will set up shop, Medulin will make us dig a bunker. Banzai… let's just hope he gets better.
And I'll just be watching how this camp, once abandoned, welcomes new guests by the fire.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Hub_Clo: The camp is under attack! No one goes in or out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Hub_Ope: We fought them off. The camp is open.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Medulin: I'll demand decent conditions for us from Scoutmaster. This is a matter of life and death, literally. I'm not trained to work in a field hospital!
Gathering medical supplies here and there. Some think we've got enough to get by, but I'd say to "get by" we need triple what we have. At least.
If you need sleeping pills or sedatives, let me know. I can share some from my personal stash.
Beats me how others get by without it. The bounty on our heads makes getting a healthy amount of sleep pretty difficult.
I never got to present my doctor's thesis. Now I have people come in for medical help – "Doctor, take a look". It's flattering, damn it!
Hope I can show you the new admissions wing soon. If Scoutmaster's finally done with his endless renovations!
I filed an anonymous request about myself to Malachite. Turns out they didn't even look for me! After an employee vanished?! Whatever… It's okay, their loss.
I can't believe it's finally over. Let's hope there are no more surprises.
Banzai is whipping up a gift for you. To say sorry.
Good god. His rehab alone was enough for three research papers! The best gift from him would be getting better, finally.
Hope it's not sclerosis. Where were we?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Selma_M: Banzai is whipping up a gift for you. To say sorry.
After he almost got us killed?! Nah, that won't fly. He's in the doghouse while he works his fingers to the bone as payback. He can take that gift and shove it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_ShelmaI: Scoutmaster and I think you're a reliable one. We're considering offering you a couple of contracts, once I get this place up and running. Think about it.
I'm just thinking: what could our USP be? Bets? Movie screenings? Urban legends about an arch-anomaly in the Burnt Forest?
When will this radio thing finally be over? We're sitting here, all scared, missing out on all the opportunities!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_ShelmaM: I know for damn sure that shooting's not my thing. I'll save up and hire security for my shop.
Banzai is our golden goose. Learns how to fix stuff faster than lightning, yet doesn't know the market prices for his work. With his prices, I can triple my profit margin!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Shelma_: That frequency gave Banzai some brains as well as wiping his memory. He says he'll start charging market price for his work. Looks like the freebie days are over.
Rostok is interested in us already. A trade partnership. That's one hell of a PR campaign I launched, right?
That was some of my genius marketing! A story about a wandering anomaly in the Burnt Forest that always has artifacts.
Tell it a couple of times by the fire, they'll spread it around. Folks will come looking, and where will they buy stuff? Exactly!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Vojatiy: Welcome to Kazkovyi. The best sanatorium in the Zone for weary professionals.
Banzai is whipping up a gift for you. To say sorry.
It's tough with idealists. When I cooled off, I told him that history's written by the victors. He doesn't get it – and he won't until he forgives himself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_QD_Vozatiy: Medulin appreciated your gift – he'd sleep in that suit! If he could fall asleep without a blanket and pillow…
Rascal already shared his problem-solving ways, right when you came. I won't even bother running them by you. He's hopeless.
I was wrong about Banzai. The problem wasn't him, it was the tools. You can ask him for repairs, now. I can highly recommend him.
Banzai versus equipment is something different now. Got him a pile to practice repairs on. So far, the equipment's winning 3-1.
Kazkovyi isn't the best place for defenses. But it's the best the Burnt Forest can offer.
Zalissya and Sidorovich solved similar problems. We will, too.
Must be a full house at the Rostok bar now. I miss these little joys of life.
When you're there, drink to Kazkovyi. To us – able to walk the Zone with no targets on our backs.
Step by step, we're repairing the second building. Sometimes it seems like it would be easier to blow it up – and I can't say I don't want to.
Medulin came over a few days ago with a med request, three pages worth. Guess how he justified it. "In a couple of years, you'll be the one who needs it".
We're getting more folks coming in. Guitar, campfire songs… I wonder if I should open a bar here when the time's right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_supack_ass: I warned you it would turn out like this.
Hm. It seems fine to me. Or this diagnosis is beyond my competence…
Poor you… Should've been more careful! We'll fix that…
Hope you're good, and not here for medical help?
Finally, we get to meet in an almost calm environment.
Assistant professor Medulin, psychology PhD., specializing in anomalous psychophysiology.
Ages ago, I was a hospital intern. Considering our state of emergency, looks like I still am.
This isn't Malachite. I can't guarantee quality.
Take some more. Who knows what you might find yourself up against.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_supack_ban: Stop by! Good to see you.
Oh, hey! You need something, or just chatting?
Here we are again. I'm settling in, so far so good. It's no Rostok, of course, but…
I can't do much, apart from radios. But I'll find a way to make myself useful! Scoutmaster can't do it all alone.
I'm no pro, but I'll do my best.
If nothing comes out of it, I'll revert it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_supack_sel: Drop you a message when we have discounts?
You'll always be a VIP here.
Look who's here! My favorite client!
Did you sort your money trouble? Congrats, or whatever?
So, what's new around the Zone? Scandals, gossip, business opportunities?
You were just on time with those bandits! I could've sorted it myself, but didn't have the time or the mood…
Nice to meet you. Rascal. The person the whole Zone will soon want to meet.
You didn't just help out a man in his hour of need, you made an investment in the future.
Not much yet, but the right package is on its way!
If I had a VIP card, I would've given it to you already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_Kazkovy_Hub_supack_voz: Not now.
Good luck in the Zone.
Off you pop.
Always happy to see you.
Welcome.
Need a guide? Or..?
I knew you'd come by. Hey there.
A shelter that you helped us build with your own hands. I hope we'll be able to settle down here and hold our fort.
No one really wanders off to the Burnt Forest, and Kazkovyi has the reputation of a place of slow and painful deaths. So far, that's good for us.
So you're here to check on us? Not bad, for a start. Thanks to your help in particular.
I took it upon myself to oversee things here since I'm quite experienced, and the others don't seem to mind.
But I'm still at your services as a guide. I don't think anything will blow up if I step out for a quick stroll.
Sky is clear. Back to your posts!
Emission. Hang tight until my command.
Emission! Run and hide, quickly!
I was wrong, Scoutmaster. Can we talk?
More than simply wrong, Skif. Those things are hard to forget.
You're no stranger to this camp. Put some coupons in the pot to help set things up here, and I'll spread the word.
I need to think about it.
Do that. But we'll think it over, too.
I hope this helps.
It does help. You, in particular.
Let's take a stroll, then.
Where to?
The Zone's quiet today. There's a lot to be admired.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QC_Banzai_TurnOn: So I thought you should do the honors and turn the switches on. If anyone deserves it, it's you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QC_Medulin_After: Perfect timing, Scoutmaster. He's the one that could always get through to Banzai, and he's gone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QC_Shelma_AfterS: Talk some sense into Banzai, or we're all toast.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Banzai_AboutG: Sounds good. I'm waiting for your guide.
Great! He's nearby and will come get you!
I've got stuff to do. I'll find my own way.
Just hurry up, okay? And stay safe. Over and out.
Skif, Banzai here. Are you okay there? Haven't heard from you in a while…
Just wanted to say I pulled some strings with the Rostok guide. He'll pick you up at the coordinates and get you to Kazkovyi. Sound good?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Banzai_Skif_F: You okay? Are your ears bleeding?
Nah! I told you we had it under control.
I don't have military-grade capacity! Though, wait a minute… Maybe there is somewhere. I did listen to one of their frequencies from…
There's an amplifier at the Volkhov SAM site. If you unscrew it from there and fix it onto here, I'll record it all!
Let me transfer some software to your PDA. It'll help you find the amplifier, but be careful! Hell knows who's lurking around there.
Without the full transmission – nothing. Banzai, can you make a longer recording?
The analyzer has started recording. Don't you lose it now! Just a bit more… there… Damn! Lost it!
Wait… turn it up a bit… there! Medulin, get it!
It's clear that nothing's clear. What do we do now?
That's all you can tell me?
Banzai, are you sure you recorded it right? It's literally a brain activity recording!
But there is no way a brain could be this complicated! I don't understand…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Banzai_Skif_N: I get it. The place is weird. Spooky.
At the Volkhov SAM. I fixed up your PDA, so there shouldn't be a problem detecting the amplifier.
Where can I find it again?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Banzai_Skif_R: If Rascal's radio keeps screaming, I won't be able to do much here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Banzai_Skif_T: I almost got it! The frequency's hopping, but I got it!
If it wasn't for Rascal and his radio, damn it!
I asked him nicely: turn your radio off when I'm working! Nah, he's sitting around listening to his music.
Pay him a visit, will you? If he won't do it the easy way, turn it off yourself.
What's this have to do with Rascal and the radio?
Slow down. You found that transmission of yours?
Yes, Medulin tuned his whatever-analyzer so that the machine would do the listening and our ears won't bleed. Problem is, Rascal's a moron.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Banzai_TurnOn: Don't be scared, hit em'! Medulin and I have it under control.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Medulin_Skif_: Banzai said there was one at the Volkhov SAM. Your PDA should detect it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_AllGroup: I got the amplifier from Volkhov.
Great! I knew you'd pull it off. Bring it over here.
Don't you fucking give it to him! That thing'll be the death of us all!
With the amplifier, I'll record the whole transmission for Medulin to decipher, and that's it!
If you manage to make an interfering signal out of the full recording, they'll be toast, not us!
I spoke to Skull at the Volkhov site.
Gee… how did you make it out? Does he know about us? Could he have followed you back?
Of course he could have! We should get outta this dump and to the Mainland while we can!
I knew I should've bolted to Rostok!
But don't turn anything on until Scoutmaster's back, you hear me?
I'll just check the amplifier. Maybe it's no good at all. Skif, you coming? Let's have some peace and quiet.
Enough with the panic. I trust Banzai.
At least someone's got a bit of brains left…
Let me at least check if the amplifier works! What if it's no good?
Poor, poor me… Skif, go with Banzai and keep an eye on him please.
Rascal's right. Let's wait for Scoutmaster.
Where did Scoutmaster go?
Ah, hell knows! Wandered off somewhere, and he's too proud to say where.
What are you fighting about?
Banzai wants to use the amplifier at full capacity to record the whole transmission. But there's a problem…
If you just listen to me, it'll all be fine! Can you take my word for it just this once?!
A big fucking one! Mercs will be able to track it and come for us!
Why'd it be the death of you?
Because if he turns it on at full power, mercs will be able to track us down!
If we don't, they'll come up with another way. The Zone is small. This way, we'll deal with the transmission, Skull, and everything!
You're both nuts with that radio of yours! If you won't listen to me, wait for Scoutmaster!
Are you nuts?! Skull will track the amplifier and we're as good as dead!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Banzai_G: First: do you trust me? That I know how to put an end to this? And that I wanna help us?
I'll try to find him. Any leads?
He had a stash at the edge of the Burnt Forest. I know because the jammer's always on. So no transmission can… catch my drift?
I'll send you the coordinates. Just don't do anything stupid if you're not sure!
I believe you want to. But I'm not sure about the rest.
Back when you found me in the mine, in the cage, you told me to wait, and I did. Told me to follow, I did. No questions asked.
It was your playing field, and I trusted you, but now we're both on mine.
Your plan threatens the whole camp. That's no way to help.
Just hear me out, okay? Let me finish. And give me the amp.
It's working great. Just as I thought.
Didn't wanna say it in front of everyone… We got a rat. You don't think Skull just happened to be at Volkhov?
Scoutmaster disappeared right after you left. I don't wanna jump to conclusions, but… it's weird.
Not just him. I don't wanna badmouth anyone since the other two stayed here, you know.
Why would Scoutmaster do that? He's the one who cares about the camp most.
Let's be real. Every one of us here at least once thought about ratting the rest out and saving himself.
Someone might've had enough. Might be Scoutmaster. I wouldn't blame him.
At least you have a plan. Unlike the others.
Thank you. You know, it's hard when everyone thinks you're cuckoo… I appreciate it. Give me the amp.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_D: You sure they're worth your help? Or your life? This is the last time I'm gonna ask you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_G: I can, but not for free.
Ballsy move. I like it. Go on, check your PDA.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_H: Banzai. I want him to solve the puzzle, his life's work.
I respect him. He'd slaughter his way to his dream, if he was able to kill.
Medulin. His research could save hundreds of lives.
After he sent dozens to the slaughter. That's just the way science works.
Scoutmaster. And he's helping the others.
Dear old Scoutmaster. New life, new callsign, and the same trick of fooling folks with his words.
Rascal. He's just a merchant. He shouldn't be caught up in this.
"I know nothing, I'm just a merchant" is his catchphrase before every deal he makes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_I: I promised to help, and I'll keep that promise.
A man of his word in the Zone. Which one are you trying to help?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_O: The whole group is in the Burnt Forest, Kazkovyi camp.
And my respect. You took out Pickaxe's whole gang on your own, so you're someone I'd part ways with peacefully.
And my respect. I knew you were a sharp one since the Old Mine. You're someone you part ways with peacefully.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_R: Classic Scoutmaster – hiding a tree in a forest. You can go. No one will touch you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_S: I don't need any loot from Kazkovyi. Consider it yours if you help me.
Stay where you are. Nice 'n' easy. We can see you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_T: A guide, a medic, a tech, and a merchant, all in my debt. It's useful.
I get that. But they're no use to a dead man.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Choice_W: How can you guarantee you'll let me walk away?
My contract is only for those four, and I've got nothing against you. My lack of interest is your guarantee.
I need the whereabouts of the NK-5 group. Medulin, Banzai, Scoutmaster, Rascal. Send me the coordinates, and be on your way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ100_QD_Skif_Shelma_A: Whoa, whoa! Chill out. Who needs a transmission to be at each other's throats?
Banzai asked you to turn the radio off.
Can't he wait a bit? I almost got killed twice! Let me calm my nerves with some music.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_AL_VozWithCherep: Surgeon, come in. You at the spot? The group still clueless?
Yes. As they should be. They're tinkering with radios, looking for something. No idea what.
Whatever it is, let them find it. Sending the frequency now. Let them tune in to it and get back to base.
That's it? Our tickets to the Mainland are worth so little? Well, it really is a rich man's world.
Hey, man! What's up?! Hey… Hey! What the hell?! Drop the gun! Drop—
(groans, the sound of radio being turned off)
Help the scientists? Let them listen to that transmission?! You fucked me over, you piece of shit!
You thought you could use me one last time? So everyone would die 'cause of me and I'd put the last bullet through my own head?!
Wrong fucking guess, Skull. I'm alive, of sound mind, and I turned that shit off. I'll be seeing you…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_BanAfterGivin: Please hurry back with some news. I really wanna be wrong about Scoutmaster.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_BanzajCrazy1_: Don't go… just don't run away, I almost got you…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_BanzajCrazy2_: Thirty-two… Seventeen… Twenty-one… What's that song you're singing to me?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_IntBanzAfterT: Scoutmaster wanted to see you. I won't pull anything this time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_InteractVozEn: Go to Kazkovyi. Don't bother an old man smoking by the water, getting his thoughts straight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_MedulinGoSlee: I, uh… I need some air.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_OnInteractAft: Decided to sleep over? Open up, quickly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_RatShelmaInte: You need something? I'm just here… weighing my options.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_VozCallAfterF: Skif? I reckon this isn't a social call. Come on over, let's talk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QC_VozCallNearSt: We're here. Come closer. I'll give you the stash key.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_DrinkingWithM: I got my head bashed in on my first day in the Zone. I came to without my stuff, an anomaly field around me, and a blind dog chewing my leg.
On my first day in the Zone… Well, it's good thing we didn't meet earlier! I was putting together a rookie team. Hot-headed, fearless. All of them died…
Not here, yet. But I saw worse things on the Mainland.
I think I'll come back later.
Provided there is a "later"…
Have you ever met Skull before? Maybe he was in one of your field teams?
I give you my word: it's the first time I've heard of him! I'd remember… he wouldn't have passed the psych eval with that name!
Nasty stuff… Between us – have you been in tough situations like this before? Or is this the worst yet?
This is between you and your conscience, and that's up to you. But you're not the rat.
I'm not scared anymore! You think you're the first group I've sent to their deaths? Maybe this is what I deserve, but not you…
(drinks vodka)
Heard of the Duga assault? I saw many battles before the Zone, but nothing like that.
Duga? God… but you're not one of those? The Wild Island ones? They were my first group… and I sent them under that transmission! To their deaths!
An Emission. While I was running to shelter, I realized people can be persuaded, mutants – shot. But this is different.
No way! No way, like with this transmission. It kills everyone: old-timers, rookies, random folks! I gathered groups, tried to get them ready… it destroyed them all!
My home burned down, along with all my memories. I was forced to watch the flames in my slippers, nothing to do, nowhere to go.
That's how I got out of Malachite – in my slippers! So I could be with this group until we solve it. Or die… I deserve it! After sending so many to their deaths.
Spell it out: what does Banzai want to do?
Use a military amplifier to record the whole transmission, from start to finish.
Then, I'd be able to create an interfering signal. If it's overlapped, this radio nightmare will no longer be a threat to anyone!
But if Banzai turns the amplifier on, I'll be trying to beat death itself! And if Skull makes it out here first, we're as good as dead anyway.
Yes. Even here in the Zone.
I guess it's personal, but will you tell me? Give me an example?
Doesn't look like your fault. Skull took all your groups out, right from the very first one.
What?! I tormented myself… when it was that bastard?! I couldn't have expected merc involvement…
It wasn't a good thing you did, but you tried to save your groups. You're not an asshole or a rat.
A drink, maybe? What does science say about the impact of alcohol on stress?
No way! Death is breathing down our necks. What if I have to shoot?
Know anything about the Monolith? I saw it. I witnessed it frying brains first-hand.
Where were you all this time with experience like that? That psi-resilience… Just what I needed for my group! So they'd have had a chance instead of a death sentence…
You don't seem tipsy at all. One more?
What are you doing? Go drink with Rascal, he's used to that! What have I become…
Being afraid won't help. I'd have a drink if I were you. Liquid courage.
A rat? What does it have to do…
You'll be less scared to do it. Grab a shotgun from Rascal. It's hard to miss with one of those.
I'll trust your expertise.
Even if he won't – we'll figure it out. Rascal ordered a whole lot of medkits for you.
Right here, at Kazkovyi, in one of the buildings. So… Skif, be honest – am I an asshole?
I can get them from his other warehouse. Where was it again?
I'm not saying we should get wasted. Just the prescribed amount.
Maybe, just a little. As a sedative.
Banzai and his ideas! I'm no better, I should have seen this coming…
Your groups were dying, all you did was whine. I agree. I'm surprised you're not the rat.
If Skull contacted me, I'd give him anything! Just so he'd leave the group alone… If he'd just take me…
When I got back from the war, to a world I didn't belong in, with no one to fucking care.
You were in the military? Then… you get it! NK-2 was a search group, I sent them to at least find the bodies… I sent them to die, you understand?!
See what coming?
That this group would be in danger, too! I should've gotten more medkits, psi-protection, headphones – everything, for crying out loud!
I was thinking: Skull figured out I was at Volkhov. Any idea how?
None whatsoever! Maybe they came to get the same amp? Just bad luck?
I guess this is the worst one by far.
Now I get why you wanted to have a drink. You're scared too, aren't you?
Only psychos aren't scared when there's good reason to be. One more? Liquid courage.
You think it was your fault the groups died. Why?
I got them the best gear! Tried to prepare them for anything… but I couldn't tell them what they'd gotten into!
They'd have refused, and a great discovery was at stake! I should've stopped after the first group died…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_DuringWalkWit: So you do trust me a bit? I didn't expect you to. Good to know.
That isn't any of your business. At least, not yet.
You still think I sold you out. Suit yourself.
I hope you're working on your defenses, and not just looking for double agents.
You got the wrong suspect, but the suspicion is justifiable. Skull managed to find you somehow. You still have the amplifier, right?
Not going to say anything? I'll wait.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_FinalWithBanz: Medulin can create an interfering signal with the full recording. We'll be safe from the transmission, while everyone who's coming to get us won't.
It doesn't matter how cool you are if your brain gets fried… Hold on. The mercs have turned their comms on!
Give me one good reason not to put a bullet in your brain.
Honestly? I haven't got one. At least now I can listen to Skull & Co. on the radio. So why don't you go ahead and get in line after them.
You knew Skull would be at Volkhov. Am I right?
Skif, I…
Yes or no?
Yes. I made sure everyone could hear us on the radio talking about Volkhov. I thought it'd be some thugs, not a merc squad!
I needed the mercs' frequencies. When I tinkered with your PDA to detect Volkhov's amp, I might've added another feature.
Well… if the mercs go on comms near you, the PDA detects it and sends it to me. And I find the algorithm of their frequency hopping.
I asked if you trusted me, and you said you didn't. So I had to risk it.
I knew I couldn't trust you.
Maybe. But it doesn't matter anymore. Now we've all got a chance to survive, understand?
We got bigger problems now. So what's your plan, lifesaver?
It looks like you sent me off to chase the rat, but it turns out the rat is right here.
Risk what? Your life, mine, the whole camp?
You said you wanted to save the group. I wasn't part of it, so you sold me out for it. You didn't even lie about it.
No! You're one of us! Skif, I'm a bastard, but it saved us. Better this than a bunch of honest corpses!
I made it so the whole network could hear us talking about Volkhov. I thought they'd send thugs! If I knew, I'd never have…
You better tell me. Facts, now.
You sent me to look for a fake rat so I wouldn't get in your way?
What the hell?! Turn it off!
What the hell are you doing? You almost lost it with that transmission!
I got it under control. It was tough without Medulin, but I managed. I installed the amp and recorded the whole thing.
I really did trust you.
You can think whatever of me, but I'll prove to you it was worth trusting me.
Scoutmaster left at the right moment as part of your plan, too?
Not exactly. He… doesn't show it, but Scoutmaster's scared of the transmission. I turned it on near him, and he was just gone.
I was lucky there. Medulin and Rascal can't decide anything without him, or without you. I can.
Remember when you said you trusted me? You were right, I pulled it off… but I had to do this one nasty thing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_MercOnRadio_s: Not a lot of campsites in the Burnt Forest. Sweep them all.
No prisoners this time. If you find any radio equipment, destroy it.
Damn. We don't have much time. Our only hope now is Medulin and his interference signal.
Good luck to us – we're gonna need it. And I'm not going anywhere, so chill.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_VazCallAboutB: Thank Banzai for that. He screwed both of us over, although he did record the transmission.
What?! Okay, you can explain later, after you've dealt with the guests. I'll go to Medulin.
Banzai recorded the whole transmission. We need Medulin to decipher it ASAP, but he's drunk as a skunk.
You picked the perfect time to get him drunk… Okay, I got it. I'll sober him up, you deal with that squad.
Skif, Scoutmaster here. We're being watched. I spotted a crew on my way back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_WithShelmaAbo: Stop looking for excuses and help your group figure all this out.
How am I supposed to help? I can't shoot the broad side of a barn! Fine. I'll try to think of something… I'm at least creative.
And thanks for being so… understanding.
Not so fast. You traded with Skull. What else did you sell him? Did you sell me out at Volkhov?
What?! No! Hell no! I'm an honest merchant, I'm not like that! Think about it – why would I do that?
You got us into this mess, you figure out what to do now.
"Up to me"… So, it's up to me which side I get a slug from, the front or the back?
Okay. This isn't your problem, and I didn't pay for consulting services. It's up to me…
I thought you were a traitor, but it turns out you're just dumb. You got people killed.
I found your notes. It looks like you and Skull go way back.
Fuck… Don't do anything rash now, let me explain!
I didn't know! I didn't! What do you want me to do, shoot myself? Or go to a gunfight with Skull all alone? What do you want from me?!
You're a fuckwit, Rascal. But not a traitor, at least.
I'm no traitor. Traitors know what they're doing, and I…
I know everything. Better come clean.
About what? Skif, what the hell? I bought scrap from Banzai below market price, but he agreed!
Got Medulin medkits, you know he's paranoid… Wait. You went through my notes? Fuck…
Stay quiet from now on. Or this camp will make sure you won't live long.
Figured as much. I'll stay quiet, then…
It sucks, but you're right about that. I made a fool of myself.
Sorry, pal. I closed up shop. I'm getting outta here.
I thought it'd be my USP – complex radio equipment! I was just looking for a partner who'd transport it into the Zone for a fee.
When some mercs contacted me, it felt like I hit the jackpot. I'd give them a list of orders, they'd deliver a box of spares. Clean, fast, safe.
How was I supposed to know they wanted names, not a profit share?! Or know what they'd do… to customers. Or to me later on!
Why didn't you come clean earlier? Like when they put a bounty on our heads?
What was I supposed to say? "Hey, I'm the reason they wanna kill us"?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_WithVozAfterS: You never said you knew Skull. Or that you were a mercenary.
Because I wanted to live, and the only way to quit is to go six feet under. So Surgeon is dead, now long live Scoutmaster.
I need Kazkovyi. My future quiet place for my golden years. Skull wants to take that away from me – so I'll have to defend myself with the people I have here.
You won't slaughter another group after listening to that transmission?
There's no way to be certain. But I can feel it when it's about to happen.
That's why I came out here. To hold some old stuff, and let out my anger on the mutants. To remind myself who I am. It helps.
Don't you worry about me. Get back to Kazkovyi.
I worked with Skull for many years. You heard of Surgeon? I guess not, I stepped back long ago.
There he was, gathering the ones still alive for one last gig, promising them a quiet house on the Mainland. "In the Zone together, out of the Zone together".
I fell for it. Bloody romantic… You heard how he abandoned me to listen to Zombie FM. So now Skull and I are in a conflict of interest.
I'll get a grip and go back to Kazkovyi. You should check if Medulin or Rascal happen to have a little rat's tail.
I'll do just that.
Remember the "perfect storm" and NK-3? I'm almost certain their complete lack of luck is Skull's handiwork. So is the disappearance of the previous groups.
It's hard to trust you, after what happened.
I can understand that, but I need your trust now more than ever.
Once Skull gets to the camp, and he will, we'll have to watch each other's backs.
Let's say you didn't rat me out, but somebody else sure did.
I'd check Medulin and Rascal. I have my suspicions.
It's quite easy with Medulin. He doesn't drink usually, but if you get him to, he won't be able to hold his tongue.
Rascal is a tough one. But Medulin did say he had a secret warehouse in the camp, so he definitely has something to hide.
If you did work with Skull before – spill it. Who's behind the transmission?
One of ours contacted Skull, promised him a ticket out and a new life. A tale as old as time, but this one was convincing.
Someone on the Mainland really wants this shit to be broadcast, and really doesn't want any scientists paying attention to it.
I'm almost sure the previous groups got into similar 'accidents', orchestrated by someone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_WithVozNearSt: You hid this stash for so long, and now you just agree to show it?
I have things to hide, but not now, and not from you. No need to be scared, crack it open.
Fine. But I wouldn't do anything stupid if I were you.
Here. Open the safe yourself, for the sake of the investigation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ101_QD_WithVozatijAf: He said only a fool trusts words alone. I underestimated the lad. What did he send you here for?
Someone tipped off the mercs about my visit to Volkhov. Everything points to you.
Fair enough. If I were you, I'd have figured as much.
I'm no saint myself, but nothing like that. Come on, I'll show you the stash.
Who told you about this place? And, since you're here, what for?
Good job dealing with those mutants. Almost too good for an old guide like yourself.
Good eye. I didn't become a guide right away, and spent my whole life shooting. What's your point?
Why did you leave the camp right when Skull ambushed me at the Volkhov site?
To clear my head, take a breather. But it's my understanding you assumed I sold you out?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_AfterPlanInte: Don't you worry, if anything happens, we've got your backs!
Get some sleep, you'll need your strength. We'll take care of security and fortifications.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_BanByeDurinDe: I know you can pull it off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_CherepAnger1_: Weighed your options and decided to quit? Smart.
Run. Raise a glass to your fallen friends. And you'd better never come back here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_CherepAnger2_: Skif..? No?! Not you? Decided to hide? I will… find you, bastard!
If I don't, your friends will tell me everything. I got all the time in the world… to have a chat with them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_CherepCallSki: Skif, where are you? Come to Banzai's! We got quite the crowd here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_MedByeDuringD: Good luck. To you, and to us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_MedHelloDurin: I'm busy deciphering! We don't have much time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_MedulinAboutG: Can anyone hear me? I can't work without electricity. Turn the generator on!
The generator! Someone turn it on! I'm almost done with the deciphering!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_MedulinIntera: The worst possible timing… We're once again catastrophically unprepared!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_MedulinLastIn: I know the moral aspect of Banzai's actions is questionable, but we're alive, and now he owes us.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_ShelmaFinalCo: He's dead… Fuck me. And you guys are all alive. I did it…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_ShelmaHiDurin: Your gun's almost ready. I'll get it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_ShelmaInterac: I heard you and Banzai. I don't know how you managed not to blow his brains out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatijAfterE: Fuck, it's Skull! Run to Medulin!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatijIntera: Leave me here! Run to the medic!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatijLastIn: So this is it – my new home. I earned it honestly, with my blood. Who would've thought…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatijToShel: Hey, soldier, don't forget to breathe. You did everything you needed to.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatyjCallSk: We fought them off, and I'm gathering our men. Come on over. We'll discuss the latest news.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatyjDontLe: Skif? Damn it, where are you off to?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatyjIntera: We'll discuss it in front of everyone. No more secrets.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QC_VozatyjWakeUp: Rise and shine. It's on. Only bandits so far, no mercs in sight.
The bag with the gun from Rascal is at your door. I'm in position, and waiting for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_abr: Since you're my VIP client today, would you prefer the local option or the foreign one?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_cha: Changed your mind? You'll help us defend the camp?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_dea: Roger. I'll cover from the rooftop. I'm a better shot than I am a runner. If everything goes to hell, climb up to the roof.
Grab a gun and go cover Medulin. And get some decent guns for us. Skif, what type of weapon do you need?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_dec: Let's deal with the northeast first.
Let's start reinforcing from the south.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_eas: And this is my gift to you. If they storm us at night, an NVG is way better than a flashlight.
Fuck. I leave the camp for a single day, and what've they done?
We'll deal with the fortifications, you get some rest. You won't sleep through an assault op, anyway.
Don't panic! I'll get you your guns. I'll sort it all out…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_ide: I'm ready to take my pick.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_lon: Get me a long-range weapon. The more of them I can take out from far away, the better.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_mid: I need a medium-range gun. And the more ammo, the better.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_no_: You’re on your own this time.
How come? You saved our asses just to leave us to die now?!
Rascal, he isn't on the list. Forgotten already? Skif, thanks for everything. I do hope you change your mind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_nor: The northeast. What do you think of the fortifications there?
If I were Skull, I'd have the main squad strike from there. They'd find cover by the building and the stage. Easy to sneak up on us.
Why should we focus on the northwest part?
It's our weak spot. In the south and northeast, the landscape is to our advantage. In the northwest, we have the weakest fortifications.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_sho: Something short range and heavy duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_sou: What if we prioritize the south part?
I doubt the main force will come from there, but it's a good place to set up trip wires. We'll cover Banzai and Medulin.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_sta: Skull now knows where we are. The first squad is a recce, the main squad will be here soon. Banzai hasn't pulled any more stunts?
I paid him a visit. He won't pull anything, or it's on him. Do you need me? If not, I'll get back to work.
Go. You're in charge of the interference signal, we're on the defenses. Skif, you're with us, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AboutPlan_yes: Reinforce the perimeter, organize fortifications. We don't have much time, so we'll have to prioritize.
They won't strike from the West as the field is a kill zone. I bet they'll come from the northwest or northeast. They could sneak in along the buildings.
Or the south, from the ruins or near Banzai. Knowing Skull, he's coming in hot. So pick one to make it easier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_AfterRadioWav: Did it work?! Somebody answer! Come in!
Damn it. A camp full of zombies…
Skif, help me finish off these poor bastards. We need to find out if Skull's here anywhere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_FinalWithCher: I see. So, you wanna drag everyone down with you…
Look at that. He finally grew a pair.
You know what, Rascal? Aren't you "just a merchant" who didn't know anything? If you get outta here right now, you'll live.
Thought I wouldn't shoot ya?! Thought I'd run?!
No Surgeon? Or did he leave without saying goodbye, like Rascal?
Here's the deal: you're going to give me the... "interfering signal". Did I get that right, doctor?
Or you take turns listening to Zombie FM until one of you changes your mind.
I got it under control. Run.
If you won't listen to me, listen to Skif.
Just think: is it really worth it? Your employers won't appreciate the sacrifice!
I got nothing to lose. Either we all die, or I make it out of this hellhole.
I won't wait long. Run while you still can.
Rascal! Chill out! He's dead, do you hear me?!
You let me leave back at Volkhov. Now it's my turn: put the gun down and leave.
We're even, right? Go fuck yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_FinalWithVozM: None of my business. You deal with him.
Many things here are your business, though. But I won't insist. We'll deal with him ourselves.
If I ever write a memoir, it'll be impossible to read. Mayhem, farce, tragedy – in only thirty minutes!
What matters is that it all ended well. Almost. How's Banzai?
He was transmitting the recording to the mercs until he fainted. He didn't get zombified, but… that's all I can say for sure.
What do we do with him? Let him stay at the camp after all? What do you think, Skif?
I can't believe Banzai's crazy idea worked. I was right on time. And we pulled through…
Banzai's plan saved us. Kicking him out after this would be low.
I guess. But we will have a talk about where good intentions and dumb decisions can lead.
Humankind turns everything into a weapon… Thank you, Skif. Here, what's ours is yours.
Plus, there's a lot to be taken from the mercs. Skull, in particular. Do that, and we'll put the camp back in order.
But the most important gift from Banzai and you, Medulin, is the last ditch weapon. As long as we have the transmission, Kazkovyi remains safe.
You need him. Finding another tech to work here will be tough.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_MedilinShelma: Banzai screwed us all over, the bastard! I told you so, didn't I? What do we do now?!
Calm down, for starters. We've got a deadly radio wave on our hands, but we'll figure it all out. We have to!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_RadioTalkDuri: Do you want to get us killed?! I'm changing it!
Skif, don't you dare! The mercs are too close, and they're listening to it with no interference! You'll die!
Surgeon. Date of birth – February tenth… nineteen… Damn it! How much longer?!
Just a bit! Hang tight for just a little longer!
Skif? Scoutmaster? You good? I think I got it all…
If you're sure, not just 'think' you have, tell us what to do!
No matter what you hear, do not switch from our frequency! I repeat: stay on our frequency! Transmission is on in three, two, one…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_ShelmaFinalIn: Hold on… I need a minute. I'm shaking…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_SkifKilledZom: I didn't see Skull among them. Did you?
I don't think I did. You don't sound so good.
It's my heart. I'm not really fit for these adventures anymore. I'd appreciate… a medkit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ102_QD_VozatijHealin: Thank you. I think I'm done. Time to hang my gun up on the wall and retire.
Don't forget about the transmission. It almost forced me to retire.
Ha… So quiet now, though. We fought them off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_AL_KirkaPDAAudiol: I got the tech. Turns out he's a useful smartass. Fixed our pump so it doesn't keep cutting out.
You didn't kill him so he could do repairs? Did I get that right?
Nah, man! So he'd rat out the others! My boys are with him now. They'll get you the other three gift-wrapped.
So you didn't get Medulin, Rascal, or Scoutmaster. Remind me, what am I paying you for?
Well, shit… For the whole group. All four, dead or alive.
Now it's twenty per cent less for the screw up. Did the tech have anything on him?
Get them to the old stash. And keep in mind that if I pay the money, I'm expecting a result.
Got it, got it. One of my boys is on his way!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QC_Banzai_Bandits: I heard there are more bandits down there! Be careful.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QC_Banzai_Door_Op: Great! The stupid thugs didn't close the door behind them. Come on, bud. Go welcome them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QC_Banzai_HelpCal: Hey! You! Get me outta here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QC_Banzai_Radio_S: CQ, CQ, CQ! Can anyone hear me?! This is Banzai. I'm captured… gang in the Old Mine, South Red Forest… anyone hear me?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QC_Kirka_NoticeSk: Did the smartass lead you straight to us? We’ll pack you up too, son of a bitch!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QC_Kirka_PumpOff_: Fuck, the pump's busted! Get your asses down there, or we'll drown in here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QC_Kirka_WTF_Elec: Dudes? Yo, dudes?! What the fuck is happening down there?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QD_Banzai_Reward_: We made it out. Thanks. I'm… Shoot, my hands are shaking. Here, take your coupons.
As for the Barge, all my things have trackers on them. Once you're near one, you'll notice! I promise I'll pay you more, and not the scraps I gave you just now.
Then I'll go? Try to find the others… Maybe we can think of something together.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QD_Banzai_Skif_Fi: Who are you? Was it you who asked for help?
There are broken cables every-freaking-where. And it's wet. Hit the switch, and they're all toast! Just make sure not to get fried yourself.
Find a pump and turn it off. They'll come running and open the door, and you follow them. Then… well, you already know how to shoot.
To each their own. Listen up: you know how they pump the water out of the mine so it doesn't flood? Same shit here.
Find a pump and turn it off. They'll come running and open the door, follow them. And then comes the best part!
What a surprise! Here it goes: you know how they pump the water out of the mine so it doesn't flood? Same shit here.
We studied this strange radio signal. If the bandits listen to it, then… I don't know what's gonna happen, but nothing good.
And if they learn to use it, it's game over. So I'm sorry, but I can't leave without them.
I never counted, but a lot. They're all sitting down there. I hope they didn't hear all the noise you've made.
Banzai. A tech. Those thugs attacked our group. Took all my freaking radio equipment then shoved me in here. Don't know why. They beat me and asked about the others, but I don't know where they are.
Worst thing is – they took my tools! Sure hope they're all thumbs so they won't think of trying to use them… Right, that's not the point.
Thanks. One more thing – could you find my stuff, please? A drive and a toolbox. The gang leader, Pickaxe, took them, and I'm no good without them!
Maybe give it another thought? I might not have a 'later'…
Shoot… Sorry if I sounded harsh. I'm terrified. They've got plenty of loot, and it's all yours! Take all my coupons, too.
What do you say?
I can't leave. I need my stuff – my drive and my toolbox. The gang leader, Pickaxe, took them, and I'm no good without them!
Imagine if every one of them had a huge bomb. But worse.
Sorry… can't tell you more. I gave my word not to involve any outsiders.
Why look for trouble? You're free already.
I know how to deal with the gang. They made me fix their scrap, and I had a look around. What plan would you like - a simple one or a smart one?
How many bandits are left?
I hope those tools are worth it. Fine. I'll be back with your stuff.
Wait. I'll deal with the bandits and get you out.
Keep it simple.
Better to think on it first than waste bullets.
If you stay here, it won't get any better. But it's your call.
Didn't take you long to ask for favors. What's in it for me?
I can't right now.
I need more details. What happens if the bandits get their hands on your tools?
Who are you?
You're no good without them? What kind of tools cost more than your life?
You gave them one hell of a fight! Wish I could've.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QD_Banzai_Skif_Re: What kind of tactics do you prefer, simple or smart?
We don't have much time! If the bandits figure out how to use the transmission, I'm done for!
We don't have much time! The bandits will come back, see the bodies, and I'm done for!
I'll help you. What was your plan again?
So? Will you help me get out of here?
And my stuff! That's most important – the drive and the tools.
Yeah. Let's go. Just open the cage, will you?
Just don't go too fast, okay? I have trouble walking.
That's everything I found on Pickaxe. There were no tools.
I found a list of your group. You, Medulin, Scoutmaster, and Rascal. Someone called Skull wants you dead or alive.
How'd it go? All done?
If we don't get out of here now, you'll find out the "or dead" part of that bounty is easiest for them. Let's roll.
You got into some shit. But while you're alive, there's a chance you'll make it out. Let's go.
Working on it.
What was your plan again?
That's everything I found on Pickaxe. There were no tools.
I gave my word to stay quiet, but… since it came down to this, I'll tell you on the way.
The bandits hid your tools for a guy named Skull. Maybe he's a radio amateur too?
Apart from the tools, he needs you and three other guys, dead or alive. Medulin, Scoutmaster, and Rascal. Heard of them?
What do you mean?! Did you find anything out?
Ah… Fine. Try to hurry up, okay?
What do you mean… dead?! How… What have we gotten ourselves into? We just studied radios!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QD_Banzai_Vozhaty: Scoutmaster? I'm alive, but we're in big trouble! I'm at the mine in the Red Forest. I need help! Over!
Copy that. Hang on. Find shelter, and stay there. I'm on my way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ95_QD_Skif_Banzai_Go: One more thing about the tools! The bandits were arguing if they should just bring my tools to the Sunken Barge, or drag me along as well. Maybe that's the place?
Remember: if you find them, there's a recording. No matter what, do NOT play it!
It ended, and I came round all teary-eyed, my table covered in blood. I was shaking. Could hardly remember what I did – or if it was my blood.
If you help me out with the tools, I can tell you more and pay you a pretty pile! When you find the tools, I'll drop a pin. Will be waiting for you there with the coupons.
I wrote to Malachite, and this one scientist contacted me. Said I got off easy, and that the transmission could kill! Now, imagine the bandits having a thing like that.
I'm a radio amateur. I listen to the Zone's waves, and I intercepted this transmission. Started listening to it, and it felt like drowning in a swamp, slowly and nastily.
Kill the bandits, get the drive. Now I'm supposed to fetch your tools?
I know it sounds bad. You saved me, and here I am, bossing you around. But this really is serious! Just give me a minute to explain.
What's so special about the recording?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C01_FindMe_Wai: Skif, Banzai here. The tech from the mine. I made it to safety, and I've got the coupons.
I'll give a heads-up – someone will meet you. I'm waiting for you and the tools!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_BackStart_: Fine, I'll go look for your tools.
I have the coordinates for three stashes at the Vehicle Graveyard. Not sure which one has the tools, but they gotta be there somewhere.
I'll stay on comms in case something goes south.
Fine, I'll go look for your tools.
I have the coordinates for three stashes at the Vehicle Graveyard. Not sure which one has the tools, but they gotta be there somewhere.
Thanks. I'll stay in touch, okay? I wanna hear that cheapskate witness karma in action, live.
No time for this now. Maybe later.
As you wish. But I'm more use to you with the tools.
No time for this now. Maybe later.
Damn it. "Later", again… What if bandits jump us again tomorrow and we've got nothing to shoot with?
What do I need to do again?
My tools are no good for fixing weapons. I need different ones. Then I'll have myself a way to be useful for the camp.
I know where this technician hid some. The tools that I need are in one of his stashes.
What do I need to do again?
And they call me absent-minded. Scoutmaster asked for some weapon repairs. My tools are no good for it – we need precision tools for fine work.
I know where a sneaky technician keeps his tools. He's clever, got several stashes, and the tools have gotta be in one of them.
You said something about tools. Still need them?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_Finish_You: Are these the tools you were looking for?
They are. Here, for your time. And you found a good riddle in the process. That one, with the solder.
Are these the tools you were looking for?
Damn right they are! Scoutmaster can't tell the difference to save his life. "Why can't you use the ones you have?" Pah!
I respect my elders, of course, but I'm not giving him unsolicited advice on how to guide.
Sorry, I got carried away. Here, for your troubles. After I try the tools out, feel free to stop by for repairs!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_FirstClue_: Hey! So, what's up? Any luck with those tools?
Found the stash. No tools there, only a piece of paper. Any idea what this might be?
Shitballs… Looks like he left it for a customer. A clue! Some kind of cipher.
Check the other trackers, will you? Just don't throw that piece of paper away! I'll think about what it might mean.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_NearSafe_G: Skif, come in! I figured it out!
Great. And I found the real safe. It's a four-digit code.
The solution is solder! Tin-lead solder, POS-60! But the numbers… Give me a minute. Stay on comms!
Ha! Melting temperature! That tricky bastard! Write down: 0-1-8-3.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_Start_Acce: Fine, I'll go look for your tools.
I have the coordinates for three stashes at the Vehicle Graveyard. Not sure which one has the tools, but they gotta be there somewhere.
I'll stay on comms in case something goes south.
Fine, I'll go look for your tools.
I have the coordinates for three stashes at the Vehicle Graveyard. Not sure which one has the tools, but they gotta be there somewhere.
Thanks. I'll stay in touch, okay? I wanna hear that cheapskate witness karma in action, live.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_Start_Befo: There's this tech who crafts custom tool sets. A massive asshole who always underpaid me for soldering. But he forgot I was the one who set up the trackers for his stashes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_Start_HowK: How do you know where to get them?
Didn't think you'd be interested after… everything.
There's this tech who crafts custom tool sets. A massive asshole who always underpaid me for soldering. But he forgot I was the one who set up the trackers for his stashes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_Start_Need: Listen. There's a gig, a big one. Scoutmaster says we need firepower, but the last group left us nothing but crap that needs fixing.
I know how to fix it all myself, but I don't have the right tools! The ones you got are for radios, and we need weapon tools, for fine work. Luckily, I know where to get them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_Start_Next: No time for this now. Maybe later.
No time for this now. Maybe later.
Later? He might hide the tools somewhere else later. We're sitting ducks here with no guns.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C02_Start_WhyN: If he sells tools, why not just buy them?
I can't spell out for you what tools I need. And going myself? Not the best idea when there's a bounty on your head.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C03_BackStart_: Fine, I'll go look for your tools.
There's a stash at the C-2 Boiler House. Gotta be there. Should be easy – no passwords this time.
Thanks. For running errands for me, even now.
No time for this now. Maybe later.
What do I need to do, again?
I need tools for calibrating. They gotta be in a stash at the C-2 Boiler House. If you get them to me, you can count on more advanced enhancements.
You said something about tools. Still need them?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C03_Finish_Giv: I got you those tools from the stash.
Let me see? Wow… Wow! Skif, that's one hell of a treasure you found. So much better than I thought!
I can work miracles with these tools! I'll test them out on some scrap later. Feel free to stop by another time, and I'll make you into a Terminator!
And tell the others to stop by, too. I got a package of gizmos for everyone, just didn't have the tools to equip them until now. A decent suit for Medulin, an NVD for Scoutmaster…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C03_Start_Acce: Fine, I'll go look for your tools.
There's a stash at the C-2 Boiler House. Gotta be there. Should be easy – no passwords this time.
Thanks. For running errands for me, even now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C03_Start_Expo: Hi. I need some help. Don't worry, it's for a good cause. It'll be a win-win situation.
I gave up radio and I'm learning to fix gear. I'm doing all I can with the tools I've got, but I need better ones. For calibrating.
The things I could do with those… I'll install an awesome scope for Scoutmaster, and craft some more for Rascal to sell.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C03_Start_HowA: How are you after everything that's happened?
I'm okay, I guess… It's not like I'm being kicked out, but I don't feel like I belong.
I knew it'd be like that, and thought I was ready. Like hell I am.
It's funny, when you think about it. Pickaxe left me alive to fix stuff. Now look at me. I'm here… alive and still doing the same.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ96_QD_C03_Start_Next: No time for this now. Maybe later.
As you wish. But I'm more use to you with the tools.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QC_BanzaiRoomBusy: I'll be quick. Even quicker with the tools you got me. Just don't hover over me, please.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QC_BanzaiRoomWork: Don't twitch… a millimeter to the left… Damn! Missed again.
Easy… Nice and easy… Just like old times. Only a little tuning, nothing too complicated.
Damn... call myself a techie and had to fix the gear with literal scraps. Pathetic.
A freaking paperclip? I'd do it in a second with the right tools. Okay, here we go. Careful, careful…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QC_NewClearMutant: Skif, if that's you, I won't open if those mutants are still outside. Sorry. Don't wanna risk it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QC_NewEntryCommen: Put your weapon away and come on in. Banzai and I have been waiting for you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QC_NewGeneratorFi: I hear mutants! Headed your way!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QC_ScoutmasterDon: That won't fly here. He needs his space to work.
Listen to me. Give Banzai some time.
Bad idea. Step away from the door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QC_ScoutmasterGen: All in order, and I can see lights in the windows. It's cozy. Cheers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_BanzaiRoom_GoA: I'll be quick. You can talk to Scoutmaster in the meantime. He might need some help.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_BanzaiRoom_Hoo: Dang it, Scoutmaster, I asked not to be disturbed!
Ha, Skif? Well… that figures. You're a curious one, and don't believe what strangers tell you.
Scoutmaster didn't chain me up here, if that's what you thought. I locked myself in. I hate being distracted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_BanzaiRoom_Nee: Do you need anything else so you can work?
Just time, and no distractions. Maybe you can give Scoutmaster a hand while I'm stuck here? He doesn't show it, but I can see he got pretty messed up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_BanzaiRoom_Too: Atta boy! Thanks a lot. I don't know what scared me more: that Skull was gonna get them, or that I'm totally useless without them.
That's all I've got. Not much, I know. You did me a solid, and I can never repay you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_BanzaiRoom_Wha: What is it you're working so much on?
Same old – that damn transmission! There's not much time, and it's not becoming any clearer.
That's okay. I'll figure it out and get all the answers – about the frequency, the bounty, all of it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_NewBanzaiRoom_: And, after you help Scoutmaster, stop by. I'll see what I can do for you.
Dang it, Scoutmaster, I asked not to be disturbed!
Ah, Skif? Well… I understand. You're smart. And curious.
Sorry. Thought you were my friend… I mean, my other friend. And I hate to be disturbed.
Scoutmaster's got your back, no matter what. He's truly a good friend.
Yeah. Good man. Used to guide our NK-5. If he hadn't been wounded, he would've gotten all of us out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_NewNK3Group_Ne: You said group NK-3 was here before you. I found their bodies and their notes. Looks like the transmission made them go crazy.
Let me see… Looks like it. I am concerned by the "unlucky event", though. It's as if it were rehearsed, a perfect storm.
Good thing you found them. Give me a minute, then Banzai and I will take care of them. We were colleagues, after all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_NewQuestGive_N: Leave them with me, I'll pass them along. Banzai is at his place. A rare luxury in the Zone – his own place. But it's too dangerous for him outside.
