I'm wounded, and we're in the middle of nowhere. Had to kill the generator so the noise didn't attract mutants, and been hoping for a miracle since. Looks like you're the miracle.
And don't rush it – this place has a way of cooling down hotheads.
And don't storm into Banzai's place, or it'll take him a whole day to concentrate again. The sooner he figures that frequency out, the better our chances are.
Turn on the generator in the main hall, but be careful – critters from outside could be attracted by the sound.
The generator's up, lights are on. Cheers! It's got a lot cozier.
I'm the guide for NK-5, his group. His bodyguard after they put a bounty on our heads – and possibly the last person who cares if Banzai is still alive.
Mind your own business.
It is my business, unfortunately. And yours too, since you came here. Are you sure you've not been added as the fifth person on the target list?
First, Banzai doesn't want to run without his equipment, and now you're willing to risk both your lives. What's the deal with this transmission?
Not a clue. But at least we have the right to know why it's open season on us, and I suppose the previous group, too.
I don’t have time for this right now.
I understand, but we don't have much time, either.
It's the reason they put a bounty on your heads. You need to run. Now's not the time for science.
If you run from a bloke like Skull, you'll die tired.
Maybe we can trade the results of this research for our lives? Maybe we can use the transmission to our advantage? Our best chance is to keep working.
Why are you and Banzai here? What is this place, anyway?
Research groups used to operate here, on Malachite's orders. Studied this radio transmission. We're NK-5. NK-3 was here before us.
I couldn't find out what happened to them, or the others. Maybe the answer's somewhere at the camp.
Do you need help? How can we defend the camp?
You're injured, Banzai's no good, and it isn't safe here. I wouldn't have picked it as a shelter.
Didn't have much choice, being chased down. Plus, this place has the equipment we need to figure out the transmission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_ReturnBanzaiRo: Keep it short and sweet. What's up?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_ScoutmasterGro: The offer to work with us still stands. What do you think?
The offer to work with us still stands. What do you think?
No. Count me out.
Suit yourself. It's a pity, though. I hope you change your mind.
I still have some questions.
Ask away.
Any clue where to find them?
Banzai overheard Pickaxe looking for the "lil one" by the Army Warehouses. If anyone is "lil", that's Rascal.
As for Medulin, I only know he's got an emergency hideout in the Malachite depot. If he's alive, he's likely to try and make it there.
You said you needed me. But what do I get out of it?
If you didn't ask, I would've seriously thought that we recruited the wrong man.
I'll pay for the work. Plus, Banzai has been getting side gigs for gear repairs – he'll be happy to help. As a guide, I'll be at your service, too.
Fine, count me in. Now, give me the details – what's happening here?
We were a team of researchers. Four of us, as you know. I'm Scoutmaster, Banzai's the tech, Medulin is a scientist, and Rascal, our quartermaster.
Our mission was to figure out the nature of a strange radio signal. As it turned out, one that makes stalkers lose their minds.
When we got ambushed by Pickaxe, Rascal and Medulin escaped. I never found their bodies, so they might be alive. We need to find them and get the group back together.
I already know everything I need to.
Fine. I'll let you know as soon as we find out more. I sure hope I can count on you doing the same.
What is that research group?
The order came from Malachite, and Medulin was in charge. The group identifier was NK-5. You saw the corpses of NK-3 already, and I don't know what happened to the others.
That Skull guy hunting you down. Know more about him?
I know his kind. He's got enough resources, and he won't back down.
What do you know about that transmission anyway?
Not much. Random stalkers intercepted it a couple of times. The ones who only heard parts of it stayed alive to tell the story.
The ones who listened to the whole thing lost it. Shot themselves or turned into zombies. It may be that Pickaxe's ambush saved us from that fate.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ97_QD_ScoutmasterQue: I did what you asked.
Scoutmaster, how did you get that generator to rise from the dead?
Wasn't me. Skif started it. He cleaned the camp up, too.
Tell me.
Working on it.
No rush. Knowing Banzai, we'll be here for a while.
Scoutmaster, I mean it. We need a guy like him here! He kicked the bandits' asses and sorted the camp out, so maybe he'd be able to take care of our bounty?
All in good time. Pay up first, then negotiate a new contract.
He's right, you know. I propose you work with us. If you agree, we'll tell you all about the transmission and the research. Think about it.
What do I need to do again?
Generator, building sweep, summer stage, got it. Anything else?
That's it for now.
Building sweep, summer stage, got it. Anything else?
You started the generator, didn't you? Cheers. It's a lot cozier.
Building sweep, got it. Anything else?
Apart from that, Banzai and I heard voices on the summer stage, and now they've gone quiet. Thanks to you, I guess. Cheers for that.
Banzai is at his place. A rare luxury in the Zone – his own place. He asked not to be disturbed, so you and I will have to wait.
While we're at it, maybe you can help us settle in? We don't have lots of money, but I'll pay a fair price for your help.
And don't rush it – this place has a way of cooling down hotheads.
And don't barge into Banzai's place. He doesn't like to be distracted, and I don't like him whining about it.
The offer still stands. Anyway, I won't refuse a conversation with a smart man like yourself.
Turn on the generator – it's locked up in the hall. You can try getting there from the roof. I saw a vent there.
Take a look around the summer stage. I can't tell you what's out there. Banzai and I heard voices, but we can't say for sure with that damn radio.
Take a look around the summer stage. I can't tell you what's out there. Banzai and I heard voices, but we can't say for sure with that damn radio.
Greetings. I'd shake your hand, but mine isn't moving that well yet.
Bandit ambushes are bad for your health. You're the one who saved our radio genius, right?
Mind your own business.
This is my business. And yours, if you came out here. I want to know who I'm in the same boat with.
Yes, I got him his tools.
That's great. Banzai is as good without them as we are with no guns – useless, and he knows it. It makes me uneasy.
Maybe. Depends on who you are and why you're asking.
I'm his group's guide. His bodyguard after they put a bounty on our heads. And, possibly, the last person who cares if Banzai is still alive.
I don’t have time for this right now.
I understand. But I'll be glad if you change your mind.
Settle down where? What is this place, anyway?
Base camp for groups who studied this strange radio transmission before us. We're the last one.
I don't know what happened to the previous group, but they never came back.
What kind of help do you need?
Take a look at the building on the left. The last group tried to stand their ground there, and we inherited their trip wires. Maybe something else, too.
Here's the key. And do be careful.
You're injured, Banzai's no good, and it isn't safe here. I wouldn't have picked it as a shelter.
Well, I like it. A sturdy roof, strong walls, and given its reputation, no one will come looking for us here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QC_AllOver_Safe_8: Is it all over? There's no more danger outside?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QC_ToScary_NotMov: I won't take another step until I know what's outside!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_ARG: The research protocols? The data packages you sent from Malachite?
Yes. My little scheduled message program for emergencies. As you can see, it's all been one huge emergency.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_Abo: I came across this radio transmission that literally makes you lose your mind. Sound waves that impact your mental state!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_Acc: I'll wait for you. We'll go together.
Great! Nothing can scare the three of us. Let's continue this talk at Kazkovyi?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_GoB: I just went out with the group to personally conduct an experiment when we were attacked. Wait a minute…
Medulin, come in. Banzai intercepted your transmission. Stay there, I'm on my way.
Scoutmaster, this is Medulin! Your friend found me and helped. Wait… Was it so easy to intercept?
It was for Banzai, but he's a genius. Skif, if you're there – thank you. You coming with us or not?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_NoO: Don't be so dramatic. No one's going to die.
Easy for you to say! You haven't been holed up here like a rat for hell knows how long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_Ref: I have things to do. I'll find my own way.
It's a shame. It would be safer to travel together. Well, see you at Kazkovyi!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_Ser: Mercenaries were sent to hunt down your group. You crossed someone powerful.
It seems so, but I fail to understand how. We were simply studying radio waves!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_Too: So many shots fired… They're late anyway. I sent the research protocols a long time ago.
Even if they silence me by force, my work won't die with me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_AfterFight_Wha: What could make these studies so important?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_DidH: He's alive? Thank god… Just him, or the others, too?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_DoNo: Stop right there! I'm armed, and I'll shoot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Enou: Three kits for one? And that's not enough?
It sure isn't! Since when can fieldwork boast one problem at a time? Bandits – one. Anomalies – two. Radiation – three. And these are just examples!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Find: The others are alive and in a safe place.
That's great news. You've put my mind at ease! I wouldn't forgive myself.
If I find a new suit for you, will you manage to get there?
I think so. Well, almost sure. If it's a high-quality suit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Give: Now you got four. Feeling any better?
Much better. Here. Take this, please. For being so understanding.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Good: I have one. You could go to Prypiat and back wearing it.
They'd make me sign three logs to get one of these in Malachite! Never thought I'd get to try one on. Thanks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_GotY: Gotcha! Another step, and you're dead!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Hard: Put the gun down. You Medulin?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Look: Scoutmaster. Asked me to find you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Next: I'm in no position to demand, but please think about it again!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Norm: I have a spare suit. A nice and sturdy one, too.
Decent, indeed. It gives me hope to get to the camp unscathed. Thanks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_NotF: Scoutmaster and Banzai are alive and safe. Don't know about Rascal yet.
Poor Rascal. He wasn't even aware of the expedition's goal! Try to find him. I'd never forgive myself if he's dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Poor: I got something here. Not much protection, though.
Yeah… That'll be my burial shroud, but it's still better than these rags. Thank you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Show: The one saving your group's asses. You've got targets on your backs.
Saving our asses? Please… tell me I'm not the only member of the group who's still alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_Stas: I don't want to be in your debt. So, in return, here are the coordinates to a stash with a gift.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_They: Shhh! Hear that? They've found us! They were probably tailing you. If someone's out there, I'm not coming out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_TryF: I'll try to figure something out. Wait here.
I will. Got no other options.
But hurry up, I'm begging you! If it was so easy for you to find me, others can too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_WeNe: Questions later. You need to get to your group.
I would, but how? Some goons are after me, and they've even asked around Malachite about me already. This isn't safe!
My protective suit is torn into pieces, and I've only got three medkits. I'm catastrophically unprepared!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindMedic_YouB: You're back! Help me, please! Without a protective suit, there's no way I can get out of here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindSuit_DoYou: Did you find a suit? Did anyone follow you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindSuit_GoodS: I did. Be careful with it. I won't be able to get you another one.
They'd make me sign three logs to get one of these in Malachite! Never thought I'd get to try one on. Thanks!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindSuit_Leave: I will. Got no other options.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindSuit_Norma: Decent, indeed. It gives me hope to get to the camp unscathed. Thanks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindSuit_PoorS: It's not the best quality, but yes.
Yeah… That'll be my burial shroud, but it's still better than these rags. Thank you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindSuit_Stash: I don't want to be in your debt. So, in return, here are the coordinates to a stash with a gift.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ98_QD_FindSuit_TheyC: Shhh! Hear that? They've found us! They were probably tailing you. If someone's out there, I'm not coming out!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QC_BanditsRandom_: Are you gonna answer or not, you piece of… Fuck! Hello?! Hello, boss?! Just static…
Boss? Come in! We've been calling for an hour.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QC_ShelmaBusy_Bus: I get it. Not need to escort me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QC_ShelmaDontLeav: Hey! Don't go! I haven't paid you for my rescue!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_ReturnToVozhat: The group's back together. Thanks to you. I had no doubt you'd pull it off.
While you were gone, I found something valuable, left by our predecessors. Part of the sale profit is yours.
Speaking of valuables – Banzai found something to show you. Now it's your turn to listen to him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_ShelmaAftermat: Mercs didn't send me, Scoutmaster did. Your group is waiting for you in the Burnt Forest.
They're alive? That's great news! I saw Scoutmaster fighting like a lion, covering the others as they fell back. Not bad for an old guy like him.
Give them my best regards, and tell them that I'll meet them in Rostok. I'll make sure they get the best personal discounts. We've been through some tough times together.
But... Considering the alternatives, if I stay — I'm fucked, even if I go to Rostok — I'm fucked. Burnt Forest, though? Maybe not.
Whatever… I'll go there. Don't forget about the stash.
Oh. Oh, fuck! Hold on, let's discuss this like two honest businessmen! I'm not the one you need, I'm telling you!
You know what? It's your lucky day! I have an excellent stash nearby. I give you the coordinates, you pretend you never saw me. Deal?
And this stash has enough to cover your ransom?
Maybe… It depends on the exchange rate. This was force-majeure! My last chance. What was I supposed to tell them?!
I get it, the situation is unpleasant. Take some more coupons, maybe? For the collateral?
All of you are in danger. Your group needs you, and you need them.
We're both grown-ups. In the Zone, it's every man for himself. I'm sorry they have to go through this, but I was nearly fucking killed. Twice!
They can do whatever, but I'm off to Rostok. They've got good security, and no freaks get further than the Arena.
If you're separated, you'll get killed. Together, you have a chance.
Chances are we'll all get killed together. One hell of a lose-lose situation.
Scoutmaster and Banzai are trying to get rid of the threat. For good.
The ones who created the problem are heroically solving it. Idealists…
Tough times have just begun. There's a bounty on your heads.
How come? What for? I didn't sign up for this! Medulin's contract only had two pages, no fine print, and definitely no mercenaries!
What do I do now? I'm no Sidorovich – I don't have a bunker! What are the others saying, if they sent you to get me?
That this is because of the radio transmission they studied.
What've I got to do with it? I was in charge of supplies. It was none of my business what transmissions they listened to.
What am I gonna show the mercs? Ration papers? They'd be better off looking for Medulin and Banzai. They say anything else?
What happened to you?
I'm still trying to figure that out! I signed a contract with this scientist – grub, spares, expedition supplies – then we got jumped! Chased! I'm a businessman, not a marathon runner.
They trapped me here and wouldn't take my money! Get it? Bandits, refusing money?! That's when I knew I was screwed.
They said there was this merc interested in me, and I'd never done any business with them before. I am quite a notable figure, of course, but not like that!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_ShelmaBanditsR: Once I get paid, I'll bolt to the mainland. Buy myself a tire shop. And get married, fo sho!
Smart investment! But I'll give you more to let me go – enough to buy a whole car shop!
Mercs and Pickaxe chewed it over, and where's he at? Only payment we'll get is in lead.
Shut up, damn it! Quit whining. You, call Pickaxe. And you, smartass, open your mouth again and I'll close it for good.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_ShelmaBandits_: Cool your jets, eh. If Pickaxe ain't answering, he's busy. Let's wait a bit, finish the chump off, then bounce.
Something's not right. Pickaxe sleeps and shits with that radio. No way he's not picking up.
Gents, gents. I'm no mercenary, of course, but I am a businessman. How much did he say I was worth?
My dead body is worth less, I guarantee. Dragging a prisoner with you? Think about security, the logistics… How about the same amount, here and now?
Oh yeah? Go ahead. Bargain for it. Surprise me.
What the hell?! You think you can screw over Pickaxe and the merc he's working for?!
Here's the money. On the PDA. Real money, right now!
Shut your trap. And you, call Pickaxe again.
Pickaxe. Come in. Come in, damn it…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Ca: I'm here for Rascal. But I'll take care of you first.
Are you fucking superman?! Alone against us? Get him, boys!
Mercs sent me. To collect the package.
A-fucking-mazing! Got the dough, like we discussed?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Co: Pickaxe – a merc. Chump thinks he's funny! Get him!
Maybe you need to cool your jets, huh?
All right. Who'd Skull shoot the shit with?
I told you he's a fraud! Fucking told you! Get him!
A-okay. We got the dough, go get your chump.
Looks about right. He's all yours.
Nah, nah, nah! No one told us about no couriers! Smells like bullshit… Lemme ask you some questions.
Who's the merc that sent you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Hi: The job's good. Pays well, too.
Why's he worth so much?! Smartass knows sumthin' important, like where the Monlith's buried?
For this much, I don't care what he knows. Gimme the coupons – he's your problem now. Let's get outta here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Ho: Look what the cat dragged in. Be on your freaking way, we're busy here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Im: Ask Pickaxe, and how he royally fucked up and lost twenty per cent.
Ask Pickaxe. He asked the customer stupid questions, too.
So you're… one of them? Those… gentlemen? And Pickaxe ain't picking up…
If Pickaxe fucked up, ain't got nuthin' to do with us. We were told to catch this one – here he is. Take 'im. We don't need no trouble.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Ju: I'm just passing by. I don't want trouble.
That's me! Didn't see me, eh? You're right on time there, buddy. Got the ransom? I'll pay you back, with interest!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Lo: I'll throw in an extra bullet for you.
Now that's better! You better not sit on other folks' money. It might end badly. Get your chump.
I'd take what I'm offered if I were you.
You're shitting me. This is bullshit! You wanna screw us over?!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_TradeDialog_Pa: What ransom? I've never seen you before.
Whatcha bitching about? Finish him off now, think about it later.
I got it, yes. Take the coupons and let the man go.
Fuck a duck… I've only seen this much money in the movies!
Dump the chump and let's go. Real fucking quick.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_supack_SQ99_QD_VozhatyNotFoun: Hello. Found any of our missing persons yet?
Where should I look for them?
Banzai thinks Rascal might be at the Army Warehouses. Bandits were chasing him, so keep your eyes peeled.
As for Medulin, I only know he had a hideout in the Malachite depot. Check both places. I hope they're alive.
Hurry up. I don't think those two have much time if they've split up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_con_belenkyi_aggro_notag: I can punch you right in the face, and we'll see how much discount I can get.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_con_belenkyi_end_conv_to: Sorry, I've got no more time for this.
Oh, well. Not many people could afford my "stuff". Come back when you get some money.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_con_belenkyi_main_dialog: You know you owe me big time. So stop screwing around.
Excuse me! My debts are payed in full!
Wow! Haven't seen you for a while.
Two months hunting, Artem. Almost lost my prey 2 days ago!
Of course, the last hunt was pretty profitable. I have some koupons right here on me.
We can tell the Boss you were swiping some koupons under the rug. He would be very pleased to finally find the "leakage".
Is there any information on other Stalkers?
Since you've left Sanya has recovered 2 artifacts. He went on a drinking spree and lost one of it in the forest.
Yeah! And Petro lost an ear fighting of a pack of Pseudodogs. We call him "Gramophone" from now on.
Need to find my new target. Could you point me to a right direction?
Just've received some intel on a new monster. What can you offer in exchange for that info?
I've got some fist sandwich with me - I could just punch you right in the face for not sharing a vital information.
What's new here at the camp?
Not much. Emissions still rage every hour, bloodsuckers are lurking in the shadows, we are short on supplies - well, just an ordinary Tuesday.
How can I be of a service?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_con_belenkyi_notaggro__1: That wouldn't be a problem. The month's been quite a profitable one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_con_belenkyi_override_to: Is there any information on other Stalkers?

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_container_belenkyi_Libra: Hey. Can you show me the way to the nearest library?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_container_belenkyi_bye_t: Not a very pleasant encounter... Good bye.
I am tired of your stories. Good bye!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_test_container_belenkyi_main_: I could really use some fuel, if you know what I mean.
Looking good for a man, who doesn't hear a thing. How are you?

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_backtomem_car: I found this guitar there, it fused with anomaly somehow and played the melody.
I took it away and anomaly field almost disappeared.
Hah, sounds just like one of those Zone ballads, which you don't believe in until it happens to you!
Previous owner... wanted his melody to play throughout the Zone.
Maybe I will help him achieve that...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_backtomem_che: I got even more questions now, but I'm not gonna waste any more of your time, stalker.
Now that you've made it back alive I guess I can take a look for myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_backtomem_pre: Didn't want to disturb the Zone's flow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_4_84909: But you were there and came back, didn't you?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_4_84910: I didn't walk deep in the forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_4_84911: When I heard that music, I became curious.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_4_84912: But as I moved closer towards it - I saw some corpses, and I ran back from that place as fast as I could.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_5_84914: Can you tell me the exact location of this place?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_5_84915: A little bit north from Izumrudne or west from Roadside Shop, somewhere in that forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_5_84916: The sound of music will lead you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_accept_: Sounds interesting. I might just check out the place.
Just remember to go there at night! And be careful.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_decline: Right now I have other things to do.
I'm sure that place will stay for a while...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_run_849: I am not afraid of what I can see, but that place gave me shivers - and I prefer my own skin to stay unharmed.
But it's still interesting what's in there. I just don't have the balls to check it out myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_start1_: Stalker, have you been in the forest north from Izumrudne at night by any chance?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_begin_start2_: I was there just yesterday, and let me tell you, there is something ominous about that place.
At night, in the forest, a melody plays after midnight, soft like a lullaby - pulls you in like gravity.
But the song... It still plays. Still waiting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_destroyed_1_8: I can't play it any longer...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_here_1_85025: Hey, stalker! Lend me your ear for a moment!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_melody_carry_: Maybe I can make the Zone hear your melody?
Take it to other places. Make it sound all over.
I can't leave this place, but with your help I guess my melody can...
Yes, take it. Carry it through the night with you...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_melody_choose: I... I just want the Zone to hear my music, my melody...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_melody_dead_8: Who are you? Are you dead?
I played here sometimes. At nights.
A phantom? Can you understand me?
See, at nights the Zone is truly magnificent...
I just wanted to add some music to it, to make it even more beautiful.
But I feel like I can't leave this place... not yet.
Do you remember anything more... recent?
I played my guitar during the night... but then... then...
Some surge happened... maybe it was an emission?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_melody_intro_: You heard it too... didn't you?
The Zone listens when I play. It remembers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_melody_place_: I wanted to give music to this place, this forest...
But something happened... I can't remember what...
Now I just play my guitar, at night, under the light of stars.
Even in the Zone there is a place for some tranquility...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_testquest_AL_QD_melody_stay_8: Then may the Zone keep my melody...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_Crucifix_1_70: Ther iz a crucifix behind you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_GetDrunk_1_70: One of the most unfortunate things about being in the Zone is that you have to kill.
I love to make real evening of it, play some music, maybe give them some vodka.
It's their last moment alive so why not make it a nice experience?
So let's drink some vodka to it!
Don't be afraid, you are our friend, it's not your "evening" yet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_GetDrunk_Agre: Bring on some music! I'm gonna get myself fucked!
Now that's the spirit! Take some more vodka!
I sense the presence of The Beast!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_GetDrunk_Atta: You think I'm stupid or what? I'm gonna fuck you up, you poor bastards!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_GetDrunk_Refu: Nah, let's get things done first.
You're such a pussy! Alright let's go then.
I sense the presence of The Beast!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_HeadOut_1_708: You know how it is, you might kill someone
And then, you think, ooh, those are some nice pants!
Let's prepare ourselves near the grave on the way,
Sure, let's head out. Keep up!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_Hello_Attack_: You know what, I think I'm gonna clean this place out of you, you bunch of a sick bastards!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_Hello_NightTi: Deacon... hi. Hey Deacon. How was your last night?
I transformed into a blind dog and had sex.
Tonight we are going into the Zone's Cathedral...
To attend the Unholy Masquerade and face The Beast.
Vladislav can tell you some stories about his great battle with The Beast.
Yeah. "Oh, I fought The Beast on a cliff." "Oh, I fought The Beast in a swamp."
The darkest part of my mind is reserved for The Beast.
"And then one time I fought The Beast in the toilets of a nightclub."
And I said "Get your hands off my balls, Beast!".
Anyway... It is important that we look good, so here, put on some clothes from the victims lying out there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_Hello_Refuse_: I think I better leave this place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_LeaveHim_1_70: Gentlemen, just leave him to die here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_NightSpawn_Aw: So, it's PM in the night-time, which is when I wake up.
And I'm going to wake up my flatmates. Awaken! Awakey-wakey!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_PreHello_DayT: Hssss... I'm not functional during the day time. Talk to me at night.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_PreHello_Wait: I'll wait here if you don't mind.
Alright, gonna come back here at night.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_TakeALook_1_7: Now behold the grave beside you! Investigate it reeealy close.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_TakeALook_2_7: You guys gotta be kidding me...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_TakeALook_3_7: You know what? I've got so fucking tired of this bullshit, you are going to shit out your teeth now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_phrase_vdiachenko_test_TheEnd_1_7091: What the actual fuck was that?
Don't worry, we are not going to torture you, we just have nothing to eat... So... We are going to suck you sooo bad.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ01_VadaHvoro: A PDA from the body of the rookie Vadya Kindling, slain by mutants. The guy had a hunch that the Monitoring Station was attracting dogs for a reason. He had a keen sense for loot, but the mutants proved to have an even keener sense for him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ04_LokotPDA_: Fueled by an overpowering desire to regain his authority, Elbow lost his marbles and decided to face the challenge alone, without any support. It could only have ended badly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ06_VadyaPDA_: A stalker’s PDA with an interrupted audio log. Startled by an unexpected encounter, the rookie inadvertently dropped his primary means of communication.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ07_RabinaPDA: Apparently Rowan had a meeting with a dealer, but things didn’t go the way he planned.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ08_NoteToHom: A note found in the Fisherman’s House. Upbeat and jovial as ever, Nightingale shows genuine concern for his friend – a sight as uncommon in the Zone as fish in the local streams.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ10_NoteMedic: Notes written by a medic, found at the Levitating Silo in the Lesser Zone. They express his hopes for expanding the Zone’s perimeter – for the good of mankind, of course.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ12_Note_desc: A report from the Perimeter decontamination station condemning Cpt. Sukhin. No one could have expected it to end up in the hands of the very person it criticized rather than Garmata.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ13_PDAVladAs: A PDA belonging to Vlad Vivid, found by the soldier statue in the Dire Thicket. He must have been so terrified, he dropped his PDA without realizing it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ15_NoteRat_d: A PDA taken from the body of a bandit punished by his own gang, found near the Railway Bridge in Garbage. Mitya seems to have set his buddies up, leading to a swift and brutal reprisal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ16_PDALetyn_: The owner of this PDA must have been either really gutsy or really naive, dissing Roosevelt like that. When you’re working for a big shot, you gotta keep quiet or be real careful who you’re talking to.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ17_AboutVara: A lost PDA from a Garbage bandit with a warning about Varan’s gang. One of the rules this kingpin lives by is, “if your own people are scared of you, everyone else will be terrified.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ20_Lost_PDA_: Yet another stalker who wanted to go back to the Mainland, but couldn’t. It’s difficult to find a way out when there’s nowhere to go. For folks like him, the Zone is a one-way ticket.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ21_MemoryDia: The note contains memories of what this place used to be like before the Disaster. The paper is visibly worn – it seems to have been carried by the wind over the bridge for quite some time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ22_ClearSkyN: An old sheet of paper ripped from a diary containing a scientist’s notes from his expedition with Scar. “September 2011” is faintly discernible on the surviving portion of the page.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ23_AtasPDA_d: A PDA found near the Hydroelectric Station. The conversation inside discusses a stash prepared for some bandits by a Warden. Looks like even the group known for imposing its law on the rest of the Zone has its own issues.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ24_VenyaNote: A crumpled note discovered in a Prypiat apartment. The author wrote down his last words, and yet his handwriting is still surprisingly steady and neat.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANCQ_19_BanditDi: An old diary of a thug employed by the Shah, discovered in the Brood’s barracks. The worn cover implies that the owner was dealing with considerable anxiety.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_ANC_18_IOUNote_d: Sounds like the author of this note screwed up big time in front of his own buddies. Luckily, his partners agreed to wait for the debt to be repaid. In the Zone, issues like this are usually settled on the spot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_AzimutControlRoo: A key card granting access to the control room of Azimuth Station. Found in the pocket of the late Ward sergeant Nikitin.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Bandits_: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This one was owned by a bandit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Duty_des: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This one was owned by a Duty member.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Freedom_: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This one was owned by a Freedom member.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Military: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This one was owned by an IPSF soldier.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Monolith: A PDA formerly used by Monolith soldiers, now broken beyond repair.

A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This particular device was modified to run on the Monolith network.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Neutrals: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This one was owned by a lone stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Spark_de: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This one was owned by a Sparker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_Ward_des: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder. This one was owned by a Warden.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BasePDA_descript: A pocket personal computer, version 2.0. In the Zone, it functions as a navigation tool, notebook, communication device, and voice recorder.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_BordulinPDA_desc: A PDA belonging to Borodulin, a man who presents himself as a Duty colonel. If he ever had three stars, though, they probably came from a brandy label, not a military rank.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC00_Deluxe_Fla: Flash drive with the Journalist's last message.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC00_Journalist: It looks like a regular PDA. But this one keeps the secret of the man who found what he was looking for in the Zone, and left on his own terms.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC00_PreOrder_F: Another secret message from the Journalist.
A flash drive with a new message from the Journalist.
A flash drive with a message from a mysterious stalker called the Journalist.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_CNPP_: An old army PDA. Chipped paint, faded buttons, but still works.
On the back of the PDA, "Acorn" has been scratched with something sharp. You can see deep knife marks in place of one of the letters, as if the owner struggled with spelling.
PDA with a crushed screen. Judging by the shape of the dent, the owner punched their device.

A PDA with greasy fingerprints. The owner stored everything on it – from moonshine recipes to photos with his friends on the Mainland. Also includes an ambitious plan to get rich by shaking down CNPP stalkers.
A loner's PDA with some useful notes among hundreds of pictures of sleeping Bayuns.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_01: An old and yellowed sheet of paper with poorly preserved printed text.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_02: A note with every letter carefully written. The author was clearly enjoying the moment, and was in no hurry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_03: Belonged to a loner who thought he was lucky to hit the jackpot. Except the Zone tends to punish the carefree.
The device is chipped, covered in scratches, and the play button is stuck. The recordings themselves might be intact and playable if you transfer them onto a different device.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_04: Belonged to a loner who managed to tune into the voices of the Zone. But they led him too far.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_05: An old military-grade device that changed hands a lot in its years of service. The last one, judging by the contents of the PDA, was a great lover of pulp fiction.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_06: A brand-new PDA without a single scratch, but with dried blood on the buttons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_07: A PDA with off-the-charts radiation levels. Better to get rid of it as soon as possible.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_08: This device has seen a lot. Including the inside of a mutant's mouth.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_09: A well-preserved PDA. The chewed-up body of its owner was found near the water in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ANCQ_IF_10: Neatly handwritten note. A surprisingly accurate chaffinch is drawn in the corner.
A folded A4 sheet of paper
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_AngelPda_d: Judging by the PDA, the owner had quite an eventful life. It's surprising the PDA still works, but it's not surprising the owner of the device is dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_D: Judging by a deep shear on the front and a cracked screen, someone was so mad they threw it at the wall.
The device barely works. Just like its owner, it's definitely seen some action.
A PDA left at the CNPP's bar. It's in perfect condition – Zulu had just bought it after he lost the previous one.
Neat cursive indicates the author was born long before PDAs were a thing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Hub_F: The back of the device has some kind of symbols scratched into it. You can't make out what they say.
The whole thing is covered in sticky stains. Bonespike probably uses it after surgeries and doesn't take his gloves off first.
A thin layer of dust on the front suggests the owner doesn't have much time to chat or look at funny pictures.
A colorful gum sticker on the back says a lot about the owner's cheerful personality.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Map_d: A worn hand-drawn map of the CNPP, schematic but precise. It marks several Monolith depots, one of them has a brief note next to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_CNPP_Map_n: Map of CNPP with Monolith stashes
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ContractPD: The PDA only has one message left, labeled "Important".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_DLC01_MQ08: A small key to a safe where Mavka stores her most precious belongings.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_DLC01_MQ09: Just an ordinary key. But Myklukha always had his most precious possessions on him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_Doctors_PD: One of the corners of the device is broken off, suggesting the PDA could have fallen and hit the floor. That could also be why some files on it have been damaged.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ01_OldKe: An old metal key. Part of the tag has been torn off, the rest of it reads: "…former. Warehouse".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ02_Lajko: A PDA with deep, choppy cuts. The reinforced frame stood no chance of saving its owner from a chimera's claws.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ03_Dunge: A steel key that looks like it's for a safe. Found in a Kurin basement.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ03_TohaP: PDA found on a body that will stay in Kurin's underground forever. The messages indicate that the unlucky bandit had almost made it to his goal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ05_Freed: A PDA in a condition so bad that it's surprising it still works at all. The owner doesn't like letting go of either his old things, or the coupons needed to get replacements.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_EQ08_PDA_M: A mercenary's PDA that caught a bullet. It's strange that the device still works even after it was shot through.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_ElhantNote: A piece of paper covered in fancy handwriting. The content is even more intriguing. Whoever wrote this must’ve been hit by the local psi-anomaly more than once.
Note from a stash in a tree
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_FujiPDA_de: This PDA's owner sure took good care of it. The outside of the device looks almost brand new, and it hardly has any chats left on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_KeyWarehou: "SKL-02" is written on a dirty tag.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ02_Garag: A torn page, where every letter is pressed into the paper.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ02_Mavka: A page from a book with a tea stain and a note in shaky handwriting.
Page from a book with a note
A document found by Mavka that could potentially have information on the coordinates of the Blast's source.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_Fenri: A mercenary's PDA with cracks in the screen. The device survived a massive blast, unlike its owner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_Gener: A key with a small tag that reads "Generator room".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_NordG: Bears the logo of an unknown mercenary group, found on a body in the Testing Workshop. Mavka and Zulu will want to see this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_Testi: These yellowish papers are from way back when the Workshop hosted a multitude of experiments, so it's a surprise they're still readable.
Notes on the Testing Workshop experiments
Folder found in the Testing Workshop. A dark liquid has been spilled over it, you can only make out what's written on one of the papers.
Status report on an unknown technology
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ03_Works: The letters on this key card are worn because of time and frequent use, so you can't make out what they say.
Key card to the Testing Workshop
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ04_Archi: A folder with documents on research into spatial anomalies. This is the information the mercenaries were looking for in the SIRCAA archives.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ04_ArtFa: The countless spelling mistakes make sure that the message will only get to the one who is desperate to receive it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ04_Karma: The PDA of an unstable mercenary from Nord's group. It doesn't have a single scratch on it, unlike its owner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ04_NordB: A PDA that belonged to an unlucky mercenary who was stuck in a SIRCAA water anomaly with his buddy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Brock: PDA that belonged to Bosch, one of Nord's mercenaries. The device glitches often, but you can still read one of the chats.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Bunch: A short confession. The author blames himself for Kosmach's death and can't live with that.
A scrap of paper with a death note
Belonged to Bunchuk, a member of Tachenko's group. A standard model, but feels heavier than it looks. Makes you slightly nauseous.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Buncu: Personal notes describing a Duty squad's failed attempts to reach the Radiowave Institute. The author writes that the city constantly changes itself, blocking the way through.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Cepur: The device took some serious damage in a short, but fierce fight. Despite that, the recorder was still operational – you can hear Chepurny screaming before he died.

A personal gadget of a Duty soldier. On the recording, Major Chepurnyi recounts how Tachenko shot Kosmach for attempting to switch off a certain device. The confession was lost in the "Miscellaneous" folder, right between photographs of his daughter and old local maps.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Chekh: The last recording is a monologue of an idealist who wanted to liberate the Zone, and then the whole world.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Corpu: This PDA seems to have suffered a fatal glitch in an anomaly. The text that never got the chance to be sent is still frozen on the screen.
PDA of a stalker in Corps uniform
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_DeadM: The frame has markings carved into it – trophies, or days being marked off. The battery is almost dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Famil: The photograph shows a happy boy with his parents. There's something wrong about the way they look, but it's hard to put a finger on what it is.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Freed: The device is slightly warm to the touch, as if someone were just holding it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Kosma: Belonged to Colonel Kosmach from Tachenko's group. The screen shows the only entry. No matter what you do, it's frozen, and won't close the entry or display the archive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Liman: The sheet of paper is clumsily folded, ripped, and looks like part of the map is missing. There are several marks, but one has been heavily circled with a red marker – the owners were looking for a way into the Radiowave Institute.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Lonel: Found near the body of a stalker stuck in Lymansk. The last note was written in shaky, almost childish handwriting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_MercB: PDA that belonged to one of Nord's people. Among several brief chats, one message has been marked "important".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_MercK: PDA taken from Celt, one of Nord's mercenaries. A bullet damaged the screen, but the memory module is intact.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Tache: An old army model that belonged to General Tachenko. No regulations or orders, just one damaged audio file. Seems like the Zone can break anyone.
Belonged to General Tachenko. Even when turned off, it makes quiet white noise. You can sometimes hear indistinct sentence fragments.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ06_Water: Covered in small, sloppy handwriting, it seems this is one of many letters that never got their answer.
A scrap of paper covered in handwriting
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Contr: A remote control for some kind of device. There are so many buttons and switches that it's scary to touch, even when it's off. Definitely connected to developments in Project X. Found in Lukash's stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Disci: Document found at the IPSF base
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Flash: A tiny veteran of Zone runs. The drive is covered in scratches, the cover is loose, and something is clicking inside.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_KoloP: A reddish-brown crust of dried blood covers the whole PDA. Its owner died a long time ago, but the device still has some life left in it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Kolo_: The key's teeth are worn from frequent use. Found in Lukash's stash.
There's not a single scratch on this PDA, and every nook and cranny is cleaned and pristine. It even still has the screen protector on.
PDA taken from Creed the mercenary
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Mercs: A folder with information gathered by Zen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_PDA_B: This PDA is new, but looks like the owner spends all their time on it. All the buttons and the screen are covered in greasy fingerprints.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_PDA_C: This PDA doesn't look like it's standard-issue, and it's covered in cartoon drawings made with a knife or other sharp object.
A PDA from the IPSF base
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ07_Radis: A PDA that belonged to a signal operator from the Perimeter Dam. The buttons have been replaced, and it has a sturdier frame than regular PDAs. The logo on the back says IPSF.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_Decod: A key card that opens the door to the X16 lab.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_Exper: A neat sheet of paper with a bloody fingerprint in the corner. It probably belongs to whoever signed under "volunteer consent".
Looks like this document was just printed. The paper is still white and doesn't have the laboratory smell.
Notice on the status of test subject N17

A sheet of A4 paper, filled out by hand, and smells like a hospital. If you look closely, you can see letter outlines. Apparently, the papers were stacked on top of each other when they wrote the death report.
Death report of test subject N17
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_FireP: The corner of the PDA is slightly melted. Looks like it spent some time close to an open fire, which is fitting considering the device owner's nickname.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_KeySa: An old key, covered in dried blood and a layer of rust.
Key from a body in X16
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_LehaP: An old, dirty PDA that looks like it's been dropped in mud more than once. There's also blood on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_MercK: A little old key, clearly meant for a door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_Proje: On the slide, there's a photograph and a number. You need a slide projector to pull the image up onto a screen.
On the slide, there's a photograph and a number. You need a slide projector to pull the image up onto a screen.
On the slide, there's a photograph and a number. You need a slide projector to pull the image up onto a screen.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_Sanya: Just as beat up as its owner. However, even with a web of cracks on the screen, some of the buttons missing, and a heavily damaged frame, the PDA still works. Sanya Pirate wasn't so lucky, and his wounds were fatal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ08_Zulus: A container packed with military explosives, taken from a bandit stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ09_Danya: A PDA with a fresh crack on the edge. Looks like the owner dropped it in a hurry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ09_Mavka: The recorder still has the factory smell. It clearly hasn't been used much, or it may have just been stored for a special occasion.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ09_Miklu: A PDA with precious information. Belonged to Freedom's leader. The former one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B01_E: A charge with a very high burning temperature. Handle carefully, and make sure to keep your distance when you set it off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B01_G: An old key that hasn't been used for many years. Looks like it might come in handy just one more time.
Key to the gas installation room
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B01_V: Instruction on the procedure for releasing gas into the station. Though, it won't help turn the rusty valves.
Voronin's instructions for the gas installation valves
A PDA with an order to place explosives in fresh snork hideouts under the checkpoint. The device is deformed, the screen broken.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_A: Found on Gout's body. It has a note about Barque and a couple of missing artifacts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_B: A lost key card, found on Latnyi. Even though the station is literally stacked with Myklukha's treasures, the locks here are old.
Key to the head of security's room
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_D: Just your usual device, apart from an old photo attached to the back: a man and a child, with their country house in the background. The other half of the photo has been ripped off, as if the owner was trying to forget someone who used to matter.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_E: Explosives that could come in handy in any situation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_G: A recorder with Godot's note about an unusual find in a regular artifact batch.
A recording about a strange artifact
A page from Vanko Copper's diary with information on an artifact order for an unknown stalker. The package number indicates that the order was delivered recently.
Found on Godot's body in the second section of the station. Has the owner's diary.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_K: Found on Keel's body, it has a chat that explains why Keel was helping Barque…
Found on Ursin's body. It has a chat with his colleague about closing down the warehouse flooded by Mercury, a task initiated by Hundo.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_M: Nothing special about this drive when you look at it, but it's incredibly valuable – it launches the Monorail.
Drive with the Monorail activation code
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_N: A completely soaked sheet of paper. The ink is blurred, but the text is still readable.
A soaked note from the warehouse
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ10_B02_S: An old notebook with information on one of the first victims of the anomaly that was later named Mercury.
A sheet of paper with increasing amounts of debt listed on it. Found at a warehouse.
A special PDA – not for work purposes, but for contemplating on what can't be shared.
An ordinary key that should open the door to the warehouse. I hope the Mercury didn't destroy it completely.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ11_B01_K: An old key card used by the CNPP personnel.
Key card to the control room
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ11_B01_P: A Freedom member's PDA, found on a dead body in the Monorail Control Depot. It has information on the activities of Mavka's group before Duty got here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ11_B01_Z: A Warden's PDA with the last message he was able to send when he was still human.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ11_B02_D: A regular key to a small space that Duty made into a storage room.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ11_B03_T: A rusty key, probably found by Duty when setting up a temporary camp in the CNPP.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ12_Explo: A package of C-4 with a detonator. Provides an effective solution to a lot of problems, and opens almost any door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ12_Keyca: A key card used by scientists. Opens almost any door of the X19 level that studied special technology.
Access card to the experimental block
A universal key that opens almost all the doors in the X19 living quarters.
Access card to the living quarters
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ12_LostS: A very old notebook that belonged to one of the X19 researchers. Seems like something had quite the impact on this poor man's mental state.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_MQ12_OldNo: A folder with a letter written by an X19 employee that could never have been sent.
A manual on sterilizing portable tanks. Seems like there was a problem with loading the last batch of tanks.
Document with a manual on portable tanks
This PDA has a chat between MDST scientists, describing the difficulties they encountered trying to survive in the lab. Judging by the date, they lived here after the second disaster.
Contains a paper that indicates the MDST scientists didn't have access to the laboratory facilities. Seems like it had been sealed off earlier.
Documents with the results of controversial experiments that Project X scientists considered justified.
A worn folder with presentation notes
Old notes describing experiments on mutants that were most likely carried out at the same time as the work on the main project.
The PDA has Lukash's notes, describing the amazing capabilities of Project X, and what it means for Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_Rostok_Hub: PDA with a screen protector on the front. The device's owner clearly handled it with care.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ01_Freed: A sheet of paper ripped out of a notebook with an old reggae band on the cover. It's half-covered in blood.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ01_GateK: Key card that opens the checkpoint gate to the Iron Forest. The smooth plastic is covered in scratches and has a half-faded IPSF logo.
Key card to the Iron Forest gate
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ01_Panch: The owner gave up this PDA as proof of his death so he could be struck from the IPSF ranks for good.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ01_Ryaby: The PDA of a dead IPSF member from Lieutenant Sorel's squad. The frame and the screen are covered in fresh blood. The contents discredit both the private and his commander.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ01_Soldi: Judging by the number of chats, Lieutenant Sorel was a busy bee – selling IPSF stashes to bandits and looking for new customers in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ02_DeadF: This old PDA belonged to a digger. Hidden within a lot of useless data are coordinates to the Iron Forest tunnel and messages to a friend who goes by Chatterbox.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ02_PDA_B: PDA of the bandit guarding the tunnel to the Iron Forest. Apart from prison jokes and erotic images of poor quality, the PDA has a chat with an unknown employer.
PDA taken from Gasbag the bandit
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ04_Bilon: Belonged to a traitor who used to spy for Freedom. It doesn't take much to find proof in the chat history.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ04_Khory: Belonged to the Freedom squad leader who once hired Skif to act as a middleman and pay the ransom for a prisoner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ04_MayoP: Belonged to Mayo, a local gang boss who decided to score some coupons in exchange for a prisoner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ06_EgorH: PDA found on a dead zombified stalker at the Dam. Looks like the poor man didn't even know what was coming when the psi hit him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ06_Serge: Personal PDA that belonged to the deceased Sergeant Shkliar. Contains details of the mission a three-man team were carrying out under his command.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ13_Artif: This artifact was found in the Flare fragment near the CNPP security building. Its properties are unknown, but it sits comfortably in the hand.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ13_Kastr: Castro's beat-up PDA. The contents shed some light on why Castro didn't reply to Rubin's calls.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ13_PDAQu: PDA taken from a dead Freedom member with a recorded cry for help. Sounds like Rubin's buddy got into a real mess.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ13_Snipe: PDA from a dead sniper who went by Python. The recording indicates he left his buddy to deal with an anomaly all by himself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Black: A small, but unexpectedly heavy device that stores data on the nature of spatial anomalies.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Bolsh: A drive, received from Chief, that suffered damage from both time and its owner. It has the coordinates and last known information about the missing research group.
Drive with coordinates to a black box
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Chadi: A PDA with a cracked screen and covered in mud. Looks like the owner parted with it against his will – or in a hurry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Drank: A PDA that belonged to one of Professor Taumin's assistants – looked after, and neatly kept in protective plastic. Contains the detailed reports and observations of a perfectionist researcher.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Gamer: The PDA that belonged to commander of the Freedom squad heading to the ABK-2 complex to hunt down the "Ghost of the CNPP".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Hatch: The PDA of the last mercenary from Nord's squad. The frame is pretty worn. Just like its owner, it's a survivor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Raboj: The PDA belonging to the commander of the Duty squad that headed to the ABK-2 complex hunting the "Ghost of the CNPP".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ14_Taumi: Reddish-brown from blood, this PDA belonged to the head of a research expedition. Only one note remains, the rest of the data has been erased.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_DoorK: Found on Otter's body. Judging by the yellow tarnish on the notches, the key hasn't been used for a while.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_DutyP: An old military-grade PDA that belonged to a Duty member. There are huge fang marks on the frame.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_Freed: This old PDA survived a chimera attack, unlike its owner. The stickers on the frame leave no doubt he was a Freedom member.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_LostS: This PDA has a recording that's not unusual in any way – if you don't think about the fate of the owner.
A worn PDA with a creepy recording – all the Zone has left of Rusty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_Quest: A rare type of PDA with notes from a dead stalker. Looks like he kept all his memories on this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_Stash: A password-protected PDA. The owner used a sharpie to write down the password right on the device. He was clearly less afraid of theft than of his own memory failing him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SQ15_Vydra: A rare type of PDA with notes from a dead stalker. Looks like he kept all his memories on this.
The battery is held in with some duct tape, but it otherwise looks ordinary. The maps haven't been updated for quite some time. Listening to the recorded messages gives an unsettling feeling.
PDA of a stalker from the CNPP
The screen is surprisingly clean, and the frame doesn't have a single scratch on it. Someone left their most treasured thoughts here.
PDA of a stalker from the CNPP
PDA of a stalker from the CNPP
PDA of a stalker from the CNPP
A rare type of PDA with notes from a dead stalker. Looks like he kept all his memories on this.
A rare type of PDA with notes from a dead stalker. Looks like he kept all his memories on this.
A lost PDA of an unknown stalker, found in a dusty old basement of the CNPP.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_SlavenkoHu: A broken recorder. The experiment might have gone south.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_X19_Scient: Contains brief information on the death of the C-Consciousness scientists who didn't get the chance to make the world a better place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_c4_charge_: Explosive charge, most commonly used by the military. A reliable solution for missions that require destruction. You won't find many of these in the Zone, so use wisely.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_memo_1986_: A faded memo. It was crumpled up, then carefully smoothed out. Clearly, someone hesitated for a long time before deciding whether to hand it over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DLC01_thermite_d: Powder mix with an extremely high burning temperature. Can be used for welding or metal cutting, but in the Zone, it's mostly used for military purposes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DevatyjPDA_descr: The PDA of a former Monolithian who resided in the Lesser Zone. It’s difficult to picture this calm, composed man among the ranks of Monolith.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DocPDA_SQ103_des: PDA of a scientist who worked in X18. An old "R&D" prototype with an inventory number on the side.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DogmasterDairy_d: A small worn-out leather notebook. Inside it are notes about trying to tame a blind dog.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DogmasterPDA_des: PDA of a hunter who died trying to tame a blind dog.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_DvupalovVodka_de: Zone-made vodka, distilled by a skilled chemist. It smells like strong moonshine.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_MQ02_BS_PDA_: A PDA owned by Mug, the leader of the gang holed up at the warehouse with the radiation hazard signs. It sports a skull keychain.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_MQ03_RebraKe: A little old key, clearly meant for a door.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_MQ03_RebraPD: Despite showing signs of damage, the device is still operational.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_MQ03_RebraSp: This key card is slightly worn from frequent use.
Key Card to the Sphere’s Cable Tunnels
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_MQ03_RihterN: A key that can be used to leave the Lesser Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_MQ03_VartaPD: A device Squint pilfered from a group of dead Wardens.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_MQ03_VartaSe: These devices are designed to measure and record environmental readings, anomalous energy fluctuations, and the wearer’s health data.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_SQ01_HmuriyP: This PDA belonged to a stalker who was taken captive by bandits. The device’s condition indicates that it suffered nearly as much as its owner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_SQ01_RabinaP: Apparently, Rowan had a meeting with a dealer – but things clearly didn’t go the way he planned.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E02_SQ01_ZorikPD: This used to belong to the stalker from the Post Office.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_01_Chernozem: A shabby PDA taken from Chornozem’s shoulder bag.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_02_OldTechDo: Blueprints detailing a certain “Product 81,” yellowed with age and ruined by mold in places.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_05_NestorNot: A worn-out notebook densely filled with Nestor’s scribbles. The former kingpin of Garbage didn’t trust electronic media.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_05_NestorPas: A weathered piece of old plastic, stained with blood.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_MQ01_GoshaMo: This PDA belonged to a bandit who bolted from the Depot out of fear of the Ward.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_MQ02_IskraPD: A PDA belonging to a Sparker from Serpentine’s group. The name on the keychain is illegible.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_MQ02_Isolato: A dull metal key with the barely visible number “-1” scratched into its surface.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_MQ02_Zmeevik: This weathered PDA bears a scar-like knife mark on its back panel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_MQ04_Key_des: These keys are commonly used to unlock the doors of prison cells.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E03_MQ05_BanditP: This PDA has seen some rough times. The case is all chipped and scratched, and there’s an old piece of chewed gum stuck to one of the buttons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_MQ02_Basemen: This worn, rusty key comes with a new plastic keychain labeled “Basement.”
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_MQ02_PDAWith: A PDA belonging to Maj. Hrygorchenko, commander of the Ward detachment during a mission at Azimut Station. He died in the line of duty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_MQ02_Recorde: This is a typical PDA of a SIRCAA scientist – a brand-new model in perfect condition, never taken outside. Regrettably, it broke after slipping out of its owner’s hands.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_NoteDubnyjTo: A carefully folded sheet of paper containing handwritten text. The letters appear almost etched into its surface.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_Note_UnityNo: A scrap of paper revealing the meticulously detailed thoughts and feelings of an unknown Noontider.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_SQ01_Lodochk: This container stores the cargo the Noontiders failed to bring back to their base. They might still be expecting it on Wild Island.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_SQ01_PDAStal: A PDA belonging to a bandit who was undone by his own greed. He thought he’d earn some extra coupons for killing more Noontiders, but all he got was a bullet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_SQ02_Control: A key to the control room in Lab X5.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E04_SQ02_KvaskaP: A PDA recovered from the body of the late Noontider Kvashka. Though it doesn’t explain the reasons behind his self-sacrifice, it does capture the final moments of his existence.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ01_EchoRep: A monitoring report from a team of SIRCAA scientists at Echo Station. Evidently, they were researching sources of psi-radiation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ01_Shterev: The personal diary of Lt. Shterev, who has since been exposed as an agent and fervent follower of Faust. It suggests that he found true happiness in carrying out his mission.
This PDA was found in the Claw, on the body of a dead Alpha Team commander. It looks like the traitor Shterev was there, but managed to escape.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ01_VartaSe: These devices are designed to measure and record environmental readings, anomalous energy fluctuations, and the wearer’s health data.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ02_Kalanch: A hand-drawn map of the Swamps, showing the beacons left by Prof. Kalancha to protect the Clear Sky base. It’s clear that a lot of effort went into it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ02_Zverobo: A PDA belonging to a wandering hunter. It contains information about his latest job and mentions an encounter with a partner who nimbly exited the scene.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ03_Kalanch: These are protocols of communication sessions from the time when C-Consciousness was still active. They were recorded using the setup in Kalancha’s laboratory, which continued to operate in autonomous mode.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ03_Lebedev: The lab employee’s last entry sheds some light on the failure of the “Mission to Protect Scientists” and the factors leading to Clear Sky’s departure from the base.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ03_NimbleD: The note is addressed to one Prof. Kalancha. It indicates that Scar had a longstanding association with Clear Sky, much like the author of the message.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_MQ03_NimbleP: The guide’s PDA contains an exchange with someone called Sickle, along with information regarding the operation of Kalancha’s beacons. Apparently, the only way to reach the Clear Sky base involves re-calibrating them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_SQ01_VartaPa: A document detailing the escaped squad’s recent patrols.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_SQ03_DocsAbo: Printed documents outlining mission objectives for the Warden squad led by Sgt. Shavruk.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_SQ03_PDASavr: This PDA bears numerous scratches and dents, evidence of a recent fight with a mutant – a stark contrast to its pristine condition just a little while ago.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_SQ03_Parts_d: Parts of exceptional reliability, used to craft military gear. The SIRCAA label is barely visible on them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_SQ04_GunPart: Surplus gear, including standard maintenance components that someone was looking to sell under the radar.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E05_SQ04_LapaPDA: This ordinary, worn-out PDA might offer insight into the mysterious customer who was supposed to receive the gear.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_E06_MQ01_AgathaN: This handwritten note from Dr. Dalin’s safe carries a faint scent of perfume.
