Page from a notebook, number 33
A neatly folded sheet of paper with some kind of list of names. Looks like it belonged to a person who made a living delivering packages and finding all kinds of trinkets around the Zone.
Page from a notebook, number 34
An old and worn-out paperback log, with notes written in Arnie's handwriting.
Arena log
Several pages ripped out from a notebook, with notes about scanners.
Page with diggers' notes
An A4 sheet with handwritten notes. Neat, large letters look almost pressed into the paper, indicating Strider's handwriting.
Page from a log
A heavy leather-cover book with neatly drawn lines on its pages.
Security service log
A log with old and yellowed pages. Some of them still have readable text left.
Diary
Names, amounts, and short notes made with rushed but clear handwriting.
Sonya Kalyna's notebook
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_e01_mq01_ssp_mem: A document found on the corpse of an International Perimeter Security Force soldier. Given the grease stains on it, it was probably not used as intended.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_krivenko_flashdr: A blank high-speed storage device designed exclusively for use on SIRCAA equipment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_krivenko_full_fl: A high-speed storage device designed exclusively for use on SIRCAA equipment. Any attempt to connect it to third-party devices will result in the destruction of the data.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_loopen_clock_not: An ordinary wall clock from your grandma’s house. Looks like it’s been broken for a while now, and it’s missing the seconds hand.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_nvgpack_ANCQ27_B: A PDA with orders for a bandit, taken from his corpse at Yantar.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_nvgpack_supack_A: Personal file of a researcher from the dead group investigating a strange transmission
Just a regular plastic drive, with the letter M and a date scratched on the side. Contains a recording. I wonder what all this means.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_nvgpack_supack_B: A regular key with something strange written on the tag: "d33s41d3m".
A regular door key with a tag
A scribbled draft that never got sent.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_nvgpack_supack_K: The PDA of the killed researcher of the mysterious radio transmission.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_old_looper_clock: You thought it was an ordinary clock you’ve seen a dozen of times. It has no batteries inside, but it glows from the inside, and as you look closer, you hear it ticking, while the seconds hand turns counter clockwise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_psilamp_part_05_: A fragment of the device responsible for subjecting Icarus personnel to psi-radiation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_scanner_lighter_: The very same TOPAZ anomaly detection scanner given to me by Hermann, though much lighter than last time. Looks like someone has tinkered with it since.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_sid_items_E02_SQ: To add a personal touch, the owner of this PDA scratched his nickname onto the back panel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_FairyTale: A regular door key that opens one of the Kazkovyi camp buildings.
Key to the Kazkovyi camp building
A little key with "Vent" carved into the key head.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ100_Sku: A folded note, put into the technician's chest pocket in a way it would be easily noticed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ95_Banz: A plastic drive with the name "Banzai" scratched onto it. Contains blueprints of a military-grade radio direction finder with strange modifications.
Drive with blueprints for a radio direction finder
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ95_Kirk: A worn-out PDA with multiple cracks on the screen. Filled with contacts like "Shady", "Skull", and "Mutt". Barely holds a charge.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ96_C01_: Note from the Vehicle Graveyard. Should help find the tools stash. Looks like it requires specific technical knowledge to understand it.
Note from the Vehicle Graveyard. Should somehow help find the tools stash. Looks like it requires specific technical knowledge to figure out what it means.
Note from the Vehicle Graveyard. Should somehow help find the tools stash. Unlike the others, this one has words that are readable.
A worn-out set of technician's tools, specifically for radio electronics. They won't be much help for weapons or body armor repairs, but will definitely be useful for radio equipment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ96_C02_: A set of tools suitable for weapon and body armor repairs under Zone conditions. With these tools, a technician can equip a variety of different modifications, although this set isn't suitable for calibration.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ96_C03_: A professional set of tools. They'd make any technician happy, even on the Mainland. Allows any technician skilled enough to equip any kind of modification available in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ97_Expe: An old journal with writing all over the pages. The first page has the STC Malachite stamp on it.
Log from the Burnt Forest expedition
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ97_Gene: Fuel voucher for a generator at Kazkovyi. Looks like the group of campers before us left it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ97_Pele: A laminated memo on an STC Malachite slip. Judging by its state, it's been passed on from the first NK group to each one after.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_SQ97_Sany: PDA of an NK-3 group member, found in a Kazkovyi camp building
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack__SQ99_She: A metal key received from Rascal.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_an_upm_se: A receiving signal antenna amplifier, military-grade. Old, but still operational.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_supack_SQ: The PDA found on a stalker's body in the boiler house basement. Looks like the owner was also looking for the tools stash, but didn't succeed.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_vojatij_k: A worn-out key to the safe belonging to Kazkovyi's guide
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_vozmercfo: A mercenary's suit with traces of skilled mending. There's a chest patch with the name "Surgeon".
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_questItemprototypes_supack_vozmercpd: A military-grade PDA with reinforced glass. Half-scratched off but still readable, "Surgeon" is written on the side in marker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_ANCQ23_AtasStash_description: The situation has changed. I left the cargo in the cave. Proceed with caution, preferably at night.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Deluxe_BurntFore: I led this gear's previous owner right into a Spark ambush. Do I feel guilty? No. This was no scientist, but a Mengele from SIRCAA. And he is not the only one. Now I know that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Deluxe_Duga_desc: In the Zone, the situation can change within seconds. While I was trying to hide from an IPSF soldier, a chimera attacked him. We beat it together, but the guy's wounds were so bad he was a goner. I remember it like it was yesterday.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Deluxe_Garbage_d: Now I am a murderer. But after what the Brood did to Shell, I had no other choice. I hate them! Strider is not one for retaliation, but he would have approved this kind. I will leave all of Shell's things here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Deluxe_Pripyat_d: I knew I would end up in Prypiat. What I didn't know was what I would become - one with no trust or faith. But I have no regrets. Apart from the fact I now have to admire Her beauty through a riflescope.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Deluxe_Rostok_de: The Zone teaches me quickly - I'm becoming picky. Even when it comes to weapons. Now I won't be carrying a piece if the ammo costs me an arm and a leg. The less my ruck weighs, the faster I can run, the longer I can live.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Deluxe_SmallZone: These trophies bring everyone closer. People cherish them and thank the Zone - for staying alive after meeting their first owners. However, I didn't get all this from the Monolithians themselves.

The Zone is no walk in the park. But it seems to me that if you learn to see the good in it, it will change the way it looks at you, too. I have no other explanation for how it treated me from the start. What does it see in me, I wonder?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Deluxe_Swamps_de: At last, I met the Monolithian I heard so many frightening things about. But Strider doesn't like talking about the past. He even gave me his kit, - out of sight, out of mind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_PreOrder_Garbage: Sidorovich is one suspicious guy, not a big fan of journalists. Didn't want to sell me anything at first. Had to run some errands for him to get a Sunrise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_PreOrder_Swamps_: I still can't get used to death being just another day in the Zone. So I can't take this rifle. If I make it out alive, I'll make sure to write about its owner. This man's life is a novel waiting to be published.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Ultimate_Promzon: Stalker weapon names are pure poetry. And the deadlier, the more metaphoric. This one, for instance, puts one to sleep, rather than kills. An escape from the truth? Isn't this exactly what we're doing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Ultimate_SmallZo: Before the Zone, I couldn’t hit the broad side of a barn. Tried it once at a range, just for fun. This weapon makes it almost easy. My fingers start remembering something they were never trained for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Ultimate_Swamps_: At last, I met the Monolithian I heard so many frightening things about. But Strider doesn't like talking about the past. He even gave me his kit, - out of sight, out of mind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC00_Stash_Ultimate_Yanov_d: Before I met the owner of this revolver, I never believed that Freedom organized mutant safaris for rich foreigners. Where Duty works hard, Freedom makes a pretty penny.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_ANCQ_CNPP_BusStash_des: Used to drive this kind of old car to my country house, catch some carp. Maybe not the best place for a stash, but there's a pack of dogs nearby. They'll guard it all right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_EQ00_ChatterboxStash_d: I'll take Goodbye's advice this time and get ready for my Iron Forest run by the book. If I pinch coupons now, I might not make it back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_FaradayStash2_descript: Information about a stash. Received while studying the radio anomaly in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_FaradayStash3_descript: Information about a stash. Received while studying the radio anomaly in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_FaradayStash4_descript: Information about a stash. Received while studying the radio anomaly in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_FaradayStash5_descript: Information about a stash. Received while studying the radio anomaly in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_FaradayStash6_descript: Information about a stash. Received while studying the radio anomaly in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_FaradayStash_descripti: Information about a stash. Received while studying the radio anomaly in the Iron Forest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_MQ03_MercenaryStash_de: Few make it into the Iron Forest, but it doesn't mean stashes shouldn't be hidden properly. In our line of work, professionalism is paramount.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_MQ07_DamStash_descript: The sergeants went through the last package my family sent faster than I could open it. I'm not sharing this stash with anyone. No fucking regulations here: these are my rules.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_MQ07_KoloStash_descrip: If I screw up that order for the damn mutants, at least I won't have to start from scratch next time. Wish I could remember where I left it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_SQ04_Stash_description: You think this is yours? And here I was, thinking it was mine. But it's all the Zone's. You, and I, we just borrowed it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_SQ06_ExMonoStash_descr: Who would've thought Monolith had a stash at the Dam! We brought all their valuable loot here. Now we check the rest of this place and get that stuff to Sidorovich!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_SQ15_OtterStash_descri: I write down everything important and hide it in different places. Here is an artifact shard and instructions on how to reach the main anomaly. I no longer remember why I needed this, but if I hid it—it must be important.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_SQ15_OtterStash_name: Stash in a passage near the Turbine Hall
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_DLC01_SQ15_QuestFail_Stash_d: Turns out that I can't store everything just in my memory. Better to write it all down and keep it in a safe place, not just in my head.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E02_SQ01_HmuriyStash_descrip: I’ll leave some supplies here for an emergency. If it gets stolen… well, so be it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E02_SQ01_ZhorikStash_descrip: If you know about this stash, you’re one of us. Don't take more than you need. The Zone doesn’t like greedy folks, and you-know-who likes them even less.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E03_MQ03_RuzveltStash_descri: Let those sanctimonious assholes think they got rid of me. There’s no such thing as ex-Duty. I’ll be back, and I’ll make good use of this stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E03_MQ03_ShakhStash_descript: You can use it to settle petty squabbles and hassle chumps — or you could reshape the balance of power in the Zone. It's your choice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E07_MQ02_Suhin_Stash_descrip: Something feels off. Won't hurt to stash some stuff. Just in case.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E07_MQ02_SyhinStash_Variable: Something feels off. Won't hurt to stash some stuff. Just in case.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E11_MQ01_DarkStash_descripti: There’s a beacon inside. Meet me at the coordinates. Feel free to keep the rest of this stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E11_MQ01_RooseveltStash_desc: I’m stashing what’s left from the good old days in the Commissary. It’s not like Voronin’s gonna lend me a hand anytime soon, right?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_E11_MQ04_VartaStash_descript: This is a space for storing material evidence confiscated from enemies of the Ward, alive and deceased.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ109_MarikTopotCache_descri: I've got a bad feeling about this meeting. I’d better hide some stuff just in case. There’s a house in the village with a stove and an intact root cellar. I’ll leave it there, in the corner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ10_Stash_description: I stashed my loot in a locker at the train station. I also left some nasty surprises for unwelcome guests, so watch your step.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ111_KorkaCacheVariable_des: I hid the cargo in the basement of the Krug Antenna Complex. Stalkers never go there, so it’s safe. I tossed the bag on top of a pipe in the corner of the hallway, so it's gonna take some jumping.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ141_TurgaCacheVariable_des: Good thing my partner told me to meet him at the dam! Who would ever expect to find such a good stash of food here in the sticks? If Rowboat doesn’t show up soon, there'll be nothing but breadcrumbs left.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ143_Stash_RybakinStash_des: I hid some stuff on the bus roof. No one will find it unless they know exactly where to look. Plus, there’s the radiation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ14_KuzaCacheVariable_descr: I hid our loot under the trailer, behind the right wheel. There are some pallets piled up right next to it, you can’t miss it. Let the boys know where to bring their contributions. The stalkers won’t be nosing around while we’re hanging out in the village.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ155_Stash_Laba_description: I left some supplies in the safe. You’ll find the combination on the collar of test subject #48.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ164_Stash_description: How come no one's noticed that nice little spot under the pier? Am I the only smart one around here? It’s the perfect place to squirrel away some loot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ166_Stash_description: I’m leaving my loot at an abandoned checkpoint to the south of the cemetery. No one will go snooping around there. There's nothing but mutants there — mutants and us loners.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ16_Stash_LootFara_descript: I left a stash at the Ribs, near the concrete fence. Stalkers barely make it out of there alive – if they make it at all. Hopefully those medkits can save someone’s life.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ20_Stash_Balcony_Marker_de: The Eastern tunnel is a good place for a stash. No one will go looking there. It’s also a perfect opportunity to see what the new recruits can do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ35_LegendStash_description: I had to get to my rookies fast, the backpack was too heavy, so I left it behind. Tossed it on the roof of a caterpillar tractor west of the Flea Market. The artifacts inside are worth a fortune...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ48_GiverStash_description: Zhenya the stalker’s stuff, found in a tunnel at the Cordon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ54_Stash_InAnomaly_descrip: Some crazy loners left a stash inside an anomaly. I don’t think there’s anything in there that’s actually worth the risk, but I wouldn’t mind offering the coordinates as a gift.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ60_Stash_LootVovcika_descr: I left a stash behind some crates in one of the pigsties. They all look alike, those damn pigsties... every time I end up looking in the wrong one and start thinking my loot got ganked.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ64_Stash_LootHolmy_descrip: I hid some supplies on the beams by the two-story building at the decontamination station in the Lesser Zone. I don’t think anyone will look there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ65_PiavkaClue_description: I hid the loot on the roof of the elevator. The place is safe — unless you fall to your death, that is.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_EQ70_Stash_LootDimona_descri: I've got a stash by a hut in the Poppy Field. The radiation warning signs around there ought to keep rookies away. The mutants will scare off all the rest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_09_StashInCave_descripti: Had to leave some loot in the cave with the bulldozer. Those damn snorks won’t leave me alone. Just you wait — I’ll get me some slugs, and then I’ll take care of you bastards...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_104_StashOnRoofKPP_descr: If the sergeant doesn’t notice, I’m good. I didn’t let anyone in, Sarge, I swear! I’ll fix the fence and the log, and then everything’ll be peachy. The stuff has to get moved from the roof, though. Too much radiation.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_105_StashNearElectricfie: It’s a good hiding place. I’m surprised the electronics are still functional. Hopefully they still are... anyway, the code is stick, cobra, porthole, infinity.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_106_StashInGasStation_de: I stocked up on food and even found a bag that odors can't get through. The wild animals here are hungry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_107_StashDuga_descriptio: I don’t accept returns. Just can’t afford it. Here’s an artifact to compensate you for the inconvenience. If you hear any strange noises, that's just the anomaly in the drill field messing around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_10_StashUnderBridge_desc: Those mercenaries have good equipment and decent pay, but will they miss an opportunity to rob a simple stalker? Never! So I had to hide some loot under the bridge close to checkpoint.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_119_StashInCafePripyat_d: The stuff is in the structure next to Olympia Cafe. I’m keeping the key myself for safety reasons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_11_StashInSafe_descripti: I played cards with the commander and lost my shirt. But I know he has a safe for his valuables. I’m gonna take an impression of the key next time the bastard goes up to the roof for a smoke.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_120_StashInDKEnergetik_d: I hid some loot in a nook on the first floor of Energetik Palace of Culture, under the balcony. It was too heavy to carry in one go. Hopefully I can pick it up next time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_127_StashOnCentralArea_d: I buried some stuff by the central square, in plain sight. No one will even think to look there. Except maybe rats...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_129_StashAboutAutotunnel: [00:45] Mission complete, Commander. We lost two men, and one is heavily wounded. We’re on the move to Wild Territory. Restocking from our stash in the Automotive Tunnel on the way. I’ll report as soon as we get there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_12_StashInGrave_descript: Stashed some loot in the grave under the wheel — and some nasty surprises in all the rest. Now any merc who follows me can rest in pieces. And that cat, too. There’s a cat there, I could smell it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_13_StashOnCrane_descript: I saw a light on the very top of the highest crane yesterday. Someone was hiding loot there – that’s gotta be it! As soon as my watch ends, I’m climbing that thing. There must be something valuable up there!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_15_StashInPumpingStation: Found a nice box with a combination lock at the Hydroelectric Station. Had too much loot on me, so I stashed some there. The code is 0666. I’d better come back for it soon, before the Monolithians show up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_16_StashOnPigfarm_descri: The padlock’s all rusty, I can see it through the window. And a padlock that big can only mean one thing: there’s something valuable inside.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_19_StashInBanditsATP_des: Just my luck! I brought that artifact to Sidorovich, got my pay — and got mugged by bandits! Good thing I know where they stashed my stuff. I need to find a friend to help me get it back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_20_StashOnBanditsATP_des: It’s a good place to hide stuff, right next to the hut and visible from a distance. If anyone goes near my stash at the vehicle station, I’ll see it right away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_21_StashOnElevatorTower_: The Gaffer’s right: loot loves quiet folks. My pals were busy squabbling about that stalkers’ stuff, so I just helped myself to a fair cut. Hid it at the elevator tower. No pig can fly all the way up there.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_22_StashOnMilitaryKPP_de: The sergeant got too cocky for his own good. He wants a cut. I’ll have to send the location of our checkpoint stash to the military police. It'll be hard to replace him, but not impossible.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_38_StashOnElevatorRoof_d: Mom always told me never to climb up so high I can’t get back down... I sprained my ankle on my way back. Well, at least my loot is safe now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_44_StashInOldShop_descri: The Zone took all my pals — Salami, Ark, even Knife... good guys, that’s what they were... I hid their stuff at the Cooling Towers, in an old workshop. No one goes there anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_45_StashInCementFactory_: I left the cargo in the anomaly field at the Cement Factory. Wouldn’t want to lose it to bandits again. I’m so fed up with running back and forth for it. Maybe it’s a good idea to pay for protection.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_48_StashInEasternTunnel_: So much treasure, I can’t even carry it all in one go. I'm sure I’ll be back for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_49_StashOnSecurityRoof_d: I saw a buddy of mine on that roof the other day, either looking for something or hiding something, I don’t know which. I wasn’t reckless enough to go check.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_51_StashOnRoof_descripti: They think I’m a rookie, so it’s safe to mess with me. They should think again. I’m making my own private stash up here on the roof. My fair share of the loot. They won’t find it in all the dust.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_61_StashOnBridgePillar_d: Okay, guess that wasn’t the best idea I've ever had. I left a stash, but there's no way I’m going in the water again. It can stay there for all I care.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_62_StashOnObservationAre: What a view! I’d love to sit here with some buddies, a guitar, and a bottle... but I have to haul my loot to the Sultan instead. All the more reason to come back later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_69_StashInBoilerRoom_des: I had them hunting me all the way there, and that wasn’t part of our agreement. So I left your cargo inside the Boiler House. Good luck getting it yourself. I’m keeping the advance payment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_76_StashHiddenBackpack_d: When you find your backpack, I suggest thinking long and hard about alcohol and the effect it's had on you. You’re lucky I've known you since we were kids, otherwise I wouldn’t be hiding your stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_77_StashInCamp_descripti: If you find this stash, be a good stalker and don’t touch it. It’s for emergencies. You never know what could be lurking in these woods… So if you take something, be sure to leave a replacement later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_79_StashInBarracks_descr: You were hoping to get some goodies here, huh? Fuck you. I hid everything in a much better place. You'll never find it. And when you’re all nice and dead, I’ll come back for my stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_84_StashOnCrossHill_desc: Sure, I had some boars on my tail, but is that a good enough reason to shoot at me? I’m not a boar! Whatever... we’ll meet again, you'll see. I’d better stash the loot here in the hut, just in case.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_GDN_86_StashOnRoofKPP_descri: I’m sick of following orders. I’m not cut out for this. Stashed a couple of magazines in the bag. They won’t find it on the roof.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash100_description: This is for everyone, but don’t take what’s not yours!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash101_description: Sometimes it's better to get the hell out than get a hell lotta loot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash102_description: Here are all my Zone riches. Hope some other fool finds them useful.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash103_description: The supplier's solid. You know the prices.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash104_description: Yeah, fuckheads, I screwed you over. You're lucky I left ya anything at all.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash105_description: Stashed it when I was drunk, can't even remember what I dragged in here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash106_description: Don't you tell me I did a shitty job getting ready for the run.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash107_description: I'm just a courier! Take it all and just leave me the heck alone!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash108_description: We all chipped in and got you a lil something. Hang in there, bro.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash109_description: Happy first hunt. Here's a little present.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash110_description: Too dangerous to meet. I'm being followed. P.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash110_name: A stash made in a hurry
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash111_description: If the mutants chew me up, at least my stuff won't go to waste.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash112_description: I'll just dump my stuff here. Maybe this one good deed will count before I die.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash114_description: Something ain't right about this place. But I guess it beats leaving it all out in the open.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash115_description: Always lucky at cards, you shitface.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash116_description: I'll leave your loot here. You won't need it anymore.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash117_description: Thanks again. I tossed the loot into a couple stashes just to be safe.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash118_description: This is the advance payment for the collars. You will get the rest once you bring me at least three of them. Try not to drag any mutants along.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash120_description: I always pay what I owe. But I don't want to see your ugly mug.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash122_description: I hated your stupid face the least back at camp. So I leave my stuff to you. Hope you can get it before some random stalker does.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash123_description: One solid spot: nothing ever gets snatched from here!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash124_description: What I took from the Zone, I return to the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash125_description: Sure hope this'll be enough for next time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash126_description: Loot from the last asshole stalker snooping around my damn stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash127_description: Did I ever ask you to rescue me? Nope. I'm freaking done running around the Zone. No more stashes.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash128_description: Better ditch six pounds of loot than end up six feet under.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash129_description: If I can't carry all of it myself, at least I won't leave any for that scumbag.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash12_description: Those morons will never, ever find it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash130_description: The Gaffer always told me: make more stashes, at least one of 'em won't get snatched.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash131_description: Stashed it at night, no tail. Let's see if it stays.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash132_description: The Zone shall punish anyone who takes this stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash133_description: Can't even keep track of these damn stashes. Screw the Zone, what's the point if it all gets nicked anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash134_description: We agreed to a face-to-face. But this is better than nothing.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash135_description: Don't think I'll survive this one, but making a stash anyway. Old habits.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash136_description: Note to self: grab on the next rest stop.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash137_description: If not for someone's stash, I'd have bitten the dust right here last year. So here's mine, for those in need.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash138_description: I'll come back here, one way or another.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash139_description: Rumor has it, this stash belonged to a stalker who got eaten by snorks, and they dragged all his stuff here. I didn't have the guts to take it, so suit yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash13_description: I really should find a better place to stash my loot next time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash140_description: It's not a shakedown, it's natural selection. The Zone ain't for the weak.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash141_description: Bandits jumped me, thought I was some kinda chump. Stashed all their crap here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash142_description: Grey, you shitwit! I figured you're fucking nicking my loot. Let's see if I'm right.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash143_description: The dead sure won't need it anymore.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash146_description: Never drink the professor's vodka again. Or at least, never make stashes while at it. It's supposed to be somewhere around here...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash146_name: Lost at the bottom of a bottle
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash147_description: Here lies all that's left of a stalker who wandered into an anomaly.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash148_description: Take it if you need it. If you don't need it, leave it for those who do.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash149_description: Better watch your back if you dare nick my stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash14_description: I ganked this stuff while everybody was asleep. I’ll hide it here for now and come back when the dust settles.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash152_description: Damn it all! Time to head back home. Take my stash if you still got your hopes up about this place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash154_description: Can't carry all this crap around, but can't dump it either - the Zone won't forgive me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash156_description: I got no idea what's in there, but I sure as hell know who can pay a pretty coupon for it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash157_description: Making friends with bandits can be a good thing. Especially when they're drunk as skunks.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash158_description: The Zone offers an endless supply of chumps.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash15_description: If you take something, you have to put something back. Other people need this stuff too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash161_description: If you ain't no Bear, better get outta here, nothing for you to see.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash163_description: Bet those potheads will screw me over. Better stash this away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash164_description: Time to lay low. That loot won't go anywhere.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash167_description: All y'all think I'm dead, let's keep it that way. Got enough stashes to get back on my feet.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash168_description: That was one awesome hunt! If you found this stash, take it, and put in a good word to Lady Luck for me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash169_description: Stay here, my goodies, while I try to sell ya for more moneys.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash16_description: Someone’s on my heels. Had to leave some of my loot. I’ll come back for it later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash170_description: Take it, it won't bite. I'm done with this Zone anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash171_description: I shouldn't have looked what was in that package. Now you'll kill me for sure. Take it back, and let me be on my merry way.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash172_description: Yet another Zone rule: everything you need is way more than you can carry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash173_description: My gift to you, Zone. Have mercy on me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash174_description: Stalker wisdom: whatever you found, stash it somewhere else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash175_description: Sidorovich sold me this useless crap. I'll resell it to another chump later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash176_description: I'll make sure to come back here tomorrow and reorganize my stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash178_description: They say the Zone is generous. But I'm not expecting anything from it. Gathered all of this by myself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash179_description: Got a fuckton of stuff to carry around. Again. Like a goddamn mule. I'll be smart this time, better leave it here and grab it on my way back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash17_description: If you touch my loot, I’ll find you and rip your damn arms off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash180_description: Gotta get out before the Emission gets here. I'll go back when it's over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash181_description: All the guys got stashes, how come I never had one? Here's to my first stash!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash182_description: Rest stop first, work later. The job can wait until tomorrow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash183_description: No more teamwork for me, no more teammates to screw me over.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash184_description: Now I just gotta remember where I left it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash186_description: I'll just sell it to a clueless rookie.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash187_description: I hope I won't ever need it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash188_description: I'll stash my cut here, before someone nicks it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash189_description: Well, brother, not much left of ya.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash18_description: What was I thinking, taking so much stuff? I’ll stash some of it here for now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash190_description: Some booze and munchies make you happy bunches.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash191_description: Back when I was a lil rookie, a stash like this saved my arse. Here I am, Zone, returning the favor. May it help someone who needs it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash192_description: Your protection's useless as shit. But if I don't pay up, you'll off me anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash193_description: Stalker number one took one bottle of vodka. Number two only left a bandage. Number three took everything and the bandage, too, but left his own stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash194_description: Saw a stalker off the whole camp before they even came round. Handy, but sure ain't sharp. Missed the stash, ha!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash195_description: Well, Ciry, now you're only half-chump!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash195_name: A lil something from the bros
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash196_description: Take if owner does not return in seven days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash199_description: Someone's trying to mess with my head. It's all here, but scattered around randomly. Better robbed than crazy. Bastards.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash19_description: Grabbed some loot off some rookies. I'll come back for it tomorrow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash1_description: If you touch my stuff, it’s your funeral.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash200_description: Quit messing with my stuff! You wanna snatch it - do it already, just stop driving me nuts!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash201_description: I'm no cheater, I just got lucky!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash202_description: If the job goes south, I'll beat it. This will do for the first few days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash204_description: Can't even remember how many times I restashed it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash205_description: Maybe all that bar goss is bullshit. But what if this really helps keep those monolith nutjobs away?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash206_description: A stalker wandered off where he wasn't supposed to. I'll take it once the stench is gone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash207_description: I offed my hundredth mutant here once. Lucky spot. Maybe this won't get snatched.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash208_description: I'll dump it here. Or Mykolaich will talk my ear off with his backache remedies.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash210_description: Lost it somewhere around here. Should find it when I get the chance.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash211_description: I'll grab it next time, for sure.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash212_description: Who knows when you end up with nothing in the Zone. This may help a little.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash213_description: Traded an artifact for this while I was wasted. I'm one legendary chump… Can't even look at this trash, I'll just leave it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash214_description: Let's see which Rostok cheapskate offers a better price for this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash215_description: Saving it for someone I'll owe for helping me out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash216_description: Yup, I sold you a map to this stash. And you paid me more than you found here. Bye, loser.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash217_description: I made up my mind, folks. I'm off to join the Ward. They issue decent kit, so I won't need all this anymore.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash218_description: Guys, don't nick my stash. I'll save up for a new guitar and throw a hell of a concert by the bonfire for ya!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash219_description: Thanks for patching me up when you could just kill me. I don't like being in anyone's debt, so here's something that might come in handy. But next time, save yourself.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash21_description: Wow! Did I really leave it here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash220_description: Ever since I looted a dead stalker, I've been in a dark place. So I'm returning everything I nicked that day.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash221_description: As for me, I left some decent shit in this stash. But I can't guarantee that's what you'll end up finding here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash222_description: Here's to hoping my digging years taught me not just to find all sorts of crap, but to hide it well.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash223_description: I'll send the next chump meet location to your PDA. This time there'll be more to shake down, promise.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash223_name: A cut from a team effort
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash224_description: This dude didn't exactly leave anything to me… But it doesn’t seem like he had anyone else.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash225_description: Like we agreed, it's a blind exchange! I hope you didn't cheap out and left me something decent.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash226_description: You'd have been better off paying me back the easy way. Now one of your goons had to learn his lesson the hard way. You can tell which one, I left him here with all his stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash227_description: You're a diehard, bastard! Alright, a deal's a deal. I lost, you won, here's your prize.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash228_description: I'll grab it on my way back from the bar. Otherwise I'll just trade it for booze.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash229_description: Like I promised, left some supplies for you, waiting at our spot. If you're not there in two days, I'm off on my own. Not safe to stay in one place for too long.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash22_description: That was definitely overkill — my shoulders are killing me. Better stash some of it here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash230_description: Cheers, folks. I thought I wouldn't make it out alive. Here's a little something for you. My eternal gratitude.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash231_description: Damn, that stalker was easy to follow. Restashed all the stuff he had. No worries, I'll sell it back to him.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash232_description: Sold my beauty. I'll buy it back when my hands heal. It's hard enough to hold a pistol, let alone hit the strings.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash233_description: Come on, guys, I didn't kill him! He's just holding his breath. For 70 hours straight, like a champ! We'll just watch his stuff meanwhile. Here's your cut.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash233_name: A stash for partners in crime
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash234_description: A couple more of these unlucky hunts, and I'll have to join Gnome's petty thieves.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash235_description: It is way too little to repay you for your help, but it's all I've got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash236_description: Time to make some noise. But first, I need to hide some stuff away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash236_name: Loot that might come in handy
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash237_description: Dealing with Baldhead was a lousy idea. One vindictive son of a gun. It's okay though, he can't keep track of everything. Sharing is caring - that's for losers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash238_description: Turns out, playing the victim can be quite useful.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash239_description: Damn emission screwed up my plans. Alrighty, I'll leave it here and restash it later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash23_description: These goodies are perfect for my stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash240_description: Get all the goodies in here. I'll decide what's your cut, and what belongs to the boss.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash241_description: Open in case of expedition failure only.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash242_description: Stashes are the real shit! Can't stash away enough under the kingpin's nose.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash243_description: Saw a couple of stalkers hiding it. If that's all their savings combined, I feel kinda bad taking it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash244_description: For the rainiest of days. If it keeps going like this, though, I might need it right away. Or maybe tomorrow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash245_description: You're better off not stashing anything of value, but I'm no chump: this place is pretty hard to stumble upon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash246_description: Left to get: grub - 3 cans, ammo - 2 mags, sausage - 2 packs, vodka - 1 bottle.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash247_description: You find this stash - you take a moment to remember Toad. It's his stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash248_description: Whoever finds it, say hello to the Shah for me, and make sure to spit in his fucking face.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash249_description: Won't give anything back to that piece of shit! I'd rather leave it all here to rot, damn it! Who does she think she is? The queen of Zaton?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash24_description: I have no idea who left this here. Whoever they are, they never came back for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash250_description: That's for taking Walrus out. He might be alright now, but there's no such thing as a former Monolithian.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash251_description: Now I see why he joined the local goons. Second day on the job, and this much loot!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash252_description: More than I hoped for, less than I wanted.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash253_description: Better to pay them smugs than to catch them slugs.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash254_description: Already got a buyer for this stash. Better not mess with them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash256_description: Hid it as well as I could. Let the Zone be the judge of that.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash257_description: Shouldn't have messed with me. Now the loot's mine, and that clown is blind dog food.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash258_description: Some jumpy chump was hanging around here. Could it be a stash?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash259_description: This loot wasn't worth catching a slug. And way too heavy to carry around.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash25_description: No one will think to look here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash260_description: Would be a shame if someone got for free what I worked so hard for.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash261_description: Genius plan, my ass. Here's your joke of a cut.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash262_description: I may be a rat, but I'm a rat with coupons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash263_description: It's coming. The chaos is underway. Coupons won't be worth anything. The only chance to survive is to prep.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash264_description: Don't get too excited if you found my stash. Nothing's for free in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash265_description: If you try to track me down through this stash, I'm not working with you anymore.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash266_description: Go ahead, knock yourself out. Quite literally.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash267_description: Coupons are good, but not good enough to patch up a wound or load your mags.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash268_description: It smells like flesh ass, but at least no one will bother to look for my stash here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash269_description: Saving up doesn't get any easier. Am I gonna return to the Mainland with nothing?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash26_description: A little something for a rainy day.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash271_description: Lookie here! My very first stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash272_description: If you got the guts to take it, know this: the stuff belonged to a dead guy. I couldn't do it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash273_description: You gotta offer something to this place if you wanna stay in one piece. Leave a gift here, and no one will dare touch it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash274_description: I hope you made it. Couldn't wait any longer, went on to the next spot. Take it all and catch up.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash275_description: Attaboy! You made it this far, which means you learned your lesson. Grab the goodies and get your arse back - we got business to discuss.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash276_description: Rumor has it, Noah was seen somewhere around here with a pet pseudodog. Maybe I'll be lucky enough to see it for myself when I go back for my loot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash277_description: I won't need this in the Shining Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash278_description: Can't decide if I should go kill that poltergeist or not. Let the Zone decide. If no one nicks this stash by tomorrow, I'm going.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash279_description: Now all I gotta do is keep my mouth shut about this place when I go drinking.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash27_description: Screw it, this loot is cursed!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash281_description: Hid it while everyone was asleep.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash282_description: Can't see it from a couple meters away - good enough for me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash283_description: What am I supposed to do, throw it away? What if I need it later?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash284_description: Whoever managed to find this must be worthy of taking it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash285_description: Looks like someone's got sticky fingers. Also looks like you won't be needing them.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash286_description: I'll grab it if I ever want to go back to the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash287_description: I'll grab it on the way back from the hunt.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash288_description: My debt, with interest. It's all I've got.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash289_description: Left it here just for fun. If you find it, pour one and toast to me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash28_description: I’m sick of lugging all this stuff around. I’ll come back later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash290_description: No time to find a better place to hide it, so I'll leave it here for now.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash291_description: Time to cleanse my karma. Take it if you need it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash292_description: Heading to the merchant tomorrow to get some coupons for it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash293_description: I left it right freaking here! Damn! Can't find it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash294_description: Let it stay here and dry out, I'll come get it later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash295_description: Can't trust anyone at camp. Them shitheads will nick it for sure.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash296_description: I'm almost sure I put some supplies away a couple of days ago. Or maybe I didn't? Or maybe I stashed them somewhere else? I'll mark the spot just in case.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash297_description: The true value of this stash is its history: I had to fight three fleshes for it!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash298_description: Had to sweat a bit before I pulled this stash out of an anomaly! Would be a bummer if someone snatched it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash299_description: Everything in this stash brings good luck to the owner.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash2_description: Took some stuff off those stalkers. I’ll come back for it later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash300_description: They promised top-notch goods, exclusive. Bastards. I spent so much on this…
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash301_description: Don't you dare whine about how I didn't leave you the stuff we agreed on. You screwed me over big time, you don't even deserve this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash302_description: Folks say this one stalker exchanged goods using stashes as dead drops. Started with a gauze, went all the way up to a Gauss! I wonder what I'll end up getting.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash303_description: Every damn time I hide some goodies away, someone finds 'em. I bet that guide makes his trails near my stashes on purpose!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash303_name: A hidden stash once again rehidden
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash304_description: I know how hard it can be here in the Zone. May this help you get through another day.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash305_description: Keep looking, you nasty fuckers. My stashes are a form of art.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash306_description: I just need to save up a bit more to buy a gun. Won't get me a Gauss, but they say the Ragman has some decent stuff for a good price.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash307_description: Hope this helps, stalker. 'Cause it sure didn't help me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash309_description: Can't let it go to waste, can I?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash30_description: I’ll leave it here for just one day. Gonna come back tomorrow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash310_description: Gotta remember where I left it. Lost two stashes already. Or someone ripped me off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash313_description: I'll have plenty of time to come back for my stuff.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash314_description: I'll make sure to find it this time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash315_description: Can't hurt to have some goods stashed away for later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash318_description: Damn pseudodog! Right where my stash was! I'll have to get it later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash319_description: I hope that idiot didn't forget where the stash is and has enough brains to grab the supplies.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash31_description: A stash like this saved me once. Maybe this one will save a life too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash320_description: Hell knows if I ever end up here again. But if I do, at least I won't starve.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash321_description: Mom always taught me to stash stuff for later. Who knew I'd actually start taking her advice, now that I'm thirty.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash322_description: This is your first job. If you can't deliver it, you're no courier for my crew.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash323_description: Deliver before midnight. It's a matter of life and death.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash324_description: Who knows what I might need on that run. Better to scatter stuff around and stash it in different spots.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash325_description: Leave the merchandise here. I'll grab it on my way back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash326_description: So sick of shooting back at mutants. Just a couple more stashes, then I'll hire some muscle and open my own shop.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash327_description: Like we agreed. Now you talk to Myklukha and make sure I get to join Freedom.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash328_description: I'm no thief! But I can't return it - they'll shoot me right away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash329_description: So what, if this never made it to its rightful owner? I need it more.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash32_description: Finally, I’ve got enough to repay my debt. But it'd be impossible to carry it all in one go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash330_description: This looks like a lousy hiding place, but I'm way too tired to carry it on.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash333_description: Stumbled upon a bloodsuckers lair. Luckily, they just ate and were out like a light. Still managed to loot a couple of corpses.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash334_description: Out to meet some folks. If I don't come back, this is all yours.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash335_description: Free piece of advice: never trust stash resellers. Total scumbags.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash336_description: Vadya, don't touch this! This is for a special occasion.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash337_description: If you take it, I won't cry. I stole it myself, anyway.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash338_description: Getting greedy, ha? Well, don't. Say thank you for the little freebie. Can't get much for free around here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash339_description: This loot is a one-way ticket.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash33_description: This stash is as reliable as a Swiss watch.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash340_description: My whole squad was wiped out right here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash341_description: At least this one spot never let me down.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash342_description: I'll win it all back, sure ain't a first. But I'll stash something away this time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash343_description: Want a piece of the pie - get ready to die.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash344_description: So basic. I'll trade it for something more fun for my collection.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash345_description: When I kick the bucket, sell my loot and give me a proper goodbye. Don't wanna die as some mutant chow.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash347_description: They're tracking their shipments, for sure. But how? I'll leave it here until I figure it out.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash348_description: It was way more fun to hide something when I was a kid.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash349_description: Wanna snatch it - go ahead. But remember, revenge is a dish best served in your damn face from a gun barrel.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash34_description: If you hit my stash, I’ll find you and beat the ever-loving snot out of you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash350_description: All this sweet stuff's from my loyal followers! Don't you touch it, or you'll have to deal with Lex the Legend himself. And I'll send my chumps after you, too!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash351_description: Some loot for Swedish's shop. I'll take it to him when I get the chance. Sure hope his plan works.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash352_description: Trinkets for Swedish. I wonder if Sidor offed him already.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash353_description: I hope this is enough to get back to the Mainland. I'll kill Adik and get the hell out. Screw all of this, screw the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash354_description: Just wanna get rid of all this crap and drink to Tolik's memory. If someone beats me to it… At least pour one to honor him!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash355_description: Crest and I used to share this stash. Can't keep it any longer. Can't get myself to use it, either.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash356_description: Damn it, Sledgehammer, here's your advance. Why the hell don't you trust us anymore?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash357_description: I'll stash everything up here and be on my merry way. Don't even know where to. Somewhere far away from Valerian and his reminiscing about the good old days.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash358_description: This is the stash of a future Warden, Kiryukha Drive, y'all. If you're thinking of nicking it, better think again!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash359_description: Lookie here, so Filimon wasn't shitting me. Turns out it's a decent stash, for real. I'll grab whatever's worth a pretty coupon and leave the rest here for later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash35_description: Who would’ve thought there’d be a place for a stash here?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash360_description: Trickster said he left this stash for me. In case Wardens start snooping around and he'll have to get out of Malachite for good. And what is a scientist supposed to do with all of this?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash361_description: Southpaw asked me to make a stash here. Like, they'll finish their last run for the scientists and switch to the big leagues. About time.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash361_name: A small stash for the team
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash362_description: Hromovyi, don't be such a wuss, pick up your pals' gear already. Or someone sure will beat you to it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash363_description: If this trick doesn't work at the Central Elevator, I'll save up for a decent gun. This will be my down payment.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash364_description: Seryoga Root, a decent bloke, is giving this stash to his poor yet proud lads. What's the craic with Freedom, by the way?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash365_description: The truth is one, but the paths toward it are many. I will no longer require this on my path. Take it. Hermit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash366_description: If Shapka finds out I'm side hustling, I'm fucked. Guess I'll hide these goodies where the devil don't go.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash367_description: Saving up for a new guitar. Guys, show some respect. If you find it, don't nick it. Beer's on me. Vadyk Firecracker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash368_description: Yukhym, here's what I owe you, bastard. Hope the fleshes tear you apart bit by bit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash369_description: If you stick around with bandits, you can actually learn a lot. Like, how to hide loot so they won't find it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash38_description: Why is it so heavy? I hope no one finds it here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash39_description: Fuck this! I’m dropping it here. Finders keepers.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash3_description: I'll leave it here just in case. I wouldn’t want to have it on me if I run into some bandits.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash40_description: If you find it, good on you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash41_description: I had to bring my loot here — my other stash got compromised.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash42_description: I hate to leave it, but I can’t carry it either. Hopefully I can find it when I come back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash43_description: I caught a bullet, can’t carry all this weight anymore. Gotta leave it here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash44_description: They say one fence had his couriers leave stuff for him here. So this must be a good spot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash45_description: Some dumbasses got eaten by mutants, so I grabbed their stuff and hid it all here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash46_description: I’m leaving it here, hoping to find it later. But if you’re reading this, I guess that's not happening.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash47_description: To whoever reads this: screw you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash48_description: I'd say this is for a rainy day, but there’s no such thing as a sunny day in the Zone.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash49_description: If you touch it, I’ll come back and bury you.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash4_description: If you find it, it’s all yours, stalker.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash50_description: I’ll bury it here before they bury me for stealing it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash51_description: Dig in, boys. I’m feeling generous.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash52_description: Take it, I dare you. The Zone isn't that big.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash53_description: If you steal it, I’ll curse you!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash55_description: A stash a day keeps the mutants away.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash57_description: This is my life savings, so don't touch it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash58_description: Loot for everyone, free, and let no one even think of stealing my shit!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash59_description: One more drop for you, and we’ll call it even.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash5_description: Got too much loot already. Better leave it here and come back later.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash60_description: If you find something here, it means I’m already dead.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash61_description: You’d better look around before diving into this stash.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash62_description: I never managed to haul this stuff to the trader. Now you found it, so it’s your problem.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash63_description: I lost my pals to an anomaly. I’m leaving their stuff here. Wouldn’t want it to go to waste.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash64_description: Congratulations, you found the treasure of the Monolith! Ha ha, just kidding!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash65_description: It’s too much loot! I can’t carry it anymore!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash66_description: This place looks shady, but I guess I have no choice.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash68_description: So, you found it? Well, enjoy it while you can. Asshole.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash69_description: This is my stash. There are many others like it, but this one is mine.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash6_description: I’ve got too much already. I’ll come back for it later... if I’m still alive.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash70_description: If you only knew how little I care about this stuff, you’d cry.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash71_description: How did I end up here — and with a full backpack, no less? Better drop some stuff, or it'll slow me down...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash72_description: What the hell are you hoping to find here, asshole?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash74_description: Go ahead, take it. But you’ll have to pay me back with interest.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash75_description: Easy come, easy go. Take it. The Zone will give me more.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash77_description: If you take what’s mine, you’ll be in my debt for the rest of your life.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash79_description: While you’re trying to get this loot, keep in mind that I’m watching you and laughing my ass off.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash7_description: I’m going to a dangerous place, so I need to travel light.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash80_description: I brought everything you asked for. Now I expect you to do the same. I’ll see you at the meeting place — don’t be late.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash82_description: Leave your payment here, and don’t even think about trying to find me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash83_description: You left me with nothing. I hope you choke on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash85_description: I expect to find your payment in the usual place.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash86_description: For that little favor you did me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash87_description: I know, it’s not nearly enough. But I’ll get you the rest in a couple of days, I swear!
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash88_description: Random stuff to be exchanged for something useful.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash89_description: If you see it, take it. I’m heading back to the Mainland.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash8_description: I got a great haul this time. One more raid, and I can finally retire.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash90_description: Whoever you are, I know you’ve been going through my stashes! You won't get anything of value — I hid all the good stuff someplace safe.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash91_description: This is the last time I save your asses.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash92_description: I’d rather give it to a stalker than let some bandits have it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash93_description: I’m a guide, okay? Stealing my stash would be pretty low.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash94_description: If I catch you with your mitts in the loot, you’ll regret it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash95_description: Congratulations, asshole, you found my stash. I hope you choke on it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash96_description: If I get robbed again, that’s it, I’m joining the bandits.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash97_description: There’s no safer place for a stash than this.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash98_description: This'll come in handy on my way back.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash99_description: One man’s trash is my treasure.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Gen_Stash9_description: I need to remember where I hid it...
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_SQ01_Stash_description: Those greedy bastards won’t get a single coupon from me. I left a stash in case I get cornered. I’m gonna shoot them one by one.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_SQ03_Stash_MastifReward_desc: Hopefully I'll find it all here when I get back from the Slag Heap.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_SQ05_ShakhStash_description: I got a gun delivered from the Mainland. What a beaut! Cost me an arm and a leg, though. I’m putting a couple of goons to protect it from stalker scum before I have a chance to put it to good use.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_SQ10_MonolithStashSPO_descri: May those who first hear the voice of the Monolith equip themselves in order to defend it.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_SQ47_ZaharBabajStash_descrip: There's a lot of people at the Garbage — plenty of fools for my share. But a stash for a rainy day is never a bad idea. Just in case someone slips away
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_SQ86_Stash_GenijCache_descri: The underground area beneath the Concrete Forest is one hell of a maze. I stashed some goods by the wooden spool under the stairs. It’s a secure spot... as long as no one’s tailing me.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_SQ89_ZhgutCache_description: I left another backpack on the train by the Curved Bridge. It’s a well-known place, so the backpack has to get picked up real soon. Good thing it’s not far from the store.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Swamp_OldChurch_1_Stash_desc: A stash like this saved me once. Maybe this one will save a life too.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_Swamp_SunkenTugBoat_2_Stash_: No one will think to look here.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_TestEQ_Stash_Dima_Moose_desc: Сталкер оставил здесь часть добычи, чтобы вернуться за ней позднее.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_supack_SQ100_MapMarkerAltern: Kazkovyi is not broadcasting anymore. What's happening out there now?
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_supack_SQ102_CherepStash_Var: A stash for the last mission. Get it done, and I'll talk to S as promised. He knows how to hide from the Ward and the ones above them, especially on the Mainland. Don't let me down. Nord.
You know what's at stake. We need to stay off the radar until their secrets are uncovered. Kill everyone who could expose us. Don't let me down. Nord.

Last shipment. Smart – leaving Nord before the event. To hell with the laboratory, we only need the technology. Get rid of everyone who knows about it, and I'll teach you to hide from our enemies on the Mainland. Chekhov.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_supack__SQ98_MedulinStash_de: You have to be prepared for anything in the Zone. The stash is in one of the two wagons on the railway tracks. It even has enough medkits to patch up a small crew.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_stashes_supack__SQ99_ShelmaStash_des: Rascal, your financial investment is behind the box in the booth. This time, be careful with the tripwire. Take it only if absolutely necessary.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_nvgpack_tutorial_note_:
Sprinting, jumping, and climbing over obstacles drain your stamina, especially on rough terrain.

To recover it, slow down or stop for a quick rest. An Energy drink or Water will also restore stamina.

Energy drinks provide a quick stamina boost and keep you awake, which is vital in dangerous situations. Be aware, however: frequent use can be harmful to your health.

Consuming too many at once will cause hand tremors, making it harder to aim. Furthermore, long-term use leads to habituation, reducing their effect.

Water, on the other hand, is completely safe. It's useful for long sorties into the Zone and can stave off hunger for a time. Nevertheless, veteran stalkers are habituated to energy drinks, downing them like water without a second thought for the consequences.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_artifact: When used, some artifacts continuously accumulate radiation in your body. Artifacts are enigmatic objects with peculiar physical properties found exclusively within the Zone, usually inside anomalous fields. 
Their effects vary, ranging from beneficial to detrimental, or even completely unpredictable. It’s up to each stalker to decide whether to use them or sell them to the highest bidder. 
If you want to use an artifact, you need to put it in a specialized equipment slot.
