ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_radiatio:
Radiation is one of the most dangerous things in the Zone. Close proximity to radioactive objects results in cumulative radiation exposure. The crackling sound emitted by your Geiger counter will alert you to a radiation hazard. 
You can mitigate radiation exposure in two ways: using anti-radiation medication, or resorting to the folk remedy of alcohol.
<item><item>

Radiation is one of the main dangers in the Zone. Exposure builds up near radioactive objects. A Geiger counter's crackling will warn you of dangerous radiation levels.
If you suddenly feel exhausted and can barely run — check your Geiger counter: if it’s over 50%, you’re in trouble!

There are two ways to reduce radiation exposure: either use antirad, or go the old-fashioned way — drink alcohol.

<item><item>
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_reputati:
The Zone is home to a number of factions bound together by ideology, a shared dark history, a need for protection, or their perspectives on the Zone and its future.
Your standing with a given faction as either friend or foe is determined by your reputation.
Helping stalkers affiliated with a specific faction positively impacts your reputation and strengthens your relations with them.
Hostile actions have the opposite effect, souring your reputation and lowering the faction’s opinion of you.
If your reputation with a faction that was once neutral deteriorates to a critical level, the members of that faction may become hostile. A hostile faction will make an effort to kill you whenever you cross paths.
Over time, the faction’s anger will diminish. They’ll refrain from attacking you on sight, yet continue treating you with animosity.
However, it is possible to mend your relations and reclaim a neutral reputation. This involves locating the faction’s leader at their camp and negotiating with them. However, keep in mind that certain stalker factions might have several leaders and multiple camps.

The game is also saved on exit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_sleepine:
Over time, drowsiness builds up. A sleepy stalker is a poor fighter. He has less stamina, can carry less weight, aims worse, and shoots less accurately.
The best way to recover is to get some sleep.

It’s best to sleep in a safe spot. Hopefully with a bed or a mattress.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_stealth_:
Staying unseen is a valuable advantage when crossing ways with enemies.

Equip a knife and sneak up on your target. When a stealth kill becomes available, your character will adjust their grip on the knife. You can then use <input> to quickly and silently take the enemy down.

A headshot against an unalerted human enemy is almost always lethal. If you kill an ally without witnesses, friendly characters won’t accuse you of the act.

If enemies find the body of a memeber of their group, they may raise an alarm and start hunting for the killer. To hide a body, pick it up <input> and move it out of sight.

Stealth allows you to either avoid combat or initiate it more effectively. Crouching <input> will slow you down and make you quieter. Turning off your flashlight <input> can make you less visible in the dark.

<image>
The detection indicator fills up when enemies notice signs of your presence and empties when they lose sight of you. If an enemy notices something suspicious, they may investigate the area. If they don't find an immediate threat, they will return to their routine. Silently eliminating an enemy before they alarm others helps you stay undetected.

<image>
The noise indicator shows how much noise you are making while moving. Noise draws attention, encouraging enemies to actively search for its source.

Mutants tend to rely on their sense of smell, making it much harder to catch them by surprise.

Certain upgrades from a technician might be locked until you’ve completed previous upgrades or obtained specific items required for those upgrades.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_trade_te:
Traders deal in a variety of supplies, including weapons, ammunition, gear, food, and anything else a stalker might need to survive in the Zone. 
Your trading options aren’t confined solely to traders, however – you can also do business with other stalkers from non-hostile factions. Initiate a conversation and choose the “Trade” option to start trading.
Trading is straightforward: place the items you want to purchase in the barter section above the trader’s inventory, while the items you want to sell go into the barter section above your own inventory. Every item has its own value, and the buy-sell balance is calculated automatically.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_wasted_t:
Your gear can deteriorate due to various factors such as wear and tear from regular use or exposure to the hazardous environment of the Zone. This damage compromises the reliability of your equipment, impacting its durability and performance. For instance, damaged weapons become less accurate and more prone to jamming during combat.
By the same token, wear and tear on protective gear weakens its ability to protect against damage.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_tutorialnotes_tutorial_note_weapon_h: Weapons are essential for combat, but not for socializing with friendly stalkers. To hide your weapon, use <input>. Or open the radial menu <input> and select <input>.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_bp_03_description: Expanding the surface area of the armor plate optimizes the distribution of kinetic energy.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_chem_01_a_descriptio: Installed rubber elements serve as chemical protection.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_container_01_a_descr: The artifact container is made of polymer material, significantly reducing the weight of the item.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_container_01_b_descr: A specialized compartment for artifacts. Can be combined with other containers.

A scientific breakthrough employing a field system to contain radiation emissions.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_el_chem_fire_01_desc: The external placement of filters on the gas mask allows for the simultaneous use of multiple filters.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_el_chem_fire_02_desc: Fiberglass is used extensively in equipment utilized by personnel from the Ministry of Emergency Services.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_elecrt_chem_01_a_des: Leather patches reinforce vulnerable areas and extend the service life of the outfit.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_elecrt_chem_01_descr: The dense polyethylene lining ensures protection against both poisonous substances and electric shock.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_elecrt_chem_02_a_des: Insulating most metal elements improves electrical protection and resistance to aggressive chemicals.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_elecrt_chem_02_descr: The integration of Plexiglas fiber and lead mesh in a woven pattern creates a seamless shield protecting against radiation and harmful substances without impeding mobility.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_electr_01_a_descript: A small device that simulates grounding. Developed by the STC Malachite.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_electr_01_descriptio: The inclusion of a thin Constantan layer provides the suit with excellent protection against electricity.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_electr_02_a_descript: Replacing conductive materials in the gear with dielectric counterparts.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_electr_02_descriptio: The soles and gloves are coated with a metamaterial incorporating cavities containing an absolute vacuum.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_bp_01_descriptio: The integration of thin armor sheets that overlap in a scale-like pattern augment the exoskeleton’s resistance to bullets and deterioration.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_bp_02_descriptio: Although titanium is generally considered too heavy for personal protective equipment, it’s a feasible choice for exoskeleton construction.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_dur_stam_01_desc: Mobile protective plates safeguard the joints, preventing overloading and augmenting the overall durability of the armor.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_dur_stam_02_desc: Replaces the steel frame with a lighter titanium counterpart.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_durable_01_descr: The considerable weight of early exoskeletons prompted the gradual replacement of metal components with lighter alternatives made of carbon fiber.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_durable_02_descr: Enhances durability without the added burden of increased weight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_hands_01_descrip: The incorporation of servos helps counteract inertia and stabilizes weapon handling.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_sprint_01_descri: The incorporation of hydraulic amplifiers that enable running is the defining characteristic that separates the fourth generation of exoskeletons from the third.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_sprint_stabilize: With an increased-capacity battery, there is no need for power conservation while operating all servos in the exoskeleton.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_stamina_01_descr: Replaces the helmet with a lightweight version, while preserving the overall quality.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_exo_stamina_02_descr: The formation of ions from molecules of atmospheric air makes it possible to generate what is known as ion wind.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_fire_01_a_descriptio: Filling the suit cavities with special foam reduces the effect of high temperatures on the body.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_fire_01_description: The use of asbestos fabric provided heat protection for twentieth century firefighters.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_ArmUpg_fire_02_a_descriptio: A compact compressor and flexible refrigerant tubes allow for more efficient dissipation of excess thermal energy.

ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_07_description: Enables the bullet to retain energy longer in flight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_08_description: Minimizes the gap between the barrel and the bullet to improve the efficiency of barrel gases.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_08_name: Tin Coating on Barrel’s Inner Surface
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_09_description: Reduces bullet deterioration within the barrel to preserve its intended design characteristics.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_10_description: Replacing the standard barrel with a titanium alternative results in a noticeable reduction in weight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_11_description: Protects the barrel from wear and tear.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_12_description: A barrel attachment designed to reduce spread, improving the lethality of buckshot.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_stvol_13_description: A rifled barrel precludes the use of buckshot, but significantly improves accuracy.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_APB_description: This buttstock improves the pistol’s stability, increasing lethality.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Bull_01_descripti: Installing a longer barrel increases effective weapon range and reduces recoil.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Bull_description: This modification can only be done once, since it involves replacing the barrel and adjusting parts to accommodate the new ammunition type.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_DP12_description: Makes it possible to fire two shots simultaneously.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Gauss_description: A modification that allows you to adjust the scope to the desired distance quickly and easily.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_IWI_description: This modification can only be done once, since it involves replacing the barrel and adjusting parts to accommodate the new caliber. Switching to the new caliber enhances the reliability of the weapon.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_M14_description: Replacing the semi-automatic trigger with an automatic one drastically boosts the rate of fire.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_MP5_description: This modification can only be done once, since it involves replacing the barrel and adjusting parts to accommodate the new caliber. Increases damage.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Maluk_description: This modification can only be done once, since it involves replacing the barrel and adjusting parts to accommodate the new caliber. Significantly increases weapon damage, along with recoil.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_PKP_description: Enables the attachment of a collimator.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_R700_description: A modification that allows you to adjust the scope to the desired distance quickly and easily.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Rem_description: The addition of a magazine feed allows for markedly faster reloading.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Sayga_description: Substituting the semi-automatic trigger with an automatic one drastically boosts the rate of fire.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Tar_description: This modification can only be done once, since it involves replacing the barrel and adjusting parts to accommodate the new caliber. Increases bullet range at the cost of a noticeable increase in spread.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_Upgr_unic_Vector_descriptio: A significant reduction in recoil comes at the cost of a considerable increase in weight.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_myriflepack_Upgr_stvol_16_d: Proper heat treatment of the barrel allows it to endure more without deformation. This makes it possible to use lower-quality ammunition, although firing such rounds will accelerate weapon wear.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_nvgpack_Upgr_gunstock_07_de: The use of bulky night-vision goggles requires the appropriate adjustment of the stock, allowing the shooter to fit the weapon well, even while wearing large goggles.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_nvgpack_Upgrade_Attachment_: Installing a laser device allows you to shoot more accurately from the hip, especially helpful at short distances.
A light laser sight, allowing the shooter to quickly align their aim with the target to be fired at.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_nwpack_GunFora230_Upgrade_B: This modification can only be done once since it involves replacing the barrel to accommodate the new caliber.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_nwpack_Upgr_gunstock_08_des: An improved stock-folding mechanism gives the shooter more control when bracing or switching weapons.
ST_S2BaseGameLocalization.sid_upgrades_nwpack_Upgr_stvol_17_descri: A reinforced barrel is more durable, which enhances the accuracy of automatic fire.
